title: Bois Imperial Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the perfect blend of freshly crushed Thai Basil leaves and Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute, enhanced by the rich, earthy aroma of Haitian Vetiver oil and Georgy wood for a dynamic, woody fragrance. The sophisticated floralcy of Petalia and vibrant Akigala wood provide a majestic and sustainable finish, with the use of upcycled Patchouli and powerful Ambrofix

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Thai Basil, Timut Pepper, Haitian Vetiver, Freesia

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Georgywood

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli, Ambrofix

title: Caden Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Caden Eau de Parfum reflects a journey shaped by destiny, rich with stories, hospitality, and the warmth of human connection. This fragrance captures the spirit of Omani heritage, delivering a welcoming and memorable olfactory experience. Its top notes blend cardamom, saffron, boozy accords, and cade, leading to a heart of cistus, suede, benzoin, and coffee. The base combines tonka, vanilla, labdanum, guaiacwood, and amberwood for a lasting, sophisticated finish.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cardamom, Boozy Notes and Cade oil

Middle notes: Coffee, Benzoin and Suede

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka, Guaiac Wood, Amberwood and Labdanum

title: Blanche Bete Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enchantment of an imaginary garden with Blanche Bête Eau de Parfum. Inspired by a mythical creature, this fragrance features notes of white flowers and opaline light, embodying purity and magic. A symbol of love and mystery, let Blanche Bête's elusive presence transport you to a world beyond the ordinary.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Milk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Mystikal

Middle notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Incense and Mahonial

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Tonka Bean and Cacao

title: Tilia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This scent evokes memories of eternal summers and never-ending holidays. The apricot tones of broom and the powdery heliotrope blend together beautifully, with a touch of velvety jasmine sambac adding depth to the bucolic bouquet. As if shading the brightness of a sunny afternoon, the smoky earthiness of vetiver completes this constellation of floral fragrances. TILIA, named after an imaginary star, is a celebration of joy, simplicity, and positivity.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime (Linden) Blossom, Jasmine Sambac and Broom

Middle notes: Heliotrope, Vetiver and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Ambrofix and Georgywood

title: Tales from Zanzibar Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The debut scent from Tales from Zanzibar, an exclusive fragrance that represents our brand's beginnings and the launch of an exhilarating global expedition. Immerse yourself in the sparkling waters of the opulent turquoise sea, bordered by a soft white sandy beach and the radiant sun above.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Red Mandarin, Pink Pepper, Mint

Middle notes: Coconut, Guava, Cassis

Base notes: Musk Cocktail, Candied Fruits, Ambergris, Transparent Oud, Moss

title: Shine Despite Everything Parfum Intense
body_html:
Shine Despite Everything Parfum Intense is a homage to the legendary Sarah Bernhardt, capturing her flamboyant, avant-gardist, and charismatic traits. The fragrance features a spicy Flamboyant accord, sumptuous Avant-gardist accord, and alluring Charismatic accord with premium ingredients like turmeric, iris, and vanilla. Perfect for those who embrace individuality and boldness.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pimento, Frankincense and Turmeric

Middle notes: Caramel, Ambrofix, Rose and Orris

Base notes: Akigalawood, Coumarin and Madagascar Vanilla

title: Love-O-Matic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Love-O-Matic Eau de Parfum by Room 1015, launched in 2025, offers a sophisticated unisex fragrance experience. It opens with vibrant blackcurrant, lemon, and strawberry notes, creating a fresh and fruity introduction. The heart reveals playful chewing gum nuances balanced with crisp freshness, while the base combines warm ambrette, cedar, and musk for a lasting, elegant finish. This expertly crafted scent suits those seeking a modern, dynamic fragrance that seamlessly blends sweetness with depth.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Strawberry, Blackcurrant and Lemon

Middle notes: Ozonic notes and Bubble Gum

Base notes: Musk, Ambrette and Cedar

title: Nuit de Bakelite Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Nuit de Bakélite by Naomi Goodsir represents a sophisticated exploration of floral and green accords, crafted by renowned perfumer Isabelle Doyen and introduced in 2017. This unisex fragrance opens with a crisp, verdant composition featuring galbanum, tomato leaf, angelica, and violet leaf—creating an immediate sense of natural freshness and botanical intrigue. The heart reveals a lush floral tapestry where tuberose and ylang-ylang intertwine with the delicate powdery facets of orris, complemented by the subtle spice of cardamom and the earthy warmth of carrot seeds and karo karounde. These middle notes establish the fragrance's distinctive character, balancing opulent florals with unexpected aromatic depth. The base anchors the composition with a refined blend of artemisia, leather, and tobacco, grounded by the woody resonance of guaiac wood and the resinous warmth of styrax and labdanum. This foundation provides lasting sophistication and complexity, ensuring the fragrance evolves gracefully throughout the day. Nuit de Bakélite is ideal for those seeking a modern, gender-neutral fragrance that transcends conventional floral boundaries, offering both artistic expression and wearable elegance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Galbanum, Tomato Leaf, Angelica and Violet Leaf

Middle notes: Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang, Orris, Carrot Seeds, Karo Karounde and Cardamom

Base notes: Artemisia, Leather, Styrax, Tobacco, Guaiac Wood and Labdanum

title: Meydan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dubai Meydan is an oriental fragrance that draws inspiration from the aristocratic Arabian stallion and the lush green fields of the playground. It features a breathtaking blend of grapefruit, bergamot, tobacco, agarwood, cedarwood, and leather, with a hint of vetiver for a romantic touch.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Amber, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Lavender, Artemisia, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Cypress, Saffron, Bergamot, Apple, Nutmeg, Styrax

Middle notes: Tobacco, Kharismal, Cashmeran, Jasmine, Muguet, Geranium, Agarwood, Labdanum, Cedarwood, Cyprus

Base notes: Oud, Musk, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Leather, Gajak, Vanilla, Tonka, Vetiver, Amber, Benzoin/tolu

title: Ingenious Ginger Parfum
body_html:
Experience an instant sense of nature in Ingenious Ginger Parfum, a solar perfume featuring sun-kissed mandarin, spicy ginger, white florals, and warm, enveloping amber. This unique fragrance captures the essence of the unscented torch ginger lily flower, abundant in the wet tropics, and incorporates Australian Red Back Ginger as an olfactory material. Be transported to a blissful and sultry destination with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger flower, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Mandarin Orange, Magnolia, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Musk and Patchouli

title: Anelo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Anelo — Pernoire is a vibrant and uplifting fragrance that celebrates the energy of sun-ripened fruits wrapped in refined woody warmth. Bright, modern, and effortlessly elegant, the composition captures the feeling of endless summer days, balancing sparkling citrus freshness with exotic tropical sweetness and an earthy, sophisticated dry down. It opens with the juicy brightness of freshly sliced pineapple, pomelo, and mandarin, creating an invigorating burst of fruity freshness. At its heart, luscious mango blends seamlessly with the gentle spice of ginger and the creamy elegance of magnolia, adding depth and a radiant floral character. As the fragrance settles, dry amber, vetiver, and patchouli emerge to create a smooth, warm, and subtly earthy base that enhances the fragrance's lasting sophistication. The interplay between vibrant fruits, delicate florals, and refined woods results in a fragrance that is joyful, elegant, and irresistibly captivating.

Fragrance Family: Fruity, Woody, Amber

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Freshly Sliced Pineapple, Pomelo, Mandarin
Heart Notes: Mango, Ginger, Magnolia
Base Notes: Dry Amber, Vetiver, Patchouli

title: Bal d'Afrique Absolu de Parfum
body_html:
Bal d'Afrique Absolu de Parfum draws from founder Ben Gorham’s deep personal ties to Africa, inspired by his father’s journeys and life on the continent. This fragrance reinterprets Bal d’Afrique by amplifying its gourmand character, creating a striking balance between lively brightness and profound richness. The scent opens with vivid notes of bergamot, lemon, and blackcurrant, seamlessly blending into a sweet heart of praline, musk, and violet, and settling into a bold, warm base of cedar, vetiver, and black amber, delivering a more intense and captivating aroma.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blackcurrant, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Praline, Musk and Violet

Base notes: Black Amber, Cedarwood and Vetiver

title: Gozo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Gozo Extrait de Parfum is a refined floral scent enriched with robust woody and spicy nuances, designed for both men and women. Crafted by perfumer Vanina Muracciole, this exclusive fragrance pays homage to the Maltese island of Gozo, renowned for its enchanting and distinctive character. Reflecting centuries of cultural intersections—from Phoenician to Roman influences—Gozo captures a unique blend of history and nature. The perfume combines vibrant notes of Tuberose, Geranium, and Cedarwood with the mysterious allure of White Musk, resulting in a sophisticated, enduring fragrance with a captivating and complex trail.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Tuberose, Bergamot

Middle notes: Cedarwood, Violet Leaves and Geranium

Base notes: Patchouli, Ambroxan and White Musk

title: Triumph Of Bacchus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Roman god Bacchus, also known as Eleutherios, was revered as the god of wine making, fertility, ritual madness, theater, and religious ecstasy. He was one of the twelve Olympians, often called "the liberator" for his ability to free mortals from societal restraints through his wine, music, and ecstatic dance. Represented by Triumph Of Bacchus (Trionfo Di Bacco), this luxurious fragrance exudes grandeur and mystery. A blend of spicy saffron, royal green apple, and rhum creates an exotic opening, while confident tobacco combined with oriental and vanilla notes reveal a powerful and seductive aphrodisiac.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, White Peach, Green Apple and Saffron

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Vetiver and Jasmine

Base notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Musc K Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Musc K originates in the Maranhão landscape, where the pure white sands of the wind-shaped dunes contrast with the various crystal-clear shades of blue, such as aquamarine, turquoise, and emerald green of the lagoons. Beginning with a salty breeze of sand lily, Musc K opens with a crisp and invigorating scent. Following the rhythm of the wind, its notes of white pepper on sand combine with a heart of salty iris and mangrove driftwood. The fragrance reaches its peak with a crescendo of vetiver grown in sand and Ambrofix™, effortlessly ending its journey with a delicate, airy cloud of white musk, reminiscent of the pristine sands of the dunes.

Fragrance family: Musk, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink pepper, sand lily

Middle notes: Orris oil, cedarwood

Base notes: Haitian vetiver fraction oil, musk

title: Garcon Manque Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This captivating Garcon Manque Eau de Parfum features the natural essences of both Gentle Osmanthus Absolute and Infusion, expertly balanced with the alluring intensity of Grasse Leather.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Osmanthus

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Leather

title: Comme des Garçons 2 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Comme des Garçons 2 Eau de Parfum explores the interplay of contrasts—sharpness against opacity, reflection alongside radiance, light meeting shadow, and earth blending with sunlight. Its fresh top notes feature aldehyde, orange blossom, mandarin, vetiver, and cumin. The chypre heart is enriched by black tea, patchouli, amber, and labdanum, creating a sophisticated and complex fragrance experience.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: aldehyde, angelica, galbanum, mandarin, orange, violet leaf

Middle notes: carnation, freesia, jasmine, magnolia, rose

Base notes: amber, cedar, labdanum cistus, leather, musk, patchouli, vetiver

title: Guidance Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Guidance offers a unique and captivating take on the classic Amouage trilogy of Rose, Frankincense, and Ambergris. With poetic undertones, a comforting scent, and a sense of enlightenment, it is a fragrance that inspires.

Amouage is honoured to have won the following prestigious awards for Guidance:

  • Belgian Beauty Awards: Best Perfume in High Luxury Award 2024
  • French Fragrance Foundation Awards: Best Niche Fragrance 2024
  • US BeautyMatter NEXT Awards: Best Breakthrough Product (Fragrance) 2024.

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Frankincense, Hazelnut

Middle notes: Saffron, Rose, Jasmine Sambac, Osmanthus

Base notes: Cistus, Sandalwood, Akigalawood, Ambergris, Vanilla

title: Bianco Latte Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bianco Latte Eau de Parfum is a beloved scent that evokes nostalgic memories. Its blend of vanilla, milk, and honey creates a warm and comforting aroma that transports you to a world of love and sweetness. Experience this best-selling fragrance and be enveloped in a gentle and tender embrace.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caramel

Middle notes: Coumarin and Honey

Base notes: Vanilla and White Musk

title: Ambre Latte Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ambre Latte Eau de Parfum is a warm, creamy, and irresistibly comforting gourmand fragrance that blends rich amber, velvety milk accords, and sweet woods into a luxurious and enveloping composition. It opens with a soft burst of caramelized sweetness and delicate spicy nuances, creating an immediate sensation of warmth, indulgence, and cozy sophistication. The heart unfolds into a creamy accord of milky notes and smooth amber facets, adding depth, softness, and an addictive gourmand richness that feels both elegant and comforting. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a sensual base of vanilla, sandalwood, musk, and warm resins, leaving a creamy, sweet, and long-lasting trail that feels intimate, soothing, and deeply addictive.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caramelized sweetness, soft spices
Middle notes: Milky accords, amber facets
Base notes: Vanilla, sandalwood, musk, warm res

title: Summer Hammer Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a burst of summer all year round with Summer Hammer Extrait de Parfum. This exotic fragrance combines the freshness of mango pinacolada with warm tropical vibes, a floral bouquet, and a creamy sandalwood base. Keep your spirits high and embrace a carefree attitude with this playful scent.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Pineapple, Coconut, Bergamot and White Rum

Middle notes: Coconut Milk, White Flowers and Marine notes

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Amber and Vetiver

title: Hibiscus Mahajad Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the vibrant and sophisticated notes of the Hibiscus Mahajád Extrait de Parfum. Crafted in collaboration with perfumer Quentin Bisch, this luxurious fragrance celebrates the hibiscus flower and its explorative nature. With a blend of earthy leather and airy vanilla, experience a rich and complex scent that will elevate your fragrance game. Discover your new signature scent today.

Fragrance family: Floral, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose Damascena Absolute, Vanilla Absolute

Middle notes: Vanilla Absolute, Leather, Spearmint Essential Oil, Cassis

Base notes: Ambrette Seeds Absolute, Cinnamon Essential Oil

title: Vanilla Powder Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vanilla Powder's unique blend of Palo Santo Oil from Ecuador provides a strong foundation and heightened dimension. The alluring scent of Vanilla is intensified with the addition of Coconut powder. White Musks harmoniously wrap the Vanilla and powders, resulting in a modern and radiant fragrance. Made with Vanilla Absolute from Madagascar through the Fair for Life agricultural program, this distinctive perfume offers a striking contrast between dark vanilla and white Palo Santo wood.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut Powder and Heliotrope

Middle notes: Madagascar Vanilla

Base notes: Vanilla Absolute, White Musk, Musk, Palo Santo, Lactones and Coconut

title: Oud Cadenza Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the captivating Oud Cadenza Extrait de Parfum, a collaboration between Maison Crivelli and perfumer Jordi Fernandez. Experience a unique blend of oud with a date and toasted cane sugar accord, inspired by Thibaud Crivelli's adventure of smelling oud at a hidden party in a palm grove. Indulge in the surprising contrast of this exquisite fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Ginger, Nutmeg and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Dates, Caramel, Agarwood (Oud), Sugar Cane, Incense, Amberwood, Myrrh and Davana

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka, Cacao Butter, Leather, Musk, Benzoin, Labdanum, Patchouli and Mate

title: Bahar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The fragrance of Bahar Eau de Parfum contains a rich blend of vanilla, amber, rose, and jasmine, evoking the depths of the sea. At the same time, notes of lime, lemon, marine and aquatic scents add a refreshing touch, reminiscent of a cool ocean breeze. Experience the awakening of wonder and possibility with this aquatic-woody scent

Fragrance family: Aquatic Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Bitter Orange, Plum, Aquatic Notes, Coconut, Violet Leaves Absolute, Spicy Notes, Ozonic Notes, Lime, Marine Note, Apple, Pineapple, Blackcurrant, Strawberry, Raspberry, Cherry, Mandarin, Green Note, Bergamot, Clary Sage, Grapefruit, Cardamom, Ginger

Middle notes: Rose, Jasmine, Saffron, Cedarwood, Cashmere, Sandal, Vanilla Berries, Iris, Fir, Lotus Flower, Cyclamen

Base notes: Amber, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk, Patchouli, Precious Woods, Immortelle, Oudh, Vetiver

title: Nostos Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Nostos eau de parfum by Etat Libre d'Orange explores the ancient Greek concept of nostalgia, using the top note of incense to evoke celebratory rituals. With its blend of mandarin, Turkish rose, jasmine, saffron, and sandalwood, this fragrance transports the wearer back to memories of endless summers, emphasizing the power of scent to trigger nostalgia.

 

Fragrance family: Spicy, Leatherr

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Essence of Enscens , Essence of Mandarin, Saffron

Middle notes: Essence and Absolu de Rose Turque, Absolu de Jasmin, Accord Oud

Base notes: Sandalwood, Georgie wood, Ambrofix, Suede, Musk

title: Wanderlust Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wanderlust Eau de Parfum captures the essence of a free-spirited and adventurous soul. It begins with fresh-cut grass combined with bright notes of bergamot, lemon, and black currant, layered with a subtle spicy mix of pink pepper, cinnamon, and saffron. The fragrance settles into a woody drydown featuring cedar and guaiac wood, enriched by hints of olibanum and a delicate fig accord.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Black Currant, Saffron and Cinnamon

Base notes: Cedar, Guaiac Wood and Olibanum

title: Akigala Mandarino Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Akigala Mandarino by New Notes is a unisex Floral Fruity scent introduced in 2024. It opens with vibrant top notes of Mandarin, Apple, and Raspberry, followed by a heart of Jasmine, Freesia, and Lily of the Valley. The fragrance settles into a warm base of Akigalawood and Amber, creating a sophisticated and balanced aroma.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Apple and Raspberry

Middle notes: Jasmine, Freesia and Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Akigalawood and Amber

title: Morocco Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Morocco Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of prosperity, conjuring images of stunning landscapes explored either atop a camel or in the luxury of a Mercedes SUV. This fragrance embodies wealth, generosity, and abundance. Inspired by a sophisticated Arab sheikh who blends Arabic and European notes, it offers a rich, elegant sweetness accented by warm spices, almond, and walnut. Evoking warm hospitality and opulence, this scent suits both business settings and intimate occasions, adding a confident, masculine touch that enhances your daily presence.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot and Aromatic Notes

Middle notes: Vanilla Flower, Vanilla, Lavender and Freesia

Base notes: Amber, Sandalwood, Musk and Tonka Bean

title: Vanille Havane Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vanille Havane by Les Indémodables, crafted by perfumer Antoine Lie, offers a deep exploration of vanilla’s complex character. Moving beyond the typical sweet notes found in many vanilla scents, this fragrance highlights the rich, dark essence of authentic vanilla bean. Lie’s creation unfolds with layers of rum, dried fruits, cocoa, cigar, and dark florals, all resting on a warm ambery leather foundation, delivering an intoxicating and multifaceted interpretation of vanilla.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tobacco, Rum, Cacao

Middle notes: Vanilla, Dried Fruits

Base notes: Amber, Leather, Floral Notes

title: Valaya Exclusif Parfum
body_html:
This elegant fragrance, created by Julien Sprecher, exudes both a radiant aura and a delicate softness. A unique combination of floral, musky, and woody notes, it plays on codes, materials, and subtle contrasts. Like a gentle caress on the skin, it evokes cotton with its blend of fresh top notes including bergamot, mandarin, and sweet white peach, followed by a mix of white flowers and settling on sensual base notes of musk and ambrofix

Fragrance family: Floral, Musky, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Peach

Middle notes: Orange Flower, Nympheal, Vetiver

Base notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix, Musk

title: Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Exude elegance and sophistication with Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum by Diptyque. This luxurious fragrance combines the warm notes of musk, the woody essence of Iris, and the sweet aroma of ambrette seeds. Elevate your signature scent with this captivating blend.

Fragrance family: Woody, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Pink Pepper, Angelica and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris and Turkish Rose

Base notes: Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Carrot, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Leather and Amberwood

title: Impadia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
An enchanting day filled with regal grandeur, exuding a sense of refinement and grace. A unique blend of woody and creamy notes that leave a captivating trail on the skin. Luxurious rose absolute complemented by essences of mandarin and bergamot on a mesmerizing base of black vanilla. A vibrant display of orangey-pink hues, from sunrise to sunset. A homage to the exquisite gardens of Paris, where the essence of blooming flowers encapsulates the essence of the city.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Bergamot and Mandarin

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose and African Orange Flower

Base notes: Akigalawood, Vanilla Absolute and Sandalwood

title: Sous les Pins Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sous les Pins — Chloé is a fresh, tranquil, and nature-inspired fragrance that evokes the serenity of walking through a sunlit pine forest, blending aromatic woods, green nuances, and soft earthy accords into a refined and atmospheric composition. It opens with a crisp burst of pine needles and fresh aromatic facets, creating an immediate sensation of cool forest air, clarity, and natural elegance. The heart unfolds into a smooth woody-green accord enriched with subtle herbal nuances, adding depth, calmness, and an understated sophistication that feels meditative and contemporary. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a soft base of cedarwood, earthy woods, musk, and resinous undertones, leaving a clean, woody, and long-lasting trail that feels grounding, serene, and effortlessly refined.

Fragrance family: Woody, Green, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Pine needles, fresh aromatics
Middle notes: Woody accords, herbal nuances
Base notes: Cedarwood, earthy woods, musk, resinous undertones

title: Hypnotizing Fire Parfum
body_html:
Hypnotizing Fire Parfum captivates with a warm, inviting blend that soothes like a gentle flame. This expert-crafted fragrance combines the rich sweetness of Madagascan Vanilla and Benzoin with delicate Bulgarian Rose, earthy Indonesian Patchouli, and vibrant Pimento Berries from Jamaica. Its balanced, glowing composition offers a restorative and enchanting experience, perfect for those seeking a refined and sensual scent that nurtures both body and spirit.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pimento, Cloves and Peppertree

Middle notes: Patchouli, Bulgarian Rose and Praline

Base notes: Vanilla, Opoponax and Benzoin

title: This Is Not Gaba Parfum
body_html:
Embrace calmness with Gaba Parfum, expertly designed to relax the mind and wrap the body in soothing tranquility. Let go of daily stress and negative energy as this captivating fragrance leads you into a lasting state of peaceful bliss, harmonizing your body and soul in serene balance.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Mandarin, Orange and Lavender

Middle notes: Osmanthus and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Ambroxan, Akigalawood and Musk

title: Orpheon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the irresistible aroma of Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum. The rich blend of tobacco, blusher and burnished wood creates a warm and familiar ambiance. With notes of tonka bean, cedar and juniper berries, this scent will transport you to a place of unforgettable memories.

Fragrance family: Woody, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper Berries

Middle notes: Jasmine

Base notes: Powdery Notes, Cedar and Tonka Bean

title: Bois Imperial Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Bois Imperial Extrait De Parfum by Essential Parfums is an aromatic unisex fragrance launched in 2024, featuring the work of perfumer Quentin Bisch. With a concentrated formulation of 32%, it utilizes alcohol from beetroot and avoids artificial coloring, using 87% natural ingredients. The scent begins with an electrifying burst of black pepper and timut berry, gradually revealing a floral heart of rose absolute. Its lasting trail is a unique blend of refined cedar, leathery notes, and liqueur-like fir balsam and labdanum. With exceptional longevity, Bois Imperial Extrait exudes a captivating and irresistible woody, balmy aroma that lingers long into the night.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Thai Basil, Timut Pepper, Haitian Vetiver, Freesia

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Georgywood

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli, Ambrofix

title: Turath Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the essence of ancient cultures as you journey through the land. Immerse yourself in the poetic beauty of the Mu’allaqat, the narrative splendour of the One Thousand and One Nights, and the enchanting flavors of Arabian cuisine with Turath Eau de Parfum. Featuring a blend of bergamot, rose damascene, jasmine, and vanilla, combined with earthy notes of patchouli and leather, enhanced by the alluring scents of ambergris and smoky nuances.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Pineapple, Strawberry, Peach, Coconut, Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper, Pepper Nepal, Bergamot, Cumin, Cinnamon, Sweet Orange, Spicy Notes, Rose Damascene, Cardamom, Coffee, Dried Fruits, Candied Fruit

Middle notes: Jasmine, Lily of the Valley, Iris, Amyris, Cedarwood, Oud, Coriander, Violet, Rose, Saffron, Cypriol, Sandal

Base notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Guaiacwood, Vetiver, Tolu Balsam, Peru Balsam, Leather, Smoky Notes, Cistus, Labdanum, Incense, Civet, White Musk, Ambergris, Vanilla, Mosses, Amber, Oakmoss

title: Van Py Rhum Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the warm, elegant story of Van Py Rhum Extrait de Parfum. Drops of rum and soft vanilla create a mellow, intoxicating scent, while notes of shadowy Patchouli and white flowers add depth and intrigue. Experience the sophistication and allure of this exquisite fragrance.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Madagascar Vanilla, Tahitian Vanilla, Vanilla, Rum and Tonka Bean

Middle notes: Vanilla, Caramel, Patchouli and White Flowers

Base notes: Black Vanilla Husk, Rum, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Speachless Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
If Speachless were a melody, it would be pure rock: bold, unrestrained, and impossible to ignore. It hits your senses like a powerful wave, instantly shifting your mood. This fragrance isn’t subtle background noise—it’s the anthem of your fearless, confident self. Opening with a vibrant burst of citrus—sharp, juicy, and electric—it quickly blends with a daring mix of peach, raw cannabis, and cool vetiver. More than a scent, Speachless commands attention, embodying freedom and raw emotion. It doesn’t just accompany you; it defines you.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sweet Orange, Bergamot, Pink Grapefruit, Lemon, Lychee, Lime, Peach, Citron Zest, Apple, Ginger, Green Tea

Middle notes: Peach Blossom, Tabacchera Peach, Nectarine, Osmanthus, Jasmine, Heliotrope, Rose, Violet, Magnolia, Rosemary, Absinth, Verbena, Lavender, Clary Sage

Base notes: Cannabis, Patchouli, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Elemi, Ambrette Seed, Vanilla Pod, White Musk

title: Meant To Be Seen Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
A fragrance designed to illuminate your presence when you feel overlooked. Meant to Be Seen captures those moments of invisibility and transforms them into quiet confidence. The composition opens with the luminous clarity of bergamot and violet's tender elegance, establishing an immediate sense of awakening. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of iris butter, moxalone, and civettone—a creamy, animalic foundation that translates vulnerability into refined strength. This Extrait de Parfum is a sensory declaration that your essence merits recognition, offering both delicate refinement and unwavering presence in a single, powerful composition.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orris Root, Moxalone and Civettone

Base notes: Akigalawood, Ambrettolide, Sandalwood and Sesame

title: Bois Imperial Collector Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the perfect blend of freshly crushed Thai Basil leaves and Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute, enhanced by the rich, earthy aroma of Haitian Vetiver oil and Georgy wood for a dynamic, woody fragrance. The sophisticated floralcy of Petalia and vibrant Akigala wood provide a majestic and sustainable finish, with the use of upcycled Patchouli and powerful Ambrofix

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Thai Basil, Timut Pepper, Haitian Vetiver, Freesia

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Georgywood

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli, Ambrofix

title: Ganymede Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A young opus that has already become a key player in the current niche perfume landscape. Ganymede is a magnificent fragrance that plays on an unexpected contrast to become the signature of a new fresh and mineral elegance... The scent moves from notes of mandarin to the spicy and slightly salty notes of the immortelle flower, to sublimate an almost metallic mineral leather... A windswept ocean of salt water, a mythical aesthetic.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Italian Mandarin

Middle notes: Chinese Osmanthus, Immortelle and Violet Leaf

Base notes: Mineral notes, Suede, Akigalawood, Musk, Cedar and Patchouli

title: Liquide Eau de Parfum
body_html:
LIQUIDE embodies the captivating essence of the Tarot's transformative odyssey, through alchemic marvels and mystical notes of Mandarin, Saffron, Carrot Seed, and Coriander Seed. Journey through a tapestry of exotic warmth and ancient wisdom with this enchanting fragrance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Solar Notes, Orange Blossom, Carrot Seeds, Jasmine and Coriander

Base notes: Vanilla, White Musk, Ambroxan, Labdanum, Woody Notes and Patchouli

title: Decision Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Beginning with a sharp scent that commands attention, Decision Eau de Parfum eliminates any uncertainties through a blend of refreshing woods and bright citrus notes. Frankincense, Bergamot, Myrrh, and Juniper Berries lend their signature coolness to the mix. As the scent unfolds, a radiant Atlas Cedarwood adds to the luminosity, while a rich base of warm Vanilla evokes the feeling of liberation and acceptance. Bold, unique, and radiant, Decision embodies the paradox that is inherent in every significant decision: staying determined towards a goal while remaining open to endless potential paths.

Fragrance family: Fresh, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Cardamom

Middle notes: Frankincense, Juniper, Myrrh

Base notes: Patchouli, Cedarwood, Vanilla

title: Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the captivating allure of Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum. Crafted by Ex Nihilo to celebrate a decade of excellence, this fragrance is a symphony of premium raw materials. Experience the sublime blend of scents that transcends the senses. Elevate your senses with Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Ginger

Middle notes: Orange Blossom and Georgywood

Base notes: Ambrofix, Musk, Akigalawood and Cedar

title: Scarlet Sands Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the magic of Dubai at dusk with Scarlet Sands Eau de Parfum. This exquisite fragrance from Ex Nihilo captures the enchanting atmosphere of the city as it transforms under a red-light sunset. With notes of raspberry, jasmine, and amber, it leaves a captivating trail that lingers through the night until dawn. Indulge in the unexpected facets of this luxurious scent.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Raspberry

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Freesia

Base notes: Akigala Wood, Vanilla, Amber

title: Valaya Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This elegant fragrance, created by Julien Sprecher, exudes both a radiant aura and a delicate softness. A unique combination of floral, musky, and woody notes, it plays on codes, materials, and subtle contrasts. Like a gentle caress on the skin, it evokes cotton with its blend of fresh top notes including bergamot, mandarin, and sweet white peach, followed by a mix of white flowers and settling on sensual base notes of musk and ambrofix

Fragrance family: Floral, Musky, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Peach

Middle notes: Orange Flower, Nympheal, Vetiver

Base notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix, Musk

title: Brioni Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Expertly tailored for sensuality and opulence. The impeccable complement to formal evening attire, this perfume is a sophisticated scent that adds an understated touch of luxury. Its aromatic blend of Italian citrus oils, peppery bergamot, and juicy mandarin opens with cool sophistication. A refined touch of earthy patchouli is followed by rich saffron and a hint of green apple. The woody and spicy notes of oud, warm Ambroxan, and suave vanilla add depth and mystery to the scent's dry down, creating an alluring and sensual experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Tangerine, Calabrian bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Green Apple, Patchouli and Saffron

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla and Ambroxan

title: The Musc Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Musc Eau de Parfum, launched in 2018 by Essential Parfums, is a gender-neutral Woody Floral Musk scent. Created by renowned perfumer Calice Becker, this fragrance offers a delicate mix of fresh, honeyed, and warm notes. Red ginger from Laos and natural lavandin grosso from France provide a crisp opening, while sustainably-sourced beeswax and pure Nirvanolide musk exude a creamy sweetness in the heart. The blend is completed with the addition of natural sandalwood from Australia, adding a touch of warmth and woodiness.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Musk, Beeswax

Middle notes: Lavender

Base notes: Sandalwood, Ginger

title: Fire At Will Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fire At Will Eau de Parfum, created by independent perfumer Vanina Murraciole, blends vanilla and mimosa to balance intensity with subtlety and seduction with charm. It opens with a delicate, airy vanilla paired with honeyed, powdery mimosa, leading to a gourmand yet light vanilla reminiscent of creamy ice cream and soft, sweet whispers. This distinctive fragrance leaves a captivating trail that draws attention and highlights the wearer’s presence. Perfect for those who want to be remembered, it serves as a signature by day and an alluring embrace by night, leaving an unforgettable trace even in absence.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla and Mimosa

Middle notes: Vanilla and Brown sugar

Base notes: Amber, Musk and Vetiver

title: Fleur du Mal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fleur du Mal Eau de Parfum, created by Dries Van Noten, boasts a complex aroma featuring the osmanthus flower known for its contradictory nature. While appearing delicate and pure, it can also evoke wild and powerful sensations. Notes of ripe peach and a velvety suede base only enhance the floral center. Plus, the refillable spliced bottles ensure a lasting enjoyment of this signature scent.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach

Middle notes: Osmanthus and Jasmine

Base notes: Suede and Amber

title: Flamenco Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the intense emotions and passionate character of Andalusian culture with Flamenco Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the wild gestures, fiery foot stamping, and soulful laments of flamenco, this fragrance is a manifestation of the art form. Notes of orange flower, rose, and jasmine are interwoven with sandal and cedarwood, while saffron, amber, and musk add a touch of sensuality. Embrace the unique state of mind that is flamenco with this captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Apple, Violet and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Rose, Iris and Jasmine

Base notes: Cedar, Cypress, Pine Tree and Amber

title: Guilty Crush Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the seductive and daring fragrance of Guilty Crush Eau de Parfum. Infused with notes of black cherry, wild strawberry, and champagne, this daring scent creates an irresistible aura of confidence and charm. With a creamy and intoxicating base, this perfume adds a touch of color and allows you to embrace your desires and live without regrets. Get ready to be intrigued and captivated by this unique blend of scents.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wild Strawberry, Black Cherry and Champagne

Middle notes: Lipstick, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Benzoin and Cedarwood

title: Delina Exclusif Parfum
body_html:
Experience the extraordinary allure of Delina Exclusif Parfum, a flawless blend of captivating florals and enticing fruits. The shimmering notes of pear, lychee, and grapefruit instantly captivate the senses, while rose damascena, incense, and vetiver form a dazzling heart that exudes beauty. A base of vanilla, musk, and evernyl adds a subtle yet luminous touch to this Parfums de Marly creation, crafted with the finest ingredients

Fragrance family: Amber, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Lychee, Grapefruit

Middle notes: Damascena Rose, Incense, Vetiver

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Evernyl

title: Sun-gria Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the exotic and sophisticated blend of Sun-gria Extrait de Parfum. With top notes of Blood Orange and Cinnamon, middle notes of Red Wine and Turkish Rose, and base notes of Vanilla and Sandalwood, this fragrance is perfect for both men and women. Launched in 2024 by expert nose Lorenzo Pazzaglia.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Cinnamon, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Ginger, Lemon, Pink Pepper, Cloves and Green Notes

Middle notes: Grapes, Red Wine, Raspberry, Black Currant, Peach, Apple, Turkish Rose and Cardamom

Base notes: Brown sugar, Vanilla, Vanilla Bean, Amber, Tonka Bean, Musk, Patchouli, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Cedarwood and Birch

title: Evil Angel Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Evil Angel Extrait de Parfum presents a complex olfactory journey beginning with crisp, ethereal mint notes that evoke a whispering breeze. The composition transitions to reveal sophisticated facets of whiskey and absinthe, creating an adventurous aromatic narrative. The heart unveils a harmonious accord of vanilla-infused myrrh, offering a balanced juxtaposition of sweetness and depth. This expertly crafted fragrance concludes with tranquil floral and woody base notes that provide a serene foundation. The composition masterfully balances contrasting elements—vigor and repose, rebellion and peace—creating an exceptional fragrance experience that evolves from dynamic intensity to contemplative calm.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fruity Notes, Tropical Fruits, Mint, Lime, Citruses, Wormwood, Petitgrain Paraguay, Cashmere Wood, Oak, Musk and Rain Notes

Middle notes: Rum, Citron, Coconut, Cinnamon, Whiskey and Black locust

Base notes: Vanilla, Bourbon Vanilla, Iso E Super, Sandalwood, Cedar, Tobacco and Myrrh

title: Le Patchouli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Le Patchouli Eau de Parfum by Reminiscence represents a masterful interpretation of one of perfumery's most iconic and complex raw materials. This contemporary unisex creation, launched in 2024, showcases the house's expertise in crafting sophisticated woody-oriental compositions that transcend conventional fragrance boundaries.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli and Cedar

Middle notes: Sandalwood and Vetiver

Base notes: Tonka Bean, White Musk, Labdanum, Vanilla and Tolu Balsam

title: Blue Talisman Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Building on the acclaim of the signature Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum, Parisian house EX NIHILO unveils Blue Talisman Extrait de Parfum, an intensified reinterpretation within the elite QUINTESSENCE Collection. Crafted in partnership with master perfumer Jordi Fernández, this extrait offers a richer, more enveloping experience that deepens the original’s essence. Shifting from the initial focus on citrus, amber, and woods, it embraces a fruitier, floral character supported by a dense, ambery foundation, delivering an elevated emotional resonance while honoring its predecessor’s spirit.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Amberwood, Ambrofix™, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Demon Dancer Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Demon Dancer Eau de Parfum — Ex Nihilo is a vibrant woody-amber fragrance inspired by the intensity and freedom of contemporary dance. The composition captures the tension between inner fire and outward expression, combining electrifying rhubarb, luminous citrus, cool peppermint, radiant orange blossom, and modern woody-amber materials. Created by perfumer Jordi Fernández, the fragrance was launched in 2026.

It opens with rhubarb, bergamot, peppermint, and blood orange, creating a sharp, green, sparkling, and refreshing introduction. At its heart, orange blossom and blackcurrant bring a luminous floral character with a subtly tart fruity edge. As the fragrance settles, Georgywood™, Akigalawood™, Ambrofix™, musks, and tonka bean create a warm, diffusive, woody-amber base with a smooth and sensual finish.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Rhubarb,Bergamot,Peppermint,Blood Orange
Heart Notes: Orange Blossom,Blackcurrant
Base Notes: Georgywood™,Akigalawood™,Ambrofix™,Musks,Tonka Bean

title: Risvelium Parfum
body_html:
Experience the Risvelium Parfum, a fragrance that transcends the ordinary and connects the earthly with the ethereal. Drawing from unseen forces, it is a bridge between the tangible and the transcendent, guiding the soul's journey with its intoxicating scent.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit and Bergamot

Middle notes: Blackcurrant and Pineapple

Base notes: Musk, Ambroxan and Amber

title: Blonde Amber Perfume
body_html:
Indulge in the luxurious decadence of Art Deco with our Blonde Amber Eau De Parfum. A warm and spicy blend of amber and blonde tobacco, accented with floral and fruit notes, evokes the opulence of the era. Discover the story of Art Deco through this rich and aromatic scent.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Olibanum, Bitter Orange, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Ginger, Bergamot and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Dried Fruits, White Tobacco, Sandalwood, Tuberose, Saffron, Osmanthus, Jasmine and Orris

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Myrrh, Vanilla, Labdanum, Patchouli, Cedar, Musk and Vetiver

title: Bergamask Parfum
body_html:
Experience the unique aroma of Bergamask Parfum, a captivating blend of bright, fresh citrus and intoxicating animal musk. Let this alluring fragrance intrigue your senses and elevate your mood.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Lemonz

Middle notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom and Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Musk, Cedar and Tonka

title: Acne Studios Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Acne Studios X Frédéric Malle collaboration seamlessly merges the worlds of fashion, perfumery, and art to create a truly unique fragrance experience. Expertly crafted by Suzy Le Helley, the sophisticated blend of peach, orange blossom, aldehyde, and vanilla presents a neoclassical olfactory journey that is both vibrant and comforting, magnetic and bold. Imbued with elegance and refinement, this scent captures the luxurious aesthetic of Acne Studios, promising a sensory journey that is truly unforgettable.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Bergamot and Mandarin

Middle notes: Peach, Orange Blossom, Violet, Rose, Lily of the Valley and Jasmine

Base notes: Sandalwood, Frankincense, Iso E Super, Musk, Vanilla and Heliotrope

title: Cuir Beluga Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cuir Beluga Eau de Parfum, crafted by Olivier Polge, features a blend of mandarin, immortelle flower, leather, amber, heliotrope, and vanilla notes. Its initial burst offers a delightful touch of wild citrus, while its finish is reminiscent of a rich vanilla cream. The leather in Cuir Beluga is exquisitely delicate, smooth, and velvety, without the harsh animalistic undertones often found in leather fragrances. This scent is as luxurious and indulgent as fine leather gloves for women.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tangerine and Aldehydes

Middle notes: Immortelle and Patchouli

Base notes: Vanilla, Suede, Heliotrope and Amber

title: Wonderwood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wonderwood Eau de Parfum captivates with its unconventional design and remarkable development. It offers a mysterious, intense, and luxurious experience, immersing you in a rich world of exquisite woods to deliver the quintessential wood fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: bergamot, mint, nutmeg, pepper

Middle notes: caraway

Base notes: amber, cashmere wood, cedar, guaiac, hinoki, incense, musk

title: Wavechild Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dive into a sensory voyage honoring Surf Culture, capturing the vibrant scents of orange, watermelon, coconut, and orientalgris. Inspired by iconic Huntington Beach and its surf gangs, bikers, and dynamic spirit, Wavechild embodies the essence of surfing as an art form. This fragrance delivers a pure, unfiltered surge of rebellious energy from start to finish. Breathe deeply, broaden your horizons, and embrace your inner Wavechild.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Orange and Lemon

Middle notes: Watermelon and Coconut

Base notes: Ambergris, Amberwood and Cacao

title: Black Creme Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Black Creme Extrait de Parfum, a sophisticated Oriental Vanilla composition crafted by master perfumer Quentin Bisch. This unisex fragrance opens with luminous notes of ambrette, iris, and candied milk, evolving into a rich heart of leather, oud, and creamy vanilla. The composition settles into a warm, sensual base of caramel, sandalwood, and amber, creating an enveloping second skin. Launched in 2025, Black Creme represents a modern interpretation of classic oriental elegance, perfect for those seeking depth and complexity in their signature scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ambrette, Iris, Candle Wax, Milk and Spices

Middle notes: Leather, Myrrh, Agarwood (Oud) and Vanilla

Base notes: Caramel, Georgywood, Sandalwood and Amber

title: Cedrus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cedrus Eau de Parfum by Chloé is a sophisticated woody-musky fragrance from the Atelier des Fleurs collection, centered on the timeless elegance of cedarwood. This unisex composition captures the essence of a serene forest with its refined blend of earthy woods, soft spice, and subtle warmth. Designed for everyday wear, Cedrus delivers understated sophistication without overwhelming presence—a versatile scent that complements both professional and casual settings with natural grace and restraint.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Woody notes, cardamom, moss

Middle notes: Sandalwood, vetiver

Base notes: Cedar (cedarwood), amber, musk

title: Hommage 1744 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Hommage 1744 Eau de Parfum, a refined and elegant woody-spicy fragrance inspired by heritage, craftsmanship, and timeless sophistication. This distinguished composition opens with fresh citrus and aromatic accords, offering a vibrant and uplifting introduction. The heart reveals a blend of warm spices and floral nuances, adding depth, richness, and a subtly refined character. In the base, smooth woods, amber, and musk create a long-lasting, elegant trail that exudes warmth and classic masculinity. Hommage 1744 is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances tradition with modern sophistication.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citrus notes, aromatic accords

Middle notes: Spices, floral nuances

Base notes: Woods, amber, musk

title: Sirene Privee Parfum
body_html:
Sirène Privée by Fragrance Du Bois opens with a luminous burst of blood orange and pink pepper, immediately captivating the senses. The composition gracefully transitions into spiced cherry and geranium, revealing layers of complexity. A sophisticated base of vetiver and oakwood provides grounding depth, creating a fragrance that seamlessly merges radiant top notes with mysterious undertones. This parfum exemplifies modern elegance—a refined choice for those seeking a scent that commands attention while maintaining understated sophistication.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Pink Pepper and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Cherry, Cinnamon and Geranium

Base notes: Cypriol, Vetiver and Oak

title: Sirene Parfum
body_html:
Sirène is our inaugural fragrance inspired by the essence of femininity, designed for those who confidently make their mark. It opens with a striking cherry note, symbolizing bold feminine power that captivates. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of incense, creating an aura of elegance and mystery. This scent invites you on a path of self-exploration and empowerment, encouraging you to awaken and celebrate the Sirène within.

 

Fragrance family: Fruity, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry and Pepper

Middle notes: Oud, Lactones and Incense

Base notes: Benzoin, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Labdanum and Moss

title: Bo-Bo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bo-Bo is a scent that embodies the lively and celebratory spirit of the Mediterranean, rooted in an ancient folkloric dance. With fresh and citrusy notes of African orange flower, Italian Bergamot, and mandarin, as well as white amber and musk, this fragrance is both traditional and modern. Indian Jasmine and Lily of the Valley bring a delicate sweetness to the mix. Blithe and effervescent, Bo-Bo captures the joyful and fanciful essence of the Mediterranean.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Black Currantot, Blood Mandarin, Rosemary, Litsea Cubeba, Grapefruit, Lavender and Clary Sage

Middle notes: African Orange Flower, Lily-of-the-Valley and Indian Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Vetiver and White Amber

title: Experimentum Crucis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A scientifically crafted chypre perfume with a straightforward and accurate formula, leaving a lasting impression with its sudden and focused aroma. The lingering scent, featuring Akigalawood and patchouli, combines with honeyed rose to create a new olfactory experience beyond the constraints of light and gravity.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cumin, Apple and Litchi

Middle notes: Rose, Honey and Jasmine

Base notes: Akigalawood, Patchouli and Musk

title: Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum is a captivating combination of vibrant citrus notes, including citronella, bergamot, and grapefruit, dancing alongside juniper and red berries. This energetic composition is further enhanced by the addition of brandy, adding a rich and boozy scent that mingles with warm spices like ginger, pepper, and clary sage. The base of this fragrance is a whirlwind of sensual warmth, with notes of amber, sandalwood, and vanilla creating a velvety richness, while benzoic resin, patchouli, and vetiver add an earthy depth that lingers on the skin. The final touches of cinnamon and musk add an animalic heat, reminding wearers of the wildness that lies beneath the surface. For those who embrace life's wild side, Drunk Lovers is an intoxicating and unpredictable fragrance, perfect for nights filled with desire and the thrill of an all-consuming love.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cognac, Red Berries, Juniper, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Pepper, Cypress, Ginger and Clary Sage

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber, Musk, Virginian Cedar, Benzoin, Patchouli, Cardamom, Vetiver and Cinnamon

title: Existence Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Existence Eau de Parfum captures the essence of serenity and endlessness through the heart-breaking note of Lily of the Valley. Delicate and fragile, this scent is elevated by the addition of Frankincense, which adds a remarkable sense of expansiveness. A touch of Aldehyde enhances the pristine whiteness, while Rose brings a living, breathing physicality. The base notes of Benzoin ground this fragrance, connecting the ethereal landscape to the complex reality of the earth. With its bright, sincere, and emotive character, Existence truly embodies the incomprehensible vastness of the infinite, evoking a feeling of life-affirming optimism.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lily of the Valley, Rose

Middle notes: Frankincense, Mystikal, Labdanum

Base notes: Ambergris, White Musk, Benzoin

title: Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the vibrant and comfortable trail of Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum. With dominant notes of nutmeg and ambery woods, this fragrance evokes a "gin frappé" effect. The subtle spicy notes of juniper berry essence balance the overall aroma, while the base notes offer a range of ambery wood facets for a sweet, enveloping or powerful, dry finish.

Fragrance family:Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper Berries, Nutmeg, Bergamot and Pineapple

Middle notes: Coriander

Base notes: Musk, Woody Notes, Cedar, Amber and Vanilla

title: The Ghost In The Shell Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing The Ghost in the Shell Eau de Parfum, a scent that delves into the complexities of humanity and its contradictions. Wear this modern fragrance at your leisure, as it symbolizes the interconnectivity of individuals and their evolution. Experience its progressive essence as it rises from within.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aqual, Yuzu and Hexyl acetate

Middle notes: Milk, Skin, Jasmine and Mugane

Base notes: Orcanox, Vinyl Guaiacol and Moss

title: Royal Incense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by authentic Omani incense, this fragrance captivates with its warm, smoky depth. It opens boldly with pink pepper, transitions into a floral blend of lily and geranium, and settles into a rich, sweet base featuring incense, honey, amber, and leather.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Geranium and Lily

Base notes: Incense, Honey, Leather, Vetiver, Cedar, Musk and Ambergris

title: Flamingo Fizz Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Flamingo Fizz is an enchanting and dynamic fragrance that captivates with its vibrant composition. The lively mix of grapefruit, berry fruits, and sparkling champagne awakens the senses instantly. Floral notes of orange blossom, jasmine, and rose add a sensual touch, while amber and musk provide a rich, mysterious base. Crafted for women who embrace life’s exciting moments and challenges, this versatile scent embodies the spirit of summer but also shines in cooler seasons thanks to its sweet undertones. Let Flamingo Fizz be your companion for unforgettable adventures, capturing the effervescent joy of life.

Fragrance family: Amber, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Champagne, Grapefruit, Wild Berries and Lemon

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Benzoin, Olibanum, Vetiver, Musk and Amber

title: Cuir InfraRouge Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Cuir InfraRouge by Maison Crivelli is an elegant creation from perfumer Jordi Fernández. It opens with lively top notes of bergamot, cinnamon, and raspberry accord. The heart blends the warmth of cedarwood, orris, and osmanthus, while its base rests on leather accord, oud accord, patchouli, and vanilla, delivering a refined and complex scent experience.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Cinnamon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orris, Osmanthus and Cedarwood

Base notes: Leather, Vanilla, Oud and Patchouli

title: Mojave Ghost Absolu de Parfum
body_html:
Mojave Ghost Absolu de Parfum enhances familiar sandalwood notes by focusing on a higher concentration for extended longevity and richer depth. The artistry behind the fragrance is reflected in a redesigned bottle, featuring a distinctive textured cap inspired by traditional woodcraft. The perfume opens with an atomizer spray that incorporates industrial design elements, creating a refined contrast while preserving the essence of the original scent.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sapodilla and Ambrette

Middle notes: Magnolia, Violet and Sandalwood

Base notes: Musk, Amber and Cedarwood

title: Sur Tes Levres E.Q Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Though its minimalist bottle suggests simplicity, Sur Tes Levres E.Q Eau De Parfum delivers a powerful fragrance. While this iteration was introduced in 2015, D'ORSAY’s legacy dates back nearly two centuries. Known for pioneering unisex scents, the French house continues to embrace gender-neutral formulas. In Sur Tes Levres E.Q., the blend of patchouli, pink berry, and jasmine captures the delicate and intimate feeling of a lover’s kiss.

 

Fragrance family: Powdery, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Berry Extract, Ambrette Absolute

Middle notes: Jasmine Accord, Iris Concrete

Base notes: Patchouli Essence, Cashmeran

title: Aira Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Aira Eau de Parfum by Sospiro Perfumes, an expressive oriental-woody fragrance crafted for unisex sophistication. Launched in 2025, it unveils a smoky and resinous opening that sets a bold, mysterious tone. The heart reveals earthy and spicy facets, adding depth and structured intensity. The base lingers with sensual, animalic woods and ambergris, offering a rich and enduring finish that embodies elegance and allure. Aira is an ideal choice for those seeking a powerful yet refined signature scent.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody


Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, patchouli, oriental notes, woody notes, amber

Middle notes: Earthy notes, labdanum, cumin

Base notes: Animalic notes, oud, dry wood, ambergris

title: Aqua de Dora Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Aqua de Dora Eau de Parfum by Pana Dora, a refreshing woody-aquatic citrus fragrance inspired by the natural beauty of Sweden’s Öland Island. Launched in 2021 and crafted by perfumer Ibrahim Al Zoabi, this invigorating scent opens with a bright burst of zesty citrus and aquatic clarity, evoking cool sea breezes and open horizons. The heart reveals a warm and subtly earthy blend, adding depth and a distinctive character. In the base, refined woody and cashmere-like tones provide a smooth, elegant finish that lingers with understated sophistication. Aqua de Dora is an excellent choice for those seeking a fresh yet textured everyday scent that feels both modern and timeless. 


Fragrance family: Woody, Aquatic, Citrus 


Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Ambroxan, Lemon zest 

Middle notes: Chestnut, Fig 

Base notes: Cashmeran, Sandalwood

title: Vanilla Tana Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Vanilla Tanà is a warm, sun-kissed gourmand that elevates natural vanilla with creamy, toasted, and slightly spicy nuances—velvety, comforting, and elegantly indulgent. This unisex-leaning composition highlights a rich vanilla bean heart softened by milky, coconut-like facets and balanced by toasted gourmand accords and gentle woods. Designed for cozy daytime wear and intimate evenings, Vanilla Tanà offers inviting sweetness with refined depth and lasting sillage without cloying heaviness.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, orange blossom, light coconut accord
Middle notes: Vanilla planifolia (vanilla bean), tonka bean, heliotrope, creamy coconut milk
Base notes: Benzoin, sandalwood, toasted almond/praline nuance, vanilla absolute, soft musk

title: Tonka Hysteria Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Tonka Hysteria leaves a lasting impression wherever you go. Created by Jordi Fernández, a pioneering perfumer renowned for his innovative techniques and profound understanding of ingredients, this fragrance reflects his expertise in traditional Middle Eastern perfumery. Designed to evoke concealed desires, Tonka Hysteria entices those nearby to stay captivated indefinitely.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Pink Peppercorn, Olibanum, Cinnamon

Middle notes: Orris Butter, Orris Resin, Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Vanilla

title: Tygar x Refik Anadol Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Tygar x Refik Anadol by Bvlgari, launched in 2025 within the Le Gemme Men series, is a distinguished men's fragrance crafted by perfumer Jacques Cavallier-Belletrud. This scent belongs to the amber and citrus fragrance families, featuring prominent accords of grapefruit and grey amber that deliver a refined and contemporary aromatic experience.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit

Middle notes: Ginger and Ambrette

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Vetiver and Patchouli

title: Terroni Parfum
body_html:
Experience the fiery intensity of Terroni Parfum, inspired by the molten lava that has shaped the once-volcanic terrain of southern Italy. With bold spice, earthy notes, and deep musky woods, this Orto Parisi fragrance celebrates the power and pedigree of the earth. Just like the explosion that began the world, Terroni captures that same passionate energy that comes from putting your hands in the soil and feeling a sense of belonging to the Earth.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry

Middle notes: Birch, Amber and Benzoin

Base notes: Guaiac Wood, Vetiver, Cedar, Musk, Patchouli, Moss, Tonka and Vanilla

title: Soie Malaquais Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Soie Malaquais Eau de Parfum is a delicate representation of Dries Van Noten's luxurious silk dresses, showcased and admired at the brand's boutique in Paris. With its gentle, velvety notes of chestnut and vanilla, this scent envelops the wearer in a comforting, satin-like aura. The trademark spliced perfume bottles of the brand are refillable, ensuring that you can savor your preferred fragrance for an extended period of time.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Currant and Bergamot

Middle notes: Silk and Rose

Base notes: Chestnut and Cacao

title: Silky Woods Parfum
body_html:
Silky Woods Parfum is the first fragrance in the luxurious Botanical Series by Goldfield & Banks, featuring sustainable Agarwood from the Daintree Rainforest in Tropical Queensland. The delicate yet sensual blend showcases Australia's unique sensorial experience with its precious wood species, encased in molten gold for a truly opulent touch.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ceylon Cinnamon and Saffron

Middle notes: Suede, Agarwood (Oud), Madagascar Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Base notes: Tahitian Vanilla, Australian Sandalwood, Tobacco Leaf, Musk and Olibanum

title: Oud Maracuja Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This exquisite perfume, created in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez, is a highly concentrated extrait that stimulates the senses with its long-lasting and robust scent. With a blend of fruity notes, warm saffron, and woody oud, it offers a rich and spicy finish.

Fragrance family: Oud, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Fruity Notes, Saffron and Turkish Rose

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Benzoin

Base notes: Leather, Akigalawood, Amber, Labdanum and Vanilla

title: Decision 42 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Decision 42 Extrait de Parfum — Amouage is an intense amber-woody aromatic fragrance created by perfumer Quentin Bisch. A 42% concentration interpretation of the original Decision, it explores the image of a juniper tree struck by lightning—transforming the impact of destruction into a deeper sense of strength, survival, and renewal. Amouage intensifies the composition with neroli, cardamom, and cinnamon in the opening, while juniper is given a darker, smokier character through pine tar, patchouli, and Javanol. Vanilla and labdanum add warmth and depth to the drydown. 

It opens with pink pepper, bergamot, cardamom, neroli, and cinnamon, creating a bright, spicy, and sparkling introduction. At its heart, frankincense, juniper, myrrh, sandalwood, and rectified pine tar create a smoky, resinous, woody character. As the fragrance settles, patchouli, cedarwood, vanilla, and labdanum create a warm, deep, balsamic base with a smooth sweetness.

Fragrance Family: Amber,Woody,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Pink Pepper,Bergamot,Cardamom,Neroli,Cinnamon
Heart Notes: Frankincense,Juniper,Myrrh,Sandalwood,Rectified Pine Tar
Base Notes: Patchouli,Cedarwood,Vanilla,Labdanum

title: Vibrato Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bask in the entrancing warmth of a perfect aromatic vibrato. A classy, sparkling fragrance that leads with sweet floral top notes of Magnolia and Jasmine with an uplifting, citrusy touch of Bergamot and Grapefruit. A burst of Ginger and Powdery notes balanced with a dewy and fresh herbal accent to add a smooth and mellow aroma. The charming and warm base made of a semi-spicy and woody mix of Cedarwood, Oriental, Musk, Patchouli, and Orris notes creates a complex and vivid scent that is also quite subtle.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Jasmine and Magnolia

Middle notes: Ginger, Herbal Notes and Powdery Notes

Base notes: Musk, Cedar, Amber, Patchouli and Orris Root

title: Dama Bianca Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dama Bianca is inspired by her own dreams, but also captivated by the irresistible allure of vanilla - the most dreamy note in the world of fragrance. This white scent conjures feelings of sensuality and optimistic visions of golden vanilla, enhanced by freshly picked kumquat.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Kumquat and Lime

Middle notes: Violet, Italian Iris, Lilac, Egyptian Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Vanilla, Malt, White Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Sandalwood and Cedar

title: Hermann a Mes Cotes Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Every individual has a shadow, even when surrounded by darkness in the depths of the forest. Some may refer to it by a different name - an invisible companion, their conscience, or perhaps their complementary ego. Your own shadow could simply be known as Hermann, or perhaps it is embodied by your chosen perfume.

Fragrance family: Amber, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pepperwood, Galbanum and Black Currant

Middle notes: Geosmin, Rose Oil and Olibanum

Base notes: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Calypsone and Vetiver

title: Reflection 45 Man Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted as a gift of time, this modern fragrance boasts a stronger, more concentrated formula that is highly coveted. With 45% perfume oil, Reflection 45 Man introduces a new standard for woody floral musk scents. Through a four-month process of maturation and maceration, it boldly reimagines one of the House's iconic scents, combining spicy top notes and textured florals to create a timeless and versatile aroma.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Benzoin, Pink Pepper, Clary Sage, Lavender, Cardamom, Juniper Berry.

Middle notes: Neroli, Orris, Jasmine, Angelica, Tonka Bean, Vanilla

Base notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Myrrh, Frankincense, Opoponax

title: Purpose 50 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The original Purpose Eau de Parfum, known for its unwavering strength and assertiveness, used Frankincense to evoke a sense of peace and inner grounding. Now, in its Exceptional Extrait form with a 50% concentration, Purpose 50 delves even deeper into the core of the fragrance. Alongside Frankincense, Papyrus, and Sand Vetiver from the Eau de Parfum, the addition of an authoritative Sandalwood accord creates a unique, creamy-woody earthiness, while a Vanillin note forms a more intimate bond with the wearer's skin. Purpose 50 is a profound connection to the earth, embodying its ancient soul, enduring patience, and timeless wisdom

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Frankincense, Pimento Berry

Middle notes: Rose, Sand Vetiver, Sandalwood, Papyrus

Base notes: Saffron, Suede, Mystikal, Akigalawood, Vanilla

title: Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense
body_html:
Cypress trees, grapevine, and amber come together to create a delightful aroma. This fresh and woody scent lingers, leaving a refined, distinctive, and bold impression.

Fragrance family: Fresh, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cypress

Middle notes: Woody Notes

Base notes: Vine

title: Purple Stain Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Purple Stain Extrait de Parfum begins with a sophisticated blend of warm saffron, cinnamon, and nutmeg, complemented by vibrant notes of mandarin and bergamot. Its complex heart reveals an opulent combination of luminous orange blossom intertwined with sumptuous caramel and vanilla accords. The composition evolves to a profound base featuring smoky oud, earthy patchouli, and distinctive cypriol, balanced by the amber warmth of cistus and the refined woody character of akigalawood. This velvety, assertive fragrance creates a lasting sillage that commands attention and remains memorable long after application.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cinnamon, Mandarin, Bark, Bergamot, Ginger and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Peru Balsam, Orange Blossom, Vanilla and Caramel

Base notes: Labdanum, Oud, Akigalawood, Patchouli, Cypriol, Concrete and Ambrofix

title: Sugar Kisses Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sugar Kisses Extrait de Parfum, crafted by Lorenzo Pazzaglia in 2023, presents a sophisticated Oriental Vanilla composition suitable for all genders. This contemporary fragrance opens with a complex bouquet of Cacao Butter, Milk, Heliotrope, Frangipani, and Orange Peel. Its heart reveals an intricate blend of Vanilla, Chocolate, Coconut, Tonka, Hazelnut, Dates, and Cacao Blossom. The foundation consists of Caramel, Toffee, Vanilla Bean, Brown Sugar, White Musk, Rum, and Benzoin, creating a rich olfactory experience that balances sweetness with depth and complexity.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cacao Butter, Milk, Heliotrope, Frangipani and Orange Peel

Middle notes: Vanilla, Chocolate, Coconut, Tonka, Hazelnut, Dates and Cacao Blossom

Base notes: Caramel, Toffee, Vanilla Bean, Brown sugar, White Musk, Rum and Benzoin

title: Insulo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
For François Hénin, vanilla stands as the ultimate tool of seduction. Celebrated worldwide, its irresistible allure captivates and invites indulgence, making it a powerful element in crafting unforgettable fragrances.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla

Middle notes: Jasmine

Base notes: White Musk

title: Oud Aquilaria Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a captivating blend of rich oud and rose that awakens your senses. The scent begins with subtle notes of pink pepper, rosemary, and a sweet apple nuance, leading into an elegant floral heart. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a seductive oud base enriched with hints of patchouli and amber, creating a sophisticated and lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Rosemary and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Cloves and Sage

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Amber and Labdanum

title: Soho Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Soho Extrait de Parfum captures the dynamic spirit of a contemporary cityscape, blending softness with sophistication and a hint of spice and mystery. Central to this fragrance are tonka bean, vanilla, and coconut, which combine to form an alluring and harmonious trio. The warm, sweet spiciness of tonka bean gently envelops the senses, complemented by the smooth, delicate sweetness of vanilla and coconut. Accents of nutmeg, agarwood, and musk add depth and complexity—nutmeg infuses vibrancy, agarwood introduces a mystical woody layer, and sandalwood grounds the scent with an earthy, balanced base. Soho offers a refined olfactory journey where urban vibrancy meets natural elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut, Mimosa, Jasmine, Patchouli

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Cardamom, Nutmeg, Tobacco, Canarium resin, Saffron, Vanilla, Tonka bean

Base notes: Agarwood, Sandalwood, Amber, Musk

title: Yin Transformation Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Yin Transformation Eau de Parfum captures the essence of water, the origin of life, blending calm and dynamic elements with precision. This fragrance balances opposing notes, from the creamy depth of Sandalwood to the sharp freshness of Calypso Orchids—a pioneering ingredient in perfumery. The result is a sophisticated and nuanced scent that stimulates the senses with subtle complexity.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orchid, Bulgarian Rose and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Almond Milk, Ylang-Ylang and Iris

Base notes: White Musk, Sandalwood and Benzoin

title: Sequence Essence de Parfum
body_html:
Experience Sequence Essence de Parfum, Amouage’s latest creation where time loops seamlessly and each note flows into the next. It opens with lively lychee, vibrant raspberry, and a hint of exotic saffron, creating an energetic introduction. The heart reveals radiant osmanthus and rich rose, enriched by creamy tonka bean for depth. Finally, the fragrance rests on a sophisticated base of leather, oud, and smoky amberwood, providing a strong, enduring foundation. Crafted with Amouage’s signature double-infusion technique, Sequence balances light and dark, movement and stillness, in a deeply layered, refillable tribute to life’s eternal rhythm.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lychee, Raspberry, Saffron

Middle notes: Osmanthus, Rose, Tonka Bean

Base notes: Leather, Oud, Amberwood

title: Creme Ebene Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Crème Ébène Eau de Parfum, a rich and velvety woody-gourmand fragrance that blends creamy softness with deep, elegant woods. This captivating composition opens with smooth and slightly sweet accords, creating a warm and inviting introduction. The heart reveals creamy sandalwood and soft spicy nuances, adding depth, texture, and sophistication. In the base, dark woods, amber, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with warmth, sensuality, and refined elegance. Crème Ébène is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances creamy richness with woody depth.

Fragrance family: Woody, Gourmand, Creamy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Creamy accords, soft sweetness

Middle notes: Sandalwood, subtle spices

Base notes: Dark woods, amber, musk

title: Pure Diamond Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Pure Diamond by The House of Oud is a luminous, sophisticated woody-oriental that fuses crystalline floral facets with a polished oud core—bright, elegant, and quietly luxurious. This unisex composition frames radiant citrus and delicate spice around a refined floral heart, settling into a warm, resinous base where smooth oud and creamy woods lend depth and lasting refinement. Suited to both daytime elegance and evening polish, Pure Diamond offers a sparkling yet substantial presence that balances freshness with oriental richness.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, pink pepper, neroli

Middle notes: Jasmine, rose, orange blossom

Base notes: Agarwood (oud), sandalwood, amber, vanilla, white musk

title: Eden Parfum
body_html:
