Eden — Adamo Parfum is a luminous and captivating fragrance that evokes the irresistible allure of an untouched paradise, where succulent fruits and blooming florals exist in perfect harmony. Created by perfumer Hamid Merati-Kashani, the composition balances temptation and elegance through a minimalist yet expressive structure. It opens with the juicy sweetness of ripe plum illuminated by the sparkling freshness of grapefruit, creating a vibrant and addictive introduction. At its heart, a delicate bouquet of white flowers unfolds with soft, velvety grace, adding a refined floral sophistication that enhances the fragrance's radiant character. As it settles, smooth woody notes emerge to provide warmth and depth, leaving a sensual and effortlessly elegant trail. Bright yet comforting, Eden captures the beauty of innocence and seduction, offering a modern interpretation of paradise through a refined fruity-floral lens.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Fruity, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Plum, Grapefruit
Heart Notes: White Flowers
Base Notes: Woody Notes

title: Angels' Share On The Rocks Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the ritual of savoring a fine spirit, this elegant fragrance masterfully combines crisp icy freshness with rich depth. It harmonizes a vibrant zesty note alongside warm cognac essence and creamy Tonka bean. Designed as a unisex scent, its golden-hued composition features a heart of cognac essence, cinnamon trunk oil, and tonka bean absolute, resting on a base enriched with oak absolute and amber.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot

Middle notes: Cognac, Myrrh

Base notes: Aldehydes, Tonka Bean

title: Havana Gold Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Havana Gold Eau de Parfum by Dries Van Noten is a sophisticated unisex fragrance launched in 2025. It opens with vibrant notes of mandarin, liquorice accord, and star anise, leading into a rich heart of cinnamon, tobacco leaves absolute, and benzoin. The base combines roasted tonka, leather accord, and cypriol, offering a warm, complex finish that balances freshness with depth for an elegant and lasting scent experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Licorice, Star Anise and Mandarin

Middle notes: Tobacco, Cinnamon and Benzoin

Base notes: Leather, Cypriol and Tonka

title: Psychedelique Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Psychedelique Eau de Parfum is a rich patchouli scent characterized by dark, smoky, and ambered notes, with a generous and opulent presence that lingers despite any weather. Its top notes feature fresh hesperidium, leading to a heart of floral rose, geranium, and woody elements like patchouli, cistus, and gum cistus. The base combines smooth vanilla and musk. Crafted by perfumer Jacques Flori (Robertet), this fragrance offers a bold and lasting impression.

 

 Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses

Middle notes: Patchouli, Amber, French labdanum, Geranium and Rose

Base notes: Vanille and Musk

title: 02 L'Air du Desert Marocain Eau de Toilette Intense
body_html:
L'Air du Desert Marocain was created as a more delicate iteration of Andy's previous fragrance, Le Maroc Pour Elle. This scent is highly favored within the collection, incorporating oriental spices that evoke the Saharan desert under the moonlight. The top notes blend coriander, cumin, and a touch of petitgrain, while the middle notes feature rock rose and jasmine. The base is a fusion of cedar, vetiver, and ambergris.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coriander, Cumin, Petitgrain and Lavender

Middle notes: Labdanum, Birch, Jasmine and Geranium

Base notes: Amber, Cedar, Vetiver, Patchouli and Oakmoss

title: Black Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the power of nature with Black Sea Extrait de Parfum. This fragrance unleashes the strength of the elements with its aromatic herbs, flowers, and salt spray notes. Embrace this bold scent as you explore the world with courage and confidence.

Fragrance family: Marine, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Sardinian Myrtle, Salt, Ozonic Notes, Watery Notes

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Cyprus Black Salt, Ylang-Ylang, Sea Notes

Base notes: Algae, White Musk, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Ambergris

title: French Defense Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a sense of self-assuredness with the alluring scent of French Defense Extrait de Parfum. Succulent black cherry, smooth liqueurs, and velvety woods and ambers create a tantalizing aroma that is further enhanced by delicate floral notes. This sophisticated fragrance sets the perfect tone for any occasion and exudes a natural grace and beauty. The initial boldness of dark liquified cherries is accented by a subtle hint of mimosa and geranium Madagascar, while the heart of the scent is a warm, comforting blend of golden amber and woods.

Fragrance family: Amber, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Violet Leaves and Chamomile

Middle notes: Rose, Geranium and Mimosa

Base notes: Amber, Blonde Woods and Cedarwood

title: This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.1 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the freedom and eternity of the new unisex fragrance This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.1 by Histoires de Parfums. With refreshing notes complemented by hints of honey and an oriental finish, this scent is perfect for those who love contrasts. Created by owner Gerald Ghislain, the fragrance captures the essence of abstraction. Also explore the addition of Fidelis, a rare edition crafted by perfumer Julien Rasquinet.

Fragrance family: Aldehyde, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes and Orange

Middle notes: Honey and Geranium

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli and Amber

title: Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover a truly captivating scent with the Tom Ford Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum. Featuring a blend of addictively floral notes, enriched with warm amber, exotic cardamom oil, and delicate ylang-ylang, this fragrance captures the brilliant radiance of the sun.

Fragrance family: Floral, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pistachio, Bergamot, Cardamom and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Base notes: Coconut, Amber, Tonka Bean and Benzoin

title: Grand Soir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the luxuriously comforting notes of this Oriental fragrance, crafted by the renowned Maison Francis Kurkdjian. With a fusion of Labdanum, benzoin, tonka bean, vanilla, and amber, this scent is sure to leave a lasting impression, making it a must-have for any perfume enthusiast.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spanish Labdanum and Orange

Middle notes: Lavender and Siam Benzoin

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk and Cedar

title: Another 13 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In 2010, Another magazine requested that Le Labo create a unique fragrance. Another 13 is crafted with ambroxyde, a synthetic animal musk, resulting in an alluringly earthy blend. The addition of jasmine and moss bring a perfect balance of warmth and brightness.

Fragrance family: Musk, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Apple and Citruses

Middle notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Amyl Salicylate, Moss and Jasmine

Base notes: Iso E Super, Cetalox, Ambrettolide and Helvetolide

title: Imperial Emerald Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The top notes of this fragrance are filled with refreshing citrus and caressing orris and pink pepper, creating a modern and joyful feeling. As the scent settles, a loving tremble of ylang ylang and opulent rose absolute Chile blends with a magnificent bouquet of lily of the valley, night-blooming jasmine, tuberose, and orange flowers. The dry-down is a warm and rich combination of white amber and precious benzoin, creating a passionately seductive dance of scents. Creamy vanilla, enveloping musks, and innovative patchouli add to the long asting and unforgettable trail of this perfume, making it the perfect choice for a woman who wants to leave her mark, just like the Imperial Emerald.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Tuberose, Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom, Lily-of-the-Valley and Rose

Base notes: White Musk, Patchouli, Benzoin, Vanilla and Amber

title: Eau Duelle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the alluring scent of Eau Duelle Eau de Parfum by Diptyque. Made with Bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, this fragrance is complemented by spiced pink peppercorn and the rich, smoky cypriol. Experience the unexpected aroma of incense, adding depth and intensity to this unique blend.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla

Middle notes: Pink peppercorn

Base notes: Cypriot

title: Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum by Creed, created by industry expert Henry Creed, is a unique blend of fruity scents such as mandarin, orange, and bergamot, combined with the calming aromas of green tea, black currant, and galbanum. The finishing touches of musk, sandalwood, and petit grain complete this exquisite fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Green Tea and Black Currant

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Petitgrain and Galbanum

title: Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Byredo's Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and captivating fragrance that captures the essence of the Mojave Desert. Experience the warm and woody blend of musk, ambrette, nesberry, violet, and sandalwood. With a base of chantilly musk, amber, and cedarwood, this fragrance leaves a subtle and lingering woody aroma on the skin.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sapodilla and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Middle notes: Magnolia, Violet and Sandalwood

Base notes:Magnolia, Violet and Sandalwood

title: Born For Eternity Parfum Intense
body_html:
Indulge in the lavish and opulent Born For Eternity Parfum Intense, a bold olfactory homage to Ancient Egypt. Inspired by the search for immortality and the discovery of King Tutankhamun's tomb, this scent exudes luxury and exoticism. Featuring three powerful accords, it is a modern celebration of the pursuit of eternity.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Coriander and Frankincense

Middle notes: Oud, Geranium, Pink Pepper, Cardamom and Praline

Base notes: Leather, Akigalawood, Javanol and Ambergris

title: Love Don't Be Shy Eau de Parfum
body_html:
With an intoxicating blend of tender orange blossom and juicy honeysuckle, Love Don't Be Shy will leave a lasting impression. Soft notes of rose and luscious marshmallow sugar evoke the innocence of first love, while a warm amber base adds a touch of sensuality. Discover the possibility of a new love, inside and out

Fragrance family: Sweet, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Neroli, Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Coriander

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Honeysuckle, Jasmine, Iris, Rose and Marshmallow

Base notes: Sugar, Vanilla, Caramel, Musk, Civet and Labdanum

title: Nassau Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Nassau Eau de Parfum by Alfred Ritchy is a unisex scent that expertly combines fruity and creamy essences with a subtle woody undertone. Its top notes of pear, bergamot, coconut, and raspberry give way to a heart of lavender, praline, and whipped cream, while the base is a harmonious blend of musk, moss, cedar, vanilla, and ambergris. Discover a sophisticated and versatile fragrance experience.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut, Raspberry, Bergamot and Pear

Middle notes: Lavender, Whipped Cream, Praline and Pistachio

Base notes: Ambergris, Cedar, Vanilla, Musk and Moss

title: Hundred Silent Ways Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the ultimate tribute to the most beloved perfumes in perfume history with Hundred Silent Ways Extrait de Parfum. Our modern interpretation and blend of pleasant notes evoke the beauty and allure of past and present souls. Radiate confidence and elegance with just one drop, leaving a lasting impact on all those you encounter. Prepare for endless compliments with this luxurious fragrance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose, Peach and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Gardenia, Jasmine and Orris

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood and Vetiver

title: The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Elevate your senses with The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum. This captivating fragrance features a vibrant blend of ginger, bergamot, and grapefruit, followed by an addictive mix of cedar, akigalawood, and lychee. With a mesmerizing base of vetiver, tonka bean, and patchouli, this perfume is the ultimate indulgence for those seeking a unique and alluring scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Ginger and Bergamot

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Lychee and Cedarwood

Base notes: Amberwood, Vetiver, Patchouli and Tonka Bean

title: Divine Vanille Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the irresistible allure of Divine Vanille Eau de Parfum. With its blend of natural Tonka Bean, benzoin, Cinnamon bark, and Osmanthus, this fragrance is both soft and addictive. Blond Tobacco, dried fruits, and a fraction of natural Cedarwood and Patchouli add to its woody, creamy structure, while silky musks create a delicate luminous finish.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon, Clary Sage and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Incense, Pomarose and Osmanthus

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Siam Benzoin, Texas Cedar, Musk and Patchouli

title: Nice Bergamote Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Highlighted by the finest natural Calabrian bergamot, Nice Bergamote Eau de Parfum evokes a sunny burst of brightness. Delicately woven with a Natural floral accord of rose petals, jasmine, and Ylang Ylang from the Comoros Archipelago, this fragrance embodies elegance. Its warm base is crafted with precious cedarwood and softened by Tonka beans from Venezuela. Additionally, our sustainable extraction of Ylang Ylang from Comores implements replanting programs to reduce local ecosystem impact.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Jasmine

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Cedar, Tonka Bean

title: Outlands Essence de Parfum
body_html:
Explore unknown lands with Amouage Outlands Essence de Parfum, expertly crafted by Cécile Zarokian. The invigorating scent of lemon sets the stage, while notes of patchouli and amber transport you to exotic and enigmatic landscapes. With a dual infusion of sandalwood and oakwood and housed in a refillable bottle, this unparalleled masterpiece offers rich depth, showcasing Amouage's first new design in 15 years.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi, Sichuan Pepper, Cardamom, Lemon, Frankincense and Bergamot

Middle notes: Patchouli, Saffron, Anise, Geranium, Coriander, Wormwood, Rose, Orange Blossom and Cumin

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Benzoin, Frankincense, Opoponax, Maltol, Birch, Ambergris, Labdanum, Oud and Musk

title: Pacific Rock Moss Parfum
body_html:
Immerse yourself in pure bliss with this fresh and aquatic perfume that captures the essence of a perfect summer day. With aromatic essences and a distinct marine note, it will transport you to a lush coastal walk by Australia's blue waters. The sturdy base of cedar wood provides a perfect canvas for the refreshing, sea spray scent. Suitable for both men and women, this fragrance is inspired by warm days spent diving into the ocean and evenings surrounded by sun-kissed rocks.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Moss, Lemon, Sage, Geranium

Middle notes: Cedarwood, Marine

Base notes: Citrus, Musky, Woody notes

title: Valaya Hair Perfume
body_html: Valaya Hair Mist provides a delicate fragrance of Valaya perfume to your hair, radiating a soft aura. A refreshing blend of bergamot, mandarin, and sweet white peach opens to a heart of orange flowers, then settles on a musk and woody base. Lightly spray the mist onto hair or a brush. Its compact size makes it convenient to carry in a purse. Perfectly complementing the Valaya eau de parfum.

title: Safanad Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted from the sun's luminous rays, Safanad Eau de Parfum unveils a warm and luxurious aroma. Notes of orange, pear, and petitgrain blend in the opening, while a heart of jasmine sambac absolute, ylang-ylang, and orange blossom adds depth and allure. The fragrance finishes with a velvety touch of amber, vanilla, and sandalwood for a truly coveted scent.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange, Pear, Petitgrain Essence

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac Absolute

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Sandalwood

title: Layton Exclusif Parfum
body_html:
This powerful and energetic fragrance presents its dominance and spontaneity. The renewed interpretation of Layton is a sophisticated and luxurious scent designed to leave a lasting impact. Bergamot, grapefruit, and apple top notes gently embrace a heart of cinnamon, lavender, agarwood, and geranium. The base notes consist of guaiac wood, sensual vanilla, and sweet cypriol. A modern twist on a classic scent, this fragrance is both traditional and refined.

Fragrance family: Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Apple

Middle notes: Geranium, Cinnamon, Lavender, Agarwood

Base notes: Cypriol, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Vanilla

title: Amber Empire Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Transport yourself to 17th-century Holland with The Black Tulip, Alexandre Dumas' timeless story of passion and ambition. Witness Cornelius' quest to cultivate the elusive black tulip and his potential release from imprisonment to wed the beautiful Rosa. Just like Atkinsons Tulipe Noire, this complex fragrance features notes of zesty coriander, invigorating bergamot, delicate jasmine, and a rich, sensual base of creamy sandalwood and warm cedar.

Fragrance family: Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Oolong Tea, Chinese Magnolia

Base notes: White Musk, Myrrh, Vanilla, Magnolia

title: Osmanthus Nectar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Uncover the alluring scent of Gucci's The Alchemist's Garden Osmanthus Nectar Eau de Parfum, featuring the sweet and floral notes of osmanthus in perfect balance with sandalwood essence. This floral-fruity-woody blend showcases the wild charm of osmanthus, encapsulating the essence of nature. Encased in a stunning red bottle adorned with a hummingbird, this fragrance captures the spirit of creativity, liberation, and the expertise of perfumer Natalie Lorson.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apricot, Bergamot and Guatemalan Cardamom

Middle notes: Tea and Osmanthus

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amyris and Virginia Cedar

title: Il Padrino Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sospiro Perfumes presents Il Padrino, a sophisticated Oriental Woody fragrance suitable for all genders. Launched in 2025, this contemporary scent represents the collaborative artistry of perfumers Nathalie Templer and Salah Al Zarooni. The composition opens with an intriguing blend of Rum, Black Currant, Bergamot, and Amaretto, transitioning to a heart of Patchouli, Sandalwood, and Amber. The foundation rests on a rich base of Siam Benzoin, Vanilla, and Labdanum, creating a complex olfactory experience that balances sweetness with woody depth.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Black Currant, Bergamot and Amaretto

Middle notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood and Amber

Base notes: Siam Benzoin, Vanilla and Labdanum

title: Concrete Parfum
body_html:
Concrete Parfum transforms the familiar, omnipresent presence of concrete—often overlooked in urban environments—into a sophisticated olfactory experience. This fragrance captures the raw, textured essence of concrete, reimagined with expert craftsmanship to evoke the spirit of modern city life. By blending industrial notes with subtle refined accords, it offers a unique sensory journey that challenges traditional perfumery boundaries. Ideal for those who appreciate innovation and complexity, Concrete Parfum invites you to explore the unexpected beauty hidden within the everyday urban fabric.

Fragrance family: Woody ,Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: caraway, cardamom, clove, ginger

Middle notes: rose, sambac jasmine

Base notes: cedar, incense, musk, sandalwood

title: Wonderoud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wonderoud Eau de Parfum features 100% natural oud, known as the "black gold of perfumers," sourced sustainably from aquilaria resins in Southeast Asia. This aromatic resin imparts a rich, complex character with woody, animalic, balsamic, and honeyed nuances, making it a refined choice for sophisticated fragrance compositions.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: black pepper

Middle notes: elemi

Base notes: agarwood, amber, cedar, hinoki, leather, teak

title: Van Exstasyn Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Seven playful girls twirl with delight, their hair adorned with white blossoms as mischievous thoughts flutter. Meanwhile, rich caramel notes gently unfold, infusing the air with enticing and captivating aromas. This fragrance opens with top notes of Bourbon, Madagascar, and Tahiti vanilla, followed by a heart of Vanilla Island, white flowers, and caramel, creating a deeply alluring scent experience.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Madagascar Vanilla, Tahitian Vanilla and Black Vanilla Husk

Middle notes: Vanilla, Caramel and White Flowers

Base notes: Vanilla Pod, Black Vanilla Husk, Tonka Bean and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Lyric Man Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lyric Man by Amouage is an Oriental Spicy scent designed for men, introduced in 2008. Crafted by perfumer Daniel Visentin, it opens with lime and bergamot, followed by a complex heart of rose, angelica, ginger, orange blossom, saffron, nutmeg, and galbanum. The fragrance settles into a rich base of musk, incense, pine tree, sandalwood, and vanilla, creating a sophisticated and enduring aroma.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Angelica, Ginger, Orange Blossom, Saffron, Nutmeg and Galbanum

Base notes: Musk, Incense, Pine Tree, Sandalwood and Vanilla

title: 20 Iconic Masculine Perfume
body_html:
Reintroducing two of the most loved scents from the house of Clive Christian Iconic Feminine & Masculine. Iconic Masculine, the perfect example of a Woody Citrus. Both energetic and mysterious with an unparalleled longevity on the skin of over 8 hours, this scent travels from bright citrusy notes to smoky vetiver.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Petitgrain, Pink Pepper and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Yuzu and Rosemary

Base notes: Haitian Vetiver and Cedar

title: Blanche Bete Limited Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the allure of Blanche Bête, an exclusive fragrance that captures the essence of an ethereal realm. This limited edition eau de parfum weaves together luminous white florals with crystalline accords, creating an olfactory experience that transcends the everyday. The sophisticated composition evokes the mystique of an otherworldly presence, while the pristine bottle design reflects the fragrance's refined elegance. A collector's piece for those who appreciate rare, transformative scents.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Milk, Ambrette and Mystikal

Middle notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Incense and Mahonial

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Cocoa

title: Nice Bergamote Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
As twilight descends on a sun-warmed landscape, Nice Bergamote Extrait De Parfum captures nature's most seductive moment. This concentrated composition—twice the potency of its Eau de Parfum counterpart—unveils a darker, more sensual interpretation of bergamote. Rich and enveloping, it reveals an intoxicating depth that unfolds gradually, delivering rare intensity through its elevated fragrance concentration.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot, bitter orange

Middle notes: Jasmine (including jasmine sambac), ylang-ylang

Base notes: Cedarwood, patchouli, tonka bean, amber-musk accord

title: Musc Pallida Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Musc Pallida Eau de Parfum, a refined fragrance that marries the luxurious warmth of iris pallida with delicate musk accords. Crafted by Christine Nagel, this 2026 release unveils a sophisticated interplay where precious iris becomes supple and graceful when enveloped by soft musk—much like gold transformed by heat. The eau de parfum format introduces a fresh sensory dimension to this intimate composition, offering understated elegance for those who appreciate nuanced, sensual fragrances. A contemporary addition to the Hermessence collection that celebrates the art of subtle refinement.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Aldehydes

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes

Middle notes: Iris

Base notes: Musk

title: Unue Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Unue is a minimalist, modern aromatic-woody that emphasizes clean freshness and subtle textured warmth—crisp, understated, and versatile. This unisex composition opens with bright, airy citrus and green facets that transition into a restrained aromatic-floral heart, finishing on a soft, woody-musk base that offers polished longevity without heaviness. Designed for everyday refinement and layered wear, Unue reads contemporary and wearable—suitable for work, casual outings, and calm evenings.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, neroli, green tea accord

Middle notes: Lavender, iris, white floral facets

Base notes: Cedarwood, vetiver, white musk, ambroxan

title: Tobacco Memories Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Tobacco Memories by Chambre52 is a warm, nostalgic tobacco-oriental that evokes vintage smoking salons and worn leather armchairs—smoky, sweet, and intimately refined. This unisex composition wraps rich, cured tobacco leaf in creamy gourmand and resinous facets, tempered by soft spice and woody depth to create a comforting yet sophisticated scent suited to evening wear and contemplative moments.

Fragrance family: Tobacco, Oriental, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, pink pepper, dried fruit (fig/prune)
Middle notes: Tobacco leaf, cacao/cocoa, dried fruits, light spice (cinnamon/cardamom)
Base notes: Vanilla, benzoin, cedarwood, leather accord, amber, tonka bean

title: Brompton Immortals Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Ex Nihilo Brompton Immortals Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more concentrated interpretation of the original Brompton Immortals—smoky, leathery, and richly resinous. This extrait amplifies the composition’s aristocratic woody-oriental character with increased depth, fuller leather and labdanum facets, and a longer-lasting, velvety amber-oud drydown. Crafted for formal evenings and moments calling for presence, it projects stately refinement and enduring sillage without losing the original’s poised restraint.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, pink pepper, bitter orange
Middle notes: Iris, leather accord, cedar heart, labdanum, spice facets
Base notes: Oud (agarwood), sandalwood, amber, vetiver, patchouli, musk, benzoin

title: Tobacco Carnaval Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Maison Crivelli Extrait Tobacco Carnaval is a rich, celebratory tobacco-oriental extrait that transforms classical cured-leaf warmth into a festive, gourmand-forward spectacle—velvety, smoky, and luxuriously spiced. This concentrated composition layers glossy, boozy gourmand facets and candied fruit over a plush tobacco heart, elevated by resinous balsams and fine woods; the result is an opulent, long-lasting scent designed for evening glamour and ceremonial moments where warmth and refined decadence are desired.

Fragrance family: Tobacco, Oriental, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, candied citrus, pink pepper
Middle notes: Cured tobacco leaf, dried fruits (prune/fig), spiced honey, jasmine or tobacco-flower facets
Base notes: Vanilla, benzoin, sandalwood, oud/amberwood accord, tonka bean, soft leather

title: Jany Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Jany Extrait de Parfum, a rich and indulgent fragrance that blends gourmand sweetness with warm, elegant depth. This captivating composition opens with delicious fruity and sweet accords, creating a vibrant and mouthwatering introduction. The heart reveals a luscious blend of creamy caramel and soft pastry-like nuances, adding richness, texture, and addictive character. In the base, warm woods, vanilla, amber, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with sweetness, warmth, and refined sophistication. Jany is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances gourmand richness with elegant depth.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Sweet, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fruity accords, sweet notes

Middle notes: Caramel, pastry accords

Base notes: Woods, vanilla, amber, musk

title: Madagascar Le Baume Vanille Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Madagascar Le Baume Vanille Eau de Parfum by Parfum d’Empire, a warm and indulgent gourmand-oriental unisex fragrance that celebrates the richness of vanilla and exotic spices. This sumptuous composition opens with bright and slightly sweet top notes that immediately captivate the senses. The heart reveals a creamy blend of vanilla, honey, and soft floral nuances, adding depth, warmth, and elegance. In the base, smooth woods, amber, and soft musks create a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with comforting richness and sophisticated gourmand character. Madagascar Le Baume Vanille is an ideal choice for those seeking a luxurious signature scent with sweet, oriental warmth.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sweet accords, light spices

Middle notes: Vanilla, honey, soft florals

Base notes: Woods, amber, musk

title: Tygar Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tygar Extrait de Parfum represents a refined concentration of Bvlgari's Le Gemme collection, inspired by the tiger's eye stone's golden luminosity. Crafted by master perfumer Jacques Cavallier-Belletrud, this unisex fragrance distills the essence of contrast through a vivid grapefruit accord layered against a warm ambergris base. The composition prioritizes clarity over complexity, merging bright citrus facets with mineral-ambery undertones to create a distinctive, streamlined scent. Launched in 2025, Tygar Extrait delivers a citrusy-woody character that balances radiance with depth, offering a modern interpretation of gemstone-inspired fragrance design.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Citruses

Middle notes: Amber, Ambergris

Base notes: Peru Balsam

title: Black Stone Extriat de Parfum
body_html:
Black Stone Extriat de Parfum draws deeply from Ramón Béjar’s encounters in the Middle East, embodying the region's rich mystique. This fragrance channels the essence of rare black minerals—obsidian, tourmaline, onyx, and the revered Kaaba stone—symbolizing light that emerges from darkness. Designed to evoke intimate secrets and profound journeys, it serves as a sophisticated bridge connecting the mysticism of the East with the curiosity of the West. Experience a refined and captivating scent that illuminates hidden depths and ancient mysteries.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Bergamot and Green Notes

Middle notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Lavender and Sandalwood

Base notes: Musk, Tonka and Vetiver

title: One Umbrella For Two Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Floraïku Paris expertly encapsulates nature's elegance in a fragrance. One Umbrella for Two Eau de Parfum is a unisex aromatic fruity scent that evokes a clear sky, free of rain. Its blend features blackcurrant absolute and energizing genmaicha tea, enhanced by cedar oil, which fades into a refined dry woody base.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Currant and Cyclamen

Middle notes: Tea and Rice

Base notes: Cedar and White Musk

title: Remember Me Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Remember Me Eau de Parfum is a captivating fragrance that invites you to become the unforgettable stranger in any crowd. Its exotic frangipani flowers dance gracefully with warm chai tea accents, while ginger and cardamom ignite a rich, milky gourmand cloud. This scent weaves a lasting spell, evoking memories and leaving an irresistible trail wherever you go.

 Fragrance family: Citrus, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Tea, Ginger and Frangipani

Base notes: Milk, Vanilla, Woody Notes and Cedar

title: Hypnotizing Fire Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Hypnotizing Fire Eau de Parfum captivates with a warm, inviting blend that soothes like a gentle flame. This expert-crafted fragrance combines the rich sweetness of Madagascan Vanilla and Benzoin with delicate Bulgarian Rose, earthy Indonesian Patchouli, and vibrant Pimento Berries from Jamaica. Its balanced, glowing composition offers a restorative and enchanting experience, perfect for those seeking a refined and sensual scent that nurtures both body and spirit.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pimento, Cloves and Peppertree

Middle notes: Patchouli, Bulgarian Rose and Praline

Base notes: Vanilla, Opoponax and Benzoin

title: Memories Gold Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Memories Gold Extrait de Parfum blends honey and caramel to create a sweet, sensual aroma that feels almost edible. This richer, more gourmand sister to the original Memories fragrance highlights these notes with added vanilla and milk for depth, while iris introduces a refined floral nuance. Cedarwood and musk provide a smooth base, complemented by the warm spice of tonka bean, resulting in a sophisticated, long-lasting scent. More than just a perfume, it evokes a captivating, unforgettable memory through its expertly balanced gourmand composition.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Honey, Caramel, Vanilla

Middle notes: Milk, Iris, Balsamic Suhar

Base notes: Cedarwood, Tonka Bean, Amber, Musk

title: Naxos Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the essence of Sicily with Naxos Eau de Parfum. Citrus notes of bergamot and lemon capture the island's Mediterranean character, while jasmine, cinnamon, and honey add a touch of romance. A base of tobacco and tonka provide a masculine balance to the delicate floral and fruit scents, all enveloped in a soft veil of vanilla. Discover the rich history and beauty of Sicily with every spritz of Naxos.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Honey, Cinnamon, Cashmeran and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Tobacco Leaf, Vanilla and Tonka Bean

title: Matsukita Perfume
body_html:
Crafted from historical archives, this elusive scent was originally created in 1892 for a Japanese princess who captivated the Victorian court with her unparalleled grace. This modern woody chypre perfume captures the mystical aura of its inspiration with a crisp and invigorating blend of green bergamot, sparkling pink pepper, and spicy nutmeg. Notes of Chinese imperial jasmine and mate tea add a floral and smoky touch, while jasmine sambac and guaiac oil bring a woody depth. A sensual and warm base of rich amber, fir balsam absolute, and whispering musks completes this enigmatic and multifaceted fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Nutmeg and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Chinese Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac, Mate and Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Balsam Fir, Woodsy Notes, Musk and Amber.

title: Angels' Share Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxury of Angels' Share Eau de Parfum, a collaboration between Kilian Hennessy and French perfumer Benoit Lapouza. Inspired by generations of cognac making, this personal fragrance delves into the founder's mind, revealing a mysterious and evocative scent. Indulge in the divine "angels' share" evaporation from oak barrels.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cognac

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Tonka Bean, Oak and Hedione

Base notes: Vanilla, Praline, Sandalwood and Candied Almond

title: Cherry Amber Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cherry Amber is a radiant new creation from Matière Première,designed exclusively for the Middle East and created by founder and perfumer Aurélien Guichard. The fragrance explores the contrast between the luminous richness of ripe cherry and the deep warmth of amber,creating a vivid and contemporary interpretation of an amber composition.

The fragrance opens with a natural cherry extract,bringing a lush,juicy red-fruit character to the composition. At the heart,Rose Centifolia Absolute from Matière Première’s own fields in Grasse adds a rich and elegant floral dimension. The drydown reveals a modern amber accord amplified by Exaltolide musk,creating a warm,sensual,and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral,Ambery,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cherry Extract

Middle Notes: Rose Centifolia Absolute

Base Notes: Amber Accord,Exaltolide Musk

title: Uruk Chronicles Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Uruk Chronicles is an evocative creation inspired by the legendary city of Uruk and the epic journey of its ruler,Gilgamesh,in his search for immortality. The fragrance transforms this ancient Mesopotamian legend into a contemporary olfactory story,where luminous fruits,precious saffron,and warm woods create an unforgettable signature.

The fragrance opens with juicy strawberry,bright mandarin,and the delicate fruity character of abelia. At the heart,saffron—the precious essence associated with the flower of immortality—unfolds alongside powdery iris and Pomarose. The base brings together tonka bean,cypriol,and cedarwood,creating a warm,woody,and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Strawberry,Abelia,Mandarin

Middle Notes: Saffron Accord,Iris,Pomarose

Base Notes: Tonka Bean,Cypriol,Cedarwood

title: Althair Exclusif Parfum
body_html:
Althaïr Exclusif is an intense yet refined interpretation of the iconic Althaïr, imagined as an olfactory sonata inspired by the grandeur and intimacy of 18th-century music. Created around a captivating contrast of noble warmth and gourmand richness, the fragrance combines the spicy radiance of saffron with velvety amaretto and an intensified Bourbon vanilla accord.

The composition opens with vibrant bergamot,rich amaretto,and warm saffron,creating an immediately captivating introduction. At the heart, cinnamon,orange blossom,cardamom,and praline add a sophisticated blend of spice,floral luminosity,and indulgent sweetness. The drydown reveals an intense Bourbon vanilla overdose,deepened by guaiacwood and ambrox for a smooth,woody,and sensual finish.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Woody,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Amaretto,Saffron

Middle Notes: Cinnamon,Orange Blossom,Cardamom,Praline

Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla,Guaiacwood,Ambrox

title: Perfect Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Eau de Parfum is an extraordinary woody fragrance with hints of leather, incense, and floral notes. Master perfumer Alberto Morillas chose to use Alaskan cedar instead of natural oud, creating a bold and refreshing scent with a smoky character.

Fragrance family: Oud, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Bergamot and Coriander

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Iris

Base notes: Cedar and Juniper

title: For Your Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted to embody the essence of a kiss, this fragrance evokes the intimate moments between two faces - the warmth of a neck intertwined with the powdery scent of lipstick and the fruity notes of raspberry. Combining musk, ambergris, and patchouli, this perfume is a playful yet sensual homage to the rituals of love.

Fragrance family: Amber, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry and Musk

Middle notes: Ambergris

Base notes: Patchouli and Benzoin

title: Portrait Of A Lady Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the unique blend of oriental and chypre notes with Portrait Of A Lady Eau de Parfum. Inspired by Henry James's novel from 1881, this modern and elegant fragrance features a dominant patchouli heart, complemented by dark and mystical rose scents. Experience the intense and intriguing journey of freedom represented by the novel's heroine, Isabel Archer.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Clove, Raspberry, Black Currant, Cinnamon and Red Berries

Middle notes: Turkish Rose, Patchouli, Incense, Sandalwood and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Incense, Sandalwood, Musk, Benzoin, Amber, Cedar, Ambergris and Vanilla

title: Dolce Sonata Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Be transported to a serene sanctuary, away from the chaos of everyday life, with Dolce Sonata's tribute to the elegant realm of classical music. Let the perfumed notes of apricot, raspberry, lime, sweet orange, and bergamot create a symphony of scents that mirrors the enchanting melodies of a captivating voice. Immerse yourself in the timeless allure of this musical masterpiece on a sensory journey like no other.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Apricot, Lime, Bergamot and Sweet Orange

Middle notes: Incense, Osmanthus, Lily of the Valley, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Incense, Cotton Candy and Patchouli

title: Deified Tony Iommi Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating aroma of Deified Tony Iommi Parfum, a dark and decadent scent created in collaboration with Black Sabbath's legendary guitarist Tony Iommi and Xerjoff founder Sergio Momo. Step into a parallel universe of mystery and indulgence with this exclusive fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Apple and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Leather and Rose

Base notes: Papyrus, Patchouli, Musk and Moss

title: Lira Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lira embodies the essence of a seductive woman with notes of caramel, citrus, lavender, cinnamon, and liquorice. This captivating fragrance is both uncomplicated and powerful, enhanced by the sweet aromas of caramel and vanilla, balanced with the calming scent of blood orange, and enriched by subtle spices.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Bergamot and Lavender

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Licorice and Jasmine

Base notes: Vanille, Caramel and Musk

title: Absolute Aphrodisiac Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted with a blend of sweet vanilla, exotic musk, and castoreum, this Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac Eau de Parfum Spray is a luxurious and alluring gourmand scent.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla, Amber

Middle notes: Musk, White Flowers

Base notes: Castoreum, Leather

title: Atomic Rose Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Experience the fresh and floral scent of the InitioPink Pepper and Bergamot Atomic Rose Eau De Parfum. Enriched with sweet notes of vanilla and pink pepper, this exquisite perfume also boasts the exquisite Bulgarian and Turkish rose, evoking an intoxicating fragrance that will leave a lasting impression. Trust the expertise of Initio to bring a touch of luxury to your everyday routine.

Fragrance family: Rose, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Pink Pepper and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose and Egyptian Jasmine

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla and Amber

title: You Or Someone Like You Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the refreshing and sophisticated scent of You Or Someone Like You by Etat Libre d'Orange. Crafted for both women and men, this fragrance boasts a blend of mint, grapefruit, bergamot, and anise, with green notes, cassis, rose, and hedione in the middle. The base notes of white musk add a touch of elegance to this Citrus Aromatic fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mint, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Anise

Middle notes: Green Notes, Cassis, Rose and Hedione

Base notes: White Musk

title: Jump Up And Kiss Me Hedonistic Perfume
body_html:
Experience a lasting impression with Jump Up And Kiss Me Hedonistic by Clive Christian. With a 25% perfume concentration, the rich amber fragrance features notes of neroli, leather, and tobacco for a smoky and sensuous aroma. The oriental woody base provides a musky contrast to the subtle fruity top notes.

Fragrance family: Amber, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Leather

Middle notes: Labdanum

Base notes: Amber

title: Rose of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum
body_html:
During WWI, soldiers gave the nickname "Rose of No Man's Land" to the nurses who saved countless lives. Byredo pays homage to these selfless and brave nurses with an olfactory tribute in the form of a light and floral eau de parfum, featuring notes of sharp pink pepper, sweet rose, and warming amber.

Fragrance family: Rose, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Turkey Red Rose and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Turkey Red Rose and Raspberry Bloom

Base notes: Papyrus and Amber

title: Pink Me Up Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience uplifting emotions with Pink Me Up Eau de Parfum. Sparkling and effervescent, this fragrance captures the radiating glow of happiness and the delight of life. Notes of champagne, blackberry, and bergamot come together for an addictive yet sophisticated scent, balanced with hints of rose and musk.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Blackberry, Champagne and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli and Iris

title: Fugazzi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the thrill of a forbidden love with Fugazzi Eau de Parfum. Indulge in the seductive blend of creamy milk, bright grapefruit, and smoky incense. Let the spicy cumin and bold warmth embrace you, creating a mysterious and alluring scent. Perfect for those who crave excitement and rebellion.

Fragrance family: Musk, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Milk, Cumin, Grapefruit, Mandarin and Incense

Middle notes: Suede, Saffron, Vetiver and Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Vanilla, Styrax and Moss

title: Santal Austral Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Matiere Premiere's focus is on the valuable raw materials found in its gender-neutral fragrances, as seen with its Santal Austral eau de parfum. The fragrance features Organic Sandal Essence Australia as its base, enhanced by the alluring Iris Absolute and the irresistible Benzoin Absolute from Laos and Venezuelan Tonka Bean Absolute.

Fragrance family: Woody, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris

Middle notes: Sandalwood

Base notes: Benzoin and Tonka Bean

title: Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette
body_html: Molecule 01 contains the pure and singular molecule Iso E Super, which was developed in a laboratory at IFF in 1973. This unique molecule has the ability to create an elusive aura that surrounds the wearer, as it hovers close to the skin. Interestingly, Iso E Super is not found in nature, making it a truly exceptional creation.

title: Sunset Hour Parfum
body_html:
As the sun sets over the Indian Ocean, the aroma of tropical fruit fills the tranquil air of the evening. This luxurious fragrance combines zesty citrus and spicy notes, creating a delectable and rich floral bouquet. Perfectly suited for the magical hour of sunset.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Quandong, desert peach, Raspberry

Middle notes: Cashmere Wood, Sandalwood, Mandarin Orange, Pink Pepper

Base notes: Jasmine Sambac, Ginger, Benzoin

title: Delina La Rosee Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Delina La Rosee is a youthful and lively eau de parfum version of the original Delina fragrance. Its fresh touch delicately illuminates the skin, thanks to a blend of transparent water flowers and peony. The scent's olfactory journey begins with a radiant citric top note of Italian bergamot that is rich, soft, and fruity, then evolves into a grassier, balsamic aroma. The heart of the fragrance features the most precious damascena rose essence, while the base is a refined, harmonious combination of Haitian vetiver, wood, and white musk that envelops the senses.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aquatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lychee, Pear, Bergamot Essence

Middle notes: Damascena Rose, Peony, Transparent Flowers

Base notes: Soft wood, White Musk, Vetiver

title: Percival Eau de Parfum
body_html:
With a combination of citrus and aromatic scents atop a woody foundation, Percival Eau de Parfum boasts a fresh, sensual, and refined fragrance. Presented in an ocean blue bottle, this scent is sure to make a lasting impression. Bergamot and mandarin notes are elevated by a touch of aromatic water while the heart notes, a blend of natural jasmine, violet, geranium, lavender, coriander, and cinnamon, give Percival its depth and character. Finally, musk, pepper, and woody spices emerge at the base, providing a captivating finish.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Lavender, Geranium, Cardamom

Base notes: Balsam fir, Woody spices, Tonka Bean

title: Birth of Venus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the beauty and allure of the Birth of Venus Eau de Parfum by Argos. Released in 2024, this fragrance expertly blends top notes of bergamot, peach, and orange blossom with heart notes of narcissus, jasmine sambac, and rose, finished with a base of amber and sandalwood. Indulge in the irresistible blend of sweet and sensual with this luxurious perfume.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach, Orange Blossom, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Lavender

Middle notes: Raspberry, Chocolate, Rose, Jasmine Sambac and Narcissus

Base notes: Amber, Mysore Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cashmere Wood

title: Under My Skin Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Under My Skin Extrait de Parfum represents my nuanced exploration of animalic fragrances. After two years of development, I refined my approach by gradually eliminating heavier elements to create a sophisticated composition that aligns with my aesthetic sensibilities. The result is a subtly animalic leather accord with powdery undertones and velvety elegance. The name reflects its intimate character—a fragrance that seems to emerge naturally from within rather than being applied externally. This composition achieves a delicate balance between human warmth and restrained animalic qualities through its carefully calibrated leathery core.

Fragrance family: Leather, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spicy Notes, Black Pepper, Lavender and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Orris Root, Carnation and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Leather, Peru Balsam, Castoreum, Ambergris, Tolu Balsam, Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Oakmoss, Costus and Tonka Bean

title: Bake Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bake Eau de Parfum captures the irresistible essence of a freshly baked lemon cupcake. This sophisticated gourmand fragrance opens with bright, tart lemon notes that gradually meld into a heart of sweet vanilla, finally settling on a rich praline base. The meticulous composition perfectly balances citrus acidity with creamy sweetness, creating an olfactory experience that satisfies cravings while maintaining complexity and elegance. A testament to Akro's expertise in transforming culinary inspirations into refined fragrance artistry.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon Zest and Rum

Middle notes: Whipped Cream and Praline

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla and Brown sugar

title: Burgundy Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This composition presents a modern, distinctive reinterpretation of oud wood, transforming this traditionally enigmatic and somber ingredient through sophisticated French perfumery techniques. In BURGUNDY OUD, perfumer Céline Perdriel revitalizes oud's primordial character by juxtaposing it against the vivid, acidulous qualities of blackcurrant and bergamot. The composition's core enhances this dynamic freshness with geranium's plush texture and amyris's refined ligneous elegance. The result is an exceptional olfactory creation that imparts a commanding yet extraordinarily sensual signature on the wearer's skin.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blackcurrant, Bergamot and Guatemalan Cardamom

Middle notes: Geranium, Davana and Magnolia

Base notes: Oud, Leather and Amyris

title: Velvet Iris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Iris by Essential Parfums is a unisex Woody Floral Musk scent introduced in 2025. Crafted by perfumer Dominique Ropion, it opens with vibrant top notes of Buchu, Pink Pepper, and Tamarind. The heart reveals a blend of Orris, Iris, Galbanum, and Mastic, while the base combines rich Saffiano Leather, Sandalwood, and Labdanum for a sophisticated finish.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Buchu or Agathosma, Pink Pepper and Tamarind

Middle notes: Orris, Iris, Galbanum and Mastic or Lentisque

Base notes: Saffiano Leather, Sandalwood and Labdanum

title: Cavort Parfum
body_html:
Cavort Parfum captures the thrilling intimacy of a first encounter with its deeply evocative scent. This fragrance opens with a sultry saffron note that stirs anticipation and intrigue, perfectly embodying the excitement behind a stolen glance. Its warm, sensual aroma lingers, creating an unforgettable impression that invites closer connection. Ideal for moments when you want to express allure and confidence, Cavort is a sophisticated choice for those who appreciate a fragrance that tells a story of passion and mystery.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cinnamon, Davana and Geranium

Middle notes: Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom and Jasmine

Base notes: Labdanum, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Incense

title: Musc Pallas Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Musc Pallas by Jovoy Paris is a refined unisex woody floral musk fragrance launched in 2023. Crafted by renowned perfumer Vanina Muracciole, it begins with vibrant top notes of ambrette (musk mallow) and bergamot, offering a fresh and luminous introduction. The heart unfolds with a delicate blend of iris and peach, adding both elegance and softness to the composition. The fragrance settles into a sensual base of musk, muscenone, and tonka bean, which provide depth and warmth. Designed to balance freshness with richness, Musc Pallas offers a sophisticated and versatile scent experience suitable for both day and evening wear.

 Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris and Peach

Base notes: Musk, Muscenone and Tonka Bean

title: Magnolia Rosae Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A soft floral composition centered on magnolia petals with subtle rose undertones, unfolding into a smooth, velvety embrace of white musks. The exquisite glass and gold bottle features a golden plate on the back displaying the ingredient imprint and a side detail unveiling the secret of the Assemblage and its Signature.

 

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose

Middle notes: Magnolia

Base notes: White Musk

title: Kolada Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Kolada by Kajal is a Floral Fruity scent designed for both women and men. Released in 2025, this new fragrance was created by perfumer Toni Cabal. It opens with top notes of pineapple, fruity accords, and bergamot, leading to a floral heart of violet and lily of the valley. The base is composed of coconut, amber, and benzoin, providing a warm and inviting finish.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Fruity Notes and Bergamot

Middle notes: Violet and Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Coconut, Amber and Benzoin

title: Amazingreen Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a burst of exhilaration with Amazingreen Eau de Parfum. The fragrance opens with vibrant wild green leaves, blending into a core of flint and coriander. This evolves into a smoky finale where gunpowder and white musk create a striking contrast, balanced by the fresh energy of jungle herbs and lively spices.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Pepper, Palm Tree and Hazelnut

Middle notes: Ivy, Coriander, Orris Root and Flint

Base notes: Vetiver, gunpowder, White Musk and Smoke

title: Eternal Sunrise Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Eternal Sunrise by The Merchant of Venice embodies the serene glow of dawn breaking over the Nile. This Eau de Parfum begins with smoky notes of Kyphi and incense, leading to a heart enriched with papyrus, Akigalawood, and luminous Ambrofix. The composition settles into a warm, enigmatic base of Styrax, Cistus, and Tonka Bean, evoking the radiant, mysterious warmth of a golden sunrise.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Frankincense and Kyphi

Middle notes: Ambrofix, Akigalawood, Papyrus and Cypriol

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Labdanum and Styrax

title: Shem El Nessim Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Shem-el-Nessim, meaning “smelling the breeze” in Arabic, draws inspiration from the Egyptian summer festival along the Nile. Introduced in 1906 as an iris fragrance, it features notes of bergamot, neroli, geranium, jasmine, rose, ylang-ylang, iris, musk, patchouli, cedar, sandalwood, heliotrope, and vanilla.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Neroli and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orris Root, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Geranium and Rose

Base notes: Heliotrope, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk and Cedar

title: Choco Loco Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Choco Loco is an audacious fragrance that reimagines hot chocolate as an uninhibited sensory experience. Raw cacao and cocoa butter establish a bitter foundation before the composition pivots toward darker indulgence—caramelized sugar, fudge, and ginger liquor create a smoky, almost intoxicating heart. The base unfolds with cookie dough and marshmallow notes, anchored by vanilla warmth and ambrette musk, leaving a lingering trace of brown sugar and skin-like musks. This is not a delicate fragrance; it's deliberately dense, sticky, and unapologetically sweet—a composition that prioritizes sensual excess over restraint.

 

Fragrance family: Sweet, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Liquor, Cocoa and Butter

Middle notes: Cacao, Liquor, Burnt Sugar, Whipped Cream, Caramel, Condensed Milk and Ginger

Base notes: Cookie Dough, Vanilla Absolute, Marshmallow, Brown sugar, Musk and Ambrette

title: Indian Venus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indian Venus is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women, composed by master perfumer Benoît Bergia in 2018. The composition unfolds with woody notes, orange blossom, and labdanum, evolving into a refined heart of white sandalwood, white flowers, and cedar. The base reveals brown sugar, woody accords, and musk, creating a sophisticated and sensual signature.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Woody Notes, Orange Blossom and Labdanum

Middle notes: White Sandalwood, White Flowers and Cedar

Base notes: Brown sugar, Woody Notes and Musk

title: Atmah Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Atmah Eau De Parfum represents Caron's 2025 debut, drawing inspiration from the Sanskrit concept of Atman—the vital essence connecting individual consciousness to the universal. The fragrance also references a historic yacht owned by Baron Edmond de Rothschild in 1898, a meaningful family touchstone for Olivia de Rothschild. The composition balances luminous white florals with sophisticated woody-musky undertones, layering tuberose, jasmine, and rosy accords with pink pepper. The base unfolds with ambrette, musk, vanilla, and vetiver, enriched by modern amber-wood materials including Ambrofix and Akigalawood, creating a refined and contemplative scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla, Ambrette Seeds, Tuberose

Middle notes: Jasmine, Musk, Pink Peppercorn, RosyfoliaTM

Base notes: AmbrofixTM, Akigalawood, Vetiver des Sables

title: Cedrus Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cedrus Intense is a woody aromatic Eau de Parfum that deepens the cedar-forward character of the original Cedrus with richer woods and sophisticated complexity. Crafted by perfumers Quentin Bisch & Louise Turner, this powerful reinterpretation balances cedar's strength with elegant green, leathery, and amber accords for a refined, long-lasting fragrance.

 

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Green Notes

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Australian Sandalwood, Chinese Cedar, Vetiver and Amber

title: Sugar Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A desert caravan traverses endless white dunes toward Al Khaluf, where sun-warmed leather saddles release their honeyed perfume against lunar landscapes. Sugar Leather embodies this sensory paradox—supple leather dusted with caramelized sweetness, as if burnished by relentless heat. Decadent yet austere, this composition balances the tactile richness of aged hide with spiced warmth and crystalline sugar notes, creating a fragrance that evokes both luxury and the raw intensity of arid terrain.

Fragrance family: Leather, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon, prune

Middle notes: Amyris, tonka bean, patchouli

Base notes: Leather, caramel, labdanum

title: Novae Vanilla Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Novae Vanilla Eau de Parfum, a rich and indulgent fragrance that celebrates the warmth and sensuality of vanilla with a refined gourmand touch. This captivating composition opens with soft sweet accords and delicate spices, creating a warm and inviting introduction. The heart reveals a creamy vanilla note blended with subtle floral nuances, adding depth, smoothness, and elegance. In the base, warm woods, amber, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with sweetness, warmth, and sophisticated allure. Novae Vanilla is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances gourmand richness with refined elegance.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Sweet, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sweet accords, soft spices

Middle notes: Vanilla, floral nuances

Base notes: Woods, amber, musk

title: Triumph of Bacchus Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Triumph of Bacchus Extrait de Parfum is a lavish, wine-infused oriental-gourmand that celebrates Dionysian excess—velvety, boozy, and sensually opulent. This unisex concentration blends ripe, fermented fruit and vinous accords with warm spices, resinous florals, and a rich, barrel-aged woody-amber base, creating a decadent, long-lasting statement suited to evening wear and special occasions.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Gourmand, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black grape accord, blood plum, bergamot, saffron

Middle notes: Red wine/port accord, Damask rose, jasmine, fig nectar, spice (cardamom/cinnamon)

Base notes: Aged oak/barrel accord, vanilla, benzoin, labdanum, cedarwood, leather, amber

title: Wake Up World Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wake Up World is an energetic, effervescent aromatic-citrus that channels morning optimism and urban vitality—bright, brisk, and invigorating. This unisex composition pairs sparkling citrus and green facets with a lively aromatic heart and a clean, slightly mineral-woody base, creating a fresh, versatile scent designed for daytime wear and active mornings where clarity and uplift are desired.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, lemon, grapefruit, green apple

Middle notes: Green tea, basil, lavender, jasmine water

Base notes: Vetiver, cedarwood, ambroxan, white musk

title: Honiara Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Honiara — Fort & Manle is a luminous tropical fragrance that captures the warmth of exotic islands through a rich blend of creamy florals, ripe fruits, and soft woods. It opens with a radiant burst of tropical fruits and citrus nuances, creating an immediate sensation of sunlit freshness and vibrant sweetness. The heart unfolds into an opulent floral accord of white flowers and creamy coconut facets, adding softness, sensuality, and an indulgent tropical depth that feels both elegant and comforting. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth base of vanilla, sandalwood, amber, and soft musk, leaving a warm, creamy, and long-lasting trail that evokes golden beaches and relaxed island luxury.

Fragrance family: Tropical, Floral, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Tropical fruits, citrus nuances
Middle notes: White florals, creamy coconut facets
Base notes: Vanilla, sandalwood, amber, soft musk

title: Nitro Musk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Nitro Musk — Scentologia is a contemporary floral-musky fragrance that explores the fascinating contrast between icy precision and intimate warmth. As the inaugural creation of Scentologia's [Ne]on Collection, the composition is designed to evolve uniquely on each wearer's skin, highlighting the transformative nature of musk. It opens with a cool and luminous blend of bergamot, lily of the valley, and heliotrope, creating an impression of crystalline freshness softened by delicate powdery nuances. As the fragrance develops, peony, jasmine sambac, and orange blossom unfold into an elegant white floral heart, adding natural sensuality and graceful refinement. The dry down reveals the true essence of the composition, where ambrettolide and musk merge with ambroxan and vetiver to create a smooth, addictive, and skin-like trail that feels both clean and deeply alluring. Sophisticated yet effortlessly wearable, Nitro Musk transforms from controlled freshness into an intimate expression of modern sensuality.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Musky, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Lily of the Valley, Heliotrope
Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac, Peony
Base Notes: Ambrettolide, Musk, Ambroxan, Vetiver

title: Torino 21 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Torino 21 Eau de Parfum by Xerjoff is a sophisticated unisex fragrance that masterfully blends aromatic green notes to create a fresh yet complex scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with invigorating top notes of mint, lemon, basil, and thyme, offering a crisp and vibrant introduction. The heart reveals a refined bouquet of black currant, lavender, rosemary, and jasmine, adding depth and floral elegance. Anchoring the composition are warm base notes of musk and vervain, which provide a subtle, lingering sensuality. This expertly crafted fragrance balances freshness with richness, making it ideal for those seeking a versatile and distinctive signature scent.

Fragrance family: Green, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mint, Lemon, Basil and Thyme

Middle notes: Black Currant, Lavender, Rosemary and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk and Vervain

title: Jasmine Freak Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jasmine Freak Eau de Parfum is a daring scent that embraces the rebellious spirit of self-expression. Bursting with the tropical brightness of mango, the captivating charm of jasmine, and the rich creaminess of tuberose, it creates a vibrant world where uniqueness shines. This fragrance blends influences from fashion, music, cinema, and literature to honor creativity and freedom. Whether boy by day or girl by night, it encourages you to challenge norms and be unapologetically yourself. Embrace your true identity with this bold, boundary-breaking aroma.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Sweet Orange, Black Currant and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Egyptian Jasmine, Indian Tuberose and Ylang Ylang

Base notes: Musk and Cashmere Wood

title: Leder 6 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Leder 6 Eau de Parfum, formerly known as Fetisch by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin, is a sophisticated leather fragrance suitable for all genders. This captivating composition draws inspiration from Berlin's provocative fetish scene, artfully blending traditional perfumery heritage with contemporary urban influences. The result is a bold olfactory statement that embodies desire and mystique, reflecting the duality of Berlin's rich cultural landscape.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Leather, Saffron and Osmanthus

Middle notes: Vanilla and Milk

Base notes: Incense and Styrax

title: Vert Malachite Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vert Malachite Eau de Parfum is a floral fragrance, incorporating top notes of bitter orange and petitgrain, floral scents of lily and jasmine, and strong base notes of vanilla.

Fragrance family: Floral, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bitter Orange and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang and Pink Pepper

Base notes: Lily, Vanilla and Benzoin

title: Tygar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar, a unique blend of woody and citrussy notes including fresh grapefruit and refined ambergris. Experience the captivating contrast of this exquisite fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit

Middle notes: Ginger and Ambrette

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Vetiver and Patchouli

title: Halfeti Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the warm, strong, and reassuring notes of Halfeti Eau de Parfum. Transport yourself to the exotic lands of Turkey where the red roses appear black and their magic is intense. The journey begins with fresh bergamot, hints of green, and aromatic Artemisia. As it evolves, jasmine and spiced rose add a touch of excitement - this love has thorns. The ending brings a promise of distant lands with the comforting scents of vanilla, sandalwood, leather, Oud, amber, and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cypress Leaf, Saffron, Cardamom, Artemisia, Bergamot and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Nutmeg and Jasmine

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Cedar, Leather, Sandalwood, Amber, Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Musk

title: Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum is an olfactory voyage reserved for the fearless. If you prefer delicate and airy scents, this is where you should stop reading. Inspired by hashish, this fragrance has been surrounded by enigma and intrigue from the start.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cannabis, Green Notes, Davana, Saffron and Thyme

Middle notes: Resins, Woodsy Notes, Tobacco, Coffee, Raspberry, Cinnamon and Violet

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Amber, Animal notes, Musk, Guaiac Wood, Tonka, Gurjan balsam, Ambroxan, Cedar and Vanilla

title: Sunset Hour Dark Peach Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sunset Hour Dark Peach captures the intoxicating beauty of an Australian sunset, when the last rays of golden light transform the landscape into shades of amber and apricot. Inspired by the original Sunset Hour, this richer interpretation places the sensual character of peach at the centre, creating an indulgent fragrance that blends luminous fruit with warm spice, creamy woods, and soft gourmand nuances.

The fragrance opens with juicy peach,bright bergamot,and cinnamon, creating a radiant and spicy introduction. At the heart, ginger,coffee,and jasmine add warmth, aromatic depth, and floral luminosity. The composition settles into a creamy base of sandalwood,vanilla,and tonka bean, leaving a smooth, addictive trail that mirrors the warmth of the fading sun.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Gourmand,Spicy,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Peach,Bergamot,Cinnamon

Middle Notes: Ginger,Coffee,Jasmine

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Vanilla,Tonka Bean

title: Velvet Violet Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Violet Eau de Parfum — Dries Van Noten is a contemporary woody-floral gourmand fragrance that explores an unexpected interpretation of violet through contrast and texture. Created by perfumer Gaël Montero, the composition pairs the green, woody freshness of violet leaf with the warm, roasted and nutty character of sesame, creating a distinctive balance between freshness, spice, and gourmand warmth.

It opens with pink pepper, violet leaf, and clary sage essence, creating a vibrant, green, aromatic introduction with a subtle spicy lift. At its heart, toasted sesame absolute and roasted barley introduce a warm, nutty, almost creamy gourmand character. As the fragrance settles, grilled tonka beans, benzoin resinoide, and vetiver essence create a smooth, warm, woody and subtly balsamic base.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Floral,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Pink Pepper,Violet Leaf,Clary Sage Essence
Heart Notes: Toasted Sesame Absolute,Roasted Barley
Base Notes: Grilled Tonka Beans,Benzoin Resinoide,Vetiver Essence

title: L'envers Du Paradis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A spicy dance with contrasting accords, joined by fresh and musky notes in a powerful composition. Inspired by water's vitality and depth, ingredients like cascalone, bergamot, and cardamom are balanced with warmer elements for a sublime contrast.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Guatemalan Cardamom

Base notes: Ambroxan and Musk

title: Promise Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the essence of honor with Frederic Malle's Promise Eau de Parfum. This warm and spicy fragrance blends Bulgarian rose essence and Turkish rose absolute with apple, pink pepper and clove. Sensual notes of patchouli, cypriol and labdanum complete this Middle Eastern pledge.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Pink Pepper, Rosemary, Saffron and Cloves;

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose and Turkish Rose

Base notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Patchouli, Castoreum, Labdanum and Ambroxan

title: Santal Blush Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing the Enigmatic Woods collection by Tom Ford, a luxurious tribute to ancient grandeur and spiritual opulence. Santal Blush features the hero ingredients of exotic eastern spices and sandalwood, complemented by delicate florals and decadent woods. The end result is a warm and alluring fusion with a subtle hint of sweetness.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices, Cinnamon, Caraway, Fenugreek and Carrot Seeds

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Sandalwood, Benzoin, Virginia Cedar, Musk and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Basso Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As the lights dim and the red curtains open, the orchestra begins to play. The commanding basso profondo voice fills the air with its deep, powerful tones. Notes of sharp Grapefruit, leathery Labdanum, spicy Carnation, and hints of Mayflower create a bold and alluring scent. At its base, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Celery Seeds, Black and Pink Pepper, Galbanum, Nutmeg, Guaiac Wood, Oakmoss, and Cedar come together in a pleasant battle between strength and sensuality.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit

Middle notes: Mayflower, Carnation and Labdanum

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Black Pepper, Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Nutmeg, Pink Pepper, Galbanum and Celery Seeds

title: Burlington 1819 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the sophistication of Burlington 1819 Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the first Roja flagship store in London, this complex citrus scent features a juicy burst of grapefruit and lime, fresh mint, and a dark twist of spiced ginger. The lush tobacco and casmir wood base adds a touch of luxury. Arrives in a striking glass bottle with gold-toned accents and a crystal stopper.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Lime, Mint, Bitter Orange and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Ginger, Cinnamon, Cumin, Saffron

Base notes: Patchouli, Oakmoss, Rum, Tobacco, Cedarwood, Casmir Wood, Benzoin, Vanilla, Labdanum, Ambergris, Musk

title: Flamenco Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Flamenco Extrait de Parfum maintains its passionate essence, reinforced by the Master's expertise and attention to detail.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Saffron and Rose

Middle notes: Iris, Cedarwood, Jasmine and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Oud, Leather, Amber and Musk

title: La Tosca Eau de Parfum
body_html:
La Tosca Eau de Parfum is a luxurious scent that takes inspiration from Giacomo Puccini's famous masterpiece, embodying the lavishness and theatricality of the Art Nouveau era. This fragrance features a blend of tangy lemon and refreshing eucalyptus, followed by delicate violet and rose petals, and finished with a warm musky base.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Mandarin and Italian Lemon

Middle notes: Violet Leaf, Eucalyptus and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli, Madagascar Vanilla and Amber

title: Narcotic Delight Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Narcotic Delight Eau De Parfum by Initio is a vibrant and seductive fragrance that awakens the senses. Its luxurious bottle encases a blend of vanilla bean, pink pepper, and cognac, evoking a wild and irresistible aroma. The addition of plump cherry adds a tantalizing twist to this unforgettable scent.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Pink Pepper and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Cognac, Hedione and Rose

Base notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Tonka, Cedar and Patchouli

title: Musk Therapy Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance, Musk Therapy Eau de Parfum by Initio, incorporates sandalwood and pink and white musks to create a curious and intriguing opening, which is further softened by notes of white magnolia.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sandalwood and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: White Magnolia

Base notes: White Musk

title: Lilyphea Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As an expert in the world of plants, Lilyphea Eau de Parfum celebrates the renowned beauty of the water lily. Its refreshing scent combines cardamom and violet leaves with a hint of sweet vanilla. The fragrance's name cleverly combines "water lily" and "Nymphéas", the French term for Claude Monet's famous Water Lilies series. The bottle features delicate outlines of water lilies, enticing us to peaceful reflection, while the sleeve depicts the vibrant blue and green tones in a stunning watercolor.

Fragrance family: Floral, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet Leaf

Middle notes: Cardamom, Ginger

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla

title: Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Diptyque Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum takes you on a journey, capturing the essence of travel and showcasing the evolution of leather in its blend. The lively spiciness of pink peppercorn and the woody scent of Atlas cedar combine to create a dynamic and captivating fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Saffron and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Leather, Iris and Cedar

Base notes: Vanilla and Musk

title: Nectarine Blossom & Honey Cologne
body_html:
Discover the captivating scents of Nectarine Blossom and Honey Cologne as it takes you on a journey to Covent Garden market at dawn. Experience the blend of juicy nectarines, peaches, and black currants with delicate spring flowers and a touch of acacia honey. This fragrance is sweet, playful, and irresistible.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Notes, Black Currant and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Nectarine and Black locust

Base notes: Peach, Plum and Vetiver

title: Taif Rose Cologne Intense
body_html:
Indulge in the luxurious scent of Jo Malone London's Taif Rose Cologne Intense.
