Inspired by the radiant beauty of the Taif rose, this fragrance combines rose infusion, exquisite Taif rose, and rich coffee notes for a truly irresistible allure. Experience the essence of Arabian luxury with this captivating masterpiece.

Fragrance family: Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Damask Rose

Middle notes: Amber

Base notes: Coffee

title: Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Queen of Silk, a seductive symphony of Chinese osmanthus, Javanese patchouli, and Madagascan vanilla. Infused with the ethereal softness of silk, this captivating fragrance transports you to distant lands with each spritz. Experience the essence of luxury and sensuality with Queen of Silk by The House of Creed.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Osmanthus and Magnolia

Middle notes: Passionfruit, Tuberose, Patchouli and Agarwood (Oud)

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Ambroxan, Musk, Myrrh, Incense and Cedarwood

title: 24 rue de l'universite Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
The 17th century mansion, Hôtel de Sénecterre, is home to SAINT LAURENT's workshops, located at 24 rue de l'universite. The scent evokes the pure elegance of this place with a sandalwood and suede blend, reflecting the immaculate white paneling.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sandalwood

Middle notes: Incense

Base notes: Daim, Cedar

title: 6 place Saint Sulpice Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Located in the iconic Rive Gauche district, 6 place Saint Sulpice is a historic SAINT LAURENT boutique. The scent captures the bold visual aesthetic of the area, with hints of rich labdanum and seductive leather in sharp black and white tones.

Fragrance family: Amber, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Bergamot

Middle notes: Labdanum, Saffron

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Leather

title: Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted by Kilian, Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum combines the bold notes of dark rum, dried fruits, and nutmeg with the warmth of patchouli. This luxurious scent is perfect for evening wear, exuding a sensual and alluring aroma. Elevate your fragrance game with this sultry and sophisticated elixir.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum and Dried Fruits

Middle notes: Patchouli, Nutmeg, Jasmine and Hedione

Base notes: Virginia Cedar, Musk, Amber, Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, Leather and Tonka

title: Black Phantom Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Black Phantom Eau De Parfum by Kilian boasts a luxurious rum accord sourced from Martinique, paired with a robust coffee aroma at its core. Packaged in a box set and topped with an engraved spray bottle.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum

Middle notes: Dark Chocolate, Coffee, Almond and Heliotrope

Base notes: Caramel, Sugar Cane, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Tonka and Vetiver

title: New York Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating "oriental touch" of New York City with Patricia de Nicolaï's intense Eau de Parfum. Featuring a blend of zesty notes, pepper, cloves, and patchouli, infused with vanilla, incense, and balms, this fragrance perfectly captures the essence of the city that never sleeps. Inspired by San Antonio, a novel written by Frédéric Dard, one of the first admirers of this intoxicating scent.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Petitgrain essence Lemon tree, Bergamot, Lemon, Thyme, Artemisia

Middle notes: Lavender, Petitgrain, Black Pepper, Cloves, Artemisia, Thyme

Base notes: Oak Moss, Tonka Bean, Styrax, Incense Resinoid, Musk

title: Emerald Green Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Step into the glorious Victorian age with Emerald Green Eau de Parfum by The House of Oud. Inspired by the emerald parure commissioned by Prince Albert for Queen Victoria, this refined jewel of a fragrance is bursting with love, style, and magnificence. With energetic citrus notes and sensual jasmine and patchouli, experience the intimacy and exclusivity of Emerald Green.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Bergamot, Tangerine and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Ginger, Jasmine and Cardamom

Base notes: Ambergris, White Musk and Patchouli

title: Ruby Red Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Royal Stones collection, designed by The House of Oud, now features a new gemstone: Ruby Red. Inspired by the many shades of red found in Queen Elizabeth II's jewelry, this fragrance celebrates the lasting love between Her Majesty and the Prince Consort. With its sophisticated and timeless scent, Ruby Red pays homage to the art of perfumery. Its regal blend of Ginger and floral notes creates an alluring aura that is both intriguing and passionate. The fleshy petals of Ylang Ylang harmonize with delicate Tuberose and distinctive Ginger flowers, swirling together in an intoxicating accord. A base of oriental notes, including sweet Vanilla, warm Woody tones, and luminous Musk, adds depth and richness to this lush and refined fragrance. The perfect balance between spicy Ginger and delicate flowers makes Ruby Red a truly captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger and Tangerine

Middle notes: Tuberose, Ginger flower and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Candied Ginger, Vanilla, Woody Notes and Musk

title: Madurai Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the essence of Madurai with Madurai Eau de Parfum. Created by Memo Paris, this fragrance combines the scents of turmeric, jasmine, and sandalwood with a sweet peach twist for a mesmerizing and unique fragrance experience. Pay homage to India's vibrant city streets and markets with this delicate and rich perfume.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon essence, Bergamot essence, Curcuma essence, Clary Sage essence, Peach alcoholate

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Tuberose absolute, Jasmine absolute, Tagete essence

Base notes: Sandalwood Album essence, Suede accord

title: Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the elegance and strength of a stallion with Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum. Crafted by Thibaud Crivelli in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez, this fragrance captures the rich scent of oud at a horse race. Exclusive to Harrods, this cologne offers a captivating olfactory journey to the racetrack.

Fragrance family: Leather, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: affron, Cardamom and Indonesian Nutmeg

Middle notes: Osmanthus, Turkish Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Leather, Cedar, Tonka and Patchouli

title: Vanille Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted with a blend of tuberose, jasmine, and orange blossom, our Vanille Leather Eau de Parfum exudes a sensual aroma. The combination of delicate, white flowers and Madagascar vanilla creates an alluring elixir. To add depth, we've added notes of smoky leather and rich woody accords created from oak wood essence and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink peppercorn, Violet accord

Middle notes: Indian tuberose absolute, Egyptian jasmine absolute, Orange blossom absolute

Base notes: Madagascan vanilla, Indonesian patchouli, Oakwood, Leather accord, Orris, Benzoin resinoid

title: 312 Saint-Honore Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The 312 Saint-Honoré eau de parfum from BDK Parfums is a sophisticated and artistic fragrance inspired by the raw materials of Parisian origins. It begins with a captivating combination of pink peppercorn leaf and extract, followed by sweet tonka bean and powdery iris. The rich blend is enhanced with ambery musk and oud wood, creating depth and warmth. Enjoy a delicate yet captivating scent trail of pink peppercorn, white musk, and orange blossom, perfectly balanced with woody, musky, and floral notes.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper and Angelica Root

Middle notes: Iris, Orange Blossom and Tonka Bean

Base notes: White Musk, Ambroxan, Ambrostar and Thailand Oud

title: Gris Charnel Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This concentrated fragrance enhances the potency of BDK’s notable Gris Charnel fragrance. Drawing inspiration from the lively Parisian nightlife, it offers a woody, spicy take on the city's sensual energy. The dynamic blend of fig, black tea, and cardamom at the top introduces a sophisticated fruity aroma that enriches the subsequent accords. Luxurious notes of sandalwood and tonka bean form a rich base, while a heart of iris and opulent bourbon vetiver adds depth and complexity to the scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Black Tea, Cardamom Essence

Middle notes: Iris Absolute, Bourbon Vetiver

Base notes: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean Absolute

title: Fig Infusion Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Created by Nathalie Lorson, Fig Infusion Eau de Parfum is inspired by the sunny atmosphere of southern France. The fragrance features bright top notes of fig, mandarin, and clementine, followed by a floral heart of freesia and orange blossom, and a base of Sri Lankan black tea and woods including Virginian cedarwood and sandalwood. The comforting and refined scent is enhanced by the addition of benzoin.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Black Tea, Orange Blossom

Base notes: Sandalwood, Benzoin

title: Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum is an exquisite blend of light and dark, delicate and powerful, subtle and extravagant - seemingly contradictory elements that are seamlessly united through the skilled craft of perfumery. Formulated with a remarkable 46% concentration.

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Frankincense, Hazelnut, Rose Water, Pink Pepper, Bitter Almond

Middle notes: Saffron, Rose, Sambac Jasmine, Osmanthus

Base notes: Cistus, Sandalwood, Akigalawood, Ambergris, Vanilla, Ambrette, Georgywood, Cypriol

title: Boundless Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Boundless Eau de Parfum captures the essence of joy and euphoria, representing the limitless energy that empowers individuals to embrace the vastness of the world. Its vibrant and dynamic scent evokes the sun's warm rays bouncing off dewy leaves in the jungle, sparkling through a canopy of colorful flowers and illuminating rainbow-hued trees before fading into the misty, gnarled branches.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Cardamom, Ginger, Elemi

Middle notes: Vanilla Bourbon, Benzoin

Base notes: Vetiver, Papyrus, Cocoa, Tobacco, Myrrh, Oakmoss, Frankincense, Patchouli

title: London Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a unique fragrance that expertly blends the sweetness of tea and the allure of leather. With deep, dark notes of oud and cypress, complemented by lush florals and succulent raspberry accents

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Agarwood (Oud), Violet and Cypress

Middle notes: Raspberry and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Leather, Vanilla, Amber and Musk

title: Yasat Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Yasat Island, located in the tranquil waters of Abu Dhabi, is a peaceful refuge where the soft ocean breeze transports a distinctive, refreshing scent of flowers and salt spray.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Cardamom

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Caramel and Cedarwood

Base notes: Vanilla, Musky and Amber Dry

title: Rimal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enchanting aura of the desert with Rimal Eau de Parfum. The rich scents of saffron, cinnamon, incense, leather, labdanum and agarwood are accompanied by enticing floral notes of rose and ylang-ylang. Feel the warm magic of the dunes in every spritz

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla, Fruity Notes, White Flowers, Saffron, Cinnamon, Nutmeg

Middle notes: Patchouli, Styrax, Sweet Notes, Incense, Rose, Ylang-ylang

Base notes: Caramel, Leather, Amber, Vetiver, Cistus Labdanum, Sandalwood, Musk, Agarwood

title: Brioni Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted with sophistication and charm, this fragrance embodies the quintessential effortless elegance of Roman chic, drawing you in with its irresistible allure. Part of the woody floral aromatic olfactory family, its composition features a modern ozonic opening of cool pink peppercorn and crisp green apple. The delicate heart reveals a powdery violet note that perfectly balances the silky warmth of ambroxan. And as it dries down, naturally sourced cedarwood and tonka bean mingle with a touch of cashmere-like musk for a sophisticated finish. Both the cedarwood and hand-picked peppercorn used in this fragrance are sustainably sourced, making it a conscious choice for the discerning consumer.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ozonic notes, Green Apple and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Violet and Ambroxan

Base notes: Cedar, Musk and Tonka Bean

title: Narcotic Venus Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Narcotic V is a highly feminine scent, with a bold, unapologetic tuberose that exudes buttery richness. It confidently announces its presence with a flourish, standing tall and strong on the ground. Few fragrances can match its absolute and total power to captivate and seduce, embracing its femininity without hesitation or disguise. It is a celebration of the beauty found in the sweet, white tropical flowers that embody it, a true mankiller in every sense of the word.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose, Jasmine

Middle notes: Lily

Base notes: Spices

title: Star Chaser Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the thrill of adventure with Star Chaser Eau de Parfum. Inspired by explorers and trailblazers, this scent represents the freedom of roaming and charting your own path. With fresh top notes of neroli and a marine accord, balanced by a touch of green apple, the fragrance exudes a modern masculinity. The middle notes combine a mysterious woody accord with the comforting sweetness of tonka bean, evoking the excitement of discovering something new. In the base, labdanum and sandalwood add an authentic and curious element, transporting you to uncharted territories and igniting your sense of discovery.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Notes, Green Apple and Neroli

Middle notes: Dry Wood and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Sandalwood and Labdanum

title: BORNTOSTANDOUT Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
BORNTOSTANDOUT by FUGAZZI is a fragrance created by Valerie Garnuch-Mentzel, embodying the allure and mystery of a second love. This scent captures the forbidden passion of wild romance and daring intensity.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Geranium

Middle notes: Rose, Akigalawood and Pepper

Base notes: Cedarwood, Leather, Tobacco and Amber

title: Dream Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Dream Sea Extrait de Parfum brings an alluring and luxurious fragrance with notes of spices, white flowers, and green vegetation. The scent of the sea adds a crisp and refreshing touch while enchanting sirens' call adds a touch of magic. Perfect for evening wear, indulge in the embrace of love and the tranquility of the sea with Dream Sea.

Fragrance family: Marine, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Watery Notes, Pink Pepper, Black Pepper, Ozonic Notes, Green Notes

Middle notes: White Flowers, Bulgarian Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Spices

Base notes: Ambergris, Cyprus Black Salt, Sandalwood, Cedar, Vanilla

title: The Forward Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Drawing inspiration from modern and unisex perfumes, The Forward Extrait de Parfum captivates with its bold and unforgettable opening of vibrant, shimmering citruses. As it progresses, the scent reveals its depth and sophistication with subtle notes of florambers and gourmands, and a touch of salt, jasmine, and vanilla. This multifaceted fragrance defies expectations and establishes a new standard of luxury.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pomelo, Mandarin Orange and Lemon

Middle notes: Salt, Tonka Bean and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Sandalwood, Cashmeran and Madagascar Vanilla

title: Mentor Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Mentor Extrait de Parfum celebrates contrasts with its indulgent and complex blend. At its core lies Boya Oud, a sophisticated and smoky ingredient that creates an earthy foundation. Warm and honeyed notes of Amber and Tonka Bean add richness and depth, while the inclusion of Dark Plum brings a multifaceted sweetness. This delicate balance of sweet and earthy notes illuminates the fragrance's base, resulting in a captivating and evocative scent experience.

Fragrance family: Amber, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caramel, Plum and Italian Lemon

Middle notes: Coffee, Amber, Resin and Cassis

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Oud

title: Queening Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Queening Extrait de Parfum is a royal and uplifting fragrance, celebrating success and perseverance. The exquisite blend of Orris and vanilla symbolize a journey through challenges, while aged rum and saffron bring an empowering touch. For all current and aspiring Queens, this fragrance inspires and represents daily successes and major accomplishments.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Clean Cotton Accord, Cypress, Apple

Middle notes: Orris, Rum, Saffron

Base notes: Whipped Vanilla Bean, Fluffy Musk, Coconut

title: Uncut Gem Eau de Parfum
body_html:
UNCUT GEM is an amber fragrance inspired by master perfumer Maurice Roucel's eau de Cologne. The fragrance opens with notes of bright bergamot and mandarin, accented by ginger and angelica root. It then reveals a sensually warm blend of vetiver, incense, and musk. The long-lasting amber wood base adds a bold and intense touch to this characterful scent fit for an uncompromising man.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Bergamot, Angelica, Mandarin Orange and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Vetiver, Olibanum, Leather and Magnolia

Base notes: Musk, Amber, Cedar, Ambrocenide and Labdanum

title: Ile Bourbon Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The unexplored terrain of the Indian Ocean serves as the inspiration for ILE BOURBON Extrait de Parfum. This exquisite fragrance captures the enigmatic aroma of smoky chocolate, found deep within the unspoiled wilderness of Madagascar. As if venturing into the unknown in the 17th century, this sensory journey takes you on an adventure through a luxurious island's untouched nature. Immerse yourself in a symphony of warm spices, including vanilla, clove, and cinnamon, as the mystical forests and earthy wilderness converge to create a truly unique and captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dark Chocolate and Cinammon

Middle notes: Guatemalan Cardamom and Jasmine

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla and Incense

title: Dorasima Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the magic of a winter wonderland with Dorasima Eau de Parfum. This floral and fruity fragrance is intertwined with a warm woody base, evoking feelings of coziness amidst the cold Swedish winters. With the scents of winter fruits and floral diversity, this perfume creates a harmonious blend of coolness and warmth. A truly enchanting fragrance for the senses.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Rose, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Violet

Base notes: Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood, Musk, Amber, Cedar and Leather

title: Swedish Wood Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The dense forests of Sweden have been a defining characteristic of the country since the 17th century, providing a fertile land for various types of flowers and woods that emit a unique aroma. This fragrance incorporates Bulgarian roses and pink pepper with a base of oud and patchouli, along with the aromatic caperpol oil, to create a blend of natural woods and roses that represents the true essence of Sweden's geography. Experience the beauty of the past and an enduring longing for nature with just a spritz of this fragrance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Rosemary and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cloves and Floral Notes

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vetiver, Patchouli, Labdanum and Cyperus esculentus

title: Herbes Troublantes Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance awakens strong and lively feelings, while staying true to the essence of Eau de Cologne. The musky and cottony undertones are enhanced with the delightful notes of Calabrian bergamot and invigorating herbs. Herbes Troublantes is the renamed version of "Un Dimanche à la Campagne", but still captures its bucolic essence.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Herbal Notes, Bergamot

Middle notes: Orange Blossom

Base notes: White Musk

title: Pacific Rock Flower Parfum
body_html:
Released in 2025 by Goldfield & Banks, Pacific Rock Flower is a unisex fragrance that falls into the citrus, woody, and floral families. Its composition begins with tea, eucalyptus, lemon, and sea salt, followed by a heart of mimosa, peony, and tuberose, and finishes with cedar, moss, patchouli, and sandalwood.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Sea Salt, Eucalyptus and Tea

Middle notes: Peony, Mimosa and Tuberose

Base notes: Sandalwood, Cedar, Patchouli and Moss

title: L'Air Des Alpes Suisses Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refreshing and invigorating scent of L'Air Des Alpes Suisses. With a bright opening of bitter alpine herbs and cool glacier air, this fragrance takes you on a journey through the lush green heart, filled with blooming alpine lilies and pine needles. The warm, woody finish, enriched with earthy tones, evokes the natural beauty of Switzerland. Discover the unique and alluring scent of L'Air Des Alpes Suisses today, created by industry expert Tauer.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Amber Gris, Tonka, Fir, Birch, Dried Needles

Middle Notes: Lily, Orchid, Wild Thyme, Basil, Rosewood

Base Notes: Nutmeg, Mountain Lavender, Lemon Balm

title: Angel's Dust Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
In an antique chamber from a past era, a paramour applies crimson to her lips, anticipating her companion's arrival. Delicate powder particles suspend in the atmosphere, intermingling with rose fragrance and the ligneous emanations from wood paneling. Innocent powdery musk notes harmonize with luxurious balsamic undertones, creating a sophisticated olfactory juxtaposition of purity and indulgence.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jasmine Tea, Bergamot

Middle notes: Peony, Freesia, Cotton Flower

Base notes: Violet, Turkish Rose

title: Glow Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Glow Eau de Parfum embodies the quintessential social magnetism that defines exceptional soirées—those rare occasions where one transcends ordinary existence to become the focal point of collective admiration. This composition acknowledges that while visual aesthetics certainly contribute to attraction, olfactory presence establishes true interpersonal gravitation. Meticulously crafted from extensive research into nocturnal social dynamics, this fragrance presents a sophisticated equilibrium of warmth and sensuality designed to establish the wearer's dominance in any gathering. The precisely calibrated aromatic profile delivers immediate confidence enhancement upon application, empowering the wearer with an unmistakable presence that commands attention and admiration—the olfactory equivalent of stepping into one's most luminous self.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Incense

Base notes: Vanilla and Amber

title: Neroli Botanica Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Neroli Botanica by Essential Parfums is a fresh citrus scent designed for both women and men, launched in 2024. Created by perfumer Anne Flipo, it features top notes of Pink Pepper, Ginger, Black Pepper, and Turmeric. The heart combines Neroli, Jasmine, and Orange Blossom, while the base is composed of Sandalwood, Vetiver, and Benzoin.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Ginger, Black Pepper and Turmeric

Middle notes: Neroli, Jasmine and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver and Benzoin

title: Golden Powder Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Golden Powder from The House of Oud is an Oriental Spicy scent crafted for both women and men, introduced in 2016. It opens with vibrant top notes of cinnamon and nutmeg, followed by a heart of sandalwood, guaiac wood, Virginian cedar, and papyrus. The fragrance settles into a warm base featuring vanilla, coumarin, musk, French labdanum, and tobacco blossom, creating a rich and sophisticated aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Virginian Cedar and Papyrus

Base notes: Vanilla, Coumarin, Musk, French labdanum and Tobacco Blossom

title: Grape Pearls Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Grape Pearls from The House of Oud is a unisex Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance introduced in 2016. It opens with vibrant Blueberry and delicate Floral Notes, followed by a heart of Rose, Grapes, Coffee, and Grape leaves. The scent settles into a warm base of Vanilla, White Musk, and Amber, creating a sophisticated and balanced aroma.  

Fragrance family: Fruity, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blueberry and Floral Notes

Middle notes: Rose, Grapes, Coffee and Grape leaves

Base notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Amber

title: Moon Glory Parfum
body_html:
Moon Glory honors the moon’s influence on the natural rhythms of the earth. This fragrance centers on the captivating aroma of evening blooms, blending the subtlety of Hawaiian Jasmine, Queen of the Night, and Passionflower with the sweet notes of lychee, honey, and ylang-ylang. The result is an elegant scent that envelops the wearer with gentle sophistication.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang, Hawaiian Jasmine and Litchi

Middle notes: Honey, Passion Flower and Lady of the Night Flower

Base notes: Peru Balsam, White Musk and Hinoki Wood

title: Wood Whisper Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wood Whisper Eau de Parfum invites you to explore the depths of a jungle forest, where the rich warmth of sandalwood releases its precious essence, surrounding you with calm and peace. A luscious plum note introduces a sweet, creamy richness, while delicate violet blossoms emerge from the forest floor, their subtle scent blending seamlessly with the earthy depth of ambergris.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum and Violet

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Cashmere Wood and White Amber

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk and Ambergris

title: Blackpepper Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Blackpepper Eau de Parfum challenges traditional perfume narratives with its unwavering, intense character. Encased in a sleek, tactile bottle featuring a night mirror finish, it captivates both visually and olfactorily. Radiating boundless magnetism, BLACKPEPPER embodies a contemporary mystery—a rich scent evoking the depths of an infinite abyss.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: pepper

Middle notes: musk, tonka

Base notes: agarwood, cedar, patchouli

title: Sonic Flower Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sonic Flower Eau de Parfum opens with the vibrant spark of pink pepper, setting the tone for the day. The powdery, slightly edgy scent of orris lingers, while jasmine petals add a fresh twist. Wrapped in a soft cashmere embrace, the fragrance balances strength and sensuality, ready to awaken the fierce spirit within. Its sweet skin-like warmth captivates, drawing hungry glances. As the lights dim, the silence is broken by the striking note of Sonic Flower—commanding attention and admiration.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Carrot Seeds and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Orris and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Cashmeran and Ambroxan

title: Endless Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Endless Sea, aptly named “infinite ocean,” captures the boundless essence of the sea with remarkable longevity, even among marine fragrances. This deep and enigmatic scent mirrors the serene balance felt while gazing at the endless ocean horizon, evoking unique, unforgettable moments. Its composition features musk harmonized with lemon and Sicilian bergamot, enriched by sweet amber, robust sandalwood, and earthy moss. Combining elegance, athleticism, and masculine allure, it suits any occasion. Exceptional in both sillage and lasting power, Endless Sea stands out for its premium ingredients. Ideal for all seasons and times of day, it promises an immediate and lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Marine, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon & Bergamot, Marine Notes

Middle notes: Pelargonium, Rose

Base notes: Musk, Amber, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Mossy Notes

title: Narcotix Citrus Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Narcotix Citrus by Lorenzo Pazzaglia is an Oriental Floral fragrance crafted for both women and men, launched in 2022. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of pineapple, yuzu, green notes, bergamot, black currant, pepper, neroli, orange blossom, and green apple. Its heart reveals a complex blend of birch, jasmine sambac, jasmine, patchouli, white flowers, juniper, elemi, Bulgarian rose, and Turkish rose. The base is grounded by cedar, ambergris, ambroxan, bourbon vanilla, and oak, creating a rich and sophisticated aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Yuzu, Green Notes, Bergamot, Black Currant, Pepper, Neroli, Orange Blossom and Green Apple

Middle notes: Birch, Jasmine Sambac, Jasmine, Patchouli, White Flowers, Juniper, elemi, Bulgarian Rose and Turkish Rose

Base notes: Cedar, Ambergris, Ambroxan, Bourbon Vanilla and Oak

title: 1969 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
1969 Eau de Parfum is an evocative fragrance that captures the carnal sensuality of a voluptuous blend of spices. This Ambery gourmand scent weaves mystery and eroticism into every note, echoing the iconic and transformative spirit of the mythical year 1969. Its complex composition invites you to experience an olfactory journey where warmth meets intrigue, making it a distinctive choice for those who appreciate refined depth and timeless allure in their fragrance. Perfect for evenings and special moments, it leaves a lasting impression that blends sophistication with bold passion.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach

Middle notes: Cardamom, Clove, Rose and White Flowers

Base notes: Mexican chocolate, Patchouli, Coffee and Musk

title: Sand and Skin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Evoking the calm and delight of an endless sunny island day, Sand and Skin captures the sensation of sun-kissed skin on a soft sandy shore. This distinctive fragrance highlights the rich warmth of Madagascar vanilla absolute, enhanced by the resinous depth of benzoin and a subtle hint of ylang-ylang. A captivating and inviting blend, it offers a luxurious sensory experience with enduring appeal.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Ylang-Ylang

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Benzoin, Musk

Base notes: Labdanum, Amyris, Patchouli

title: Sound of a Ricochet Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Floraïku Paris excels at encapsulating nature’s essence in fragrance. Sound of a Ricochet Eau de Parfum evokes the image of a red dragonfly against a blazing sky, presenting a striking amber vanilla scent. This composition blends smooth vanilla and tonka bean absolute with the deep, gourmand richness of sandalwood oil.

 

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla Absolute

Middle notes: Tonka Bean

Base notes: Sandalwood

title: Aican Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Aican by Kajal is a unisex Eau de Parfum introduced in 2024, expertly crafted by perfumer Gökhan Şimşek. This sophisticated fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of passionfruit, pineapple, and mandarin orange, offering an invigorating and fresh burst. The heart reveals a bold blend of ginger, black pepper, and jasmine, adding spicy warmth and floral elegance. Its rich base combines musk, vanilla, praline, sandalwood, vetiver, and patchouli, creating a long-lasting, creamy, and earthy finish. Aican is ideal for those seeking a refined and complex scent that balances freshness with depth and sensuality.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Pineapple and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Ginger, Black Pepper and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Praline, Sandalwood, Vetiver and Patchouli

title: Charon's Vail Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Argos Charon’s Vail, a 2024 Halloween special edition, is a unisex parfum that guides the wearer through a timeless voyage inspired by myth and the soul’s final journey. It begins with fresh rose top notes, symbolizing enduring elegance. The heart unfolds with an enigmatic fusion of patchouli, sandalwood, oud, and atlas cedar, conjuring ancient woodlands and ritualistic mysteries. The dry down features cistus labdanum and saffron, imparting a deep, enigmatic aura that honors Charon’s immortal charge.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose

Middle notes: Oud, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Atlas Cedar

Base notes: Saffron and Labdanum

title: Remain Essence de Parfum
body_html:
Remain Essence de Parfum offers a sensory journey where brightness, depth, and spirit unite. It begins with fresh bergamot and the unexpected sweetness of carrot, enlivened by warming spices that evoke a sacred ambiance. The heart features a blend of raw and refined vanilla combined with radiant ylang-ylang and jasmine, balancing soft luxury with a luminous, almost spiritual sensuality. The base anchors the scent with rich sandalwood, sacred frankincense, and a hint of castoreum, evoking timelessness and deep emotional resonance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices, Carrot, Bergamot

Middle notes: Vanilla, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine

Base notes: Frankincense, Sandalwood, Castoreum

title: A Corps Secret Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A Corps Secret Extrait de Parfum is an Oriental Woody fragrance designed by master perfumer Jordi Fernández for both women and men. The composition unfolds with a spiced citrus opening of ginger, bergamot, and mandarin, complemented by warming cinnamon and bark. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of akigalawood, jasmine sambac, and praline, softened by orange and peru balsam. The base anchors the fragrance with oud, patchouli, and labdanum, finished with vanilla and cypriol for a sensual, enduring trail. Launched in 2025, this refined unisex scent captures the essence of modern oriental elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Safraleine, Bergamot, Mandarin, Bark and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Orange, Jasmine Sambac, Mahonial, Praline and Peru Balsam

Base notes: Labdanum, Oud, Cypriol, Patchouli and Vanilla

title: Kun Amo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted by master perfumer Vanina Muracciole, Kun Amo Extrait de Parfum is a sophisticated chypré fruity composition designed for those who appreciate refined unisex fragrances. This 2025 release opens with a crisp pear accord, evolving into a warm heart of maltol and ambroxan that creates an inviting sensuality. The composition settles into a refined base of musk, woody notes, and maltol, delivering a fragrance with remarkable depth and longevity. An elegant choice for discerning wearers seeking complexity and balance.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral 

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear

Middle notes: Maltol and Ambroxan

Base notes: Musk, Maltol and Woodsy Notes

title: Nasaj Eau de Parfum
body_html:
NASAJ is a radiant floral expression born from the heart of Oman, crafted to celebrate heritage through luminous blooms that capture the essence of cultural richness and contemporary elegance. This sophisticated eau de parfum weaves together tradition, fashion, and vibrant spirit into a singular, unforgettable fragrance experience. The composition unfolds as a living bouquet—colorful, bright, and intricately spiced—that reveals layers of complexity with each wear. Drawing inspiration from Omani botanical treasures, NASAJ balances delicate floral notes with warm spice accords, creating a scent that feels both deeply rooted and distinctly modern. The fragrance embodies a distinctly human quality, resonating with those who appreciate artisanal perfumery and meaningful olfactory storytelling. Ideal for the discerning wearer seeking a signature scent that transcends seasons and occasions, NASAJ offers a refined alternative to mass-market fragrances. Its longevity and sillage reflect premium craftsmanship, making it a worthy addition to any fragrance collection. Experience the intersection of Omani heritage and contemporary luxury with every application.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Grapefruit, Tangerine, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Pear

Middle notes: Jasmine, Lily, Gardenia, Tuberose, Magnolia and Neroli

Base notes: Sandalwood, Frankincense, Cypriol, Saffiano Leather, Patchouli and Tonka

title: Jild Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jild Eau de Parfum, created by Ali Abdulla Almarzooqi in December 2019, is a unisex Fruity-Amber-Floral-Woody fragrance produced in the UAE with premium oils from Grasse and France. The opening delivers an aromatic burst of strawberry, saffron, cinnamon, black pepper, and rhubarb—notes that command immediate attention. Jasmine anchors the heart, while the base unfolds with crisp Oriental accords, balsam, smoky leather, and guaiac wood. A distinctive composition engineered for special occasions, designed to set the wearer apart with memorable presence and refined complexity.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Strawberry, Saffron, Coriander, Cinnamon, Black Pepper, Pink Pepper and Rhubarb

Middle notes: Jasmine

Base notes: Cedar, Gurjan balsam, Guaiac Wood, Vetiver, Amber, Labdanum, Moss and Leather

title: Coromandel Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Coromandel Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from the ornate Chinese lacquered screens that captivated Gabrielle Chanel. This woody-oriental composition weaves together a resonant amber heart with the austere elegance of incense and benzoin, layered with refined wooden accords that create a mysterious, multifaceted trail. A fragrance of profound contrasts—simultaneously warm and austere, opulent and contemplative—it embodies the exotic allure and timeless sophistication that defined Chanel's aesthetic vision.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bitter orange, citruses, neroli 

Middle notes: Patchouli, orris root, rose, jasmine 

Base notes: White chocolate, benzoin, incense (olibanum/frankincense), amber, woody notes, musk

title: Vanilla Emelian Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Vanilla Emelian Eau de Parfum by Ricco di Bontà, a sumptuous oriental‑vanilla unisex fragrance that harmonizes sweetness, spice, and creamy depth. Launched in 2026, it opens with a bright and playful mix of red berries and citrus balanced with sugary nuances. The heart reveals a warm blend of vanilla, cacao, spicy nuances, and rose, adding rich gourmand character and floral elegance. In the base, smooth woody accords, tonka bean, amber, and musk provide a warm, luxurious finish that lingers with depth and sensuality. Vanilla Emelian is an ideal choice for those seeking a rich, indulgent scent with both vibrant sweetness and sophisticated warmth. 


Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla 


Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red berries, mandarin, orange, sugar 

Middle notes: Spicy notes, vanilla, cacao, rose 

Base notes: Woody notes, tonka bean, amber, musk

title: Gladiator Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gladiator Eau de Parfum embodies invigorating strength and modern masculinity, where fresh aquatic brightness meets aromatic complexity. This captivating scent captures the essence of confidence and dynamic energy, drawing inspiration from bold, active lifestyles and versatile daily wear.

Fragrance family: Aromatic Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Mint, Watermelon, Pineapple 

Middle Notes: Sage, Geranium, Cardamom, Marine Accord 

Base Notes: Vetiver, Musk, Amberwood

title: Mandorle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Mandorle Eau de Parfum embodies rich gourmand sophistication and irresistible sensuality, where nutty sweetness meets warm boozy depth and creamy comfort. This captivating unisex fragrance blends delectable gourmand accords with subtle woody and musky nuances, creating a memorable scent that feels both indulgent and alluring.

Fragrance family: Gourmand-Leather/Woody Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Almond, Absolute Cocoa, Tonka Absolute

Middle Notes: Heliotrope, Rum CO₂, Deer, Cashmere Wood

Base Notes: Vanilla, Caramel, Sparkling Woods, White Musk

title: Chypre Mojo 45 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Chypre Mojo 45 Eau de Parfum, a bold and modern chypre-fruity fragrance that blends vibrant freshness with earthy depth. This captivating composition opens with bright citrus and soft spicy accords, creating a luminous and energetic introduction. The heart reveals a juicy mango note, adding sweetness and a unique tropical twist to the classic chypre structure. In the base, patchouli, mossy accords, amber, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, rich trail that lingers with sensual warmth and refined elegance. Chypre Mojo 45 is an ideal choice for those seeking a distinctive signature scent that balances freshness with depth.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citrus accords, soft spices

Middle notes: Mango

Base notes: Patchouli, moss, amber, musk

title: Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Oud Robert Piguet Eau de Parfum, a bold and opulent fragrance that celebrates the depth and richness of oud with refined oriental sophistication. This captivating composition opens with warm spicy and aromatic accords, creating a striking and inviting introduction. The heart reveals a luxurious blend of precious oud and subtle floral nuances, adding depth, elegance, and complexity. In the base, rich woods, amber, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with warmth, sensuality, and refined majesty. Oud Robert Piguet is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that highlights the regal beauty of oud with elegant intensity.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices, aromatic accords

Middle notes: Oud, floral nuances

Base notes: Woods, amber, musk

title: Unique Blue Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Unique Blue is a vibrant, modern aquatic-aromatic that captures crisp oceanic clarity with a luminous, contemporary twist—fresh, mineral, and elegantly energetic. This unisex composition layers sparkling citrus and ozonic-marine facets over a cool, slightly green heart and resolves on a clean, driftwood-amber base with ambroxan smoothness. Designed for daytime wear and warm-weather versatility, Unique Blue offers crisp lift and polished longevity for a refined, invigorating signature.

Fragrance family: Marine, Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, sea salt/ozone accord, grapefruit
Middle notes: Marine/ozonic accord, neroli, green tea, watery florals
Base notes: Driftwood accord, ambroxan, cedarwood, white musk, light vetiver

title: Ne Il Giorno Ne L'Ora  Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Né Il Giorno Né L’Ora — Filippo Sorcinelli is a dark, introspective, and profoundly spiritual fragrance that explores themes of silence, mortality, and sacred contemplation, blending smoky incense, deep resins, and austere woods into a solemn and emotionally charged composition. It opens with an immediate surge of dense incense and dark aromatic nuances, evoking the stillness of a shadowed sanctuary where time feels suspended. The heart unfolds into rich balsamic resins and earthy myrrh, creating a heavy, meditative depth that feels both ritualistic and hauntingly beautiful. As it develops, the fragrance settles into a deep base of oud, smoky woods, and subtle leathery facets, leaving a powerful, austere, and long-lasting trail that embodies sacred darkness and contemplative silence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental, Resinous

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Incense, dark aromatics
Middle notes: Myrrh, balsamic resins
Base notes: Oud, smoky woods, leather nuances

title: Myrrh K Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Myrrh K — Ella K Parfums is a warm, mystical, and elegantly resinous fragrance that explores the spiritual richness of myrrh through a refined oriental-woody composition. It opens with a luminous blend of aromatic spices and balsamic nuances, creating an immediate aura of warmth, depth, and quiet sophistication. The heart unfolds around an opulent myrrh accord enriched with smoky resinous facets and subtle floral touches, giving the composition a meditative and velvety character that feels both sacred and sensual. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth base of amber, woods, and soft musks, leaving a long-lasting, enveloping, and deeply comforting trail marked by elegance and spiritual depth.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Resinous, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Aromatic spices, balsamic nuances
Middle notes: Myrrh, smoky resins, subtle florals
Base notes: Amber, woods, soft musk

title: Chicelle Extrait de Parfum
