title: Bleu Lazuli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the perfect balance of intense tobacco and supple honey in Bleu Lazuli Eau de Parfum from Armani/Privé. It is a reflection of India's spiritual dream, along with Bleu Turquoise, as Giorgio Armani honors the country's rich culture, history and captivating tales, drawing inspiration from its magnetic and mystical allure. Bleu Lazuli embodies the boundless essence of the universe in an Indian dream that never ceases to inspire through its spirituality, exoticism and historical significance.

Fragrance family: Tobacco, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mate, Cardamom and Bergamot

Middle notes: Plum, Osmanthus and Jasmine

Base notes: Tobacco, Honey, Vanilla and Sandalwood

title: English Pear & Freesia Cologne
body_html:
English Pear & Freesia Cologne captures the essence of autumn. The alluring crispness of just-ripe pears is blended with a floral arrangement of white freesias, then softened with amber, patchouli, and woods. Rich and radiant. Silky. Crisp. Brilliant.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear and Melon

Middle notes: Freesia and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli, Rhuburb and Amber

title: Spice And Wood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the perfect balance of freshness, spice, and wood with Spice And Wood Eau de Parfum by Henry Creed. Sparkling top notes of bergamot, lemon, and Italian apple lead to a complex heart of angelica, pimento, patchouli, birch, and clove. The deep, powdery base features African iris, cedar, musk, and oak moss, making this fragrance a truly unique and captivating scent.

    Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

    Olfactive pyramid

    Top notes: Apple, Lemon and Bergamot

    Middle notes: Pepper, Birch, Clove, Angelica and Patchouli

    Base notes: Cedar, Musk, oak moss and Iris

title: This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.2 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the beauty of a floral twist with This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.2 Eau de Parfum. Its sweet notes of ylang-ylang and lilac are perfectly balanced with sandalwood and white musk, creating a captivating and long-lasting scent. Perfect for both men and women, this "perfume of light" is truly a masterpiece.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ivy and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Lilac and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Sandalwood

title: Vanille Antique Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing the latest addition to Byredo's Night Veils collection - a fragrance expertly crafted for the perfect evening scent that lasts all night long. Combining the smoky aroma of vanilla with a luxurious blend of cistus and musk, this scent is a must-have for any sophisticated individual.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Musk and Plum

Middle notes: White Wood and Labdanum

Base notes: Vanilla and Amber

title: Sellier Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the refined luxury of Sellier Extrait de Parfum. Each Night Veils fragrance expertly combines noble raw materials for an unparalleled experience. Its high concentration provides a new perfume ritual, while its distinguished, sombre scent evokes a vintage smoking room. Immerse yourself in a world of leather, tobacco, and olfactory acrobatics.

Fragrance family: Leather, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cashmeran and Black Tea

Middle notes: Leather and Tobacco Leaf

Base notes: Birch and Oakmoss

title: Nuda Veritas Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the lightness of being with Nuda Veritas Eau de Parfum. This delicately floral fragrance evokes a spiritual journey towards happiness. The layers of white textures, hints of moss and watery haze create a connection to earth and truth. Experience the gentle caress of ambroxan and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calone, Orange Blossom and Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Chinese Jasmine, Osmanthus and Tiare Flower

Base notes: Ambroxan, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Marigold, Oakmoss and Patchouli

title: Sacred Wood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sacred Wood by Kilian embodies the ethereal essence of a fragrant wood from the East, paying homage to the sensory delights found in nature through the craft of perfumery. It also celebrates one of the most desired and prohibited perfume components in the world: sandalwood.

Fragrance family: Woody, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Carrot Seeds and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Milk, Amyris, Copahu Balm, elemi and Caraway

Base notes: Atlas Cedar, Myrrh, Tolu Balsam, Incense, Amber and Mysore Sandalwood

title: Intoxicated Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the captivating scent of Intoxicated Eau de Parfum by By Kilian. With spicy notes of cinnamon and nutmeg, this sweet fragrance is the perfect balance of warmth and sweetness. With a base of caramelised sugar, it will leave you feeling intoxicated by its irresistible aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Coffee, Bergamot and Aldehydes

Middle notes: Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Tobacco, Ginger and Geranium

Base notes: Caramel, Mocha, Vanilla, Coumarin, Balsam Fir, Marshmallow, Sugar and Patchouli

title: Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the sophistication and history of Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum by Kilian Paris. With notes of Wheat Absolute, Davana Essence, and Cedarwood Essence, this fragrance brings to life the warmth and richness of a Scottish fireside. Experience the timeless elegance and refined scent of Old Fashioned.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wheat and Davana

Middle notes: Immortelle and Cedar

Base notes: Tolu Balsam and Styrax

title: Venom Incarnat Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted with a delicate combination of venom, strawberry, and glamour, Venom Incarnat Eau de Parfum boasts a captivating red hue. Its fragrance, an alluring blend of leather and sophisticated amber, is known to awaken the senses and ignite the imagination, making it a truly irresistible scent.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wild Strawberry, Strawberry, Caramel and Blackberry

Middle notes: Raspberry, Virginian Cedar and Cinnamon

Base notes: Russian Leather, Caramel, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Balsam Fir

title: Panthea Iris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Panthea Iris will surely satisfy those who love Iris absolute. This scent exudes a divine aura, embodying a rare elegance and a distinguished character. Its initial burst of Bergamot and Tangerine from Italy is followed by a refreshing and pure white Tea. The fragrance is adorned with a delicate blue and white silken veil. The subtle Sandalwood and Patchouli, enhanced by Tonka absolute, elevate the powdery and refined aspects of intense Iris. With a strong sillage, this scent gently and sensually evolves on the skin.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris, Tangerine and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris, Violet and Jasmine

Base notes: White Musk, Tobacco, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood

title: Velvet Desire Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Desire by Dolce&Gabbana embodies the charm of femininity, expertly crafted with the highest quality ingredients. It honors a captivating blend of three white flowers: gardenia, jasmine, and Indian Tuberose. A coveted addition to the Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Collection, perfumes draped in opulent velvet, beckoning you to discover their artistic essence - an intimate exploration of the designers' scent memories and Italy's love.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Frangipani, Gardenia and Amaryllis

Middle notes: Indian Tuberose, Champaca, Orange Blossom and Jasmine

Base notes: Peru Balsam, Cinnamon, Vanilla and Amber

title: Dates Delight Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enchanting allure of love with Dates Delight Eau de Parfum. This exquisite blend features Kalimantan oud, peony, and infusion of riyadh dates, evoking a sense of mystery. The solemn notes delicately caress the skin, leaving a lingering aroma that takes you on a journey through the East.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dates and Peony

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Caramel, Tonka Bean and Coumarin

Base notes: Honey, Sugar, Vanilla, Benzoin and Labdanum

title: White Pearl Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Take a journey to the sea with White Pearl Eau de Parfum. Inspired by Akoya pearls, known for their elegance and unique luster, this fragrance blends marine and floral notes with lively spices. Embodying purity and innocence, White Pearl is a treasure fit for a queen, just like the iconic "Japanese Pearl Choker" worn by Queen Elizabeth II

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang, Cardamom and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Rose and Iris

Base notes: Marine notes and Ambergris

title: Gambling Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the thrilling rush of adrenaline with Gambling Eau de Parfum. This bold and sophisticated fragrance features warm, golden notes of whiskey and coffee, complemented by spicy and woody scents. Fresh hints of bergamot and green galbanum add a touch of freshness. A daring and unique creation unlike any other.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey, Sichuan Pepper, Coffee and Bergamot

Middle notes: Mastic or Lentisque, Cypress, Galbanum and Elemi resin

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Amyris, Guaiac Wood, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Benzoin and Musk

title: Bonbon Pop Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the playful and alluring aroma of Bonbon Pop Eau De Parfum. This fragrance takes you back to the carefree days of childhood, with its juicy notes of White Peach and tropical Coconut. Infused with warm Woods and Oriental scents, with a hint of Whole Sugar for a deliciously sweet finish. A nostalgic and delicious whirlwind of fragrance.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Peach, Coconut and Bergamot

Middle notes: Patchouli and Jasmine

Base notes: Brown sugar, Precious Woods, Musk and Amber

title: Falcon Leather Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Matiere Premiere Falcon Leather Extrait de Parfum is a unisex scent crafted by perfumer Aurélien Guichard and released in 2024. The natural blend features a rich saffron opening, followed by a luxurious birch tar note that emulates leather and finishes with warm benzoin and fresh cistus. This vegan and cruelty-free fragrance is perfect for those who appreciate sophisticated and sustainable scents.

Fragrance family: Leather, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron

Middle notes: Birch Tar

Base notes: Labdanum and Benzoin

title: French Flower Eau de Parfum
body_html:
French Flower Eau de Parfum features a bouquet of Tuberose with Absolute and Enfleurage of Tuberose petals. Nigeria Ginger and Chinese Tea Leaf Essence enhance the delicate white and vegetal character of this fragrance. Indulge in the freshness and elegance of this stemmed flower.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear and Nigerian Ginger

Middle notes: Tuberose, Orange Blossom and Chinese Tea

Base notes: Ambroxan

title: Neroli Oranger Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As a product expert, Matiere Premiere's Neroli Oranger eau de parfum starts with the purity of orange blossom. The brand carefully sources and extracts precious ingredients, showcasing the vibrant core of the scent through Italian bergamot and Lebanese neroli oil.

Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Neroli and Bergamot

Middle notes: Tunisian Orange Blossom

Base notes: Musk and Ylang-Ylang

title: Hundred Silent Ways X Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
HUNDRED SILENT WAYS has always been one of the top 5 bestsellers of NISHANE in global markets. HUNDRED SILENT WAYS X is designed to maintain the overall mood that the original fragrance (launched in 2016) offers. The leathery notes were resorted to be able to add an even more elegant touch to the original formula. HUNDRED SILENT WAYS X is a deliciously captivating fragrance that combines the elegance of floral notes with the richness of gourmand accords.

Fragrance family: Floral, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach, Tuberose and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Gardenia, Jasmine, Iris and Heliotrope

Base notes: Leather, Vanilla and Patchouli

title: Tuberoza Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating scent of Tuberoza Extrait de Parfum. This luxurious fragrance features the scents of Mexican tuberose, along with the delicate notes of gardenia, marigold, and jasmine. With a strong ambery base, this scent is truly one of a kind. Elevate your senses with each spritz

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom, Artemisia and Sweet Orange

Middle notes: Tuberose, Gardenia, Jasmine and Marigold

Base notes: Vetiver, Amber, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Tubereuse Astrale Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Maison Crivelli's Tubereuse Astrale is a sparkling Extrait de Parfum conceived in collaboration with perfumer Quentin Bisch. Thibaud Crivelli's childhood memory of smelling tuberoses under the Milky Way inspired this opulent fragrance, featuring a luminous blend of tuberose, velvety leather, and musks. Embrace the celestial essence of Tubereuse Astrale.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon

Middle notes: Tuberose and Osmanthus

Base notes: Musk and Vanilla

title: Velvet Tonka Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A blend of tonka bean, almond, and orange blossom forms a trilogy on a base of amber. A woody accord with notes of vanilla and honey adds a velvety touch. This oriental fragrance is delicately enhanced with powdered sugar, leaving behind an addictive, powdery, and translucent trail

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange blossom, Almond

Middle notes: Rose absolute, Balkan tobacco absolute

Base notes: Tonka bean absolute, Madagascan vanilla absolute, Amyris wood essence, Amber woods

title: Patchouli Mania Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The scents of patchouli are the main inspiration for Fabrice Pellegrin's Patchouli Mania Eau de Parfum. This fragrance perfectly blends invigorating davana and green hazelnuts with the spicy, woody aroma of coriander seeds. In the heart of the scent, a luscious fusion of cocoa and clearwood® emerges, followed by the earthy base notes of patchouli, vetiver, and cetalox®. The result is a captivating, sensual, and enigmatic fragrance that will take you on an olfactory journey.

Fragrance family: Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Hazelnut, Davana and Coriander

Middle notes: Cacao, Tea and Clearwood

Base notes: Patchouli, Vetiver and Cetalox

title: Orange X Santal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Transport yourself to the Italian coast with Orange X Santal Eau de Parfum. This expertly crafted fragrance combines natural bitter orange, sandalwood, and basil essential oil from Egypt for a radiant and joyful experience. A touch of French oak moss adds a chypre accord, while French cypress wood and Australian sandalwood anchor the luminous top notes.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bitter Orange, Egyptian Basil

Middle notes: Cypress

Base notes: Oakmoss, Australian Sandalwood

title: Overture Man Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Overture Man is a captivatingly woodsy fragrance that draws inspiration from the solitary nature of man in society. Bold, daring, and self-assured, this perfume was expertly crafted by acclaimed perfumer Karine Vinchon-Spehner and encapsulates the enigmatic essence of a gentleman through potent scents of Myrrh, Sandalwood, and smoky Frankincense

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Cardamom, Cumin, Ginger, Nutmeg, Cognac Accord

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Lentisque, Benzoin, Labdanum, Patchouli, Geranium, Myrhh

Base notes: Sandalwood, Leather, Clary Sage, Annimalic Accord, Frankincense

title: Reflection Man Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Reflection Man Eau de Parfum embodies the essence of refinement, offering a compelling, distinctive, and undeniably masculine scent that never goes out of style.

Fragrance family: Fougere, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rosemary, Red Pepper, Bitter Orange Leaves

Middle notes: Neroli, Orris Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedarwood

title: Enclave Eau de Parfum
body_html:
At dusk, as the sun says goodbye to the fjords of Musandam, Enclave elegantly captures the invigorating essence of a luxurious, warm refuge where the land and sea converge

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spearmint, Cardamom, Cinnamon Bark, Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Frankincense, Patchouli Heart, Vetiver, Rose

Base notes: Amber, Labdanum, Saffiano

title: Search Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the powerful transformation of embracing your true self and overcoming challenges with Search Eau de Parfum. This scent embodies the determination and strength of those who refuse to let their inner struggles hold them back.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Lime, Mandarin

Middle notes: Hojari Frankincense, Black Pepper, Elemi

Base notes: Cade, Vetiver, Guaiacwood

title: Limited 71 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted with a luxurious combination of incense and rare spices, Limited71 Extrait de Parfum enthralls the olfactory with its captivating Fougere-Ambery essence.

Fragrance family: Fougere, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Sage and Bergamot

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Cashmeran, Amber and Bay Leaf

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vetiver, Amber and Patchouli

title: Black II Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A captivating floral scent that delicately layers each note on a bed of Damascus roses, enveloped by exquisitely smoky musk, for a distinct sweet and darkly sensual aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla and Moss

title: Opulent Gold Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in a luxurious royal lifestyle with Opulent Gold Eau De Parfum. This "woody ambery" fragrance expertly blends peppery musky rose with leathery undertones, creating an irresistible addiction. Perfect for your most precious occasions, this exclusive scent will elevate your experience to new levels of opulence.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Rose, Orris Root and Orchid

Base notes: Musk, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Leather

title: Majalis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious and captivating aroma of Majalis Eau de Parfum from Dubai. Combining the rich scents of qahwa, dates, royal pure rose Taif, cardamom, and musk, this fragrance will transport you on a sensory journey through Arabian hospitality. Inspired by the opulence of Persian rugs and intricate patterns, Dubai Majalis is a truly unique and groundbreaking scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Sweet Orange, Spicy Notes, Rose Damascene, Elemi, Incense, Peach, Apple, Rose, Rose Taif, Geranium, Osmanthus, Green Note, Cardamom

Middle notes: Sandal, Vetiver, Benzoin Resinoid, Coriander, Ginger, Saffron, Floral Transparent, Powdery, Clove, Gaiac, Dates

Base notes: Patchouli, Oud, Leather, Vanilla, Woody, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Myrrh, Musk, Honey, Qahwa (Arabic Coffee)

title: Fakhama Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dubai Fakhama offers a luxurious experience with its captivating fragrance. A blend of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, oud, vanilla, and vetiver creates an enchanting scent. This perfume is adorned with base notes of amber, incense, leather, and oakmoss, adding to its centuries-old appeal.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Turkish Rose, Rose Bulgarian, Bergamot, Fruity Notes, Oud, Sweet Orange, Spicy Notes, Rose Damascene, Elemi, Cardamom, Coffee, Frutta Secca, Candied Fruit

Middle notes: Sandal, Cypriol, Benzoin Resinoid, Vanilla, Patchouli, Vetiver, Coriander, Ginger, Rose, Saffron

Base notes: Amber, Castoreum, Civetta, Mosses, Caramelised Sugar, Incense, Leather, Oakmoss

title: Bohemian Lime Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refreshing essence of the native citrus trees thriving in the abundant rainforests, captured in the invigorating scent of Bohemian Lime. With Australian finger lime and coriander as its opening notes, this fragrance transports you to the tropical haven of Byron Bay. As it settles, woody vetiver and sandalwood provide a grounding and blissful aroma. Discover the carefree and free-spirited nature of Australia's premier tropical enclave in every spritz of Bohemian Lime.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Finger Lime, Coriander, Vetiver

Middle notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood

Base notes: Tropical, Punchy, Citrusy, Woody

title: Imperium Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Imperium Eau de Parfum was a symbol of ultimate authority and influence, wielded by the intellectual and political giants of antiquity. It demanded a combination of intellect, presence, ambition, success, and popularity. This exquisite scent begins with a refreshing mix of bergamot and coriander, complemented by a subtle woody undertone and a delicate floral heart.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Coriander

Middle notes: Jasmine, Lily, Saffron, Neroli, Tuberose and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Amber and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Athalia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Athalia fragrance features a sophisticated blend of floral, woody, and musky scents. Key notes of bitter orange and incense subtly open the senses, while the heart of the perfume delivers a powdery iris and soft orange blossom essence. Wrapped in a veil of mysterious amber and white musk, this feminine eau de parfum exudes an alluring opulence

Fragrance family: Floral, Powdery, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bitter Orange, Incense

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Iris, Cashmeran

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Amber

title: Greenley Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Greenley Eau de Parfum is encased in a dignified green bottle and inspired by its distinctive blend, evoking a sense of vitality and the rejuvenating essence of spring. This aromatic blend draws inspiration from the natural world, resulting in a playful mix of fruit, citrus, wood, and resin, culminating in a refreshing, tart green apple twist. With a bold fusion of nature's finest elements, this powerful, masculine scent is crafted to endure the test of time.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sicilian Bergamot, Mandarin, Green Apple, Cashmere Wood

Middle notes: Cedarwood, Petitgrain, Violet, Pomarose

Base notes: Oakmoss, Musk, Amberwood Accord

title: Safran Secret Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enigmatic sophistication of Safran Secret Extrait de Parfum by Maison Crivelli. The rich golden saffron essence perfectly harmonizes with the warm dark woods, creating an intoxicating blend of spicy, hazy, and diffusive notes. Its comforting yet smoldering scent leaves a trail of depth and warmth, like a whispered secret.

Fragrance family: Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices

Middle notes: Saffron

Base notes: Blonde Woods

title: Nocologne Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Elevate your fragrance game with Nocologne Extrait De Parfum. With 30% perfume oil, this scent will outshine others with its audacious blend of grapefruit, pomplemouse, Calabrian bergamot, mandarin, mimosa, pink pepper, and clary sage. The modern, subtle bottle reflects the luxe feeling this scent brings.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Mandarin Orange, Calabrian bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Ginger, Orange Blossom, Clary Sage, Pink Pepper and Mimosa

Base notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Crystal Amber, Oakmoss and Vetiver

title: Chergui Eau de Parfum
body_html:
From the alchemist, Serge Lutens, comes Chergui - a fragrance crafted from the final rewards of a hot, dry Eastern wind. This desert wind, known for its powerful suction, carries along plants, insects, and twigs, creating a fiery effect that crystallizes shrubs, bushes, and berries. As the night falls, this still smoldering memory transforms into a fragrant, ambery, and candied aroma, a testament to the expertise of the alchemist.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tobacco Leaf, Honey

Middle notes: Iris, Musk, Rose

Base notes: Amber, Hay, Incense, Sandalwood

title: Blockade Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Transform yourself with Blockade Extrait de Parfum. This dynamic mango fragrance features warm notes of leather, oud, and amber that inspire growth. Embrace your vulnerabilities and shift your mindset with a vivacious freshness of mango, spicy pepper, and tomato leaf. Let Blockade be your source of transformation.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Tomato Leaf

Middle notes: Mango Blossom, Lavender, Watery Cyclamen and Star Anise

Base notes: Amber, Agarwood (Oud), Suede and Patchouli

title: J'Adoube Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the alluring scent of J’adoube Extrait de Parfum. With a tantalizing burst of pomegranate, rouge groseille, and mandarin, this fragrance evolves into a bold and deep base of leather, patchouli, and ambrostar. Embrace the balance of chaos and spontaneity in this captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Currant and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Pomegranate and Damask Rose

Base notes: Leather, Patchouli, Benzoin and Amber

title: Vieri Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Let Vieri Extrait de Parfum transport you to the stunning Mediterranean landscape where the love story of nobleman Vieri and Lionora unfolds. This fragrance begins with a burst of crimson lemongrass, citron, and pink pepper, followed by floral notes of peony and camellia tea, and finishes with musks, incense, and Amberwood, reflecting Vieri's subtle yet avant-garde approach to love. Experience the enchanting first impressions and lasting charm of Vieri, a timeless fragrance that captures the essence of true love.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemongrass, Lemon and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Tea, Red Fruits, Camellia and Peony

Base notes: Musk, Amberwood and Incense

title: Sissa Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sissa Extrait de Parfum offers a deep and transformative fragrance experience. Its powerful, exponential growth unfolds with rich notes of toasted sesame, followed by decadent gourmands and delicate florals. As a reminder of boundless potential, Sissa's warm, earthy base of labdanum and musks captivates the senses with each passing moment. Inspired by the concept of gradual progress leading to greatness, this scent uses unique edible notes such as ambrette seed and coumarin to create a warm and alluring aroma. With its personal and enveloping scent trail, Sissa Extrait de Parfum is a true masterpiece.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sesame, Coumarin and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Middle notes: Milk, Tonka Bean and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Musk and Labdanum

title: Dangerous Maryx Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Immerse yourself in my scent and let your eyes drift closed. Can you sense my presence? I am intertwined within you, enveloping you in a state of blissful euphoria with notes of cannabis, wormwood, and green tea. I dance through your thoughts like a delicate, fragrant reverie, captivating your heart. You won't be able to resist my allure for long, as you will soon succumb to my irresistible charm.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Eucalyptus, Green Tea, Wormwood, Cannabis, Grapefruit, Citron

Middle notes: Birch, Hemp, Rosemary, Cardamom, Tobacco Leaf, Oak

Base notes: Cannabis, Oregano, Patchouli

title: Anatolia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Located in Anatolia, modern day Turkey, is the stunning city of Cappadocia. Full of history and natural wonders, this region boasts geological marvels and underground cities that will leave you in awe. Cappadocia has been chosen by Alfred Ritchy as his travel destination due to its surreal beauty and numerous wonders, including the famous hot air balloons. As the sun rises over the orange sky, scores of balloons take flight, creating an unforgettable sight that attracts visitors from across the world.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Pear and Mandarin

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Incense, Caramel and Geranium

Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Amber

title: Ambre 114 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the mythical raw material of Ambre 114 Eau de Parfum, a 114-element composition that intensifies the natural sensuality of Ambergris. Let the enchanting fragrance of Amber-colored skin warmed by a balmy, aromatic breeze transport you to a caravanserai of exotic scents. Experience the extreme eroticism of this hot oriental perfume. Scientifically crafted for an irresistible enchantment.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Nutmeg and Thyme

Middle notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Rose, Geranium, Cedar and Vetiver

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Benzoin, Tonka Bean and Musk

title: Opera Infernal Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
OPERA INFERNAL embodies the lively spirit of Latin America, where the beat of tango music pulses through the streets and the passionate essence burns fiercely. Taking inspiration from a volcanic eruption, its fiery and molten lava-like essence captures an intense fervor that crescendos with emotion and liberation. The deep-dark red bottle evokes the rich velvet stage curtains of an opera and the captivating charm of Carmen's dress. Like a two-part opera, the fragrance begins with a burst of juicy pineapple before embracing the intense floral heart of the scent. Infused with Praline and Vetiver, it adds a fiery intensity to the lingering trail. Awaken your senses, embrace the crackling fire of OPERA INFERNAL, and let the unyielding power of Havana's streets ignite your soul.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple and Bergamot

Middle notes: Geranium and Magnolia

Base notes: Praline, Patchouli, Cedarwood and Vetiver

title: Au Coeur du Desert Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Au Coeur du Desert Extrait de Parfum is a luxurious scent with higher concentrations of key ingredients like coriander, cumin, and patchouli. Its smooth patchouli and warm woods, along with a higher dose of ambergris, give this fragrance a silky texture and a warm, golden aura. Experience the evocative sophistication of this scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Resins, Coriander

Middle notes: Cedar, Ambergris

Base notes: Patchouli, Cumin

title: Voluptuous Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Francesca Bianchi's Voluptuous Oud presents a sumptuous reimagining of this precious material, delivering a caramelized sweetness with subtle fruity and leather undertones. This extrait de parfum embodies luxurious abundance through its sophisticated fusion of woody, animalic, and gourmand elements. The composition creates an atmosphere of opulent intimacy with its enveloping warmth and comforting depth.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Mandarin and Bergamot

Middle notes: Plum and Heliotrope

Base notes: Oud, Caramel, Leather, Tolu Balsam and Vetiver

title: The Mariner’s Rhyme Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Francesca Bianchi's artistic vision shines through this sophisticated ozonic composition, balancing refreshing vivacity with complex dramatic depth. The distinctive ozonic accord is anchored by a substantial amber foundation, transforming ethereal transparency into something more substantial. Iris introduces an opaque density, while elemi and incense contribute a mystical, almost sacred character. This masterfully crafted unisex fragrance juxtaposes airy freshness with structural complexity—its citrus-ozonic introduction delivers contemporary crispness, accentuated by precise aldehydic edges.

Fragrance family: Fougere, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Lavender

Middle notes: Ozonic notes, Iris and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Oakmoss, Frankincense, Patchouli and Amber

title: Sticky Fingers Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This 'rock-chic' composition showcases an opulent, refined patchouli as its central character. The experience begins with vibrant spice notes that gradually unveil leather and tobacco accords, all luxuriously enveloped in creamy iris butter. The fragrance captures a paradoxical essence—untamed yet nonchalant, refined yet deeply sensual, presenting elegance with distinctive originality.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli, Tobacco, Orris, Leather

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Castoreum, Cinnamon

Base notes: Sandalwood, Heliotrope, Musk, Coriander

title: Neroli Hasbaya Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A masterful 2024 composition showcasing the multidimensional character of orange blossom. Neroli Hasbaya Extrait de Parfum opens with a sophisticated interplay of luminous neroli accented by pistachio and almond nuances. The heart reveals orange blossom's complex facets in harmonious dialogue with rose, while the foundation delivers refined depth through sandalwood's creamy texture, Peru balsam's resinous warmth, and musk's subtle persistence. This expertly crafted unisex fragrance represents the pinnacle of contemporary perfumery artistry.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange Blossom, Neroli, Pistachio and Almond

Middle notes: Orange Blossom and Rose

Base notes: Sandalwood and Musk

title: Black Guava Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Black Guava Extrait de Parfum opens with an exhilarating accord of succulent guava complemented by aromatic cardamom and vibrant Madagascan mandarin. The composition evolves to reveal a sophisticated heart where the refined floral notes of rose and geranium are masterfully juxtaposed against the profound depth of oud, creating an exceptional sweet-smoky tension. The dry-down presents a complex foundation of earthy patchouli, distinctive cypriol, and sophisticated grey amber, imparting a compelling resinous character. This meticulously crafted fragrance achieves a remarkable equilibrium between luminous fruit notes and mysterious depth—a true olfactory masterpiece.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Guava, Mandarin and Cardamom

Middle notes: Oud, Peony, Rose and Geranium

Base notes: Amber, Cypriol and Patchouli

title: Oud Candy Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Candy Extrait de Parfum presents an exquisite olfactory composition that commences with a luxurious accord of caramelized brown sugar, buttery nuts, and lactonic milk notes, enveloping the senses in opulent comfort. The heart reveals a sophisticated bouquet of delicate white florals that introduce an element of elegant refinement. The base notes showcase a masterful interplay of premium oud, precious saffron, and deep black woods, harmoniously balanced with sumptuous caramel and bourbon vanilla. Subtle leather accords and verdant oak moss provide a sophisticated depth to the composition. This remarkable fragrance achieves a perfect equilibrium between gourmand sweetness and smoky complexity—a truly sophisticated interpretation of indulgence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sweet Notes, Brown sugar, Milk and Nutty Notes

Middle notes: White Flowers

Base notes: Oud, Leather, Saffron, Oakmoss, Caramel, Ambroxan, Vanilla, Sandalwood, dark woodsy notes and Cedarwood

title: La Playa Eau de Parfum
body_html:
La Playa by Carner Barcelona, launched in 2024, is a sophisticated unisex fragrance that artfully blends citrus, spicy, and gourmand elements. It opens with a vibrant burst of orange, ylang-ylang, and lemon, creating an invigorating and fresh introduction. The heart reveals a creamy and exotic fusion of pistachio, cardamom, and coconut milk, adding depth and warmth. Finally, the scent settles into a smooth, comforting base of tonka bean, musk, and vanilla, providing lasting richness and subtle sensuality. This expertly crafted perfume offers a balanced and memorable olfactory experience suitable for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange, Lemon and Ylang-Ylang

Middle notes: Pistachio, Coconut Milk and Cardamom

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Musk

title: Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Musc Ravageur by Frederic Malle is a unisex Oriental fragrance introduced in 2000, crafted by perfumer Maurice Roucel. It opens with fresh lavender and bergamot, followed by a warm heart of cinnamon and cloves. The scent settles into a rich base of sandalwood, tonka bean, vanilla, guaiac wood, and cedar, creating a captivating and sophisticated aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Tangerine, Bergamot, Coriander and Neroli

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Cloves, Orris Root, Rose and Osmanthus

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Cedar, Animal notes and Patchouli

title: Love Delight Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Love Delight by Amouage is a Floral Fruity Gourmand scent designed for women. Introduced in 2024, this fragrance offers a fresh and captivating aroma that embodies elegance and charm.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Mandarin, Rose water, Cinnamon

Middle notes: Heliotrope, Jasmine, Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Cocoa, Rum Absolute, Cypriol

title: Overdose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Designed to capture a mood of intense joy, this fragrance opens with a burst of vibrant citrus notes enhanced by spicy accents. It then unfolds into a floral core of jasmine, lily, and orange blossom, resting on a deep, luxurious base of vetiver, ambergris, musk, and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Orange, Lemon, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Mandarin Orange and Saffron

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Lily, Jasmine, Sage, Orris and Fig

Base notes: Ambergris, Musk, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Cedar, Patchouli, Tonka Bean and Plum

title: Minuit et Demi Parfum
body_html:
Minuit et Demi is a captivating fragrance designed to engage all your senses with its intimate and sensual character. It begins with delicate oriental spices of cardamom and pimento that pique your interest. The heart reveals an irresistible blend of coffee and caramel, deepening the allure. Finally, a rich base of tobacco and bourbon wraps the scent in an air of mystery from beginning to end. This exquisite perfume embodies pure pleasure, crafted for both men and women to enjoy together.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Pimento and Bergamot

Middle notes: Caramel and Coffee

Base notes: Vanilla, Madagascar Vanilla, Tobacco, Cinnamon, Musk, Cashmeran, Liquor, Cedar and Vetiver

title: Breath Of The Infinite Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Breath Of The Infinite by The House of Oud is a unisex Floral Woody Musk fragrance released in 2016. It opens with fresh freesia and peony, followed by a peach heart, and settles into a warm base of cashmeran, ambroxan, and musk.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Freesia and Peony

Middle notes: Peach

Base notes: Cashmeran, Ambroxan and Musk

title: Empathy Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Empathy, the fifth release in The House of Oud’s Klem Garden collection launched in February 2017, draws inspiration from Arabian gardens. This fragrance conveys the profound connection between two souls who instantly recognize one another. Described as "the olfactory projection of silence," it expresses a deep, wordless energy that transcends physical attraction.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry Bloom, Pear Blossom and Artemisia

Middle notes: Raspberry, Tobacco and Fruity Notes

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Woody Notes, Spruce, Musk and Benzoin

title: Patiala Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Drawing inspiration from India's enigmatic Patiala necklace, this exquisite fragrance by British niche house Thameen London is designed to uplift and invigorate its wearer. Mirroring the necklace’s artistry and elegance, Patiala begins with a vibrant blend of fresh citrus and the deep sweetness of aldehydes. At its core, the scent reveals sharp floral notes of orange blossom and wild rose, enriched by the warm amber, crisp moss, and alluring musk, creating a sophisticated and masterfully crafted olfactory experience.

 

 Fragrance family: Rose, Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes and Citruses

Middle notes: Rose and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Amber, Musk and Oakmoss

title: Ambre Supreme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ambre Supreme Eau de Parfum highlights ambergris, a rare and highly valued substance derived from aged and oxidized sperm whale secretions. Because of its scarcity and expense, synthetic versions of ambergris are used in 99 percent of perfumes that feature this ingredient.

 

 Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Clary Sage, Pink Pepper and Cardamom

Middle notes: Moroccan Jasmine, Neroli and Patchouli

Base notes: Ambergris and Immortelle

title: Musc Des Sables Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Musc Des Sables Eau de Parfum is a captivating balsamic, musky, and oriental fragrance that stands out as a luminous olfactory mirage. Its radiant composition offers a distinctive presence, making it a remarkable choice for those seeking a sophisticated and memorable scent within the balsamic and musky oriental category. This perfume delivers depth and warmth, enveloping the wearer in an elegant and enduring aura.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Mandarin

Middle notes: Orris absolute

Base notes: Patchouli Indonesia, Amber

title: Zero Parfum
body_html:
Comme des Garçons introduced Zero in 2022, a new woody fragrance crafted by perfumer Fanny Bal. This scent combines bergamot, cedar, vetiver, musk, and rose oxide to embody a bold simplicity—a deliberate departure from extravagance. ZERO Eau de Parfum features a streamlined formula with fewer ingredients, carefully balanced to reflect Comme des Garçons’ olfactory vision while emphasizing resource conservation.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: bergamot

Middle notes: metallic notes, rose

Base notes: amber, ambermax, cedar, haitian vetiver

title: Copper Parfum
body_html:
Copper Parfum captures the strength of red metal, combining warmth and freshness in a unique blend. Bright berry notes contrast with dark leafy tones, while synthetic metallic accords merge seamlessly with natural vanilla and Ethiopian myrrh. This evolving fragrance explores harmony through striking contrasts, offering a sophisticated and dynamic scent experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: blackcurrant, pink pepper

Middle notes: benzoin, galbanum, ginger, metallic notes

Base notes: amber, myrrh, tobacco, vanilla

title: Serpentia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Serpentia by Alfred Ritchy is a unisex fragrance that artfully combines vibrant fruits with alluring florals and a musky foundation. Known for its fresh, clean, and subtly soapy character, it is ideal for summer wear, featuring prominent notes of raspberry and sandalwood. This scent delivers an elegant and sensual aura with a lasting presence. Inspired by Alfred Ritchy’s experience during the Chinese Spring Festival in the Year of the Snake, Serpentia reflects the wisdom, charm, and cultural richness of this historic celebration.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Orange and Peach

Middle notes: Pink Pepper, Sandalwood, Hedione, Violet and Rose

Base notes: Helvetolide, Ambroxan, Vanilla, Orris and Musk

title: Babycat Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Babycat Raw Bourbon from Yves Saint Laurent’s Le Vestiaire des Parfums line is a striking unisex fragrance. It captures the essence of Saint Laurent’s iconic couture design, celebrated for its allure. This scent combines animalic notes with versatility, offering a sophisticated and enduring elegance.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Saffron, Resins and Olibanum

Base notes: Vanilla, Suede and Cedarwood

title: And Your Lips Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance is a homage to love, centered on the concept of addiction, enhanced by a sweet candied jujube accord that captivates the senses. Its aromatic top notes are balanced by a warm, gourmand base, while white musk and Turkish rose absolute deliver a bold and elegant essence to the composition.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jujube Blossom, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Lavender and Clary Sage

Middle notes: Turkish Rose, Egyptian Jasmine and Geranium

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean, White Musk and Moss

title: Kajal III Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Kajal III Parfum captures vibrant energy, crafted to celebrate strength and perseverance. Its opening blends a sparkling lemon soda zest with bright grapefruit, symbolizing renewal and clarity. The heart unfolds with a tranquil mix of rosemary, neroli, and lavender, enhanced by the sharp warmth of ginger—an emblem of power and joy. The fragrance settles into a deep, earthy base of ambroxan, patchouli, and musk, enriched by a warm Oriental sweetness that embodies courage, endurance, and wisdom.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Lemon Zest and Lemon Soda

Middle notes: Ginger, Neroli, Rosemary and Lavender

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Patchouli and Amber

title: Rose of No Man's Land Absolu de Parfum
body_html:
Rose of No Man's Land Absolu de Parfum transforms the classic scent with a richer, smoky character, honoring the resilient rose thriving in unlikely places. Central to the fragrance are three refined rose varieties, intricately layered from the top through to the base notes, enhancing its sophisticated depth. The opening blends saffron and blackcurrant with a spicy pink pepper accent, while black raspberry and peony complement the rose heart. The dry down combines papyrus, dark patchouli, and warm amber, giving the fragrance a lasting smoky warmth.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Blackcurrant and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Peony and Raspberry

Base notes: Black Amber, Patchouli and Papyrus

title: Aphrodisiac Touch Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Aphrodisiac Touch by Unique'e Luxury is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2018. Crafted by perfumers Jorge Lee, Sylvain Cara, and Selim Özen, it opens with vibrant top notes of lilac, saffron, cardamom, lily-of-the-valley, cloves, cinnamon, and bergamot. The heart reveals a blend of rose, orris root, cedar, patchouli, and geranium, while the base offers warm accords of vanilla, amber, musk, woody notes, and sandalwood.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lilac, Saffron, Cardamom, Lily-of-the-Valley, Cloves, Cinnamon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Orris Root, Cedar, Patchouli and Geranium

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Woody Notes and Sandalwood

title: Ithaka Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ithaka Eau de Parfum is the inaugural chapter of Versi Studio's ambitious olfactive trilogy, a collaboration between Mendittorosa and the literary legacy of C.P. Cavafy. This fragrance distills the essence of the poet's 1911 masterpiece—a meditation on journeys, discovery, and the sensual treasures encountered along life's voyage. Inspired by Cavafy's evocative imagery of Phoenician harbors, Egyptian wisdom, and exotic commodities—mother of pearl, coral, amber, and precious perfumes—Ithaka captures the spirit of wanderlust and intellectual awakening. Each application becomes a passage through distant ports and ancient civilizations, awakening the senses to beauty in its most refined forms. The presentation reflects this poetic ambition: a hand-crafted wooden cap crowns each flacon, while a hand-incised tablet bearing a solitary boat symbol honors the journey itself. Housed within Mendittorosa's signature wooden box—designed to echo the protective cases used for transporting fine art—Ithaka transcends fragrance to become a tangible work of olfactory literature, inviting the wearer to embark upon their own odyssey of sensory discovery.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Incense and Magnolia

Base notes: Benzoin, Incense, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Labdanum, Virginia Cedar and Patchouli

title: Orlo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Orlo Eau de Parfum is the second movement in Versi Studio's poetic olfactive trilogy, drawing inspiration from Sylvia Plath's haunting 1965 poem "Edge." This fragrance honors the courage of those who confront their inner darkness and stand resolute at the precipice of transformation. Mendittorosa has distilled Plath's exploration of emotional extremity into a sensory experience—a composition that acknowledges the struggle between vulnerability and artistic transcendence. Orlo speaks to those whose inner landscapes have grown numb, who seek expansion and illumination beyond their current boundaries. It is a fragrance for the spiritually ambitious, those who understand that art itself becomes a bridge between chaos and consciousness. Like Plath's monumental literary legacy—a body of work suspended between psychological fragility and superhuman creative force—Orlo captures the delicate equilibrium required to navigate profound emotional terrain without surrendering to the abyss. Each application becomes an act of resilience, a sensory affirmation that beauty and meaning can emerge from our darkest confrontations with self.

 

 Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Basil, Bitter Orange, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Cumin, Neroli, elemi, Ylang-Ylang, Petitgrain, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Lavender

Base notes: Papyrus, Hay, Leather, Rum, Agarwood (Oud) and Saffron

title: Gold Juice Eau de Intimite
body_html:
Gold Juice by BORNTOSTANDOUT presents a dynamic composition that begins with vibrant rhubarb, durian, and mango. The fragrance evolves into a luminous heart of osmanthus absolute, white florals, and radiant accords, before grounding itself in a warm base of caramel, almond, and guaiac wood. This golden scent masterfully balances sweetness with woody depth, creating a multifaceted olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Durian and Rhubarb

Middle notes: Osmanthus, White Flowers and Solar Notes

Base notes: Caramel, Almond and Guaiac Wood

title: Dirty Milk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dirty Milk by BORNTOSTANDOUT is a 2025 unisex fragrance that masterfully balances creamy gourmand sweetness with unexpected spice and woody depth. The composition opens with a luxurious blend of milk and caramel—indulgent and unapologetically rich. A heart of buttery iris and akigalawood introduces sophisticated contrast, where warmth meets subtle heat. The base settles into vanilla and musk, creating a sensual, skin-like finish that lingers intimately. This fragrance celebrates the art of contradiction: soft yet provocative, sweet yet complex, designed for those who appreciate fragrances that challenge convention and reward exploration.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caramel, Black Pepper and Milk

Middle notes: Condensed Milk, Akigalawood, Cashmeran and Iris

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Musk

title: 20 Iconic Feminine Perfume
body_html:
Experience the captivating allure of Iconic Feminine, a masterfully composed fragrance that celebrates timeless elegance. This sophisticated scent opens with the regal essence of Damask Rose, harmoniously blended with warm saffron and the delicate sweetness of plum and violet. Luminous florals and amber notes create a radiant, crystalline finish that embodies refined femininity. A signature creation from Clive Christian's prestigious collection, this iconic perfume delivers a luxurious olfactory journey that transcends fleeting trends.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron

Middle notes: Plum, Violet and Damask Rose

Base notes: Amber and Honey

title: Cheeky Smile Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cheeky Smile is a collaborative creation between V-Monkeys and perfumer Dominique Moellhausen, blending woody and musky accords inspired by acid house energy. Iso E Super provides transparent woody structure, while Oriental Extreme and Cashmeran deliver sensual depth and creamy warmth. A modern composition that balances minimalist woody elegance with rich oriental undertones, creating an engaging and contemporary fragrance experience.

 

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iso E Super and Ambrocenide

Middle notes: Ambroxan and Amber

Base notes: Cashmeran and Amber Xtreme

title: Above the Waves Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Above the Waves by Etat Libre d'Orange is a new fragrance released in 2025, designed for both women and men. This perfume features a blend of bergamot and frankincense in the top notes, with heart notes of Ceylon tea, rose, and Taiwanese oolong tea. The base is composed of Calocedrus formosana, cedar, and vetiver.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Frankincense

Middle notes: Oolong tea, Tea and Rose

Base notes: Cypress, Cedar and Vetiver

title: I Wanna Be Loved By You Eau de Parfum
body_html:
I Wanna Be Loved By You captures the essence of nocturnal allure and uninhibited passion. This fragrance awakens as darkness descends, embodying the magnetism of a woman who commands attention through her sensuality and confidence. It celebrates liberation from constraint, the intoxication of being desired, and the transformative power of self-assured femininity. A scent that lingers like a whispered declaration of devotion—a fragrant love letter to those who embrace their most captivating selves.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes:  Wild Berries, Sake and Plum

Middle notes: Amber, Rose and Apple

Base notes: Oud, Osmanthus and Vetiver

title: Diamond In The Sky Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Diamond in the Sky represents a sophisticated Oriental composition crafted by master perfumer Benoît Bergia for Haute Fragrance Company. This women's fragrance opens with an intriguing blend of caramel, saffron, and wild berries that immediately captivate the senses. The heart reveals creamy cashmere wood and refined white woods, creating a luxurious middle phase. The composition settles into a warm, sensual base of vanilla, amber, tolu balsam, and moss—delivering lasting depth and complexity. Launched in 2019, this fragrance balances gourmand sweetness with woody elegance, making it ideal for those seeking a distinctive scent with both richness and refinement.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes:  Caramel, Saffron and Wild Berries

Middle notes: Cashmere Wood and White Woods

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Tolu Balsam and Moss

title: Strange Heavens Out Of The Blue Perfume
body_html:
Strange Heavens Out Of The Blue by Clive Christian is a sophisticated extrait de parfum that masterfully balances warmth with complexity. The fragrance opens with roasted coffee and aniseed, brightened by spicy baies rose, before revealing a floral heart of jasmine and orange flower. The composition settles into a captivating base of cocoa absolute, vanilla caramel, and smoky undertones, creating a sweet yet slightly dark gourmand character that lingers on the skin. Ideal for those seeking a dense, multifaceted scent with addictive depth.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee, Pink Pepper and Anise

Middle notes: Orange Blossom and Jasmine

Base notes: Cocoa, Caramel, Vanilla and Smoke

title: Sama Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sama Eau de Parfum captures the spirit of Dubai's boundless ambition through a sophisticated fragrance journey. Opening with luminous apricot and Turkish rose, the composition transitions into a radiant heart of Osmanthus, evoking golden light and celestial warmth. The base unfolds with rich Oud and dry amber, creating a lingering glow reminiscent of twilight on the horizon. This is a fragrance for those who embrace infinite possibilities and the captivating essence of a city that reaches toward the stars.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apricot, lemon, mandarin, passion fruit, bergamot, cardamom, Indian black pepper, ginger, Turkish rose, geranium, ozonic accord 

Middle notes: Osmanthus, iris, ylang-ylang, jasmine, cinnamon, caramel, salt, fir balsam, olibanum (frankincense), cypriol 

Base notes: Oud, Indian sandalwood, patchouli, leather, vanilla, labdanum, ambergris, musk, tonka bean, incense, dry amber

title: Midnight Scented Dream Parfum Intense
body_html:
Midnight Scented Dream Parfum Intense represents Atkinsons' 2025 Reserve Collection offering, a sophisticated unisex fragrance crafted by master perfumer Fabrice Pellegrin. The composition unfolds with vibrant Calabrian bergamot and the ethereal floral character of Paradisone, transitioning into a refined heart of jasmine and queen of the night softened by delicate vanilla notes. The fragrance settles into a warm, creamy base featuring almond, Anthamber, heliotrope, and sandalwood—delivering a balanced olfactory experience that bridges brightness and sensuality.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Paradisone and Calabrian bergamot

Middle notes: Queen of the Night Flower, Vanilla and Jasmine

Base notes: Almond, Sandalwood, Heliotrope and Amber

title: Red Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Red Extrait de Parfum embodies fiery vibrancy and irresistible warmth, where spicy brightness and juicy facets come together in a captivating gourmand expression that stands out at night and in memorable moments. This unisex fragrance balances fresh citrus and playful spice with a rich, evocative heart and a warm, indulgent base, making it a bold choice for those who favor a spirited and unforgettable scent.

body_html:
Discover Super Nova Eau de Parfum by Gritti, a radiant fruity-floral woody unisex fragrance that captures the explosive brilliance and energy of a stellar phenomenon. This vibrant composition opens with a luminous blend of juicy fruits and sparkling citrus, creating an immediate impression of brightness and vitality. The heart unfolds into an elegant floral accord enriched with soft sweetness, adding depth and sophistication. In the base, smooth woods, warm amber, and sensual musk create a refined and long-lasting trail that balances freshness with warmth. Super Nova is an ideal choice for those seeking a modern, expressive signature scent with vibrant character and elegant depth.

The heart reveals a deep and harmonious accord of amber, labdanum, and soft spices, adding complexity and luxurious depth. In the base, smooth woods, vanilla, and subtle musk create a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with elegance and sensuality. In the base, amber, soft musks, and smooth woods create a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with warmth, elegance, and regal presence. Your Oudhness is an ideal choice for those seeking a distinguished signature scent that highlights the depth and majesty of oud.

The heart reveals a smooth blend of creamy florals and soft spices, adding elegance, richness, and an addictive character. In the base, warm woods, amber, vanilla, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with sensual warmth and refined sophistication. This captivating composition opens with delicious sweet accords and soft spices, creating an inviting and addictive introduction. The heart reveals a smooth blend of roasted coffee, creamy vanilla, and nutty nuances, adding depth, richness, and a delectable character. In the base, warm woods, amber, and soft musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with warmth, sweetness, and sensual elegance. Check Please is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances gourmand richness with refined depth.

title: Infinite Sky Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Infinite Sky Eau de Parfum by Estée Lauder is an airy floral-woody fragrance that evokes open horizons and effortless luminosity. This modern feminine composition balances bright, sparkling top facets with a soft, floral heart and a warm, clean woody-musk base. Designed for versatile daytime and evening wear, Infinite Sky offers a polished, uplifting presence that feels both contemporary and timeless.

title: Mango Yuzu Gasoline Perfume
body_html:
Mango Yuzu Gasoline is an audacious, modern citrus-oriental that fuses sun-ripe tropical fruit with an unexpected, smoky petrol accord for contrast—vibrant, edgy, and unmistakably contemporary. This unisex composition opens with effervescent citrus and lush mango, pierced by a clean, mineral gasoline/ozonic facet that adds urban grit. The heart softens into creamy florals and warm spice while the base settles into resinous woods and a subtly smoky, sweet gourmand drydown. Designed for confident daytime or nightwear, Mango Yuzu Gasoline balances playful fruitiness with urban darkness for a memorable, avant-garde statement.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Tropical, Oriental, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Yuzu, bergamot, green mango, ozonic/gasoline accord

title: Musk Butterfly Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Musk Butterfly Eau de Parfum, a luminous and elegant fragrance that blends airy aldehydes with delicate floral and musky sophistication. This captivating composition opens with sparkling aldehydes, Damask rose, Turkish rose, and geranium, creating a fresh and radiant introduction. The heart reveals soft violet and violet leaf, adding a powdery floral nuance and refined elegance. In the base, ambrette, sandalwood, and subtle musks provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with softness, warmth, and sensual sophistication. Musk Butterfly is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances floral brightness with smooth musky depth.

Olfactive pyramid

title: Astrum Nova Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Astrum Nova is a radiant, modern aldehydic-floral with a celestial, metallic-ozonic edge—luminous, airy, and quietly magnetic. This unisex composition opens with sparkling aldehydes and bright citrus that evolve into a crystalline floral heart of iris and neroli, while a warm, mineral-woody base of vetiver, ambroxan, and soft incense provides depth and longevity. Designed for versatile, signature wear, Astrum Nova projects refined luminosity—polished and memorable without excess.

Fragrance family: Aldehydic Floral, Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, bergamot, ozonic accord

Base notes: Vetiver, ambroxan, cedarwood, soft incense, white musk

title: Broye Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Broye is a refined, textured woody-aromatic that balances crisp aromatic freshness with warm, tobacco-tinged woods—understated, elegant, and quietly masculine-leaning. This unisex composition opens with bright, slightly herbal citrus and aromatic spice, unfurls into a noble tobacco-wood heart, and settles on a dry, earthy-amber base that emphasizes longevity and poise. Designed for day-to-evening versatility, Broye offers polished restraint suited to both professional and contemplative settings.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, pink pepper, lavender

Middle notes: Tobacco leaf, cedarwood, vetiver, iris

Base notes: Tonka bean, amber, leather accord, oakmoss

title: Papyrus Oud 71 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Papyrus Oud 71 is a refined, woody-oriental that fuses dry papyrus-green facets with smoky, resinous oud—earthy, textured, and quietly noble. This unisex composition opens with crisp green-citrus lift and papyrus reed greenness, moves into a calm heart where incense and soft florals meet woody oud, and settles on a dry, mineral-tinged base of resins and aged woods for a contemplative, long-lasting signature suited to both daytime elegance and evening depth.

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Agarwood (oud), cedar heart, vetiver, amber, labdanum, light leather/mineral accord

title: Milky Musk 39 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Milky Musk 39 is a soft, cozy musk-gourmand that wraps a clean, milky accord around a warm, powdery core—comforting, intimate, and effortlessly wearable. This unisex composition blends lactonic creaminess and gentle florals with a soft musky-vanillic base, creating a close, skin-like sillage ideal for everyday wear and quiet, personal moments.

title: Russian Tea Eau de Parfum

Russian Tea by Masque Milano is a warm, spiced tea-gourmand that evokes a cozy, intimate tea ceremony—smoky, slightly boozy, and gently sweet. This unisex composition blends brisk black tea and bright citrus with aromatic spices and a plush, resinous-vanillic base, creating a comforting yet sophisticated scent suited to cooler days and evening relaxation.

title: Musk Kashmir Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Musk Kashmir is a plush, intimate musk-oriental that evokes cashmere-wrapped warmth and quiet luxury—soft, powdery, and sensually cozy. This unisex composition centers on a silken musk heart enriched by warm resins, gentle spice, and creamy woods, creating a refined, close-wearing scent suited to intimate evenings and cooler days when comfort and understated elegance are desired.

This unisex composition layers a sheer, luminous top with a soft, powdery floral-musky heart and a warm, suede-like woody-amber base, creating a natural, second-skin effect ideal for everyday wear and close, personal moments.

title: Her Majesty Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Her Majesty by Kilian is a regal, opulent oriental-amber that channels baroque luxury and refined decadence—rich, honeyed, and warmly resinous. This feminine-leaning composition layers sumptuous honeyed florals and candied fruit facets with noble spices and creamy vanillic woods, settling into a deep, balsamic-amber base that imparts long-lasting sillage and ceremonious elegance. Designed for evening grandeur and special occasions, Her Majesty reads lavish and authoritative without losing refined polish.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Amber, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, candied lemon, saffron (bright-spicy-gourmand facets)
Middle notes: Honeyed rose, orange blossom, jasmine, praline nuance
Base notes: Amber, vanilla, benzoin, sandalwood, labdanum, white musk

title: Fire At Will Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fire At Will Eau de Parfum, created by independent perfumer Vanina Murraciole, blends vanilla and mimosa to balance intensity with subtlety and seduction with charm. It opens with a delicate, airy vanilla paired with honeyed, powdery mimosa, leading to a gourmand yet light vanilla reminiscent of creamy ice cream and soft, sweet whispers. This distinctive fragrance leaves a captivating trail that draws attention and highlights the wearer’s presence. Perfect for those who want to be remembered, it serves as a signature by day and an alluring embrace by night, leaving an unforgettable trace even in absence.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla and Mimosa

Middle notes: Vanilla and Brown sugar

Base notes: Amber, Musk and Vetiver

title: Fatih Sultan Mehmed Eau de Parfum

Fatih Sultan Mehmed is a majestic, historic-inspired oriental-woody that evokes imperial courts and triumphal processions—regal, resinous, and richly spiced. This unisex composition layers bright, noble spices and citrus with a lush, floral-resin heart and a commanding base of oud, leather, and amber, creating a dignified, long-lasting scent suited to formal evenings and ceremonial moments. Designed to project authority and timeless elegance, Fatih Sultan Mehmed balances opulent depth with refined structure.

body_html:
Dubai by Bortnikoff is an opulent, majestic oriental-oud that channels the gilded glamour and desert grandeur of a modern metropolis—rich, resinous, and intensely luxurious. This unisex composition layers radiant spices and bright citrus over a lush floral-oud heart, resolving into a deep, honeyed-amber and woody base with leathered and balsamic nuances. Crafted for formal evenings and ceremonial presence, Dubai projects commanding sillage and long-lasting warmth without losing refined structure.

title: Blue Astaral Parfum
body_html:
Blue Astaral by Xerjoff is a radiant, modern marine-woody that captures polished oceanic clarity with a luminous, sophisticated twist—fresh, mineral, and elegantly refined. This unisex composition opens with sparkling citrus and saline-ozonic facets that flow into a crystalline heart of airy florals and watery green accords, then settles on a smooth, driftwood-amber base with ambroxan clarity and soft woody warmth. Designed for versatile daytime wear and polished evening moments, Blue Astaral offers a clean, enduring signature that feels contemporary and effortlessly wearable.
