Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, lemon, sea spray/ozone accord
Middle notes: Neroli, jasmine water, watery florals, green leaves
Base notes: Driftwood accord, ambroxan, sandalwood, cedarwood, white musk

title: Acqua di Sale di Parfum
body_html:
Acqua di Sale — Profumum Roma is a refined marine fragrance that captures the raw serenity of the Mediterranean coast, evoking salty sea air, sun-warmed skin, and the mineral freshness of ocean waves. It opens with an intense burst of sea salt and marine accords, immediately creating a crisp, airy sensation reminiscent of wind over open water. The heart reveals earthy myrtle and subtle seaweed nuances, adding natural depth and a slightly aromatic green facet that enhances the coastal realism of the composition. As it develops, the fragrance settles into a smooth cedarwood base, grounding the aquatic freshness with warmth and quiet elegance, leaving behind a clean, mineral, and long-lasting oceanic trail.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea salt, marine accords
Middle notes: Myrtle, seaweed
Base notes: Cedarwood

title: Basilica di Assisi  Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Basilica di Assisi — Filippo Sorcinelli is a sacred, contemplative, and architectural fragrance inspired by the spiritual aura of ancient basilicas, blending luminous incense, soft florals, and refined woods into a serene and reverent composition. It opens with a bright yet gentle wave of incense and aromatic nuances, immediately evoking the still air and glowing light of a sacred interior. The heart unfolds into a delicate balance of white florals and balsamic resins, adding warmth, purity, and a quiet emotional depth that feels both uplifting and devotional. As it settles, the fragrance rests on a smooth base of cedarwood, soft woods, and clean musks, leaving a calm, ethereal, and long-lasting trail that reflects silence, faith, and architectural majesty.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Incense, aromatic nuances
Middle notes: White florals, balsamic resins
Base notes: Cedarwood, soft woods, white musk

title: Beach Hut Man Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Beach Hut Man — Amouage is a sophisticated, windswept, and deeply aromatic fragrance that evokes the solitude of a secluded coastline through an intense blend of mint, woods, and smoky green accords. It opens with a striking burst of mint, orange blossom, and galbanum, creating an immediate sensation of cool freshness and untamed greenery reminiscent of ocean air meeting wild coastal vegetation. The heart unfolds into a refined aromatic blend of ivy, vetiver, and moss, adding earthy depth and a dry green texture that feels elegant, contemplative, and powerfully natural. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a rich base of myrrh, patchouli, and dry woods, leaving a smoky, resinous, and long-lasting trail that feels mysterious, masculine, and effortlessly luxurious. Widely regarded for its distinctive green character and exceptional performance, it balances freshness with dark woody sophistication in a uniquely atmospheric way.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Mint, orange blossom, galbanum
Middle notes: Ivy, vetiver, moss
Base notes: Myrrh, patchouli, dry woods

title: Paddock Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Paddock — Hermès is a distinctive, atmospheric, and deeply evocative fragrance inspired by the world of equestrian elegance, capturing the scent of stables, hay, leather, and warm woods in a refined and artistic composition. Created by Christine Nagel for Hermès, the fragrance evokes the quiet intimacy of the paddock before and after a ride, blending rustic textures with luxurious sophistication. It opens with the honeyed warmth of hay and fresh grassy nuances, immediately creating an earthy yet comforting sensation that feels natural, nostalgic, and unexpectedly elegant. The heart unfolds around ambery carrot seed accords, adding powdery warmth and a subtly leathery depth that enriches the fragrance’s equestrian identity. As it settles, soft amber, woods, waxy nuances, and musky undertones create a warm, textured, and long-lasting trail that feels both intimate and quietly daring. Widely praised for its originality, Paddock transforms the raw beauty of stable life into a refined olfactory experience that feels artistic, earthy, and unmistakably Hermès.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Green, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Hay, grassy accords
Middle notes: Carrot seed, amber nuances
Base notes: Woods, musky accords, waxy amber facets

title: Thorns Become Roses Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Thorns Become Roses — Nishane is a bold and sophisticated oriental floral fragrance that explores the transformative beauty of the rose through striking contrasts of light and shadow. Created by perfumer Julien Rasquinet for Nishane's Rumi Collection, the composition embodies the journey from resilience to grace, where sharp edges gradually unfold into velvety elegance. It opens with a vibrant blend of lychee, raspberry, saffron, and cardamom, creating a luminous fusion of juicy fruits and warm spices that immediately captivates the senses. At its heart, luxurious Turkish rose takes center stage, enriched by the green, leathery facets of violet leaf and the delicate powdery softness of mimosa, resulting in a floral accord that is both powerful and refined. As the fragrance settles, sandalwood, patchouli, and amberwood create a smooth, woody foundation that leaves a warm, mineral, and subtly ambery trail. Richly textured and exceptionally elegant, Thorns Become Roses is a modern interpretation of the rose—sensual, resilient, and endlessly captivating.

Fragrance Family: Oriental Floral, Woody, Amber

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Lychee, Raspberry, Saffron, Cardamom
Heart Notes: Turkish Rose, Violet Leaf, Mimosa
Base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Amberwood

title: What About Pop Eau De Parfum
body_html:
What About Pop — The House of Oud is an irresistibly playful and sophisticated gourmand fragrance that transforms the comforting aroma of buttery caramel popcorn into a luxurious olfactory creation. Inspired by the joyful anticipation of a night at the cinema, the composition masterfully balances sweet indulgence with elegant woods and creamy resins, creating a scent that is both nostalgic and refined. It opens with the deliciously addictive accord of salted popcorn and hawthorn, where buttery, toasted nuances are lifted by a delicate fruity-floral freshness. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy milk, whipped cream, and exotic floral notes create a velvety heart that adds richness and smooth texture without overwhelming the senses. The dry down reveals warm vanilla, caramel, ebony wood, amber, benzoin, and vetiver, leaving a sensual, woody-gourmand trail that is comforting, sophisticated, and remarkably long-lasting. Richly textured and unexpectedly elegant, What About Pop transforms a familiar treat into an unforgettable niche fragrance experience.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand, Amber, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Salted Popcorn, Hawthorn, Caramel
Heart Notes: Milk Cream, Whipped Cream, Exotic Floral Notes
Base Notes: Vanilla, Ebony Wood, Amber, Benzoin, Vetiver

title: Amber Bloom Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Amber Bloom Extrait de Parfum — Electimuss London is a luxurious amber-floral fragrance that celebrates the opulent beauty of radiant blossoms wrapped in rich resins, creamy vanilla, and precious woods. Inspired by the grandeur and refinement of the Roman Empire, this extrait de parfum blends luminous floral elegance with warm amber depth, creating a composition that is sophisticated, sensual, and undeniably captivating. Smooth yet powerful, it unfolds with remarkable richness and exceptional longevity, leaving an unforgettable trail of modern luxury. It opens with a sparkling fusion of bergamot, mandarin, and pink pepper, delivering a vibrant citrus freshness accented by delicate spice. At its heart, an opulent bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine sambac, and rose blooms with velvety richness, revealing a radiant floral character that is both elegant and intoxicating. As the fragrance settles, golden amber, benzoin, Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood, patchouli, and soft musk create a creamy, resinous base that envelops the skin in warmth, depth, and refined sensuality. Rich, luminous, and exquisitely balanced, Amber Bloom is an elegant expression of timeless luxury and contemporary sophistication.

Fragrance Family: Amber, Floral

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Pink Pepper
Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac, Rose
Base Notes: Amber, Benzoin, Madagascar Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, White Musk

title: Tyrannosaurus Rex Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tyrannosaurus Rex Extrait de Parfum — Zoologist Perfumes is a daring smoky-woody fragrance that captures the raw power and untamed dominance of the prehistoric king of predators. Intensified in extrait concentration, this bold composition immerses the wearer in a dramatic landscape of blazing forests, molten earth, aromatic resins, and primal woods, creating an unforgettable olfactory experience of remarkable depth and longevity. It opens with a fiery burst of black pepper, bergamot, fir, bay leaf, and smoky accords, delivering an explosive introduction that evokes the heat and chaos of a primeval world. At its heart, rich florals intertwine with jasmine, osmanthus, ylang-ylang, clove, and incense, adding an unexpected elegance that contrasts beautifully with the fragrance's fierce character. As the scent settles, a commanding base of leather, cedarwood, sandalwood, patchouli, vetiver, vanilla, civet, and resins creates a dark, powerful foundation that lingers with extraordinary intensity and complexity. Bold, untamed, and unmistakably distinctive, Tyrannosaurus Rex Extrait de Parfum is a fearless statement piece for those who appreciate avant-garde perfumery and uncompromising artistic expression.

Fragrance Family: Smoky, Woody, Resinous

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Black Pepper, Bay Leaf, Fir, Smoke
Heart Notes: Jasmine, Osmanthus, Ylang-Ylang, Clove, Incense
Base Notes: Leather, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver, Vanilla, Civet, Resins

title: Tales From Zanzibar Golden Hour Parfum Intense
body_html:
Tales From Zanzibar Golden Hour — Memoirs of a Perfume Collector is a radiant amber-woody fragrance inspired by the warm glow of the setting sun, capturing the beauty of golden light with a luxurious blend of tropical fruits, creamy woods, and sensual amber accords. Crafted for those who appreciate elegant compositions with an exotic character, the fragrance seamlessly balances vibrant freshness, soft florals, and rich woody nuances into a captivating scent that evokes the serenity of an endless summer evening. It opens with a luminous burst of juicy tropical fruits and sparkling citrus, creating a bright and uplifting introduction that feels both refreshing and inviting. At its heart, creamy floral accords intertwine with smooth coconut nuances and soft spices, adding warmth and an effortlessly sophisticated tropical character. As the fragrance settles, rich sandalwood, warm amber, vanilla, and sensual musk create a velvety base that leaves an elegant, long-lasting trail of comfort and refinement. Warm, luminous, and irresistibly sophisticated, Golden Hour is a luxurious celebration of tropical sunsets and timeless elegance.

Fragrance Family: Amber, Woody, Tropical

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Tropical Fruits, Citrus Accords
Heart Notes: Floral Accords, Coconut, Soft Spices
Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Musk

title: Soie Malaquais Limited Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Soie Malaquais — Dries Van Noten is a sumptuous and sophisticated fragrance that transforms the sensation of touch into scent, weaving together contrasting textures in an elegant olfactory tapestry. Inspired by the interplay of delicate silk and artisanal craftsmanship, the composition explores the beauty of unexpected harmonies—where softness meets depth and refinement embraces indulgence. It opens with the sparkling freshness of bergamot intertwined with the juicy richness of blackcurrant, creating a vibrant and luminous introduction. At its heart, velvety rose is enveloped in a distinctive silk accord, imparting an airy, smooth texture that feels both graceful and modern. As the fragrance settles, the comforting warmth of chestnut emerges, wrapped in the bittersweet richness of cocoa to create a balsamic and irresistibly addictive trail. The result is a fragrance of exquisite contrasts: delicate yet enveloping, refined yet sensual, evoking the fluid elegance of silk adorned with golden details.

Fragrance Family: Amber, Gourmand, Floral

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Blackcurrant
Heart Notes: Rose, Silk Accord
Base Notes: Chestnut, Cocoa

title: Lucius Maximus Parfum
body_html:
Lucius Maximus — Fragrance Du Bois is a powerful, luxurious, and intensely refined oriental-woody fragrance that reimagines the original Lucius with deeper gourmand richness and commanding sophistication. It opens with a vibrant blend of bergamot, bitter orange, mandarin, and pink pepper, creating an energetic citrus-spice freshness that feels bold, luminous, and immediately captivating. The heart unfolds into an opulent accord of coffee, orange blossom, cedarwood, Georgywood, and Mahonial, adding creamy warmth, aromatic depth, and a dark roasted sensuality that gives the composition its rich and modern character. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth and long-lasting base of tonka bean, Madagascar vanilla, Haitian vetiver, Akigalawood, and cypriol, leaving a warm, woody, and slightly smoky trail that feels powerful, elegant, and irresistibly addictive.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Bergamot, bitter orange, mandarin, pink pepper
Middle notes: Coffee, orange blossom, cedarwood, Georgywood, Mahonial
Base notes: Tonka bean, Madagascar vanilla, Haitian vetiver, Akigalawood, cypriol

title: This Ember Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Ember is a smoldering, modern amber-woody fragrance that captures the quiet glow of a lingering ember—warm, intimate, and subtly smoky. This unisex composition layers glowing resins and toasted woods with soft spices and a muted floral heart, creating a refined, cozy presence suited to evening wear and close moments where restrained warmth is desired.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink pepper, bergamot, nutmeg

Middle notes: Labdanum, iris, smoked jasmine

Base notes: Amber, guaiacwood, sandalwood, benzoin, white musk

title: Desert Eden Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Desert Eden is a rich, sun-drenched oriental-woody fragrance that conjures a secluded oasis amid arid dunes—warm, resinous, and opulently spiced. This unisex composition blends radiant dried fruits and floral nectar with exotic spices and deep woody-resinous accords, creating a luxurious, contemplative scent suited for evening wear and special moments.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, bergamot, cardamom, dried fig

Middle notes: Date accord, orange blossom, rose, iris

Base notes: Oud, amber, sandalwood, labdanum, vanilla, white musk

title: Vanilla Haze Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Fugazzi's Vanilla Haze Extrait de Parfum represents a sophisticated evolution of the original fragrance—darker, more complex, and unapologetically intense. Crafted in France with a potent 30% fragrance concentration, this extrait opens with crisp lemon before transitioning into a luxurious blend of coconut milk and roasted hazelnut. The composition deepens through Madagascar vanilla, tonka bean, clove, and cashmeran, settling into a sensual base of saffron, caramel, bourbon vanilla, and musk. Designed for evening wear and those who appreciate layered olfactory narratives, Vanilla Haze balances creamy sweetness with smoky undertones. Founded by Bram Niessink, Fugazzi prioritizes globally sourced premium ingredients and sustainable practices, delivering a fragrance that tells a story through scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut Milk, Hazelnut and Lemon

Middle notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Clove, Cashmeran and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Saffron, Bourbon Vanilla, Caramel and Musk

title: Cherry Punk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cherry Punk Eau de Parfum unveils a rich, smoky cherry wrapped in dark leather. The delicate jasmine accents evoke a romantic, dreamlike atmosphere. Initially, the scent presents a bold, cherry-infused leather with a subtle sharpness. As it settles, it evolves into a warm, inviting fragrance that maintains a captivating edge.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Saffron and Sichuan Pepper

Middle notes: Violet, Mimosa and Jasmine

Base notes: Leather, Tonka Bean and Patchouli

title: I Dont Know What Eau de Parfum
body_html:
I Dont Know What Eau de Parfum functions as a sophisticated fragrance enhancer, designed to elevate any perfume with what the French refer to as an ineffable quality—a certain "je ne sais quoi." This unique composition possesses its own distinct olfactory profile, meticulously formulated with high-performance synthetic molecules that create a transparent radiance when layered with other fragrances, enhancing their complexity and projection.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Iso E Super and Vetiver

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber and Synthetic Civet

title: 195 A.C. Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
As an essential part of the Pompei collection, 195 A.C. Extrait de Parfum is renowned for its beloved fragrance created by Agatho Parfum. This Maison pays tribute to the historic year of 195 BC, when the Lex Oppia - a law aimed at oppressing women's prosperity and wealth - was abolished. This symbolic year was marked by a vibrant awakening of the senses and a renewed celebration of life's luxuries and pleasures. The result is a harmonious blend of citrus, herbaceous, and woody notes, with the invigorating essence of fig as the centerpiece. It serves as a symbol of humanity's desire to fully embrace its rebirth.

Fragrance family: Green, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig Leave, Pomegranate, Bergamot, Mint, Lemon

Middle notes: Fig, Cardamom, Jasmine

Base notes: Cashmere Wood, Styrax, Black Tea , Cedarwood, Incense, Patchouli, Oud

title: Teint de Neige Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This luxurious fragrance encapsulates the essence of the belle-époque era with a soft, gentle, and enveloping aroma. Evoking memories and the atmosphere of the time, it exudes a delicate sweetness and powdery finish.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Heliotrope, Musk, Rose and Jasmine

title: Rock the Myrrh Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the unique and intoxicating scent of Rock the Myrrh Eau de Parfum by Dries Van Noten. Inspired by their Parisian boutique, this fragrance features a blend of myrrh, benzoin resin, and cistus, with a touch of black pepper and cyprus. The refillable bottle allows for long-lasting enjoyment.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper and Cypress

Middle notes: Myrrh and Patchouli

Base notes: Suede and Benzoin

title: Replica Jazz Club Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Replica Jazz Club Eau de Toilette evokes the exclusive setting of a private jazz club, filled with the enticing scents of cigars, whisky, cognac, and rum. With its elegant and smoky aroma, this fragrance captures the tradition of generations passed down in the private Brooklyn club. Among lively conversations and the soft melodies of jazz music, you'll find yourself enveloped in a woody and spicy blend of tobacco leaf and pink pepper. Maison Margiela has expertly crafted this heady eau de toilette, recreating the refined aromas of cocktails through a mix of Vanilla Beans and Rum absolute.

Fragrance family: Leather, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Neroli and Lemon

Middle notes: Rum, Java vetiver oil and Clary Sage

Base notes: Tobacco Leaf, Vanilla Bean and Styrax

title: Mefisto Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Mefisto Eau de Parfum is a refreshing scent that evokes images of fresh clouds, blue skies, and serene azure oceans. With its blend of classic Italian citrus, floral, and woody notes, this perfume is a true heritage. The marine vibe of a citrus accord, featuring grapefruit and bergamot, further solidifies its Italian identity.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon

Middle notes: Lavender, Iris and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Virginia Cedar and Amber

title: Layton Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Layton Eau de Parfum expertly captures the debonair essence with its seductive blend of amber and floral notes. Opening with a tangy passion of bergamot, followed by the fresh and chic combination of lavender and geranium, this fragrance embodies chivalrous charm. The intensity is heightened by the addition of natural pink pepper, while the distinguished character is enhanced by the allure of vanilla and precious woods. These elements are further enriched by a caramelized coffee note, creating an addictive and intriguing scent.

Fragrance family: Amber, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Bergamot, Lavender

Middle notes: Jasmine, Violet, Geranium

Base notes: Vanilla, Pepper, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli

title: Gris Charnel Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gris Charnel Eau de Parfum by BDK Parfum is a captivating blend inspired by a romantic encounter in Paris. With cardamom and fig, it evokes a sense of calm while the rich Iris absolute, dark cistus essential oil, and creamy sandalwood offer a bold and balanced aroma. Indulge in this unique fragrance that captures the essence of love and adventure.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Fig and Black Tea

Middle notes: Iris and Bourbon Vetiver

Base notes: Sandalwood and Tonka Bean

title: Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a sensuous and captivating journey with Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum by Kilian. Enter a garden of beauty and corruption, where the delicate scent of apricot-infused osmanthus, orange blossom, and rose of May absolute are seduced by the irresistible allure of tuberose, jasmine, and narcissus.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Osmanthus, Peach, Neroli, Bergamot, Mandarin and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Indian Tuberose, Jasmine, Narcissus and May Rose

Base notes: Amber, Cedar, Vetiver, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: God of Fire Eau de Parfum
body_html:
God of Fire Eau de Parfum embodies a symbol of power and wisdom with its exquisite fragrance. Fresh and exotic notes mask an intense warmth, reflecting the incredible strength of its ruler over the volcanoes. Its Oud heart burns with a shamanic intensity, offering a regenerating and confidence-boosting experience.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Lemon, Pink Berries, Ginger

Middle notes: Blue Coumarin, Jasmine, Dry Woods

Base notes: Oud, Nagarmotha, Musk, Amber

title: Frustration Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the love game of perfumes with Frustration Eau de Parfum. Created to ignite desire and awaken the inner child, this fragrance is a journey to the dominion of vanilla, rum, and vetiver. Embrace the ever-renewing distance and live passionately between childhood and adulthood. Let Frustration awaken your senses and memories.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Cinnamon and Cumin

Middle notes: Vanilla, Vanilla Absolute and Labdanum

Base notes: Chestnut, Bourbon Vetiver and Guaiacol

title: Delina Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Delina Eau de Parfum features a delightful and contemporary floral blend. This fragrance is intricately crafted to exude sweetness and sensuality with its floral notes of damascena rose, lily of the valley, and peony, complemented by tangy accents of lychee, rhubarb, bergamot, and nutmeg. The base notes of vanilla, white musk, cashmeran, cedarwood, and incense add a touch of sensuality to the overall composition.

Fragrance family: Floral, Rose, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rhubarb, Lychee, Bergamot Essence

Middle notes: Damascena Rose, Vanilla

Base notes: Cashmeran, Musk, Vetiver

title: Blanche Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Blanche Eau de Parfum by Byredo is a refreshing and alluring fragrance, exploring the delicate textures of cleanliness, purity, and crisp linens. This captivating scent blends notes of violet, sandalwood, and musk, evoking the intimate sensation of human touch with every spray.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Rose and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Peony, Violet and African Orange Flower

Base notes:Musk, Woodsy Notes and Sandalwood

title: Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the exotic with Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum. This captivating scent is a tribute to the majestic Arabic Horse, blending spiced volutes, bewitching roses, and bergamot with Oud, Amber, and Musk for an audacious, fiery fragrance. Intended for lovers of rare perfumes, this scent evokes an animal temperament with hints of feminine allure.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Saffron

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Oud

Base notes: Amber, Oakmoss, Tonka bean, Cane sugar, white musk.

title: Fuego Futuro Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Fuego Futuro Extrait de Parfum is an olfactory vision of fire transformed into something futuristic and elemental. Inspired by the meeting of incandescent energy and contemporary materials, the fragrance explores the tension between heat, smoke, mineral textures, and luminous warmth. Its character is bold and atmospheric, evoking a landscape where fire burns beneath an otherworldly sky.

The fragrance opens with the vibrant heat of pink pepper and the aromatic brightness of bergamot, creating an electrifying first impression. At the heart, saffron and incense introduce a smoky, resinous dimension, enriched by the dark character of leather. The composition settles into a powerful base of oud, vetiver, and amber woods, creating a warm, mineral-like trail with remarkable depth and persistence.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Saffron,Incense,Leather

Base Notes: Oud,Vetiver,Amber Woods

title: Ginseng Biloba Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ginseng Biloba is a luminous creation from the Hermessence collection, imagined by perfumer Christine Nagel as a composition of curves and graphic lines. Inspired by the sinuous forms of ginseng roots intertwining with the delicate leaves of ginkgo biloba, the fragrance creates an elegant meeting of textured earthiness and radiant botanical freshness.

The composition brings the textured character of ginseng root together with the luminous expression of ginkgo biloba. Their graceful encounter develops into a refined woody trail, subtle yet distinctive, evoking the precious shimmer of golden threads. Designed for both women and men, Ginseng Biloba expresses the Hermessence philosophy through the sophisticated union of two contrasting natural inspirations.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Green

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Ginkgo Biloba Leaf

Middle Notes: Ginseng Root

Base Notes: Woody Accord

title: Bubble Tea Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bubble Tea is a playful and comforting creation from d’Annam,celebrating Taiwan’s beloved drink and its journey from a joyful local invention to a global phenomenon. The fragrance captures the sensory pleasure of freshly prepared milk tea,bringing together roasted black tea,rich brown sugar,creamy milk,and soft tapioca pearls in a deliciously contemporary interpretation.

The composition centers on the aromatic depth of black tea,balanced by the smooth creaminess of whole milk. Brown sugar adds a warm,caramelized sweetness,while tapioca pearls bring a soft,chewy gourmand character that gives the fragrance its distinctive bubble tea signature.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand,Lactonic,Tea,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Black Tea

Middle Notes: Whole Milk,Brown Sugar

Base Notes: Tapioca Pearls (Boba)

title: Overture 41 Woman Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Overture 41 Woman Extrait de Parfum is an intensified interpretation of Amouage’s original Overture Woman,a grand and dramatic composition inspired by the uncompromising elegance of an operatic diva. Created by perfumer Annick Ménardo and dosed at a monumental 41% concentration,this exceptional extrait expands the original fragrance into a richer,more powerful,and profoundly sensual expression. Saffron,Calvados,and Rose take center stage,while sophisticated Sandalwood Drèches adds depth and refinement to the composition.

The fragrance opens with the resinous glow of Frankincense,the opulence of Saffron,the boozy warmth of Calvados,and the spicy character of Cinnamon. At the heart,Benzoin and Rose Centifolia unfold alongside Geranium and the smooth elegance of Sandalwood Drèches,creating a luxurious floral-woody contrast. The drydown becomes darker and more enveloping,with Vanilla,Labdanum,Patchouli,and Leather grounding the composition in a warm,resinous,and commanding finish.

Fragrance Family: Amber,Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Frankincense,Saffron,Calvados,Cinnamon
Heart Notes: Benzoin,Rose Centifolia Accord,Geranium,Sandalwood Drèches
Base Notes: Vanilla,Labdanum,Patchouli,Leather

title: Cedrus de Nuit Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cedrus de Nuit Eau de Parfum is a sensual and enveloping woody fragrance from Chloé’s Atelier des Fleurs, inspired by the mysterious atmosphere of Parisian nights on the Rive Gauche. Created by perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner, it reinvents the cedar character through the rare and ephemeral Queen of the Night flower, whose honeyed and subtly spicy character blooms against the darkness.

The fragrance opens with a warm,spiced accord of Cinnamon Oil,Clove Bud Oil,and Black Pepper Oil, creating an intriguing contrast with the nocturnal floral heart. Queen of the Night unfolds alongside Rosyfolia and Mahonial™, bringing a voluptuous floral dimension, while the base deepens into Vanilla Absolute,Benzoin Resinoid,and Cedar for a dark,ambery,and enveloping finish.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cinnamon Oil,Clove Bud Oil,Black Pepper Oil
Heart Notes: Queen of the Night,Rosyfolia,Mahonial™
Base Notes: Vanilla Absolute,Benzoin Resinoid,Cedar

title: Drunk Lovers Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Drunk Lovers Extrait Extrême is an intense, provocative interpretation of BORNTOSTANDOUT’s celebrated Drunk Lovers, created for the part of the night that becomes impossible to forget. Crafted at an exceptionally high fragrance concentration and aged for three months in traditional Korean Onggi pottery, this extrait amplifies the original’s seductive character with the opulence of red wine,leather,and oud. Bold,raw,and unapologetically sensual,it captures a night where desire takes over and restraint disappears.

The fragrance opens with the dark richness of Red Wine and Wine Lees, giving the composition a fermented,tannic depth,while Bergamot and Clary Sage add a controlled brightness. In the heart, Brandy and Red Ginger create a warm,boozy heat,joined by the fruity intensity of Davana,Jasmine Sambac,and the balsamic sweetness of Peru Balsam. The drydown becomes darker and more commanding,with Roasted Tonka,Akigalawood,Cistus,Leather,and Oud creating a smoky,woody,and deeply sensual trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Amber,Leather,Bozy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Red Wine,Bergamot,Wine Lees,Clary Sage
Heart Notes: Brandy,Red Ginger,Davana,Jasmine Sambac,Peru Balsam
Base Notes: Roasted Tonka,Akigalawood,Cistus,Leather,Oud

title: London Black Edition Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
London Black Edition Extrait de Parfum — WIDIAN is a luxurious woody-leathery fragrance inspired by the elegance and mystery of the Victorian era. This limited-edition interpretation brings together noble oud, supple leather, juicy raspberry, and warm amber, creating a darker and more opulent expression with an unmistakably refined character. Created by perfumer Jordi Fernández, it is presented as a 50ml Extrait de Parfum.

It opens with oud wood, cypress, violet, saffron, and pink peppercorn, creating a sophisticated blend of dark woods, aromatic freshness, powdery violet, and warm spice. At its heart, lily-of-the-valley, raspberry, patchouli, and dry amber introduce a soft floral-fruity character, with raspberry adding a subtle sweetness to the darker composition. As the fragrance settles, leather, dry amber, musk, and vanilla create a smooth, sensual, and long-lasting base with warmth and depth.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Leather,Floral,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Oud Wood,Cypress,Violet,Saffron,Pink Peppercorn
Heart Notes: Lily-of-the-Valley,Raspberry,Patchouli,Dry Amber
Base Notes: Leather,Dry Amber,Musk,Vanilla

title: The Blazing Mister Sam Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
The Blazing Mister Sam Intense Eau de Parfum — Penhaligon's is a bold, spicy-woody fragrance that gives the original Mister Sam a darker, richer, and more provocative character. The Intense version is described by Penhaligon's as a fragrance of plum liquor, tobacco, and leather, portraying Mister Sam as taking his usual Stateside swagger into a darker game.

It opens with cardamom and cinnamon, creating a warm and vibrant spicy introduction. At its heart, cumin, saffron, and black pepper intensify the composition with a dry, fiery spice accord. As the fragrance settles, patchouli, tobacco, vanilla, and cedar create a rich, warm, woody base with a smooth tobacco sweetness and lasting depth. The result is a confident and magnetic fragrance with a darker, more intense personality than the original Mister Sam.

Fragrance Family: Spicy,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Cardamom,Cinnamon
Heart Notes: Cumin,Saffron,Black Pepper
Base Notes: Patchouli,Tobacco,Vanilla,Cedar

title: Late Harvest Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Late Harvest Eau de Parfum — Fort & Manlé is a warm, nostalgic fragrance inspired by memories passed down through generations and the comforting aroma of an old leather tobacco pouch. The composition evokes the final days of the harvest season, blending rich cherry pipe tobacco with woods, leather, rose, and vanilla to create an intimate portrait of autumn. It opens with the deep, aromatic character of cherry pipe tobacco, bringing a sweet, smoky, and slightly fruity warmth. At its heart, cedarwood and rosewood add a dry, refined woody character, while leather introduces depth and the worn-in feel of a cherished tobacco pouch. As the fragrance settles, vanilla and rose create a soft, warm finish that balances the darker tobacco and woods. Nostalgic, elegant, and deeply atmospheric, Late Harvest Eau de Parfum is a celebration of memory, craftsmanship, and the quiet beauty of the changing seasons.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Tobacco,Vanilla

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Cherry Pipe Tobacco
Heart Notes: Cedarwood,Rosewood,Leather
Base Notes: Vanilla,Rose

title: Oudian Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Oudian Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a powerful smoky-fruity fragrance built around the striking contrast between tropical durian and precious oud. Inspired by the concept of natural dominance, this intense composition combines exotic fruits, saffron, Sichuan pepper, smoky resins, leather, and earthy woods to create an unapologetically commanding presence. It opens with the unmistakable tropical intensity of durian, enriched by saffron, tropical fruits, and the spicy character of Sichuan pepper. At its heart, cistus labdanum and olibanum introduce a deep resinous and smoky dimension, adding warmth and mystery to the composition. As the fragrance settles, oud, leather, and vetiver create a dark, powerful base with an earthy and sophisticated character that leaves a striking, long-lasting trail. Bold, intense, and unmistakably distinctive, Oudian Extrait de Parfum is a fragrance of strength, authority, and undeniable presence.

Fragrance Family: Smoky,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Durian,Saffron,Tropical Fruits,Szechuan Pepper
Heart Notes: Cistus Labdanum,Olibanum
Base Notes: Oud,Leather,Vetiver

title: Yuma Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Yuma Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a fresh aromatic-woody fragrance inspired by the serene balance of the Swiss Alps, where crisp mountain air, alpine greenery, and quiet natural landscapes create a feeling of clarity and inner harmony. Part of the Odus Collection, Yuma takes its name from Yuzu and Mint, reflecting the fragrance's central contrast between sparkling citrus freshness and cool Swiss mint. It opens with Swiss mint, peppermint, yuzu, and bergamot, creating a crisp, invigorating introduction that awakens the senses. At its heart, alpine breeze, edelweiss, ginger, and Cashmeran create an airy, subtly spicy and softly textured character, evoking fresh mountain landscapes and alpine flowers. As the fragrance settles, dry amber, vetiver, musk, and patchouli create a smooth, earthy and refined foundation that brings warmth and balance to the freshness of the opening. Clean, tranquil, and sophisticated, Yuma Extrait de Parfum is an elegant olfactory expression of balance, clarity, and connection with nature.

Fragrance Family: Citrus, Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Swiss Mint,Peppermint,Yuzu,Bergamot
Heart Notes: Alpine Breeze,Edelweiss,Ginger,Cashmeran
Base Notes: Dry Amber,Vetiver,Musk,Patchouli

title: Muskaria Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Muskaria Extrait de Parfum — Gritti is a sophisticated musky-woody fragrance that explores the sensual beauty of musk through a refined blend of luminous florals, creamy woods, soft spices, and warm amber accords. Presented in extrait concentration, this luxurious composition creates an intimate yet captivating aura, balancing airy freshness with smooth, enveloping warmth. It opens with a delicate combination of bergamot, pink pepper, and fresh citrus accords, delivering a sparkling introduction with subtle aromatic brightness. At its heart, elegant white florals, iris, and rose unfold with graceful richness, creating a soft and refined floral core enhanced by powdery nuances. As the fragrance settles, sensual musk intertwines with sandalwood, amber, vanilla, and soft woody accords, creating a creamy, velvety foundation that lingers beautifully on the skin. Elegant, intimate, and unmistakably sophisticated, Muskaria Extrait de Parfum is a luxurious expression of modern musk and effortless refinement.

Fragrance Family: Musk, Floral, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Citrus Accords
Heart Notes: White Florals, Iris, Rose
Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Woody Accords

title: Ame du Coeur Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The heart has long been revered as a potent symbol representing life, love, passion, and romance. Throughout history, Cupid's arrow piercing the heart has captured our imagination in art and literature. It is believed to be the seat of our deepest emotions and desires, the very essence of our being. Ame du Cœur embodies love, the essence of the heart, like a precious ruby, bold and explosive.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Pink Pepper, Ginger, Black Pepper, Cypress, Grapefruit, Cardamom, Mandarin Orange, Rose and elemi

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Pomarose and Cacao

Base notes: Akigalawood, Cedar, Tonka Bean, Vetiver and Vanillin

title: Dom Rosa Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Buveur de Vent is a scent that captures the power of a wild, majestic stallion. It is inspired by the scent of the stallion's leather saddle, leaving a fragrant trail wherever it goes. This scent exudes strength and grandeur, reflecting the beautiful adornment of the mighty beast. Allow Buveur de Vent to take you on a bold and wild journey.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Champagne, Pomelo and Pear

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Cloves and Olibanum

Base notes: Woody Notes, Cedar, Vetiver and Guaiac Wood

title: Dom Rosa Millesime Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Elevate your senses with Dom Rosa Millesime Eau de Parfum. This perfectly aged rose champagne has a romantic and intoxicating scent that is sure to make you fall in love. Created to celebrate its 10th anniversary, this Millésimé version is more concentrated, providing a more powerful and long-lasting romantic experience.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Champagne, Pomelo and Pear

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Cloves and Olibanum

Base notes: Woody Notes, Cedar, Vetiver and Guaiac Wood

title: Ambre Royal Parfum
body_html:
Created through expert synergy, Ambre Royal Parfum features a timeless blend of rose, jasmine, orange blossom, and bergamot, deepened by patchouli and cedar wood. A heartwarming touch of warm amber adds to the opulence and balance of this hypnotic perfume, making it a cherished and dependable scent - both strong and sensual, as well as warm and powerful.

Fragrance family: Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Notes, Orange Absolute and Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine Absolute, Osmanthus, Rose Oil, Amber, Orris Butter and Orchid Oil

Base notes: Cedar Wood, Ambroxan, Tonka, Patchouli and Musk

title: Champaca Parfum
body_html:
Champaca, a small pale orange flower originating from India, is considered sacred in the Indus Valley and related to the magnolia. Its absolute form emits a heavenly, creamy floral scent that exudes both elegance and intimacy. Through a combination of neroli and bamboo, and accented with notes of fragrant rice and green tea, this perfume boasts a distinguished aroma of extraordinary beauty.

Fragrance family: Floral, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Neroli, Pink Pepper and Bamboo

Middle notes: Champaca Absolute, Freesia Absolute and Basmati notes

Base notes: Myrrh, Green Tea and Musk

title: Damask Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the seductive allure of Damask Eau de Parfum. Let the abstract fragrance of damascene rose captivate your senses, while gourmande fruity notes of pear, lemon, blackcurrant, and pink berries add a touch of uniqueness. With a blend of mineral amber and musk, this perfume exudes sophistication and elegance. Experience the extraordinary with Damask Eau de Parfum.

Fragrance family: Rose, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Currant, Pear and Italian Lemon

Middle notes: Rose, Pink Pepper and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Mineral notes, Vetiver and Amber

title: Mango Skin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the beauty of South Africa with Vilhelm Parfumerie's Mango Skin Eau de Parfum. This fragrance captures the explosive freshness of blackberry and mango, while the addition of black pepper and wild orris add depth and complexity. Immerse yourself in the warm, fruity scents of the infinite sky.

Fragrance family: Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Blackberry and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Orris, Jasmine and Lotus

Base notes: Vanilla, Icing pink and Patchouli

title: Dear Polly Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the love and warmth of Dear Polly with every spritz. Top notes of apple and bergamot create a sense of familiarity, while musk and spices add complexity. A piquant and seductive scent perfect for lovers, near or far.

Fragrance family: Green, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Apple

Middle notes: Black Tea

Base notes: Black Amber, Musk and Oakmoss

title: Morning Chess Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Morning Chess Eau de Parfum captures the essence of the Swedish summer, evoking the memories of coastal Falkenberg where my grandfather and his two sons would spend hours playing chess in a summer cottage. The fragrance mimics the lush, green surroundings, illuminated by the bright, endless summer mornings. Its light, grassy scent hints at the sharpness of the distant winter air.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Leather and Galbanum

Base notes: Patchouli and Black Amber

title: Replica Sailing Day Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the invigorating freshness of a day sailing on the ocean with Replica ‘Sailing Day’ eau de toilette. Imagine the sea spray on your face and the warm sun on your back as you commune with the deep blue and set sail for distant lands. This fragrance captures the essence of a summer day on the water, with its refreshing Aquatic accord followed by aromatic Coriander and the woody saltiness of Red Seaweed and Ambergris. Dive into this scent and discover the endless possibilities of the ocean.

Fragrance family: Marine, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Notes, Aldehydes, Coriander and Red Pepper

Middle notes: Juniper, Iris, Amyl Salicylate and Rose

Base notes: Seaweed, Ambergris, Cedar and Amberwood

title: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the gentle touch of freshly laundered linen on a sunny morning. Start your day with the relaxing warmth of the sun on your skin while you indulge in a leisurely Sunday morning in crisp cotton sheets. Lazy Sunday Morning by Maison Margiela is a sophisticated floral scent that evokes images of peaceful mornings spent in bed. With no obligations or destinations, simply relax and unwind. This eau de toilette captures the comforting and pure essence of freshly washed linen on your skin, combining the clean floral notes of Lily of the Valley with the comforting embrace of White Musks.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Lily-of-the-Valley and Pear

Middle notes: Rose, Iris and Orange Blossom

Base notes: White Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

title: Amore Caffe Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the Italian coffee and cream tradition with Mancera Amore Caffè. This fragrance captures the indulgent blend of espresso and vanilla ice cream, with notes of black coffee, Amaretto, and speculoos. The comforting base of grey amber, vanilla pod, and brown sugar creates a lingering aroma. Embrace the irresistible allure of Amore Caffè for a unique sensory journey.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee and Amaretto

Middle notes: Vanilla and Ice cream

Base notes: Brown sugar, Vanilla and Ambergris

title: Roses Vanille Eau De Parfum
body_html:
This Mancera Roses Vanille Eau De Parfum boasts a blend of Calabrian lemon, Turkish delight, and rose, anchored by a base of cedarwood, vanilla, and white musk for a luxurious, floral scent. Presented in a sleek flask.

Fragrance family: Rose, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Lemon

Middle notes: Turkish Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Cedar

title: One More Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the irresistible allure of Amorino Black One More Love Eau de Parfum. This unisex fragrance is perfect for every occasion, with a fresh floral scent and warm musky base notes. A long-lasting and captivating aroma that blends sensuality and sophistication. Indulge in classic elegance and leave a lasting impression with Amorino Black One More Love.

Fragrance family: Fresh, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aniseed, Bergamot, Clove.

Middle notes: Iris, Jasmine.

Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Sandalwood.

title: Much Ado About The Duke Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Penhaligon's The Duke Eau de Parfum has a blend of floral and woody scents, complimented by a touch of pepper and rose. Encased in a glass bottle with a regal gold-tone bloodhound head, this fragrance exudes a perfect balance of femininity and masculinity.

Fragrance family: Woody, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Pepper

Middle notes: Gin

Base notes: Woody Notes, Leather

title: The Tragedy of Lord George Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Based on research and expertise, The Tragedy of Lord George Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated scent crafted from top notes of brandy and a subtle hint of tonka bean. Encased in a lavish glass bottle, embellished with a golden stag head, this fragrance showcases a timeless and refined blend.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Brandy, Amber

Middle notes: Tonka Bean

Base notes: Woody Notes

title: Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum contains luxurious oud and warm woods, resulting in a regal and addictive fragrance. Its Oriental scent family delves into the alluring yet mysterious world of Arabic tobacco and its precious resin and spicy, herbaceous dokha blend. This fragrance is a must-have for those seeking a mesmerizing and unique aroma.

Fragrance family: Oud, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey

Middle notes: Spicy Notes, Cinnamon and Coriander

Base notes: Tobacco, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Benzoin, Vanilla and Cedar

title: Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the aromatic world of Vanilla Fatale by Tom Ford, as this perfume combines warm vanilla with smoky undertones for a distinctive and familiar scent. A perfect choice for those who appreciate traditional fragrances with a contemporary edge, this blend of vanilla is both alluring and one-of-a-kind. Discover the alluring nature of vanilla in a whole new way with Vanilla Fatale.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coriander and Saffron

Middle notes: Coffee, Barley, Frangipani and Narcissus

Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Tobacco, Suede and Mahogany

title: Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum by Tom Ford evokes the essence of an English gentlemen’s club, featuring a blend of exotic spices, rich cocoa, sweet vanilla, and woody sap notes. This luxurious fragrance showcases a modern and lavish interpretation of masculinity.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tobacco Leaf and Spicy Notes

Middle notes: Vanilla, Cacao, Tonka Bean and Tobacco Blossom

Base notes: Dried Fruits and Woody Notes

title: Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the luxurious scent of Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum. With an incandescent black lacquer accord and Makassar ebony wood note, this fragrance exudes smoky opulence and leather tones. Underneath, a mysterious dark peony accord adds an irresistible touch. Experience modern perfumery at its finest.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ink, Vinyl, Black Pepper and Rum

Middle notes: Ebony Wood, elemi, Apricot and Peony

Base notes: Olibanum

title: Baccarat Rouge 540 Hair Mist
body_html: Delicately scent your hair and leave it feeling soft with Baccarat Rouge 540 Hair Mist. Its light, airy texture allows for easy application - simply spray onto your hair or brush for a freshening effect. This signature fragrance evokes a graphic and highly concentrated scent that combines amber, floral, and woody elements. The jasmine and saffron notes add a subtle mineral quality, while the cedar wood adds woody undertones. Perfect for any time of day.

title: Isola Blu Parfum
body_html:
Experience the essence of summer with a single spray of Isola Blu Parfum by Roja. Bright and citrusy notes blend with rich amber and spicy pink pepper, evoking memories of a Mediterranean day. These elements are complemented by crisp herbs and succulent fruits, lending a refreshing and natural character. The fragrance concludes with a base of velvety champaca, alluring jasmine, and creamy coconut for a luxurious finish.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Bergamot, Lemon, Thyme and Lavender;

Middle notes: Apple, Orange Blossom, Black Currant, Champaca, Coconut, Jasmine and Lily

Base notes: Birch, Cedar, Juniper Berries, Grass, Musk, Ambergris, Pink Pepper, Amber, Oakmoss, Mate, Patchouli, Leather, Tonka Bean, Anise, Labdanum, Vanilla and Orris Root

title: Maria Callas Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Maria Callas scent is a modern interpretation of the traditional chypre blend. Lively mandarin and lemon are followed by a touch of black pepper, awakening the senses. In the heart notes, a well-known rose and delicate neroli buds embody the feminine and graceful essence of the Divina, while the combination of Cedarwood, Georgywood and Akigalawood provide depth and allure to the scent. This woody fusion adds longevity to the fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, CItrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Mandarin, Black Pepper and Lemon

Middle notes: Black Currant, Rose, Neroli and Green Notes

Base notes: Akigala wood, Texas Cedar, Virginia Cedar and Georgy wood

title: Byzantium Saffron Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Drawing inspiration from the Muda della Tana e di Romania, Byzantium Saffron evokes the spirit of trade and travel along the ancient Greek coast. Traded raw materials such as musk, nutmeg, and benzoin resin from the storax plant were highly sought after by the Venetian market. Saffron, in particular, was crucial to this trade and is a key ingredient in this luxurious fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Black Pepper, Thyme and Lemon

Middle notes: White Suede, Cedar, White Lily, Lilac and Rhubarb

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Crystal Amber

title: Red Potion Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a journey that begins on North Africa's coastline, perfumed by the captivating scents of Orange Blossom and Rosemary. As you follow the Mediterranean Sea, you'll be transported to the enchanting city of Venice, where the alluring notes of Sandalwood and precious Immortelle await. This noble and refined fragrance is a harmonious and sophisticated blend that will captivate your senses.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Marigold, Immortelle and Orange

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Rosemary and Honeysuckle

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Moss

title: Vinegia 21 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious and captivating aromas of Vinegia 21 Eau de Parfum as it takes you on a journey through the most exquisite and rare raw materials. Discover the powerful and alluring blend of saffron, cinnamon, pralines, and fine woods, reminiscent of a forest at sunset. Embrace the enchanting scents of oud, cedarwood, akigalawood, and patchouli, evoking images of exotic and mysterious oriental nights. With creamy vanilla and sandalwood, as well as balsamic and smoky notes of myrrh and incense, this fragrance creates an intense and enveloping harmony that is as opulent and unforgettable as the city of Venice.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Praline, Saffron and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Akigalawood and Patchouli

Base notes: Vanilla, Incense, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Venetian Jade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the opulent and mysterious allure of Venice with Venetian Jade Eau de Parfum. A Harrods exclusive, this luxurious fragrance boasts fresh citrus and green notes that give way to a floral and spicy heart, enveloping you in the beauty of Venetian gardens. The warm and sensual base of amber, musk, and sandalwood make this perfect for special occasions.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Quince and Pecan

Middle notes: Suede, Vetiver, Carnation and Rose

Base notes: Bark, Amber, Kumbaru, Tonka Bean and Musk

title: Torino 22 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the invigorating TTorino 22 perfume from Xerjoff, created to celebrate the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin for the second consecutive year. Its captivating scent will thrill and invigorate the wearer, both on and off the court.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Eucalyptus, Saffron and Bergamot

Middle notes: Mate, Clary Sage and Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Dry Wood and Musk

title: 40 Knots Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the luxurious and exclusive 40 Knots Eau de Parfum from the Join the Club Collection. Inspired by the elegance and sophistication of a yachts club, this perfume boasts a refreshing and invigorating scent, perfect for the modern and fashionable individual. Elevate your senses with the ultimate fragrance experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Marine

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Notes

Middle notes: Salt, Sea water

Base notes: Woody Notes, Cedar

title: La Tosca Hair Mist
body_html: La Tosca Hair Mist is a luxurious hair fragrance designed to give your locks a delightful scent while also providing a touch of shine and softness. This mist typically blends floral, fruity, or warm notes, creating a sophisticated and lasting fragrance that stays with you throughout the day. It’s perfect for refreshing your hair in between washes or simply adding a layer of scent to your hairstyle. Some formulations may also include nourishing ingredients to help condition and protect the hair, leaving it feeling as good as it smells.

title: Bouquet Ideale Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted with a delightful blend of powdery cashmere, enchanting vanilla and cinnamon, and a touch of labdanum amber, Bouquet Ideale captures the essence of the Mediterranean Sea. It evokes a dreamy breeze, the smell of flowers, and the warmth of the sun on rocky shores. This eau de parfum offers a cozy yet flamboyant, and powdery aura, enveloping you in its irresistible charm.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Virginia Cedar and Papyrus

Base notes: Vanille, Coumarin, Tobacco Blossom, French labdanum and Musk

title: Side Effect Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the exquisite oriental blend of sweet and spicy notes with Initio's Side Effect Eau de Parfum Spray. Immerse yourself in the harmonious fusion of tobacco, vanilla, rum, and cinnamon, creating an irresistible fragrance that captivates and mesmerizes the senses.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla, Rum

Middle notes: cinnamon

Base notes: Tobacco

title: Crab Apple Blossom Perfume
body_html:
Experience the fresh and invigorating scent of Crab Apple Blossom Perfume by Clive Christian. This Crown Collection fragrance features signature notes of spring flower Apple Blossom and exotic Marine Bergamot, creating a citrusy and aquatically aromatic blend. The fruity floral heart is balanced by a base of sandalwood and driftwood, making it perfect for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Marine

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Notes, Bergamot and Apple Blossom

Middle notes: Mojito and Rhubarb

Base notes: Driftwood and Sandalwood

title: Philosykos Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Eau de Parfum from Diptyque, Philosykos, perfectly encapsulates the summer atmosphere of Greece. The scent showcases the delicate aroma of fig leaves, blended with the deep tones of white wood and bark, infused with a creamy fig flavor. The sleek glass bottle, characteristic to the brand, is enhanced by a one-of-a-kind graphic design label.

Fragrance family: Green, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig Leaf and Fig

Middle notes: Green Notes and Coconut

Base notes: Fig Tree, Woody Notes and Cedar

title: Santal Greenery Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the unexpected and unconventional with Santal Greenery Eau de Parfum. This expertly balanced fragrance combines grounded sandalwood with lively fig, creating a blend of the everlasting and the fleeting. Designed for longevity, the stylish spliced perfume bottle can be refilled for endless enjoyment.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Fig and Violet Leaf

Base notes: Sandalwood and White Musk

title: Tabac Blanc Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Explore a new facet of rich, raw material with Tabac Blanc, the latest opus from Jean Jacques' Les Beaux Tabacs collection. This fragrance combines the fresh, herbaceous scent of Brazilian mate with the woodiness of cinnamon and the intensity of West African cocoa absolute. Supported by bergamot and white tea, this scent is a true olfactory illusion, balancing the freshness of mate with the intensity of cocoa. The elegant iris and comforting sensuality of violet add a powdery touch to this fragrance. Experience the opulence of Tabac Noir and the greedy intensity of Tabac Exquis with Tabac Blanc.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mate, White Tea and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris and Jasmine

Base notes: Cacao Pod, Vanilla and Cinnamon

title: Bois d'Encens Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the most personal fragrance of Mr. Armani with Bois d'Encens Eau de Parfum. Inspired by his childhood memories of an Italian church, this scent evokes a lingering mysticism with smoky incense and a profound, solemn universe. Experience the cool, damp stones and let this fragrance transport you to a place of serenity and nostalgia.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vetiver

Middle notes: Cedar

Base notes: Labdanum, Spices

title: Rouge Malachite Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious aroma of Rouge Malachite, part of the Armani/Privé fragrance line. Envision a fiery red gem, representing the sensual and lavish tuberose flower, hidden beneath the frigid landscapes of Russia. Both Rouge Malachite and Vert Malachite pay homage to the country that has served as a source of inspiration and emotion for Giorgio Armani. This fragrance embodies the dichotomy of Russia's enigmatic allure, captivating with its alluring and potent essence. A land of contrasts and irresistible allure, where desire and fervor course through the icy exterior.

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose, Pink Pepper and Clary Sage

Middle notes: Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang, Benzoin, Cashmeran and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Tuberose and Amber

title: Carmina Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in Carmina Eau de Parfum, Henry Creed's delicate potion of femininity. With top notes of black cherry, pink pepper, and saffron, this scent evolves into a bittersweet fusion of violets and rose wink, before settling into a base of woody, musky notes. Experience the luxurious blend of cherry and florals.

Fragrance family: Rose, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Cherry, Saffron and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: May Rose, Peony, Violet and Cashmere Wood

Base notes: Musk, Ambroxan, Myrhh and Frankincense

title: This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.5 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
If you enjoy the Ying of 1.4, you will love the Yang of This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.5 from Histoires de Parfum's collection. This fresh scent contains mineral accords and offers endless versatility whether used alone or to complement other perfumes. With a unique character encompassing citrus, mineral, and floral scents, 1.5 is the perfect everyday perfume.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Ozonic notes and Citruses

Middle notes: Floral Notes

Base notes: Musk, Ambroxan and Mineral notes

title: Velvet Haze Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Haze evokes the daze state attained in artificial paradises. The opulence of the scent embarks us in a psychedelic whirlpool. Along this exhilarating path, the sweetness of coconut water soon gives way to the feverish power of patchouli leaves. An experience of all senses that the velvety cacao and the wild musk enrich with their earthy envelope.

Fragrance family: Musk, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut, Hibiscus and Bergamot

Middle notes: Patchouli, Tuberose and Osmanthus

Base notes: Patchouli, Musk, Cacao Pod, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Cashmeran

title: 37 rue de Bellechasse Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
37 rue de Bellechasse is where the old Abbey of Penthemont is located, which now serves as the headquarters for SAINT LAURENT. The scent of this former Abbey is captured in the fragrance, paying tribute to the paradoxical atmosphere of the place - both sacred and sacrilegious. Notes of elemi and oud wood evoke the raw atmosphere of the fashion brand.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orris Root, Incense

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud)

Base notes: Benzoin, Musk

title: Trench Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
The elegant TRENCH fragrance is presented in a sleek, square bottle made of sheer glass, showcasing its sophistication. Inspired by Monsieur Saint Laurent's tuxedo fabric, the ornate jewel cap features a "grain de poudre" texture. TRENCH eau de parfum is a refreshing blend of bright citruses and refined iris, accented by a bold leather note. Experience the captivating and instinctive sensuality of this fragrance, with a sharp and dignified profile. Iris - Leather Florals

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tangerine, Bergamot and Fig

Middle notes: Iris and Neroli

Base notes: Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Cedar

title: The Eyes of the Tiger Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Eyes of the Tiger Eau de Parfum is inspired by the belief that in China, amber represents the "soul of the tiger" as it transforms from earth to stone. This fragrance takes you on a symbolic journey into the heart of the tiger. Notes of Benzoin and Tonka create a deep and powerful aroma, evoking the intensity of a tiger's gaze, while woody and sweet Ciste resin adds a balancing touch, mirroring the animal's dynamic and complex nature.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Amber

Middle notes: Vanilla

Base notes: Labdanum

title: 24 Old Bond Street Eau de Cologne
body_html:
Drawing inspiration from the inaugural Atkinsons scent crafted two centuries ago, 24 Old Bond Street Eau de Cologne is a rich and spicy blend of juniper, rose, and Earl Grey tea. Underlying these quintessentially British aromas is a delicate touch of smoky, oak-aged whiskey, resulting in a warm yet unexpectedly crisp fragrance that has stood the test of time as a timeless symbol. With its distinctive character, this refined contemporary masterpiece is ideal for individuals who honor tradition while embracing a bold and dynamic modern existence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper and Cardamom

Middle notes: Whiskey and Rose

Base notes: Black Tea, Cedar, Ambergris and Musk

title: Mint & Tonic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Designed to embody the essence of summertime, Atkinsons Mint & Tonic eau de parfum enchants the senses with a blend of refreshing mint, floral and spicy ginger notes, and a musky, woody undertone. Whether worn daily or on sunny afternoons, this invigorating and uplifting scent captures the charm of an English garden, transporting you to a tranquil oasis with just one spritz.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Mint and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Ginger, Mandarin Orange and Geranium

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar and Musk

title: Gold Fair In Mayfair Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gold Fair In Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a carefully crafted fragrance that captures the essence of London's most exclusive neighborhood. The bold scents of absinthe and nutmeg blend seamlessly with delicate notes of iris, sage, and cocoa beans, culminating in a seductive combination of Ambrox, Vetiver, and incense. Presented in a luxurious gold bottle, this scent exudes glamour and understated elegance.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Absinthe and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Cacao, Sage and Iris

Base notes: Ambroxan, Styrax and Vetiver

title: Caravanserail Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As an expert in the product and industry, Caravanserail Intense Eau de Parfum acts as a gateway connecting multiple regions. Serving as a rest stop for travelers on both the coffee and spice routes, this historic location in the Levant region is known for its warm hospitality and traditional coffee. Infused with the fresh and fruity flavors of cardamom seeds, this addictive blend also features hints of cinnamon, cloves, and a heart of patchouli and sandalwood. As a final touch, a powerful sand breeze carries notes of amber, everlasting flower, vanilla, and tonka bean. Experience the adventure of the sands at Caravanserail Intense.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee, Plum and Raspberry

Middle notes: Cardamom, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Clove and Cinnamon

Base notes: Immortelle, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Amber

title: Bois Belize Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the alluring and exotic scent of Bois Bélize Intense Eau de Parfum. Notes of smoked tea, precious woods, citrus bergamot, mate leaves, rose, cardamon, clove, and oak moss blend together to create a spicy and bittersweet fragrance. Let this elegant and original scent transport you to the distant lands of the Americas.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Ambrette and Osmanthus

Middle notes: Rose, Cloves and Cardamom

Base notes: Mate, Guaiac Wood, Oakmoss, Vetiver, Patchouli and Musk

title: Dirty Rice Eau de Parfum
body_html:
From the perspective of a product expert, Dirty Rice Eau de Parfum is a refined seduction with a touch of playfulness. The opening notes of bergamot and almond create a vibrant and attention-grabbing blend, while the heart of the fragrance features a dominant note of basmati rice that adds a warm, starchy sweetness. The addition of peony and milk provides a delicate floral sweetness and a creamy touch of innocence. The base notes of smoky sandalwood and vetiver offer a classic, woody foundation, while the animalic whisper of musk adds depth and raw sensuality. Finally, Cetalox adds a velvety, skin-like warmth that ensures a lingering and addictive trail.

Fragrance family: Woody, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Almond and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rice Basmati, Milk and Peony

Base notes: Sandalwood, Musk, Cedar, Cetalox and Vetiver

title: Sugar Addict Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sugar Addict begins with a dazzling explosion of pure sugar, a clear rush that awakens the senses. Notes of rich cocoa, warm cinnamon, and creamy vanilla blend together, creating a complex sweetness that remains perfectly balanced. A generous splash of rum adds a deep, boozy depth, while cashmere wood creates a luxurious and soft base. Subtle hints of coffee and labdanum provide a touch of sophisticated bitterness, reminding us that true indulgence is all about harmony. Sugar Addict is perfect for the playful gourmet lover, who believes that a hint of sweetness can elevate any experience. Wear it alone for a delicious skin scent, or layer it with your boldest and most daring perfumes to create a signature that is both intoxicating and uniquely yours.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sugar, Cinnamon Essence

Middle notes: Cocoa Absolute, Coffee Extract

Base notes: Tonka Beans, Vanilla Absolute, Rum Extract, Labdanum Absolute, Cashmere Wood

title: MMW Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the creative energy of Givenchy with MMW Eau de Parfum. Created by Matthew M. Williams, this woody fragrance is both daring and sophisticated. The perfect blend of modern and chic, this scent is a must-have for those in the know. Part of the La Collection Particulière, this fragrance adds a touch of luxury to any outfit.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Guatemalan Cardamom

Middle notes: Palo Santo

Base notes: Ambroxan, Atlas Cedar, Virginia Cedar, Iso E Super and Haitian Vetiver

title: Velvet Amber Sun Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Amber Sun by Dolce&Gabbana beautifully captures the luminosity of golden mosaics, glimmering in sunlight as they emerge from shadows. The amber accord is an opulent blend of luxurious, golden elements, making it a beloved addition to the Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Collection. Immerse yourself in the designers' olfactory reminiscences and love for Italy through the intimate journey offered by this cherished fragrance.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanilla, Labdanum, Ylang-Ylang and Bergamot

Middle notes: Smoke, Sandalwood, Pepper and Coriander

Base notes: Amberwood, Myrrh, Benzoin, Olibanum, Tonka Bean, Opoponax, Agarwood (Oud), Cinnamon and Patchouli

title: Velvet Infusion Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Infusion Eau de Parfum by Dolce&Gabbana is a contemporary take on the legendary tea. Expertly crafted by Alex Lee, this woody and citrusy scent begins with lively Italian Mandarin and Bergamot and a touch of Pink Pepper. The earthy Black Tea heart gives way to a soothing base of Cedarwood and Mate.

body_html:
Discover Dear Karma, the fifth release in the Crazy collection by combining stunning illustrations and a captivating fragrance. Inspired by the controversial ingredient absinthe, known for its aromatic, woody, sweet, and bitter character, this scent will bring vital energy and mysticism to your daily routine

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Black Currant and Bergamot

Middle notes: Thyme, Cedar and Cardamom

Base notes: Patchouli, Musk and Ambergris

body_html:
Introducing Dacha, a new Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men by Alfred Ritchy. Experience a blend of fruity and citrus notes, balanced with warm Oriental and Amber scents. This long-lasting perfume, launched in 2022, features Dry Wood, Vanilla, Ambergris, and White Musk to create a unique and enticing aroma.

title: Tero Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
As an expert in the industry, Nishane's Tero Extrait de Parfum is a unisex scent that pays homage to Mother Earth. Its captivating fragrance is a blend of syrupy, spicy, and earthy notes, evoking a sense of enchantment and wonder. The fragrance is composed of salted caramel and zingy pepper, along with a heart of rich patchouli and cinnamon bark, and finished with leather-scented vetiver, sweet amber, and woody oak.

The Hedonist by EX NIHILO is a recent addition to the Iconoclaste range that captures a luxurious and technological expedition through the untamed, with no set end goal. The trademark scents of Cedar and Vetiver intertwine with Akigalawood, a novel ingredient extracted from Bio Science, resulting in a bold and invigorating fragrance.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Ginger

Middle notes: Akigalawood and Cedar

Introducing the 10 Years Limited Edition The Hedonist Eau de Parfum from Ex Nihilo. Featuring sustainable ingredients such as akigalawood and energizing notes of ginger extract, grapefruit, and cardamom, this ultra-limited collector's bottle celebrates the brand's 10th anniversary. A fresh and invigorating fragrance with deep notes of cedar wood and vetiver.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Ginger

Middle notes: Cedarwood, Akigalawood

body_html:
Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum elevates femininity with a deep and intense expression, enhanced by a hypnotic heart of floral notes and elevated with the finest ingredients of haute perfumery. Expertly crafted by the perfumer, this luxurious fragrance captivates with its alluring essence and exudes elegance

Top notes: Litchi, Osmanthus and Bergamot

Middle notes: Peony, Orange Blossom, Freesia and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Moss

title: Outcast Blue Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the ultimate thrill with Outcast Blue Extrait de Parfum. Designed by industry expert Jordi Fernández, this fragrance exalts the flames of outcast blue and disobeys all norms. With the finest raw materials, its rebellious sillage is sure to leave a lasting impression. Embrace your inner rebel and make a statement with Outcast Blue

Base notes: Tobacco, Agarwood (Oud), Vetiver, Sandalwood and Moss

title: Marfa Hair Perfume
body_html: Experience a new level of luxury with Marfa Hair Perfume, inspired by the renowned Marfa eau de parfum. This innovative product features an alcohol-free formula that leaves your hair delicately scented with the perfect blend of Orange blossom absolute, Tuberose absolute, and White musk. With notes of Oil of mandarin, Agave accord, oil of Ylang Ylang, oil of Sandalwood, oil of Cedar, and Vanilla seed, this hair perfume is the ideal choice for any season.

title: Overture Woman Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Overture Woman is a tribute to the contemporary woman, confident, refined, and bursting with intrigue, portraying the tale of a singular moment where all else fades away. Developed by Expert Perfumer Annick Menardo, this heavenly scent is a harmonious blend of some of the most exceptional and highly coveted elements in the world, capturing the profound feeling of a mesmerizing operatic experience.

title: Honour Woman Eau de Parfum
body_html:
An elegant white floral scent that draws inspiration from the poignant tale of Madame Butterfly. This fragrance pays homage to the values of authenticity and aestheticism, reflecting upon her poetic romance and heartache that resonate throughout time

Fragrance family: Floral,

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Amber, Opoponax, Leather, Frankincense

title: Opus XIII Silver Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Through its rich composition and bold character, Opus XIII Silver Oud Eau de Parfum captures the essence of memorable life experiences and the resilience of the human spirit. Drawing inspiration from Stendhal's iconic novel, The Red and the Black, and its driven main character, Julien Sorel, this fragrance pays homage to the House's storytelling legacy. Crafted by perfumer Cecile Zorakian, this woody and amber perfume highlights the rare Oud in its most magnificent form

Base notes: Ambrarome, Birch, Guaiac Wood, Castoreum

body_html:
Opus V Woods Symphony Eau de Parfum evokes a floral and woody scent, drawing inspiration from both traditional and contemporary channels for spreading knowledge.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orris, Rhum

title: Opus XIV Royal Tobacco Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Opus XIV Royal Tobacco Eau de Parfum offers a sensory experience that combines the fragrant journey of Royal Frankincense from Oman to Cuba with the regal scent of Tobacco. Expertly interpreted by renowned perfumer Cecile Zarokian, this unique blend of Frankincense and Tobacco creates a novel and rich aroma.

Amouage is honoured to have won the following prestigious awards for Opus XIV - Royal Tobacco:
- The Fragrance Foundation (USA): Indie Fragrance of the Year award
- EXIPA (Mexico): Fragrance of the Year 2022 Excellence Award
- ScentXplore (USA): Fragrance of the Year Award
- Belgian Beauty Awards: Best Niche Perfume
- Icon Awards (Spain): Beyond Gender Category, Unisex, Reinvented, Winner
