Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Frankincense, Elemi, Cardamom, Anise, Basil, Bergamot

Middle notes: Tobacco, Liqorice, Lavender, Prunol, Fenugreek, Clove, Orange Blossom, Osmanthus, Rose

Base notes: Frankincense, Balsam, Benzoin, Labdanum, Myrhh, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Birch, Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, Oud, Musk

title: Opus XV King Blue Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the unexpected with Opus XV King Blue Eau de Parfum, where the real and unreal collide, the impossible and mundane clash, and life reveals its surrealistic nature. This dreamlike fragrance boasts a perfect balance of fire and nightshade, highlighted by the juicy Mandarin, grandiose Amber, and somber Oud. Indulge in this oneiric wood supreme and embrace the unpredictable.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Frankincense, Amber

Base notes: Sandalwood, Oakwood, Patchouli, Oud Silver, Leather

title: Jubilation 40 Man Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience true sophistication with Jubilation 40 Man Extrait de Parfum. This premium scent blends the beauty of Eastern and Western cultures, embodying the nobility of true masculinity. Aged patiently for 10 weeks at 40% concentration, the fragrance becomes even more intricate and versatile, perfectly encapsulating the essence of elegance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blackberry, Blackcurrant, Rosemary, Labdanum, Orange, Davana.

Middle notes: Scotch Broom, Frankincense, Cinnamon, Clove, Bay St Thomas, Rose, Celery Seeds.

Base notes: Patchouli, Cistus, Opoponax, Myrrh, Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood, Musks, Moss, Ambergris, Oud.

title: Material Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Material Eau de Parfum embodies a paradox, blending material and immaterial elements. By transcending appearances, it teaches us to appreciate the unseen aspects that truly matter. This sensation is reminiscent of standing in a vibrant grove, being enveloped by a plethora of textures and shades from the wood, leaves, and bark harmoniously intertwined.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Elemi, Patchouli

Middle notes: Benzoin, Vanilla Madagascar

Base notes: Guaiacwood, Patchouli, Osmanthus, Oud, Frankincense, Labdanum, Tonka Bean

title: Ajyal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enduring spirit of Dubai with Ajyal Eau de Parfum. This luxurious scent embodies generations of hope, vitality, and happiness. The initial burst of bergamot and plum gives way to a heart of delicate cherry blossoms and soothing lavender, before settling into a base of cedarwood and vanilla. Paying homage to the iconic Ghaf tree, it represents resilience and continuity, transporting you to the golden sands where past, present, and future merge in a captivating blend of fruit, floral, and oriental aromas.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Plum, Green Note, Petrichor, Marine Note, Pear, Mint, Rhubarb, Black Pepper, Grapefruit, Lime, Lemon, Candied Apple

Middle notes: Cherry Blossoms, Osmanthus, Carnation, Mimosa, Ylang, Jasmine Sambac, Heliotrope, Magnolia, Freesia, Lavender, Helichrisum, Jasmine, Lily Of The Valley, Orchid, Indian Sandalwood, Amberwood, Rose Loukoum

Base notes: Cedarwood, White Musk, Musk, Patchouli, Tonka, Vanilla, Intense Amber, Brown Sugar

title: Auster Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Auster, the deity of the south winds, represents the strong and tempestuous Sirocco winds that sweep from Africa to southern Europe. The aroma of Mediterranean lemon groves and fragrant geraniums are complemented by hints of star anise and cloves, while the scent transforms into a stormy sky with a grounding base of patchouli, ambergris and cedar. This captivating fragrance is a balance of light and dark, evoking a journey of the senses.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Star Anise and Lemon

Middle notes: Geranium and Cloves

Base notes: Patchouli, Ambergris and Cedar

title: Caspian Cherry Perfum
body_html:
Electimuss Caspian Cherry is a new fragrance for both women and men, released in 2024. This rich and seductive scent is inspired by the irresistible allure of cherries, enveloped in a sophisticated gourmand accord. Starting with a playful hint of almond liqueur and the juicy essence of black cherries, it is perfectly balanced by the deep, bittersweet taste of dark chocolate. As the scent evolves, a warm touch of spiced honey appears, along with the delicate aroma of coconut, adding layers of complexity. The intensity of the gourmand notes is amplified by a bold burst of coffee, softened by the gentle warmth of vetiver. A touch of powdery tonka bean ensures that the cherry note remains prominent, while creamy sandalwood and smooth white chocolate create an irresistible and delicious dry down.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Cherry, Amaretto and Dark Chocolate

Middle notes: Coconut, Coffee, Cinnamon, Honey and Vetiver

Base notes: White Chocolate, Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Sandalwood

title: Delina Hair Perfume
body_html: The Delina Hair Perfume is a gentle mist that can be sprayed directly onto the hair or brushed onto it. Its captivating floral aroma will linger in your thoughts even after it has been applied. The fragrance is centered around the romantic scent of rose, with a modern twist that adds a touch of femininity. The base note of cashmere wood essence gives the hair perfume a luxurious and sensuous finish. It pairs perfectly with the Delina eau de parfum.

title: Teint de Neige Hair Mist
body_html: The Teint de Neige Hair Mist adds a fragrant aura to your hair, diffusing a magical veil for a dreamy night. With its unmistakable scent of precious flowers and powdery notes, this hair mist is gentle and seductive, like a charming stardust, providing an enchanting and protective beauty.

title: Iperborea Eau De Toilette
body_html:
In the endless spring, the crisp northern breeze transports the luminous scent of blooming petals hidden in the snow and beneath the dew of the morning, seeking the initial beam of sunshine.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lily-of-the-Valley, Green Notes, Cyclamen, Citruses, Flowers, Peach, Mandarin Orange and Orange

Middle notes: Lily-of-the-Valley, Magnolia, White Flowers and Mimosa

Base notes: Musk, White Flowers, Jasmine, African Orange Flower and Woodsy Notes

body_html:
Baraonda Extrait de Parfum from the Nasomatto line is a mystifying addition, with subtle hints attached. Meaning chaos or uproar in Italian, the fragrance is surprisingly delicate and almost translucent. The nose behind this captivating scent promises an intense, unrefined experience... but what we experience is both soothing and sophisticated.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey

Middle notes: Woody Notes, Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Base notes: Rose, Ambroxan, Musk

title: Cuoium Parfum
body_html:
Cuoium Parfum draws inspiration from Vincenzo’s single pair of custom leather shoes, representing a tribute to the traditional use and appreciation of leather. This scent embodies a modern society that stays connected to its pagan roots, upholding its origins and embracing the unknown. It honors the strength and determination required to move forward, to restore rather than replace, and to preserve heritage.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Animal notes and Woody Notes

Middle notes: Violet

Base notes: Leather, Incense, Cade oil, Labdanum, Cedar, Patchouli and Vanilla

title: Seminalis Parfum
body_html:
Discover the power of Seminalis, a unique aromatic aldehyde found in our fragrance. With its ability to help sperm locate the ovum, this ingredient is a testament to the undeniable olfactory attraction of human life. Experience the initiation of life through the sense of smell

Fragrance family: Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: lactone

Middle notes: carnation, lily of the valley, raspberry

Base notes: cedar, leather, patchouli, sandalwood, sugar, vanilla

Viride, derived from Latin with the meaning of "green", exudes a powerful yet refreshing scent profile. Embracing the combination of strong, crisp wood notes, this fragrance delivers a unique and invigorating experience

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wormwood, Artemisia and Lavender

Middle notes: Jasmine

Base notes: Fir, Juniper, Tobacco, Cedar and Musk

Base notes: Agarwood, Leather, Musk, Vanilla, Heliotrope and Cedar

Sedley Eau de Parfum offers a refreshing, invigorating experience with its blend of watery and airy scents that take you on a true olfactory journey. Featuring bergamot, spearmint, watery accord, geranium bourbon, lavender, and bright notes, this classic yet modern fragrance embodies a perfect balance between tradition and contemporary style, with a woody signature in the background.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Tonic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Spearmint, Watery accord

Middle notes: Geranium, Lavender, Solar note

Base notes: Sandalwood, Incense, White Musk, Cedarwood

title: Valhalla Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the perfect balance of emotions with Valhalla's exotic citrus top notes of Mandarin and rich Mango along with refreshing Bergamot. The addition of spicy and woody Cedarwood, soft and sensual cashmere, and intoxicating Jasmine creates a truly harmonious and elegant fragrance.

Olfactive pyramid

Middle notes: Cedarwood, Cashmere, Jasmine from Egypt.

As an expert in the beauty industry, Adam & Eve's Dress Extrait de Parfum perfectly captures the complex scent of the fig tree - from its ripe, succulent fruits to the crisp aroma of its leaves and the creamy sweetness of its sap. With a blend of green and aromatic notes, complemented by the sensual and exotic touches of tuberose and jasmine, this fragrance invites you to embrace the simple pleasures that make life truly beautiful.

Prodigy Extrait de Parfum is a sophisticated infusion of unexpected elements and refined nuances, a true testament to innovation. With its comforting notes of warm café au lait, this scent is elevated by exotic florals and aromatic spices such as fresh Longoza Flower, Rose Absolute, Cinnamon, and Bergamot. The result is a modern blend of sweet, bitter, and spicy tones that satisfy our cravings for comfort while indulging our desire for the unexpected.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Bergamot and Cardamom

Middle notes: Longoza and Patchouli

Base notes: Vanilla, Blonde Woods and Sandalwood

title: Gambit Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Explore the dynamic and daring scent of Gambit, designed for the modern player. This fragrance exudes virile energy and a commanding presence, inspiring confidence and seeking victory. With a fiery blend of spices and subtle hints of fruit, layered over a soothing warmth, this scent is sure to leave a lasting impression. The scent lingers with bursts of fresh geranium before settling into the warm and inviting base notes of sandalwood and amber.

Fragrance family: Woody, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Petitgrain, Lavender, Clove

Middle notes: Cardamom, Geranium Madagascar, Mimosa Abs

Base notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood Drêches, Ambrostar

body_html:
Nº4 Candy Eau de Parfum exudes a charming playfulness on a refined stage. Drawing inspiration from the sweet notes of Nº4 Après l’Amour, Candy - with its top notes of red fruits and cherry, middle notes of tiare flower and raspberry blossom, and base of caramel, candy floss, and vanilla - captures the essence of sugary temptation in a more sophisticated way. Like its predecessor, Candy boasts long-lasting projection, inviting you to embrace your playful side while turning heads with its irresistible scent.

Top notes: Red Fruits and Cherry

title: Heroine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover your inner strength and grace with Heroine Eau de Parfum. This dynamic blend of dewberry, boudoir flowers, and vanillic musks creates a plateau of flowers with subtle hints of citrus and exotic fruits. Experience the sophisticated poise of this fragrance, scented with notes of jasmine, rose, and powdery heliotrope.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet, Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Orris and Vetiver

body_html:
Transport yourself to 17th-century Holland with The Black Tulip, Alexandre Dumas' timeless story of passion and ambition. Witness Cornelius' quest to cultivate the elusive black tulip and his potential release from imprisonment to wed the beautiful Rosa. Just like Atkinsons Tulipe Noire, this complex fragrance features notes of zesty coriander, invigorating bergamot, delicate jasmine, and a rich, sensual base of creamy sandalwood and warm cedar.

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Cedar and Sandalwood

title: Blanche Absolu de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the ultimate intensity with Blanche Absolu de Parfum. Dive deeper into a comforting embrace with its amplified signature scent of aldehydes, musk, floral hearts, black pepper, and amber wood notes. Find the perfect balance between purity and strength, creating a sanctuary of love and intimacy with each spritz.

title: Portrait of a Lady 15th Anniversary Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the unique blend of oriental and chypre notes with Portrait Of A Lady Eau de Parfum. Inspired by Henry James's novel from 1881, this modern and elegant fragrance features a dominant patchouli heart, complemented by dark and mystical rose scents. Experience the intense and intriguing journey of freedom represented by the novel's heroine, Isabel Archer.

title: French Lover Eau de Parfum
body_html:
French Lover Eau de Parfum, created by Pierre Bourdon, embodies the essence of male sensuality with the use of high-quality raw materials. Redefining traditional notions of masculinity in fragrance, this scent embraces a sophisticated virility that is both subtle and inviting. The notes of angelica, enhanced by capsicum and galbanum, are balanced by the elegance of iris, cedar, and vetiver. A touch of incense, complemented by musk and patchouli, adds a primal sensuality to this enticing scent.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Galbanum, Pepper, Juniper, Violet Leaf and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Angelica, Cedar, Incense and Orris

Base notes: Vetiver, Oakmoss, White Musk and Amber

title: Iris Poudre Eau de Parfum
body_html:
IRIS POUDRE, created by fragrance expert Pierre Bourdon, is a modern and contrasting tribute to the timeless femininity of aldehydic floral fragrances from the 20th century. With a blend of powdery iris, creamy vanilla of tonka bean, and soft white musk, this scent embodies seduction and sophistication. Aldehydes add a clean and sparkling touch to the delicate floral heart, while rose and violet provide cosmetic accents and hints of eternal femininity.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang, Carnation, Palisander Rosewood, Bergamot, Aldehydes, Orange, Grapefruit and Juniper

Middle notes: Violet, Lily, Jasmine, Rose, Magnolia, Orris, Peach, Leather and Cyclamen

Base notes: Iris, Musk, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Vanilla, Amber, ebony tree, Cedar and Tonka

title: Silky Woods Elixir Parfum
body_html:
Silky Woods Elixir is a sophisticated blend of Australian agarwood, fig, saffron, orris, and balsam. This luxurious and sensual perfume is meticulously crafted to reveal the intricate heart and verdant foliage of agarwood. Perfect for connoisseurs, it offers a rich and intense woody and gourmand experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Saffron,Orris, Guaiac Wood

Middle notes: Vanilla, Oud Assafi

Base notes: Agarwood Tropical Australia

title: Angels' Share Paradis Parfum
body_html:
Angels' Share Paradis by Kilian is a bold Extrait de Parfum, drawing inspiration from the world's most exquisite oak-barrel cognac. This fragrance encapsulates Maison's unparalleled expertise and the legacy of Kilian Hennessy, delivering a daring and powerful essence. The scent showcases alluring raspberry liquor, luxurious Bulgarian Rose Oil Orpur, combined with a lavish Praline Accord and the warm notes of Venezuelan Tonka Bean Absolut. It leaves behind an enchanting, seductive trail.

Fragrance family: Floral, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cognac, Raspberry and Liquor

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Bulgarian Rose and Oakmoss

Base notes: Praline, Oak and Sandalwood

title: Musician Eau de Parfum
body_html:
From the perspective of a product expert, Musician Eau de Parfum captures the unique scent of a violin, evoking the passion and dedication that comes with mastering such a complex instrument. The aromatic notes of wood and the sensation of its strings against your neck transport you into a world of artistic expression. Let Musician Eau de Parfum ignite your love for music and inspire your journey towards mastery.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Yuzu

Middle notes: Orange Blossom

Base notes: Cedar, Amyris, Amber

title: Singer Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Before releasing the silence, I briefly close my eyes and let the initial chords resound in my mind. My body transforms into an instrument, giving voice to my senses. Singing becomes a necessary expression, as essential as breathing. In turn, we breathe to sing and sing to live.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang

Middle notes: Honey

Base notes: Osmanthus

title: Tattoo Artist Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The human canvas is a platform for self-expression - a place where art and emotion intertwine to create something beautifully raw. It's a brave display of creativity, sensuality, and beauty, with ink and gun as tools to dress the nakedness and ignite the soul. Join the tribe and embrace the pain as it transforms into a masterpiece.

Fragrance family: Amber, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender

Middle notes: Atlas Cedar, Saffron

Base notes: Musk, Cardamom

title: Oud Tuareg Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
OUD TUAREG Extrait de Parfum is a tribute to the timeless art of living in the desert, paying homage to the Tuareg culture through its emblematic indigo turban. This elixir, infused with the memories of ancient caravans and boundless wealth, has an enigmatic oasis at its heart. The luxurious scent of Oud is combined with modern rose, warm sandalwood, and a hint of citrusy mandarin and spicy ginger. Radiating pride and allure, OUD TUAREG embodies the enduring spirit and alluring mystique of the Sahara, a treasured legacy of kings and the unyielding spirit of the Tuareg people.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin and Ginger

Middle notes: Damask Rose and Myrrh

Base notes: Oud and Sandalwood

title: Sacred Flame Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the bold and powerful scent of Argos Sacred Flame. Inspired by the fire of Prometheus, this daring fragrance features zesty citrus notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and tangerine, balanced with warm spices like ginger, pepper, and clove. The floral heart adds a touch of elegance, while the intense base of amber, sandalwood, and vanilla brings a lasting warmth. Unleash your inner strength with Sacred Flame Eau de Parfum.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach, Ginger, Tangerine, Grapefruit, Bergamot, Clove and Pepper

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Rose, Patchouli, Tuberose, Bark, Jasmine, Violet and Orris

Base notes: Amber, Benzoin, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Opoponax, Cashmeran and Vetiver

title: Danae Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Danaë Eau de Parfum is a sensual and divine fragrance inspired by the iconic oil painting by Gustav Klimt. In this work of Symbolism, Danaë is depicted as the quintessential symbol of divine love and transcendence. It is said that while imprisoned by her father in a tower, she was visited by Zeus in the form of golden rain. This legend is captured in the fragrance's notes of Bright Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Spicy Pink Peppercorn, Deep Gaiac, Cedar, Cashmere Wood, Sweet and Sticky Cistus, Spicy Patchouli, Mysore Sandalwood, and Intoxicating Musk. Experience the captivating essence of Danaë.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Sicilian Lemon

Middle notes: Cashmere Wood, Guaiac Wood, Cedar and Pink Pepper

Base notes: Mysore Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk and Cistus Incanus

title: Patchouli Paris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Patchouli Paris by Guerlain offers a sophisticated and woody take on patchouli, capturing the allure of romantic Parisian evenings. This captivating fragrance begins with lively aldehydes, leading into a heart of powdery and earthy iris, and finishes with a rich, warm blend of patchouli, vanilla, ambergris, and musks.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes

Middle notes: Iris

Base notes: Patchouli, Ambergris and Vanilla

title: Musc Outreblanc Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted by the Guerlain Perfumer, Musc Outreblanc Eau de Parfum features a pristine musk accord elevated by effervescent neroli notes. With a sublime fragrance that radiates with white light, this fragrance is a masterful combination of orange blossom absolute, Bulgarian rose, and musks, enhanced by ambrette and iris Pallida butter, all quintessential elements of the Guerlain brand.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Musk, Neroli and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Middle notes: Iris, Orange Blossom and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Milk, Sandalwood and White Amber

title: Giardinodiercole Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The Giardinodiercole Extrait de Parfum, named after the mythical Vesuvian city's symbolic corner - The Garden of Hercules, is a top fragrance choice from Agatho Parfum's new Pompei Collection. This expertly crafted scent blends spicy and smoky notes with high-end ingredients, reviving the legacy of legendary Perfumer Agatho and embodying the perfect balance between classic tradition and fearless innovation.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Juniper Berries, Labdanum, Bergamot, Lavender and Rhubarb

Middle Notes: Incense, Black Pepper, Saffron, Sage and Pimento

Base Notes: Virginia Cedar, Sandalwood, Labdanum, Cashmeran, Amber, Patchouli and Musk

title: Sundowner Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the artistry of Andy Tauer's latest creation, Sundowner. This enticing fragrance blends notes of boozy ginger and cinnamon with a touch of floral smoky happiness. With a hint of tobacco and a captivating drydown of gourmand amber, this scent celebrates modern pleasures and ancient beauty in a harmonious blend. A masterpiece of spice and sweetness, citrus and amber, Sundowner is a must-have for both Tauer enthusiasts and those looking for a bold and alluring unisex scent. Don't miss out on this effortlessly charming and seductive fragrance.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Cinnamon, Orange Peel, Rose Oil and Bergamot

Middle Notes: Tobacco, Cacao and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

Base Notes: Ambergris, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Vanilla

title: Palo Santo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
"Palo Santo, a sacred wood revered for its magical and mystical properties for centuries, captures an ethereal aroma that delicately combines earthy wood and incense notes. Used by shamans for ages, this spiritual wood is believed to bestow protection and invite good fortune. A light spritz will purify the ambiance and uplift the spirit, harnessing the true cleansing qualities of Palo Santo." - a statement from the maker. Palo Santo by Carner Barcelona is a unisex fragrance released in 2015. The perfumer behind this blend is Shyamala Maisondieu. The top notes are artemisia and rum; the heart is composed of milk, guaiac wood, and tonka bean; and the base notes are vetiver, vanilla, and sandalwood.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum and Artemisia

Middle notes: Milk, Guaiac Wood and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood and Vetiver

title: Chai Desert Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Chai Desert is a fragrance that captures the beauty of the desert and the history of Al Seef in Dubai. With top notes of saffron, pink pepper, and raspberry, this scent takes you on a journey through warm vanilla, Arabic coffee, and earthy cedar, while oud and patchouli anchor the scent. Experience the essence of the desert with Chai Desert Extrait de Parfum.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Pink Pepper, Raspberry

Middle notes: Qahwah (Arabic Coffee), Cedar, White Floral Notes

Base notes: Oud, Patchouli, Musk, Ambergris

title: Trouble In Paradise Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Effortlessly escape the chaotic world around you by embracing the vibrant colors of the sunset and reconnecting with the soothing sand beneath your feet. Take a moment to express gratitude for the tropical air that envelops you with each breath, and fully immerse yourself in the beauty and wonder of life. Remember, we don't travel to escape life, but to fully experience and appreciate it.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Cognac, Cardamom, Bergamot

Middle notes: Rum, Caramel, Leather, Violet

Base notes: Moss, Amber, Ambroxan, Sandalwood, Animalic Notes, Oud

title: Beyond The Pashtun Summit Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the rich history and stories of the past with Beyond The Pashtun Summit Extrait de Parfum. Journey into the depths of ancient secrets hidden beneath the desert sands. Let the words of the desert guide you to unearth and revel in its glories.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Hashish, Pomegranate, Davana

Middle notes: Labdanum, Cistus Absolute, Poppy Flower, Naswar

Base notes: Agarwood Oud, Deer Musk, Leather, Sandalwood

title: The Black Knight Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The Black Knight Extrait de Parfum draws inspiration from the Renaissance commander Giovanni Dalle Bande Nere, embodying his unwavering loyalty and austere principles. This composition masterfully reconstructs the olfactory landscape of a military encampment—interweaving the honeyed notes of wild vegetation, smoldering campfire emissions, and the distinctive aroma of leather equestrian equipment. A delicate powdery rose accord, representing the commander's clandestine paramour, elegantly complements the robust vetiver foundation that forms the fragrance's commanding presence.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Leather, Orris Root, Honey

Middle notes: Beeswax, Vetiver, Oakmoss, Patchouli

Base notes: Caraway, Artemisia, Narcissus, Cedar, Bulgarian Rose

title: Awake Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Awake Eau de Parfum embodies the quintessential coffee experience—that transformative moment when coffee transcends mere beverage to become ritual necessity. This sophisticated composition recreates the multisensory atmosphere of an inviting café during winter: the aromatic complexity of freshly pulverized beans, the delicate wisps of vapor, the comforting thermal embrace, and the exquisite bittersweet indulgence. Meticulously crafted to evoke both memory and sensation, this olfactory stimulant provides an invigorating aromatic boost regardless of the hour, making it an exceptional addition to the discerning fragrance connoisseur's collection.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee

Middle notes: Cardamom, Italian Lemon

Base notes: Haitian Vetiver

title: Vanille Carbone Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vanille Carbone by Atelier Materi presents a sophisticated Oriental Vanilla composition suitable for all genders. Released in 2025, this contemporary fragrance was crafted by perfumer Natalie Gracia-Cetto. The scent architecture begins with vibrant Black and Pink Pepper accords, transitions through a complex heart of Leather and Frankincense, and settles on a foundation of rich Vanilla Absolute and Madagascar Vanilla, creating a harmonious olfactory experience that balances warmth with depth.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Leather and Frankincense

Base notes: Vanilla Absolute and Madagascar Vanilla

title: Ambre Papier Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A sophisticated fragrance built upon the foundation of Siam Benzoin, an exceptional and valuable aromatic element with diverse characteristics. In AMBRE PAPIER, perfumer Céline Perdriel creates a sensory experience of juxtapositions, expertly harmonizing potency with delicacy. The initial crisp, piquant notes of black pepper and Red Mandarin give way to saffron's deep leathery warmth, which emerges with vibrant, almost crackling intensity. The benzoin gradually reveals its opulent, velvety, vanilla-esque dimensions, enhanced by the distinguished sophistication of Haitian Vetiver.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper, Pepper and Mandarin

Middle notes: Saffron, Myrrh, Mate and Jasmine

Base notes: Benzoin, Vetiver and Tonka

title: El Pasajero No.1 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
El Pasajero No.1 Parfum evokes an enchanting evening in the Andalusian highlands—a moment of diamond-like clarity, simultaneously untamed and peaceful. The fragrance lingers on skin while one contemplates the celestial panorama above, capturing fleeting perfection. This exceptional scent accompanies the wearer as a fellow traveler, seeking experiences beyond description—moments whose exquisite nature transforms into yearning upon recognition. A masterpiece of perfumery, El Pasajero offers sophisticated luxury and refined elegance for any occasion, with its nuanced balance of cool and silken accords creating an enigmatic presence.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Osmanthus, Magnolia, Red Algae

Middle notes: Hedione, Amber

Base notes: Galbanum, Vanilla, Benzoin

title: Sekushi Supreme No.7 Parfum
body_html:
Extraordinarily potent. Profoundly alluring. Exceptionally opulent. This composition presents a masterful interplay between refined, enticingly succulent fruit notes and rich leather accords—delivering an unparalleled olfactory experience that represents the pinnacle of contemporary perfumery artistry.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cotton Candy, Raspberry, Patchouli, Apricot

Middle notes: Olibanum, Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Leather, Musk, Palisander Rosewood

title: Carbonara Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Carbonara Extrait de Parfum presents a masterful olfactory tribute to Lorenzo Pazzaglia's culinary artistry. This composition artfully combines spices and exotic elements to engage the senses. The composition features fruity Coconut and Davana notes that harmonize with the amber warmth of cane sugar and bourbon vanilla. Creamy Sandalwood provides textural depth, while Oud introduces a sophisticated complexity. This fragrance represents perfumery excellence designed to captivate and intrigue the discerning connoisseur.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper, Pink Pepper, Coconut, Smoke and Elemi resin

Middle notes: Pepper, Rum, Davana and Jasmine

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Sugar Cane, Amber, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Cherry Ink Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Cherry Ink Extrait de Parfum delivers an intoxicating sensory experience where rum notes intertwine with passionate accords. The composition unfolds with sophisticated almond and cherry facets reminiscent of fine wine, complemented by an elegant floral heart of mimosa and jasmine. These elements converge with deep, ink-like base notes that leave an indelible impression. The fragrance creates a sophisticated olfactory narrative that evokes intimate moments and lingering promises through its complex aromatic structure.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sour Cherry, Cherry, Almond, Rum, Black Pepper and Bergamot

Middle notes: Ink, Red Wine, Myrrh, Damask Rose, Cinnamon, Mimosa, Lily-of-the-Valley and Jasmine

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla Bean, Precious Woods, Benzoin, Amber, Patchouli, Musk and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Nº12 Oud Douze Eau de Parfum
body_html:
No.12 Oud Douze Eau de Parfum by Thomas Kosmala draws inspiration from the poetic imagery on its packaging. It opens with the subtle sweetness of saffron flower and rose, evolving into a rich blend of creamy sandalwood and gentle cashmere at its core. The fragrance concludes with the warm glow of amber and the grounded richness of patchouli leaf, creating a sophisticated and layered olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron Flower, Rose

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Cashmere, Amber, Patchouli Leaf

Base notes: Oud, Vanilla, Absolute Musk

title: Love Tuberose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Love Tuberose captures the essence of tropical blooms, radiant sun-kissed skin, and sweet sunlight, celebrating the beauty of self-love.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose, Gardenia and Jasmine

Middle notes: Whipped Cream and Vanilla

Base notes: Sandalwood and Cedar

title: Vespero Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This distinctly masculine extrait de parfum is crafted for sophisticated urban night dwellers seeking their definitive scent. Its exclusive character turns wearing it into a subtle signal, creating an unspoken connection among those who share this refined olfactory taste, like members of a select circle.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Pink Grapefruit and Bergamot

Middle notes: Leather, Cedar, Geranium and Jasmine

Base notes: Woody Notes, Musk, Patchouli and Amber

title: This Is Not Testosterone Parfum
body_html:
Testosterone Parfum is a striking and compelling fragrance designed to project confidence and authority. It is perfect for individuals who command attention and embody strength.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Cardamom and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Vanilla and Jasmine

Base notes: Praline, Sandal, Musk and Amberwood

title: Zafar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Zafar Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated homage to the rich incense heritage of its origin. This oriental fragrance artfully blends natural oud, aromatic incense, and exotic spices, creating a warm and inviting scent profile. The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus and spicy notes, evolving into a cozy base that envelops you in sweetness and depth. Ideal for those who appreciate complex, luxurious aromas that evoke tradition and elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Rose, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Olibanum, Cinnamon, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Orris and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Moss, Vetiver and Tonka Bean

title: Khanjar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Khanjar draws inspiration from a distinctive Omani emblem representing honor and sacred elegance. This fragrance captures the essence of Oman's heritage, beginning with a luxurious blend of floral accords, saffron, and bergamot. It then unfolds into a sophisticated fusion of genuine oud, ambergris, and leather, creating a rich and timeless scent.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Davana, Saffron, Coriander, Bergamot, Artemisia and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Rose, Cedar, Vetiver, Immortelle, Orris, Nutmeg and Geranium

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Leather, Ambergris, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Sandalwood, Praline, Amyris, Tonka Bean, Styrax, Labdanum, Musk, Patchouli and Vanilla

title: Paramour Eau de Parfum
body_html:
An opulent and seductive blend of leathery rose with bright, fruity, and subtly sweet candy-like nuances. Enhanced by smoky leather accords, this fragrance exudes sensuality, enriched with warm touches of caramel, vanilla, musk, and amber.

Fragrance family: Leather, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Saffron, Bergamot and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Rose, Cinnamon, Jasmine and Lily

Base notes: Leather, Caramel, Amber, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Patchouli, Cedar, Moss and Musk

title: Lovers Parfum
body_html:
Designed for lovers, this captivating fragrance embodies the pure joy of intimate moments and shared delight. The scent opens with vibrant passion fruit, blending seamlessly with succulent plum and spicy ginger, before unfolding into a tender embrace of jasmine and saffron. Delicate rose petals leave a subtle, lingering aroma on the skin. As the warmth intensifies, rich cashmeran woods and creamy sandalwood wrap you in a comforting, sensual hug. This warm, woody composition is both alluring and luxurious, evoking the radiant glow of new love.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Plum, Ginger and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Saffron and Jasmine

Base notes: Patchouli, Cashmere Wood, Cedarwood, Sandalwood and Vetiver

title: Almond Harmony Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Almond Harmony from The House of Oud is a unisex Oriental Floral fragrance introduced in 2016. It opens with vibrant notes of almond, orange blossom, bergamot, and petitgrain. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of heliotrope, iris, ylang-ylang, jasmine, and rose. Its warm base combines vanilla, tonka bean, tolu balsam, peru balsam, and musk, creating a rich and balanced scent profile.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Almond, Orange Blossom, Bergamot and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Heliotrope, Iris, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Tolu Balsam, Peru Balsam and Musk

title: Just Before Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Just Before by The House of Oud is an Oriental Woody scent designed for both women and men, introduced in 2018. Crafted by perfumer Maurizio Cerizza, it features top notes of saffron, lemon, and bergamot. The heart combines palo santo, myrrh, and ylang-ylang, while the base is enriched with vanilla, sandalwood, amber, and benzoin, delivering a warm and sophisticated fragrance experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Palo Santo, Myrrh and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber and Benzoin

title: Live In Colors Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Live In Colors by The House of Oud is a Woody Aromatic fragrance crafted for both women and men, released in 2018. Created by perfumer Maurizio Cerizza, it opens with vibrant notes of grapefruit, lemon, and red fruits. The heart features spicy pink pepper and ginger, while the base combines hinoki wood, musk, and amber for a refined and dynamic scent.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Lemon and Red Fruits

Middle notes: Pink Pepper and Ginger

Base notes: Hinoki Wood, Musk and Amber

title: Halwa Kiss Perfume Absolute
body_html:
Halwa Kiss Absolute perfume oil draws inspiration from the renowned Omani treat, offering a rich and generous fragrance. It blends the gentle sweetness of dates and honey with the delicate floral touch of rose, enhanced by the warmth of vanilla, and the spicy notes of cardamom and saffron. Accents of pistachio and nuts add a savory depth, creating a scent that captures the festive spirit and treasured moments with loved ones in a warm, inviting embrace.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cardamom and Pistachio

Middle notes: Honey, Dates, Rose and Roasted Nuts

Base notes: Vanilla, Sesame and Amber

title: Fougere Emeraude Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This 21st-century fougère fragrance embodies the refined elegance of bespoke creations crafted by the finest Haute Couture designers, presenting an aromatic floral profile with expert sophistication.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Indian Tuberose

Middle notes: Lavender, Clary Sage

Base notes: Moroccan Mimosa

title: Oriental Velours Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oriental Velours Eau de Parfum is a captivating woody oriental scent designed for connoisseurs of exquisite, luxurious fabrics. This fragrance envelops you in a rich, sensual aura that evokes the softness and depth of rare velvets and silks. Its carefully crafted notes create an elegant and mysterious atmosphere, perfect for those who appreciate refined sophistication and timeless allure. Ideal for evening wear or special occasions, Oriental Velours leaves a lasting impression of warmth and opulence.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Myrrh, Spruce

Middle notes: Indian Jasmine

Base notes: Haitian Vetiver, Madagascar Vanilla

title: Caramelo Vanilla Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Caramelo Vanilla by New Notes is a unisex Floral Fruity Gourmand scent introduced in 2022. It opens with rich Caramel and delicate Vanilla Flower, followed by heart notes of Dulce de Leche, Cotton Candy, White Flowers, and Frangipani. The fragrance settles into a warm base of Vanilla Pod, Tonka Bean, and Musk, creating a sophisticated and inviting aroma.


Fragrance family: Gourmand, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caramel and Vanilla Flower

Middle notes: Dulce de leche, Cotton Candy, White Flowers and Frangipani

Base notes: Vanilla Pod, Tonka Bean and Musk

title: Latte Mimosa Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Latte Mimosa Extrait de Parfum by New Notes is a sophisticated unisex fragrance introduced in 2024, expertly blending floral and warm notes to create a captivating scent experience. The fragrance opens with fresh, uplifting top notes of bergamot and mimosa, setting a bright and inviting tone. At its heart, a delicate bouquet of ylang-ylang, iris, and jasmine unfolds, offering a rich and elegant floral complexity. The base is anchored by sensual musk, creamy sandalwood, and smooth vanilla, providing a lasting warmth and depth. This extrait de parfum concentration ensures a more intense and enduring aroma, perfect for those seeking a refined and memorable signature scent.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Mimosa

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Iris and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Vanilla

title: Cocktail Maracuja Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Cocktail Maracuja Extrait de Parfum by New Notes, introduced in 2023, is a vibrant floral fruity scent suitable for both women and men. It opens with lively top notes of passionfruit, pear, lemon, strawberry, and black currant, creating a fresh and juicy introduction. The heart blends spicy and floral elements including ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, jasmine, pink pepper, and rose, adding complexity and warmth. The base combines white musk, amber, patchouli, lactones, cedar, and vanilla, delivering a smooth, sensual, and lasting finish. This fragrance offers a balanced and sophisticated aroma for those seeking a dynamic yet elegant scent.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Pear, Lemon, Strawberry and Black Currant

Middle notes: Ginger, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Jasmine, Pink Pepper and Rose

Base notes: White Musk, Amber, Patchouli, Lactones, Cedar and Vanilla

title: KHAMZAT The Wolf Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
KHAMZAT The Wolf Extrait de Parfum is crafted for exceptional individuals who demand exceptional scents. This fragrance exudes unwavering focus and masculinity through its rich woody and leathery accords. Its persistence mirrors the boldness of saffron, while the distinctive combination of cardamom and musk adds a unique character. Designed to last, The Wolf captures the essence of invincibility and determination.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Apple, Saffron and Cardamom

Middle notes: Lily of the Valley, White Flowers, Violet and Cinnamon

Base notes: Leather, Musk, Woody Notes and Amber

title: Que Chimba! Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Que Chimba! Extrait de Parfum is a bold and sensual fragrance that embodies the vibrant spirit of life and passion. Inspired by a warm Colombian afternoon, it captures sunlight filtering through palm leaves and the joyful atmosphere of shared moments. The scent begins with fresh star anise, inviting you to embrace Colombia’s lively rhythm. Juicy guava and passion fruit blend with the exotic Cattleya orchid, creating a dynamic and captivating aroma. Que Chimba! celebrates tradition and emotion, offering a rich sensory experience that lingers like a cherished memory.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Guava, Cloves, Star Anise, Passionfruit, Peach, Ginger and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Tobacco, Tonka Bean, Heliotrope, Orchid and Damask Rose

Base notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vanilla Bean, Benzoin, Amber and Ambergris

title: Gong Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gong takes its name from the Dorayaki accord, a subtly sweet scent inspired by the beloved Japanese teatime cake. This aroma reflects the round shape of the traditional gong, a sacred instrument whose resonant sounds promote calm, balance, and inner peace. In Japanese, "Dora" means "gong," linking the fragrance to these cultural roots. Gong captures the tranquil moment of tea, embodying mindfulness and harmony. According to legend, the first dorayaki was created when a samurai’s gong was repurposed as a pan, giving rise to this cherished treat.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Yuzu, Italian Mandarin and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Dorayaki, Black Pepper and Siam Benzoin

Base notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, Amber and Guaiac Wood

title: Oud Bouquet Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This blend features a trio of distinctive Wood Essences shaped by a Praline Rose signature. It combines two-decade-old Oud Wood with smoky Gaïac Wood accents and the gentle touch of Copahu Wood. The elegant glass and gold bottle is enhanced by a golden plate on the back displaying the ingredient imprint, while the side reveals the secret behind the Art of Assemblage.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Vanilla

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Copahu Balm

Base notes: Praline, Agarwood (Oud)

title: Oud Zarian Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Zarian by Creed, released in 2025, is a unisex fragrance that combines spicy, woody, and amber notes. It begins with an invigorating blend of frankincense, ginger, bergamot, and spicy elements, leading to a heart centered on rose centifolia absolute. The rich base showcases aged oud, enhanced by patchouli, sandalwood, tonka bean, licorice root, and myrrh, delivering a sophisticated and luxurious scent profile.

    Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

    Olfactive pyramid

    Top notes: Frankincense, Bergamot, Ginger and Spices

    Middle notes: May Rose

    Base notes: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Licorice, Myrrh and Oud

title: Opus XVI Timber Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Opus XVI – Timber by Amouage is a distinguished woody scent that begins with a strong, commanding presence of wood notes. It reveals vibrant and radiant highlights from cypress, cardamom, and lavandin, while the dynamic blend of frankincense, juniper, and fir balsam adds lively movement. Its foundation rests on palo santo, sandalwood, cedarwood, and patchouli, conveying a deep sense of timeless insight. This fragrance captures the essence of ancient natural wisdom, harmonized with a hopeful outlook toward what lies ahead.

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Sandalwood, Palo Santo, Vanilla, Cedarwood and Patchouli

title: Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tales of Amber by Goldfield & Banks is an extrait de parfum that captures the essence of ambergris through a uniquely Australian lens. It begins with fresh notes of dewy moss and orange blossom, evolving into a complex heart featuring orris, cistus oil, musk, and cinnamon. The scent deepens with a luxurious base comprising labdanum, Australian agarwood, New Zealand ambergris, vanillin, and a refined oud accord.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Middle notes: Orris, Cinnamon, Musk and Labdanum

title: Silk Road Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refined elegance of Silk Road by Hajine, a fragrance inspired by the noble spirit of horses. This perfume combines luxury and heritage, guiding you through a sensory journey along historic trade routes. Silk Road blends exotic spices and rare flowers, encapsulating the essence of ancient commerce. Discover the allure and mystery of the East with Silk Road’s rich and evocative scent.

 

 

Fragrance family: Spicy, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sicilian Bergamot, Davana and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), White Amber and Rosemary

Base notes: Leather, Haitian Vetiver and Musk

body_html:
Discover Line 618 Essence de Parfum by Amouage, a fragrance that explores light, movement, and luxury. It opens with smoky frankincense combined with a creamy lactonic accord, illuminated by juicy notes of pineapple, peach, and plum. The heart reveals pine and heliotrope, conjuring misty forest paths and expansive horizons. The scent settles into a warm, textured base of sandalwood and sophisticated leather, offering a rich and enduring finish.

Fragrance family: Woody, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Frankincense, Lactonic Accord, Pineapple, Peach, Plum

Middle notes: Pine, Heliotrope

Can't Get Enough by Initio Parfums Privés, featured in The Hedonist Collection, begins with a vibrant blend of citrus and aldehydes. Its core reveals a spirited cognac note enhanced by a chilling icy nuance, which then evolves into a rich, warm foundation of cinnamon, amber, tonka bean, and oak. This fragrance gracefully transforms from a fresh, sparkling opening to a deep, ambery-woody finish.

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Cinnamon, Tonka Bean, Amber and Oak

title: Kingside Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Kingside by Mind Games, launched in 2025, is a unisex extrait de parfum. This fragrance combines citrus, nutty, floral, and gourmand accords to deliver a sophisticated and modern aroma. Crafted by renowned perfumer David Apel, it offers a complex and balanced scent experience.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pistachio, Cardamom and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Hazelnut, Rum and Peony

Base notes: Almond Milk, Peru Balsam and Tonka Bean

Bois Obscur stands as a distinguished member of Byredo's Night Veils collection, presenting a captivating woody-amber floral composition. The fragrance commences with saffron, eucalyptus, and smoky papyrus, evolving into a complex heart of jasmine absolute, oud, and tuberose absolute. It settles gracefully on a foundation of labdanum, patchouli, sandalwood, and mineral amber, creating an intoxicating depth. Housed in an elegant elongated bottle with substantial glass construction and antique gold hardware, presented in a sustainable reusable box.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Eucalyptus and Papyrus

Middle notes: Oud, Tuberose and Jasmine

Base notes: Patchouli, Labdanum, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Nettuno Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Nettuno Extrait de Parfum draws inspiration from Marco Pesatori's evocative poetry, capturing the essence of cosmic wonder and celestial transcendence. This sophisticated fragrance transports the wearer to realms where imagination transcends earthly boundaries, blending ethereal notes that evoke the mystique of the cosmos. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, Nettuno represents the pinnacle of perfume artistry. The extrait concentration ensures a luxurious, long-lasting experience with remarkable sillage and depth. Each application unveils layers of complexity, revealing nuanced accords that resonate with those who appreciate refined, introspective fragrances. Perfect for the discerning individual seeking a signature scent that bridges art, astronomy, and olfactory excellence, Nettuno invites you to embark on an intergalactic journey through scent.

Fragrance family: Floral, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Cyclamen, Nutmeg and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Rose

Base notes: Iris, Leather, White Musk, Rum, Haitian Vetiver, Carrot Seeds and Benzoin

title: Id Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Id Eau de Parfum transcends gender boundaries, embodying an androgynous elegance that mirrors the duality inherent in all beings. This fragrance celebrates equilibrium—a harmonious interplay between contrasting elements that dance in perpetual dialogue, much like light yielding to shadow and shadow embracing light. Where extremes clash with desperation, Id offers serenity and compassion. It possesses the wisdom to bridge divides, to unite opposing forces, and to surrender to the transformative power of connection. Its enigmatic character draws inspiration from the volcanic heart of Stromboli and the sacred black stones of Iddu Island—ancient geological forces pulsating with primordial energy. Id is neither beginning nor end, but rather the sacred space between—a fragrance for those who understand that true sophistication lies in balance, acceptance, and the courage to love without boundaries.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ravensara

Middle notes: Iris, Violet, Jasmine

Base notes: Birch, Labdanum, Siam Benzoin, Ceylon Cinnamon, Ambroxan, Oud, Precious Woods, Indonesian Patchouli, White Musk

The composition unfolds with a vibrant citrus prelude of bergamot, mandarin, and grapefruit, enriched by artemisia's herbal whisper and nutmeg's warmth. A luminous heart of jasmine, ylang-ylang, orange blossom, and orris creates a delicate floral core, while a grounding base of cedarwood and patchouli anchors the composition, complemented by vanilla, tonka bean, and amber for lasting sensuality.

The composition unfolds with ambrette and incense, creating an aromatic introduction that transitions into a heart of ciste and cotton candy—a juxtaposition of floral and gourmand elements. The base reveals a sophisticated blend of musks, amber, and resins, establishing a warm, enveloping finish. This expertly crafted scent embodies a distinctly musky and sensual character, designed for those seeking depth and emotional resonance in fragrance.

Brunello Cucinelli Pour Femme is a sophisticated eau de parfum crafted by renowned master perfumer Daphné Bugey. This refined composition opens with vibrant top notes of pink pepper SFE, Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian mandarin orange, and delicate orange blossom, creating an invigorating and luminous introduction. The heart reveals warm, earthy nuances of chestnut that gracefully transition into a complex base of Atlas cedar, Virginian cedar, and Vetiver Haiti SFE. Enhanced with precious Olibanum SFE, Ambrox Super, and musk, the fragrance develops into an elegant, long-lasting signature with remarkable depth and character. Ideal for the discerning woman who appreciates artisanal craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Base notes: Haitian Vetiver, Atlas Cedar, Virginia Cedar, Ambrox Super, Musk and Olibanum

title: The Queen and the Viper Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Imagine the cool whisper of mint against ancient papyrus—a scent that evokes the Nile's mystique. This fragrance captures a queen's journey and her devoted admirer across two shores, a sea transformed into intimate passage. Sun-drenched vessels carry precious cargo: rare unguents, exotic spices, and transformative essences that unlock hidden dimensions. The composition embodies feminine power through geometric precision and sensual depth, crowned like emerald royalty. A luminous olfactory beacon rooted in Alexandrine tradition, this formula transcends mere perfume to become an olfactory narrative of ancient grandeur and timeless allure.

The fragrance captures the essence of dawn—a moment of transition and renewal—through its carefully balanced structure. Ideal for those seeking a versatile scent that transcends traditional gender boundaries, Estrella de la Mañana delivers complexity and refinement suitable for both daytime wear and evening occasions. title: Jardins de Misfah Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
At dawn, she arrived in Misfah, where ancient irrigation channels whispered through terraced gardens. Her touch awakened the village—pomegranates deepened to crimson, apricots glowed amber, figs split with sweetness, and almonds perfumed the air. Roses unfurled in jeweled profusion while date palms bowed beneath their treasure. Jardins de Misfah Extrait captures this sensory awakening in concentrated form. More refined than its predecessor, this composition balances opulence with restraint. A luminous rose heart anchors notes of honeyed dates and toasted almonds, creating an olfactory landscape where each inhale reveals layered complexity—neither excessive nor austere, but precisely calibrated for those who appreciate depth and nuance in fragrance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, nutmeg

Middle notes: Date accord, rose absolute, rose essence

Base notes: Almond, saffron

In the base, a rich assembly of woods, moss, and amber lend a grounded warmth and sophisticated finish that lingers with refined complexity. The heart reveals a floral-woody fusion that adds elegance and textural depth, while a warm, rich base of resinous and sensual woods provides a memorable and sophisticated finish. body_html:
J’ai Fait Un Rêve Obscur — Majda Bekkali is a dark, enigmatic, and emotionally immersive fragrance that explores the beauty of shadow and mystery through an opulent blend of smoky woods, resins, and sensual florals. It opens with a deep and atmospheric burst of spices and incense, creating an immediate aura of intrigue, warmth, and introspective intensity. The heart unfolds into a rich floral-resinous accord where velvety petals intertwine with balsamic nuances, adding depth, texture, and a dreamlike sensuality to the composition. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a powerful base of oud, patchouli, amber, musk, and smoky woods, leaving a dense, long-lasting, and hypnotic trail that feels mysterious, artistic, and profoundly seductive.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody, Resinous

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Spices, incense
Middle notes: Floral accords, balsamic resins
Base notes: Oud, patchouli, amber, musk, smoky woods

title: Purple Molecule 070 · 07 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Purple Molecule 070·07 — Zarkoperfume is a luminous, dreamy, and modern fragrance that blends sparkling florals, creamy vanilla, and soft musky woods into an airy yet addictive composition inspired by Scandinavian minimalism and elegance. It opens with a delicate accord of wildflowers, white orchid, and magnolia, creating an immediate sensation of freshness, softness, and radiant femininity. The heart gradually develops into a smooth molecular floral aura where airy petals intertwine with subtle fruity nuances, adding transparency and a uniquely skin-like sensuality to the composition. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a comforting base of Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood, silver musk accord, and signature molecules, leaving a creamy, powdery, and softly woody trail that feels clean, elegant, and effortlessly modern.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musky, Oriental Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Wildflowers, white orchid, magnolia
Middle notes: Floral molecular accords, airy fruity nuances
Base notes: Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood, silver musk accord, molecules

title: Tutu Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tutù — Gritti is a playful, elegant, and irresistibly feminine gourmand-floral fragrance inspired by the grace of ballet and the sweetness of delicate indulgence. It opens with a sparkling burst of grapefruit, blackcurrant, coconut, and apple, creating an immediate sensation of juicy freshness and creamy sweetness that feels vibrant and uplifting. The heart unfolds into a soft floral accord of heliotrope, jasmine, and rose, adding powdery elegance and romantic sophistication that balances the fragrance’s gourmand character beautifully. As it settles, the composition reveals a smooth and addictive base of raspberry, vanilla, amber, and musk, leaving a creamy, fruity, and long-lasting trail that feels joyful, sensual, and effortlessly chic.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Grapefruit, blackcurrant, coconut, apple
Middle notes: Heliotrope, jasmine, rose
Base notes: Raspberry, vanilla, amber, musk

title: Vert Soleil Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vert Soleil — Chloé is a radiant, green, and effortlessly elegant fragrance that captures the warmth of sunlit foliage and blooming gardens through a refined blend of citrus, florals, and soft woods. It opens with a luminous burst of bergamot and leafy green accords, creating an immediate sensation of freshness, vitality, and natural sophistication. The heart unfolds into a delicate floral bouquet enriched with neroli and soft white blossoms, adding airy elegance and a graceful femininity that feels bright yet understated. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth base of cedarwood, musk, and subtle amber nuances, leaving a clean, fresh, and softly woody trail that feels serene, modern, and effortlessly chic.

Fragrance family: Green, Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Bergamot, leafy green accords
Middle notes: Neroli, white florals
Base notes: Cedarwood, musk, amber nuances

title: Immortelle Solaire Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Immortelle Solaire — Les Indémodables is a radiant and sophisticated fragrance that pays tribute to the multifaceted beauty of immortelle, capturing the warmth and brilliance of a Mediterranean landscape under the summer sun. The composition opens with a vibrant blend of aromatic herbs, candied fruits, and spices that immediately evoke a sense of golden warmth and natural richness. As the fragrance develops, immortelle takes center stage, revealing its characteristic honeyed, herbal, and slightly licorice-like nuances, enriched by subtle facets of dry hay and warm spice. The dry down introduces smoky leather, precious woods, and resinous notes, creating depth, texture, and elegance. Rich yet airy, the fragrance balances sweetness, aromatic freshness, and earthy sophistication, resulting in a distinctive scent that feels both luminous and deeply refined.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic, Woody, Leather

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Aromatic Herbs, Candied Fruits, Spices
Heart Notes: Immortelle
Base Notes: Leather Notes, Woody Notes, Resinous Notes

title: Jasminum Sambac Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jasminum Sambac — Chloé is a luminous and sophisticated floral fragrance that celebrates the exquisite beauty of jasmine sambac in its purest and most elegant form. Part of Chloé’s Atelier des Fleurs collection, the composition is crafted to evoke the delicate yet intoxicating character of jasmine blooming at dusk. The fragrance opens with fresh green nuances that highlight the natural vibrancy of the flower, creating an airy and radiant introduction. As it unfolds, jasmine sambac takes center stage, revealing its creamy, velvety petals and subtly fruity facets, balanced by a delicate floral sweetness. The dry down is soft and refined, where gentle musky and woody undertones enhance the richness of the blossom without overshadowing its natural elegance. Graceful, radiant, and effortlessly chic, the fragrance captures the timeless allure of jasmine with a distinctly modern and refined touch.

Fragrance Family: Floral, White Floral, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Green Notes
Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac
Base Notes: Musk, Soft Woody Notes

title: Tonka Kumaru Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Tonka Kumaru — Atelier Materi is a refined and comforting gourmand fragrance that pays tribute to the many facets of the tonka bean, revealing its almond-like sweetness, smoky warmth, and velvety depth with remarkable elegance. Created by perfumer Céline Perdriel, the composition transforms childhood nostalgia into a sophisticated olfactory experience, balancing indulgence with restraint. It opens with the luminous freshness of bergamot, enhanced by bitter almond and the aromatic spice of cardamom, creating an inviting introduction that feels both vibrant and creamy. The heart unfolds through roasted barley, hay absolute, and cedar leaf, adding a toasted, textured warmth that highlights the dry and slightly rustic nuances of tonka. As the fragrance settles, roasted tonka bean takes center stage, enriched by vanilla, amber, and soft musks to create a smooth, enveloping trail that is addictive without ever becoming overly sweet. Elegant and deeply comforting, Tonka Kumaru is a modern gourmand that celebrates the raw beauty of one of perfumery's most beloved ingredients.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand, Oriental Vanilla, Amber

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bitter Almond, Cardamom, Bergamot
Heart Notes: Roasted Barley, Hay Absolute, Cedar Leaf
Base Notes: Roasted Tonka Bean, Vanilla Resinoid, Amber, Musks

title: Juanillo Parfum
body_html:
Juanillo — Adamo Parfum is an irresistibly indulgent tropical gourmand fragrance inspired by the pristine beaches of the Dominican Republic, where swaying coconut palms, crystal-clear waters, and sun-drenched afternoons create an atmosphere of pure escapism. Created by Hamid Merati-Kashani, the composition transforms exotic holiday memories into a sophisticated olfactory experience, balancing vibrant citrus freshness with creamy, addictive sweetness. It opens with a luminous blend of mandarin, orange, and lemon, delivering a juicy burst of sunshine that feels bright and uplifting. The heart reveals an unexpected gourmand accord of coconut, pistachio, and dates, where creamy tropical facets intertwine with nutty richness and honeyed fruit to create a smooth and decadent texture. As the fragrance settles, ambroxan, musk, and praline emerge to form a warm and sensual dry down, leaving a velvety trail that is both comforting and alluring. Rich without being overwhelming, Juanillo perfectly captures the elegance of a luxurious tropical escape wrapped in modern sophistication.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Fruity, Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Mandarin, Orange, Lemon
Heart Notes: Coconut, Pistachio, Dates
Base Notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Praline

title: Gladiator Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Gladiator Extrait de Parfum embodies invigorating strength and modern masculinity, where fresh aquatic brightness meets aromatic complexity. This captivating scent captures the essence of confidence and dynamic energy, drawing inspiration from bold, active lifestyles and versatile daily wear.

Fragrance family: Aromatic Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Mint, Watermelon, Pineapple 

Middle Notes: Sage, Geranium, Cardamom, Marine Accord 

Base Notes: Vetiver, Musk, Amberwood

title: London Hall Eau de Parfum
body_html:
London Hall — Jusbox is a vibrant and charismatic woody-aromatic fragrance inspired by the golden era of British rock, where iconic concert halls became the birthplace of legendary performances and cultural revolutions. The composition captures the electric atmosphere of London's live music scene, blending energetic freshness with rich woods and warm spices to evoke creativity, confidence, and timeless style. It opens with a sparkling accord of bergamot, grapefruit, and black pepper, creating an invigorating introduction that is bright, spicy, and full of character. At its heart, lavender and geranium intertwine with aromatic clary sage, adding an elegant herbal depth that reflects the refined yet rebellious spirit of classic British music. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, patchouli, amber, and musk create a smooth, woody foundation that lingers with warmth, sophistication, and understated sensuality. Dynamic and effortlessly modern, London Hall embodies the energy of live performance while maintaining the refined craftsmanship synonymous with Jusbox.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Black Pepper
Heart Notes: Lavender, Clary Sage, Geranium
Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Amber, Musk

title: Matcha Soft Serve Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Matcha Soft Serve — d'Annam is a delicate and comforting gourmand fragrance inspired by the creamy indulgence of Japanese-style matcha soft serve, where the vibrant bitterness of ceremonial green tea meets the silky sweetness of vanilla ice cream. The composition transforms this beloved dessert into an elegant olfactory experience, balancing freshness, creaminess, and subtle woody warmth with remarkable finesse. It opens with the vibrant aroma of premium matcha, offering a crisp, green bitterness that feels both invigorating and serene. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy milk and vanilla create a velvety heart, softening the matcha with smooth gourmand richness while preserving its refined character. The dry down reveals white musk and sandalwood, adding a clean, silky warmth that lingers gently on the skin, creating an intimate and comforting trail. Minimalist yet addictive, Matcha Soft Serve captures the quiet joy of savoring a perfectly crafted frozen treat with effortless sophistication.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand, Green, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Matcha Tea
Heart Notes: Milk, Vanilla Cream
Base Notes: White Musk, Sandalwood

title: Jubilation 25 Woman Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jubilation 25 Woman — Amouage is a luxurious and elegant amber-floral fragrance that celebrates feminine grace, opulence, and timeless sophistication through a rich composition of precious florals, exotic fruits, and warm resins. Created by master perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour, the fragrance reflects the artistic heritage of Amouage, blending luminous floral accords with sensual woods and oriental depth to create an unforgettable signature. It opens with a radiant blend of tarragon, lemon, and green notes, offering a fresh and refined introduction that is both vibrant and elegant. At its heart, an exquisite bouquet of jasmine, rose, magnolia, and ylang-ylang unfolds with creamy floral richness, enhanced by subtle spices and a luxurious sense of femininity. As the fragrance settles, amber, patchouli, vanilla, musk, and precious woods create a warm and enveloping base, leaving a sophisticated trail that is smooth, sensual, and remarkably enduring. Majestic yet graceful, Jubilation 25 Woman is a celebration of classic beauty, combining floral elegance with the unmistakable depth and craftsmanship of Amouage.

Fragrance Family: Amber, Floral, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Tarragon, Lemon, Green Notes
Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Magnolia, Ylang-Ylang, Spicy Floral Accords
Base Notes: Amber, Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk, Precious Woods

title: L'Explicite Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L'Explicite Eau de Parfum — The House of Oud is a bold and irresistibly indulgent gourmand fragrance that transforms the comforting aroma of freshly baked pastries into an elegant and contemporary olfactory creation. Rich, playful, and sophisticated, the composition balances buttery sweetness with precious woods and warm spices, creating a scent that is both comforting and unexpectedly refined. It opens with the delectable aroma of cinnamon, cardamom, and crisp apple, offering a vibrant introduction that evokes the warmth of a gourmet bakery. At its heart, creamy pastry accords blend seamlessly with soft floral nuances and brown sugar, revealing a deliciously smooth gourmand character that is both luxurious and addictive. As the fragrance settles, rich vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood, amber, and musk create a velvety base that envelops the skin in a warm, long-lasting embrace. Decadent yet elegant, L'Explicite is a modern gourmand masterpiece that celebrates comfort, creativity, and the irresistible pleasure of indulgence.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand, Amber, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Apple, Cinnamon, Cardamom
Heart Notes: Pastry Accord, Brown Sugar, Soft Floral Accords
Base Notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Amber, Musk

title: Devil's Intrigue Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Devil's Intrigue Eau de Parfum — Haute Fragrance Company (HFC) is an opulent floral-gourmand fragrance that masterfully balances luminous elegance with irresistible sensuality. Created for those who appreciate bold sophistication and modern luxury, the composition intertwines luscious fruits, delicate florals, creamy gourmand nuances, and warm woods into a captivating scent with remarkable depth and refinement. It opens with the juicy sweetness of osmanthus and white tea, offering a fresh yet velvety introduction that is both radiant and inviting. At its heart, enchanting orange blossom and creamy sandalwood unfold with graceful sophistication, adding warmth and floral richness to the composition. As the fragrance settles, smooth vanilla, sensual cashmere wood, and soft musk create a luxurious, long-lasting base that envelops the skin in an elegant trail of comfort and allure. Seductive, refined, and unmistakably distinctive, Devil's Intrigue Eau de Parfum is a luxurious expression of modern elegance and irresistible charm.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Gourmand, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Osmanthus, White Tea
Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Sandalwood
Base Notes: Vanilla, Cashmere Wood, Musk

title: Three Little Owls Summer Hammer, Sun-Gria, and Black Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html: Three Little Owls Extrait de Parfum Collection — Lorenzo Pazzaglia is a vibrant trio of extrait de parfums that captures the carefree spirit of summer through three distinctive olfactory journeys. Summer Hammer, Sun-Gria, and Black Sea each interpret a different facet of the season—from tropical beaches and Mediterranean sunsets to the mysterious allure of the open sea. Crafted with Lorenzo Pazzaglia's signature intensity and exceptional concentration, these fragrances combine vivid natural accords with remarkable longevity, offering immersive sensory experiences that are both artistic and unforgettable.

title: Buongiorno Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Buongiorno — Acqua di Parma is a bright, elegant citrus-aromatic that captures Italian morning luminosity—fresh, refined, and effortlessly uplifting. This unisex composition pairs sparkling citrus peel with aromatic green-herbal facets and a clean, polished woody-musk base, creating a versatile, breezy scent ideal for daytime wear and warm-weather ease.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Italian lemon, petitgrain

title: Wild Vetiver Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Wild Vetiver Eau de Parfum, a fresh and refined fragrance that reimagines the elegance of vetiver with bright citrus and soft floral nuances. This sophisticated composition opens with sparkling bergamot, timur pepper, and pink pepper, creating a vibrant and slightly spicy introduction. The heart reveals a refined blend of rose, geranium, and blackcurrant, adding floral softness and subtle fruity depth. In the base, vetiver, cedarwood, and amberwood provide a long-lasting, structured trail that lingers with woody elegance and earthy freshness. Wild Vetiver is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances citrus brightness with refined woody depth. 

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic, Citrus 

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, timur pepper, pink pepper 

Middle notes: Rose, geranium, blackcurrant

title: Mefisto Gentiluomo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Mefisto Gentiluomo Eau de Parfum, a refined and elegant fragrance inspired by classic Italian barbershop traditions and timeless gentlemanly style. This sophisticated composition opens with bright citrus and aromatic lavender accords, creating a fresh and uplifting introduction. The heart reveals a refined blend of iris, violet, and rose, adding powdery elegance and floral softness. In the base, amber, cedarwood, and musk provide a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with woody warmth and clean sophistication. Mefisto Gentiluomo is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances fresh citrus brightness with powdery floral elegance and classic woody depth. 

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic, Woody

title: Vanille Havane Cuir des Abysses Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vanille Havane Cuir des Abysses Eau de Parfum

Discover Vanille Havane Cuir des Abysses Eau de Parfum, a dark and opulent fragrance that blends gourmand richness with raw leathery intensity. This captivating composition opens with warm spices, rum, and dried fruits, creating a bold and intoxicating introduction. The heart reveals a luxurious fusion of vanilla, tobacco, cacao, and subtle floral nuances, adding depth, sweetness, and refined complexity. In the base, Russian leather, birch tar, woody notes, amber, and animalic accords create a long-lasting, enveloping trail that lingers with smoky warmth, sensual power, and untamed elegance.
