title: Cambodi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cambodi Eau de Parfum, launched in October 2017, is a unisex Woody-Agarwood fragrance crafted by Ali Abdulla Almarzooqi using premium oils from Barcelona and Spain. The composition weaves fruity and Oriental accords with rich agarwood notes, creating a sensorial experience of refined complexity. Oud and amber add warmth and sweetness, elevating the composition with luxurious depth. Designed to enhance special occasions and elevate personal presence with distinctive character and sophistication.

Fragrance family: Oud, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Agarwood (Oud), Oriental notes and Fruity Notes

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Woodsy Notes

Base notes: Musk

title: Archetipo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Archetipo Eau de Parfum transcends conventional fragrance, functioning as a portal to primordial consciousness and ancestral memory. This composition exists in profound stillness—a space where flickering candlelight dances across moonstone and marble, invoking the archetypal scents embedded within the human soul before language and culture shaped perception. Archetipo awakens dormant olfactory memories, dissolving the boundaries between past and present, reality and imagination. It represents a return to the tabula rasa—a liberation from fragrance stereotypes and a reconnection with the universal scent archetypes that Plato himself might have recognized in his cave of shadows. This is not merely a fragrance; it is an invitation to transcend temporal constraints and access the primordial essence that dwells within. With each application, you venture beyond the veil of ordinary perception, encountering the shadowed truths of your authentic self—simultaneously distant and intimately near.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Balsam Fir, Incense and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Smoke

Base notes: Black Amber, Oakmoss, Vetiver, Labdanum, Cashmere Wood and Patchouli

title: Kirke Overdose Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Marking its 10th anniversary, this limited edition of Kirke Overdose Extrait de Parfum honors the captivating myth of the enchantress Circe. Tiziana Terenzi’s iconic fragrance, beloved for a decade, is now presented in an elegant celebratory box. The bottle, inspired by a Grecian vase from the Metropolitan Museum, contains a rich blend of Brazilian passion fruit, alpine muguet, and Madagascan bourbon vanilla, embodying a timeless and sophisticated scent experience.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Peach, Bulgarian Rose and Raspberry

Middle notes: Blackcurrant, Gardenia, Sand, Lily of the Valley and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Musk, Bourbon Vanilla, Australian Sandalwood, Indian Patchouli, Ambergris and Heliotrope

title: Latte Di Cherry Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Latte Di Cherry Extrait de Parfum is a luscious blend that combines fruity and velvety notes, evoking the vibrant spirit of an unforgettable evening. This fragrance captures a delicious concentration of joie de vivre, inviting you to savor its rich aroma as if sipping a fine cocktail. Expertly crafted, it envelops the senses in a euphoric mood, making every moment feel celebratory and full of life. Perfect for those who appreciate a sophisticated scent that balances sweetness with depth, Latte Di Cherry offers a unique olfactory experience that lingers beautifully throughout the day.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Almond, Red Berries and Sweet Orange

Middle notes: Spices, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Turkish Rose

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk, Amber and Vetiver.

title: Kirke Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Kirke Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of the enchanting landscape south of Rome with its sensual, magical composition. This sophisticated fragrance opens with sweet fruit notes of passion fruit, peach, and pear, artfully blended with raspberry and cassis. The heart reveals delicate lily of the valley, while the base combines heliotropine, patchouli, and musk wood for a mysterious, captivating trail that evokes the seductive power of the goddess Circe.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Peach, Pear, Raspberry, Cassis and Sand

Middle notes: Lily-of-the-Valley

title: Golestan Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the graceful and sophisticated blend of blooming flowers in a vibrant garden. First impressions are of fresh citrus and rich ylang, while Bulgarian rose absolute softens the exuberant doses of white flower absolutes: jasmine, tuberose, and orange blossom. The natural absolutes create a dynamic and abundant floral perfume, with a rich base of creamy patchouli and sweet, soft woods. Golestan is a seductive classic with an uncompromising and original twist.

title: Complex Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Complex Eau de Parfum is a blend of heady base notes, violet, incense, sage, and basil, achieving its alluring complexity through perfumery expertise. This distinguished fragrance is sexy, suggestive, and confident with a long-lasting effect on the skin, showcasing the multifaceted nature of your distinct personality. A true tour de force of power and seduction from the iconic Boadicea the Victorious brand.

body_html: Indulge in a refined and arousing scent that combines refreshing citrus notes with rich, sensual undertones. Our exclusive formula captures the authentic essence of human intimacy, leaving you feeling invigorated and balanced.

title: The Moon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Released in 2019, The Moon by Frederic Malle is a unisex Oriental Floral perfume created by expert perfumer Julien Rasquinet. Its scent profile includes a blend of fruits, spices, and resins, with notes of rose oud, frankincense, and ripe red berries. Sweet raspberry and red currant mix with floral violet and rose, while underlying strength is provided by patchouli, sandalwood, and agarwood, accompanied by warm amber aromas.

title: Teint de Neige Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Teint de Neige Eau de Toilette, released in 2000, is an exquisite blend of delicate rose and powdery notes. The top notes feature jasmine, rose, and ylang ylang, while the heart consists of Tonka, jasmine, and rose, along with sweet, powdery, and floral elements. The base notes offer a hint of heliotrope and musk.

title: Replica By the Fireplace Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Enjoy the comforting embrace of a crackling wood fire with REPLICA By The Fireplace, a warm and spicy unisex fragrance from Maison Margiela, launched in 2015. This Eau de Toilette evokes memories of roasting chestnuts in a chimney, with a blend of smoky guaiac wood, cashmeran, and clove oil. The scent also includes notes of red berries and chestnuts, while the sweet touch of vanilla adds to the cozy sensation. Perfect for the colder months, By The Fireplace is a versatile and inviting fragrance for both men and women, though the dominant notes may lean more towards the masculine side.

title: New York Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the irresistible aroma of New York as captured in this Extrait de Parfum. With sparkling bergamot and mandarin, complemented perfectly by a floral bouquet and subtle hints of tonka bean and tobacco, this fragrance captures the essence of Central Park in springtime.

title: Liberty Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the enchanting scent of Liberty Eau de Parfum. Mystical saffron meets delicate white lily for a warm and spicy aroma, while oriental and patchouli notes add a rich and unique touch. Embrace the heritage of leather with this captivating fragrance.

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Crystal Amber and Patchouli

title: La Femme Camelia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The frigid air envelops them as they make their way through the willow trees that line the winding river. The soft light emanating from the windows draws them closer, knowing exactly who they will find inside. Her name falls from their lips like melting candles. In the warmth of her presence, surrounded by the scents of orchids and tobacco flowers, they enter a world of fantasy and desire. They touch her, their hunger evident, as she reigns over both peasants and princes, reveling in their undivided attention. As they throw their wishes into the well, hoping to capture her enchanting essence, she remains intoxicatingly aloof, lost in the smoke of her cigarette.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Apple, Peach, Green Pear, Lemon, Bergamot

Middle notes: Tagete, Rose, Leather, Oud

Base notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Birch

title: Escentric 02 Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Escentric 02 and Molecule 02 make up the second synthetic fragrance duo from Escentric Molecules. This pair is inspired by grey amber's essential fragrance component, ambroxan, which takes center stage. Similar to Escentric 01, the fragrance also contains expertly crafted imitations of natural scents, such as muscone for musk, jasmine-scented hedione, elderflower extract, and orris. The result is a light, invigorating beginning (elderflower and hedione) and a cozy, warm finish.

Fragrance family: Woody, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Almdudler, Juniper Berry, Mandarine, Lime, Bergamot

Middle notes: Ginger, Freesia, Clary Sage, Pink Pepper, Hedione (green jasmine bud), Orris

Base notes: Muscone (Musk), AMBROXAN™, Vetiver, Tonka

title: Dirty Heaven Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As an expert in the industry, I can tell you that Dirty Heaven Eau de Parfum opens with a brilliant burst of white flowers - jasmine and neroli. What sets it apart is its ability to amplify the flowers' natural sweetness rather than tame it. A creamy tonka bean adds a richness, complemented by a hint of saffron spice that brings warmth to the heart. But it's the base where things truly get interesting: notes of ambroxan, vanilla, and white musks create a sensual warmth, while grey amber and modern woods add a subtle, animalic edge. It's a surprising combination that becomes addictive. For those who seek beauty with a touch of intrigue, Dirty Heaven is the perfect choice. The scent is captivating and mysterious, evoking a sense of something deliciously out of reach.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jasmine, Neroli, White Flowers

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Saffron, Ambroxan

Base notes: Vanilla, White Musks, Grey Amber, Modern Woods

title: Changing Constance Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Changing Constance belongs to the Penhaligon's Portrait collection and is said to be made for the modern woman. The fragrance opens with notes of pimento and cardamom, with the heart of salted caramel and the base of woody floral harmonies. The notes also include cashmeran, tobacco and vanilla.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom and Pimento

Middle notes: Caramel and Salt

Base notes: Vanilla, Cashmeran and Tobacco

title: Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating allure of Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum by Byredo. Inspired by the fusion of African and French cultures, this scent boasts sensual notes of woods and spices, paired with delicate floral essences. Embody cultural beauty with every wear

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Amalfi Lemon, Marigold, Black Currant, Bergamot and African Orange Flower

Middle notes: Violet, Cyclamen and Jasmine

Base notes:Vetiver, Musk, Amber and Virginia Cedar

title: Azaran Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating and distinctive scent of Azaran Eau de Parfum. This luxurious fragrance boasts notes of rich leather, warm wood, and rare saffron, enhanced by the exotic essence of Virginia cedarwood.

Fragrance family: Leather, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Bergamot

Middle notes: Green Tea and Cedar

Base notes: Leather, Beeswax and Woody Notes

title: Aventus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Aventus Eau de Parfum by Henry Creed boasts a complex blend of fruity and earthy scents, including peppery rose, birch, jasmine, and patchouli. The base notes of oakmoss, ambergris, and vanilla add a subtle yet satisfying finish.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Black Currant, Apple, Lemon and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Pineapple, Patchouli and Moroccan Jasmine

Base notes: Birch, Musk, oak moss, Ambroxan and Cedarwood

title: Japanese Whiskey Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the contemplative beauty of Japanese poetry and the quiet pleasure of living in the moment, Japanese Whiskey celebrates the art of savoring life without reservation. Its poetic inspiration reflects a humble acceptance of existence, finding contentment in the simple pleasures of the present and embracing the freedom of nature beyond this life.

The composition unfolds with the rich,spirited character of whiskey, evoking the warmth of aged spirits and the depth of a contemplative evening. Mizunara oak and malted barley introduce a distinctly Japanese woody character, complemented by the aromatic freshness of clary sage. As the fragrance develops, sandalwood brings creamy warmth,while chestnut adds a subtle nutty richness, creating a smooth and meditative finish.

Fragrance Family: Whiskey,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Whiskey

Middle Notes: Mizunara Oak,Malted Barley,Clary Sage

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Chestnut

title: Havana Tonka Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Part of Byredo’s Night Veils collection of highly concentrated extraits de parfum, Havana Tonka captures the evocative sensuality of Havana’s golden nights. Inspired by the city’s amber-lit atmosphere, the fragrance evokes a world of intoxicating rum,smoky tobacco,and the rich warmth of roasted tonka bean.

The composition opens with the vibrant freshness of bergamot and pink peppercorn, enriched by the spirited warmth of rum and the creamy sweetness of crème brûlée. At the heart, smoky tobacco leaves intertwine with violet,cashmere wood,and white suede,creating a sophisticated interplay of texture and depth. As the fragrance evolves, roasted tonka bean absolute reveals its addictive richness, complemented by patchouli,resinoid,and skin musks that leave a warm,lasting trail.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Gourmand,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Rum,Pink Peppercorn,Crème Brûlée

Middle Notes: Tobacco Leaves Accord,Violet,Cashmere Wood,White Suede

Base Notes: Roasted Tonka Bean Absolute,Patchouli,Resinoid,Skin Musks

title: Epic Man Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Epic Man Eau de Parfum is an evocative journey inspired by the legendary Silk Road, where ancient trade routes connected distant lands through stories of discovery, precious materials, and cultural exchange. Created for Amouage by perfumer Randa Hammami, the fragrance draws on the imagery of a caravan travelling from China to Arabia, transforming incense, spices, woods, and leather into a rich and majestic olfactory landscape.

The fragrance opens with pink bay, saffron, cardamom, nutmeg, and mace, creating a warm and aromatic introduction with a distinctive spicy character. At the heart, geranium, myrrh, and olibanum deepen the composition with an incense-rich and resinous dimension. The base unfolds through agarwood, sandalwood, patchouli, leather, castoreum, styrax, and musk, creating a dark, powerful, and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pink Bay,Saffron,Cardamom,Nutmeg,Mace

Middle Notes: Geranium,Myrrh,Olibanum

Base Notes: Agarwood,Sandalwood,Patchouli,Leather,Castoreum,Styrax,Musk

title: Sol Salgado Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sol Salgado Extrait de Parfum is an evocative celebration of sun-kissed skin and the shimmering sensuality of salt. Inspired by the magic of an endless summer, this radiant composition captures the intimate warmth of skin touched by sunlight and sea air, creating a luminous fragrance that feels both natural and deeply seductive.

The fragrance opens with the delicate floral softness of linden blossom, mimosa, and cotton flower, creating a luminous and airy introduction. At the heart, salt and heliotrope are enriched by the mineral warmth of ambergris, evoking the crystalline atmosphere of sunlit shores. The composition settles into sandalwood, skin musks, and smoked vanilla, creating a warm, creamy, and sensual trail that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Linden Blossom,Mimosa,Cotton Flower

Middle Notes: Salt,Heliotrope,Ambergris

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Skin Musks,Smoked Vanilla

title: Grand Beau Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Grand Beau Extrait de Parfum is an evocative portrait of a day spent beside the sea, beyond the nearest dunes, beneath the shade of pine trees. Inspired by the French Riviera and the meeting of coastal air, aromatic forests, and distant waves, this distinctive fragrance captures a vision of radiant freshness with an elegant, mineral depth.

The fragrance opens with pine, juniper berry, and tuberose, creating a fresh and aromatic introduction where coniferous greenery meets a delicate floral presence. At the heart, olibanum, vetiver, and tonka bean bring together resinous warmth, earthy refinement, and a subtle sweetness. The composition settles into a distinctive base of ambrette, seaweed, and Ambrocenide, creating a musky, woody, and subtly saline trail reminiscent of dry driftwood and the sea breeze.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic,Woody,Fresh

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pine,Juniper Berry,Tuberose

Middle Notes: Olibanum,Vetiver,Tonka Bean

Base Notes: Ambrette,Seaweed,Ambrocenide

title: Fleur Danger Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Fleur Danger Extrait de Parfum is a flower forged rather than grown—a bold, futuristic interpretation of nature shaped by friction, tension, and steel. Created by perfumer Ugo Charron for the Flowers for Future collection, the fragrance imagines a flower that pierces rather than blooms, protecting its delicate beauty beneath a metallic exterior. The result is an uncompromising composition where organic sensuality meets an artificial, visionary edge.

The fragrance opens with the striking tension of a steel accord, pink pepper, and rum, creating a sharp and electrifying first impression. At the heart, saffron and raspberry introduce warmth and vibrant contrast, while Suederal brings a smooth, tactile leathery character. The composition settles into Orcanox, gurjum balsam, and sandalwood, leaving a warm, woody and enveloping trail beneath its cool metallic aura.

Fragrance Family: Spicy,Leathery,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Steel,Pink Pepper,Rum

Middle Notes: Saffron,Raspberry,Suederal

Base Notes: Orcanox,Gurjum Balsam,Sandalwood

title: Velvet Tonka Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Tonka Extrait de Parfum is an intense reinterpretation of BDK Parfums’ signature Velvet Tonka, drawing inspiration from the meeting of David Benedek’s Moroccan heritage and the creative energy of Paris. Richer, denser, and more textured than the original, this contemporary composition explores the sensual depth of tonka bean through a luminous gourmand character, enriched by roasted pistachio and dark saffiano leather.

The fragrance opens with a distinctive pistachio accord and Cosmofruit™, creating an immediately addictive and textured introduction. At the heart, orange blossom and tonka bean bring together floral radiance and creamy gourmand warmth, recalling the richness of caramelised Moroccan pastries. The composition settles into a deep base of vanilla, tobacco, and Saffiano leather, creating an ambery, sensual trail with a sophisticated leathery dimension.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Gourmand,Leathery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pistachio Accord,Cosmofruit™

Middle Notes: Orange Blossom,Tonka Bean

Base Notes: Vanilla,Tobacco,Saffiano Leather

title: Sun Bleached Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sun Bleached Extrait de Parfum is a more intense and enveloping interpretation of Une Nuit Nomade’s luminous signature, inspired by the radiant light of ancient Egypt and the mythology of Ra, the sun god. Its composition explores the contrast between the freshness of clean linen and the sensual warmth of precious floral and resinous notes, creating a powerful yet refined trail.

The fragrance opens with the soft, musky warmth of ambrette butter, brightened by the aromatic spice of cardamom. At the heart, tuberose absolute unfolds alongside a clean linen accord, evoking the sensation of sun-dried fabric glowing beneath a brilliant sky. The drydown reveals the comforting richness of vanilla and the resinous depth of myrrh, leaving a smooth, warm, and luminous impression.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Floral,Musky,Resinous

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Ambrette Butter,Cardamom

Middle Notes: Tuberose Absolute,Clean Linen Accord

Base Notes: Vanilla,Myrrh

title: Skadi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by Skadi, the Norse goddess of winter and mountains, Skadi Eau de Parfum captures the untamed beauty and quiet power of the Nordic wilderness. Created by Ibrahim Al-Zoubi, this unisex fragrance evokes frost-kissed landscapes, silent forests, and the comforting warmth of a hidden ember beneath the winter air. Its composition balances crisp fruit and sparkling citrus with delicate florals, aromatic resins, and a velvety amber-musk foundation.

The fragrance opens with juicy pear and crisp apple, illuminated by sparkling citrus. Hazelnut adds a subtle nutty warmth, while olibanum introduces a resinous, mystical nuance. At the heart, apricot-like osmanthus and golden saffron blend with rose, amberette, moss, and amyl salicylate, creating a sophisticated floral warmth. The drydown envelops the skin in rich labdanum and smooth vanilla, supported by Cetalox, ambrettolide, and Helvetolide for a soft, modern amber-musk trail.

Fragrance Family: Amber,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pear,Apple,Citruses,Hazelnut,Olibanum

Middle Notes: Osmanthus,Saffron,Rose,Amberette,Oakmoss,Amyl Salicylate

Base Notes: Labdanum,Vanilla,Cetalox,Ambrettolide,Helvetolide

title: Iridium 71% Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Iridium 71% is an exceptionally concentrated interpretation of Tom Daxon’s signature Iridium, created to reveal new layers of complexity through an extraordinary 71% fragrance-oil concentration. Described as the olfactory equivalent of charcoal-coloured cashmere, it combines the powdery sophistication of precious iris with a cool, silvery character and an unmistakably refined modernity.

The fragrance opens with crisp juniper,green angelica,and earthy carrot seed, creating a fresh yet intriguing introduction. At the heart, iris emerges with a smooth, powdery elegance, lending the composition its distinctive silvery texture. The drydown introduces vetiver and cedarwood, enriched by Iso E Super, creating a clean, woody trail that feels both understated and deeply sophisticated.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Floral,Powdery,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Juniper,Angelica,Carrot Seed

Middle Notes: Iris

Base Notes: Vetiver,Cedarwood,Iso E Super

title: Pomelo Oolong Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the quiet elegance of Chinese tea culture, Pomelo Oolong captures a moment of reflection and connection in a sunlit tea house. The fragrance brings together the deep, refined character of oolong tea with the sparkling freshness of pomelo, creating a serene composition that feels both refreshing and contemplative.

The opening introduces the crisp brightness of pomelo, before unfolding into the delicate floral warmth of osmanthus and the smooth, mineral impression of porcelain. At the heart, oolong tea becomes the defining signature, evoking the roasted, comforting character of freshly brewed leaves. A veil of white musk completes the composition with a soft, clean finish that lingers close to the skin.

Fragrance Family: Tea,Fresh

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pomelo,Oolong Tea

Middle Notes: Osmanthus,Porcelain

Base Notes: White Musk

title: Melon Malo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Melon Malo is a playful yet provocative creation from BORNTOSTANDOUT®,turning the juicy freshness of melon into an unexpectedly sensual olfactory statement. Bright,creamy,and addictive,the fragrance plays with the contrast between refreshing fruit and indulgent sweetness,creating a bold gourmand character with a distinctly contemporary attitude.

The fragrance opens with watermelon,bergamot,and pink pepper,creating a sparkling and juicy introduction. At the heart,melon,peach,and coconut milk create a creamy tropical accord,while jasmine adds a soft floral touch. The drydown reveals vanilla,amberwood,musk,and sandalwood,bringing warmth,creaminess,and depth to the lingering trail.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Gourmand,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Watermelon,Bergamot,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Melon,Peach,Coconut Milk,Jasmine

Base Notes: Vanilla,Amberwood,Musk,Sandalwood

title: N°1 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
N°1 is a sophisticated expression from Donbablic,created as a statement of individuality,elegance,and refined sensuality. The fragrance brings together luminous citrus,aromatic spices,precious florals,and deep woods,creating a distinctive composition with a luxurious and confident character.

The fragrance opens with bergamot,lemon,black pepper,and cardamom,creating a bright and invigorating introduction. At the heart,iris,rose,jasmine,and violet add a refined floral and powdery dimension. The drydown develops into a rich blend of cedarwood,sandalwood,vetiver,amber,and musk,creating a smooth,warm,and enduring trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Floral,Spicy,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Lemon,Black Pepper,Cardamom

Middle Notes: Iris,Rose,Jasmine,Violet

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Sandalwood,Vetiver,Amber,Musk

title: Last Dance in Stockholm Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Last Dance in Stockholm is an evocative unisex fragrance from Donbablic, inspired by the romantic atmosphere of a final dance beneath the lights of Stockholm. The composition captures the bittersweet beauty of a fleeting moment,combining cool freshness with elegant florals,soft woods,and sensual warmth.

The fragrance opens with bergamot,lemon,black pepper,and cardamom,creating a bright yet spicy introduction. At the heart,iris,rose,jasmine,and violet create a sophisticated floral bouquet with a subtle powdery character. The drydown reveals cedarwood,sandalwood,vetiver,amber,and white musk,creating a smooth,woody,and intimate finish.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Spicy,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Lemon,Black Pepper,Cardamom

Middle Notes: Iris,Rose,Jasmine,Violet

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Sandalwood,Vetiver,Amber,White Musk

title: Koeba Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Koeba is a rich and captivating unisex fragrance from Donbablic, inspired by the luxurious character of a fine Cuban cigar. The composition recreates the atmosphere of aged and fermented tobacco leaves stored in handmade cedarwood boxes,combining tobacco,dried fruits,precious woods,and warm resins into a sophisticated and memorable olfactory experience.

The fragrance opens with tobacco absolute,propolis,dried plums,and raisins,creating a rich and slightly sweet introduction. At the heart,amberwood,tobacco accord,oakwood,and Atlas cedarwood deepen the composition with a dry,woody character. The base brings creamy sandalwood,amber,myrrh,cade wood,benzoin,and guaiac wood,creating a warm,resinous,and subtly smoky finish.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Smoky,Resinous

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Tobacco Absolute,Propolis,Dried Plums,Raisins

Middle Notes: Amberwood,Tobacco Accord,Oakwood,Atlas Cedarwood

Base Notes: Creamy Sandalwood,Amber,Myrrh,Cade Wood,Benzoin,Guaiac Wood

title: Spectre 568 - 147 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Spectre 568 - 147,The Fall of Fluidic Fauna, is an evocative unisex fragrance from Alûstre that explores the delicate meeting point between fluid freshness and blooming florals. Its composition creates an impression of lightness and calm,where aquatic and ozonic nuances flow through a luminous floral landscape before settling into a soft,creamy base.

The fragrance opens with bergamot,caviar lemon,cedrat,and melon,creating a sparkling and refreshing citrus-fruity introduction. At the heart,violet flower,iris,ozonic effects,marine notes,rose,peony,magnolia,and orchid create an airy and richly layered floral accord. The drydown reveals white musk,patchouli,sandalwood,ambergris,crystallized oakmoss,and honey,bringing warmth,depth,and sensual softness.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Ozonic,Marine,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Caviar Lemon,Cedrat,Melon

Middle Notes: Violet Flower,Iris,Ozonic Effects,Marine Notes,Rose,Peony,Magnolia,Orchid

Base Notes: White Musk,Patchouli,Sandalwood,Ambergris,Crystallized Oakmoss,Honey

title: Lust in Paradise 10 Years Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Lust in Paradise 10 Years is a celebratory interpretation of Ex Nihilo’s iconic Lust in Paradise,created to commemorate a decade of the Parisian fragrance house. The composition captures the radiant,seductive atmosphere of the French Riviera,where luminous florals,juicy fruits,and creamy woods evoke a sun-drenched escape filled with elegance and desire.

The fragrance opens with sparkling pink pepper and lychee,bringing a bright and sensual fruity freshness. At the heart,peony,rose,and orange blossom create a luminous floral bouquet,while the base introduces white musk,cedarwood,and amber for a soft,creamy,and sophisticated finish.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pink Pepper,Lychee

Middle Notes: Peony,Rose,Orange Blossom

Base Notes: White Musk,Cedarwood,Amber

title: Fleur Narcotique 10 Years Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fleur Narcotique 10 Years is a limited-edition celebration of one of Ex Nihilo’s signature creations,created to mark the house’s tenth anniversary. Presented in a collectible bottle,the fragrance preserves the sophisticated and seductive character of Fleur Narcotique while celebrating its distinctive floral identity.

The composition opens with sparkling bergamot,juicy lychee,and peach,creating a fresh and luminous fruity introduction. At the heart,jasmine,peony,and orange blossom unfold into a sensual floral bouquet. The drydown reveals transparent wood,moss,and musk,leaving a soft,elegant,and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Lychee,Peach

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Peony,Orange Blossom

Base Notes: Transparent Wood,Moss,Musk

title: Perception Parfum
body_html:
Perception is a sophisticated expression from Spirit of Kings’ Wisdom Collection, created around the commanding presence, charisma, and approachability associated with royalty. Inspired by the qualities of insight, awareness, and refined judgment, the fragrance explores the contrast between a powerful first impression and the warmth that makes true leadership approachable.

The composition opens with a vibrant and aromatic blend of bergamot,birch,ylang-ylang,thyme,rosemary,and cognac, creating a green and spicy introduction. The heart reveals a refined floral and powdery character through orris,rhubarb,violet,jasmine,geranium,and heliotrope. In the drydown, vetiver,patchouli,sandalwood,leather,labdanum,styrax,musk,vanilla,and amber create a rich,deep,and warm foundation.

Fragrance Family: Spicy,Oriental,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Birch,Ylang-Ylang,Thyme,Rosemary,Cognac

Middle Notes: Orris,Rhubarb,Violet,Jasmine,Geranium,Heliotrope

Base Notes: Vetiver,Patchouli,Sandalwood,Leather,Labdanum,Styrax,Musk,Vanilla,Amber

title: Imperial Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Imperial Extrait de Parfum by Wesker is an elegant and mysterious fragrance inspired by an enchanted garden surrounded by endless green meadows. A path lined with blooming linden trees leads into a garden filled with delicate jasmine,deep cherry fruits,and violets,while a majestic fortress rises above the landscape. The composition captures this dreamlike setting through a refined interplay of luminous florals,soft textures,and subtle mineral depth.

The fragrance opens with linden blossom,sour cherry,jasmine,and clover,creating a fresh,delicate,and slightly fruity introduction. At the heart,mimosa,violets,lily of the valley,and an intriguing iron accord create a sophisticated floral composition with a cool,mineral character. The drydown becomes soft and intimate,with parchment,almonds,cotton,and white musk creating a smooth,powdery,and comforting finish.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Powdery,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Linden Blossom,Sour Cherry,Jasmine,Clover
Middle Notes: Mimosa,Iron,Violets,Lily of the Valley
Base Notes: Parchment,Almonds,Cotton,White Musk

title: Pinar del Rio Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Pinar del Rio Extrait de Parfum by AAWED is a rich and atmospheric fragrance inspired by the lush landscapes of Pinar del Río in western Cuba,where fertile earth,tropical vegetation,and the unmistakable character of tobacco country create an intoxicating sense of place. The composition captures the spirit of Cuba through aromatic freshness,warm spices,and deep woody accords.

The fragrance opens with bergamot,lemon,and spicy pink pepper,creating a bright and invigorating introduction. At the heart,tobacco leaves,cedarwood,and earthy aromatic nuances bring warmth and depth,evoking the rich landscape and traditional tobacco fields of Pinar del Río. The drydown unfolds into a smooth blend of vanilla,patchouli,vetiver,and amber,leaving a warm,woody,and sensual trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Tobacco,Amber

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Lemon,Pink Pepper
Middle Notes: Tobacco Leaf,Cedarwood,Earthy Notes
Base Notes: Vanilla,Patchouli,Vetiver,Amber

title: Junoon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Junoon Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums is an evocative fragrance inspired by the legendary love story of Leyla and Majnoon, capturing the passion,idealistic devotion,and spiritual intensity of a love that transcends the ordinary. Created by perfumer Hamid Merati Kashani, Junoon explores the simultaneous pain and bliss of love through a rich composition of saffron,rose,patchouli,and oud.

The fragrance opens with the aromatic freshness of sage and lavender,joined by the intoxicating presence of tuberose. At the heart,silky saffron,rose,and patchouli are deepened by labdanum,creating a warm and sensual expression of longing and devotion. The drydown reveals the woody depth of oud,alongside tonka bean and vanilla,leaving a rich and enveloping trail inspired by sleepless nights and boundless dreams.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Woody,Floral

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Sage,Lavender,Tuberose
Heart Notes: Patchouli,Labdanum,Rose,Saffron
Base Notes: Patchouli,Oud,Tonka Bean,Vanilla

title: Garden of Youth Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Garden of Youth Eau de Parfum is a vibrant floral fragrance inspired by the vision of an Indian princess entering a flourishing baag,a garden in full bloom. Created by perfumer Jordi Fernandez,it captures the rich aromas of fragrant Indian flowers,the freshness of spring,and the youthful vitality of a new season. Luminous,exotic,and sensual,it evokes a garden filled with blossoming flowers,dreams,and the promise of renewal.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of Lime,spiced Pink Peppercorn,warm Saffron,and juicy Blackcurrant,creating a bright and intriguing introduction. At the heart,Rose,Ylang Ylang,Jasmine,Tuberose,Champak,and Rangoon Creeper create an opulent floral bouquet filled with creamy,exotic,and intoxicating nuances. The drydown becomes warm and sensual,with Leather,Vanilla,and Amber forming a rich and enveloping foundation.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity,Spicy,Amber

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lime,Pink Peppercorn,Saffron,Blackcurrant
Heart Notes: Rose,Ylang Ylang,Jasmine,Tuberose,Champak,Rangoon Creeper
Base Notes: Leather,Vanilla,Amber

title: Forbidden Words Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Forbidden Words Eau de Parfum is a dark and seductive fragrance built around the intoxicating tension between temptation and restraint. Sasva describes it as the scent of forbidden desire,the freedom of surrendering to one’s deepest impulses,and secret encounters beneath the moonlight. Smoky tobacco and spicy pink pepper create an intriguing opening,while decadent oud and vanilla deepen the composition before leather,patchouli,and amber leave a mysterious and sensual trail.

The fragrance opens with the refreshing brightness of Lime,contrasted by the spicy warmth of Pink Pepper and the smoky richness of Tobacco. At the heart,Oud,Vanilla,and Cedarwood create a decadent blend of creamy sweetness,dark woods,and exotic depth. The drydown becomes deeper and more sensual,with Leather,Patchouli,and Dry Amber creating a warm,smoky,and sophisticated foundation.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Amber,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lime,Pink Pepper,Tobacco
Heart Notes: Oud,Vanilla,Cedarwood
Base Notes: Leather,Patchouli,Dry Amber

title: Floruits Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Floruits Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant and expressive unisex fragrance built around the spirit of personal discovery. “Your world,your journey!” is the invitation at its heart,with each facet unfolding like a new chapter in an evocative olfactory story. Juicy tropical fruit,citrus,and luminous florals create a bright and uplifting character,while mossy and ambery accords add depth and sensuality.

The fragrance opens with the exotic sweetness of Passion Fruit and the sparkling freshness of Mandarin,creating a juicy,citrusy introduction. At the heart,Freesia,Jasmine,and Muguet bloom into a delicate and radiant floral bouquet. The drydown becomes warmer and more sensual as Mossy Notes and Ambery Notes create a smooth,earthy,and enveloping finish.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral

Olfactive Pyramid

title: Bo-Bo Intenso Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Bo-Bo Intenso Extrait de Parfum — Carner Barcelona is a richer and creamier interpretation of the house’s vibrant Mediterranean Bo-Bo, transforming its fresh citrus-floral character into a more sensual and enveloping composition. Launched in 2026, it combines sparkling citrus and juicy pear with luminous white florals, before settling into a soft, warm base of sandalwood, vanilla, white amber, and musk.

It opens with bergamot, mandarin, and pear, creating a bright, juicy, and refreshing introduction. At its heart, lily of the valley, orange blossom, and jasmine create a luminous white-floral bouquet with a delicate sweetness. As the fragrance settles, musk, sandalwood, white amber, and vanilla create a smooth, creamy, and warm drydown that gives the Intense version its richer character.

title: Felicity Extreme Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Felicity Extreme Extrait de Parfum — Paradis des Sens is a refined woody-aromatic-spicy fragrance created by Sébastien Martin as part of the The Overdrive collection. It is built around a quiet sense of strength, combining crisp aromatic freshness with elegant woods, earthy moss, and soft suede. The brand describes it as controlled, confident, and naturally commanding.

It opens with cardamom, bergamot, and juniper berry, creating a fresh, dry, and aromatic introduction. At its heart, clary sage, cashmere wood, and sandalwood bring a smooth, warm, and refined woody character. As the fragrance settles, oakmoss, patchouli, and suede create an earthy, slightly leathery base with depth and sophistication.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Aromatic,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

title: Coffeee Passion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Coffeee Passion Extrait de Parfum — Lorenzo Pazzaglia is a rich woody-spicy gourmand fragrance built around the comforting ritual of coffee. Inspired by coffee as a symbol of tradition, sharing, conversation, and memories of home, the composition combines intense coffee with hazelnut, chocolate, caramel, coconut milk, vanilla, and toasted woods. The result is an enveloping and unmistakably gourmand fragrance designed to leave a warm, distinctive trail.

It opens with cinnamon, coconut, Arabica coffee, hazelnuts, and dates, creating a warm, sweet, nutty introduction with a spicy edge. At its heart, coffee, chocolate, caramel, coconut milk, tonka bean, and heliotrope create a creamy, rich gourmand accord. As the fragrance settles, toasted coffee, cedarwood, benzoin, sugar, vanilla, and white musk create a smooth, warm, woody base with lingering sweetness and depth.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Heart Notes: Coffee,Chocolate,Caramel,Coconut Milk,Tonka Bean,Heliotrope

title: Pink Milk Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Pink Milk Extrait de Parfum — Lorenzo Pazzaglia is a luminous gourmand-floral fragrance inspired by an enchanted night beneath a deep blue sky, where sparkling stars meet the soft, comforting sweetness of milk, rose petals, cookies, and coconut. The fragrance combines vibrant citrus with velvety roses and creamy gourmand accords, creating a dreamy and irresistibly comforting composition.

It opens with pink grapefruit, lemon, sweet orange, bergamot, pink pepper, cinnamon, and Pakistani rose, creating a bright citrus-spicy introduction with a delicate rosy facet. At its heart, Damask rose, Bulgarian rose, peony, heliotrope, cookie accord, sweet almond, lychee, raspberry, and coconut create a creamy, fruity, powdery, and gourmand bouquet. As the fragrance settles, fior di latte, vanilla berries, cane sugar, white musk, tonka bean, vetiver, and sandalwood create a smooth, milky, sweet, and softly woody base.

title: Pomelo Malindi Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Pomelo Malindi Extrait de Parfum — New Notes is a radiant citrus-aromatic fragrance inspired by the sunlit coastal atmosphere of Malindi. The composition captures the meeting of juicy citrus and an icy sea breeze, combining sparkling pomelo and exotic yuzu with aromatic herbs, luminous florals, and a warm woody-amber base. New Notes describes the fragrance as an olfactory journey where the freshness of the ocean meets the zest of ripe pomelo.

It opens with pomelo, yuzu, lemon, lime, and an icy accord, creating a crisp, sparkling, and invigorating citrus introduction. At its heart, coriander, nutmeg, mint, orange blossom, and jasmine introduce aromatic spice and a soft floral dimension. As the fragrance settles, patchouli, sandalwood, cedarwood, white amber, and musk create a smooth, warm, and sensual woody foundation that balances the bright opening.

title: Changing Constance Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Changing Constance Eau de Parfum Intense — Penhaligon's is a bold, spicy-gourmand fragrance that gives the iconic Constance character a deeper, more intense expression. Part of the Portraits Collection, this 2026 interpretation revolves around the contrast of fiery pimento, indulgent salted caramel, and luxurious saffron.

It opens with pimento, creating a warm, peppery introduction with an energetic spicy edge. At its heart, salted caramel brings a rich, creamy sweetness with a delicious gourmand character. As the fragrance settles, saffron adds a warm, slightly leathery and refined depth, giving the composition a more sophisticated and intense finish.

Fragrance Family: Spicy,Gourmand,Woody

Heart Notes: Salted Caramel
Base Notes: Saffron

title: Mezzo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Mezzo Eau de Parfum — Sospiro is a refined woody-aromatic fragrance that captures a feeling of suspended presence—fresh, composed, and quietly magnetic. The composition balances bright citrus and aromatic lavender with crisp fruit, earthy vetiver, warm ginger, and soft magnolia, creating an elegant transition from freshness to depth. It opens with bergamot, mandarin, juniper, and lavender, creating a bright and aromatic introduction with a crisp, refreshing character. At its heart, apple, vetiver, ginger, and magnolia combine fruity freshness with earthy, spicy, and floral nuances. As the fragrance settles, tonka, moss, musk, and patchouli create a smooth, grounded base with warmth and lasting depth. Elegant, balanced, and understated, Mezzo Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated composition designed around quiet magnetic presence.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot,Mandarin,Juniper,Lavender
Heart Notes: Apple,Vetiver,Ginger,Magnolia

title: V For Vetiver Eau de Parfum
body_html:
V For Vetiver Eau de Parfum — Fort & Manlé is a bold woody-spicy fragrance inspired by the aromatic heritage of Kannauj, the historic Indian center of perfumery. The composition tells the story of a rebellion against the Vardhana dynasty’s Vetiver Tax, where fragrance masters used aromatic oils to transform the city and ultimately abolish the tax. Rebellious, defiant, and alluring, the fragrance combines dark fruits, warm spices, incense, cocoa, florals, and earthy woods around the distinctive character of vetiver.

It opens with grape, black cherry, cinnamon, and clove, creating a rich fruity-spicy introduction. At its heart, incense, cocoa, rose, and carnation bring smoky, floral, and subtly gourmand depth. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, oakwood, vanilla, birch, and vetiver create a deep, earthy, woody base with a warm and lasting character.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Grape,Black Cherry,Cinnamon,Clove
Heart Notes: Incense,Cocoa,Rose,Carnation
Base Notes: Cedarwood,Oakwood,Vanilla,Birch,Vetiver

title: Lost in Translation Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lost in Translation Eau de Parfum — RASEI FORT is a luminous floral-fruity gourmand fragrance inspired by the sun-drenched citrus orchards of Lefke, Cyprus. The composition is a sensory homage to an expansive orchard filled with orange, lemon, grapefruit, and mandarin trees, capturing the intoxicating freshness of citrus blossoms alongside creamy gourmand warmth. It opens with orange bitters, tea, and white grapefruit, creating a bright, crisp introduction with a subtle bitter-citrus character. At its heart, lily of the valley, orange blossom, neroli, butterscotch, and jasmine sambac unfold into a radiant floral gourmand accord, balancing delicate white florals with indulgent caramelized sweetness. As the fragrance settles, white musk, caramel, and vanilla create a smooth, creamy, and sensual base that leaves a warm and lasting trail. Radiant, comforting, and subtly exotic, Lost in Translation Eau de Parfum is an olfactory journey through the aromatic heart of Cyprus.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Orange Bitters,Tea,White Grapefruit
Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley,Orange Blossom,Neroli,Butterscotch,Jasmine Sambac
Base Notes: White Musk,Caramel,Vanilla

title: Son of a Mint Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Son of a Mint Eau de Parfum — RASEI FORT is a bold aromatic fragrance inspired by the rebellious spirit of a lavender plant growing among its mint-family relatives in the enchanted gardens of Provence. The composition brings together several varieties of lavender with fresh herbs, cool mint, aromatic tea, delicate florals, and a deep balsamic-woody base. It opens with lavender flowers, French lavender, Bulgarian lavender, clary sage, oregano, tomato leaf, rosemary, and camphor, creating an intensely green, herbal, and invigorating introduction. At its heart, neroli, mint leaves, black tea, rose, and jasmine create a fresh aromatic-floral accord, balancing the coolness of mint with delicate floral warmth. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, patchouli, birch tar, benzoin, balsam, labdanum, and vanilla create a warm, smoky, resinous foundation with lasting depth. Rebellious, aromatic, and distinctive, Son of a Mint is a contemporary interpretation of the fougère style, where lavender and mint take center stage.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic,Fougère

Heart Notes: Neroli,Mint Leaves,Black Tea,Rose,Jasmine
Base Notes: Cedarwood,Patchouli,Birch Tar,Benzoin,Balsam,Labdanum,Vanilla

title: Silent at The Theme Park Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Silent at The Theme Park Eau de Parfum — Toskovat is a nostalgic floral-woody fragrance inspired by childhood memories, family, and the bittersweet realization that time continues to move forward. Created by perfumer David-Lev Jipa-Slivinschi, the fragrance recalls a first flight, a visit to a theme park at the age of five, a mother’s sweater, lemon tart, blooming lilacs, and the comforting scent of clean linens. The composition transforms these memories into a soft yet complex olfactory experience.

It opens with lemon tart, orange blossom, linden blossom, and lilac, creating a bright citrus-floral introduction with a gentle sweetness. At its heart, lily of the valley, cacao, ylang-ylang, clean linens, and the comforting impression of a mother’s sweater create a soft, creamy, floral and nostalgic character. As the fragrance settles, olibanum, fir balsam, labdanum, patchouli, cedarwood, oakmoss, and vanilla form a warm resinous and woody base that deepens the emotional character of the composition.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Lemon Tart,Orange Blossom,Linden Blossom,Lilac
Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley,Cacao,Ylang-Ylang,Clean Linens,Mother's Sweater
Base Notes: Olibanum,Fir Balsam,Labdanum,Patchouli,Cedarwood,Oakmoss,Vanilla

title: Last Birthday Cake Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Last Birthday Cake Eau de Parfum — Toskovat is a bittersweet gourmand fragrance that transforms the familiar comfort of birthday cake into a deeply nostalgic and melancholic olfactory story. Created as an exploration of memories, passing time, and the fleeting nature of celebration, this unconventional composition contrasts creamy gourmand sweetness with smoky, resinous, and tactile accords. It opens with blinding light, milk, wick, instant cocoa, peace lily, bitter almond, cork, and malt, creating an unusual opening where creamy sweetness, nutty nuances, wax, and toasted facets intertwine. At its heart, Armagnac, stollen cake, brown sugar, vanilla custard, tonka beans, benzoin, and sweet clover create a rich, warm, and indulgent gourmand accord reminiscent of a celebration already fading into memory. As the fragrance settles, rope necklace, Chekhov’s gun, styrax, skin, tolu balsam, incense, bran absolute, and papyrus create a dark, smoky, resinous base that contrasts dramatically with the sweetness of the heart. Unconventional, emotional, and hauntingly atmospheric, Last Birthday Cake Eau de Parfum is a poetic interpretation of celebration, nostalgia, and the melancholy of time passing.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand,Ambery,Smoky

Olfactive Pyramid

Base Notes: Rope Necklace,Chekhov’s Gun,Styrax,Skin,Tolu Balsam,Incense,Bran Absolute,Papyrus

title: Inexcusable Evil Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Inexcusable Evil Extrait de Parfum — Toskovat is an unconventional aromatic fragrance that transforms destruction, loss, and human resilience into a deeply evocative olfactory experience. Inspired by memories of fallen buildings, burnt flowers, wounds, and the aftermath of devastation, this provocative composition contrasts the harshness of destruction with the comforting presence of rain, incense, and sandalwood. It opens with gunpowder and ozone, creating a metallic, explosive atmosphere that immediately establishes its intense character. At its heart, blood, bandages, iodine, burning flowers, guaiac wood, copaiba oil, and nagarmotha create a complex composition that is simultaneously medicinal, smoky, floral, resinous, and earthy. As the fragrance settles, fallen concrete, rain, incense, and sandalwood create a dark mineral-woody base, bringing a quieter and more contemplative dimension to the composition. Powerful, unconventional, and deeply thought-provoking, Inexcusable Evil Extrait de Parfum is an olfactory tribute to those who survive, endure, and rise from the ruins.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Gunpowder,Ozone
Heart Notes: Blood,Bandages,Iodine,Burning Flowers,Guaiac Wood,Copaiba Oil,Nagarmotha
Base Notes: Fallen Concrete,Rain,Incense,Sandalwood

title: Age of Innocence Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Age of Innocence Extrait de Parfum — Toskovat is an unconventional aromatic fragrance that explores the bittersweet transition from childhood sweetness to the harsh realities of adulthood. Inspired by memories of strawberry jam, raspberry yoghurt, cotton candy, and childhood innocence interrupted by the screech of metal, burning rubber, and petrol, this composition creates a striking contrast between sweetness and industrial intensity. It opens with bubblegum, cotton candy, and strawberry, creating an unmistakably playful and nostalgic introduction filled with sugary fruity sweetness. At its heart, metal screech, rubber, gasoline, rose, and car-seat accords create a dramatic and unexpected transformation, contrasting innocent sweetness with the raw smell of machinery and asphalt. As the fragrance settles, natural oud, Haitian vetiver, cade, and cedar create a dark, woody foundation that gives the composition depth and a mature character. Unconventional, provocative, and deeply evocative, Age of Innocence Extrait de Parfum transforms childhood memories into a striking olfactory story of innocence, disruption, and growing up.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bubblegum,Cotton Candy,Strawberry
Heart Notes: Metal Screech,Rubber,Gasoline,Rose,Car Seats
Base Notes: Natural Oud,Haitian Vetiver,Cade,Cedar

title: Amoral Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Amoral Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a sophisticated smoky-woody fragrance inspired by a mysterious, uncompromising character who bends the rules in pursuit of power and success. Created around the magnetic atmosphere of 1980s Miami, this intense composition combines sparkling lime, smoky tea, exotic spices, dark fruits, precious oud, and warm woods to create an alluring and provocative olfactory experience. It opens with the freshness of key lime, immediately enveloped by black tea, cardamom, cinnamon, cumin, and smoked prunes, creating a vibrant yet darkly spiced introduction. At its heart, violet, iris, oud, and cypriol unfold with smoky, powdery, and woody depth, adding an enigmatic character to the composition. As the fragrance settles, orange blossom, ambery notes, sandalwood, and tonka create a warm and velvety base, while the intense oud reinforces its powerful presence. Mysterious, rebellious, and undeniably elegant, Amoral Extrait de Parfum is a bold expression of confidence, defiance, and the fascination of the forbidden.

Fragrance Family: Smoky,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Key Lime,Black Tea,Cardamom,Cinnamon,Cumin,Smoked Prunes
Heart Notes: Violet,Iris,Oud,Cypriol
Base Notes: Orange Blossom,Ambery Notes,Sandalwood,Tonka

title: Kama Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Kama Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a seductive sweet-leathery fragrance inspired by the essence of desire, attraction, and irresistible connection. Named after the Sanskrit word for desire and inspired by Kamadeva, the Hindu god of erotic love, this captivating composition explores the tension between temptation and surrender through dark fruits, smoky woods, powdery florals, playful sweetness, leather, and sensual musks. It opens with the dark sweetness of blackberries, meeting the smoky character of birch tar, while violet and orris add a refined powdery elegance. At its heart, cotton candy introduces a playful sweetness, contrasted by the depth of leather, spicy cypriol, and dry amber. As the fragrance settles, moss, cashmere wool, and musk create a warm, soft, and sensual base that envelops the skin with lasting richness. Magnetic, seductive, and unapologetically sensual, Kama Extrait de Parfum is an olfactory expression of pure desire and irresistible attraction.

Fragrance Family: Sweet,Leathery

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Blackberries,Birch Tar,Violet,Orris
Heart Notes: Cotton Candy,Leather,Cypriol,Dry Amber
Base Notes: Moss,Cashmere Wool,Musk

title: Vitias Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Vitias Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a sophisticated citrus-aquatic fragrance inspired by the first kiss by the sea and the longing for a deep connection between two souls. Created around the feeling of romance, it combines sparkling citrus, fresh spices, marine nuances, elegant iris, airy woods, and sensual musks to evoke the freshness and serenity of the Mediterranean. It opens with a bright combination of bergamot, lime, pink pepper, and black pepper, creating a crisp and invigorating introduction with a subtle spicy edge. At its heart, angelica root, iris, blond woods, guaiac wood, and marine notes unfold into an airy, mineral composition that evokes the depth and vastness of the ocean. As the fragrance settles, ambergris and white musk create a smooth, clean, and sensual base that lingers delicately on the skin. Fresh, intimate, and refined, Vitias Extrait de Parfum is a poetic expression of romance, connection, and Mediterranean elegance.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Aquatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Heart Notes: Angelica Root,Iris,Blond Woods,Guaiac Wood,Marine Notes
Base Notes: Ambergris,White Musk

title: Otimo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Otimo Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a sophisticated spicy-sweet fragrance that embodies pride, resilience, and the feeling of rising stronger after overcoming adversity. Inspired by the phoenix, Otimo represents the pursuit of excellence and the confidence that comes from achievement. It opens with the fruity elegance of quince, enriched by the warm spice of cardamom and the deep, boozy character of rum, creating a vibrant and captivating introduction. At its heart, tobacco, praline, patchouli, and tonka unfold into a rich, warm, and indulgent accord with a refined gourmand character. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, vanilla, and osmanthus create a smooth and luxurious base that leaves a warm, persistent, and sophisticated trail. Proud, powerful, and deeply refined, Otimo Extrait de Parfum is an olfactory expression of resilience, confidence, and the satisfaction of surpassing expectations.

Olfactive Pyramid

Heart Notes: Tobacco,Praline,Patchouli,Tonka
Base Notes: Cedarwood,Vanilla,Osmanthus

title: Poka Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Poka Extrait de Parfum — Pernoire is a rich gourmand-amber fragrance inspired by the indulgent pleasure of the ultimate dessert. Created in collaboration with a world-champion confectioner, this luxurious composition translates the aroma, texture, and balance of a decadent culinary creation into an expressive perfume. It opens with the irresistible sweetness of caramel popcorn and freshly baked apple pie, refined with a touch of cinnamon for a warm and inviting introduction. At its heart, roasted hazelnut, labdanum, and dried apricot unfold with nutty, fruity, and resinous richness, creating an indulgent and textured gourmand core. As the fragrance settles, vanilla, musk, tonka bean, and cedarwood create a smooth and velvety base that leaves a warm, creamy, and long-lasting trail. Indulgent, playful, and irresistibly gourmand, Poka Extrait de Parfum celebrates the art of enjoying life's sweetest moments.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand, Amber

Olfactive Pyramid

Heart Notes: Roasted Hazelnut,Labdanum,Dried Apricot

title: Oud Nacre Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Nacré Eau de Parfum — Giorgio Armani is a sophisticated woody-amber fragrance that explores the luminous beauty of precious oud through an elegant blend of warm spices, radiant florals, creamy woods, and sensual amber accords. Created for the discerning wearer who appreciates refined luxury and distinctive craftsmanship, this captivating composition balances the intensity of oud with a soft, polished character, creating remarkable depth and sophistication. It opens with a radiant combination of saffron, pink pepper, and bergamot, delivering a sparkling yet warmly spiced introduction with an exotic character. At its heart, rose, jasmine, and orange blossom unfold with luminous floral richness, creating an elegant contrast against the deeper woody character of the composition. As the fragrance settles, precious oud intertwines with sandalwood, patchouli, amber, and musk, creating a smooth, velvety base that leaves a luxurious and long-lasting trail of warmth and refinement. Rich, luminous, and unmistakably elegant, Oud Nacré Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated expression of contemporary oud perfumery and the artistry of Giorgio Armani.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Amber, Oud

Olfactive Pyramid

Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom

title: Shanghai 1930 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Shanghai 1930 Extrait de Parfum — Astrophil & Stella is a sophisticated amber-woody fragrance inspired by the glamour, mystery, and cosmopolitan spirit of 1930s Shanghai. Presented in extrait concentration, this luxurious composition blends vibrant citrus, exotic spices, elegant florals, and rich woods into an evocative fragrance of remarkable depth and refinement. It opens with a radiant combination of bergamot, mandarin, and pink pepper, creating a sparkling and subtly spicy introduction that immediately captures attention. At its heart, jasmine, rose, and osmanthus unfold with luminous floral richness, enhanced by warm aromatic nuances that evoke an atmosphere of timeless elegance. As the fragrance settles, smooth sandalwood, patchouli, amber, vanilla, and musk create a deep, velvety base that leaves an intense and sophisticated trail of warmth and sensuality. Mysterious, elegant, and unmistakably distinctive, Shanghai 1930 Extrait de Parfum is a luxurious expression of vintage glamour and the creative artistry of Astrophil & Stella.

title: Paris Chéri Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Paris Chéri Extrait de Parfum — Astrophil & Stella is a sophisticated floral-gourmand fragrance that evokes the romance and elegance of Paris through a refined blend of luminous fruits, delicate florals, creamy gourmand accords, and sensual woods. Presented in extrait concentration, this luxurious composition balances sparkling freshness with rich, velvety warmth, creating an enchanting fragrance with remarkable depth and lasting presence. It opens with a vibrant combination of bergamot, cherry, and pink pepper, delivering a juicy and sparkling introduction with a playful touch of spice. At its heart, rose, jasmine, violet, and orange blossom unfold with elegant floral richness, creating a romantic bouquet enhanced by soft powdery nuances. As the fragrance settles, smooth vanilla, almond, sandalwood, amber, and musk create a creamy, indulgent base that leaves a sensual and long-lasting trail of warmth and sophistication. Romantic, glamorous, and unmistakably distinctive, Paris Chéri Extrait de Parfum is a luxurious expression of modern Parisian elegance and the artistic spirit of Astrophil & Stella.

Nabati Oud Extrait de Parfum — Astrophil & Stella is a rich oud-gourmand fragrance that blends the opulence of precious oud with the indulgent sweetness of exotic fruits, warm spices, creamy resins, and sensual woods. Presented in extrait concentration, this luxurious composition creates a deep and enveloping olfactory experience with remarkable intensity, warmth, and sophistication. It opens with a radiant combination of bergamot, saffron, and dried fruits, delivering a vibrant yet richly spiced introduction with an exotic character. At its heart, dates, rose, honey, and jasmine unfold with sumptuous gourmand and floral richness, creating an addictive core enhanced by warm aromatic nuances. As the fragrance settles, precious oud intertwines with sandalwood, vanilla, amber, benzoin, and musk, forming a deep, velvety base that leaves an intense and long-lasting trail of warmth and sensuality. Nabati Extrait de Parfum — Astrophil & Stella is a sophisticated amber-gourmand fragrance inspired by the rich sweetness and aromatic character of traditional Middle Eastern confections. Presented in extrait concentration, this luxurious composition blends exotic spices, dried fruits, creamy gourmand accords, and precious woods into an opulent fragrance with remarkable depth and sensuality. title: Love Is Lost Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Love Is Lost Extrait de Parfum — Astrophil & Stella is a sophisticated floral-woody fragrance that explores the bittersweet contrast between romantic florals, creamy sweetness, warm spices, and deep sensual woods. Presented in extrait concentration, this luxurious composition creates an intimate yet captivating olfactory experience with remarkable depth and lasting presence. It opens with a luminous blend of bergamot, pink pepper, and juicy fruits, delivering a sparkling and vibrant introduction with a subtle touch of sweetness. At its heart, rose, jasmine, iris, and violet unfold with rich floral elegance, creating a velvety bouquet enhanced by delicate powdery nuances. As the fragrance settles, smooth sandalwood, vanilla, amber, patchouli, and musk create a warm, enveloping base that leaves a sensual and long-lasting trail of sophistication. Romantic, mysterious, and unmistakably distinctive, Love Is Lost Extrait de Parfum is an evocative expression of contemporary niche perfumery and the artistic spirit of Astrophil & Stella.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Woody, Powdery

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Juicy Fruits
Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Iris, Violet
Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli, Musk

title: Untitled Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Untitled Eau de Parfum — Maison Martin Margiela is a sophisticated green-woody fragrance that captures the raw beauty of nature through a refined blend of vibrant greenery, aromatic herbs, delicate florals, and deep woods. Created as an elegant unisex composition, this distinctive fragrance explores the contrast between freshness and intensity, creating a scent that feels both natural and contemporary. It opens with a luminous burst of green accords, bergamot, and aromatic herbs, delivering a crisp and invigorating introduction with an earthy freshness. At its heart, delicate jasmine, orange blossom, and green floral nuances unfold with graceful richness, adding softness and depth to the composition. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, patchouli, vetiver, and white musk create a smooth, earthy base that leaves a sophisticated and long-lasting trail of natural warmth and refinement. Minimalist, artistic, and unmistakably distinctive, Untitled Eau de Parfum is a refined expression of modern perfumery and the unconventional spirit of Maison Martin Margiela.

Fragrance Family: Green, Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Green Accords, Bergamot, Aromatic Herbs
Heart Notes: Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Green Floral Accords
Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Vetiver, White Musk

body_html:

body_html:
Fortuitous Finley embodies the essence of brief moments, channeling the excitement of pursuit, the allure of mystery, and the risks of the unknown. This fragrance guides you through a maze of feelings and experiences, inviting you to discover the Portraits collection as an outsider. The aroma presents a tempting harmony of savory pistachio and luxurious leather, weaving a tale of purity and compulsion that captivates and delights.

A serene walk along Geneva Lake on an August day inspires the master perfumer, accompanied by the aroma of Oud Assafi, a pure essence of agarwood from India and Bangladesh. This captivating scent, enhanced with incense and Bulgarian rose, is perfect for both women and men.

body_html:
Capture the golden moments of twilight with the luminous and timeless ingredients chosen by master perfumer Alberto Morillas. Notes of tiare flower, musk, iris, sandalwood, and vanilla blend beautifully to create a magical fragrance.

title: Musc Eternel Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A "second skin" scent blending with the body's natural fragrance, the Musc Eternel Eau de Parfum is composed by master perfumer Alberto Morillas as a tender tribute to his daughter and granddaughter. The delicate petals of rose, jasmine, and hawthorn are layered with sophisticated musks and the precious Florence iris, creating a harmonious fusion of floral and musky notes. Enhanced by the subtle tones of tonka bean, this fragrance evokes both nostalgic childhood memories and tender moments of adulthood. With Musc Eternel, the wearer and those around them are enveloped in a comforting cocoon of powdery, almondy white musks, creating a timeless ode to sensuality.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose

Middle notes: Iris, Hawthorn and Egyptian Jasmine

Base notes: White Musk and Tonka Bean

title: Buveur De Vent Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Buveur de Vent is a fragrance born from the power of a wild stallion of light, created by a god from long ago. Its unique scent is inspired by the powerful leather of the saddle of this fabulous creature, which leaves a trail of fragrance as it passes. This fragrance exudes strength and glory, reflecting the faithful adornment of this mighty beast like no other. Let the fragrance of Buveur de Vent carry you away on a wild, powerful journey.

title: Fortis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the transformative properties of Fortis fragrance, akin to a regenerating flame that rejuvenates and invigorates, leaving you with a sense of renewal and revitalization. Its enveloping warmth instills assurance, while its bursts of energy ignite a newfound vitality within. Much like a fire ignites new growth from the ashes, Fortis possesses the ability to regenerate and revitalize the soul, granting the fortitude and vigor to confidently embrace the future. Let the phoenix within you soar to new heights with the empowering aroma of Fortis.

body_html:
Experience the unparalleled beauty of oud with Hope Eau de Parfum by Frederic Malle. This luxurious fragrance, created as the third masterpiece by Dominique Ropion for the Desert Gems collection, pays tribute to the noble essence of oud. The amber-woody scent combines smoky incense, rich vetiver, and fresh spices like pink peppercorn, cypress, and juniper, creating a simply refined aroma. Each note beautifully unfolds to showcase the oud's pure elegance, making Hope the epitome of luxury. Discover the exquisite form of oud through this exceptional scent.

Middle notes: Oud, Smoke and Vetiver

body_html:
Experience the intoxicating and bold scent of Ta'if Parfum. This luxurious perfume, originating from the Arabian desert, is perfect for evening occasions, parties, and romantic encounters. Its name is a fusion of 'zengin', the Turkish word for "rich," and the Zen practice of inner enlightenment. This fragrance evokes a sense of mindful freshness with its blend of grapefruit, bergamot, pink pepper, olibanum, vanilla, patchouli, vetiver, cedarwood, and amber. Experience Zen'gi to make a statement and connect with your inner wisdom.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Perfect for summer gatherings, this perfume boasts a bright, zesty citrus opening and a refreshing oceanic undertone. As it develops, the aroma takes on a more complex and refined character. With its impressive sillage and longevity, this scent will make a lasting impression wherever you go. Discover a truly unique fragrance that is unlike anything you've ever experienced before.

Middle notes: Pineapple, Thyme, Myrtle, Apple, Lavender and White Flowers

As the fragrance develops, delicate and alluring notes of rose and vanilla combine with the rich and earthy scent of cashmere wood. Discover this unique and captivating scent that transports you to a world of pure splendor.

As the rain clears, the sky becomes calm, the clouds disappear, and the sun peeks through. The fragrance is inspired by the joy of Spring, evoking images of a rainbow shining down on the wet landscape. The aquatic scent represents the last remnants of the rain evaporating into the fresh air, while luminous Isparta rose and vibrant pink pepper add a blissful heart to the perfume.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Notes, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Like a faithful servant, possessing a distinct and unparalleled personality, who guards your secrets with utmost discretion - for the most trustworthy servants are those who can be entrusted with your secrets.

title: Prima Donna Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Prima Donna Eau de Parfum is the epitome of elegance and luxury. Its complex and alluring scent blends fruity, floral, and musky notes to create a mesmerizing aroma. Beginning with a burst of sweet cherry and jasmine, it evolves into a smoky leather and fresh green scent, before settling into a warm and sensual base of chocolate, musk, cedarwood, and resin. However, in order to increase the intensity, the creator went against the traditional perfumery rules and added balsamite and neroli to the classic bergamot and lime accords. body_html: Bouquet Idéale Hair Mist is a sophisticated and enchanting fragrance designed to delicately perfume your hair. Expect to find a mix of soft, dewy flowers like rose, jasmine, and peony, perhaps with a hint of green freshness to mimic the vibrancy of a garden in bloom.

As the water slips over him, it seeps into the grooves of his muscles and pores, providing unrestricted access to the great outdoors. Notes of birch leaves, cypress, galbanum and pine at its heart evoke the essence of the forest.
