Enriched with airy notes of sea breeze and maritime plants, this luminous perfume is presented in a mesmeric flacon.

Fragrance family: Floral, Marine

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea water, Jasmine, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Peony, Pink Nerium Oleander, Red Berries and Rose

Base notes: Musk and Sandalwood

title: Gypsy Water Hair Perfume
body_html: Boost the fragrance of your hair with Byredo’s Gypsy Water Hair Perfume. Experience lustrous, nourished locks graced with subtle scents of lemon, pepper, and juniper berries.

title: Bal D'Afrique Hair Perfume
body_html: Enhance your daily scent with Byredo's Bal D'Afrique Hair Perfume, featuring a sensual blend of African woods, spices, and French floral essences. Complement your signature Eau de Parfum and leave your locks with a lusciously scented finish.

title: Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxury of Byredo Tobacco Mandarin Night Veils Extrait de Parfum. This fragrance evokes contrasts and intrigue with its blend of raw, noble ingredients. Enjoy a sparkling burst of citrus and spice, followed by a rich heart of leather and labdanum. The intoxicating base of tobacco will envelop you in its smoky embrace.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cumin, Mandarin Orange and Coriander

Middle notes: Tobacco, Leather and Labdanum

Base notes: Olibanum, Agarwood (Oud) and Sandalwood

title: Rose Noir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Byredo's Rose Noir Eau de Parfum offers a unique take on the traditional rose aroma, featuring a blend of tangy grapefruit, sweet and spicy patchouli, earthy moss, and powdery musk. This exquisite scent evokes fond memories of springtime as the rosebushes bloomed, with a dark and decadent twist. Perfect for both men and women, this complex and alluring fragrance is sure to become a treasured addition to your collection.

Fragrance family: Rose, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Freesia, Red Berries and Cardamom

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Raspberry, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Violet

Base notes: Moss, Musk, Labdanum and Patchouli

title: Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum embodies Byredo's renowned expertise in crafting luxurious fragrances. Its multifaceted composition features hints of rosewood, incense, tobacco, and moss for a refined yet intricate scent. The dark and rare oud note adds a distinctly unforgettable element, unique to this exceptional fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Limoncello, Incense and Cardamom

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Papyrus and Brazilian Rosewood

Base notes: oak moss and Tobacco

title: Bois Sikar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bois Sikar Eau de Parfum captures the essence of cigars, cedar wood, and Islay whisky with a beguiling smoky tobacco scent. The oak barrel adds robust woody notes, while the cedar leaf intensifies the fragrance for an intoxicating experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Precious Woods and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Styrax, Guaiac Wood and Cedar Leaves

Base notes: Tobacco Leaf and Java vetiver oil

title: Lune Feline Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Immerse yourself in the seductive and tempting aura of Lune Feline Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the alluring power of the moon, this fragrance weaves together warm spices and precious woods for a vibrant and luxurious scent. Sensual vanilla and orchid mingle with balsamic and musky notes, leaving a rich and gourmand trail in its wake. Perfect for capturing attention and exuding confidence.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Cinnamon and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Woodsy Notes, Ambergris, Styrax, Cedar and Green Notes

Base notes: Tahitian Vanilla, Peru Balsam and Musk

title: Blouse Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
The blouse by Yves Saint Laurent is a versatile garment that transforms into a sensual and iconic piece, embodying both scandal and freedom. The fragrance BLOUSE expertly incorporates the airy fluidity of the fabric by highlighting the rose with a touch of animalic angelica, resulting in a sensual and provocative scent that perfectly complements the delicate nature of the blouse.


Fragrance family: Musk, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Galbanum and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Damask Rose and Angelica

Base notes: White Musk and Cashmeran

title: A Chant for The Nymph Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A Chant for The Nymph Eau de Parfum, A Chant for the Nymph, transports you to tropical forests with its intoxicating Ylang Ylang and sensual Tiare flower notes. Experience the exoticism and sublimating effects of solar flowers while being ensnared by the nymph's invitation.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Frangipani

Middle notes: Tiare Flower and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Vanilla

title: Love at your Darkest Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the intense sensation of Love at your Darkest Eau de Parfum. This deep woody-spicy scent, featuring black pepper, frankincense, and cedarwood, envelopes you in a warm and sensual richness. With notes of incense and balsam, it's perfect for those who want to shine in the dark like a hawk slicing through the sky.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper

Middle notes: Olibanum

Base notes: Cedar

title: 1921 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
To commemorate its centennial milestone, Gucci debuts the 1921 fragrance from The Alchemist's Garden series. This scent features a refreshing blend of green, citrus, and chypre notes, highlighted by the sweet and floral essence of neroli. The addition of Florence's limone cedrato fruit, verbena, and moss add an invigorating and earthy touch to this aromatic creation.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citron

Middle notes: Neroli and Lemon Verbena

Base notes: Oakmoss

title: A Gloaming Night Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the alluring warmth and elegance of A Gloaming Night Eau de Parfum. Let Cinnamon's spicy sweetness soothe your senses as it mingles with the woody notes of Vetiver. The intensity is further heightened by the deep, dry scent of Patchouli. Experience a captivating fragrance that mimics the beauty of a sunset, with its final glow before the night takes over.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon

Middle notes: Vetiver

Base notes: Patchouli

title: Oud Save The Queen Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a mesmerizing fusion of English refinement and Eastern allure with Oud Save The Queen Eau de Parfum. Paying homage to a tragic love story, this fragrance features a delicate blend of bergamot, cloves, and orange blossom, before revealing its seductive powers of Guaiac wood and Oud Accord.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Earl Grey Tea, Clove and Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Agarwood (Oud) and Guaiac Wood

title: Oud Save The King Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating and royally-inspired scent of 24 Old Bond Street Triple Extract Eau de Cologne. Immerse yourself in the forbidden love story between Crown Prince Mohammed Ali Ibrahim of Egypt and American movie star Mabel Normand with the sensual blend of Earl Grey tea and luxurious Suede accord. Enhanced with exotic sandalwood and musky Oud, this majestic fragrance is fit for a king.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Earl Grey Tea and Bergamot

Middle notes: Suede and Orris

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Sandalwood

title: 41 Burlington Arcade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the bold and enigmatic scent of Atkinsons 41 Burlington Arcade Eau de Parfum. With top notes of lively pepper and citrus, it boasts a spicy blend of cardamom, nutmeg, and pimento, layered over musk and patchouli. This sophisticated and unconventional unisex fragrance embodies the chic and eclectic spirit of the iconic shopping gallery.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Pepper, Grapefruit, Citruses, Lemon and Floral Notes

Middle notes: Licorice, Nutmeg, Cardamom and Pimento

Base notes: Vetiver, Smoke, Cedar, Amber and Musk

title: Good Girl Gone Bad Hair Mist
body_html: Indulge in Kilian's Good Girl Gone Bad Hair Mist. Experience the luxurious scent of the signature fragrance while nourishing and protecting your hair from UV rays. With a lightweight, non-sticky formula, this mist is perfect for all hair types. Conveniently sized at 50ml for on-the-go touch-ups, spritz on your hairbrush for an all-day subtle scent.

title: Love Don't Be Shy Hair Mist
body_html: Elevate your summer hair game with the Kilian Paris Love Don't Be Shy hair mist. Infused with the signature scent, this enriched formula contains marshmallow, neroli, and vanilla for a delightful aroma. Not only does it enhance your hair, but it also nourishes and shields it from the sun. Your go-to for flawless summer locks.

title: Woman In Gold Hair Mist
body_html: Experience the opulent aroma of Kilian’s Woman in Gold hair mist, inspired by the striking contrasts of Klimt's famous painting. Developed by perfumer Calice Becker, this mist captures the intricate beauty of the artwork through a blend of rose and vanilla scents. Enhanced by an exclusive patchouli molecule, Akigalawood, this luxurious scent embodies the multi-faceted nature of the modern woman.

title: Rolling In Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the intimate and pure emotion of love with Rolling In Love Eau de Parfum. A creation by perfumer Pascal Gaurin, this scent showcases a more direct and focused representation of love, with notes of ambrette seeds, almond milk, iris, and musk. The "white" scent creates a layered and textured trail, evoking feelings of warmth and tenderness.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Almond Milk and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Middle notes: Iris, Freesia, Heliotrope, Raspberry, Hedione and Peony

Base notes: Tuberose, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk, Lactones and Caramel

title: Bamboo Harmony Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bamboo Harmony Eau de Parfum is inspired by Japanese culture, symbolizing perfection and art. Its main ingredient, bamboo, is used in calligraphy brushes, representing beauty and the "men of letters". Experience this aromatic scent and embrace the harmony of nature and tradition.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Neroli and Bitter Orange

Middle notes: Tea, Bamboo, Mate, Mimosa and Spices

Base notes: Fig Leaf, Holly and oak moss

title: Woman in Gold Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge your senses with Kilian Woman in Gold Eau de Parfum. Created by perfumer Alberto Morillas, this complex and dazzling scent will leave you feeling luxurious and elegant. Housed in a stunning glass flacon inspired by a cognac carafe and topped with a zamac gold globe cap, this fragrance is a true work of art.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Aldehydes

Middle notes: Vanilla Absolute, Rose, Geranium, Freesia and Marshmallow

Base notes: Vanilla, Akigalawood, Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Musk

title: Rosso Rubino Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a symphony of scents with Rosso Rubino Eau de Parfum. Harmoniously blended notes of bergamot and rose create a captivating aroma, while hints of forest and shady undertones add depth. Let this perfume awaken your senses and leave you feeling decisively elegant.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Orange and Lemon

Middle notes: Cacao Pod, Rose and Wild Berries

Base notes: Oakmoss, Cashmeran, Pink Pepper, Coumarin and Patchouli

title: Lady White Snake Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In Chinese tales, it is believed that transformation is possible for all things. Objects can take on new forms: a stone can become a plant, a plant can become an animal, an animal can become a human, and a human can become a deity. The Lady White Snake fragrance, representing purity and femininity, captures this concept with a delectable essence of white flowers.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange Blossom, Honeysuckle and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Tuberose, Magnolia and Jasmine

Base notes: White Leather, White Musk and Amber

title: Black Gemstone Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating essence of Pierre Soulages' renowned artwork on light and darkness with Black Gemstone Eau de Parfum. This unique fragrance expertly blends Myrrh, three different types of cedar, and a touch of lemon to create a subtle yet striking scent. The infusion of incense adds a lasting depth to this heavenly scent, making it truly one-of-a-kind. Join the pilgrimage and discover the mesmerizing aroma of Black Gemstone.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cedar and Lemon

Middle notes: Resins and Myrrh

Base notes: Teak Wood, Olibanum and Tonka Bean

title: Soleil de Jeddah Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the radiance and power of Soleil de Jeddah Eau de Parfum. Immerse yourself in the intense opening of Italian lemon, followed by a sensual heart of vanilla and osmanthus. Infused with a sublime Florence iris and deep leather notes, this oriental fragrance exudes a sophisticated aura. Perfect for those who seek a divine and powerful scent.

Fragrance family: Floral, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Chamomile, Osmanthus and Lemon

Middle notes: Ambergris, Iris and Earthy Notes

Base notes: Leather, Iris and Vanilla

title: Sand Dance Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sand Dance Eau de Parfum is a captivating fragrance that evokes a sensational performance in the heart of the desert. Inspired by the graceful movements of women, wearing sublime black and multicoloured dresses with jewels, this perfume captures the essence of a trance-like state, where the warm and sweet notes of Cacao blend with the breath of desert spices carried by the burning wind. Its hypnotic beauty and charm will leave you mesmerized.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey, Coriander, Mandarin Orange, Sesame and Anise

Middle notes: Cacao, Sandalwood and Cashmeran

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Styrax, White Cedar Extract, Patchouli, Vanilla and Cashmere Wood

title: Soleil de Jeddah Mango Kiss Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance is a vibrant and nourishing variation of Soleil de Jeddah, featuring zesty Mandarin and Mango top notes. A refreshing Coconut sorbet adds contrast to the sweet Ylang Ylang, while Solar Amber and Vanilla absolute bring a delectable oriental touch. Enjoy the irresistible gourmand aroma and indulgent experience of Soleil de Jeddah Mango Kiss.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Chamomile and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Coconut, Ylang Ylang, Amber and Fig

Base notes: Vanilla, Iris Butter, Siam Benzoin and Sandalwood

title: Patchouli Intense Hair Mist
body_html: Enhance your signature scent while nourishing your hair with Patchouli Intense Hair Mist. This innovative and elegant mist contains natural ingredients like Provitamin B5 for softer, shinier hair, and hydrolyzed silk for added volume. Keep your locks hydrated and silky with this unique and lightweight mist.

title: Musc Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This sophisticated composition envelops the skin in a sensual imprint with its musky accord, which is complemented by the sparkling addition of juicy pear and Turkish rose petals for a feminine and cocooning touch.

Fragrance family: Musk, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Turkish Rose, Pear and Galbanum

Middle notes: Rose, Violet, Carnation and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Civet, Sandalwood and Amber

title: Angels' Powder Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a burst of playful sweetness with Angels' Powder Eau de Parfum, reminiscent of cotton candy at a carnival. Cheeky pink pepper adds a hint of spice while a vibrant flash of nail polish brings a touch of whimsy. The fragrance then melts into a heart of luscious raspberry and creamy vanilla, creating a sense of pure indulgence. Warm woods and heliotrope ground the scent, adding a touch of nostalgia and childlike wonder.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Nail Polish, Sugar and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cotton Candy, Raspberry and Vanilla Sugar

Base notes: White Musk, Heliotrope and Guaiac Wood

title: Mad Honey Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enticing aroma of Mad Honey Eau de Parfum as it unfolds with a burst of pink pepper and smoldering rum, contrasting with the raw, unfiltered honey and its almost illicit intensity. This intoxicating scent is enriched with notes of Damascena rose, warm bourbon vanilla, and creamy tonka bean, while being grounded by smoky patchouli, resinous benzoin, and the musky hum of orcanox. A decadent, addictive fragrance that envelops you in a lush, honeyed haze.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Honey and May Rose

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Bourbon Vanilla, Patchouli and Orcanox

title: Nuts Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Nuts Eau de Parfum embodies the essence of decadent nuts, with a harmonious blend of pistachio, almond, and sesame. Immerse yourself in the sweet, creamy swirl of roasted nuts, drizzled with sticky caramel and infused with a rich pour of aged rum. The subtle spice of davana adds a unique aromatic depth, while vanilla and smoked woods create a velvety base. Hints of tobacco, grey amber, and musk add a touch of sultry sophistication to this indulgent and unforgettable fragrance. For those who crave a grown-up, bold, and opulent scent, NUTS Eau de Parfum is a heavenly escape that will linger on your skin and in your memory.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pistachio, Almond, Caramel, Rum and Honey

Middle notes: Vanilla, Sesame and Davana

Base notes: Tonka, Tobacco, Guaiac Wood, White Musk, Ambergris and Patchouli

title: Sin & Pleasure Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A potentially dangerous indulgence, Sin & Pleasure begins with a seemingly sweet blend of lush white flowers and rich ylang-ylang. However, this initial sweetness is undercut by a touch of darkness as caramel and almond create a gourmand heart with a hint of bitterness. As the scent evolves, it reveals its true nature: a rich combination of smoky oud and leather, accompanied by a subtle hint of vanilla. The base of the fragrance is a storm of contrasts, with alcoholic notes of rum providing a warm and boozy touch, while patchouli, oakmoss, and sandalwood ground the scent in an earthy and primal intensity.

Fragrance family: Woody, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White flowers

Middle notes: Ylang Ylang Extra, Caramel, Almond

Base notes: Vanilla, Oud, Leather, Patchouli, Rum, White musks, oakmoss, Sandalwood

title: Indecent Cherry Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indecent Cherry Eau de Parfum is a playful yet sophisticated scent that begins with a burst of cherry and a touch of almond, only to reveal its true nature with a bold mix of tart sour cherry and sassy strawberry. Hints of rose and mimosa add a touch of refinement, while the base notes of musk, patchouli, and benzoic create a grown-up twist to this decadent fragrance experience. Think of it as the olfactory equivalent of sneaking a nip of bourbon into your cherry milkshake.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Almond and Saffron

Middle notes: Sour Cherry, Strawberry, Bulgarian Rose and Mimosa

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Benzoin and Patchouli

title: Enflamme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted with precision and expertise, Enflamme Eau de Parfum combines the pure essences of Gentle Osmanthus Absolute and Infusion with the captivating intensity of Grasse Leather.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Madagascar Vanilla

Middle notes: Coffee

Base notes: Tobacco

title: Accord Particulier Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted by fragrance experts, Accord Particulier Eau de Parfum embodies the essence of Givenchy. It unites individuals while celebrating their distinct identities. Inspired by Hubert de Givenchy, this exquisite perfume blends Vetiver, Patchouli, Rose, and Ambroxan, embodying the sophistication of the Givenchy Hôtel Particulier.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ambroxan

Middle notes: Vetiver, Damask Rose

Base notes: Patchouli

title: Coeur Fou Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cœur Fou Eau de Parfum captures the essence of wild passion and roams freely through the Art Gallery in the Hôtel Particulier. The hotel is energized by its devoted effect, emanating an impulsive and instinctive aura that beckons you to follow your heart. At the core of this fragrance lies the Damascena Rose, an iconic flower expressed in three remarkable qualities: Essence, Infusion, and Absolute. This floral, fresh, and fruity perfume is irresistibly addictive, thanks to the exhilarating trail of the Rose.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cassis and Basil

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose and Damask Rose

Base notes: Moss and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

title: Equivoque Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Equivoque defies categorization and defies expectations. Enigmatic and complex, it reveals itself discreetly in the peaceful haven of the Givenchy Hôtel Particulier. The delicate Cardamom spice, carefully collected by hand, is a rare and valuable ingredient. Its bold aroma is extracted through a sustainable steam distillation process from its dried seeds. This is paired with Assam Oud, a spicy eau de parfum that exudes an elegantly woody and intensely amber fragrance, crafted with precision by experienced Master Distillers. The enigmatic Cardamom-Assam Oud accord is elevated with the luxurious essences of Malaysian Oud, Gaiac, and Atlas Cedar, creating a beguiling and unforgettable scent.

Fragrance family: Oud, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Guatemalan Cardamom

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Atlas Cedar and Virginian Cedar

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud)

title: Fantasque Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Fantasque Intense Eau de Parfum blends Myrrh Absolute and Incense Essence with opulent Malaysian Oud for a captivating and alluring scent. From the Maison Givenchy's La Collection Particulière.

Fragrance family: Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Myrrh

Middle notes: Incense

Base notes: Malaysian Oud

title: Imperial Peacock Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious blend of Oriental Woody notes in Imperial Peacock Eau de Parfum by Alexandre.J. Launched in 2022, this new fragrance creates a divine scent with top notes of Rhubarb, Almond, and Heliotrope, balanced by warm middle notes of Cinnamon, Black Vanilla Husk, Tonka Bean, and Sugar. The base notes of Balsamic and Musk add depth and sophistication to this gender-neutral scent. Indulge in the opulence of Imperial Peacock and make a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rhubarb, Almond and Heliotrope

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Black Vanilla Husk, Tonka Bean and Sugar

Base notes: Balsamic Notes and Musk

title: Velvet Tender Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted with precision and intrigue, Velvet Tender Oud by Dolce&Gabbana beautifully amalgamates the fragrances of the East and West. This luxurious scent features the rare and coveted damask rose, complemented by crisp tones of rose centifolia and rich oud. The addition of sweet almond and smooth suede leather adds a subtle softness to this alluring blend.

Fragrance family: Rose, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sweet Almond

Middle notes: Damask Rose and Rose de Mai

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Woody Notes

title: Velvet Zafferano Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dolce & Gabbana introduces Velvet Zafferano Eau de Parfum, part of The Velvet Collection and a tribute to saffron, the revered "king of spices" with a rich cultural and symbolic significance in Italy. Crafted by renowned perfumer Aurélien Guichard for Dolce & Gabbana, this perfume incorporates a lively saffron top note, a comforting heart of tobacco leaves, and a foundation of patchouli, vanilla, and amber cistus.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron

Middle notes: Tobacco

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla and Patchouli

title: Sapphire Blue Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sapphire Blue Eau de Parfum is the second scent in the sparkling royal stones collection. Inspired by a true icon in the Windsor House and the romantic love story of Prince William and Kate Middleton, this sensual fragrance opens with a sweet blend of almond and warm spices, followed by a heart of elegant jasmine and orchid. The floral notes give way to light woods, enveloping musks, and a hint of mischievous vanilla, creating an intoxicating and narcotic aroma.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices, Almond, West Indian Bay and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Orchid, Jasmine and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Vanilla, Jasmine and Musk

title: Wabisabi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the unexpected and unconventional with Wabisabi Eau de Parfum. This fragrance features the spicy and lively Wasabi, blended with white flowers, citrus fruits, and spices for a unique olfactory experience. Unleash your curiosity and embark on a sensory journey to the distant lands of Nippon

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Wasabi, Bergamot, Pear, Citrus Leaves and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Turkish Rose, Elemi resin and Geranium

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk and Cinnamon

title: Radical Rose Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Radical Rose Extrait de Parfum features Immortelle Absolute, a guest ingredient from Croatia, known for its bold and unique combination of salt and flower notes. This addition deepens and enriches the fragrance, creating a robust and distinctive scent. Experience the transformation of the rose note in this premium perfume

Fragrance family: Rose, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: May Rose

Middle notes: Patchouli, Saffron, Immortelle

Base notes: Pepper,Spanish Labdanum

title: Parisian Musc Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A contemporary vegetal and woody musk, with a fig leaf note. The fragrance is built around Ambrette Seed from Peru, the only vegetal musk Perfumers can have in their palette. A Cedar Oil from Virgina brings out its woody long lasting trait. The musky facet is amplified by Ambrettolide Supreme, a vegan musk. Ambroxan binds wood to musks.

Fragrance family: Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Virginia Cedar

Middle notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Base notes: Musk, Ambrettolide and Ambroxan

title: Encens Suave Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Encens Suave Eau de Parfum by Matiere Premiere is a respectful blend of raw materials. With Somalian resin incense at its core, accented by Labdanum Absolute and Benzoin Absolute, this scent is both carnal and addictive. Notes of Venezuelan coffee and Madagascan Vanilla add a gourmet touch.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee

Middle notes: Incense and Madagascar Vanilla

Base notes: Benzoin and Labdanum

title: Crystal Saffron Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crystal Saffron Eau de Parfum is a contemporary, genderless scent amplified by Habanolide Musk. The comforting and addictive Ambroxan adds to its character, while Incense Oil Somalia enhances saffron's vibrancy and texture. Experience the alluring aura of saffron with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Musk

Middle notes: Saffron

Base notes: Ambroxan and Incense

title: Falcon Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious and captivating scent of Falcon Leather Eau de Parfum. With top notes of saffron and labdanum, and a middle note of birch tar, this Oriental fragrance is perfect for both men and women. Launched in 2019 by perfumer Aurélien Guichard, the base notes of benzoin and agarwood (oud) provide a long-lasting and captivating aroma. Elevate your daily scent with Falcon Leather.

Fragrance family: Leather, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Labdanum

Middle notes: Birch Tar

Base notes: Benzoin and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Falkar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Unleash the luxurious scent of Falkar Eau de Parfum by Bvlgari Le Gemme. Experience the allure of a rich blend of woody black musk and captivating oud essence. Indulge in a deep and opulent fragrance that exudes sophistication and elegance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Musk

title: Molecule 01 + Mandarin Eau de Toilette
body_html: Iso E Super is a synthetic molecule with a cedarwood note that creates a velvety, warm sensation. Mandarin orange is a natural ingredient extracted from the fruit itself. According to Geza Schoen, "Mandarin is instantly energizing and has a bright, citrusy aroma. But it also has fruity and aromatic qualities that make it a truly exceptional ingredient." To enhance this scent, a special mandarin extract is added to give it extra juiciness. As the mandarin fades, Molecule 01 takes over, adding a sensual warmth to the citrusy freshness. It's rare to see such a perfect balance between a topnote like mandarin and a base note like Iso E Super, without any other ingredients in between. Once the mandarin disappears, all that's left is the elevated simplicity of Molecule 01.

title: Molecule 01 + Black Tea Eau de Toilette
body_html: Experience the warm, velvety aroma of Iso E Super, an abstract synthetic molecule with cedarwood tones, combined with the subtle and complex aroma of black tea in Molecule 01 + Black Tea Eau de Toilette. title: Merry Poplin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sitting at the kitchen table made of wood, she was illuminated by a beam of light shining in from the window, casting away the shadows from her face. While contently listening to the cheerful songs of the birds outside, she calmly and thoughtfully sewed her fabric, enjoying the serene atmosphere. As the teapot started to hum, she put down her needle and fabric, smoothing her hands over her skirt as she stood up. With the hot water poured and infusing with her tea, she watched the patterns form at the bottom of the cup. Leaning against the doorframe, she basked in the morning sun and the peacefulness of the moment.

title: Polish Potatoes Perfume
body_html:
As the night persisted, the sun's gentle rays bathed the vibrant stalls in light. A pleasant, inviting fragrance lingered in the air, adding to the sense of anticipation. It is in these moments that simplicity takes on a mystical significance and ordinary life transforms into an extraordinary experience. The Polish market, resembling a stage with its diverse array of produce, was the beating heart of the local community - every Wednesday, it pulsed with the rhythm of commerce. Local farmers and artisans would gather on Wednesday mornings, creating a magical atmosphere that came to life. These moments were like journeys into the depths of one's soul, with each fragrance revealing a new discovery.

Olfactive pyramid

Each step through the market brought me deeper into a mesmerizing world of sensory overload, where every aroma, color, and sound captured my senses and transported me into a state of all-encompassing trance. I have immortalized these mystical memories in my creation, 'ORIENTAL•SAFFRON', which encapsulates the allure and richness of this unique experience.

For Gilbert, magic and spirituality act as a compass, guiding him towards his destiny and allowing him to embrace his true desires. Perfume making is more than just a job for him; it is an essential part of who he is. The MAGIC MUSHROOMS perfume embodies this profound spiritual bond and Gilbert's unwavering belief in the enchantment of life. Let the warming scents of wormwood, pink pepper, and cinnamon greet you with a slightly bitter and boozy introduction. As the fragrance evolves, delicate tuberose and alluring leather intertwine, leading to a base of resinous amber and balsamic notes. This sophisticated and luxurious perfume is a true indulgence.

This scent begins with a bold and exhilarating blend of briny ambergris and the coolness of Egyptian geranium, evoking a sense of power and resilience. The addition of cardamom adds a touch of steel while Hay absolute, Haitian vetiver, and cumin seed capture the warmth of the arena's soil. As the battle rages on, notes of Oud oil and cedarwood bring an air of nobility and grace, reminiscent of the victorious gladiators. The scent is elevated to new heights with hints of saffron and honey, representing the ultimate reward of victory.

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Spices

title: Silver Musk Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This Silver Musk Extrait de Parfum offers a quintessential "your-skin-but-better" fragrance, with no hints of flowers, forests, or tropical breezes. Its subtle yet strong scent evokes the freshness of just-showered skin and exudes a gentle warmth that may seem effortless in a perfume, but is actually quite challenging to achieve

Fragrance family: Musky

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Musk

title: China White Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The fragrance created by Nasomatto perfumer Alessandro Gualtieri does not shy away from the spotlight, standing out from other timid scents with its bold name inspired by an '80s drug. Its white ceramic cap with a textured finish symbolizes the concept behind China White: the resilience of fragility. China White is truly mesmerizing, captivating in its essence

Fragrance family: Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Powdery Notes

Middle notes: Floral Notes, Rose

Base notes: Woodsy Notes, Musk

title: Pardon Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Nasomatto's Pardon Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of masculinity with a sophisticated and alluring blend of dark, woody notes. Expertly crafted by The Nose, this Italian niche fragrance exudes a subtle yet alluring charm.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Magnolia and Flowers

Middle notes: Dark Chocolate, Tonka Bean and Cinnamon

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Sandalwood

title: Blamage Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Blamage Extrait de Parfum is a mesmerizing testament to mistakes and failures, inspired by the legends of classic fragrances. Despite being labeled as a "disgrace" in German, it exudes a vibrantly intoxicating aroma that can only come from the hands of a master perfumer like Alessandro Gualtieri. Each fragrance in the complete Nasomatto line is a testament to his expert craftsmanship and artistic vision, making Blamage a must-have for perfume connoisseurs.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Birch

Middle notes: Musk

Base notes: White Woods, Leather

title: Fantomas Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Fantomas by Nasomatto embodies an alluring and captivating scent, derived from a meticulous research process aimed at evoking earthly bliss. Prepare to be enchanted by the invisible power that will entrance your senses, as you are enveloped in a mysterious and intoxicating blend of notes. This fragrance is both exciting and seductive, with a rich and dark aroma that will leave you mesmerized.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Melon, Rubber, Plastic, Sweet Notes

Middle notes: Smoke, Gunpowder, Caramel, Earthy Notes

Base notes: Tropical Fruit, Cashmeran, Patchouli

title: Galloway Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the art of olfactory music with Galloway Eau de Parfum. Infused with the perfect blend of pepper and citrus aromatics, this discerning fragrance will surprise your senses. Sweet iris and heady orange blossom add a touch of femininity, while warm musk, honey-like amber, and deep-wooded sandalwood create a rich and distinguished scent profile. Elevate your perfume collection with Galloway.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citrus, Pepper

Middle notes: Iris, Orange Blossom

Base notes: Musk, Amber, Sandalwood

title: Cassili Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This captivating and delectable scent combines luscious fruits and delicate flowers, accented with hints of vanilla and wood. Cassili is a unique fragrance with a striking presence, created for modern aesthetes seeking something unconventional. The bold plum notes define this eau de parfum, offering an unconventional, luxurious, and lively experience that also exudes understated elegance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Currant, Bulgarian Rose, Transparent White Flowers

Middle notes: Plum Accord, Mimosa Absolute, Plumeria, Petalia

Base notes: Sandalwood, Tonka Beans, Vanilla Pod

title: Carlisle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Carlisle Eau de Parfum is a fresh and radiant fragrance embodying light. It features a warm sandalwood theme with notes of vanilla, crisp green apple, nutmeg, saffron, rose, tonka bean, osmanthus, davana, and a base of vanilla, patchouli, and opopanax resinoid. A sophisticated choice for fragrance connoisseurs and lovers of niche scents.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Apple, Nutmeg, Saffron

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Rose, Osmanthus, Davana

Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Opopanax Resinoid

title: Haltane Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Haltane Eau de Parfum was created by Julien Sprecher, Founder and Artistic Director of Parfums de Marly, inspired by the timeless elegance of the Chateau de Marly in the 18th century. This exquisite fragrance combines rare and precious ingredients in a nod to the traditional French perfumery. Its vibrant and fresh top notes are balanced by warm and smooth leather, intertwined with a symphony of precious woods. The sweetness of saffron and praline add a contemporary twist, while the legendary agarwood leaves a lasting and refined impression on the skin. Experience this luxurious and sensory journey with Haltane.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lavender, Clary Sage

Middle notes: Saffron, Cedarwood, Praline, Oudwood

Base notes: Patchouli, Vetiver, Musk, Leather, Natural Agarwood

title: Herod Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Herod Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated blend of diverse notes that personify its smoky vanilla scent. Its powerful heart contains spice, tobacco leaf, incense, ciste, and osmanthus, while the base is filled with vanilla, musk, patchouli, and woody accord. This distinguished perfume is suitable for both men and women and exudes old-world sophistication.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon, Pepper

Middle notes: Tobacco Leaf, Incense, Ciste, Osmanthus

Base notes: Vanilla pods, Musk, Woody accord, patchouli

title: Nº4 Neon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
With a blend of Yuzu, Mandarin, and Pomelo, Nº4 Neon Eau de Parfum's top notes bring an invigorating burst of citrus. The fruity sweetness of Melon and Mango add a delicious touch, while the molecular base lends projection and longevity. Combined with Ozonic, Solar notes, and aldehydes, this fragrance exudes a bright energy that illuminates any atmosphere.

Fragrance family: Fresh, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pomelo, Yuzu, Mandarin

Middle notes: Melon, Galbanum, Mango

Base notes: Ozonic Notes, Aldehydes, Solar Notes

title: Immortal Potion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the first scent from the Alkeme collection with Immortal Potion Extrait de Parfum. This highly concentrated fragrance combines the best ingredients to create a luxurious and enveloping aroma. Crafted with a unique scientific blend and infused with an artistic essence, the name itself evokes a sense of everlasting existence and mystery.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear and Cassis

Middle notes: Jasmine, Ylag-ylag, lily of the valley, orris

Base notes: Musk, Balsam, Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli

title: Un bois vanille Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Take a stimulating journey to the heart of a lost civilization with Un bois vanille Eau de Parfum. Through the footsteps of Hernán Cortés, discover the sweet, woody aroma of vanilla, known as the "heavenly nectar" in Aztec Mexico. According to Freud, virtue, not wickedness, leads to remorse - and these woodscented notes embody this sentiment with dark, contrasting wood elements.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vanila, Coconut Milk, Beeswax

Middle notes: Bitter Almond, Benzoin, Guaiac Wood, Musk

Base notes: Black Licorice, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean

title: Lionora Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the irresistible allure of Lionora Extrait de Parfum. Indulge in the seductive blend of fruits, florals, and honeyed notes of Osmanthus fragrance, before being captivated by the creamy sandalwood finish. This powerful yet delicate scent evokes the passion and romance of new love, and the enduring sweetness of true love.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Tonka Bean and Ginger;

Middle notes: Apricot, Osmanthus and Freesia

Base notes: Lactones, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Musk

title: En prise Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
En Prise Extrait de Parfum is a complex and refined fragrance that invites you to discover the alluring aspects of vulnerability. It begins with a delightful burst of fresh grapefruit, which then gives way to the luxuriously sweet notes of crystalline sugars and the intimacy of saffron at its heart. As you experience this dynamic blend, the earthy hints of vetiver and moss add a delicate finish to the exquisitely nuanced En Prise.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Bergamot and Saffron

Middle notes: Sugar, Cassis and Geranium

Base notes: Cedar, Madagascar Vetiver and Oakmoss

title: Double Attack Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Double Attack is crafted with a complex blend of chocolate notes, resulting in a harmonious mix of bitter and woody aromas. This powerful scent utilizes a combination of spices and florals that create a captivating opening, leading to a base of bourbon and vanilla fragrance. Its effectiveness in breaking down defenses is unparalleled, leaving an enticing impression on all who encounter it.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bitter Orange, Pimento and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Agave and Geranium

Base notes: Dark Chocolate, Madagascar Vanilla, Sandalwood and Bourbon Vetiver

title: Caissa Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Caïssa Extrait de Parfum is an ethereal blend that captures the depths of love in a stunning bouquet. Delve into the enigmatic black licorice notes, enticing the heart and mind with a sense of intrigue and desire. Let the opulent floral tones unfold into a musky and alluring ambrosia fragrance, igniting feelings of infatuation.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fougassette, Pink Pepper, Cardamom and Black Licorice

Middle notes: Gardenia, Egyptian Jasmine and Madagascar Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Ambrocenide, Musk and Cacao

title: Sans Voir Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a transcendent journey with Sans Voir Extrait de Parfum, awakening your senses and freeing your intuition. Let the symphony of sea salt, grapefruit, and jasmine, intertwined with cypress and freesia, take you on a coastal dream. The mystical rose and palo santo reveal hidden possibilities, while a trail of guaiac wood and smoky incense invites you to discover the unseen. Embrace a new way of experiencing the world.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Salt, Grapefruit and Cypress

Middle notes: Rose, Freesia and Incense

Base notes: Palo Santo, Musk and Guaiac Wood

title: Grand Master Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the impressive transformation of Grand Master Extrait de Parfum. The floral and coffee notes are enhanced by seductive hints of incense, myrrh, and dark wood. The result is a perfect balance of strength and tenderness that will awaken your senses and reveal your divine potential.

Fragrance family: Amber, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose Water, Black Currant and Peony

Middle notes: May Rose, Coffee and Violet

Base notes: Incense, Myrrh, Ebony and Panettone

title: Gardez Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Gardez Extrait de Parfum is a celebration of love, freedom, and the sacrifices we make for our future. This exquisite perfume expertly combines sharp pepper and spicy cologne notes with alluring jasmine, orris, and juicy fruits, showcasing its full range of scents. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a base of leathers and woods, evoking both tenderness and strength at its heart.

Fragrance family: Woody, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blackberry leaf and Apricot

Middle notes: Orris Root, Cassis, Palisander Rosewood and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Popcorn, Black Leather and Cedar

title: Scholar's Mate Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Scholar's Mate Extrait de Parfum is a tribute to collaboration and brims with potential. The melding of cardamom leaf and grapefruit, along with powdery orris, creates a base of velvety and luscious sandalwood, enriched and perfected by the refinement and vigor of vetiver. Faint hints of smoke allude to the surge of excitement that arises when partners, comrades, confidants, and soulmates unite in the pursuit of shared goals.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Cinnamon Leaf

Middle notes: Elemi, Pimento and Orris

Base notes: Sandalwood, Fig Nectar, Madagascar Vetiver and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: As-suli's Diamond Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
As-Suli's Diamond Extrait de Parfum evokes an aura of an ancient and mystical era through its rich and captivating blend of intense, carnal, smoky, and luminous notes. Fruits and flowers from the Middle Eastern region delicately mingle with resinous woods, while subtle hints of incense add a smoky allure, transporting you to an exotic realm of indulgence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig Leaf, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Broom, Ylang-Ylang and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Incense, Opoponax, Amberwood and Myrrh

title: Dark Opulence Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the captivating scent of Dark Opulence Extrait de Parfum, an olfactory masterpiece that transforms your senses into a luxurious sensory experience. This opulent fragrance embodies lavishness and invites you into a world of timeless elegance and rich enchantment. Infused with energizing Ginger and Saffron, and a hint of smoky leather, Dark Opulence awakens your senses. As the fragrance unravels, notes of Tobacco and velvety Osmanthus create an enchanting spell of sophistication. Finally, the luxurious blend of earthy essences and the enveloping aroma of Agarwood leaves a lasting impression wherever you go. Elevate your senses and indulge in the richness of Dark Opulence, the epitome of opulence in a bottle.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Saffron and Ginger

Middle notes: Tobacco, Osmanthus and Black Tea

Base notes: Guaiac Wood, Agarwood and Leather

title: Forest.Blends. Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the essence of nature with Forest.Blends Eau de Parfum. Its blend of cashmere wood, leather, grapefruit, and rose perfectly recreates the scent of the wilderness, giving you a sense of connection and personality.

Fragrance family: Woody, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Saffron

Middle notes: Cashmere Woods, Cedar Atlas, Rose

Base notes: Leather, Vetiver, Cypriol

title: Ab.so.lute. Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in Absolute Eau de Parfum, an oriental fragrance that captures the essence of sensuality. Let the blend of vanilla and white flowers mesmerize your being while the lingering notes of amber and musk leave a lasting impression. Experience the absolute scent that reveals your true self.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Hay, Sage and Bay Leaf

Middle notes: Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, Gurjan balsam and White Flowers

Base notes: Tobacco, Tonka Bean, Musk and Amber

title: Arcadia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the sophisticated and complex aroma of Arcadia Eau de Parfum by Paradis des Sens. With a blend of oriental, chypre, and spicy hints, this perfume offers a dry and warm touch to your skin. Let the base notes of vanilla and ambergris, combined with top notes of pink pepper and coriander, take your senses on a sensual journey of lulling elation.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Coriander, Tangerine, Violet

Middle notes: Cedar, Patchouli, Tree Moss

Base notes: Ambergris, Vanilla, Wood, Benzoin

title: Nº3 Crepuscule Ardent Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating scent of Nº3 Crepuscule Ardent Eau de Parfum. With a mesmerizing blend of leather, floral, and spice notes, this fragrance will awaken your senses and leave you feeling confident and irresistible. Indulge in the powerful saffron and jasmine top notes, followed by a seductive combination of amber and soft suede. Elevate your charm with every spray.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron

Middle notes: Olibanum and Jasmine

Base notes: Leather, Suede and Amber

title: Nº4 Sport Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Nº4 Sport is a complex and energizing scent from the Après l’Amour family. The top notes of Lemon, Grapefruit, and Bergamot provide a refreshing kick, while the middle notes of Melon, Agave, and Pineapple add a sweet touch. The base notes of Ozonic and Sea Water, combined with a signature molecular base, create an uplifting and sophisticated fragrance that is sure to captivate.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Agave, Melon and Pineapple

Base notes: Sea water and Ozonic notes

title: Camelia K Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The alluring Camelia K Eau de Parfum is a tropical paradise in a bottle. With a powerful blend of ginger, dragon fruit, and blood orange, this fragrance invites you to indulge your senses. A rich floral heart of red camellia, Sambac jasmine, and orange blossom is heightened by the tempting notes of vanilla, vetiver, and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood orange, dragon fruit

Middle notes: Red camellia, orange blossom

Base notes: Tonka beans, vetiver

title: Blue Sapphire Parfum
body_html:
With a fusion of citrus, cardamom, and precious gemstone-inspired ingredients, Blue Sapphire Parfum celebrates the qualities of loyalty, harmony, friendship, and trust. A fragrance fit for a king and queen, this scent is both uplifting and cool, evoking happy and carefree times with its engaging personality.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Chamomile, Sage, Marigold and Saffron

Middle notes: Rose, Indian Jasmine and Magnolia

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli and Amber

title: Hanuman Parfum
body_html:
Hanuman honors the Chinese Year of the Monkey, which symbolizes fidelity, hope, boldness, and resilience, infused with a touch of playfulness. The fragrance combines zesty citrus and alluring florals atop an elegant base of sturdy woods and warm musk. Vetiver evokes the verdant freshness of forests and roots. The scent offers a sensation of vitality and sunny blossoms dancing amidst a tranquil arboreal backdrop. The lemon essence, reminiscent of lemonade rather than sharpness, lingers beautifully. In Hanuman, a fusion of lemon, blood orange, bergamot, and cassis descends gracefully, highlighting the intricate bouquet of marigold at the heart of the fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange Blossom, Bergamot, Lemon and Black Currant

Middle notes: Osmanthus, Neroli, Magnolia and Cyclamen

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Musk, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Ardent Hair Mist
body_html: Experience the enchanting aroma of Ardent Hair Mist. With a blend of spicy coriander and creamy Turkish rose, this mist will add a touch of sophistication to your hair. Indulge in the subtle base notes of musk, vanilla, and amber, while the heart is filled with the sensuality of Rose Absolute and jasmine. Perfect for sultry nights filled with romance and drama.

title: Iris Bleu Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Embark on a sensory journey with Armani/Privé's Iris Bleu Eau de Toilette, inspired by the lush Mediterranean landscape and Giorgio Armani's love for travel. This exquisite fragrance blends airy Iris flower with green jasmine, evoking the elegance of the open sky. A delicate touch of white musk envelopes the scent, capturing the tranquil essence of dawn on the Mediterranean Sea. The Iris, known as "blue gold of perfumery", is expertly intertwined with the luxurious jasmine grandiflorum superinfusion, resulting in a modern and natural fragrance that perfectly embodies the harmonious union of sea and sky.

Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Galbanum and Lemon

Middle notes: Iris Butter and Jasmine

Base notes: White Musk, Virginia Cedar and Guaiac Wood

title: 44 Gerrard Street Eau de Cologne
body_html:
Radiating vitality and vigour, Atkinsons 44 Gerrard Street is an homage to the very first Atkinsons store, established in 1799 in London’s Soho. Brimming with energy and sophistication, it captures the eccentric, hedonistic spirit of Georgian London, from the refreshing, invigorating notes of cool eucalyptus, spicy ginger and fresh green lemon through to a softer floral heart of jasmine, orchid and rose. Amber notes hint at a woody, ever so slightly musky base for an eau de cologne that packs a sophisticated, energising punch.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Ginger and Eucalyptus

Middle notes: Rose, Orchid and Jasmine

Base notes: Woody Notes and Amber

title: Pirates' Grand Reserve Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Pirates' Grand Reserve Eau de Parfum is a heady and bold scent, inspired by the English gentleman pirate Sir Francis Drake. Like the legendary explorer, it is full of adventure and daring. The intoxicating aroma of aged rum and dark chocolate will awaken your inner buccaneer, while soothing notes of jasmine and heliotrope may appeal to your softer side. However, the intense and spicy scent of distilled patchouli will ultimately bring out your pirate spirit, completing this luxurious fragrance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, SPicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Cacao, Vanilla, Heliotrope and Jasmine

Middle notes: Virginia Cedar, Cardamom, Broom, Clary Sage and Geranium

Base notes: Cashmeran, Patchouli, Musk and Moss

title: Amunae Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the balancing power of Moonstone in Amunae Eau de Parfum. Journey to Sri Lanka and trust your intuition with the gemstone of balance. Reflecting our diverse and constantly evolving personalities, its bluish pearlescent shimmer captures the moon's hidden power. Experience AMUN, the Arabic word for "hidden," with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes and Olibanum

Middle notes: Jasmine and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Base notes: Black Musk and Oak

title: Rose & Cuir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
ROSE & CUIR by Jean-Claude Ellena is a fragrance that juxtaposes the delicacy and sensuality of flowers with the sleek elegance of animalic materials. Through the expert blending of exceptional extracts of Timut pepper and bourbon geranium, the rose is brought to the forefront with a pure, streamlined beauty. As the scent develops, a mysterious, dark leather blend emerges, enhanced by the earthy tones of vetiver essence. This floral scent evolves over time, revealing a bold and androgynous sensuality.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Geranium, Black Currant, Sichuan Pepper and Cassis

Middle notes: Leather and Rose

Base notes: Vetiver and Cedar

title: Purple Suede Parfum
body_html:
Purple Suede is a captivating new product in the Goldfield & Banks Botanical Series. It embodies an olfactory experience that captures the aroma of sun-kissed lavender fields, where flowers are crisped by the intense heat of the sun. Complemented by the essence of rust-colored saddles, this alluring parfum unveils a uniquely opulent and dry trail. A modern and unconventional interpretation of lavender and leather.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Leather, Lavender and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Hyssop, Leatherwood and Coriande

Base notes: Cashmeran, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Patchouli, Civet and Oakmoss

title: Encens Roi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
With the herbaceous aroma of Roman Chamomile and the mineral and zesty notes of Olibanum CO2, Encens Roi Eau de Parfum captures the essence of Incense Trees and their resin, reminiscent of scorching desert winds. The uplifting yet carnal Atlas Cedarwood, combined with Saffron's leather and tobacco undertones, creates a captivating and complex scent. Olibanum and Saffron, representing the divine and the profane, add depth and richness to the fragrance. Interlaced with notes of mystical Oud and warm Cistus, as well as indulgent White Cacao and Vanilla, Encens Roi tells the captivating story of a hopeful humanity.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Olibanum, Peppertree and Chamomile

Middle notes: Atlas Cedar, Saffron and Pimento

Base notes: Labdanum, Agarwood (Oud), Cacao and Vanilla

title: 1826 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Born in Granada, the jewel of Andalusia, Eugénie de Montijo, the future and last French empress, was known for her seductive nature and elegant beauty. Her influence on the artistic refinement of her time inspired this luminous fragrance, much like she delighted Napoleon the third with her sparkling beauty.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tangerine and Bergamot

Middle notes: Violet, White Flowers, Cinnamon and Ginger

Base notes: Patchouli, Amber, Woody Notes, Incense, Musk and Vanilla

title: 1740 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The 1740 Eau de Parfum pays homage to Donatien-Alphonse-François, the Marquis de Sade, a Parisian gentleman infamous for his libertine lifestyle. This alluring fragrance combines top notes of bergamot and davana sensualis with a heart of patchouli, coriander, and cardamom, and a base of cedar, elemi, leather, and labdanum.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Artemisia and Bergamot

Middle notes: Patchouli, Cardamom and Coriander

Base notes: Immortelle, Leather, French labdanum, Elemi resin, Birch, Vanilla and Virginia Cedar

title: Outrecuidant Eau de Parfum
body_html:
From the expert perspective, the lively blend of Grapefruit, Pineapple, Orange Blossom, Saffron, Cardamom, Labdanum, Leather, Oud, and Patchouli creates a dynamic reaction, intensifying the woody and resinous nature of Labdanum when Leather arrives on the scene, resulting in a heightened sense of arrogance.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Grapefruit and Cassis

Middle notes: Saffron, Cardamom and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Leather, Patchouli, Labdanum, Cedar and Sandalwood

title: Prolixe Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The combination of Ginger, Cardamom, and Cinnamon in Prolixe Eau de Parfum creates a complex and enveloping scent. The addition of Rose, Patchouli, and Oud adds depth and intensity, while hints of Tobacco and Oliban add to the overall experience. This fragrance is perfect for those captivated by the ardent meanderings of spices and the captivating twirls of Rose and Oliban.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom and Ginger

Middle notes: Rose, Olibanum and Chamomile

Base notes: Patchouli, Tobacco and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Bloodiris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bloodiris is a fresh, new fragrance by Roberto Cavalli that appeals to both men and women. Launched in 2022, this scent features top notes of Blood Orange, middle notes of Italian Iris and Turmeric, and a base of Musk and Cashmeran.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange

Middle notes: Italian Iris and Turmeric

Base notes: Musk and Cashmeran

title: Frantic Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the luxurious blend of floral and musk scents in a new fragrance by Roberto Cavalli. With top notes of Damask Rose, Rose, and Taif Rose, this fragrance is sure to capture the essence of elegance and romance. Expertly crafted by perfumer Philippine Courtière, the heart of this scent is elevated with the addition of Myrrh and balanced with a rich base note of Amyris. Experience the irresistible bouquet of Frantic Rose for both women and men.

Fragrance family: Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Damask Rose, Rose and Taif Rose

Middle notes: Myrrh

Base notes: Amyris

title: Power Self Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience confidence and intensity with Initio Power Self, a new 2025 fragrance designed for both women and men. This woody, spicy, and floral scent is enriched with top notes of pink pepper, middle notes of white flowers, and base notes of musk.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper

Middle notes: White Flowers, Osmanthus, White Rose and Magnolia

Base notes: Musk, Cedarwood and Ambrox Super

title: Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense
body_html:
Experience the captivating essence of an exotic tropical flower through notes of bold red hibiscus, delicate jasmine sambac, and alluring vanilla. This intense cologne is a unique blend of solar and exotic fragrances that will transport you to a tropical forest with just one spritz. Discover the rare beauty that is Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense.

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Ginger and Black Cardamom

Middle notes: Hibiscus, Black Orchid, Jasmine, Water Lily and Ylang Ylang

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber and Incense

title: Muse Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Le Vestiaire des Parfums by Yves Saint Laurent's Muse fragrance showcases a mysterious ink accord, expertly crafted by Master Perfumer Marie Salamagne. Its alluring blend of woody and smoky tones is enhanced by iris concrete and Bourbon vanilla absolute, resulting in a truly one-of-a-kind 'skin perfume' with a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Clary Sage and Incense

Middle notes: Orris, Bourbon Vanilla and Ambrette

Base notes: Amberwood and Ink

title: Patchouli Precieux Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refined elegance of Versace Patchouli Précieux. This new fragrance for women and men, is expertly crafted with earthy patchouli and fiery spices for a truly sophisticated scent. Launched in 2024, it's a must-have for those seeking a luxurious and unique fragrance experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dried Plum

Middle notes: Amberwood

Base notes: Saffron and Nutmeg

title: Encens Supreme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a mystical journey with Encens Supreme Eau de Parfum. The smoky accord, combined with coriander and cashmere wood, captures the essence of African incense and Spanish cistus. Embrace the imperial character and natural burn of incense.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cistus Incanus, Coriander

Middle notes: Olibanum

Base notes: Cashmere Wood

title: Gingembre Petillant Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Created by master perfumer Jordi Fernandez, Versace's Gingembre Pétillant is a harmonious blend of luminous red ginger from Laos, delicate white blooms, and a praline and warm vanilla base. Drawing inspiration from Middle Eastern traditional scents, this perfume offers a unique and captivating sensory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger

Middle notes: White Flowers

Base notes: Praline and Vanilla

title: Safran Royal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the rare and precious character of saffron with Safran Royal Eau de Parfum. This unique interpretation combines spicy notes of Moroccan wormwood with a refreshing blend of leather and amber. Indian cypriol, Indonesian patchouli, and Spanish cistus add an exotic touch, making it a truly luxurious scent.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Leather

Middle notes: Cistus Incanus, Amber

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Wormwood

title: Jasmin au Soleil Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In October 2019, Versace released the Atelier Versace collection featuring six perfumes, including Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé, and Vanille Rouge. Each scent is centered around one ingredient and was developed by a team of five perfumers. Jasmine au Soleil, crafted by perfumer Nathalie Lorson, is a blend of beeswax, Indian jasmine, lemon, hay, tobacco, and cedar.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Indian Jasmine, Beeswax

Middle notes: Lemon, Cedar

Base notes: Hay, Tobacco

title: Eclat De Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In October 2019, Versace introduced the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes. These scents, including Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé and Vanille Rouge, were carefully crafted by five perfumers, each focusing on one ingredient as the main theme. One of the perfumers, Nathalie Lorson, created Éclat de Rose, which features Moroccan Centifolia rose and Ambrox, resulting in a unique blend of amber, incense, woods, tobacco and musk.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Moroccan Rose, Ambroxan

Middle notes: Musk, Amber

Base notes: Woodsy Notes, Tobacco, Incense

title: Cristallo Bianco Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Like the sun reaching its highest point, this scent unveils an inner beauty that is both pure and transformative. Inspired by the luminous clarity of rock crystal, it channels universal love through a graceful blend of woody Patchouli, fig leaves, and Indian Jasmine Sambac. This fragrance is a story of simplicity and power, bringing your own inner light to the surface.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, White Peach and Orange

Middle notes: Magnolia, Fig and Indian Jasmine

Base notes: Patchouli, Cashmere Wood, Sandalwood and Madagascar Vanilla

title: Love Triumphs Over War Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In the midst of the chaos of Vulcan's forge, the goddess of love takes a stand against the god of war. Their opposing energies are evident in their contrasting appearances - her alluring complexion and his imposing, frigid armor. Venus draws near to her partner, her seductive yet tender gaze captivating him. As a result, Mars is unable to continue his military pursuits. Venus removes his helmet as playful putti twirl around his sword and shield. "This captivating scent embodies the victory of love over war." The opening notes of Bright Bergamot, Orange, Lemon, Sweet Tuberose, Rose Petals, Raspberry, and Seductive Blackcurrant transition into the irresistible heart tones of Violet, Clove, Cinnamon Bark, Geranium, Gardenia, Iris, and Ylang Ylang. The base notes of Warming Oriental, White Musk, Cashmere Wood, Mysore Sandalwood, Patchouli, and Vanilla create a captivating and alluring fragrance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose Petals, Raspberry, Black Currant, Bergamot, Orange, Lemon and Tuberose

Middle notes: Geranium, Clove, Violet, Iris, Gardenia, Cinnamon and Ylang Ylang

Base notes: Mysore Sandalwood, White Musk, Vanilla, Cashmere Wood, Amber and Patchouli

title: Fall of Phaeton Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Assuming the perspective of an industry expert, it is worth noting that the Fall of Phaeton Eau de Parfum, launched in 2024 by Argos, boasts a sophisticated combination of bergamot, lemon, cardamom, pink pepper, and ginger in its top notes, followed by labdanum, lavender, and agarwood in its heart notes, and musk, leather, tonka bean, and vanilla in its base notes.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Cardamom, Lemon, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Labdanum, Lavender and Agarwood

Base notes: Leather, Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Musk

title: Adonis Awakens Eau de Parfum
body_html:
John Waterhouse, an English painter, was renowned for his Pre-Raphaelite style and focus on Greek mythology. According to legend, Adonis, the Greek god of beauty, desire, and rebirth, would tragically die while hunting, only to be revived by a kiss from the goddess Aphrodite. This romantic fragrance, Argos ADONIS AWAKENS, contains opulent and timeless scents such as bright bergamot, grapefruit, pink peppercorn, Bulgarian rose, Sambac jasmine, creamy vanilla, chestnut, juicy raspberry, and base notes of Mysore sandalwood, cashmere wood, and rose absolute.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Raspberry, Bulgarian Rose, Vanilla, Jasmine Sambac and Chestnut

Base notes: Rose, Cashmere Wood and Mysore Sandalwood

title: Pallas Athene Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating scent inspired by the rebellious Wiener Sezession, founded by Gustav Klimt. Pallas Athene, the powerful Greek goddess of just causes, strength, and the arts, was the group's symbol. Legend says she emerged fully armed from Zeus' brain with a loud battle cry, adorned with Medusa's head on her aegis. This romantic yet commanding fragrance opens with Bright Bergamot, Delicious Red Berry, Grapefruit, and Spicy Pink Peppercorn, transitioning to a floral heart of Peony, Violet, and Rose Petals. Bold base notes of Powdery Iris, Mysore Sandalwood, Oriental, Earthy Vetiver, Patchouli, and Creamy Vanilla create an alluring, seductive scent.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Berries, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Peony, Rose, Blue Hyacinth and Violet

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Iris, Mysore Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vetiver

title: Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Argos Pour Femme is a luxurious, sensual, and feminine fragrance that is crafted from only the finest ingredients. With an Eau de Parfum strength, it will last for hours on end. This unforgettable and intoxicating scent will surely leave a lasting impression on anyone who encounters it. Beginning with Passionate Violet Leaves from Greece and a blend of other exquisite notes such as Fresh Italian Bergamot, Jamaican Ginger, Moroccan Lemon, and Orange Blossom Absolute from Egypt, Argos Pour Femme creates a beautiful symphony of aromas. Its floral top notes seamlessly transition to a rich and exotic heart of Fresh Iris, Cloves, Pink Pepper, Lavender, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley, and Sweet Bulgarian Rose. The fragrance finishes with a remarkable combination of Sicilian Sandalwood, Oriental notes, Musk, Vanilla Bean, Tonka Bean, and Ylang Ylang. Boasting excellent diffusion, Argos Pour Femme is long-lasting, elegant, and sensual. This versatile and romantic.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Moroccan Lemon, Bergamot, Violet Leaf, Orange Blossom and Ginger

Middle notes: Iris, Lavender, Pink Pepper, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, White Musk, Amber, Ylang-Ylang and Sandalwood

title: Kropp & Sjal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Kropp & Sjal Eau de Parfum, translated into body and soul, is a gift for the body that penetrates deep into the soul. The Swedish culture has always had a strong interest in healing the body and soul, by discovering natural treasures and blending them in an optimal way to create a final product with powerful healing properties. This fragrance is infused with the wonders of nature and takes you on an intimate journey through the lush landscapes of Sweden. The alluring notes of Kropp och Själ awaken all your senses, leaving behind a captivating aroma. This bottle of perfection contains exquisite ingredients such as amber, vanilla, musk, saffron, jasmine, cardamom, and other delightful components that nourish from within.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Blood Orange, Ginger, Cardamom and Bergamot

Middle notes: Amber, Patchouli, Broom, Iris, Jasmine and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Woody Notes, Balsam Fir, Amber, White Chocolate, Vanilla, Labdanum, Musk, Cedar and Leather

title: Orchestra Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Orchestra Eau de Parfum offers a sophisticated blend of fragrances, combining various notes to achieve a distinctive scent. The top notes of nutmeg, bergamot, davana, suede, and white pear provide an alluring introduction. The heart notes contain rosemary, vetiver, and leather, adding complexity and personality. As the fragrance settles, the base notes of agarwood, vanilla, white musk, and cardamom offer a comforting and enduring conclusion.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Pear, Bergamot, Davana, Nutmeg and Suede

Middle notes: Rosemary, Leather and Vetiver

Base notes: Agarwood, Cardamom, Vanilla and White Musk

title: Dux Orientis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Taking inspiration from Odaenathus's epic journey, Ibrahim set out on a mission to capture the essence of the king through the medium of fragrance. This aromatic pilgrimage pays tribute to the golden sands of Palmyra and the resilient spirit of its inhabitants, beginning with a lively blend of citrus notes that dance together in perfect harmony. Bergamot, cantaloupe, mandarin orange, and tangelo come together to create a vivid depiction of sun-drenched sands. The top notes are a celebration of vitality and vigor, a prologue to the aromatic voyage that awaits. As the journey continues, the heart of the perfume unravels deeper layers, reflecting the king's profound connection to both the sea and the land. Seaweed, green nard, and litchi blossoms emerge, each note seamlessly blending to paint a portrait of a ruler whose influence extended beyond borders and boundaries.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: antaloupe, Tangelo, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Seaweed, Litchi Blossom and Green Nard

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk and Oud

title: Onyx Black Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Onyx Black by Pana Dora is a sophisticated blend of warm spices and rich resins. The opening includes saffron and citrus notes, while the heart features ambergris and olibanum, balanced by cypriol oil's earthy intensity. The base adds a grounding touch of cedar, fir resin, and labdanum.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cinnamon, Bergamot, Nutmeg and Lemon

Middle notes: Cypriol, Olibanum and Ambergris

Base notes: Labdanum, Fir Resin and Cedar

title: Eladaria Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Eladaria by Creed is a women's floral fragrance, set to launch in spring 2025. This captivating scent reinvents the traditional rose with a contemporary, luminous blend of light and dark, sensuality and freshness. Drawing inspiration from a paradise garden at sunrise, Eladaria captures the essence of blooming nature through a dynamic interplay of floral notes, creamy undertones, and sparkling hints of citrus.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Mandarin and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Powdery Notes, Peony and Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Cashmere Wood and Vanilla

title: Peche Mirage Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This unisex fragrance from Guerlain, called Pêche Mirage, is part of the L'Art & La Matière Collection. Perfumed by Delphine Jelk, it boasts notes of peach, saffron, and black currant in the top layer, osmanthus in the middle, and a base of sandalwood and amber.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach, Blackcurrant and Saffron

Middle notes: Osmanthus

Base notes: Leather, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Oud Nude Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the luxurious and unique scent of Oud Nude Eau de Parfum. Its masterful blend of rich oud wood and creamy white almond is complemented by tantalizing raspberry and warm Atlas cedar. As it settles, hints of sandalwood and Madagascan vanilla tincture create a smooth and exotic finish.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Almond, Agarwood (Oud)

Middle notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood

Base notes: Rose, Atlas Cedar

title: Rose Cherie Eau de Parfum
body_html:
According to perfumer Delphine Jelk, Rose Chérie embodies the joy of a kissed embrace on a street corner, the magic of a carousel ride in Montmartre, and the sophistication of Parisian life. Combining the beautiful pink-violet duo, much like a Frédéric Malle Lipstick Rose or a Chanel Misia from the Exclusives collection, with heliotropin and tonka bean, this fragrance exudes a suave and romantic aura.

Fragrance family: Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Rose

Middle notes: Violet, Heliotrope

Base notes: Musk, Tonka Bean

title: Spiritueuse Double Vanille Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover a new world with Spiritueuse Double Vanille Eau de Parfum. With a luxurious blend of vanilla, jasmine, and ylang ylang, this woody-amber fragrance transports you on an exotic journey. Inspired by the smell of spices and rum, this epic fragrance will make you feel like you're sailing to distant lands. Experience the essence of adventure and indulgence with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Pink Pepper and Bergamot

Middle notes: Cedar, Ylang-Ylang, Bulgarian Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Vanilla and Benzoin

title: Agar Ebene Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the timeless essence of perfumery with Agar Ebene by Hermessence. Crafted with the legendary agar wood, this fragrance expresses a warm and enigmatic aura, as described by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel. Combining the sensuality of agar wood with the soothing aroma of fir balsam, Agar Ebene is an Hermessence perfect for anyone seeking a profound and mysterious scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Balsam Fir

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud)

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud)

title: Osmanthe Yunnan Eau de Toilette
body_html:
With each new discovery of a country, language, culture, or unique ingredient, the Osmanthe Yunnan Eau de Toilette is continually enriched. This exclusive line, currently consisting of eight fragrances, is only available in Hermès stores. Inspired by a visit to the Forbidden City of Beijing, Osmanthe Yunnan is a smooth blend of osmanthus petals and Chinese tea, with notes of freesia and dried apricots. The delicate tea aromas guide us to the Imperial Palace with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tea and Orange

Middle notes: Osmanthus and Freesia

Base notes: Apricot and Leather

title: Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum by Hermès was created by renowned perfumer Christine Nagel, who was captivated by an exceptionally rare oud. Inspired by the intimate and sensual nature of the fragrance, Nagel was reminded of an unforgettable experience of smelling a chestnut horse's neck. With its heady and majestic scent, Oud Alezan harmoniously combines the enveloping essence of oud with a striking contrast of roses, making it a versatile fragrance for both men and women.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose

Middle notes: Rose Water

Base notes: Oud

title: Vetiver Tonka Eau de Toilette
body_html:
