The Vetiver Tonka Eau de Toilette is crafted with a unique blend of powerful vetiver, velvety hazelnut, and sweet Tonka beans to create a warm and enveloping scent. The perfumer constantly seeks inspiration from new countries, languages, and cultures, resulting in an exclusive line of eight fragrances available only at Hermès stores. This particular fragrance offers a tender twist on traditional vetiver, balancing its earthy notes with a touch of praline.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vetyver, Tonka Bean, Hazelnut

Middle notes: Tobacco, Praline, Caramel

Base notes: Sandalwood, Lily-of-the-Valley

title: Santal Massoia Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Indulge in the refined fragrance of Santal Massoia Eau de Toilette, created by renowned perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena. With notes of Massoïa wood resin from New Guinea, sandalwood, and hints of coconut, peach, and butterscotch, this scent offers a sophisticated blend of milk and dried fruit sweetness. Elevate your senses with this luxurious and unique fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Massioa, Milk

Middle notes: Dried Fruits, Sugar, Floral Notes

Base notes: Sandalwood

title: Cedre Sambac Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the powerful blend of cedar and climbing jasmine in Cedre Sambac Eau de Toilette. With its raw and voluptuous scent, this fragrance captures the beauty of both ingredients. Inspired by the strength and grace of an age-old cedar tree, perfumer Christine Nagel artfully combined the two to create an enveloping floral aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jasmine Sambac

Middle notes: Cedar

Base notes: Cedar

title: Sileno Extrait de Parfum
body_html: Immerse yourself in the aromas of ancient distant lands and lush Mediterranean gardens with Sileno Extrait de Parfum, one of the seven alluring fragrances in the Pompei line by Agatho Parfum. Its wild woodland scents are infused with refreshing marine accents, accompanied by the enchanting music of Silenus, and awaken the irresistible call of nature. Experience the noble art of otium and journey to unspoilt places only ever found in poetry with Sileno.

title: Fauno Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
As an expert in the field, I present to you Fauno Extrait de Parfum, one of the seven premium scents in the Pompei collection. This fragrance boasts a combination of balsamic and playful notes, including fresh citrus and subtle leather, inspired by the untamed and enigmatic atmosphere of nature and its enchanting creatures, such as the faun. The Agatho Fauno fragrance embodies the irresistible force of instinct, inviting you to escape reality and indulge in a dreamy world where your deepest instincts and forbidden desires are awakened.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Mugwort, Tobacco Leaves, Smoky Accents, Grapefruit, Bergamot, Sweet Orange

Middle Notes: Pimento, Petitgrain, Tuberose, Juniper Berries, Clary Sage, Jasmine

Base Notes: Olibanum, Suede, Cedarwood, Amber, Patchouli

title: Phi Une Rose de Kandahar Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Phi is a luxurious fragrance, inspired by a rare and exceptional extract of roses from the rose region of Afghanistan, Nangarhar. This precious rose oil, of the utmost quality, is derived from roses grown in a dry and rugged land. Phi is a true gem, perfectly balancing contrasts and enriched with natural raw materials that add depth and authenticity. Due to the limited production of the rose oil, the availability of Une Rose de Kandahar is not guaranteed. Launched in 2013, PHI Une Rose de Kandahar by Tauer Perfumes is a new floral scent for women and men, created by the nose behind the fragrance, Andy Tauer. With top notes of apricot, cinnamon, almond, and bergamot, and a heart of Bulgarian rose absolute, rose from Kandahar, Bourbon geranium, and tobacco leaf, this fragrance is anchored by base notes of patchouli, vetiver, vanilla, tonka bean, musk, and

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Almond, Apricot, Cinnamon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Tobacco Leaf and Geranium

Base notes: Ambergris, Patchouli, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk and Vetiver

title: Latin Lover Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Latin Lover Eau de Parfum is a captivating, irresistible scent featuring a blend of heady and herbaceous notes. Created by industry expert Jordy Fernandez, this fragrance expertly balances smooth seduction with hot-blooded passion. With a perfect combination of bergamot, narcissus, and patchouli, Latin Lover will surely enrapture your senses and ignite your desires.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Magnolia, Ylang-Ylang and Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Lily-of-the-Valley, French Narcissus and Violet

Base notes: White Musk, Benzoin and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

title: Origins Of The Collector Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
While sipping coffee and strolling along the Thames, I am reminded of the beautiful city and its rich history. The banks of this great river have witnessed the stories of countless individuals. The journey of traveling the world often leads to discovering one's origins and roots. I have personally found a sense of purpose and meaning while exploring London and its bountiful experiences. London truly stands alone, with nothing else quite like it in the world.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Olibanum

Middle notes: Coffee, Patchouli and Caramel

Base notes: Peru Balsam, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Musk, Vanilla and Amber

title: A Night in Marrakesh Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover a sensory experience like no other with A Night in Marrakesh Extrait de Parfum. Immerse yourself in the sights, sounds, and smells of this enchanting city, where every turn brings you closer to the vibrant culture and rich traditions. As you wander through the souk, let the notes of spices and coffee transport you to a world of exotic aromas. Lose yourself in the bustling market atmosphere as you admire the handcrafted goods and vibrant colors. This is an unforgettable sensory journey you won't want to miss.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vetiver, Almond, Cardamom, Moroccan Bergamot

Middle notes: Coffee, Blond Tobacco, Moroccan Rose, Olibanum, Cedarwood, Ginger, Cinnamon, Saffron

Base notes: Amber , Cambodian Oud, Sandalwood, Nagarmotha, Honey, Patchouli, Castoreum

title: Sex and the Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sex and the Sea Extrait de Parfum evokes the passionate recollection of an intimate coastal encounter. This composition transcends typical oceanic fragrances, delivering instead a bold amalgamation of sun-warmed skin, coconut-infused sunscreen, and the briny essence of sea and sand. The fragrance masterfully captures the intoxicating atmosphere of a clandestine tryst amid the dunes, creating an olfactory experience that is both primal and sophisticated.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut, Ambergris, Pineapple, Mimosa

Middle notes: Civet, Immortelle, Iris, Vanilla

Base notes: Myrrh, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Labdanum, Rose

title: Dark Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dark Eau de Parfum embodies the sophisticated allure of dark chocolate—an acquired indulgence that reveals itself only to the mature palate. This complex fragrance represents the pinnacle of sensory refinement, comparable to premium coffee or fine wine in its depth and character. The composition masterfully captures chocolate's transportive essence, evoking the terroir of South American cacao highlands while stimulating multiple sensory pathways. With remarkable precision, it recreates that moment of pure hedonistic satisfaction, delivering an olfactory experience that neurochemically mimics pleasure itself—a true testament to perfumery's ability to translate gustatory luxury into aromatic artistry.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dark Chocolate

Middle notes: Cacao, Vanilla

Base notes: Hazelnut, Cinnamon

title: Rausch Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rausch Eau de Parfum represents Berlin's innovative spirit as the inaugural contemporary creation in this collection. This sophisticated fragrance captures the city's essence through distinctive smoky accords and delicate bitter elements, creating an olfactory bridge between the opulence of Berlin's Golden Twenties and its current status as a premier nightlife destination.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Sandalwood.

Middle notes: Cypriol, Patchouli Heart, Vanilla Bean.

Base notes: Amber, Oud.

title: Rosa Centifolia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The composition begins with delicate sandalwood undertones complemented by vibrant, verdant freshness—heralding the arrival of the centifolia rose. This hundred-petaled bloom emerges gradually from its spice-infused stem, initially reserved before asserting its commanding presence. Rosa Centifolia reveals itself with sensual confidence, its cool buds reaching toward vitality and illumination. This is not merely a fragrance but a celebration of an enduring botanical icon, reminiscent of Gertrude Stein's famous assertion about the rose's singular, irreducible essence.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Petitgrain and Osmanthus

Middle notes: Rose, Bourbon Geranium and Jasmine

Base notes: Bourbon Vetiver, Sandalwood and Myrrh

title: Eisbach No.5 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A masterful composition that harmonizes vibrant citrus notes with the sophisticated essence of Japanese green tea, creating an exhilarating olfactory experience. This exceptional extrait de parfum captures the dynamic interplay between invigorating freshness and serene balance—an artfully crafted homage to Munich's distinctive character and charm.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Basil, Lavender

Middle notes: Mint, Green Tea, Grapefruit

Base notes: Mimosa, Cassis

title: Sekushi No.7 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
An intoxicating juxtaposition of innocence and desire, this composition unveils a sensory narrative where sweet confectionery notes intertwine with provocative depth. The Japanese-inspired "Sekushi" fragrance masterfully balances delicate candyfloss and succulent fruits against rich leather undertones, creating an olfactory tension that embodies seduction. This sophisticated extrait de parfum commands attention with its bold character, making a memorable impression regardless of the hour.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Leather, Cotton Candy

Middle notes: Apricot, Patchouli

Base notes: Musk, Olibanum, Lily-of-the-Valley

title: El Pasajero No.1 Hair Perfume
body_html: El Pasajero No.1 Hair Perfume delivers an exquisite olfactory experience reminiscent of starlit Andalusian summer nights. This sophisticated formulation balances intense aromatic notes with the silky softness of magnolia, creating an elegant feminine fragrance specifically designed for hair application. The carefully calibrated composition ensures lasting scent without compromising hair health or texture.

title: In Between No.4 Hair Perfume
body_html: The In Between No.4 Hair Perfume captures an exquisite olfactory duality. This sophisticated fragrance artfully balances the innocent, dulcet notes of youthful exuberance with the complex maturity of fully-bloomed Arabian jasmine. The composition presents a meticulously crafted aromatic profile—delicately restrained yet unmistakably feminine—revealing a nuanced sensory experience that evolves with remarkable subtlety on the hair's canvas.

title: Amber Kiso Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Amber Kiso Eau de Parfum by DS&Durga presents a sophisticated Woody Chypre composition suitable for all genders. Created in 2018 by perfumer David Seth Moltz, this fragrance opens with aromatic Incense, Cypress, and Cedar notes. The heart reveals a complex blend of Maple, Patchouli, and Iris, while the foundation settles into rich Leather, distinctive Hinoki, and earthy Moss accords. The scent architecture demonstrates masterful balance between woody elements and chypre characteristics.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Cypress, Cedar

Middle notes: Maple, Patchouli, Iris

Base notes: Leather, Hinoki, Moss

title: Debaser Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Debaser Eau de Parfum by DS&Durga represents a sophisticated Aromatic Fruity composition suitable for all genders. Developed in 2015 by perfumer David Seth Moltz, this fragrance opens with verdant Stems Greens, citrusy Bergamot, and succulent Pear. Its heart reveals a complex interplay of luscious Fig, creamy Coconut Milk, and elegant Iris. The foundation evolves into refined Precious Woods complemented by warm Tonka Bean and earthy Moss, creating a distinctive olfactory signature.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Green Leaf, Pear Steam

Middle notes: Fig, Coconut milk, Iris

Base notes: Blond Woods, Tonka bean, Moss

title: Duran Duran Black Moonlight Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Black Moonlight creates an aura of refined elegance, drawing the wearer into its mysterious depths and celebrating intricate sophistication. The composition begins with lively bergamot, bright mandarin, and spicy cardamom that awaken the senses. Its complex heart unfolds with precious saffron, aromatic lavender, exotic sambac jasmine absolute, resinous myrrh, and sensual ylang-ylang, creating an intimate olfactory experience. The foundation rests on rich patchouli, evocative labdanum, velvety tonka bean, and balsamic tolu—resulting in a fragrance of enduring sensuality. Reflecting Duran Duran's artistic heritage, Black Moonlight offers a contemplative yet transformative experience, masterfully balancing innovation with emotional resonance.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Mandarin, Bergamot and Saffron

Middle notes: Myrrh, Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang and Lavender

Base notes: Tolu Balsam, Labdanum, Tonka Bean and Patchouli

title: Artik Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A frozen Arctic seascape captured in fragrance—Artik Sea presents an olfactory masterpiece where lime granita and salt crystals mingle with yuzu and arctic wisteria. The composition opens with powerful marine accords, transporting wearers beyond the polar circle to pristine landscapes dominated by icy winds and untamed nature. Balsamic mint and verdant notes create a refreshing counterpoint to the warm woody-musk foundation. The composition achieves perfect balance through ambergris, its distinctive salinity amplifying the aquatic elements while lending extraordinary depth and longevity. An elegant, sensual embrace that stands as a pinnacle of contemporary perfumery.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Notes, Ozonic notes, Wormwood, Bergamot, Green Notes, Pink Grapefruit, Orange Blossom, Lime, Yuzu, Citron, Pink Pepper and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Sea Notes, Myrtle, White Flowers, Jasmine, Davana, Rose, Fig and Wisteria

Base notes: Salt, Seaweed, Ambergris, Oakmoss, Precious Woods, Amber, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Patchouli

title: Sweet Xplosion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sweet Xplosion Extrait de Parfum delivers an extraordinary olfactory experience that transcends the ordinary. This sophisticated fragrance creates a sensory journey where joy and serenity intertwine, momentarily suspending the wearer from daily concerns. The meticulously balanced composition offers a luxurious escape, enveloping you in a distinctive aura of refined sweetness that persists throughout the day, providing both emotional elevation and lasting aromatic presence.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Honey, Coconut Milk, Lime and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Davana, Argan, Ylang Ylang, Broom, Malva and Taif Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Coffee, Benzoin, Patchouli and Musk

title: Extreme Passion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Passion defined: a crisp, tangy fruit experience. This fragrance captivates with effervescent citrus notes that transport you through undulating waves of sumptuous peach and alluring grape accords. The composition performs a graceful dance between juicy pear and sophisticated white floral elements, while pristine musk and profound amber notes interplay with remarkable equilibrium, creating an olfactory masterpiece of technical precision.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Passionfruit, Peach, Citruses and Grapes

Middle notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: White Musk, Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber and Oakmoss

title: Bloody Smoke Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Bloody Smoke Extrait de Parfum presents a symphony of contradictions: cold mineral elements and spicy elemi clash with luxurious jasmine and lily of the valley at first encounter. The composition evolves to reveal incense and metallic accords complemented by saline ambergris, counterbalanced by mellow, warm resins and woods. This provocative arrangement of notes creates an unexpected harmony through deliberate tension. More than a mere fragrance, Bloody Smoke evokes a battlefield narrative where clashing swords, warrior cries, and the mingling of smoke and blood create an olfactory epic. This composition challenges only the most audacious fragrance connoisseurs willing to embrace its bold character.

Fragrance family: Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mineral notes, Elemi resin, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley

Middle notes: Incense, Metallic notes, Olibanum and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Myrrh, Ambergris, Vanilla, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Passion Rose Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Passion Rose Extrait de Parfum presents an exquisite olfactory composition where lush roses intertwine seamlessly with passionate fruit notes. The fragrance unfolds with a commanding presence, revealing sophisticated leather accords and the refined sensuality of black currant. This expertly crafted perfume leaves a distinctive signature trail, marking the wearer's path with an unmistakable aura of elegant allure.

Fragrance family: Rose, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Passionfruit, Black Currant, Saffron, Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Agarwood (Oud)

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Damask Rose, Jasmine, Patchouli Leaf and Petitgrain Paraguay

Base notes: White Musk, Grapefruit, Vanilla, Oak, Oakmoss, Guaiac Wood and Leather

title: Andromeda Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Andromeda by Tiziana Terenzi presents a sophisticated Oriental Floral composition suitable for all genders, debuting in 2015 under the artistry of Paolo Terenzi. The composition opens with an aromatic quartet of Ylang-Ylang, Water Jasmine, Bergamot, and Grass notes. Its heart reveals a complex bouquet of Peach, Pear Blossom, Lily, White Heliotrope, Violet Leaf, and Damask Rose. The foundation rests on a luxurious blend of Cashmere Wood, Ebony, Amber, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Sugar, and Coconut, creating a harmonious olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang, Water Jasmine, Bergamot and Grass

Middle notes: Peach, Pear Blossom, Lily, White Heliotrope, Violet Leaf and Damask Rose

Base notes: Cashmere Wood, Ebony, Amber, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Sugar and Coconut

title: Libra Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Libra Extrait de Parfum by Tiziana Terenzi presents a sophisticated unisex composition introduced in 2022, crafted by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The composition opens with vibrant citrus accords of grapefruit, lemon, and Calabrian bergamot, complemented by Bulgarian rose and tuberose. Its heart reveals ambergris, Italian orris root, jasmine sambac, and Atlas cedar, while the foundation consists of musk, vanilla flower, benzoin, Haitian vetiver, oakmoss, and Singapore patchouli for a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Lemon, Calabrian bergamot, Bulgarian Rose and Tuberose

Middle notes: Ambergris, Italian Orris Root, Jasmine Sambac and Atlas Cedar

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla Flower, Benzoin, Haitian Vetiver, Oakmoss and Singapore Patchouli

title: Gold Rose Oudh Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tiziana Terenzi's Gold Rose Oudh Extrait de Parfum belongs to their inaugural 2012 collection inspired by fire's transformative power. This fragrance, distinguished by its "black soul" and leather label, embodies the brand's philosophy of capturing emotional moments through scent, representing one stage of a symbolic journey through fire's hypnotic essence.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fir, Sand and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Patchouli and Black Pepper

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Honey, Musk, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Dubhe Assoluto Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Dubhe Assoluto Extrait de Parfum, a 2016 creation by Paolo Terenzi for Tiziana Terenzi, presents a sophisticated Oriental Floral composition suitable for all genders. The fragrance commences with an elegant bouquet of Rose and Saffron, complemented by the distinctive notes of Cyperus esculentus and Geranium. Its complex heart reveals a harmonious blend of White Oud, Gurjan balsam, and Guaiac Wood, enriched with Currant buds, Cedar, Orris, and Vanilla. The composition culminates in a luxurious base featuring precious Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, and Sandalwood, enhanced by warm Amber and sensual Musk.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Saffron, Cyperus esculentus and Geranium

Middle notes: White Oud, Gurjan balsam, Guaiac Wood, Currant buds, Cedar, Orris and Vanilla

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Sandalwood, Amber and Musk

title: Alioth Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Alioth, the luminous celestial giant in Ursa Major, outshines our sun by a factor of four with its brilliant radiance. This extraordinary star, pulsating with intense light across the cosmic expanse, serves as the magnificent inspiration behind this distinguished addition to the Stelle di Luna Absolute collection.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cardamom, Green Pepper and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Patchouli and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Cambodian Oud, Indian Oud, Ambergris, Madagascar Vanilla and Musk

title: Telea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Telea Extrait de Parfum presents a sophisticated Woody Floral Musk composition from Tiziana Terenzi's 2020 collection, crafted by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. This unisex fragrance opens with a harmonious blend of pear, citrus accords, Bulgarian rose, and hawthorn. The heart reveals an exquisite floral arrangement of jasmine, ylang-ylang, and heliotrope, while the foundation combines musk, Haitian vetiver, mahogany, oak, and Cambodian oud for a distinguished, lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Citruses, Bulgarian Rose and Hawthorn

Middle notes: Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Heliotrope

Base notes: Musk, Haitian Vetiver, Mahogany, Oak and Cambodian Oud

title: Cubia Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Cubia Extrait de Parfum represents a refined Citrus Aromatic creation from Tiziana Terenzi, introduced in 2020 and developed by master perfumer Paolo Terenzi. This distinguished unisex composition begins with vibrant citrus accords that transition into a luscious heart of peach and black currant. The foundation features sophisticated woody notes that provide depth and longevity, creating a balanced olfactory experience suitable for discerning fragrance connoisseurs.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses

Middle notes: Peach and Black Currant

Base notes: Woody Notes

title: Orza Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Orza Extrait de Parfum represents a sophisticated Floral Fruity composition from Tiziana Terenzi's 2020 collection, expertly crafted by Paolo Terenzi. This unisex fragrance opens with a complex bouquet of wild berries, coconut, green apple, plum, orchid, mandarin orange, and magnolia. Its heart reveals an exquisite floral arrangement of jasmine, Bulgarian rose, and lily-of-the-valley, while the foundation combines gourmand caramel and Madagascar vanilla with musk, benzoin, amber, and sandalwood for a luxurious, multifaceted experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wild Berries, Coconut, Green Apple, Plum, Orchid, Mandarin Orange and Magnolia

Middle notes: Jasmine, Bulgarian Rose and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Caramel, Musk, Madagascar Vanilla, Benzoin, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Poggia Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Poggia Extrait de Parfum by Tiziana Terenzi presents a sophisticated Chypre Floral composition suitable for all genders, introduced in 2020 and crafted by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus accords of Bergamot, Lemon, and Orange, complemented by succulent Peach. Its heart reveals an intricate blend of Ylang-Ylang, aromatic Rosemary, Turkish Rose, exotic Passionfruit, and crisp Green Apple. The composition settles on a refined foundation of Musk, precious Ambergris, and smooth Vanilla.

Fragrance family: Floral, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Peach and Orange

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Rosemary, Turkish Rose, Passionfruit and Green Apple

Base notes: Musk, Ambergris and Vanilla

title: Halley Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Halley Extrait de Parfum by Tiziana Terenzi represents a refined Floral Fruity composition suitable for all genders, developed by master perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019. The fragrance commences with an exquisite blend of tropical Passionfruit, tart Cassis, bright Lemon, and delicate Rose. Its complex heart reveals juicy Peach, sweet Raspberry, sophisticated Floral accords, fresh Green elements, and warm Cinnamon. The composition concludes with a luxurious foundation of Musk, creamy Vanilla, distinctive Woody Notes, and rich Amber.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Cassis, Lemon and Rose

Middle notes: Peach, Raspberry, Floral Notes, Green Notes and Cinnamon

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Woody Notes and Amber

title: Le Rem Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Le Rem Eau de Parfum by Reminiscence represents a bold and innovative approach to contemporary perfumery, masterfully blending aquatic freshness with rich florals and warm gourmand elements. This sophisticated unisex creation, launched in 2024, showcases the house's ability to create unexpected yet harmonious olfactory combinations that challenge traditional fragrance conventions.

Fragrance family: Fresh, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calone, Jasmine and Lilac

Middle notes: Fenugreek and Patchouli

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean and White Musk

title: Souffle Ambre Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Souffle Ambré Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated amber fragrance that captures the warm, enveloping essence of precious resins and woods in a contemporary unisex composition.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Geranium and Clove

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cedarwood

Base notes: Benzoin, Vanilla, Amber and White Musk

title: Patchouli Elixir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Patchouli Elixir Eau de Parfum represents the quintessential expression of Reminiscence's olfactory heritage, delivering an intensified interpretation of patchouli that captures the revolutionary spirit and cultural awakening of the 1970s. This iconic fragrance serves as both a historical tribute and a contemporary masterpiece, embodying the era's fascination with Eastern mysticism, bohemian freedom, and exotic exploration.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli

Middle notes: Sandalwood

Base notes: Cedar

title: Falling Into The Sea Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Falling Into The Sea Eau de Parfum is an extraordinary olfactory journey inspired by one of literature's most haunting love stories. At nineteen, Nica Galas penned her autobiographical masterpiece, chronicling a passionate summer romance that unfolded among the sun-scorched beaches and fragrant lemon groves of the Gulf of Naples.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Grapefruit

Middle Notes: Lychee, Tropical Flowers

Base Notes: Warm Sand

title: Sundrunk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sundrunk Eau de Parfum is a masterful olfactory interpretation of summer's most intoxicating moments—those blissful instances when the sun's warmth becomes almost narcotic, leaving you deliciously woozy and utterly content.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Neroli, Rhubarb

Middle Notes: Honeysuckle, Rose Water

Base Notes: Orange Zest, First Kiss

title: Every Storm a Serenade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Every Storm a Serenade captures the essence of windswept Danish coastlines and untold stories of desire. This inaugural fragrance from imaginary author Niels Bjerregaard weaves a tale of Stina, a writer seeking solitude in her mother's summer house, whose brief encounter with mysterious fisherman Ulv ignites a passion that permeates every page of her unfinished novel.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Eucalyptus Absolute , Vetiver, Spruce Oil

Middle Notes: Calone, Ambergris

Base Notes: Heather, Baltic Sea Mist

title: Untamable Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Untamable embodies the fierce independence of the American frontier, where endless horizons meet untamed spirits and freedom knows no boundaries. This captivating 2024 unisex eau de parfum captures the essence of those who refuse to be confined, drawing inspiration from the raw beauty of desert landscapes and the wild hearts that call them home.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Leather, Cumin and Tonka

Middle Notes: Cactus Flower and Floral Notes

Base Notes: Animal notes

title: The Language Of Glaciers Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Language Of Glaciers captures the profound solitude and breathtaking beauty of alpine wilderness, where silence speaks volumes and every snowflake tells a story. This evocative eau de parfum embodies the romantic epic of an unnamed narrator whose mountain encounters reveal the extraordinary within the seemingly barren—chunky snowflakes swirling like nature's confetti, the haunting call of a solitary snow owl piercing crystalline air.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: White Pine, Lilac

Middle Notes: Cashmere, Juniper, Forget Me Not

Base Notes: Blue Bugle, Virgin Snowfall

title: Divina Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Divina Eau de Parfum captivates with its bold gourmand character, blending a sharp intensity that lingers on your pulse points. This fragrance melds seamlessly with your skin’s warmth, embodying passion and daring rather than delicate grace. Inspired by a goddess yet unrestrained, Divina reveals a raw, indulgent essence designed for moments charged with desire. It’s a scent crafted for those who embrace temptation, ignite secret passions, and defy convention with every glance.

Fragrance family: Oriental Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin and Orange

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Benzoin and Violet

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Cedarwood and Tonka

title: Oriento Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Oriento by Jeroboam is a unisex Oriental fragrance introduced in 2015, crafted by perfumer Vanina Muracciole. Its composition opens with vibrant saffron, styrax, and lemon, followed by a heart of rose, apple, and ylang-ylang. The scent settles into a warm base of patchouli, sandalwood, and white musk, offering a sophisticated and balanced olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Styrax and Lemon

Middle notes: Rose, Apple and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood and White Musk

title: Hauto Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Hauto by Jeroboam is a unisex Floral Woody Musk scent introduced in 2015, crafted by perfumer Vanina Muracciole. It opens with vibrant pineapple and bergamot, followed by a heart of tuberose, spicy accords, and rose, resting on a base of white musk.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple and Bergamot

Middle notes: Tuberose, Spicy Notes and Rose

Base notes: White Musk

title: Attaquer le Soleil Marquis de Sade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Attaquer le Soleil Marquis de Sade by Etat Libre d'Orange is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2016. Crafted by perfumer Quentin Bisch, this scent offers a distinctive olfactory experience for both women and men.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Cistus

title: This Is Not Serotonin Parfum
body_html:
Elevate your mood with Serotonin Parfum, a carefully crafted blend designed to gently stimulate the brain and encourage the release of uplifting happy hormones. This harmonious fusion of aromas evokes feelings of happiness, excitement, and joy, offering a refreshing boost that brightens your day with every spray. Embrace moments of bliss and positivity wherever you go.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee, Chocolate, Artemisia and Bergamot

Middle notes: Tobacco, White Flowers and Caramel

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Ambroxan and Incense

title: Serenity Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Serenity Eau de Parfum offers a captivating fusion that delivers depth, character, and balance. This scent is expertly crafted with precise notes of cumin, spices, and oud. It reinterprets classic Middle Eastern fragrance traditions by blending contrasts—light and shadow, masculine and feminine, strength and elegance—into a harmonious composition.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose and Saffron

Middle notes: Cumin, Clove, Cedar and Jasmine

Base notes: Leather, Agarwood (Oud), Olibanum, Praline, Patchouli and Musk

title: Voyage Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Voyage Eau de Parfum invites you on a historic journey to the golden age of Oman’s maritime trade. Inspired by merchant fleets that transported precious spices and incense to ancient civilizations like the Pharaohs, Sumerians, Romans, and the Kingdom of Sheba, this fragrance captures the vintage essence of those exotic goods. A masculine, smoky, and refined scent, Voyage leaves a lasting impression and draws admiration.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Ginger and Bergamot

Middle notes: Floral Notes, Geranium and Rose

Base notes: Ambergris, Incense, Labdanum, Patchouli and Musk

title: Blu Mare Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Blu Mare captures the exhilaration of sunlight shimmering on ocean waves, the soothing pulse of the sea, and the invigorating aroma of pine forests. It opens with vibrant Lemon and Grapefruit notes that sparkle like sunlight on water. At its core, a marine accord evokes the seaside, blending the gentle sound of waves with the fresh scent of Cypress in a captivating harmony. The base features Ambergris and Oakmoss, adding depth and longevity, wrapping the skin in a sensual, sea breeze-inspired embrace for an alluring finish.

 

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cypress and Sea Notes

Base notes: Oakmoss and Ambergris

title: Solstis Parfum
body_html:
Solstis Parfum captures the essence of the sun’s solstices in a timeless fragrance. It opens with fresh citrus notes of mandarin and bergamot, followed by spicy pink pepper and fruity hints. The heart blends earthy spices and white florals, leading to warm autumnal tones of nutmeg, neroli, and cardamom. Japanese vetiver, sandalwood, and vanilla create a sensual, lasting finish. Perfect for any season, Solstis is a sophisticated scent that evokes passion and transformation.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Apple, Mandarin Orange and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Neroli, Cardamom, Pepper and Nutmeg

Base notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla and Vetiver

title: Faith Parfum
body_html:
Drawing inspiration from the majestic and modern design of Pakistan’s Faisal Mosque, Faith Parfum embodies the essence of steadfast belief. This enduring and evocative scent offers both comfort and strength, resonating deeply like true faith. It opens with a captivating fusion of spices and aquatic notes, immediately engaging the senses. The heart reveals a delicate floral blend of osmanthus, rose, violet, and a hint of sweet Immortelle. Anchored by a lasting base of cypriol, sandalwood, moss, amber, vanilla, and musk, Faith delivers a refined and resilient fragrance that supports you with calm confidence and hope throughout your day.

Fragrance family: Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Nutmeg, Mandarin Orange and Davana

Middle notes: Violet Leaf, Immortelle and Rose

Base notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Amber, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla and Oakmoss

title: Blessing Silence Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Blessing Silence from The House of Oud is a unisex Oriental Woody fragrance introduced in 2016. It features a top note of labdanum, a heart of patchouli, and a base composed of agarwood (oud), rose, and sandalwood, delivering a rich and sophisticated scent experience.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Labdanum

Middle notes: Patchouli

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Rose and Sandalwood

title: Neverending Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Neverending by The House of Oud is an Oriental Floral scent crafted for both women and men, introduced in 2021. Created by perfumer Douglas Morel, it opens with vibrant top notes of spices, nutmeg, cumin, black pepper, and pink grapefruit. The heart reveals a refined blend of suede, tuberose, and jasmine, while the base combines rich black vanilla husk, guaiac wood, amber, cypriol oil (nagarmotha), musk, and Virginia cedar for a lasting, sophisticated finish.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices, Nutmeg, Cumin, Black Pepper and Pink Grapefruit

Middle notes: Suede, Tuberose and Jasmine

Base notes: Black Vanilla Husk, Guaiac Wood, Amber, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Musk and Virginia Cedar

title: Wind Heat Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wind Heat from The House of Oud is a unisex Leather fragrance introduced in 2016. It opens with vibrant top notes of pink pepper, bergamot, and nutmeg. The heart features iris and Virginia cedar, while the base is composed of suede, musk, agarwood (oud), and vetiver, creating a rich and sophisticated scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Iris and Virginia Cedar

Base notes: Suede, Musk, Agarwood (Oud) and Vetiver

title: Wonderly Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wonderly invites you to explore limitless possibilities where nothing is out of reach and surprises await. This fragrance blends the radiant warmth of myrrh with the refined clarity of iris. Its joyful top notes of goji berry and apricot introduce a sweet, uplifting opening that leads to a heart enriched by white flowers—African neroli and jasmine—offering both emotional depth and graceful sophistication. The base combines the rich embrace of Madagascar vanilla and Mysore sandalwood, subtly enhanced by Yemeni incense, creating a profound and enveloping finish.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apricot and Goji Berries

Middle notes: Almond Blossom, Neroli and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Sandalwood, Madagascar Vanilla, Musk, Myrrh, Virginia Cedar, Italian Iris and Incense

title: Get The Feeling Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Get The Feeling by The House of Oud is a unisex Woody Spicy fragrance introduced in 2020, crafted by perfumer Maurizio Cerizza. It opens with vibrant top notes of Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon, watery accords, ginger, and pink pepper. The heart blends davana, cardamom, coriander, chamomile, and angelica, while the base features juniper berries, precious woods, ambrette (musk mallow), and patchouli, creating a complex and captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Watery Notes, Ginger and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Davana, Cardamom, Coriander, Chamomile and Angelica

Base notes: Juniper Berries, Precious Woods, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Patchouli

title: Sacred Groove Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In 2022, The House of Oud highlights pure creativity, nature, organic craftsmanship, and a passion for aesthetics. Sacred Groove is a collaborative artistic endeavor with Domitilla Biondi, an Italian paper artist known for her intricate scalpel-cut works. This project reflects her personal inspirations and explores connections with other dimensions, resulting in truly unique creations.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Angelica and Bitter Orange

Middle notes: Lavender, Labdanum, Iris, Turkish Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Amber, Spicy Notes, Myrrh, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Patchouli and Woody Notes

title: Up To The Moon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Up To The Moon by The House of Oud is a unisex Oriental Floral fragrance launched in 2020, crafted by Cristian Calabro and Carlo Ribero. It opens with top notes of Tuscan iris, black currant, neroli, pear, and grapefruit. The heart features magnolia, jasmine sambac, and damask rose, while the base combines raspberry, Madagascar vanilla, musk, amber, ambrette (musk mallow), and sandalwood for a rich, elegant finish.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuscan Iris, Black Currant, Neroli, Pear and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Damask Rose

Base notes: Raspberry, Madagascar Vanilla, Musk, Amber, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Sandalwood

title: Burnt Roses Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The woman living just across the street, surrounded by a wall of withered vine roses, always welcomed me with a warm, genuine smile and a voice that stood out whenever we met. She appeared elegant and well-liked. One day, as I was heading home, we paused to chat briefly. Her expressive gestures and confident gaze were striking, yet beneath that vibrant exterior, I sensed a profound loneliness—a scent of yearning she seemed unable to satisfy.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Ozonic notes, Black Pepper and Salt

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Lavender, Oakmoss and Cinnamon

Base notes: Incense, Olibanum, Ambergris, Cashmeran, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Drunk Maple Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Drunk Maple by BORNTOSTANDOUT® is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2024, crafted by perfumer Alex Lee. It opens with vibrant top notes of rum, davana, and pink pepper. The heart blends syrup, maple, coffee, and suede, while the base features warm vanilla, benzoin, Orcanox™, and sandalwood, creating a rich and sophisticated scent.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Davana and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Syrup, Maple, Coffee and Suede

Base notes: Vanilla, Benzoin, Orcanox™ and Sandalwood

title: Filthy Musk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Filthy Musk Eau de Parfum opens with fleeting notes of pineapple and honey, leading into a dominant, sensual musk that commands attention. This primal musk is enriched by warm nutmeg and earthy patchouli, forming a compellingly raw accord. Jasmine and spices introduce an intoxicating complexity, while patchouli anchors the scent in a deep, animalistic base. As it develops, darker vanilla and caramel notes emerge, blending with the musk’s intense energy. A hint of civet adds a wild, untamed edge, complemented by amber and tonka bean for a warm, enduring finish. The result is a bold, unforgettable fragrance that embraces the raw power of desire.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Musk, Honey and Pineapple

Middle notes: Musk, Jasmine, Patchouli and Nutmeg

Base notes: Musk, Civet, Vanilla, Caramel, Tonka, Ambergris, Ambroxan and Rum

title: Unholy Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The man next door embodies sensuality. His striking contrast of a voluptuous physique and delicate features stirred a deep desire within me. One morning, feeling unusually bright, I caught sight of his back as I headed to the elevator. His thick black hair, pale skin, doe-like eyes, sharp v-shaped chin, and small lips formed a captivating silhouette beneath broad, strong shoulders. Sensing my gaze in the brief silence, he turned to meet my eyes and greeted me with a clear, awakening voice: “Hello.”

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Laotian Oud, Turkish Rose and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Palisander Rosewood, Tonka Bean, Heliotrope and Vanilla

title: Rougewood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rougewood Eau de Parfum blends the sweetness of red fruits with the warmth of amber woods, enhanced by notes of pomelo, peach, and musk. This vibrant scent captures the passionate and bold essence of a deep red hue. Perfumer Emna Doghri, founder of her own fragrance design company, connected with Mohamed Rebatchi through their shared dreams and cultural backgrounds. Inspired by Mohamed’s passionate spirit, she crafted this rich, warm, and embracing fragrance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pomelo

Middle notes: Black Currant and Peach Blossom;

Base notes: Amberwood and Caramel

title: Metal Flower Parfum
body_html:
Metal Flower is a contemporary fragrance that enchants like a gleam reflecting off polished metal. It blends elegant Bulgarian Rose, Rose of May, and Patchouli with crisp metallic accents, forming a floral trio with a striking, refined edge. Subtle yet precise, this radiant Yin scent captivates and inspires.

Fragrance family: Floral, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Orange Blossom and Rose Oxide

Middle notes: Rose de Mai, Bulgarian Rose and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: White Musk and Patchouli

title: Blue Heart Hair Fragrance
body_html: The Blue Heart Hair Fragrance draws inspiration from the world’s largest heart-shaped diamond, a brilliant cut exceeding 30 carats. This reflects the lively joie de vivre of the Blue Heart’s socialite owners. Its composition centers on vanilla, harmoniously combined with saffron and white coconut to evoke the vibrant and exotic essence of their glamorous lifestyles.

title: Chords Cologne Elixir
body_html:
Chords Cologne Elixir blends the essence of British tradition with the timeless cologne format, reinventing it through intricate chords and accords that deliver remarkable projection and lasting power. Each scent in this collection is designated as a Cologne Elixir, representing a creative and sophisticated reinterpretation of classic fragrance design.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Orange Blossom and Neroli

Middle notes: Honey, Tobacco and Ylang Ylang

Base notes: Leather, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Cedar

title: Centre Stage Cologne Elixir
body_html:
Thameen Centre Stage, introduced in 2024, is a unisex fragrance inspired by the vibrant nightlife of the 1920s cabaret scene, frequented by elite socialites in search of sensory delight. This scent captivates with a rich orange blossom absolute that delivers intense sweetness, complemented by leather undertones that create a seductive and enigmatic finish.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Cardamom and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Orris, Orange Blossom and Jasmine

Base notes: Amberwood, Styrax and Animal notes

title: Fanfare Cologne Elixir
body_html:
Fanfare draws inspiration from Covent Garden’s Flower Market, celebrated through films and musicals and recently transformed into a vibrant entertainment space. Chong reflects, “I admire the enduring legacy of George Bernard Shaw’s Pygmalion, a timeless work adapted across various forms. Collaborating with French perfumer Bruno Jovanovic to create an olfactory tribute has been a remarkable opportunity to contribute to this ongoing evolution.”

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Neroli, Bergamot and Floral Notes

Middle notes: Vermouth, juniper berry and Rosemary

Base notes: Vetiver, Musk and Patchouli

title: Bold As Love Cologne Elixir
body_html:
Bold As Love expertly combines aromatic and animalic elements with rich leather, accented by fresh, sharp highlights. Negrin shares, “While developing Bold As Love, I was inspired by an image of Jimi Hendrix in a purple outfit—my favorite color. To evoke the spirit of that image, I designed a fragrance featuring smoky leather notes that reflect his raw, powerful stage presence and distinctive style. The smoky nuances also capture Hendrix’s vibrant and unconventional life. This scent honors a remarkable and innovative genius who continues to inspire.”

Fragrance family: Spicy, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Mandarin, Apple and Ginger

Middle notes: juniper berry, Lavender and Geranium

Base notes: Leather, Patchouli and Vetiver

title: Bohemian Infusion Cologne Elixir
body_html:
Bohemian Infusion draws inspiration from the vibrant Covent Garden Piazza of the 19th and early 20th centuries, a hub for the indulgent pleasures of dandies and literati. Master Perfumer Maurice Roucel and award-winning perfumer Alexandra Carlin capture the interplay of light and shadow, danger and desire. This fragrance balances bright, energetic notes with dark, mysterious undertones, offering a fresh take on the classic cologne structure through unexpected, freestyle ingredients.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Petitgrain, Cardamom and Black Currant

Middle notes: Myrtle, Ginger, Artemisia and Cinnamon

Base notes: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Labdanum and Amber

title: Riviere Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The renowned Riviere necklace, once owned by Queen Mary and featuring 34 old-cut diamonds, was later passed to Princess Margaret and sold at Christie’s for nearly £1 million in 2006. Inspired by this legacy, Thameen’s new fragrance, Riviere, embodies balance and a seamless blend of rare, sparkling notes that grace the skin. Its radiant opening combines Indian black pepper and Persian saffron with Ceylon cinnamon and luminous lemon blossom. The heart reveals Russian clary sage layered over Turkish rose and carnation, enriched by warm Indonesian patchouli. The base glows with golden amber, oud, Indian cypriol, and sunlit leather, creating a sophisticated, richly textured scent. Riviere is a refined olfactory composition, perfect for connoisseurs seeking elegance and complexity.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Turkish Rose, Sage and Carnation

Base notes: Leather and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: Royal Sapphire Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the British Royal Family’s prized bright blue sapphires, Royal Sapphire Extrait de Parfum captures their dazzling brilliance and depth. This refined fragrance blends fresh bergamot and mandarin with warm amber, creating an elegant and captivating scent. As Thameen’s Jewel in the Crown, it embodies regal sophistication and timeless allure.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orange Blossom and Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Woody Notes, Oakmoss and Patchouli

title: Amber Room Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The Amber Room at Catherine Palace near St Petersburg was famed for its walls covered entirely in amber panels, enhanced by gold leaf and mirrors. Illuminated by over five hundred candles, it radiated a golden, sunlit glow. This fragrance draws inspiration from that brilliance, blending amber, Cognac, and honey into a warm, smoky essence. The scent opens with bright Italian bergamot, unfolds into rich Turkish rose, and is deepened by spicy cinnamon and cedarwood, capturing the room’s seductive and radiant character.

 

 Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Amber, Turkish Rose

Middle notes: Coriander, Spices

Base notes: Cedar, Bergamot

title: L'Oudh Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
L'Oudh Extrait de Parfum offers a distinctive and rare olfactory experience. This unisex eau de parfum features a natural oudh essential oil sourced from Laos, accompanied by cypriol and other supporting notes that emphasize its wild, untamed character. Unlike traditional fragrances, it does not follow a conventional olfactory pyramid but centers on the authentic oudh accord. With impressive longevity and a balanced sillage, it is recommended to sample before purchase. Additional ingredients include dark vetiver from Java, patchouli, myrrh, catoreum, morrel extract, musk, cistus, sandalwood, and ambergris. The oudh oil is legally imported under a CITES license.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental,Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose and jasmin absolute, oudh oil

Middle notes: cistus oil, styrax, tobacco, sandalwood

Base notes: myrrh oil, patchouli, vetiver, cypriol

title: Halwa Kiss Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Halwa Kiss Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from the renowned Omani treat, offering a lavish and generous scent that captures the festive spirit and treasured moments with loved ones. It blends the gentle sweetness of dates and honey with the elegant floral touch of rose, enriched by vanilla’s warmth, the spicy notes of cardamom and saffron, and a savory burst of pistachio and nut accords. Each spray wraps you in a cozy embrace, filling the air with an alluring sweetness.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pistachio, Saffron and Cardamom

Middle notes: Honey, Dates, Roasted Nuts and Rose

Base notes: Sesame, Vanilla and Amber

title: Eagle Eyed Stranger Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Eagle Eyed Stranger Eau de Parfum honors the profound essence of frankincense, capturing its raw, soulful character with minimal alteration to preserve its natural poetry. Accents of warm spices and pimento enrich its refined nuances, while vetiver and birch woods contribute depth and complexity, creating a fragrance that radiates boldness and mystery.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Bay Leaf and Lily-of-the-Valley

Middle notes: Dry Wood, Vetiver and Oakmoss

Base notes: Pimento, White Amber and Birch

title: Encens Cuirve Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Encens Cuivre Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from ancient legends, crafting a scent journey centered on three earthly treasures: frankincense, myrrh, and gold. This fragrance blends precious natural resins—frankincense, myrrh, and elemi—with the luxurious essence of vanilla, known as the "gold of perfumers," and is softened by a velvety musk. The result is a radiant, hypnotic trail that bridges timeless stories with contemporary elegance.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi and Brazilian Rosewood

Middle notes: Frankincense, Myrrh and Patchouli

Base notes: Musk, Ambergris and Vanila

title: Montabaco Aruba Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Montabaco Aruba captures the essence of the island’s natural beauty with a refined and inviting scent. It opens with bright citrus notes of bergamot, orange absolute, and grapefruit, reminiscent of sun-drenched beaches and fresh ocean air. The heart reveals a vibrant bouquet of magnolia, jasmine, rose, and violet, reflecting the island’s lush flora. Anchored by a creamy sandalwood base, the fragrance deepens with warm tobacco leaf, leather, and spicy cardamom, finishing on a sensual sandalore note that leaves a lasting impression of elegance and warmth.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot and Orange

Middle notes: Violet, Magnolia, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Sandalore™, Tobacco Leaf, Cardamom and Leather

title: Montabaco Cuba Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Montabaco Cuba is celebrated for its dynamic creativity and global charm, evoking the warmth of a beloved friend or a family rich with stories. This fragrance embodies the spirit of Latin America with a delicious gourmand touch. It opens with bright notes of bergamot, magnolia, and jasmine, resting on a smooth base of sandalwood and vanilla absolute, making Montabaco Cuba a distinctive and memorable scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Orange, Mandarin Orange, Freesia and Juniper

Middle notes: Dry Wood, Tea, Magnolia and Jasmine

Base notes: Tobacco Leaf, Iso E Super, Ambergris, Tonka, Suede, Sandalwood and Vanilla Absolute

title: Montabaco Rio Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Montabaco Rio reaches new levels of vibrancy with sun-ripened wild fruits, bright pineapple, and luscious mango, embodying a lively celebration of energy. This dazzling, dynamic fragrance captures the spirit of a carnival—bold, exciting, and full of flair. Its sophisticated blend of moss, amber, vanilla, and suede creates a captivating contrast, enabling Montabaco Rio to deliver its striking character with exceptional elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Fruits, Caramel, Rhubarb, Bergamot and Cardamom

Middle notes: Cashmere Wood, Mango, Ambroxan and Tea

Base notes: Suede, Tonka, Iso E Super, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Tobacco Leaf and Moss

title: Desert Suave Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Delight Desert Suave captures the warmth of a desert breeze. It embodies the spirit of an oasis that captivates the mind, offering a luscious mirage that enchants the senses.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dates, Sesame, Cardamom

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Cedar

Base notes: Mandarin Orange, Rose

title: Cuir de Chine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance offers a fresh and refined scent that celebrates the essence of suede and leather. It creates a sophisticated, sporty-chic aura, perfect for spontaneous escapes.

 

Fragrance family: Fruity, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Osmanthus

Middle notes: Egyptian Jasmine

Base notes: Tobacco, Clary Sage

title: Oranger Sirocco Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oranger Sirocco Eau de Parfum was created to serve as a distinctive olfactory landmark—a sensory guide that is both radiant and uplifting. This fragrance reflects a return to fundamental values, celebrating life with a thoughtful spirit. From the opening notes, it transports the senses to a warm, shimmering breeze sweeping across a Mediterranean orange blossom grove. With eyes closed, the rich scent of orange blossoms blends with the distant sounds of a bustling souk, where waves of spicy aromas mingle, carried by the steady breath of the sirocco wind.

 Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Spices

Base notes: Cinnamon

title: Patchouli Noisette Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Patchouli Noisette Eau de Parfum offers a fresh take on the iconic patchouli note by blending it with a groundbreaking ingredient: an ultrasound extract of Piedmont hazelnut from Italy. This exclusive extract, crafted using entirely green extraction methods, highlights the finest quality hazelnuts in the world. The fragrance achieves a refined harmony, contrasting the deep, earthy character of patchouli with the smooth, praline-like softness of Piedmont hazelnut.

 Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Hazelnut

Middle notes: Patchouli

Base notes: Patchouli

title: Rose de Jamal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rose de Jamal Eau de Parfum offers an innovative take on the traditional rose fragrance, blending aromatic, rosy, and woody elements in a bold, avant-garde composition. This perfume breaks away from classic floral interpretations, presenting a modern and sophisticated scent profile that highlights the complexity and depth of rose in a fresh, unexpected way. Ideal for those seeking a distinctive and refined fragrance experience, it balances aromatic freshness with warm woody undertones for lasting elegance.

 


Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Moroccan Rose

Middle notes: Pink pepper

Base notes: Lavander, Cedarwood

title: Musk Complexity Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Musk Complexity Extrait de Parfum by New Notes, launched in 2022, is a refined woody floral musk fragrance designed for both women and men. It opens with a vibrant blend of lemon, ginger, rum, bergamot, petitgrain, and red fruits, creating an invigorating and dynamic introduction. The heart reveals a rich and exotic combination of chocolate flower, labdanum, cardamom, and jasmine, adding depth and complexity. The base is a warm, sensual mix of cinnamon, musk, brown sugar, guaiac wood, animal notes, synthetic civet, patchouli, and sandalwood, providing a lasting and sophisticated finish. This extrait de parfum offers an intense and enduring scent experience for those who appreciate intricate and bold compositions.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Ginger, Rum, Bergamot, Petitgrain and Red Fruits

Middle notes: Chocolate Flower, Labdanum, Cardamom and Jasmine

Base notes: Cinnamon, Musk, Brown sugar, Guaiac Wood, Animal notes, Synthetic Civet, Patchouli and Sandalwood

title: New Leather Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
New Leather Extrait de Parfum by New Notes, launched in 2022, is a sophisticated leather fragrance crafted for both women and men. It opens with vibrant top notes of saffron, pink pepper, nutmeg, and bergamot, offering a spicy and fresh introduction. The heart reveals a complex blend of cardamom, iris, labdanum, and palisander rosewood, adding depth and a refined floral-woody character. The base is rich and enduring, featuring suede, woody notes, vetiver, cinnamon, cypriol oil (nagarmotha), gurjan balsam, and patchouli, which together create a warm, earthy, and luxurious finish. This extrait de parfum delivers an intense and lasting scent experience, perfect for those who appreciate a bold yet elegant leather fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Pink Pepper, Nutmeg and Bergamot

Middle notes: Cardamom, Iris, Labdanum and Palisander Rosewood

Base notes: Suede, Woody Notes, Vetiver, Cinnamon, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Gurjan balsam and Patchouli

title: Latte Pistachio Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Latte Pistachio Extrait de Parfum is a luxurious fragrance that artfully combines the creamy warmth of a frothy latte with the rich, nutty essence of pistachio. This gourmand scent wraps the wearer in a comforting yet refined aroma, reminiscent of enjoying pistachio ice cream on a sunny summer day—smooth, creamy, and delightfully nutty. Inspired by the joy of indulgence and the playful spirit of childhood, this fragrance balances elegance with a sense of fun. Designed for those who appreciate both sophistication and whimsy, Latte Pistachio transforms every moment into a sweet, memorable experience.

 


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pistachio, Orange and Lemon

Middle notes: Coriander, Milk and Cardamom

Base notes: Sandalwood, Musk and Amber

title: Smesh Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Khamzat Chimaev popularized the term "Smesh" in his wrestling, symbolizing an unparalleled and relentless dominance rarely witnessed in MMA history. This perfume embodies that same spirit—bold and commanding. Its blend of cedarwood and fiery spices fuels enduring passion, while vanilla and tonka bean add an alluring depth. The burst of blood orange injects an energetic, explosive edge, empowering you to pursue your ambitions with confidence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Lavender and Neroli

Middle notes: Spices, Cashmeran and Cinnamon

Base notes: Vanilla, Vetiver, Moss, Amber, Tonka Bean and Cedarwood

title: Tenerife Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tenerife Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of Mediterranean luxury with a charismatic and dominant presence. Imagine wandering through a sunlit village where warm smiles and vibrant streets set the scene for unforgettable encounters. This fragrance opens with fresh citrus notes that evoke the sea breeze, seamlessly blending into delicate white florals and rich amber, enhanced by subtle aromatic hints. Warm, sweet spices add depth and passion, making it ideal for free spirits and adventurers. Perfect for spring and summer, it also adapts to cooler seasons indoors, offering a strong yet balanced scent that deepens with every wear.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citrus notes, White floral notes

Middle notes: Sweet notes, Warm spicy notes, Fresh spicy notes

Base notes: Amber, Aromatic notes, Vanilla

title: Choco Raptor Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Choco Raptor by Lorenzo Pazzaglia is an Oriental Woody fragrance crafted for both women and men, introduced in 2023. The scent opens with rich notes of chocolate, saffron, candied almond, anise, ginger, grapefruit, and bergamot. Its heart reveals a blend of patchouli, white chocolate, cedar, almond blossom, davana, cardamom, and violet. The base combines leather, sandalwood, agarwood (oud), tonka bean, patchouli, Madagascar and Bourbon vanilla, woody accords, musk, and amber, creating a complex and sophisticated aroma.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Chocolate, Saffron, Candied Almond, Anise, Ginger, Grapefruit and Bergamot

Middle notes: Patchouli, White Chocolate, Cedar, Almond Blossom, Davana, Cardamom and Violet

Base notes: Leather, Sandalwood, Agarwood (Oud), Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Madagascar Vanilla, Bourbon Vanilla, Woody Notes, Musk and Amber

title: Fom Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Fôm by Lorenzo Pazzaglia is an Oriental Woody fragrance designed for both women and men, introduced in 2022. The composition opens with top notes of whiskey, rum, caramel, elemi, and bergamot. Its heart features birch tar and labdanum, while the base is enriched with agarwood (oud), leather, cedar, myrrh, and oakmoss, delivering a deep and sophisticated scent profile.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey, Rum, Caramel, elemi and Bergamot

Middle notes: Birch Tar and Labdanum

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Leather, Cedar, Myrrh and Oakmoss

title: Van Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Van Sea by Lorenzo Pazzaglia is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2022. Crafted by Lorenzo Pazzaglia, it opens with a blend of Bourbon, Madagascar, Tahitian, and classic Vanilla, complemented by Yuzu, Mint, and Wormwood. The heart reveals Vanilla intertwined with Sea Notes, Caramel, Myrtle, and White Flowers. Its base combines Black Vanilla Husk, Salt, Tonka Bean, Ambergris, Algae, Patchouli, and Agarwood (Oud), creating a sophisticated and layered scent experience.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Madagascar Vanilla, Tahitian Vanilla, Vanilla, Yuzu, Mint and Wormwood

Middle notes: Vanilla, Sea Notes, Caramel, Myrtle and White Flowers

Base notes: Black Vanilla Husk, Salt, Tonka Bean, Ambergris, Algae, Patchouli and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Generation(s) Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Generation(s) Eau de Parfum, launched in 2025, offers a sophisticated unisex scent that balances fresh and warm notes. The fragrance opens with vibrant frankincense, juicy pear, and spicy pink pepper, leading to a rich fig heart. Its base combines creamy sandalwood, sensual musk, and sweet tonka bean, creating a lasting, elegant aroma suitable for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Pink Pepper and Frankincense

Middle notes: Fig

Base notes: Sandalwood, Musk and Tonka Bean

title: 21 Conduit St Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jovoy’s latest creation, "21 Conduit St," reinterprets a hallmark of English perfumery with a fresh, contemporary perspective. Rooted in the timeless association of lavender—evoking images of Norfolk sachets and traditional British Eau de Cologne—this fragrance elevates lavender with a distinct clarity. Developed by Oli Marlow, whose lifelong passion for this aromatic note inspired the formula, the scent enhances lavender’s complexity by intensifying its zesty, fruity facets and enriching it with warm, resinous undertones. The result is a sophisticated tribute to a classic note, reimagined for the modern era.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Rhubarb, Lavender and Bergamot

Middle notes: Balsam Fir and Amaretto

Base notes: Ambroxan, Woody Notes and Tonka Bean

title: Creme de Cuir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Creme de Cuir Eau de Parfum captures the essence of Indian summer with its refined blend of white and beige tones, embodying contemporary sensuality. This sophisticated fragrance reveals a pristine leather accord, delicately purified to a luminous white, while green notes add a fresh, embracing depth. Accents of musk and bergamot elevate the scent with Italian-inspired brightness, creating a harmonious, evolving composition reminiscent of Rothko’s monochromatic style, where each element gracefully interacts in a captivating dance. Perfect for those seeking a subtle yet elegant expression of refined warmth.

Fragrance family: Musk, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: White Suede, Sandalwood, Pink Pepper and Pepper

Base notes: Cashmeran, Vanilla, White Musk, Gray Musk and Birch

title: Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Between Two Trees Night Eau de Parfum by Floraïku Paris tells the evocative tale of an owl observing the peaceful twilight hours. This unisex citrus aromatic fragrance opens with vibrant, sharp notes of grapefruit that awaken the senses. The heart features mate absolute, adding a unique, herbal depth that enhances the complexity of the scent. Grounding the composition is a warm, earthy vetiver base, which provides balance and longevity. Together, these elements create a refined and harmonious fragrance that captures the quiet mystery and tranquil beauty of dusk between two trees.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit

Middle notes: Mate

Base notes: Vetiver

title: I See The Clouds Go By Eau de Parfum
body_html:
I See The Clouds Go By Eau de Parfum by Floraïku Paris captures a moment of serene detachment, beautifully blending a unisex floral fruity composition. The fragrance opens with the luscious, tangy sweetness of cassis absolute, paired harmoniously with the delicate, fruity nuances of cherry blossom. This fresh and uplifting combination creates a light, airy top impression that evokes drifting clouds and calm skies. The heart gradually gives way to a rich, velvety musk base, adding depth and warmth that balances the bright florals and fruits. The result is an elegant scent that embodies effortless grace and tranquility, perfect for those seeking a refined yet approachable fragrance.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cassis

Middle notes: Cherry Blossom

Base notes: White Musk

title: Figues & Agrumes Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This luminous blend captures the essence of a Mediterranean orchard. Crisp, sun-ripened green figs are enhanced by vibrant citrus highlights and warm jasmine nuances. The elegant glass and gold bottle features a golden plate at the back displaying the ingredient list and a side detail unveiling the unique Assemblage and its Signature.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses and Sorbet

Middle notes: Jasmine

Base notes: Fig

title: Biassanot Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Biassanot Eau de Parfum captures the essence of nocturnal allure with a sophisticated blend that commands attention. It opens with the raw intensity of smoke and rich leather, smoothly intertwining with the warmth of smoky oud to create a deeply resonant base. The heart unfolds into a sensual whisper of jasmine, adding a carnal, almost magnetic breath that lingers close. Every note transitions seamlessly—from the final traces of strong coffee to the faintest morning mist—evoking a journey through twilight until the stars fade away. This fragrance is designed for those who own the night, embodying confidence and mystery with undeniable elegance.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vetiver, Hay and Coffee

Middle notes: Leather, Smoke and Night Blooming Jasmine

Base notes: Oud, Tobacco and Musk

title: Jacqueline Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gritti Venetia proudly introduces Jacqueline, the latest fragrance in the White Collection, embodying "me time" and the transformative power of femininity. This serene and dreamy scent evokes calm and introspection, inviting you to pause and discover a renewed self. Jacqueline opens with a soft, green almond accord that gently embraces the skin, leading to delicate floral notes of lavender, freesia, and violet leaves. As the dream fades, a subtle musky-vanilla base enriched with warm tonka beans lingers, completing this enchanting journey of self-discovery and change.

 

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Almond, Mate and Green Notes

Middle notes: Lavender, Violet Leaves and Freesia

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla and Tonka Bean

title: Over The Musk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Over The Musk Eau de Parfum embodies a bold journey across fragrance genres, inspired by Thierry Mugler’s avant-garde creative vision. The Mugler Les Exceptions collection reimagines iconic perfume archetypes—floral, chypre, oriental, musky, and fern—showcasing Mugler’s mastery through daring, captivating scents. Designed for both men and women, these fragrances blend the finest ingredients to deliver an extraordinary and addictive olfactory experience where perfumery transcends the conventional.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper

Middle notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Base notes: Musk, Cashmere Wood

title: My Sweetest Morphine Limited Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
My Sweetest Morphine offers a refined interpretation of sensuality, balancing boldness with elegance. This captivating perfume gently wraps the skin in a tender and inviting veil. Central to its composition is a floral blend of Lilac and Mimosa, enriched with Rose, forming a stunning bouquet that delights the senses and stirs the imagination. The fragrance’s soft, powdery finish is complemented by warm, sunlit accents and subtle musky depths, creating an undeniably seductive presence.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lilac, Ozonic notes and Bergamot

Middle notes: Mimosa, Solar Notes and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli and Vetiver

title: Istanbul Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Istanbul by Unique'e Luxury is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2018. Developed by Sylvain Cara and Jorge Lee, it features top notes of grapes, citrus, tea, parsley, and lemon. The heart reveals neroli, jasmine, pink pepper, and geranium, while the base combines toffee, vanilla, musk, and woody notes.


Fragrance family: Sweet, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapes, Citruses, Tea, Parsley and Lemon

Middle notes: Neroli, Jasmine, Pink Pepper and Geranium

Base notes: Toffee, Vanilla, Musk and Woody Notes

title: Izmir Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Izmir by Unique'e Luxury is a unisex fragrance released in 2018. Developed by Sylvain Cara, Selim Özen, and Bihter Türkan Ergül, it features a fresh opening of pineapple, mandarin orange, lemon, and bergamot. The heart combines rose, iris, and cloves, while the base is composed of tonka bean, oakmoss, sandalwood, patchouli, and vanilla.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Mandarin Orange, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Iris and Cloves

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vanilla

title: Blue Knight Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refined allure of Blue Knight, a distinguished fragrance by Hajine that draws inspiration from the noble grace of horses. This elegant scent captures the spirit of freedom and honor, leading you through verdant fields and majestic royal settings. A unique fusion blending the calmness of cool blues with the courageous essence of a contemporary knight, Blue Knight embodies strength and sophistication, offering a scent that celebrates modern chivalry with balanced elegance.

 


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Chamomile, Sage. Saffron and Tagetes

Middle notes: Rose, Indian Jasmine and Magnolia

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli and Amber

title: Arabian Fusion Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Arabian Fusion, expertly designed by Hajine, embodies the pinnacle of lavishness—a scent journey that speaks of pure elegance. This fragrance artfully combines the rich heritage of Arabia with modern olfactory elements. Arabian Fusion represents the seamless blend of Eastern mystery and Western charm, creating a sophisticated and captivating aroma.

 

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Agarwood (oud) incense

Middle notes: Sandalwood, amber

Base notes: Saffron, rose

title: Flower Lust Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Flower Lust Extrait de Parfum invites those who embrace intensity and seek to explore their deepest desires. Crafted by renowned French perfumer Dominique Ropion, this bold fragrance generates a dynamic atmosphere. Vibrant pink and black pepper accentuate the rich sandalwood, harmonizing beautifully with floral notes of ylang-ylang and orange blossom.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Peppercorn, Black Pepper

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Ylang Ylang

Base notes: Benzoin, Sandalwood, Tonka bean, Patchouli, Vetiver

title: A Coeur Perdu L.B Eau De Parfum
body_html:
À cœur perdu L.B. Eau de Parfum by D’ORSAY offers an intricate exploration of personal fragrance. Its nuanced blend features delicate iris combined with the vibrant energy of orange blossom, creating a refined complexity. The addition of neroli and a mossy base adds depth, promising a rich and evocative sensory experience with each application.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Iris Aldehyde

Middle notes: Neroli, Orange Blossom

Base notes: Ambroxan, Moss, Cashmeran

title: Une Rose Au Paradis R.B Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Une Rose Au Paradis R.B Eau De Parfum, conceived by Caroline Dumur, blends floral and woody elements to evoke a vision of futuristic love. This romantic fragrance opens with spicy pepper combined with Turkish rose, filling the air with its vibrant scent. As it develops, musk and sandalwood create a soothing, timeless atmosphere, transporting you gently through a dreamlike space beyond time.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cashmeran, Turkish Rose and Freesia

Base notes: Musk, Incense and Sandalwood

title: Sketchbook P.33 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the essence of Xerjoff’s inspiration with Sketchbook P.33 Eau de Parfum. This fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, apple, and pink pepper, leading to a refined heart featuring iris, cinnamon, and cypress. It settles into a sophisticated base of cedarwood, musk, and amber, creating a balanced and elegant scent experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cypress, Iris and Cinnamon

Base notes: Cedar, Musk and Amber

title: Mar Eterna Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
