Ramon Bejar Mar Eterna Eau De Parfum captures the essence of the Eternal Sea with a refreshing sea breeze. It opens with subtle, crisp ozone notes enhanced by zesty yuzu and lime, creating a fresh and invigorating experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ozonic notes and Fresh Evergreen

Middle notes: Orchid, Lily of the Valley and Rose

Base notes: Cedar, Musk, Moss and Sandalwood

title: Deep Amber Extriat de Parfum
body_html:
A timeless classic, Deep Amber Extrait de Parfum blends ambrette seeds and styrax seamlessly with grey amber and natural ingredients, creating one of the finest amber compositions available.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vetiver and Hibiscus

Middle notes: Amber, Benzoin, Styrax and Violet

Base notes: Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Labdanum and Amber Xtreme

title: Amberwood Perfume
body_html:
A smooth and translucent amber style perfume with woody tones, capturing the brilliance of this precious art deco material. A smooth and almost translucent amber is enhanced with rich and opulent woods, freshened with sage and bergamot. A hint of tonka and tobacco in the base adds warmth to this beguiling perfume.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Angelica, Sage, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Woody Notes, Tobacco, Patchouli and Helvetolide

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sage, Musk, Vanilla, Cashmere Wood, Ambroxan, Orris, Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Labdanum

title: Hasu No Hana Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Hasu-no-Hana, inspired by the Japanese Lotus Lily and created in 1888, reflects timeless elegance. This floral fragrance blends chypre and oriental elements atop a dry, woody foundation. Its notes include bergamot, bitter orange, rose, jasmine, ylang-ylang, iris, patchouli, oakmoss, vetiver, cedarwood, sandalwood, and tonka bean.

 

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Bitter Orange

Middle notes: oak moss, Ylang-Ylang, Iris, Jasmine, Tincture of Rose and Lotus

Base notes: Patchouli, Vetyver, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Virginia Cedar

title: King's Salute Eau de Parfum
body_html:
King's Salute by Grossmith is an aromatic fougère fragrance for men, introduced in 2023 and created by perfumer Matthieu Meneuvrier. It features top notes of bergamot, elemi resin, black pepper, and black currant. The heart combines lavender, lavender extract, cardamom, thyme, and iris, while the base is composed of cashmeran, oakmoss, musk, and amber, delivering a refined and dynamic scent.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Elemi resin, Black Pepper and Black Currant

Middle notes: Lavender, Lavender Extract, Cardamom, Thyme and Iris

Base notes: Cashmeran, Oakmoss, Musk and Amber

title: Valero Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Valero is a woody-fougère fragrance that balances tradition with modernity, designed for those who embody quiet strength and sophisticated style. It opens with a fresh and vibrant blend of bergamot, cedrat, and juniper, creating an energizing and clean introduction. The heart deepens with Bourbon geranium, lavender, aromatic cypress, and a subtle hint of nutmeg, blending classic fougère elements with a contemporary edge. The base reveals a lasting warmth through rich patchouli cœur, creamy sandalwood, and a luminous touch of ambrox, leaving a refined and enduring finish.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citron, Bergamot and Juniper

Middle notes: Lavender, Geranium, Cypress and Nutmeg

Base notes: Ambrox Super, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Queenside Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Queenside by Mind Games, from the Perfumer Extraordinaire collection, is showcased in a limited edition crystal decanter. The fragrance begins with bright pear and lychee leaf notes, delivering a fresh and vibrant start. Its core reveals refined floral accords such as geranium, lily of the valley, and violet, while the base combines Madagascar patchouli, oakmoss, and musk for a warm and sophisticated finish.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cassis, Lychee and Pear

Middle notes: Lily of the Valley, Violet and Geranium

Base notes: Patchouli, Oakmoss and Musk

title: Verticaloud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Verticaloud Eau de Parfum is a compelling fragrance that commands attention with its powerful presence. Expertly crafted, it combines the timeless elegance of Rose Essence with the rich, resinous depth of Oud, a rare dark wood native to the Middle East, renowned for its luxurious aroma. This iconic note is artfully reinterpreted to bring forward a refined and sophisticated character. Complemented by a warm Amber note, the fragrance achieves a harmonious balance, adding an alluring depth and warmth that captivates the senses. Verticaloud is an expertly layered scent designed for those who appreciate complexity and refinement in their fragrance choices.


Fragrance family: Amber, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose essence, Mandarin essence, Nutmeg essence

Middle notes: Cinnamon essence, Violet leaf absolute

Base notes: Amber, Oud, Cypriol essence, Amyris essence, Vetiver essence

title: Redmoon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Redmoon Eau de Parfum presents a captivating blend defined by striking contrasts and enigmatic allure. At its heart lies the unique pairing of vetiver essence and pink pepper, which together create a vibrant floral character with a subtle metallic shimmer. This lively interaction is beautifully balanced by the warm, spicy depth of saffron, which gently envelops the bouquet, adding sophistication and intensity. The fragrance unfolds like a celestial alignment, where each note harmonizes to evoke a sense of mystery and elegance. Redmoon is a refined composition that radiates energy and intrigue, perfect for those seeking a bold yet nuanced scent that leaves a memorable impression.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink pepper essence, Bergamot essence, Mandarin essence

Middle notes: Saffron, Jasmine absolute, Mate superessence, Iris

Base notes: Vetiver essence, Moss, Benjoin resinoid, Myrrh essence

title: Sogno Reale Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sogno Reale Extrait de Parfum captures the ethereal essence of dreams and introspection, drawing inspiration from the philosophical musings of literary masters. This sophisticated fragrance transcends the ordinary, offering a sensory journey that blurs the line between reality and imagination. With its concentrated formula, each application delivers a profound olfactory experience that evolves throughout the day, revealing layers of complexity and depth. Crafted for those who appreciate the finer nuances of perfumery, Sogno Reale is a testament to the power of scent to transport us beyond the mundane. Perfect for the discerning individual seeking a fragrance that speaks to both intellect and emotion.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Marine/Iodine Accord, Tuberose, Patchouli

Middle notes: Volcanic Olibanum, Hyraceum, Rhum

Base notes: Sandalwood, Styrax, Amber Woods

title: Omega Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Omega Eau de Parfum represents the culmination of Mendittorosa's philosophical approach to fragrance as a "scent path"—odors that resonate with the soul rather than merely adorning the body. This baroque composition embodies theatrical sensuality and intimate mystery, capturing the essence of transformation and duality. Omega is unapologetically opulent, evoking the decadence of a boudoir where identities blur and dissolve. In a single breath, femininity surrenders to masculinity, wrapped in veils of smoke and the warmth of aged red wine. The fragrance carries the powdery elegance of cipria, that timeless face powder that speaks to vintage glamour and refined restraint. At its heart lies nutmeg—the enigmatic note that anchors this paradoxical composition, adding spiced intrigue to the baroque narrative. Omega invites the wearer to embrace contradiction, to exist simultaneously at the threshold between extremes, and to discover that true sophistication emerges when opposing forces converge in perfect equilibrium.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Leather accord (Labdanum, Oud)

Middle notes: Jasmine, Iris, Violet

Base notes: Palisander Rosewood, Egyptian Cumin, Incense, Virginian Cedar, White Musk, Vanilla

title: South Eau de Parfum
body_html:
South Eau de Parfum evokes the timeless essence of Mediterranean living, transporting the wearer to sun-drenched landscapes where simplicity and sensuality converge. This fragrance captures the olfactory poetry of southern European tradition—the warmth of freshly baked bread emerging from a village bakery, the pristine comfort of white linen billowing in coastal breezes, and the iconic cleanliness of Marseille soap that has graced generations. The composition unfolds with green cyclamen and bittersweet lilac, introducing floral complexity that mirrors the region's botanical abundance. Sandalwood provides a creamy, grounding base that anchors these luminous notes, creating a sophisticated interplay between airy freshness and sensual depth. South represents more than a fragrance—it is an olfactory meditation on the Mediterranean soul, where rustic authenticity meets refined elegance. Each application becomes a journey through sun-warmed courtyards, whitewashed villages, and the unhurried rhythms of southern life. For those who cherish the beauty found in everyday rituals and the profound sensuality of natural, unpretentious living, South offers an intimate escape into timeless Mediterranean grace.

 Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Bergamot, Egyptian Basil, Cyclamen

Middle notes: Soft Jasmine, “Dry Cleaning Cover” accord, Syringa (Philadelphus flower)

Base notes: Australian Sandalwood, White Sandalwood, Green Hazelnuts, Bread accord, Precious Woods, Carrot Seeds, Amyris Wood

title: Mariya Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Mariya Eau de Parfum captures the essence of refined elegance through a sophisticated aromatic composition. This expertly crafted fragrance unfolds with vibrant fruity and floral top notes that give way to a captivating heart of sumptuous red roses infused with bourbon warmth. The composition settles into a luxurious base where creamy vanilla and caramel intertwine with distinctive coffee undertones, creating a memorable and sensual finish. A fragrance that embodies timeless beauty and understated luxury.

Fragrance family: Rose, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coriander, Orange Blossom, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Taif Rose and Bourbon Geranium

Base notes: Patchouli, Caramel, Vanilla and Coffee

title: Black Karak Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Black Karak Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of tradition reimagined. This fragrance opens with the warmth of spiced tea—sweet, milky, and deeply comforting—before unveiling its darker character. Smoky oud and leather notes transform the familiar into the unexpected, creating a scent that honors hospitality while embracing bold sophistication. A fragrance that tells the story of ritual disrupted, comfort elevated, and tradition set ablaze.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Karak tea, cardamom, coffee

Middle notes: Black tea, cypriol essence, saffron infusion

Base notes: Amberwood, tonka bean absolute, gaiacwood

title: Florae Nebulae Parfum
body_html:
Florae Nebulae Parfum represents a sophisticated fusion of botanical refinement and cosmic intrigue. Drawing from feng shui philosophy, this fragrance achieves olfactory equilibrium through carefully balanced floral and ethereal notes. The composition celebrates delicate, flowing characteristics while channeling distinctly feminine sensibilities. The Harmonist's approach prioritizes harmonious accords that inspire and elevate, positioning this scent as both a grounding and transcendent olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Bitter Orange and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Apricot, Bulgarian Rose and Datura

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk and Amber

title: Black Oregano Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Black Oregano is a sophisticated Extrait de Parfum that captures the essence of duality—where raw, sun-baked oregano collides with shadowed undertones. The composition balances aromatic intensity with sensual depth, as the herb's distinctive character intertwines with warm woody notes and supple leather accords that evoke weathered hide. This is a fragrance of contrasts: mineral yet tactile, fierce yet refined. The result is a complex, layered scent that embodies craftsmanship and bold olfactory vision, designed for those who appreciate nuance in their fragrance experience.

 


Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Rosemary and Cardamom

Middle notes: Oregano, Australian Sandalwood and Vetiver

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Leather and Labdanum

title: Cuvee Skin Eau de Intimite
body_html:
CUVÉE SKIN by BORNTOSTANDOUT captures the luxurious essence of champagne against bare skin. This sophisticated fragrance opens with soft ambrette musk and earthy oakmoss, transitioning into a creamy heart of tonka bean and vanilla orchid. The composition settles into a sensual base of blond woods and white leather, delivering an intimate and enduring presence that evolves throughout the day.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ambrette and Oakmoss

Middle notes: Vanilla Orchid and Tonka Bean

Base notes: White Leather and White Woods

title: Warm Air Eau de Intimite
body_html:
Warm Air by BORNTOSTANDOUT is a sensual composition that captures the intimate warmth of two bodies in perfect harmony. It opens with a luminous, metallic geranium, flowing into a decadent heart of roasted caramel, rum extract, and davana that balances richness with airiness. The base unfolds with vapor, amber woods, cashmere woods, and grey amber, delivering a distinctly modern, skin-like warmth that embodies the essence of tender proximity.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Geranium

Middle notes: Caramel, Rum and Davana

Base notes: Amberwood, Cashmere Wood and Ambergris

title: Golden Eyes Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Golden Eyes Eau de Parfum unveils a sophisticated woody composition built on the harmonious interplay of nutmeg essence, black tea extract, and cedarwood oil. This refined fragrance delivers a sumptuous, velvety character that evokes the sensory experience of traversing ancient forests in autumn, with layers of warmth and depth that unfold throughout the day.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Nutmeg

Middle notes: Black Tea

Base notes: Cedarwood

title: Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Voyager by Tom Ford masterfully merges precious oud with an opulent floral heart. This sophisticated composition opens with vibrant citrus and pink pepper, immediately drawing you in with its dynamic character. At its core lies an exclusive floral oud tri-distillate—a rare fusion of premium oud and crimson florals crafted specifically for Tom Ford. Geranium absolute contributes a fresh, rosy elegance, while cardamom and saffron weave in subtle warmth and spice. A luxurious red peony accord, captured through advanced headspace technology, imparts a sumptuous velvety dimension. The fragrance settles into a refined base of oud, grounded by earthy patchouli, vetiver, cypriol, and musk, creating a captivating olfactory journey that lingers with understated sophistication.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Geranium, Pink Pepper and Citrus

Middle notes: Red Peony, Cardamom and Saffron

Base notes: Oud, Cypriol, Patchouli, Vetiver and Musk

title: ABCBA Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
ABCBA by Unico Perfume® represents a bold olfactory statement—an extrait de parfum designed for those who refuse conventional fragrance boundaries. This 2025 creation from master perfumers Federica Russo and Giuseppe Amorese delivers a unisex composition in a refined 30 ml format that speaks to individuality through scent. The opening presents a radiant citrus character anchored by elemi's resinous warmth and coconut's creamy softness. The heart evolves into an airy composition of marine accords, plumeria's delicate florality, and crystalline sky notes that evoke weightlessness and boundless horizons. The base unfolds with an imaginative accord of stardust and nebula impressions, culminating in an intriguing unknown element that lingers with futuristic sophistication. ABCBA invites wearers to express their unique olfactory identity through a fragrance that transcends traditional categories.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Elemi resin and Coconut

Middle notes: Plumeria, Sea Notes and Ozonic notes

Base notes: Sandalwood and White Musk

title: Benjoin Boheme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the essence of refined bohemian elegance with Benjoin Bohême, an eau de parfum that captures the spirit of artistic sophistication. Built on a foundation of warm Laotian benzoin enhanced by subtle balms and spices, this fragrance evokes the timeless allure of a cultured aesthete—whether a dapper British gentleman or a free-spirited Latin creative. A miniature olfactory masterpiece that whispers rather than shouts, it embodies the refined sensibility of those who inhabit the legendary streets of Paris's Left Bank.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli and citrus

Middle notes: Benzoin and Peru balsam

Base notes: Sandalwood, amber, vanilla, deeper woody notes

title: Green Bubble Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Immerse yourself in Green Bubble Eau de Parfum, a fragrance inspired by the liberating spirit of reggae culture. This scent captures the essence of natural freedom—verdant landscapes, ocean waves, and the rhythmic energy of life itself. Blending earthy green notes with uplifting accords, it evokes the soul and authenticity that define reggae's global influence. A fragrance for those who embrace life's authentic moments and celebrate the beauty of cultural expression through every spritz.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: cannabis, Wormwood and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Cedar, Saffron and Honey

Base notes: Amber, Patchouli, Labdanum and Sandalwood

title: Odeon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Odéon opens with a luscious rose and candied date accord, unfolding into a heart of amber and musk with gourmand sweetness. The Isparta rose—prized for its green, litchi, and powdery character—harmonizes beautifully with Indonesian patchouli and creamy Tonka bean, creating a sophisticated fragrance with an enveloping warmth. A refined composition for those who appreciate complexity and sensual depth.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose and Rose Jam

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cashmeran

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Amber and Musk

title: The Dark Side Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover an Oriental fragrance of remarkable complexity and depth. The Dark Side Extrait de Parfum draws inspiration from Marrakesh's vibrant souks, capturing the intoxicating blend of spices, woods, and amber that define the city's sensory landscape. This multifaceted composition reveals itself gradually, offering layers of intrigue with each wear. A signature scent for those who appreciate sophisticated, unconventional fragrances with genuine character and presence.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes:

Warm spices, Honey

Middle notes: Iris, Voilet, Rasins

Base notes: Sandalwood, incense, vanilla, patchouli, and musk

title: Once Upon a Time Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Once Upon a Time by Francesca Bianchi is a refined gourmand fragrance that transforms cherished memories into sophisticated scent. The composition opens with vibrant mandarin and pink pepper, evolving into indulgent layers of cotton candy, candied almonds, and vanilla. A subtle musk and castoreum base provides an intriguing animalic warmth that grounds the sweetness. Drawing inspiration from intimate moments—crackling fireplaces, kitchen adventures, carnival treats, and festive celebrations—this fragrance reimagines nostalgia through an elegantly mature lens.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, pink pepper

Middle notes: Cotton candy, candied almonds, vanilla

Base notes: Musk, castoreum

title: Pink Moon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Pink Moon Eau de Parfum captures the ethereal essence of lunar romance through a sophisticated floral-oud composition. This fragrance transports you to a realm where peony and camellia petals dance with crystalline amber and velvety musk, creating an intoxicating sensory experience. Designed for those who appreciate celestial beauty and refined elegance, Pink Moon weaves together delicate florals with warm, enveloping base notes that linger on the skin. Each application evokes the serene magic of moonlight, transforming everyday moments into extraordinary experiences. The result is a luxurious, captivating scent that commands attention while maintaining an air of understated sophistication—a fragrance that speaks to dreamers and those who seek beauty beyond the ordinary.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Amber, Musk

title: Cargo de Nuit Eau de Parfum Gift Set
body_html:
Discover Cargo de Nuit Eau de Parfum by Prada, a sleek woody‑aromatic unisex fragrance from the Olfactories collection, crafted by perfumer Daniela Andrier and launched in 2017. This refined scent opens with crisp aromatic and citrus accords that immediately evoke a sense of freshness and understated confidence. The heart reveals nuanced spices and green herbal facets that add depth and character, while the base settles into warm woods, vetiver, and soft musk for a smooth and enduring finish. Cargo de Nuit is an excellent choice for those seeking a modern, elegant scent that balances fresh vibrancy with grounding warmth and subtle sophistication.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aromatic and citrus accords

Middle notes: Spices, green herbal facets

Base notes: Woods, vetiver, musk

title: 17/17 Stone Label Richwood Parfum
body_html:
Richwood by Xerjoff is a polished, luxurious woody-oriental that celebrates noble timbers and refined resinous depth—elegant, warm, and quietly opulent. This unisex composition opens with bright, refined citrus and spicy lift that lead into a heart of tactile woods and subtle floral nuances, resolving on a plush, ambered-woody base with soft balsamic and vanillic sweetness. Designed for formal wear and refined evenings, Richwood offers stately presence and long-lasting, well-mannered sillage.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, pink pepper, bitter orange
Middle notes: Cedarwood, sandalwood, orris/orris powder, subtle rose or jasmine facets
Base notes: Agarwood/oud accord, amber, benzoin, vanilla, patchouli, soft musk

title: Desert Eden Limited Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Desert Eden Eau de Parfum Limited Edition is an intensified, collector-ready interpretation of the original Desert Eden—richer, glossier, and wrapped in an air of exclusive refinement. This limited-edition expression amplifies the perfume’s sun-soaked oriental-woody character with heightened resinous depth, lusher fruit facets, and a warmer, more enveloping drydown. Crafted for special occasions and those who favor bold, luxurious scents, it elevates the oasis-inspired gourmand-spicy heart into a more opulent, long-lasting statement.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody, Spicy, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, bergamot, cardamom, dried fig, candied citrus

Middle notes: Date accord, orange blossom, rose, iris, honeyed accords

Base notes: Oud, amber, sandalwood, labdanum, vanilla, benzoin, white musk

title: Musc Tonkin Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Musc Tonkin Extrait de Parfum by Parfum d’Empire, a refined musky-oriental unisex fragrance that blends sensuality, elegance, and subtle warmth. This sophisticated composition opens with fresh and clean musky accords, creating an immediate sensation of purity and refinement. The heart reveals delicate floral and soft resinous notes, adding depth, elegance, and a gentle complexity. In the base, warm woods, amber, and rich musks provide a long-lasting, smooth trail that lingers with understated sensuality. Musc Tonkin is an ideal choice for those seeking a signature scent that balances clean freshness with luxurious musky warmth.

Fragrance family: Musky, Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fresh musky accords

Middle notes: Soft florals, resinous notes

Base notes: Woods, amber, musk

title: Fifty Four Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Fifty Four Eau de Parfum, Jusbox's 2024 masterpiece crafted for all genders. This gourmand fragrance weaves an intoxicating tapestry of spiced warmth—cardamom, cinnamon, and saffron—with creamy indulgence from chocolate, vanilla, and sandalwood. Exotic nagarmotha and davana provide earthy depth, while rum and pina colada accords deliver tropical sweetness. Tobacco and patchouli ground the composition with sophisticated complexity. A versatile scent that balances gourmand comfort with refined spice and woody elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Piña Colada, Cardamom, Guatemala Davana

Middle notes: Saffron, Chocolate Accord, Nagarmotha, Cinnamon Bark

Base notes: Rhum, Vanilla Resin Absolute, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Tobacco

title: Sisters B4 Misters Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sisters B4 Misters Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated 2025 fragrance by Jusbox, crafted for the modern woman. This captivating composition opens with exotic florals, cotton candy sweetness, and creamy vanilla, evolving into a heart of juicy peach and plum. The sensual base of caramel and musk creates a lasting impression that balances gourmand indulgence with floral elegance. Perfect for those who appreciate complex, multi-layered scents that transition beautifully throughout the day.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Blackcurrant and Ginger

Middle notes: Banana, Strawberry, Lily of the Valley and Orris

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber and Sweet Milk

title: Cuir Impertinent Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cuir Impertinent Eau de Parfum charts new territory by blending genres and crafting daring, unexpected combinations. Inspired by Thierry Mugler’s refusal to conform, Les Exceptions reinterprets classic perfume families to create something truly extraordinary. Mugler disrupts traditional forms with inventive pairings that include surprising ingredients. This intoxicating fragrance fuses the smoky richness of tanned leather with a striking burst of star anise, delivering a bold and sensual olfactory experience. Housed in an Art Deco-inspired bottle, it reflects Mugler’s signature architectural elegance.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Star Anise

Middle notes: Tobacco

Base notes: Amber and Leather

title: Saint Julep Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Saint Julep transports you to a hidden sanctuary in the Mississippi Delta, where a humble church found new purpose as a clandestine gathering place. This evocative eau de parfum captures the spirit of a legendary juke joint that emerged from hardship, carried by hand to a wild mint field on the shoulders of determined souls.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Sweet Mint, Tangerine

Middle Notes: Southern Magnolia, Bourbon

Base Notes: Grisalva, Sugarcube

title: Radio Bombay Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Radio Bombay Eau de Parfum by D.S. & Durga exemplifies a sophisticated Oriental Woody composition suitable for all genders. Introduced in 2016 and crafted by perfumer David Seth Moltz, this fragrance commences with distinctive woody accords and aromatic cedar. Its heart reveals a complex interplay of creamy sandalwood, powdery iris, exotic boronia, and succulent peach. The foundation evolves into a multifaceted blend of musky ambrette, additional sandalwood, marine ambergris, resinous balsam fir, sensual musk, and tropical coconut, creating a remarkable olfactory journey.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Woody Notes and Cedar

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Iris, Peach and Boronia

Base notes: Sandalwood, Coconut, Ambergris, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Balsam Fir and Musk

title: Bodacious Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The top-selling Bodacious perfume by Boadicea the Victorious boasts a tempting blend of floral aromas, infused with rich notes of cognac, almonds, musk, and a subtle hint of tobacco. This highly coveted scent exudes a bold and alluring aura, perfect for evening wear. The fragrance opens with a burst of sweet cherry and nutty almond, followed by a warm blend of spiced clove and cognac. As the night unfolds, Bodacious reveals a captivating bouquet of jasmine sambac, Moroccan rose oil, and the sweet scent of heliotrope. The intoxicating floral essence is complimented by hints of malted sandalwood and white tobacco, leaving a lingering sensation of elegance and seduction.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry, Cognac, Almond and Clove

Middle notes: Heliotrope, Jasmine Sambac and Moroccan Rose

Base notes: Tobacco, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Musk and Vetiver

title: Lettre De Pushkar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the magnificence and allure of Pushkar, Rajasthan, India. From sunrise to sunset, this holy site captivates the senses. The stunning scenery and alluring aromas exemplify the devotion of those seeking spiritual purification on the lake's shores. Nature itself contributes to the enchantment of this legendary destination - as the roses bloom on the lake's edge, they offer their luscious petals to the revered god Brahma. And as the sun sets and sets the sky ablaze, worshippers are immersed in the mesmerizing chants of prayer.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, nutmeg, cinnamon

Middle notes: Rose, orange blossom, cypriol

Base notes: Patchouli, vetiver, vanilla, musk

title: Terrible Teddy Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Terrible Teddy Eau de Parfum captivates with a tantalizing blend of leather, incense, and ambroxan, irresistibly drawing in unsuspecting hearts. With his smooth charm, he was focused on Helen, until the Duke came along.


Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Ambroxan

title: Aldebaran Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the radiance of ALDEBARAN Eau de Parfum, a soliflore scent featuring tuberose with hints of milk and freshly bloomed petals. Notes of paprika and tonka beans add a subtle touch. Named after the brightest star discovered by an 18th-century Arab astronomer and inspired by its Arabic name "Al-Debaran," meaning "the one who guides," this fragrance embodies hope and optimism. With this olfactory experience, embark on a journey from darkness to light, like a quest for positivity through the looking glass.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose

Middle notes: Paprika and Mate

Base notes: Tonka Bean

title: Checkmate Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A lively explosion of champagne immediately invigorates in Checkmate, unleashing a dazzling glimmer of anticipation. Juicy and alluring fruits and florals soon join in, tapping into their inner strength. Surrender to the blissful moment as a mesmerizing mix of tobacco and bourbon emerge. The memory of the conflict fades as the rich and robust scents of earth, moss, and patchouli envelop you.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Champagne, Red Currant and Davana

Middle notes: May Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Rose and Magnolia

Base notes: Tobacco, Patchouli and Moss

title: Tears from the Moon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover Tears from the Moon Eau de Parfum, adorned with a dragonfly symbolizing freedom, wisdom, and transformation. With a decorative pattern of golden foliage and a green bow, it is a precious jewel from The Alchemist's Garden collection. Add it to your fragrance routine to create a unique and personalized scent experience

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peony

Middle notes: Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Stephanotis

title: Patchouli Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The oriental notes of incense and spices perfectly complement the rich patchouli in this fragrance. According to expert Patricia de Nicolai, patchouli is a valuable and essential element, much like the viola in a symphony orchestra.

Fragrance family: Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Geranium, Lavender and Orange

Middle notes: Patchouli, Ceylon Cinnamon and Rose

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber and Vanilla

title: Opulent Shaik Classic 77 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Opulent Shaik Classic 77 Eau de Parfum is an Oriental fragrance for men that perfectly complements a luxurious and regal lifestyle. Its aromatic blend remains as alluring, enigmatic, and timeless as the shimmering sands of the desert

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Bergamot, Lemon and Basil

Middle notes: Apple, Cinnamon, Cloves and Geranium

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Cedar and Labdanum

title: N°5 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This N°5 Eau de Parfum features a crisp floral top note of lilly of the Valley, which evokes a natural spring sensation. This is complemented by warm spiced notes and a high-quality saffron. The base notes are a blend of amber musk and an intense oriental style. The result is a potent and alluring combination of vanilla, tonka beans, and strawberries. This fragrance boasts an exotic and unique flower, unlike anything found in nature, making it a dream-like experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices and Exotic floral notes

Middle notes: Carnation and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla and Musk

title: Megamare Parfum
body_html:
The ocean is vast and boundless, requiring no explanation. Megamare Parfum embodies an everlasting sensation, mirroring ceaseless breath. Its enigmatic, potent, refined, and delicate qualities cannot be opposed or challenged. Instead, allow it to guide you. Megamare beckons you to the unknown and everywhere. It will transport you to uncharted territories and inspire further exploration

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Seaweed, Calone and Hedione

Base notes: Musk, Ambroxan and Cedar

title: Interlude Man Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Interlude Man eau de parfum is a blend of spice and wood, drawing inspiration from chaos and disorder. In its heart, it evokes a moment of interlude and harmony.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Pimento Berry, Oregano

Middle notes: Amber, Cistus, Frankincense, Vanilla, Opoponax

Base notes: Oud, Leather, Patchouli, Sandalwood

title: Hacivat Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the elegance, kindness, and love of art with Hacivat Extrait de Parfum. Inspired by the traditional shadow play character, this eau chypre features stimulating notes of pineapple and bergamot, complemented by genuine woody tones. Experience the everlasting sparkles and feeling of being loved with this iconic scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Grapefruit and Bergamot

Middle notes: Cedar, Patchouli and Jasmine

Base notes: Oakmoss and Woody Notes

title: Encelade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Encelade Eau de Parfum features a distinctive, captivating scent that expertly combines the freshness of rhubarb with the alluring essence of leather, accented by the sophisticated and earthy notes of vetiver and sandalwood.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rhubarb

Middle notes: Cedar

Base notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Leather

title: Chic Shaik Classic No.70 Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Experience the alluring scent of Chic Shaik Classic No.70 Eau De Parfum, inspired by the passion of a desert prince. This "woody ambery" fragrance balances subtlety and intoxication, evoking a sense of power and masculinity. The perfect complement for a modern, relaxed lifestyle, this fragrance embodies the beauty and romance of Arabia and its creator.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Clary Sage, Orange and Lemon

Middle notes: Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Cedar, Musk, Vetiver, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Chic Shaik Classic No. 30 Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Chic Shaik Classic No. 30 Eau De Parfum is an aromatic celebration of life and love, conveying a sense of free-spirited happiness that knows no limits. This fragrance is irresistibly joyful, original, and unconventional, with a hint of mischievousness. It was crafted for frequent use, allowing you to capture the blissful mood and make it last with its beautiful blend of Praline, Bergamot, Cardamom, Passion fruit, Rose, jasmine, Vanilla and Tonka bean, Ambergris, and Patchouli. Embrace freedom, happiness, and sensuality with this modern and oriental perfume, perfect for the woman who lives life on her own terms.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Cardamom and Bergamot

Middle notes: Passionfruit, Patchouli, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Ambergris

title: Cherry Blossom Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a vibrant and refreshing scent with Floris Cherry Blossom Eau de Parfum. This fragrance features a captivating blend of bergamot, orange, and pink pepper, complemented by a delicate floral bouquet of cherry blossom, osmanthus, rose, and peony. Hints of juicy cherry add a fruity touch to the heart notes, while the base is anchored by creamy sandalwood and sensual musk.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Orange

Middle notes: Cherry Blossom, Cherry, Peony, Osmanthus and Rose

Base notes: Musk and Sandalowood

title: Blazing Mister Sam Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Blazing Mister Sam is a part of Penhaligon's Portrait collection, taking inspiration from a bold American who lives at a high pace, indulges generously, and speaks with bravado. The scent begins with hints of cardamom and cinnamon, leading into a warm and spicy heart with botanical and woody accords. The formula also incorporates cumin, saffron, black pepper, vanilla, patchouli, cedar, and tobacco.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Black Pepper, Saffron and Cumin

Base notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Cedar and Patchouli

title: Black Essence Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the global attraction of Black Essence's alluring pheromones. With just one spritz, you'll exude an irresistible aura. This fragrance evokes a seductive and enigmatic charm, sure to make a lasting impact.

Fragrance family:Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Lemon

Middle notes: Ginger, Sage, Iris, Geranium and Carrot Seeds

Base notes: Musk, Vetiver and Amber

title: Black Caviar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a timeless indulgence. Embrace the opulence and grandeur of Emperor Severus as he presents caviar to esteemed visitors, enveloped in the scent of briny ocean breeze, floral aromas of sage and lavender, and earthy undertones of vetiver and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caviar, Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar

Middle notes: Rosemary, Lavender and Sage

Base notes: Oakmoss, Vetiver and Patchouli

title: Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Baccarat Rouge 540 eau de parfum resulted from the collaboration between Maison Francis Kurkdjian and Baccarat to commemorate the crystal manufacturer's 250th anniversary. This woody fragrance embodies a poetic fusion, a dense and visually striking olfactory profile. Refreshing jasmine notes and illuminating saffron amplify the mineral notes of ambergris and the freshly-hewn cedar wood tones. Radiant and refined, Baccarat Rouge 540 eau de parfum delicately embraces the skin with an aromatic, woody floral essence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Jasmine

Middle notes: Amberwood, Ambergris and Hedione

Base notes: Fir Resin, Cedar, Sugar, Ambroxan and Oakmoss

title: A Midnight Stroll Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating allure of the night with A Midnight Stroll Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the mysterious jaguar, this fragrance combines aromatic Incense and smoky Cade Wood for an intense and alluring scent. Perfect for those who seek adventure after dark.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense

Middle notes: Cade oil

Base notes: Cypress

title: 125th & Bloom Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As one approaches the entrance of grandiose brownstones or discovers hidden backyard havens, behold the floral abundance of Harlem. Follow the alluring scent of angelica seeds and saffron to the captivating allure of damascene roses and violets, which reveal a core of ebony wood and leather.

Fragrance family: Leather, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Angelica

Middle notes: Rose and Violet

Base notes: Leather and Ebony

title: Wasabi Klub Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wasabi Klub is a bold and unconventional fragrance by Room 1015, created by perfumer Jérôme Di Marino and launched in 2026. Inspired by the electric energy of underground nightlife and the unexpected intensity of Japanese-inspired spice, this composition challenges convention through a striking contrast of zesty citrus, fiery peppers,and mineral woods.

The fragrance opens with an invigorating burst of yuzu,lime,and grapefruit, delivering a sharp and luminous citrus freshness. At the heart, wasabi introduces a distinctive green heat, intensified by black pepper,pepper,Timur,and Sichuan pepper, creating a vibrant and tingling spicy accord. The composition settles into a modern base of concrete,Orcanox™,and amberwood, bringing mineral textures,amber warmth,and a lasting woody depth.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Yuzu,Lime,Grapefruit

Middle Notes: Wasabi,Black Pepper,Pepper,Timur,Sichuan Pepper

Base Notes: Concrete,Orcanox™,Amberwood

title: Sugar Bowl Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sugar Bowl invites the senses into a dreamlike world where sweetness becomes a feeling of nostalgia,comfort,and childlike wonder. The second creation in Superz.’s Celestial Collection, this fragrance captures the sensation of floating through cherished memories, where fruity delights and creamy textures melt into a soft,weightless embrace.

The composition opens with the playful sweetness of strawberry yogurt,macaron,and raspberry, creating a deliciously fruity introduction. At the heart, coconut and sunscreen evoke the warmth of sun-kissed skin, while crème brûlée adds a rich,caramelized gourmand character. The fragrance settles into a comforting base of pineapple,milk,cashmere,whipped cream,and vanilla, creating a soft and enveloping trail that feels warm,creamy,and irresistibly nostalgic.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Sweet,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Strawberry Yogurt,Macaron,Raspberry

Middle Notes: Sunscreen,Coconut,Crème Brûlée

Base Notes: Pineapple,Milk,Cashmere,Whipped Cream,Vanilla

title: Space Cake Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Space Cake is the third and boldest creation in Superz.’s Celestial Collection, an imaginative journey into a surreal cosmic patisserie where fragrance becomes an expression of boundless creativity. Unconventional and irresistibly playful, it explores a universe of edible sweetness,unexpected herbal facets,and dreamlike textures,where familiar gourmand pleasures take on an otherworldly character.

The composition opens with the herbal sharpness of cannabis,contrasted by the playful sweetness of gummy bears and caramelized sugar,while jasmine tea introduces a delicate aromatic nuance. At the heart, creamy Irish butter,warm milk,and vanilla sauce create a rich gourmand texture, complemented by powdery heliotrope and the nostalgic sweetness of Christmas cookie. The fragrance settles into a distinctive base of tonka bean,amber,and sensual musk, accompanied by imaginative accords of magic mushroom,moon powder,and spaceship that reinforce its surreal,cosmic identity.

Fragrance Family: Sweet,Ambery,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cannabis,Gummy Bears,Caramelized Sugar,Jasmine Tea

Middle Notes: Irish Butter,Creamy Milk,Vanilla Sauce,Heliotrope Flower,Christmas Cookie

Base Notes: Pheromone Musk,Tonka Bean,Amber,Magic Mushroom,Moon Powder,Spaceship

title: Monsieur Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Monsieur is a bold and sophisticated fragrance created by perfumer Bruno Jovanovic, exploring the dark, sensual character of patchouli through an elegant composition of rich woods, warm spices, and indulgent sweetness. It expresses a confident, contemporary elegance, balancing the intensity of its materials with remarkable refinement.

The fragrance opens with the aromatic warmth of rum, introducing a rich and intriguing first impression. At the heart, patchouli takes center stage, revealing its earthy depth and distinctive character, enhanced by the smooth sweetness of mandarin and the subtle warmth of cedar. The composition settles into a luxurious base of incense,amber,and musk, creating a deep, enveloping trail with a lingering sensuality.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Rum

Middle Notes: Patchouli,Mandarin,Cedar

Base Notes: Incense,Amber,Musk

title: Salalah Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Salalah evokes the lush beauty of southern Oman, where the scent of frankincense rises through green landscapes touched by the Khareef monsoon. The fragrance captures the meeting of ancient Arabian traditions and the freshness of a tropical oasis, transporting the senses to a place where mountains,sea,and aromatic resins exist in harmony.

The composition opens with bright citrus and aromatic freshness,creating an uplifting introduction. At the heart, rose and jasmine bring a luminous floral character,while the fragrance develops into a rich base of frankincense,amber,and woods,creating a warm,resinous,and sophisticated trail.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Woody,Floral

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Citrus Notes,Aromatic Notes

Middle Notes: Rose,Jasmine

Base Notes: Frankincense,Amber,Woody Notes

title: Bilbao Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bilbao captures the artistic spirit of the Basque city, where contemporary architecture,rich culinary traditions,and the rugged beauty of northern Spain meet. The fragrance evokes the atmosphere of wandering through Bilbao,from the energy of its streets to the distinctive character of its cuisine and the green landscapes surrounding the city.

The composition opens with the vibrant freshness of bergamot and grapefruit,bringing a bright citrus introduction. At the heart, green tea and fig create a fresh yet subtly creamy character, while the fragrance settles into cedarwood,vetiver,and musk,forming an elegant woody foundation with a clean and sophisticated trail.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Woody,Green

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Grapefruit

Middle Notes: Green Tea,Fig

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Vetiver,Musk

title: Hydra Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Hydra, created by perfumer Ilias Ermenidis, captures a holiday of peace and quiet on the Greek island of Hydra. Surrounded by crystalline sea,whitewashed beauty,and the warmth of the Mediterranean sun, the fragrance reflects a moment of simplicity,reflection,and pure tranquillity.

The composition opens with the refreshing combination of watermelon and mint,bringing a juicy,green freshness reminiscent of a cool drink enjoyed beside the sea. At the heart, hyacinth and jasmine unfold in a luminous floral accord, while the base settles into sea notes and white musk, creating a clean,soft,and gently sensual trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Watermelon,Mint

Middle Notes: Hyacinth,Jasmine

Base Notes: Sea Notes,White Musk

title: Reykjavik Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Reykjavik captures the stark beauty and elemental character of Iceland’s capital, where cool ocean air, volcanic landscapes,and pristine Nordic nature create an atmosphere of remarkable purity. The fragrance translates this northern landscape into an elegant composition that contrasts luminous freshness with mineral and woody depth.

The composition opens with crisp citrus and aromatic freshness, evoking the sensation of cold air carried from the sea. At the heart, delicate floral and green facets unfold against a mineral character, while the base develops into smooth woods and soft musks, creating a clean and quietly enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Fresh,Aromatic,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Citrus Notes,Aromatic Notes

Middle Notes: Floral Notes,Green Notes,Mineral Notes

Base Notes: Woody Notes,Musk

title: Dubai Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dubai, created by master perfumer Anne Flipo, translates her memories of the city through its unforgettable culinary traditions. Inspired by a luxurious hotel restaurant surrounded by the Dubai desert, the fragrance captures a meeting of Arabian heritage and futuristic modernity, where traditional sweets,spices,dates,and Arabic coffee fill the air beneath the distant Dubai skyline.

The composition opens with the rich sweetness of dates,brightened by mandarin and warmed by saffron. At the heart, sweet gourmand notes are balanced by the earthy depth of patchouli and the green floral character of geranium. The fragrance settles into an intense base of exotic vanilla,amber,and moss, creating a warm,opulent,and enduring trail.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Dates,Saffron,Mandarin

Middle Notes: Sweet Notes,Patchouli,Geranium

Base Notes: Vanilla,Amber,Moss

title: Grey Senses Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Grey Senses evokes the quiet poetry of a misty landscape, where cool mineral air,soft woods,and subtle aromatic nuances merge beneath a sky of shifting grey. The fragrance captures an atmosphere of understated sophistication, creating a sense of calm,depth,and modern elegance.

The composition opens with the crisp freshness of bergamot and grapefruit,creating a luminous yet cool first impression. At the heart, iris and violet bring a refined powdery floral character, while the fragrance settles into cedarwood,vetiver,and musk,forming a smooth and quietly sensual foundation.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Powdery,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Grapefruit

Middle Notes: Iris,Violet

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Vetiver,Musk

title: Sable Noir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sable Noir evokes the mysterious beauty of desert landscapes at dusk, when the last traces of sunlight disappear and warm sands surrender to the darkness of night. The fragrance captures this striking contrast through a composition where luminous spice,smoky woods,and rich amber create an atmosphere of depth and mystery.

The fragrance opens with the warm intensity of saffron,creating a radiant yet mysterious first impression. At the heart, incense and rose bring together smoky resinous facets with a refined floral softness,while the base reveals the deep character of oud,patchouli,and amber. The result is a rich and enveloping trail with a distinctly sensual character.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Saffron

Middle Notes: Incense,Rose

Base Notes: Oud,Patchouli,Amber

title: Charme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Charme captures the effortless allure of a blooming Mediterranean garden, where radiant citrus,delicate flowers,and warm woods create an atmosphere of natural elegance. The fragrance evokes the graceful charm of an intimate garden in the south of France, illuminated by the softness of the sun.

The composition opens with sparkling bergamot and mandarin,bringing a bright and refreshing introduction. At the heart, orange blossom and jasmine unfold with a luminous floral character,while the base reveals smooth sandalwood and soft musk,creating a warm and sensual finish.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Floral,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Mandarin

Middle Notes: Orange Blossom,Jasmine

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Musk

title: Omelie 44 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Omelie 44 is an ode to Parisian elegance, inspired by the refined atmosphere of a distinguished Parisian interior where polished woods,soft light,and delicate floral accents create an intimate sense of luxury. The fragrance captures the quiet sophistication of a timeless Parisian address through a harmonious balance of luminous florals and warm woods.

The composition opens with the delicate freshness of neroli,creating a radiant and graceful first impression. At the heart, rose and jasmine unfold into an elegant floral bouquet,while the fragrance gradually reveals a warm foundation of sandalwood and musk. The result is soft,refined,and effortlessly sophisticated.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Neroli

Middle Notes: Rose,Jasmine

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Musk

title: Suede Elixir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Suede Elixir is an intimate study of refined sensuality, inspired by the supple touch and enveloping warmth of fine suede. The fragrance evokes the atmosphere of a luxurious dressing room, where polished leather,precious woods,and soft floral nuances create an elegant and deeply comforting impression.

The composition opens with a luminous touch of bergamot,bringing freshness to the rich character that follows. At the heart, iris introduces an elegant powdery facet, while suede lends the fragrance its distinctive soft leather character. The base deepens into warm amber and creamy sandalwood, leaving a smooth and sophisticated trail.

Fragrance Family: Leathery,Powdery,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot

Middle Notes: Iris,Suede

Base Notes: Amber,Sandalwood

title: Admirabilis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Admirabilis evokes the serenity and timeless beauty of Fontfroide Abbey, a remarkable Cistercian sanctuary in the south of France. Along its ancient stone walls and vaulted arches, light filters through the cloister while the surrounding landscape offers a feeling of pristine purity. The fragrance captures this sacred atmosphere through luminous elemi resin, warm amber,and the mysterious presence of incense.

The composition opens with the fresh,slightly peppered character of elemi resin, creating a clean and inviting first impression. At the heart, amber introduces warmth and comfort, while the fragrance deepens into the sacred, smoky character of incense. The result is a serene yet captivating composition that balances freshness with resinous depth.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Woody,Smoky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Elemi Resin

Middle Notes: Amber

Base Notes: Incense

title: Reve Ottoman Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rêve Ottoman transports the senses to the heart of Istanbul, where history, mystery, and opulent beauty meet along the shores of the Bosphorus. Inspired by the grandeur of the Dolmabahçe Palace, the fragrance evokes warm saffron glowing like gold, rose-scented gardens, and the refined interiors of an Ottoman palace.

The composition opens with the warm and vibrant intensity of saffron, creating an immediately rich and captivating impression. At the heart, noble rose unfolds with a delicate yet powerful floral character, its softness contrasting beautifully with the spice of the opening. The fragrance settles into creamy sandalwood, leaving a smooth, refined,and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Spicy,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Saffron

Middle Notes: Rose

Base Notes: Sandalwood

title: BoHaras Eau de Parfum
body_html:
BôHaras draws its inspiration from the majestic Haras Selman in Morocco, where the powerful presence of Arabian thoroughbreds meets the refined elegance of one of the kingdom’s most beautiful stables. A warm desert breeze moving through the wooden doors evokes an atmosphere of strength, character,and untamed beauty.

The fragrance opens with the spicy freshness of cardamom, awakening the senses with a vibrant aromatic facet. At the heart, bold leather brings a smouldering richness and depth, expressing the powerful character of the Arabian stables. The composition settles into warm, enveloping amber, leaving an intense and captivating trail.

Fragrance Family: Leather,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cardamom

Middle Notes: Leather

Base Notes: Amber

title: Cashmere Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cashmere envelops the senses in the comforting softness of an elegant cashmere fabric. Inspired by the warmth and sensuality of a precious textile, the fragrance combines creamy woods,delicate florals,and soft musks to create an atmosphere of refined comfort and understated luxury.

The composition opens with the luminous freshness of bergamot,followed by the delicate floral character of jasmine and the smooth richness of sandalwood. As the fragrance develops, soft musk adds an intimate and enveloping dimension, leaving a warm and sophisticated trail reminiscent of cashmere against the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot

Middle Notes: Jasmine

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Musk

title: Impatiente Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Impatiente invites the senses into a refined dream within the gardens of an elegant château. Inspired by the beauty of a carefully landscaped French park, the fragrance captures the serenity of formal gardens while leading the imagination toward the freshness and depth of the surrounding forests.

The composition opens with a sparkling burst of bergamot,bright and invigorating. At the heart, subtle aromatic mint introduces a fresh green character, creating a lively contrast with the citrus opening. The fragrance settles into the rich woody depth of vetiver, leaving a modern,warm,and elegant trail.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Green,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot

Middle Notes: Mint

Base Notes: Vetiver

title: Precieuse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Précieuse evokes the timeless elegance of a precious garden in full bloom, where delicate florals meet the refined warmth of precious woods. The fragrance unfolds with an understated sophistication, creating an impression that is both luminous and deeply sensual.

The composition opens with the radiant freshness of bergamot and the delicate sweetness of pear. At the heart, jasmine and orange blossom create a graceful floral bouquet, while the base reveals the warm richness of sandalwood and the soft sensuality of musk.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Pear

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Orange Blossom

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Musk

title: Rare Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rare awakens in a luminous burst of bergamot, evoking the freshness and quiet beauty of morning beyond the imposing stone walls of an ancient fortress. A gentle citrus breeze mingles with the aromatic greenery surrounding the old battlements, creating an atmosphere of serenity and understated elegance.

The fragrance opens with the vivid freshness of bergamot, bright and refined. At the heart, basil reveals a tender yet distinctly green aromatic character, reminiscent of a light morning breeze. The composition settles into vetiver, whose deep woody character brings warmth, strength,and a reassuring sense of permanence.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Aromatic,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot

Middle Notes: Basil

Base Notes: Vetiver

title: Noble Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Noble captures the spirit of refinement found in the historic elegance of Aix-en-Provence. Inspired by the private apartments and reception halls of a distinguished Provençal mansion, the fragrance evokes an atmosphere where aristocratic heritage meets understated sophistication.

The composition opens with fresh, luminous mandarin, creating a bright and sun-kissed impression. At the heart, cardamom introduces a refined spicy facet, adding subtle warmth and sophistication. The fragrance settles into a soft base of white musk, enveloping the skin in a gentle and intimate veil.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Citrus

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Mandarin

Middle Notes: Cardamom

Base Notes: White Musk

title: Traverse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The snowflakes rhythmically paced the long march toward the cedar forests of the Atlas Mountains. In the Ifrane Valley, a limestone cave offered shelter for the night, while the horses of the caravan brought a welcome warmth to the cold surroundings. Their powerful presence, carrying the rich scents of leather,amber,and musk, became an evocative part of the journey.

The fragrance opens with the elegant floral character of rose, sharpened by the resinous freshness of cypress and the warm intensity of saffron. At the heart, white honey introduces a soft, luminous sweetness alongside cedarwood and cinnamon, creating a rich and comforting warmth. The composition settles into a deep base of cypriol,patchouli,tobacco,and amber, evoking the mysterious atmosphere of a mountain caravan resting beneath the winter sky.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Rose,Cypress,Saffron

Middle Notes: White Honey,Cedarwood,Cinnamon

Base Notes: Cypriol,Patchouli,Tobacco,Amber

title: Sirius Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sirius draws inspiration from the brightest star in the night sky and the profound realization that the universe we seek beyond ourselves can also be found within. Crafted by Julien Rasquinet, this fragrance expresses a celestial journey of reverie, vibration,blossoming,and gratitude, evoking the sensation of reaching toward the heavens.

The composition opens with a vibrant burst of pineapple,ginger extract,and lemon, creating a luminous and energetic introduction. At the heart, violet leaf,juniper berry oil from the Balkans,and lavandin oil bring a crisp green and aromatic character. The fragrance settles into a sophisticated base of rum,Amber Extreme,and a mineral accord,creating a warm,modern,and subtly radiant finish.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Aromatic,Fresh

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pineapple,Ginger Extract,Lemon

Middle Notes: Violet Leaf,Juniper Berry Oil Balkans,Lavandin Oil

Base Notes: Rum,Amber Extreme,Mineral Accord

title: Opulence Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Opulence celebrates the sacred origins of chocolate in Aztec culture, transforming the historical richness of cacao into an expression of indulgence and timeless luxury. The fragrance evokes the allure of fine chocolate through a sophisticated interplay of citrus, gourmand sweetness, and precious woods.

The composition opens with an opulent accord of chocolate enriched by orange peel,lemon peel,apricot,and date, creating a luscious and radiant introduction. At the heart, salted and milky notes mingle with caramel,cashmere wood,and prune, adding depth and creamy warmth. The fragrance settles into a sumptuous base of vanilla,sandalwood,praline,cookie,white musk,and tonka bean, leaving an irresistibly smooth and indulgent trail.

Fragrance Family: Cacao,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Chocolate,Orange Peel,Lemon Peel,Apricot,Date

Middle Notes: Caramel,Salty Notes,Milky Notes,Cashmere Wood,Prune

Base Notes: Vanilla,Sandalwood,Praline,Cookie,White Musk,Tonka Bean

title: Fenix Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fenix invites us on the most adventurous journey of all: the journey within ourselves. Inspired by the mysteries discovered deep within the heart, this fragrance is imagined as a mystical breeze carrying vibrations of love, awakening the senses with luminous citrus and leading toward a deeper, more enigmatic world.

The composition opens with the radiant freshness of orange and lemon zest, creating an uplifting and vibrant first impression. At its heart, aromatic notes and spices introduce warmth and mystery, while the base reveals a rich and grounding combination of amber,musk,and woods. Together, these elements create a fragrance that moves from luminous freshness into a warm, sensual depth.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Orange,Lemon Zest

Middle Notes: Aromatic Notes,Spices

Base Notes: Amber,Musk,Woods

title: Evasion Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Evasion transports the senses to Havana, capturing the sweet and fiery character of this legendary city in the West Indies. Inspired by wandering through the atmospheric streets of Havana beneath a cloud of tobacco, the fragrance evokes a world where warm spices, aromatic herbs,rich woods,and indulgent sweetness meet in an alluring and mysterious composition.

The fragrance opens with a lively combination of lavender,mandarin,apple,bergamot,and pink pepper, creating an aromatic and vibrant introduction. At the heart, violet,geranium,jasmine,and cardamom bring floral depth and spicy character,while the composition develops into a rich base of sandalwood,guaiac wood,patchouli,amber,and tobacco leaves, leaving a warm,smoky,and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lavender,Mandarin,Apple,Bergamot,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Violet,Geranium,Jasmine,Cardamom

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Guaiac Wood,Patchouli,Amber,Tobacco Leaves

title: Escapade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Escapade captures the intoxicating promise of the Caribbean, inspired by the moment when the coast of Santo Domingo emerges after days of sailing across the sea. The fragrance evokes the exuberance of the West Indies through the sensual sweetness of vanilla, the delicacy of rose petals, and the luscious character of ripe peach.

The composition opens with the juicy softness of peach, creating a bright and inviting first impression. At its heart, rose introduces a refined floral elegance, while the base settles into a warm, enveloping blend of vanilla and musk, leaving a smooth and sensual trail reminiscent of tropical shores and sun-drenched island landscapes.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Peach

Middle Notes: Rose

Base Notes: Musk,Vanilla

title: Chrysalide Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Chrysalide Eau de Parfum is an evocative expression of transformation, inspired by the profound metamorphosis that carries a caterpillar from its cocoon into the freedom of a butterfly. Derived from the ancient Greek word “khrusallís,” associated with gold, Chrysalide reflects the golden radiance found within certain chrysalides and the emotional journey that accompanies the discovery of a new purpose. It is a fragrance about evolution, self-conquest, and the beauty of becoming.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of bergamot and grapefruit, enriched by green vetiver grass and the resinous depth of frankincense. At the heart, rose and jasmine create a luminous floral contrast, while nutmeg, black pepper, clove, and Laos aoud introduce warmth, spice, and exotic depth. The composition settles into a rich foundation of amber, vetiver, cedarwood, guaiac wood, and patchouli, creating a deep and sophisticated woody trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Grapefruit,Green Vetiver Grass,Frankincense

Middle Notes: Rose,Jasmin,Nutmeg,Black Pepper,Clove,Laos Aoud

Base Notes: Amber,Vetiver,Cedarwood,Guaiac Wood,Patchouli

title: Calda Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Calda Eau de Parfum is an enchanting and captivating expression of romance, where sparkling fruits and effervescent champagne meet a delicate white floral heart. Its name evokes warmth and intensity, while the composition unfolds like a mysterious evening filled with sweetness, attraction, and quiet seduction.

The fragrance opens with champagne, strawberry, lychee, and cassis, creating a vibrant and playful introduction filled with juicy fruit and sparkling freshness. At the heart, jasmine and lily of the valley bring a luminous floral elegance, softening the exuberance of the opening. The composition settles into a sensual base of musk, dry amber, vanilla, and cotton candy, leaving a warm, creamy, and irresistibly sweet trail.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Champagne,Strawberry,Lychee,Cassis

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Lily of the Valley

Base Notes: Musk,Dry Amber,Vanilla,Cotton Candy

title: Balade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Balade Eau de Parfum is an evocative journey born on the old harbor of Palermo, where the Mediterranean breeze carries the exotic scent of a ship returning from the Pacific. Inspired by the unexpected meeting of Polynesia and Italy, this luminous floral composition transports the imagination from the historic shores of Sicily to the golden beaches of Tahiti, where tropical flowers bloom beneath an endless sun.

The fragrance opens with sparkling tangerine, delicate rose, and sweet honeysuckle, creating a bright and romantic introduction. At the heart, peony and jasmine unfold alongside the exotic richness of tiaré, bringing a lush Polynesian character to the composition. The fragrance settles into a warm base of sandalwood, musk, and patchouli, creating a smooth and sensual trail that evokes sun-warmed skin and distant tropical shores.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Tangerine,Rose,Honeysuckle

Middle Notes: Peonies,Jasmine,Tiaré

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Musk,Patchouli

title: Boreale Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Boreale Eau de Parfum is an ethereal exploration of softness, light, and floral elegance. Inspired by the serene beauty of northern landscapes, this refined composition evokes the delicate stillness of a pale dawn, where powdery florals and luminous petals emerge against a cool, tranquil atmosphere. Its graceful character balances floral sophistication with a warm and comforting sensuality.

The fragrance opens with Bulgarian rose, orris, and heliotrope, creating a refined powdery floral impression with an elegant, velvety texture. At the heart, violet and lily of the valley introduce a delicate freshness, softened by the warm glow of amber. The composition settles into a smooth base of musk and vanilla, leaving a creamy, intimate trail that gently lingers on the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Powdery,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose,Orris,Heliotrope

Middle Notes: Violet,Lily of the Valley,Amber

Base Notes: Musk,Vanilla

title: Aventure Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Aventure Eau de Parfum is an evocative journey inspired by the heat, beauty, and mystery of ancient Egypt. Set against the majestic temples of Karnak and the sacred Nile, this luminous composition captures the atmosphere of a sun-drenched landscape where shimmering citrus, exotic fruits, radiant flowers, and precious woods come together in an elegant olfactory voyage.

The fragrance opens with bergamot, grapefruit, peach, and pineapple, creating a sparkling and refreshing introduction enriched by the succulent character of tropical fruit. At the heart, ylang-ylang, rose, gardenia, and jasmine unfold into a lush floral bouquet, bringing warmth and sophistication to the composition. The fragrance settles into a refined base of patchouli, amber, and musk, leaving a smooth and sensual trail that evokes the warmth of an Egyptian sunset.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Grapefruit,Peach,Pineapple

Middle Notes: Ylang Ylang,Rose,Gardenia,Jasmine

Base Notes: Patchouli,Amber,Musk

title: Alexandria II Anniversary Parfum
body_html:
Alexandria II Anniversary is a regal and complex fragrance created to honour the conception and significance of Alexandria and Alexandria II, two prestigious creations from Xerjoff’s Oud Stars collection. A celebration of their olfactory legacy, this composition brings together powdery florals, refined spices, precious oud, and warm woods in an expression of grandeur and sophistication.

The fragrance opens with Bulgarian rose, cardamom, cumin, and lavender, creating a refined interplay of floral softness, aromatic freshness, and warm spice. At the heart, amber and precious Tarakan oud from Borneo are enriched by civet, clary sage, cypriol, mint, Tuscan orris, and wormwood, creating a richly textured and resinous character. The composition settles into Australian sandalwood, musk, and Madagascan vanilla, leaving a warm and sophisticated trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose,Cardamom,Cumin,Lavender

Middle Notes: Amber,Civet,Clary Sage,Cypriol,Mint,Tarakan Oud,Tuscan Orris,Wormwood

Base Notes: Australian Sandalwood,Musk,Madagascar Vanilla

title: Argentium Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Argentium Eau de Parfum is a refined exploration of contrast, where luminous citrus and aromatic freshness meet the rich warmth of spices, oud, and precious woods. Crafted with a distinctly contemporary character, this composition balances brightness and depth, creating an elegant fragrance that feels both polished and quietly powerful.

The fragrance opens with the vibrant freshness of orange, sharpened by the aromatic spice of cardamom and the green, herbaceous character of artemisia. At the heart, nutmeg and saffron introduce a warm, spicy richness, while an oud accord adds depth and mystery. The composition settles into a smooth base of amberwood, musk, and sandalwood, creating a warm and sophisticated trail with a refined woody character.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Orange,Cardamom,Artemisia

Middle Notes: Nutmeg,Oud Accord,Saffron

Base Notes: Amberwood,Musk,Sandalwood

title: Eau Coeur Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Eau Coeur Extrait de Parfum is an intimate and luminous exploration of the heart, inspired by the meeting of emotion, nature, and skin. The composition expresses a quiet sensuality through delicate floral nuances, radiant freshness, and soft woods, creating a fragrance that feels personal, enveloping, and effortlessly refined.

The fragrance opens with bright bergamot and delicate pink pepper, creating a sparkling introduction with a subtle spicy lift. At the heart, rose, jasmine, and orange blossom unfold in a luminous floral bouquet, softened by the creamy character of sandalwood. The composition settles into a warm base of musk, amber, and cedarwood, leaving a smooth and intimate trail that melts naturally into the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Rose,Jasmine,Orange Blossom,Sandalwood

Base Notes: Musk,Amber,Cedarwood

title: Ultima Storia Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Ultima Storia Extrait de Parfum is an evocative composition inspired by the final chapter of a story, where memories, emotions, and traces of the past converge into something lasting. Created within Thomas De Monaco’s artistic universe, the fragrance explores the beauty of contrasts, bringing together luminous freshness, sensual florals, and a deep woody foundation to create an atmosphere that feels intimate, mysterious, and cinematic.

The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus and aromatic facets, creating a bright yet intriguing introduction. At the heart, floral nuances unfold against a darker, more textured background, gradually revealing a sensual depth. The composition settles into warm woods, amber, and musk, leaving a refined trail that evokes the lingering impression of a story that continues long after its final page.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Floral

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Citrus Notes,Aromatic Notes

Middle Notes: Floral Notes

Base Notes: Woods,Amber,Musk

title: Neo Eden Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Neo Eden Extrait de Parfum is an olfactory vision of a future paradise, where the raw vitality of nature meets a sleek and contemporary sensibility. Inspired by the idea of an Eden reimagined for a new world, the fragrance explores the contrast between lush botanical freshness, luminous florals, and deep natural textures. It is an immersive composition that feels both primordial and futuristic.

The fragrance opens with sparkling bergamot, green leaves, and pink pepper, creating a fresh and energetic introduction. At the heart, jasmine and ylang-ylang bring a radiant floral dimension, while fig adds a creamy, subtly fruity character. The composition settles into a rich base of vetiver, cedarwood, and musk, creating an earthy yet polished trail that connects the fragrance to its natural inspiration.

Fragrance Family: Green,Floral,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Green Leaves,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Ylang-Ylang,Fig

Base Notes: Vetiver,Cedarwood,Musk

title: Jade Amour Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Jade Amour Extrait de Parfum is an intimate expression of love, inspired by the mysterious beauty and serene energy of jade. The fragrance explores the contrast between luminous freshness and sensual depth, creating a contemporary olfactory portrait that feels both precious and deeply personal. Like a polished stone warmed by the skin, it combines delicate floral nuances with smooth woods and an enveloping softness.

The fragrance opens with sparkling bergamot and pink pepper, creating a bright and subtly spicy introduction. At the heart, rose and jasmine unfold with elegant floral luminosity, enriched by the creamy character of sandalwood. The composition settles into a warm base of amber, musk, and cedarwood, leaving a soft, sensual trail that gradually merges with the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Rose,Jasmine,Sandalwood

Base Notes: Amber,Musk,Cedarwood

title: Raw Gold Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Raw Gold Extrait de Parfum is an intense exploration of gold in its most primal and unrefined form. Inspired by the raw energy of precious metals, this composition contrasts luminous radiance with earthy depth, creating an olfactory portrait of mineral warmth, sensual skin, and the mysterious beauty of nature before it is polished or shaped.

The fragrance opens with the vibrant brightness of bergamot and the spicy warmth of pink pepper, creating a luminous introduction. At the heart, jasmine and saffron unfold with a rich floral-spicy character, while osmanthus adds a subtle fruity and leathery facet. The composition settles into a deep foundation of oud, patchouli, and amber, creating a warm and enveloping trail with a distinctive mineral richness.

Fragrance Family: Ambery,Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Pink Pepper

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Saffron,Osmanthus

Base Notes: Oud,Patchouli,Amber

title: Velvet Crystal Smoke Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Crystal Smoke Eau de Parfum is an enigmatic and alluring fragrance where the divine and earthly entwine. Inspired by the wisdom of ancient Egypt and the mysticism of Sicily, this mineralic spicy creation explores the compelling duality of incense and star anise. The result is a mysterious olfactory journey in which sacred resinous warmth meets crystalline mineral facets and the salty richness of ambergris.

The fragrance opens with the spicy aromatic character of star anise and the rich, resinous depth of incense, creating an intriguing and atmospheric introduction.
