At the heart, mineral woods and salty ambergris bring a crystalline, almost aquatic dimension, contrasting the warmth of the opening with an unexpected sense of clarity. The composition settles into patchouli and fir balsam, adding earthy depth and a warm, resinous finish.

Fragrance Family: Mineralic,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Star Anise,Incense

Middle Notes: Mineral Woods,Ambergris

Base Notes: Patchouli,Fir Balsam

title: Velvet Passion Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Passion Oud Eau de Parfum is a voluptuous and enigmatic fragrance inspired by the atmosphere of an Arabian palazzo in Palermo, where majestic frescoes meet the velvety swirls of narghile smoke. Created by Paul Guerlain for Dolce&Gabbana, this fruity oud composition explores the contrast between the exotic brightness of passion fruit, the smoky character of tobacco and narghile, and the opulent depth of oud.

The fragrance opens with addictive passion fruit, contrasted by the burning embrace of a narghile accord. At the heart, saffron and rose create a sensual and sophisticated floral-spicy dimension. The composition settles into a deep base of cistus, where smoky resinous facets give way to the rich and powerful presence of oud.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Oud

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Passion Fruit,Narghile Accord

Middle Notes: Saffron,Rose

Base Notes: Cistus,Oud

title: Darling Point Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Darling Point Eau de Parfum is an evocative journey to Sydney Harbour, inspired by the elegant neighbourhood of Darling Point facing the Opera House. Imagined as an unprecedented Australian encounter, the fragrance captures the warmth of golden light, the freshness of the harbour, and the indulgent sweetness of ripe pear. Its luminous floral character and gourmand accents create a captivating composition sculpted for infinite horizons.

The fragrance opens with cinnamon, sweet pear, and apple, combining warm spice with the succulent freshness of ripe fruit. At the heart, jasmine absolute and bright orange blossom illuminate the composition, joined by saffron and rose absolute for a rich and elegant floral dimension. The fragrance settles into a refined base of moss, cashmere wood, and praline, leaving a soft, warm, and subtly gourmand trail.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cinnamon,Sweet Pear,Apple

Middle Notes: Jasmine Absolute,Bright Orange Blossom,Saffron,Rose Absolute

Base Notes: Moss,Cashmere Wood,Praline

title: Wild Flame Scented Candle
body_html:
Inspired by flickering firelight across Australia’s ancient forests, Wild Flame is an intimate home fragrance where glowing woods meet rich natural resins. Created by Dimitri Weber, this atmospheric scented candle evokes the warmth of a secluded forest at dusk, transforming the interior into a space of reflection, comfort, and quiet luxury.

The fragrance opens with a spicy accord intertwined with the powdery elegance of iris and violet, creating a softly floral and subtly leathery introduction. At the heart, guaiac wood and cedarwood bring a rich woody depth, while ciste and labdanum add warm, resinous facets. The composition settles into a lingering base of leather, warm woods, and musk, creating a smoky and enveloping atmosphere as the candle burns.

Creative Director: Dimitri Weber

Olfactive Description: Smoky,Warm,Enveloping

Fragrance Family: Chypre,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Spicy Accord,Iris,Violet

Middle Notes: Guaiac Wood,Cedarwood,Ciste,Labdanum

Base Notes: Leather Accord,Woods,Musk

title: Ginfusion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Ginfusion Extrait de Parfum is an energetic and unconventional celebration of the gin cocktail, transforming the sparkling freshness of citrus, aromatic herbs, and juniper into a vivid olfactory experience. Inspired by the instant freshness of a Gin Lemon enjoyed on a summer night, this fragrance captures a sense of freedom, vitality, and carefree sophistication through a composition that moves effortlessly between brightness and depth.

The fragrance opens with a vibrant citrus explosion of lemon, sweet orange, mandarin, bergamot, lime, yuzu, and pomelo, sharpened by peppermint and enriched with neroli, citron, and cassis. At the heart, juniper and gin spirit take centre stage, surrounded by green tea, mate tea, tarragon, lemon balm, spearmint, lemongrass, ginger, and vervain. The composition settles into a warm and aromatic base of cedarwood, vetiver, sandalwood, cardamom, wild juniper, oakmoss, and amber, creating a refined yet rebellious trail.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lemon,Sweet Orange,Mandarin,Orange Zest,Bergamot,Peppermint,Lime,Yuzu,Neroli,Citron,Pomelo,Cassis

Middle Notes: Green Tea Leaves,Juniper,Gin Spirit,Tarragon,Lemon Balm,Lily of the Valley,Mate Tea,Spearmint,Lemongrass,Ginger,Vervain

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Vetiver,Sandalwood,Cardamom,Wild Juniper,Oakmoss,Amber

title: Tropikalys Karma Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tropikalys Karma Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant celebration of tropical abundance, created as a fragrance that feels almost drinkable—like a creamy, fresh smoothie overflowing with colour and exotic fruit. Part of Lorenzo Pazzaglia’s Self Portrait Collection, it transforms the joy of summer into an intensely colourful olfactory experience, expressing energy, happiness, and the irresistible pleasure of tropical indulgence.

The fragrance opens with a lively tropical symphony where creamy coconut and velvety papaya meet sparkling pineapple, surrounded by grapefruit, star fruit, guanabana, mangosteen, and apple. At the heart, yellow pitaya, mango smoothie, lychee, mulberry, flambéed peach, banana, and yellow melon create an exceptionally rich and juicy dimension, softened by milk accord and delicate violet and geranium. The composition settles into a warm, enveloping base of plantain, amber woods, Boswellia, patchouli, musk, myrrh, and musky vanilla, leaving a luminous and deeply gourmand trail.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Coconut,Papaya,Grapefruit,Star Fruit,Guanabana,Mangosteen,Pineapple,Apple

Middle Notes: Violet,Geranium,Flambéed Peach,Mulberry,Banana,Yellow Pitaya,Mango Smoothie Accord,Milk Accord,Lychee,Yellow Melon

Base Notes: Plantain,Amber Woods,Boswellia,Patchouli,Musk,Myrrh,Musky Vanilla

title: Let's Pretend Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Let's Pretend Eau de Parfum is a playful and expressive olfactory spectacle created by perfumer Nisrine Grillie to celebrate the twentieth anniversary of Etat Libre d'Orange. Inspired by the theatre of life, the fragrance explores the idea of perfume as an invisible costume—something that allows us to embody different facets of ourselves and step into the spotlight with confidence. Fruity and spicy, it combines luminous freshness, velvety fruit, and warm woods in a composition that moves gracefully between appearance and revelation.

The fragrance opens with radiant mandarin, sparkling pink pepper, and intriguing saffron, creating an energetic introduction reminiscent of a curtain rising before a performance. At the heart, juicy peach takes centre stage, enveloped by the softly apricot-like, subtly leathery character of osmanthus absolute and the delicate floral luminosity of jasmine sambac absolute. The final act reveals an elegant precious-wood accord built around cedar,Akigalawood,and Georgywood, enriched by the resinous warmth of styrax and benzoin.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Saffron,Pink Pepper,Mandarin

Middle Notes: Peach,Osmanthus Absolute,Jasmine Sambac Absolute

Base Notes: Cedar,Akigalawood,Georgywood,Styrax,Benzoin

title: Vanilla Affair Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Vanilla Affair Extrait de Parfum is an evocative exploration of irresistible attraction, created by master perfumer Nathalie Lorson for D’ORSAY. Inspired by the clandestine romance of Alfred d’Orsay and Marguerite de Blessington, the fragrance transforms desire into an intense olfactory expression, built around the mysterious duality of vanilla. At 35% concentration, it reveals a rich and enveloping character where luminous sweetness meets darker, sensual facets.

The fragrance opens with Balkan tobacco, tonka bean, and cistus, creating a warm, aromatic introduction with a delicate honeyed quality. At the heart, a duo of vanillas reveals two contrasting personalities: one deep, warm, and almost leathery, the other creamy, luminous, and gourmand. White musk, patchouli, and amber form the base, leaving a sensual, ambery trail that lingers on the skin with captivating depth.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Balkan Tobacco,Tonka Bean,Cistus

Middle Notes: Vanilla Duo

Base Notes: White Musk,Patchouli,Amber

title: Arrakis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Arrakis Eau de Parfum is an evocative fragrance from the Gold Collection, inspired by a poignant tale of royal devotion, hope, and the enduring bond between a king and his daughter. Named after Arrakis, the Mu Draconis star system, the fragrance carries an atmosphere of luminous strength and quiet emotion, translating its celestial inspiration into a contemporary woody composition.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of grapefruit, creating a vivid and energetic introduction. At the heart, woody notes bring depth and structure, developing the composition with a smooth, refined character. Ambroxan forms the base, adding a warm, subtly musky and radiant finish that gives the fragrance its lasting presence.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Citrus

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Grapefruit

Middle Notes: Woody Notes

Base Notes: Ambroxan

title: Eau Nabati Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Eau Nabati Eau de Parfum Intense is an evocative journey deep into the desert, imagining an oasis where time stands still and luxuriant vegetation flourishes beneath the warmth of the sun. Inspired by the idea of a paradise garden, this distinctive fragrance creates a vivid contrast between fresh citrus brightness and the rich, amber warmth carried by a spicy desert wind.

The fragrance opens with fresh bergamot and petitgrain, bringing a lively citrus character to the composition. At the heart, immortelle flowers introduce a warm, honeyed amber facet, while Peru balsam deepens the composition with its rich, resinous warmth. The contrasting elements come together in a harmonious and enveloping olfactory experience.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Ambery,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Petitgrain

Middle Notes: Immortelle

Base Notes: Peru Balsam

title: Yellow Hibiscus Cologne
body_html:
Yellow Hibiscus Cologne is a radiant floral fragrance inspired by the exotic yellow hibiscus, a striking tropical bloom that turns towards the warmth of the sun. Evoking sun-drenched shores and balmy island days, this luminous composition captures the flower’s joyful spirit in a delicate and sparkling scent.

The fragrance opens with the bright, exotic character of yellow hibiscus, creating a beaming floral impression. At the heart, rose brings a dewy, petal-fresh elegance, adding a soft and sumptuous dimension. White musk settles into the base with a clean, powdery softness, leaving a gentle and enduring trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Yellow Hibiscus

Middle Notes: Rose

Base Notes: White Musk

title: Rose Amber Cologne
body_html:
Rose Amber Cologne is a sumptuous floral fragrance inspired by England’s iconic Tudor rose, a flower closely associated with the grandeur and intrigue of royal history. Blending the elegance of rose with the warmth of amber and a distinctive spicy edge, this captivating composition reimagines a timeless floral emblem through a rich and sensual olfactory expression.

The fragrance brings together the spicy character of clove, the opulent floral presence of rose, and the enveloping warmth of amber. These key notes create a contrast between floral elegance and resinous depth, giving the composition a distinctive character that feels both classic and contemporary.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Ambery,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Clove

Middle Notes: Rose

Base Notes: Amber

title: Patchouli Spirit Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Patchouli Spirit Eau de Parfum Intense is a radiant and sensual interpretation of one of perfumery’s most legendary ingredients. Created by Patricia de Nicolaï, this fragrance explores the rich, sun-drenched facets of patchouli, revealing its earthy depth alongside a warm, ambery character. The composition evokes the damp richness of forest undergrowth, transformed into an enveloping and sophisticated olfactory experience.

The fragrance opens with a lively burst of orange, angelica, and mandarin, introducing a bright aromatic freshness. At the heart, Indonesian patchouli reveals its profound, woody character, enriched by Turkish rose absolute, pelargonium, and cinnamon. The composition settles into a smooth and captivating base of sandalwood, vanilla, incense, amber, and ambroxan, creating a warm, sensual trail with remarkable depth.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Orange,Angelica,Mandarin

Middle Notes: Patchouli,Turkish Rose Absolute,Pelargonium,Cinnamon

Base Notes: Ambroxan,Sandalwood,Vanilla,Incense,Amber

title: Musc Amarante Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Musc Amarante Eau de Parfum is an imaginative exploration of childhood memories, inspired by perfumer Quentin Bisch’s recollections and the unexpected beauty of beetroot. At the heart of this distinctive creation lies a surprising combination of vegetal character and soft musk, refreshed by a delicate citrus touch. Part of the Le Potager collection, it brings an unconventional ingredient into the world of fine fragrance with artistry and originality.

The composition opens with the refined, musky nuances of ambrette, introducing a soft and subtly fresh impression. Beetroot accord takes centre stage, lending the fragrance its distinctive vegetal character and evoking memories of a familiar garden. As the scent develops, white musk envelops the composition in a smooth, comforting softness, while the bergamot accent adds a bright, refreshing contrast.

Fragrance Family: Fresh

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Ambrette

Middle Notes: Beetroot Accord

Base Notes: White Musk

title: Pacific Rock Moss 10 Years Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Pacific Rock Moss 10 Years Eau de Parfum is an evocative celebration of the Australian coastline, capturing the refreshing spirit of the ocean and the timeless beauty of sunlit shores. Inspired by the meeting of sea breezes, coastal greenery, and sun-warmed rocks, this aromatic aquatic fragrance invites the wearer into a world of natural freshness and effortless freedom.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling brightness of Italian lemon, intertwined with the distinctive green character of Australian coastal moss. At the heart, French sage and Egyptian geranium introduce an aromatic, botanical dimension. The composition settles into a smooth foundation of Virginia cedarwood and white musk, creating a refined trail that evokes the calm and enduring allure of the seaside.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic,Aquatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lemon Italy,Australian Coastal Moss

Middle Notes: Sage France,Geranium Egypt

Base Notes: Cedarwood Virginia USA,White Musk

title: Pacific Rock Swell Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Pacific Rock Swell Extrait de Parfum is an evocative interpretation of the ocean’s raw and elemental power. Inspired by the meeting of shadowy underwater depths and brilliant sunlight, this contemporary fragrance captures the untamed freedom of the sea through a distinctive aquatic composition. It invites the wearer into a world of crashing waves, mineral freshness, and sun-warmed coastal landscapes.

The fragrance opens with fresh oceanic nuances and bright citrus, creating a vibrant impression reminiscent of sea spray carried on a coastal breeze. At the heart, sun-warmed woody notes emerge alongside a mineral clarity, evoking the contrast between the cool depths of the ocean and the warmth of the sunlit shore. The composition creates an atmospheric aquatic experience that feels expansive, modern, and deeply connected to nature.

Fragrance Family: Aquatic,Citrus,Woody,Fresh

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Marine Notes,Citrus Notes

Middle Notes: Woody Notes,Mineral Notes

Base Notes: Not individually specified

title: Scandic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Scandic Eau de Parfum is an olfactive portrait of the Scandinavian spirit, inspired by the purity of Nordic nature and the striking contrast between crisp landscapes and warm human connection. The fragrance captures the sensation of fresh northern air, green forests, and sunlit moments, translated into a refined composition with a distinctly Scandinavian character.

The fragrance opens with sparkling citrus and aromatic freshness, creating a bright and invigorating introduction. At the heart, elegant florals and green nuances unfold with a natural softness, while the composition gradually deepens into woods and warm, enveloping musks. The drydown leaves a clean yet sensual trail that evokes the quiet beauty of the Nordic landscape.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Aromatic,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Lemon,Orange

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Rose,Green Notes

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Sandalwood,White Musk,Amber

title: Nohiba Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Dark, deep, and oriental, Nohiba belongs to the rare and treasured formulas of Maison L.T. Piver. Born in 1868 under the aegis of Alphonse Piver, this evocative creation emerged from a Europe captivated by vanished civilizations and the mysterious worlds they inspired. Preserved through generations, its character resists simple definition, inviting the imagination to wander through an atmosphere of ancient splendour and timeless intrigue.

The fragrance opens with the warm spice of cinnamon, brightened by mandarin’s sparkling citrus character. At the heart, rose unfolds alongside the sacred, resinous depth of olibanum and the supple richness of leather. The base reveals a sensual blend of vanilla and amber, grounded by the dry, papyrus-like texture of precious woods, creating a deep and lingering oriental trail.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Ambery,Spicy,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cinnamon,Mandarin

Middle Notes: Rose,Olibanum,Leather

Base Notes: Vanilla,Amber,Papyrus

title: Musk Colada Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Musk Colada is a fearless celebration of strength, sensuality, and individuality. Created by perfumers Nanako Ogi and Margherita Carini, this 2026 fragrance from OJAR’s Musk Collection brings together luminous fruit, delicate florals, and distinctive Middle Eastern botanical ingredients. Its unexpected contrasts create a scent that feels playful yet confident, soft yet unforgettable.

The fragrance opens with the juicy freshness of prickly pear and nectarine, illuminated by the delicate floral touch of cherry blossom. At the heart, Japanese musk melon reveals a lush, distinctive character, wrapped in the earthy warmth of henna, the golden spice of saffron, and the resinous nuance of mastic. The drydown settles into white musk and benzoin, leaving a smooth, sensual trail that feels intimate and magnetic.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Prickly Pear,Cherry Blossom,Nectarine

Middle Notes: Musk Melon,Henna,Saffron,Mastic

Base Notes: White Musk,Benzoin

title: Oligarch Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oligarch is a 2026 fragrance from Vilhelm Parfumerie, created as a bold and sophisticated composition for women and men. Its character unfolds through the contrast of juicy fruits, aromatic spice, earthy patchouli, and smooth, enveloping woods, creating a scent with a confident and distinctive presence.

The fragrance opens with vibrant pineapple and green apple, sharpened by the lively warmth of black pepper. At the heart, patchouli introduces an earthy depth, while tonka bean and white tobacco bring a smooth, subtly sweet and aromatic richness. The composition settles into ambroxan and musk, leaving a warm, sensual trail with a refined, contemporary character.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Woody,Musky,Ambery

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pineapple,Black Pepper,Green Apple

Middle Notes: Patchouli,Tonka Bean,White Tobacco

Base Notes: Ambroxan,Musk

title: Sable Lavande Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sable Lavande is a luminous and enveloping fragrance from Chloé’s Atelier des Fleurs collection, inspired by the poetic meeting of sun-warmed sand and aromatic lavender. It captures the sensation of a Mediterranean landscape at dusk, where the dry warmth of the earth is softened by the delicate, soothing presence of lavender.

The fragrance opens with aromatic lavender, offering a fresh yet subtly honeyed introduction. At the heart, the composition develops into a warm and textured floral impression, revealing the elegant depth of lavender absolute. The drydown brings a soft woody warmth and musky trail, creating a smooth, intimate finish that remains close to the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Aromatic,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lavender

Middle Notes: Lavender Absolute

Base Notes: Woody Notes,White Musk

title: Oud for Grace Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud for Grace is a new 2026 creation from Initio Parfums Privés’ Black Gold Project, offering a contemporary interpretation of oud where intensity is expressed through refinement and balance. The fragrance brings together luminous bergamot, precious woods, sacred oud, and a contrasting touch of black pepper, softened by the addictive warmth of vanilla and praline.

The fragrance opens with the clarity of bergamot sharpened by black pepper, creating a vibrant and precise introduction. At the heart, oud is intertwined with sandalwood, cedarwood, and guaiacwood, forming a deep and resonant woody structure. The drydown introduces vanilla and praline, adding a smooth, subtly gourmand warmth that rounds the darker woods without overwhelming them.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Ambery,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot

Middle Notes: Praline,Black Pepper

Base Notes: Vanilla,Oud,Sandalwood,Cedarwood,Guaiacwood

title: Saint Petal Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Saint Petal is a 2026 fragrance from BORNTOSTANDOUT®’s Freeze Collection, composed by perfumer Jordi Fernández. A provocative exploration of contrasts, it brings together radiant florals, aromatic spice, dark coffee, incense, and textured woods, creating a scent that feels simultaneously sacred, rebellious, and unapologetically modern.

The fragrance opens with luminous orange blossom and bergamot, sharpened by cumin and an evocative dust accord. At the heart, violet and jasmine sambac introduce a floral softness, while incense, coffee, and Akigalawood add smoky, bitter, and woody dimensions. The base becomes darker and more sensual, blending amyris, cistus, vetiver, leather, and oud into a deep, earthy trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Spicy,Woody,Smoky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Orange Blossom,Bergamot,Cumin,Dust

Middle Notes: Violet,Jasmine Sambac,Incense,Coffee,Akigalawood

Base Notes: Amyris,Cistus,Vetiver,Leather,Oud

title: Lumiere d’Issey Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum is a luminous floral fragrance inspired by the enchanting moment when the first rays of sunlight meet nature. It explores the contrast between radiant freshness and sensual warmth, creating a delicate composition that feels bright, airy, and effortlessly feminine.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of pear and lotus, creating a translucent and joyful introduction. At the heart, rose and lily unfold with soft floral elegance, illuminated by a delicate aquatic freshness. The composition settles into a warm base of sandalwood, white musk, and amber, leaving a smooth and subtly sensual trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Aquatic,Woody,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Pear,Lotus

Middle Notes: Rose,Lily

Base Notes: Sandalwood,White Musk,Amber

title: Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette is an elemental fragrance inspired by the powerful connection between salt,water,and earth. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, it transforms the mineral character of salt into a distinctive masculine signature, blending marine freshness with aromatic herbs and warm woods.

The fragrance opens with seaweed and marine notes, creating a fresh, salty impression reminiscent of the ocean shore. At the heart, vetiver and cedarwood bring an earthy, aromatic depth, while the salty accord continues to give the composition its mineral character. The base unfolds into warm sandalwood and oak, leaving a smooth and naturally woody trail.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Marine,Aromatic,Earthy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Seaweed,Marine Accord

Middle Notes: Vetiver,Cedarwood,Salty Accord

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Oak

title: Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum explores the elemental power of salt, inspired by the meeting of land and sea. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, this contemporary masculine fragrance transforms salt into an olfactive signature, balancing marine freshness with earthy woods and a warm, sensual trail.

The fragrance opens with ginger and oakmoss, creating a vibrant contrast between spicy freshness and mineral earthiness. At the heart, seaweed and vetiver evoke the meeting of ocean and soil, while the salty accord gives the composition its distinctive character. The base unfolds through sandalwood and oak, creating a warm, woody foundation that gives the fragrance depth and persistence.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Marine,Aromatic,Earthy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Ginger,Oakmoss

Middle Notes: Seaweed,Vetiver,Salty Accord

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Oak

title: A Drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum Essentielle
body_html:
A Drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum Essentielle is a luminous, nature-inspired fragrance that explores the beauty of a single drop of water. Created by perfumer Ane Ayo, this fresh and floral interpretation celebrates the delicate encounter between lilac and the natural world, revealing a composition that feels airy, radiant, and serene.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of green mandarin, creating a crisp and invigorating introduction. At the heart, lilac takes center stage, joined by the creamy floral facets of magnolia and the delicate freshness of jasmine. The composition settles into a soft base of cedarwood and musk, creating a clean, subtly woody trail that remains close to the skin.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Musky,Citrus

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Green Mandarin

Middle Notes: Lilac,Magnolia,Jasmine

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Musk

title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau Essentielle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau Essentielle Eau de Parfum is a luminous celebration of water in its purest form. This contemporary interpretation of the iconic L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme signature explores the meeting of freshness and natural warmth, creating an elegant composition with a distinctly modern character.

The fragrance opens with a vibrant citrus freshness, before revealing a refined heart shaped around aromatic and luminous natural facets. The composition gradually settles into a warm woody base, creating a clean yet sensual trail that balances transparency with depth.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Aromatic,Woody,Aquatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Cardamom

Middle Notes: Lavender,Geranium

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Vetiver,Patchouli

title: L’Eau d’Issey Eau Essentielle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Eau Essentielle Eau de Parfum is a luminous celebration of water in its purest state. Inspired by water flowing over a stone warmed by the sun, this contemporary interpretation of the iconic L’Eau d’Issey captures the meeting of crystalline freshness, radiant flowers, and warm mineral woods.

The fragrance opens with the crisp, juicy freshness of Nashi pear, softened by delicate aquatic nuances. At the heart, orange blossom absolute brings a warm, sunlit floral radiance, creating a beautiful contrast with the freshness of the opening. The composition settles into cedarwood, revealing dry, subtly ambered and musky facets that leave a refined mineral trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Musky,Aquatic,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Nashi Pear,Aquatic Accord

Middle Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute

Base Notes: Cedarwood,Amber,Musk

title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Vetiver Eau de Toilette Intense
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Vétiver Eau de Toilette Intense explores the encounter between the purity of water and the raw strength of vetiver. A powerful and woody interpretation of the iconic L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme signature, it creates a striking contrast between aquatic transparency, aromatic warmth, and smoky woods.

The fragrance opens with sparkling ginger, bringing a vibrant spicy freshness. At the heart, the aquatic character of Calone creates transparency and fluidity, enhanced by Haitian vetiver and the sandalwood-like Dreamwood™ accord. The base intensifies the composition with smoky vetiver root, lifted by warm clary sage for a rugged yet refined finish.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Aquatic,Spicy,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Ginger

Middle Notes: Calone,Haitian Vetiver,Dreamwood™

Base Notes: Vetiver,Clary Sage

title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Solar Lavender Eau de Toilette Intense
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Solar Lavender Eau de Toilette Intense explores the contrast between the cool freshness of water and the radiant warmth of Provence lavender. Inspired by the meeting of hot and cold, aquatic and aromatic, this modern interpretation gives the iconic L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme signature a distinctly solar and contemporary character.

The fragrance opens with grapefruit, Sichuan pepper, and nutmeg, combining sparkling freshness with warm, earthy spice. At the heart, Diva lavender and Bourbon geranium reveal an aromatic, herbaceous character, bringing the luminosity of sun-warmed lavender to the composition. The drydown settles into vetiver and cedarwood, creating a powerful yet refined woody foundation.

Fragrance Family: Aromatic,Woody,Spicy,Aquatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Grapefruit,Sichuan Pepper,Nutmeg

Middle Notes: Diva Lavender,Bourbon Geranium

Base Notes: Vetiver,Cedarwood

title: L’Eau d’Issey Shades of Kolam Eau de Toilette
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Shades of Kolam Eau de Toilette is an evocative limited-edition interpretation of the iconic L’Eau d’Issey, inspired by the vibrant colours and artistic traditions of India. The fragrance draws its inspiration from the ancient art of Kolam, transforming its intricate patterns and joyful colours into a luminous floral composition.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of cardamom and bergamot, creating a bright and uplifting introduction. At the heart, jasmine and rose unfold with a rich floral elegance, while coconut water adds a soft, refreshing dimension. The composition settles into a warm and sensual base of sandalwood,vanilla,and musk, leaving a smooth and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody,Spicy,Musky

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cardamom,Bergamot

Middle Notes: Jasmine,Rose,Coconut Water

Base Notes: Sandalwood,Vanilla,Musk

title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Sport Eau de Toilette
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Sport Eau de Toilette captures the energy of movement through a fresh, vibrant interpretation of the iconic Issey Miyake signature. Inspired by the exhilaration of outdoor sport, it combines sparkling citrus with an invigorating aromatic heart and a warm, woody foundation.

The fragrance opens with bright grapefruit and bergamot, creating an energetic burst of freshness. At the heart, nutmeg adds a spicy aromatic character, while the composition develops toward a powerful base of vetiver, cedarwood, and amber, giving the fragrance a dry, masculine finish with lasting depth.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Woody,Spicy,Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Grapefruit,Bergamot

Middle Notes: Nutmeg

Base Notes: Vetiver,Cedarwood,Amber

title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette is a powerful interpretation of the iconic L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme signature, where the purity of water meets the warmth and depth of precious woods. The composition creates a striking contrast between freshness, spice, and an enveloping woody trail.

The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus freshness, creating an energetic first impression before revealing a warmer, spicier heart. The composition deepens into rich woods and amber, giving the fragrance a more intense and sensual character while preserving the distinctive freshness of the L’Eau d’Issey universe.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Aquatic,Spicy,Ambery

title: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a powerful new interpretation of the iconic masculine fragrance, inspired by the captivating depth and infinite nuances of the ocean. Created by perfumer Sophie Labbé in collaboration with underwater explorer and photographer Alexis Rosenfeld, it explores the contrast between the cool intensity of deep water and the warmth of precious woods.

The fragrance opens with the spicy brilliance of Sichuan pepper, adding an invigorating edge to the signature aquatic character of L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme. At the heart, fir balsam absolute introduces a rich, resinous warmth and textured depth. The composition settles into cedarwood, creating a powerful woody foundation that gives the fragrance its modern, masculine presence.

body_html:
L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Toilette is the iconic signature fragrance of Issey Miyake, created around the pure, elemental beauty of water. Launched in 1992 and composed by perfumer Jacques Cavallier, it expresses a vision of femininity through transparency, freshness, and the natural harmony of flowers and woods.

The fragrance opens with luminous lotus and rose, complemented by the sparkling freshness of bergamot and lemon. At the heart, delicate lily,peony,and carnation unfold with an airy floral elegance, while the distinctive aquatic character of the composition creates a sensation of purity. The base reveals precious woods,ambrette,and musk, leaving a soft and refined trail that remains effortlessly timeless.

Inspired by the contrast between water and fire, the fragrance explores the meeting of luminous florals with warm, enveloping woods, creating an intense yet elegant expression of femininity.

The composition opens with the sparkling freshness of ylang-ylang and orange blossom, creating a radiant floral introduction. At the heart, rose and lotus blend with the distinctive warmth of cinnamon, adding depth and sensuality. The fragrance settles into a rich base of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood, leaving a smooth, warm trail that contrasts beautifully with the freshness of the opening.

title: Une Vanille Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Une Vanille is a sensual interpretation of vanilla that moves beyond the familiar world of sugary gourmand fragrances. Obvious returns to vanilla in its most natural and mysterious form, celebrating the deep, creamy character of black Madagascar vanilla and the almond-like facets of Venezuelan tonka bean.

The fragrance opens with the soft, almond-like richness of Venezuelan tonka bean absolute before revealing the sumptuous depth of black Madagascar vanilla absolute at the heart. The fragrance opens with sparkling lemon, fresh ginger, pink pepper, and crisp Granny Smith apple, creating an energetic and invigorating first impression. At the heart, coriander,lavender,and Sambac jasmine bring an aromatic and floral dimension, balancing freshness with gentle spice. Created as a Harrods-exclusive fragrance, it brings together unexpected contrasts of sparkling fruit, aromatic spice, luminous florals, supple suede, and smoky woods.

The fragrance opens with the tart brightness of rhubarb,energized by ginger and bergamot. At the heart, luminous magnolia meets balsamic styrax and a smooth suede accord, creating a refined leather-like texture. Sirio is an olfactive journey toward the stars, inspired by Sirius, the brightest star in the known universe and a symbol of humanity’s eternal search for where we come from and where we are going. body_html:
Affinity is a refined expression from Spirit of Kings’ Compassion Collection, inspired by mutual understanding, shared values, and the sophisticated bonds that bring people together. The fragrance represents trust, respect, and harmonious relationships, translating these qualities into an elegant and compelling olfactory composition.

The fragrance opens with the bright citrus freshness of bergamot enriched by the warm,spicy character of nutmeg. At its heart, jasmine,lavender,and geranium create a soft floral dimension, while the base settles into a warm and sophisticated blend of amber,musk,moss,sandalwood,patchouli,and olibanum.

title: Loyalty Parfum
body_html:
Loyalty is a rich and powerful expression from Spirit of Kings’ Guardianship Collection, created to symbolize the unwavering devotion and enduring bond between kings and queens. Warm, regal, and deeply sensual, the fragrance explores loyalty through the comforting sweetness of vanilla and the profound richness of rum, creating an elegant composition with a bold and addictive character.

The fragrance opens with the opulent warmth of saffron,rum,and bergamot before revealing a sophisticated heart of Damask rose,cistus labdanum,and oud accord. As the composition settles, cedarwood atlas,guaiacwood,patchouli,vanilla,musk,and amber create a deep, woody, and enveloping drydown with a luxurious oriental character.

title: The Scent of Banat Extrait de Parfum

The Scent of Banat Extrait de Parfum by Wesker is an evocative fragrance inspired by the Banat region,where lush landscapes,rich traditions,and the warmth of Eastern European nature create a captivating sense of place. The composition reflects the beauty of this historic land through fresh aromatic nuances,delicate florals,and a deep woody foundation.

The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of green and aromatic notes,creating a fresh and invigorating introduction. At the heart,floral nuances unfold with a soft and elegant character,bringing warmth and refinement to the composition. The drydown settles into rich woods,amber,and musk,creating a smooth and enveloping trail that lingers beautifully on the skin.

body_html:
Histria Extrait de Parfum by Wesker is a sophisticated fragrance inspired by the ancient city of Histria on the Black Sea coast,where Mediterranean influences,ancient traditions,and the rugged beauty of nature meet. The composition evokes a journey through history with aromatic freshness,precious woods,and warm sensual accords,creating an atmosphere that feels timeless,mysterious,and refined.

The fragrance opens with a vibrant combination of citrus and aromatic spices,creating a fresh and invigorating introduction. At the heart,floral and woody nuances unfold with a smooth and elegant character,bringing depth and complexity to the composition. The drydown reveals warm amber,vanilla,and musk intertwined with rich woods,leaving a sophisticated and lasting trail.

body_html:
Deviant Extrait de Parfum by Wesker is a provocative and unconventional fragrance created for those who embrace individuality and refuse to follow the expected path. It explores the darker side of temptation through an intriguing balance of sweetness,spice,and sensual woods,creating a composition that feels rebellious,mysterious,and undeniably addictive.

The fragrance opens with an expressive blend of aromatic and spicy nuances,creating a bold first impression. At the heart,rich floral and gourmand facets unfold with warmth and sensuality,adding depth and intrigue to the composition. The drydown reveals dark woods,amber,vanilla,and musk,creating a smooth and lingering trail with a seductive character.

body_html:
Rubeus Extrait de Parfum by Wesker is a rich and decadent fragrance inspired by passion,fire,and the fierce power of desire. Part of The Alchemist’s Dream collection,Rubeus is imagined as a ruby-red elixir that ignites the senses,blending luscious fruits with dark chocolate,creamy sweetness,and the mysterious depth of oud.

The fragrance opens with juicy raspberry,sweet cherry,and cocoa,creating an irresistibly fruity and gourmand introduction. At the heart,dark chocolate,apricot,and nougat create a rich,indulgent character that feels almost edible. The drydown deepens into hazelnut,vanilla cream,caramel,and agarwood,leaving a warm,creamy,and seductive trail.

body_html:
Wesker Nocturne Extrait de Parfum is a dark and sophisticated fragrance inspired by the mystery and sensuality of the night. It evokes the atmosphere of a moonlit evening,where cool aromatic nuances,rich florals,and deep woods come together to create an alluring composition filled with elegance,shadow,and intrigue.

The fragrance opens with fresh citrus and aromatic accents,creating a crisp and mysterious introduction. At the heart,floral and spicy nuances develop with a rich and seductive character,adding warmth and complexity. The drydown reveals dark woods,amber,vanilla,and musk,creating a smooth and enveloping trail that lingers on the skin.

Wesker Delirium Extrait de Parfum is an intense and hypnotic fragrance that explores the exhilarating edge between obsession and surrender. Designed as an olfactory journey into delirium,it combines luminous sweetness with darker,more sensual facets to create a powerful composition that feels mysterious,addictive,and unapologetically expressive.

The fragrance opens with vibrant citrus and fruity nuances,creating a bright yet provocative introduction. At the heart,floral and aromatic accords develop into a rich and intoxicating character,while warm spices add complexity and depth. The drydown reveals creamy vanilla,amber,and dark woods,leaving a smooth,deep,and long-lasting trail.

Wesker Cruelle Extrait de Parfum is a dark and seductive fragrance built around the tension between sweetness,floral elegance,and shadowy depth. The composition creates an intriguing contrast between luminous fruit and flowers and a richer,more sensual base,evoking an atmosphere of mystery,confidence,and unapologetic allure.

The fragrance opens with vibrant fruity and spicy nuances that immediately draw attention. At the heart,rich floral facets unfold with a soft yet intoxicating character,while warm gourmand touches add depth and sensuality. The drydown becomes darker and more enveloping,with creamy vanilla,amber,and woody accords creating a smooth and lingering finish.

body_html:
Nosy Manitra Extrait de Parfum by AAWED is an exotic and immersive fragrance inspired by the lush island of Nosy Manitra in Madagascar,where tropical vegetation,rich spices,and the warm Indian Ocean create a landscape filled with natural beauty and sensuality. The composition captures the island’s vibrant character through an intriguing blend of citrus,florals,spices,and precious woods.

The fragrance opens with bergamot,lemon,and pink pepper,creating a bright and invigorating introduction. At the heart,ylang-ylang,jasmine,and cinnamon unfold with an exotic floral warmth,while earthy and aromatic nuances add depth. The drydown reveals vanilla,patchouli,vetiver,and sandalwood,creating a smooth,woody,and enveloping finish.

body_html:
Muttrah Extrait de Parfum by AAWED draws inspiration from the captivating allure of Muttrah,the historic port city of Oman,where ancient walls meet the sea and veiled figures move gracefully through the atmospheric souks. The fragrance evokes a world of incense,spices,and precious woods,creating an opulent olfactory journey filled with mystery,tradition,and refined luxury.

The fragrance opens with fresh bergamot,black pepper,pink pepper,and incense,creating a vibrant yet smoky introduction. At the heart,rose absolute,labdanum,cashmere wood,and spicy nuances create a rich and sophisticated character,balancing floral softness with resinous warmth. The drydown reveals oud,musk,amber,frankincense,myrrh,and vanilla,forming a deep,balsamic,and sensual trail that lingers beautifully.

body_html:
Meguro River Extrait de Parfum by AAWED is a luminous and playful fragrance inspired by the graceful Meguro River in Tokyo,where cherry blossom petals drift through the air beneath the soft glow of lanterns. It captures the youthful energy and modern elegance of the city through a vibrant composition of juicy fruits,delicate blossoms,and serene woody depth.

The fragrance opens with a bright and vibrant blend of cherry,yuzu,bergamot,and bitter almond,creating a fresh and subtly gourmand introduction. At the heart,cherry blossom,almond blossom,plum blossom,rhubarb,and rose create a lush floral bouquet that reflects Tokyo's springtime beauty. The drydown settles into moss,ambergris,vanilla,and woody notes,creating a smooth,calming,and softly sensual finish.

title: La Foce Vita Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
La Foce Vita Extrait de Parfum by AAWED is a sophisticated fragrance inspired by long,leisurely stays in Tuscany,where expansive landscapes,citrus groves,green fields,and warm Italian sunshine create an unmistakable feeling of freedom. It captures the timeless elegance of the Tuscan countryside through a bright citrus opening,a refined floral-woody heart,and a warm,earthy base.

The fragrance opens with mandarin orange,grapefruit,bergamot,and lemon,accented by cardamom and pepper for a vibrant and refreshing introduction. At the heart,cedar,iris,cashmere wood,pepper,geranium,and amber create a sophisticated blend of powdery,woody,and aromatic nuances. The drydown reveals vanilla,vetiver,patchouli,tonka bean,and amber,bringing warmth,depth,and sensuality to the composition.

title: Leisure in Paradise Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Leisure in Paradise Eau de Parfum by Simone Andreoli is a vibrant tropical escape inspired by the carefree pleasure of spending endless summer days beneath the Caribbean sun. It evokes the feeling of warm sand,crystal-clear waters,and exotic fruit shared in a secluded paradise,creating a juicy,creamy,and irresistibly sensual fragrance.

The fragrance opens with a luscious combination of peach,pineapple,and lemon,creating a bright and mouthwatering introduction. At the heart,coconut milk and jasmine bring a creamy tropical floral character,while the sweetness of passion fruit adds an exotic dimension. The drydown settles into vanilla,musk,and amber,leaving a warm,soft,and sun-kissed trail.

body_html:
Zest di Sorrento Eau de Parfum by Simone Andreoli is a radiant and refreshing fragrance inspired by the sun-drenched Amalfi Coast and the legendary lemon groves of Sorrento. It captures the joy of an Italian summer,where sparkling citrus,the Mediterranean breeze,and lush greenery come together in an uplifting and irresistible composition.

The fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of Sorrento lemon,bergamot,and grapefruit,creating an intensely fresh and sparkling introduction. At the heart,orange blossom and petitgrain add a luminous floral-green character,evoking the scent of citrus trees in full bloom. The drydown settles into soft musk and cedarwood,bringing a clean,woody warmth that leaves the skin feeling fresh and radiant.

Vicebomb Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli is a bold and provocative fragrance inspired by the intoxicating atmosphere of a decadent night out. It captures the seductive energy of temptation through a rich interplay of juicy fruits,floral sensuality,and warm gourmand nuances,creating an addictive composition that embraces pleasure without restraint.

The fragrance opens with a vibrant explosion of exotic fruits and sparkling citrus,creating an energetic and enticing introduction. At the heart,opulent floral notes unfold with a creamy and sensual character,while sweet gourmand nuances add irresistible depth. The drydown reveals a warm combination of vanilla,amber,and musk,leaving a smooth,seductive,and long-lasting trail.

Venom Secret of Shaman Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli is a dark and hypnotic fragrance inspired by ancient Mayan shamanic rituals and the mystical journey of spiritual transformation. It evokes the wild energy of the jungle,where sacred resins,smoldering woods,and intoxicating tobacco create an atmosphere of mystery,transcendence,and supernatural intensity.

The fragrance opens with the warm richness of saffron,sweet dates,and dried fruits,creating an immediately captivating and slightly exotic introduction. At the heart,tobacco,dark woods,resins,and black pepper form an intense and hypnotic accord,bringing depth and smoky warmth. The drydown reveals leather,vanilla,patchouli,and everlasting flower,creating a sensual,resinous,and enduring trail.

Tulum Junglescape Eau de Parfum by Simone Andreoli is an exotic and immersive fragrance inspired by the lush tropical landscape of Tulum,the vibrant Mexican paradise where dense jungle meets the Caribbean Sea. It captures the sensation of humid tropical air,green vegetation,and sun-drenched beaches through a composition that feels fresh,wild,and irresistibly sensual.

The fragrance opens with sparkling lime and refreshing green notes,creating a vibrant and invigorating introduction. At the heart,tropical fruits and exotic flowers emerge alongside creamy coconut,evoking the lushness of the Tulum jungle and the turquoise waters of the Caribbean. The drydown settles into warm woods,amber,and musk,leaving a smooth and enveloping trail reminiscent of tropical skin warmed by the sun.

Smoke of Desert Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli is a mysterious and evocative fragrance inspired by the vast deserts of Oman and the sacred tradition of burning precious incense beneath the night sky. It captures the profound silence of the dunes,the warmth of desert sands,and the hypnotic trail of aromatic smoke drifting through the darkness.

The fragrance opens with luminous elemi and the bitter,aromatic character of absinth,creating an intriguing and slightly resinous introduction. At the heart,Oman incense takes center stage,bringing a rich,balsamic,and spiritual depth to the composition. The drydown unfolds with soft cashmere and leather,creating a warm,sensual,and smoky finish that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Rose of Dangerous Flamenco Eau de Parfum by Simone Andreoli is a passionate and seductive fragrance inspired by the fiery soul of Spanish flamenco. It captures the intensity of a dancer moving beneath the Andalusian night sky,where crimson roses,smoky woods,and sensual warmth create an atmosphere charged with desire and danger.

The fragrance opens with vibrant pink pepper and saffron,creating a spicy and magnetic introduction. At the heart,opulent rose blends with jasmine and dark fruity nuances,evoking the dramatic beauty of a flamenco performance. The drydown reveals rich oud,patchouli,amber,and vanilla,leaving a warm,smoky,and irresistibly sensual trail.

Pacific Park Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli is a playful and nostalgic fragrance inspired by the famous amusement park of Santa Monica. It captures the carefree spirit of childhood and sunny July days,where the scent of candied fruit,caramel,and sweet treats drifts between colorful carousels along the pier. The composition is a joyful return to innocence,lightness,and uncomplicated happiness.

The fragrance opens with the juicy freshness of mandarin and pear,creating a bright and fruity introduction. At the heart,candied fruit and caramel bring an irresistibly sweet,gourmand character,evoking the atmosphere of candy stalls and freshly made crêpes along Ocean Avenue. The drydown settles into creamy vanilla,leaving a soft,warm,and deliciously addictive trail.

Moorea Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli captures the carefree spirit of a vacation in French Polynesia,far from the noise and frenzy of everyday life. Inspired by the idyllic shores of Moorea,it evokes the sensation of salt crystallizing on sun-warmed skin,the endless blue of the sea,and the luminous beauty of exotic white flowers.

The fragrance opens with the refreshing contrast of lime and salt,brightened by luminous neroli. At the heart,precious tiaré and ylang-ylang create an intense and magnetic floral bouquet with exotic nuances. The composition settles into wet woods,bringing a smooth,earthy depth that recalls driftwood washed by the waves and the peaceful atmosphere of a secluded Polynesian beach.

Mandorla del Sud Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli is a sumptuous gourmand fragrance inspired by the refined almond pastries of Sicily. It evokes the intimate atmosphere of a Sicilian master confectioner’s workshop,where clouds of powdered sugar and creamy almonds create an irresistibly soft and comforting olfactory experience.

The fragrance is built around the sophisticated sweetness of almond,wrapped in a delicate veil of icing sugar. As the composition develops,warm amber and creamy vanilla enrich the gourmand character,creating a smooth,velvety,and enveloping sensation reminiscent of freshly prepared Sicilian almond desserts.

It embodies a rebellious spirit through an addictive contrast of vibrant freshness,creamy sweetness,and sensual woods,creating a composition that refuses to be restrained.

The fragrance opens with bright citrus and juicy fruity nuances,creating an energetic and inviting introduction. At the heart,delicate florals are wrapped in creamy gourmand facets,bringing softness and sensuality to the composition. The drydown deepens into warm vanilla,amber,and smooth woods,leaving a rich and seductive trail.

Camouflage Eau de Parfum Intense by Simone Andreoli is a sophisticated and enigmatic fragrance inspired by the art of concealment,the thrill of mystery,and the allure of what remains hidden. It creates a striking contrast between freshness and depth,combining vibrant citrus,aromatic nuances,and sensual woods in a composition that feels both contemporary and effortlessly magnetic.

The fragrance opens with a bright burst of bergamot and citrus,accented by aromatic spices that create a crisp and energetic introduction. title: Criminal Lipstick Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Criminal Lipstick Extrait de Parfum by Simone Andreoli is a seductive and rebellious fragrance inspired by the provocative allure of a woman who knows exactly how to command attention. It captures the sensual ritual of applying lipstick before an unforgettable night,blending powdery cosmetics,creamy florals,and warm woods into an irresistibly glamorous composition.

The fragrance opens with a soft and powdery accord of iris and violet,evoking the delicate texture of freshly applied makeup. At the heart,rose and jasmine unfold with creamy elegance,while heliotrope adds an addictive almond-like softness. The drydown reveals vanilla,musk,sandalwood,and amber,creating a warm,velvety,and sensual trail reminiscent of lipstick on skin.

Apricot Innocence Extrait de Parfum by Simone Andreoli is a luminous and nostalgic fragrance inspired by the pure joy of childhood summers spent in the countryside. Part of the Timeless Nomad collection, it recalls carefree days in the family orchard,where sun-warmed apricots,exotic flowers,and the beauty of nature create an enchanting memory of innocence and happiness.

The fragrance opens with juicy apricot nectar,sweet orange,and exotic fruits,creating a radiant and deliciously fruity introduction. At the heart,creamy sambac and osmanthus mingle with delicate rose petals and soft hints of vanilla,forming a lush and tender floral embrace. The drydown settles into soft amber and velvety white musk,creating a warm,comforting,and long-lasting trail.

body_html:
Reverie de la Rose Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums is a romantic and luminous interpretation of the rose, inspired by the timeless beauty of Indian rose gardens at dawn. The fragrance captures a moment of quiet reverie,where dew-covered petals,soft sunlight,and delicate florals create an atmosphere of elegance,serenity,and refined femininity.

The fragrance opens with a fresh and sparkling blend of bergamot,blackcurrant,and pink pepper,creating a vibrant introduction. At the heart,velvety rose unfolds alongside jasmine and violet,bringing a soft and sophisticated floral character. The drydown reveals a warm and sensual foundation of vanilla,patchouli,and musk,leaving a smooth and lingering trail.

body_html:
Moha Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums is a rich and sensual gourmand fragrance inspired by a sultry morning walk through the sun-drenched spice bazaars of Old Mylapore. Created by perfumer Laurent Marrone, it evokes the vibrant atmosphere of South India,where sweet shops,temple offerings,and the intoxicating scent of Madurai jasmine mingle with the aromas of bustling bazaar cafés,roasting coffee,and burning wood.

The fragrance opens with the bright freshness of lime,combined with the roasted warmth of chestnut and coffee. At the heart,jasmine and sandalwood blend with dry woods,creating a creamy yet smoky character that recalls the aromatic cafés and sun-warmed streets of Mylapore. The drydown becomes rich and decadent,with vanilla,caramel,amber,and musk creating a smooth,sweet,and enveloping finish.

body_html:
Light of the Earth Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums is an evocative fragrance inspired by the timeless connection between humanity and nature. It captures the feeling of walking through an ancient forest at dawn,where fresh air,green foliage,and earthy woods create a sense of harmony and quiet strength. The composition balances luminous freshness with rich natural depth,reflecting the beauty and resilience of the earth.

The fragrance opens with refreshing bergamot,green leaves,and aromatic spices,creating a vibrant and invigorating introduction. At the heart,floral nuances blend with earthy and woody facets,bringing warmth and natural elegance to the composition. The drydown settles into a rich foundation of patchouli,vetiver,cedarwood,and amber,leaving a deep,grounded,and enveloping trail.
