title: Le Notti di Goa Shanthi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Le Notti di Goa Shanthi Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums captures the tranquil side of Goa,where sun-drenched beaches,swaying palm trees,and refreshing coastal air create a sense of peace and escape. Created by perfumer Luca Maffei, Shanthi evokes a relaxing getaway through a vibrant blend of fresh green accents,tropical fruits,and marine accords.

The fragrance opens with an invigorating combination of cardamom,pink peppercorn,and mint,creating a crisp and refreshing introduction. At the heart,pineapple and mango unfold within a luminous marine accord,bringing a juicy,tropical character reminiscent of a fruity cocktail by the Goan sea. The drydown introduces patchouli,labdanum,and amberwood,adding warmth,depth,and a smooth woody finish.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Marine,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cardamom,Pink Peppercorn,Mint
Heart Notes: Marine Accord,Pineapple,Mango
Base Notes: Patchouli,Labdanum,Amberwood

title: Le Notti di Goa Palolem Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Le Notti di Goa Palolem Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums captures the carefree spirit of Palolem Beach,one of Goa’s most iconic coastal destinations. Created by perfumer Ping Wei Ling, the fragrance evokes salty sea breezes,sun-kissed sands,tropical flowers,and colorful beach shacks,bringing to life the bohemian freedom and nomadic spirit of nights spent by the sea.

The fragrance opens with a citrusy and boozy blend of orange,boozy accords,cardamom,and cinnamon,creating a warm and inviting introduction. At the heart,exotic champak flower and jasmine are joined by black pepper and lavender,forming a vibrant floral and aromatic character. The drydown reveals the luminous depth of Amber 84 De Laire,combined with moss,balsam,cedarwood,musk,and benzoin for a warm,woody,and enveloping finish.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Spicy,Amber

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Orange,Boozy Accord,Cardamom,Cinnamon
Heart Notes: Champak Flower,Jasmine,Black Pepper,Lavender
Base Notes: Amber 84 De Laire,Moss,Balsam,Cedarwood,Musk,Benzoin

title: L’Amour Libertin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L’Amour Libertin Eau de Parfum by Sasva Parfums is a provocative and intoxicating fragrance inspired by a bacchanalian dive into pleasure and ecstasy,celebrating the freedom of surrendering to the more instinctive side of human nature. Created by perfumer Gaël Montero, it unfolds as an extravagant journey into mystery,indulgence,and refined sensuality,with an addictive poppy accord at its heart.

The fragrance opens with the seductive warmth of saffron,pepper,ginger,and lavandin,creating a spicy and aromatic introduction. At the heart,the distinctive poppy accord is enriched with amber,rum,and incense,bringing a sensual and intoxicating character. The drydown reveals a smoky and opulent blend of oud,tobacco,leather,vanilla,benzoin,and sandalwood,leaving an unforgettable trail of warmth and intrigue.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Spicy,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Saffron,Pepper,Ginger,Lavandin
Heart Notes: Poppy,Amber,Rum,Incense
Base Notes: Oud,Tobacco,Leather,Vanilla,Benzoin,Sandalwood

title: Fruit du Paradis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fruit du Paradis Eau de Parfum is a vibrant and joyful tribute to the fertile abundance of nature, capturing the radiant spirit of a sun-drenched mango orchard. Inspired by the freshness of a sea breeze mingling with the richness of a bountiful harvest, it celebrates the vivid energy of tropical fruit and the warmth of an Indian summer. Bright,citrusy,and naturally sensual,it creates an uplifting fragrance filled with freshness and sunlit sweetness.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling tang of Lime and the bright citrus character of Kamala Oranges,creating a refreshing first impression. At the heart,Pomegranate,Mango,and Jasmine introduce a lush combination of juicy fruit and delicate floral softness. The drydown becomes smoother and more refined,with Sandalwood and Vetiver creating a subtle powdery,woody foundation that allows the vibrant fruit notes to linger beautifully.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Floral,Citrus

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lime,Kamala Oranges
Heart Notes: Pomegranate,Mango,Jasmine
Base Notes: Sandalwood,Vetiver

title: Forbidden Words Bombay Gourmand Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Forbidden Words Bombay Gourmand Eau de Parfum revisits Sasva’s Forbidden Words with a decadent Bombay twist,transporting the senses into the pulsating heart of Bandra,Mumbai. Inspired by nights filled with smoke,boozy desserts,decadence,and temptation,the fragrance captures the intoxicating atmosphere of a city after dark. Created by perfumer Luca Maffei,it blends exotic woods and oriental gourmand accords into a rich and sensual composition.

The fragrance opens with Sweet Orange,Fior di Mandorla Sweets,and Rose,evoking the richness of Indian confections with a bright citrus and floral touch. At the heart,Oud,Salted Caramel Accord,Cypriol,and Davana create a dark,boozy,and addictive contrast,where smoky woods meet creamy sweetness. The drydown becomes warm and enveloping,with Vanilla,Patchouli,Labdanum,and Cedarwood creating a smooth,resinous,and sophisticated finish.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Sweet Orange,Fior di Mandorla Sweets,Rose
Heart Notes: Oud,Salted Caramel Accord,Cypriol,Davana
Base Notes: Vanilla,Patchouli,Labdanum,Cedarwood

title: Route 66 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Route 66 Extrait de Parfum is a bold and enigmatic fragrance inspired by the legendary road and the captivating atmosphere of a hazy night drive. Its character is built around an unconventional contrast of vibrant spices,bright citrus,earthy woods,and the unexpected rawness of gasoline. Dark,adventurous,and unapologetically distinctive,it evokes the freedom and mystery of a journey where the destination matters less than the road itself.

The fragrance opens with Spicy Notes,Cinnamon,and Bergamot,creating a lively and warmly aromatic introduction. At the heart,Gasoline,Patchouli,and Sandalwood introduce an unusual smoky,earthy,and woody character,with the gasoline accord adding a hazy,industrial edge. The drydown becomes softer yet deeply enveloping,as Vanilla,Tonka Bean,White Musk,and Amber create a warm,sweet,and sensual trail that contrasts beautifully with the rebellious heart.

Fragrance Family: Gasoline,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Spicy Notes,Cinnamon,Bergamot
Heart Notes: Gasoline,Patchouli,Sandalwood
Base Notes: Vanilla,Tonka Bean,White Musk,Amber

title: Patchouli Dream Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Patchouli Dream Extrait de Parfum is a rich and indulgent unisex fragrance inspired by the luxurious atmosphere of a tropical paradise. Conceived as a royal escape,the composition begins with a sumptuous blend of rum,vanilla,and sun-kissed coconut,creating the sensation of an exotic island retreat. As the fragrance unfolds,it becomes increasingly decadent,combining sensual florals with crème brûlée,caramel,and saffron before revealing a deep and sophisticated woody drydown.

The fragrance opens with Rum,Vanilla,and Coconut,creating a warm,creamy,and tropical introduction. At the heart,Rose,Jasmine,Crème Brûlée,Caramel Notes,and Saffron create a sumptuous contrast of floral elegance and edible sweetness. The drydown becomes darker and more luxurious,with Patchouli,Agarwood,Cashmere Wood,Vanilla,Tonka Bean,Musk,Amber,Labdanum,and Leather creating a warm,woody,and deeply enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Liquorish,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Rum,Vanilla,Coconut
Heart Notes: Rose,Jasmine,Crème Brûlée,Caramel Notes,Saffron
Base Notes: Patchouli,Agarwood,Cashmere Wood,Vanilla,Tonka Bean,Musk,Amber,Labdanum,Leather

title: Nirvana Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Nirvana Extrait de Parfum is a sophisticated and intriguing unisex fragrance that promises a journey of discovery with every wear. Fresh,citrusy brightness meets warm spices and a mysterious marine-woody heart,creating a composition that constantly shifts between freshness,depth,and sensuality. Its combination of aromatic citrus,precious woods,iris,and marine nuances gives Nirvana an elegant yet enigmatic character.

The fragrance opens with the invigorating freshness of Orange,Bergamot,Mandarin,and Grapefruit,energized by the spicy warmth of Ginger and Clove. At the heart,Marine Notes,Lily-of-the-Valley,Agarwood,Cashmere Wood,Sandalwood,Iris,and Patchouli create a sophisticated contrast between aquatic freshness,delicate florals,and rich woody textures. The drydown becomes warm and sensual,with Amber and Musk creating a smooth and luxurious finish.

Fragrance Family: Wood,Oriental

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Orange,Bergamot,Mandarin,Ginger,Grapefruit,Clove
Heart Notes: Marine Notes,Lily-of-the-Valley,Agarwood,Cashmere Wood,Sandalwood,Iris,Patchouli
Base Notes: Amber,Musk

title: Monarchy Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Monarchy Extrait de Parfum is an elegant and indulgent unisex fragrance that embodies a sense of refined luxury and effortless allure. From its first impression,it creates a vibrant and enchanting aura,combining sparkling citrus with a soft,powdery heart of luscious fruits. As the fragrance develops,it becomes increasingly creamy and sensual,finally settling into a warm and delicious base of vanilla,tonka,amber,and musk.

The fragrance opens with the zesty freshness of Lemon,Orange,and Mandarin,creating a bright and invigorating citrus introduction. At the heart,Powdery Notes are blended with Apple,Peach,Coconut,Strawberry,and Pineapple,forming a juicy,tropical,and softly creamy fruity accord. The drydown becomes smooth and addictive as Vanilla,Tonka Bean,Amber,and Musk create a sweet,warm,and enveloping finish.

Fragrance Family: Powdery,Sweet

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Lemon,Orange,Mandarin
Heart Notes: Powdery Notes,Apple,Peach,Coconut,Strawberry,Pineapple
Base Notes: Vanilla,Tonka Bean,Amber,Musk

title: Lux'us Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Lux'us Extrait de Parfum is a sophisticated unisex fragrance that embodies the idea of boundless luxury through a striking contrast of marine freshness,precious spices,floral elegance,and sensual woods. The journey begins with the breathtaking freshness of an ocean breeze,where aquatic accords meet saffron and spices,then moves into an elegant floral garden before culminating in a warm,opulent base of vanilla,tonka,and amber.

The fragrance opens with Aquatic Notes,Saffron,Pink Pepper,and Clove,creating a fresh yet spicy introduction with an unexpected richness. At the heart,Rose,Jasmine,Muguet,Iris,Oud,Sandalwood,Oak Moss,and Leather create a sophisticated floral-woody composition,balancing luminous flowers with darker and more sensual textures. The drydown becomes smooth and enveloping,with Vanillin,Tonka,Labdanum,Amber,Amberwood,and Musk leaving a warm,velvety,and luxurious trail.

Fragrance Family: Neo Oriental,Oud

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Aquatic Notes,Saffron,Pink Pepper,Clove
Heart Notes: Rose,Jasmine,Muguet,Iris,Oud,Sandalwood,Oak Moss,Leather Note
Base Notes: Vanillin,Tonka,Labdanum,Amber,Amberwood,Musk

title: Limerence Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Limerence Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant and captivating unisex fragrance from Soleil de Grâce’s The Origins collection,created as an expression of an emotion so intense that words become inadequate. Fresh citrus and crisp fruits create a lively beginning,softened by creamy coconut,while a spicy floral heart introduces warmth and intrigue. As the fragrance settles,it reveals a rich and sensual foundation of woods,leather,amber,musk,and tonka bean.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of Bergamot and Lemon,interwoven with the juicy sweetness of Pear,Apple,and Pineapple,while Coconut adds a smooth,creamy facet. At the heart,Chilly Pepper,Elemi,Cardamom,and Rose create a vibrant contrast between fiery spice,aromatic resin,and romantic floral softness. The drydown becomes deeper and more grounded,with Sandalwood,Patchouli,Cedarwood,Amber,Vetiver,Tonka Bean,Leather,Musk,and Mossy Notes forming a warm,earthy,and enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Neo Oriental

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Lemon,Pear,Apple,Pineapple,Coconut
Heart Notes: Chilly Pepper,Elemi,Cardamom,Rose
Base Notes: Sandalwood,Patchouli,Cedarwood,Amber,Vetiver,Tonka Bean,Leather,Musk,Mossy Notes

title: L’Ambre Vanille Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
L’Ambre Vanille Extrait de Parfum is a rich and indulgent unisex fragrance that explores the sensual meeting point between creamy gourmand sweetness and deep oriental resins. Created by perfumer Gökhan Şimşek, it opens with the comforting softness of coconut and milk before revealing an intriguing heart of myrrh,olibanum,labdanum,and juniper. The composition ultimately melts into a luxurious vanilla-amber base,where praline,tonka,and musk create an irresistibly warm and enveloping trail.

The fragrance opens with Coconut and Milk,creating a smooth,lactonic,and subtly tropical introduction. At the heart,Myrrh,Olibanum,Labdanum,and Juniper bring a darker resinous and aromatic character,adding depth and contrast to the creamy opening. The drydown becomes sumptuous and gourmand,with Tonka Bean,Vanilla,Praline,Amber,and Musk forming a warm,velvety,and lingering foundation.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Vanilla,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Coconut,Milk
Heart Notes: Myrrh,Olibanum,Labdanum,Juniper
Base Notes: Tonka Bean,Vanilla,Praline,Amber,Musk

title: Cherish Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Cherish Oud Extrait de Parfum is a provocative and sensual unisex fragrance that explores the intriguing contrast between playful fruitiness and darker,more seductive woods. Presented by Soleil de Grâce as a journey into forbidden territory,it combines juicy cherry and raspberry with sparkling spice before revealing a floral heart and an alluring oud-rich drydown. The result is a fragrance that balances youthful playfulness with deep sensuality.

The fragrance opens with the vibrant sweetness of Cherry and Raspberry,energized by the brightness of Ginger and the warm spice of Cinnamon. At the heart,Rose,Lily-of-the-Valley,and Violet create a soft and captivating floral accord,while Patchouli introduces an earthy,woody depth. The drydown becomes richer and more mysterious as Oud,Amber,Musk,and Vanilla create a warm,smooth,and addictive finish.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Cherry,Raspberry,Ginger,Cinnamon
Heart Notes: Rose,Lily-of-the-Valley,Violet,Patchouli
Base Notes: Oud,Amber,Musk,Vanilla

title: Carat Iris Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Carat Iris Extrait de Parfum is an elegant and mysterious unisex fragrance that explores the refined beauty of iris through a rich floral and woody composition. Inspired by the atmosphere of a secret garden in full bloom,it brings together delicate flowers with the darker mystery of incense and myrrh,while cedarwood adds a sophisticated woody depth. The result is a graceful and enigmatic fragrance with a distinctly luxurious character.

The fragrance opens with the elegant powdery character of Iris and the luminous floral presence of Jasmine,creating an immediately refined and captivating impression. As the composition develops,Incense and Myrrh introduce a mysterious,resinous dimension that deepens the floral heart. In the drydown,Cedarwood lends warmth and structure,leaving a smooth,woody,and sophisticated trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Iris,Jasmine
Heart Notes: Incense,Myrrh
Base Notes: Cedarwood

title: Black Tonka Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Black Tonka Extrait de Parfum is a rich and indulgent unisex fragrance that brings together the opulence of oriental perfumery with the irresistible character of a gourmand composition. Designed around a powerful opening of creamy milk,caramel,warm spices,and tobacco,it gradually softens into an elegant floral heart before settling into a deep,velvety base of woods,resins,vanilla,and tonka bean.

The fragrance opens with an intense blend of Milk,Caramel,Cinnamon,Elemi,Saffron,Nutmeg,and Tobacco,creating a creamy,warm,and richly spiced introduction. At the heart,Mimosa,Muguet,and Jasmine introduce a delicate floral softness that contrasts beautifully with the powerful opening. The drydown becomes smooth and enveloping,with Patchouli,Sandalwood,Benzoin,Tonka Bean,Vanilla,Amber,and Musk creating a warm,woody,and ambery finish.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Milk,Caramel,Cinnamon,Elemi,Saffron,Nutmeg,Tobacco
Heart Notes: Mimosa,Muguet,Jasmine
Base Notes: Patchouli,Sandalwood,Benzoin,Tonka Bean,Vanilla,Amber,Musk

title: Atlantis Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Atlantis Extrait de Parfum is a captivating aquatic and woody fragrance inspired by the mysterious beauty of the sea. Created to evoke the sensation of standing on serene shores,where fresh ocean air meets delicate seaside blooms,it balances invigorating marine freshness with soft florals and a warm,woody base. The result is an elegant unisex composition that feels refreshing,serene,and quietly alluring.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of Bergamot and Marine Notes,creating the impression of a crisp ocean breeze. At the heart,Cyclamen,Muguet,and Jasmine unfold into a delicate floral bouquet that brings softness and luminosity to the aquatic opening. The drydown becomes deeper and more enveloping,with Amber,Musk,Sandalwood,and Seaweed creating a smooth,slightly salty,and sophisticated finish.

Fragrance Family: Marine,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Bergamot,Marine Notes
Heart Notes: Cyclamen,Muguet,Jasmine
Base Notes: Amber,Musk,Sandalwood,Seaweed

title: Addictoud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Addictoud Extrait de Parfum is a dark,opulent,and addictive fragrance from Soleil de Grâce’s NÉO collection,where gourmand sweetness meets mysterious oriental depth. Described by the house as a journey born in the embrace of the night,it begins with the intoxicating warmth of deep wine and melting caramel before revealing a floral and woody heart. As the fragrance develops,it becomes richer and more enigmatic,blending creamy sweetness with resinous woods,oud,and sensual musks.

The opening combines Wine and Caramel,creating a warm,boozy,and deliciously seductive introduction. At the heart,Jasmine,Cedarwood,Sandalwood,Mossy Notes,and Cashmere Wood bring together floral radiance,earthy texture,and smooth woody warmth. The drydown turns deeper and more luxurious,with Cotton Candy,Vanilla,Tonka Bean,Labdanum,Amber,Musk,Oud,and Cypriol creating a sweet,resinous,and intensely enveloping trail.

Fragrance Family: Neo Oriental,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Wine,Caramel
Heart Notes: Jasmine,Cedarwood,Sandalwood,Mossy Notes,Cashmere Wood
Base Notes: Cotton Candy,Vanilla,Tonka Bean,Labdanum,Amber,Musk,Oud,Cypriol

title: Moonwalk Seacoco Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Moonwalk Seacoco Extrait de Parfum is a luminous and tropical gourmand inspired by a reimagined Pavlova,transforming the delicate dessert into an exotic olfactory journey. The fragrance travels from the sun-drenched pineapple fields of Hawaii to the fiery ginger of Madagascar,the creamy Seacoco of the Seychelles,and finally the sparkling citrus landscapes of Italy. Fresh,fruity,and irresistibly creamy,it captures the carefree sensation of a tropical escape.

The fragrance opens with the vibrant freshness of Italian Mandarin Essential Oil,Sicilian Lemon,and Sugarloaf Pineapple from Hawaii,creating a bright and juicy introduction. At the heart,Passion Fruit,Madagascan Ginger Essential Oil,Seacoco from the Seychelles,and Whipped Cream create a contrasting blend of tropical fruit,spice,and creamy sweetness. The drydown becomes smooth and enveloping with Comoros Vanilla CO₂ Extract,Indian Sandalwood,and Italian Lemon Zest,leaving a radiant,creamy,and refreshing trail.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Fruity,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Italian Mandarin Essential Oil,Sicilian Lemon,Sugarloaf Pineapple
Heart Notes: Passion Fruit,Madagascan Ginger Essential Oil,Seacoco,Whipped Cream
Base Notes: Comoros Vanilla CO₂ Extract,Indian Sandalwood,Italian Lemon Zest

title: Akatsuki Melba Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Akatsuki Melba Extrait de Parfum is a playful and sophisticated gourmand inspired by a fragrant road trip through exotic landscapes and cherished dessert memories. The journey begins with the luscious Akatsuki peach from Japan,moves through the icy intensity of Siberian raspberry,and culminates in the rich indulgence of Guérande salted-butter caramel. Fruity,creamy,and irresistibly gourmand,it creates a captivating contrast between exotic freshness and familiar sweetness.

The fragrance opens with the juicy,velvety character of Akatsuki Peach from Japan,paired with the delicate floral-fruity facets of Osmanthus Absolute. At the heart,Blackcurrant Bud Absolute meets Siberian Icy Raspberry Jelly,creating a vibrant red-fruit accord with a deliciously tart and jammy character. The drydown becomes warmer and more indulgent,with Guérande Salted Butter Caramel Coulis,Tahitian Vanilla,and Tonka Absolute melting together into a creamy,salty-sweet,and enveloping finish.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Akatsuki Peach,Osmanthus Absolute
Heart Notes: Blackcurrant Bud Absolute,Siberian Icy Raspberry Jelly
Base Notes: Guérande Salted Butter Caramel Coulis,Tahitian Vanilla, Tonka Absolute

title: Pannaco Tahaa Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Pannaco Tahaa Extrait de Parfum is a sumptuous gourmand journey inspired by an olfactory road trip across Thailand,Tahiti,and Italy. At the heart of the story is the exotic Mahachanok mango,discovered in the vibrant markets of Bangkok,then carried toward the vanilla-rich island of Taha'a before meeting the creamy indulgence of Italian panna cotta. The result is a luscious,fruity,and creamy composition that transforms tropical ingredients into an elegant haute parfumerie dessert.

The fragrance opens with the juicy sweetness of Mahachanok Mango,brightened by Orange and softened by Vanilla. At the heart,Panna Cotta creates a smooth,milky,and indulgent texture,joined by an additional veil of Vanilla. The drydown becomes warmer and more sensual as Tahitian Vanilla,Saffron,Benzoin,White Musk,and Tonka Bean melt together into a creamy,ambery,and softly spiced trail.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand,Fruity,Vanilla

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Mahachanok Mango,Orange,Vanilla
Heart Notes: Panna Cotta,Vanilla
Base Notes: Tahitian Vanilla,Saffron,Benzoin,White Musk,Tonka Bean

title: Red Keela Split Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Red Keela Split Extrait de Parfum is a playful yet sophisticated gourmand fragrance that transforms the indulgence of a classic banana split into an extravagant olfactory journey. Created by perfumer Camille Leguay,the fragrance travels from the tropical richness of India to the elegant landscapes of Sicily,before arriving in the vibrant excess of New York. Fruity,creamy,and irresistibly decadent,it brings together precious ingredients and dessert-inspired accords in a contemporary gourmand composition.

The fragrance opens with the bright bitterness of Italian Lemon Essential Oil and Bigarade,evoking the freshness of a sunlit Mediterranean journey. At the heart,Strawberry Gelato,Indian Red Banana,and Orange Blossom create a lush and creamy fruity accord. The drydown becomes sumptuous and enveloping,with Bronte Pistachio Dessert Cream,Tonka Absolute,Caramel,Vanilla,Indian Sandalwood,and Ambroxan creating a rich,velvety,and addictive finish.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Italian Lemon Essential Oil,Bigarade
Heart Notes: Strawberry Gelato,Indian Red Banana,Orange Blossom
Base Notes: Bronte Pistachio Dessert Cream,Tonka Absolute,Caramel,Vanilla,Indian Sandalwood,Ambroxan

title: Vanille des Rois Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Vanille des Rois Extrait de Parfum is a luxurious and deeply gourmand fragrance that celebrates vanilla in all its richness and splendor. Created as an olfactory road trip, it journeys across Tunisia,the Comoros,Tahiti,and Provence,bringing together precious ingredients from around the world with the spirit of an exquisite French dessert. At its heart,the fragrance pays homage to the iconic Galette des Rois,reimagined through creamy vanilla,orange blossom,praline,and tonka bean.

The fragrance opens with the luminous bitterness of Italian Bigarade Orange,creating a radiant citrus introduction. The heart becomes warmer and more sensual as Peru Balsam,Tunisian Neroli,Orange Blossom,Pink Pepper,and Sri Lankan Cinnamon unfold in a rich,spiced floral accord. In the drydown,a sumptuous blend of Comoros Vanilla CO₂ Extract and Tahiti Vanilla Absolute takes center stage,layered with Labdanum,Pink & Brown Praline,Brazilian Tonka,Patchouli,Atlas Cedar,Amber Woods,and natural Vanillin for an opulent,creamy,and addictive finish.

Fragrance Family: Amber,Oriental,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Italian Bigarade Orange Essential Oil
Heart Notes: Peru Balsam,Tunisian Neroli Essential Oil,Orange Blossom Water,Pink Pepper Essential Oil,Sri Lankan Cinnamon Essential Oil
Base Notes: Comoros Vanilla CO₂ Extract,Tahiti Vanilla Absolute,Labdanum Absolute,Pink & Brown Praline,Brazilian Tonka Absolute,Patchouli Essential Oil,Moroccan Atlas Cedar Essential Oil,Amber Woods,Natural Vanillin

title: The Manoeuvres of the Baroness Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Manoeuvres of the Baroness Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated and enigmatic addition to Penhaligon’s Portraits Collection, portraying a woman who operates from the shadows with intelligence,elegance,and unmistakable influence. A strategist hidden behind impeccable charm,the Baroness is always a step ahead—watching,calculating,and quietly shaping the secrets and scandals of high society. Her fragrance is creamy,sensual,and quietly commanding,reflecting a woman who writes her own rules.

The composition opens with the sparkling freshness of Italian Mandarin and the luminous presence of Orange Blossom,creating an intriguing first impression touched by incense. At the heart,the innovative Chantilly accord introduces an airy,gourmand softness inspired by vanilla whipped cream,delicate yet irresistibly sensual. The fragrance then settles into the sophisticated warmth of Sandalwood,leaving a smooth,creamy,and elegant trail that lingers with quiet authority.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Gourmand,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Italian Mandarin,Orange Blossom,Incense
Heart Notes: Chantilly Accord
Base Notes: Sandalwood

title: Ti Amo Parfum
body_html:
Ti Amo Parfum is an opulent expression of romance,created to capture the intoxicating feeling of falling completely in love. Part of Roja Dove’s Profumi d’Amore collection,it brings together luminous citrus,an extravagant floral heart,and a rich gourmand-woody base. Its character is sensual,refined,and deeply emotional,balancing freshness and sweetness with an unmistakable aura of luxury.

The fragrance opens with the sparkling brightness of Mandarin and Bergamot,before unfolding into an abundant floral heart of Ylang-Ylang,Heliotrope,Pineapple,Orange Blossom,Jasmine,Rose,Neroli,and Lily-of-the-Valley. As it develops,the composition becomes warmer and more sumptuous,with Cacao,Vanilla,Orris Root,Sandalwood,Tonka Bean,and Ambergris surrounded by ginger,pink pepper,cinnamon,saffron,labdanum,patchouli,and woods. The result is an extraordinarily intricate trail that moves from radiant florals to creamy gourmand warmth and sophisticated spice.

Fragrance Family: Oriental Floral

Olfactive Pyramid

Top Notes: Mandarin Orange,Bergamot
Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang,Heliotrope,Pineapple,Orange Blossom,Jasmine,Rose,Neroli,Lily-of-the-Valley
Base Notes: Cacao,Vanilla,Orris Root,Sandalwood,Tonka Bean,Ambergris,Ginger,Pink Pepper,Cinnamon,Labdanum,Cumin,Saffron,Patchouli,Carrot Seeds,Guaiac Wood,Galbanum,Vetiver

title: Portamarina Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Portamarina Extrait de Parfum — Agatho Parfum is a fresh citrus-aromatic fragrance inspired by a serene morning in ancient Pompeii, where Mediterranean citrus, aromatic herbs, dew-kissed apples, sea breeze, and the powdery atmosphere of frescoed walls come together. The fragrance belongs to Agatho Parfum’s Pompei Collection and is presented as a 100ml Extrait de Parfum.

It opens with apple, orange, and bergamot, creating a vibrant, juicy citrus-fruity introduction. At its heart, sage, thyme, sea breeze, and orris bring an aromatic, marine, and softly powdery character, evoking the Mediterranean atmosphere of Pompeii. As the fragrance settles, musk and cedar create a clean, smooth, and elegant woody base.

Fragrance Family: Citrus,Aromatic,Marine,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Apple,Orange,Bergamot
Heart Notes: Sage,Thyme,Sea Breeze,Orris
Base Notes: Musk,Cedar

title: Great Ocean Road Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Great Ocean Road Extrait de Parfum — AAWED is a sophisticated woody-spicy fragrance inspired by the wild and rugged beauty of Australia's iconic Great Ocean Road. The composition captures a coastal journey along dramatic cliffs and sparkling seas, blending lush greenery, salty marine nuances, warm spices, and deep earthy woods. AAWED describes the fragrance as an ode to the natural grandeur of this Australian coastline.

It opens with rose, fig, cardamom, honey, cananga, and pimento, creating a lush fruity-floral introduction with warm, spicy nuances. At its heart, seaweed, violet, caramel, cypriol, and geranium bring together marine freshness, powdery florals, earthy woods, and a touch of gourmand sweetness. As the fragrance settles, ambergris, musk, oud, oakmoss, and civet create a deep, earthy, resinous, and sensual base that evokes damp forests meeting the rugged coastline.

Fragrance Family: Woody,Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Rose,Fig,Cardamom,Honey,Cananga,Pimento
Heart Notes: Seaweed,Violet,Caramel,Cypriol,Geranium
Base Notes: Ambergris,Musk,Oud,Oakmoss,Civet

title: Un Jardin sur le Nil Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Un Jardin sur le Nil Eau de Toilette — Hermès

Un Jardin sur le Nil Eau de Toilette — Hermès is a fresh, green, and woody fragrance created by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena in 2005. Inspired by the garden islands of Aswan, Egypt, it captures an impressionistic journey along the Nile through the freshness of green vegetation, water, sand, and sunlit gardens.

The fragrance opens with the tangy freshness of green mango, creating a crisp and slightly fruity introduction. At its heart, lotus and incense bring a delicate aquatic-floral character, while calamus adds a green, aromatic nuance. As the fragrance settles, sycamore wood provides an elegant woody foundation, giving the composition a smooth and natural finish.

Fragrance Family: Green,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Green Mango
Heart Notes: Lotus,Incense,Calamus
Base Notes: Sycamore Wood

title: Valhalla Extreme Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Valhalla Extreme Extrait de Parfum — Paradis des Sens is a rich fruity-amber fragrance that intensifies the original Valhalla into a denser, more sensual expression. Created by perfumer Pierre-Constantin Guéros and launched in 2026, the fragrance is built around juicy tropical fruits, luminous florals, and a warm combination of musk, amber, and leather.

It opens with mango, pear, and plum, creating a juicy, succulent introduction with a rich fruity character. At its heart, jasmine, ylang-ylang, and lily of the valley bring a luminous floral dimension that softens the intensity of the fruit. As the fragrance settles, musk, amber, and leather create a warm, sensual, and slightly animalic base, giving the composition a smooth and enveloping finish.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Ambery,Leathery

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Mango,Pear,Plum
Heart Notes: Jasmine,Ylang-Ylang,Lily of the Valley
Base Notes: Musk,Amber,Leather

title: Un Jardin en Mediterranee Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Un Jardin en Méditerranée Eau de Toilette — Hermès

Un Jardin en Méditerranée Eau de Toilette — Hermès is a fresh, delicate fruity-woody fragrance created by Jean-Claude Ellena in 2003. It evokes a walk through a secret garden in Tunisia, where lush trees and flowers create an unusual Mediterranean oasis filled with freshness, light, and shade.

The composition centers around the creamy, green character of fig tree, complemented by the aromatic freshness of green lentisk and the delicate floral character of oleander. The result is a serene, airy fragrance that captures the feeling of a Mediterranean garden in the warmth of the sun. Hermès classifies the fragrance as fresh and delicate, with fig tree, green lentisk, and oleander as its principal raw materials.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Fig Tree,Bergamot,Green Notes
Heart Notes: Green Lentisk,Orange Blossom,Oleander
Base Notes: Fig Wood,Woody Notes,Oakmoss

title: Eliksiro Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Eliksiro Extrait de Parfum — Jeroboam is a sophisticated oriental-woody fragrance inspired by the timeless idea of a magical elixir or love potion—a captivating composition designed to intrigue, attract, and linger on the skin. Created by perfumer Vanina Muracciole, the fragrance contrasts radiant citrus freshness with creamy woods, sensual florals, dark oud, leather, and velvety fruit. It opens with mandarin, guaiac wood, and saffron, creating a vivid and juicy introduction with warm spicy and creamy woody facets. At its heart, leather, oud, cardamom, jasmine, pink pepper, ozone, and rose create a rich and contrasting accord where dark woods and supple leather meet luminous florals and airy freshness. As the fragrance settles, sandalwood, raspberry, white musks, patchouli, amber woods, and vanilla create a smooth, warm, and sensual base with a velvety gourmand sweetness. Mysterious, elegant, and magnetic, Eliksiro embodies Jeroboam's interpretation of a modern olfactory love potion.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Mandarin,Guaiac Wood,Saffron
Heart Notes: Leather,Oud,Cardamom,Jasmine,Pink Peppercorn,Ozone,Rose
Base Notes: Sandalwood,Raspberry,White Musks,Patchouli,Amber Woods,Vanilla

title: Pearl of Dawn Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Pearl of Dawn Extrait de Parfum — Fabbrica Della Musa is a refined floral-fruity gourmand fragrance inspired by the delicate beauty of porcelain—pure, luminous, precise, and shaped through patience and craftsmanship. The composition translates the quiet elegance and soft lustre of porcelain into a warm and comforting olfactory experience. It opens with rum, apple, and orange, creating a bright fruity accord enriched by a gentle boozy warmth. At its heart, orris, white chocolate, and jasmine create a powdery, creamy, and luminous floral-gourmand character. As the fragrance settles, tonka bean, cinnamon, vanilla, and cashmere wood create a soft, warm, and enveloping base with a refined sweetness. Elegant, delicate, and quietly luxurious, Pearl of Dawn celebrates craftsmanship, purity, and modern sophistication.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Rum,Apple,Orange
Heart Notes: Orris,White Chocolate,Jasmine
Base Notes: Tonka Bean,Cinnamon,Vanilla,Cashmere Wood

title: Perseveranza Parfum
body_html:
Perseveranza — Xerjoff is a refined, determined, and elegantly resilient fragrance that embodies quiet strength through a sophisticated blend of bright spices, aromatic woods, and warm ambered resins. Created as part of the 2026 collaboration between Xerjoff and Lamborghini, the composition reflects perseverance, precision, and unwavering focus. It opens with a vibrant fusion of ginger, cedrat, and pimento berry, creating an immediate sensation of sparkling freshness and spicy energy. The heart unfolds into a textured accord of vetiver, clove bud, and elemi, where earthy woods and aromatic spices add depth, character, and understated sophistication. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a rich base of tonka bean, styrax, and cistus oil, leaving a warm, smoky, and subtly ambery trail that feels confident, elegant, and enduring. The contrast between bright citrus-spice facets and the smooth resinous dry down creates a fragrance that is both uplifting and deeply grounded.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy, Amber

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Ginger, cedrat, pimento berry
Middle notes: Vetiver, clove bud, elemi
Base notes: Tonka bean, styrax, cistus oil (labdanum)

title: Fierezza Parfum
body_html:
Fierezza — Xerjoff is a bold, refined, and proudly distinctive fragrance created in collaboration with Lamborghini, embodying confidence, craftsmanship, and Italian excellence through an elegant interplay of spices, florals, marine nuances, and rich resins. It opens with a vibrant blend of pink pepper, Sichuan pepper, davana, and incense, creating an immediate sensation of energy, sophistication, and magnetic intensity. The heart unfolds into a unique accord of geranium, frangipani, ambrette, and marine notes, where floral softness meets airy freshness, adding depth and modern elegance to the composition. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a rich base of amber, myrrh, and suede, leaving a warm, leathery, and long-lasting trail that feels luxurious, confident, and unmistakably sophisticated.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fresh, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Pink pepper, Sichuan pepper, davana, incense
Middle notes: Geranium, frangipani, ambrette, marine notes
Base notes: Amber, myrrh, suede

title: Avanguardia Parfum
body_html:
Avanguardia — Xerjoff is a bold, sophisticated, and contemporary fragrance that celebrates innovation through a refined blend of aromatic freshness, spices, and elegant woods. Created as part of Xerjoff’s Blends collection, it opens with a vibrant burst of citrus and aromatic accords, creating an immediate sensation of energy, clarity, and modern refinement. The heart unfolds into a smooth composition of spicy and herbal nuances enriched with subtle floral facets, adding depth, texture, and a polished sophistication that feels both dynamic and effortlessly elegant. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a rich base of woods, amber, musk, and smoky undertones, leaving a warm, refined, and long-lasting trail that feels confident, contemporary, and unmistakably luxurious.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Citrus accords, aromatic nuances
Middle notes: Spicy accords, herbal facets, subtle florals
Base notes: Woods, amber, musk, smoky undertones

title: Harem Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Harem Rose Eau de Parfum — Fort & Manlé is a luxurious floral fragrance inspired by the timeless art of seduction and the sensual beauty of the rose. The composition centers around the softness of Damascene rose, enriched by warm amber, velvety cashmere, creamy vanilla, and the earthy depth of vetiver. It opens with the lush elegance of rose, creating a soft and silky floral introduction that immediately evokes the atmosphere of an intimate garden. At its heart, amber, benzoin, and vanilla bring warmth and sensual richness, while cashmere adds a smooth, velvety texture. As the fragrance settles, woods, musk, and vetiver create a warm and subtly earthy foundation that complements the rich floral character. Elegant, sensual, and enveloping, Harem Rose Eau de Parfum is a refined interpretation of rose that captures beauty, intimacy, and quiet seduction.

Fragrance Family: Floral

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Rose
Heart Notes: Amber,Benzoin,Vanilla
Base Notes: Cashmere Woods,Musk,Vetiver

title: Milky Bar Kid Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Milky Bar Kid Eau de Parfum — RASEI FORT is a creamy gourmand fragrance inspired by childhood innocence and the simple joy of a sweet treat. The composition combines the richness of white chocolate and the golden sweetness of ripe mango with the comforting warmth of milk, creating a soft and nostalgic olfactory experience. It opens with lemon, violet, milk, and white chocolate, creating a bright yet creamy introduction with delicate floral and milky facets. At its heart, iris, orris butter, roasted cocoa, and mango create a velvety gourmand accord, balancing powdery elegance with rich cocoa and tropical fruit. As the fragrance settles, vanilla, musk, and sandalwood create a smooth, warm, and comforting base that lingers softly on the skin. Nostalgic, creamy, and irresistibly comforting, Milky Bar Kid Eau de Parfum captures the sweetness of childhood memories in a sophisticated contemporary fragrance.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand,Floral,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Lemon,Violet,Milk,White Chocolate
Heart Notes: Iris,Orris Butter,Roasted Cocoa,Mango
Base Notes: Vanilla,Musk,Sandalwood

title: Rose Otto Mobil Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rose Otto Mobil Eau de Parfum — RASEI FORT is a romantic floral fragrance inspired by a moonlit night in Bulgaria, where endless fields of roses become the setting for an unexpected story of love and nostalgia. The fragrance tells the tale of Swenford Gulsevenskis, whose broken-down Bedford became an unlikely sanctuary while transporting freshly harvested Bulgarian rose otto petals. It opens with spices, tuberose, and tomato leaf, creating an intriguing green and spicy introduction with creamy floral nuances. At its heart, Rose Otto, dried rose petals, and iris unfold into a velvety floral bouquet, emphasizing the richness and elegance of rose. As the fragrance settles, leather, amber, and metallic notes create a warm, textured base with an unexpected mineral edge. Romantic, atmospheric, and distinctive, Rose Otto Mobil Eau de Parfum is an olfactory portrait of passion, nostalgia, and roses blooming under the night sky.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Spicy,Leathery

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Spices,Tuberose,Tomato Leaf
Heart Notes: Rose Otto,Dried Rose Petals,Iris
Base Notes: Leather,Amber,Metallic Notes

title: Reina Del Mar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Reina Del Mar Eau de Parfum — RASEI FORT is an enigmatic aquatic-leather fragrance inspired by the legendary shipwreck resting in the depths of the Gulf of Mexico. The composition evokes the mystery of a pirate’s lost treasure, combining sparkling tropical fruit, salty marine nuances, warm spice, smoky tobacco, gunpowder, rich rum, and weathered woods. It opens with pineapple, salt, lemon peel, and cardamom, creating a bright and invigorating introduction where juicy fruit meets salty freshness and aromatic spice. At its heart, seaweed, birch tar, tobacco, and gunpowder create a dark, smoky, and maritime character, evoking the atmosphere of an aged vessel beneath the sea. As the fragrance settles, tonka bean, labdanum, rum, and oakwood create a warm, resinous, boozy, and woody base with remarkable depth. Mysterious, adventurous, and atmospheric, Reina Del Mar Eau de Parfum is an olfactory journey into maritime legends and the hidden treasures of the sea.

Fragrance Family: Aquatic,Leather,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Pineapple,Salt,Lemon Peel,Cardamom
Heart Notes: Seaweed,Birch Tar,Tobacco,Gunpowder
Base Notes: Tonka Bean,Labdanum,Rum,Oakwood

title: Annacamento Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Annacamento Eau de Parfum — Toskovat is a luminous fruity-gourmand fragrance inspired by the bittersweet beauty of summer memories, Mediterranean landscapes, and the melancholy of places and moments that can never be lived again. The fragrance evokes a journey through the Tyrrhenian coast, blending sparkling citrus and tropical fruit with creamy gourmand accords, aromatic herbs, and Mediterranean woods. It opens with orange, blood orange, prickly pear, and verbena, creating a bright, juicy, and refreshing introduction. At its heart, ricotta, rum, frangipani, broom, crêpes, and raisins create a creamy, boozy, fruity gourmand accord with a distinctive Mediterranean character. As the fragrance settles, cedar wood, oak wood, poplar buds, sea fennel, rock rose, mastic, and cypress create a green, resinous, woody base that adds depth and recalls the dry coastal landscape. Nostalgic, radiant, and beautifully bittersweet, Annacamento Eau de Parfum is an olfactory portrait of summers remembered rather than lived.

Fragrance Family: Fruity,Gourmand,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Orange,Blood Orange,Prickly Pear,Verbena
Heart Notes: Ricotta,Rum,Frangipani,Broom,Crêpes,Raisins,Dryad’s Dust
Base Notes: Cedar Wood,Oak Wood,Poplar Buds,Sea Fennel,Rock Rose,Mastic,Cypress

title: Ichigo Ichie Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ichigo Ichie Eau de Parfum — Toskovat is a sophisticated floral-fruity fragrance inspired by fleeting moments, lost memories, and the beauty found in the passing of time. Its name evokes the Japanese philosophy of ichigo ichie—the idea that each encounter is unique and can never be repeated. The composition captures this emotional theme through sparkling fruits, delicate blossoms, creamy powdery nuances, aromatic tea, and soft woods. It opens with buntan, hibiscus, nashi pear, ume fruit, sakura, and cream soda, creating a bright, playful introduction that combines juicy fruit with sparkling sweetness. At its heart, hydrangea, angel trumpet, tiger lily, orris root, water lily, black tea, steam, and oshiroi powder create an airy, powdery floral accord with a subtle tea-like depth. As the fragrance settles, hinoki, redwood, bleeding heart, rooibos tea, musk, amber, incense, and silk create a warm, smooth, and intimate base. Poetic, nostalgic, and delicately unconventional, Ichigo Ichie Eau de Parfum transforms fleeting memories into an elegant olfactory experience.

Fragrance Family: Floral,Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Buntan,Hibiscus,Nashi Pear,Ume Fruit,Sakura,Cream Soda
Heart Notes: Hydrangea,Angel Trumpet,Tiger Lily,Orris Root,Water Lily,Black Tea,Steam,Oshiroi Powder
Base Notes: Hinoki,Redwood,Bleeding Heart (Dicentra),Rooibos Tea,Musk,Amber,Incense,Silk

title: Empty Wishes Well Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Empty Wishes Well Eau de Parfum — Toskovat is an evocative earthy-aromatic fragrance that explores the melancholy of forgotten wishes, abandoned places, and the quiet hope that remains after everything has seemingly dried up. Part of Toskovat’s Eau de Mémoire collection, the fragrance was launched in 2022 and was created by David-Lev Jipa-Slivinschi. Its composition evokes the atmosphere of a forgotten well, where rain, stone, fallen leaves, herbs, and damp earth create a hauntingly beautiful landscape. Toskovat currently lists Empty Wishes Well within its Eau de Mémoire collection.

It opens with metallic notes, creating a cold, mineral introduction reminiscent of an old rusty coin. At its heart, rain notes, stone, dried fallen leaves, sage, and myrrh create a damp, atmospheric character with aromatic and resinous depth. As the fragrance settles, earthy notes, patchouli, Java vetiver oil, Haitian vetiver, galbanum, amyris, and carrot seeds create a green, woody, and deeply earthy base that evokes wet soil and forgotten vegetation.

Fragrance Family: Earthy,Aromatic,Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Metallic Notes
Heart Notes: Rain Notes,Stone,Dried Fallen Leaves,Sage,Myrrh
Base Notes: Earthy Notes,Patchouli,Java Vetiver Oil,Haitian Vetiver,Galbanum,Amyris,Carrot Seeds

title: Amaretto In The Melting Room Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Amaretto In The Melting Room Extrait de Parfum — Toskovat is a rich oriental-spicy gourmand fragrance that explores the warmth of amaretto through an unconventional blend of sweet bread, juicy fruit, candle wax, resinous labdanum, honeycomb, vanilla, tobacco, and tonka. Created by perfumer David-Lev Jipa-Slivinschi and launched in 2025, this unisex composition forms part of Toskovat’s Betrayal Collection.

It opens with a curious combination of bread, peach, stone, and orange peel, creating a warm, fruity introduction with a distinctive baked quality. At its heart, amaretto, candle wax, sugar syrup, and labdanum create a rich, boozy-sweet and resinous accord with an intriguing tactile character. As the fragrance settles, honeycomb, vanilla, tobacco, and tonka bean create a deep, creamy base that leaves a warm, indulgent, and long-lasting trail. Sweet, atmospheric, and unconventional, Amaretto In The Melting Room Extrait de Parfum transforms familiar gourmand sensations into a uniquely evocative Toskovat creation.

Fragrance Family: Oriental,Spicy,Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bread,Peach,Stone,Orange Peel
Heart Notes: Amaretto,Candle Wax,Sugar Syrup,Labdanum
Base Notes: Honeycomb,Vanilla,Tobacco,Tonka

title: In The Belly of The Beast Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
In The Belly of The Beast Extrait de Parfum — Toskovat is a dark marine-woody fragrance that explores the mysterious depths of the sea through an unconventional blend of salty aquatic accords, smoked leather, exotic fruits, resins, natural oud, and weathered woods. Inspired by shipwrecks, abyssal depths, and the resilience of those who survive them, this intense composition creates an olfactory journey through an unfamiliar underwater world. It opens with Sweetie (Oro Blanco), sea water, mulberry, leather, and saffron, creating a striking contrast between juicy fruit, salty freshness, smoky leather, and warm spice. At its heart, charas (hashish), copal resin, elemi resin, costus root, Hercules Club, lanolin, and immortelle create a complex resinous, earthy, smoky, and subtly animalic character. As the fragrance settles, shipwreck accords, ambergris, natural oud, Palo Santo, sequoia, driftwood, moss, lichen, and flowers from the Mariana Trench create a deep, mineral, woody, and marine base that evokes the remains of a vessel resting in the abyss. Mysterious, intense, and deeply unconventional, In The Belly of The Beast Extrait de Parfum is an immersive expression of the beauty and darkness hidden beneath the surface.

Fragrance Family: Marine,Woody,Animalic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Sweetie (Oro Blanco),Sea Water,Mulberry,Leather,Saffron
Heart Notes: Charas (Hashish),Copal Resin,Elemi Resin,Costus Root,Hercules Club,Lanolin,Immortelle
Base Notes: Shipwreck,Ambergris,Natural Oud,Palo Santo,Sequoia,Driftwood,Moss & Lichen,Flowers from the Mariana Trench

title: Oud Velvet Mood Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
OUD Velvet Mood Extrait de Parfum — Maison Francis Kurkdjian is a luxurious fruity-woody fragrance that evokes the sensation of sumptuous velvet caressing the skin. The composition brings together the plush, fleshy character of peach skin, the supple softness of delicate suede, and the deep, enveloping sensuality of oud wood. Its rich, tactile character creates an intimate fragrance experience inspired by the warmth of slow movement and the infinite embrace of a soft, luxurious fabric. Elegant, sensual, and deeply enveloping, OUD Velvet Mood Extrait de Parfum presents oud through a softer and more tactile interpretation, where fruity radiance meets suede-like smoothness and precious woods.

Fragrance Family: Fruity, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Peach Skin
Heart Notes: Suede
Base Notes: Oud Wood

title: White Blood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
White Blood Eau de Parfum — L’ENTROPISTE is a luminous fruity-floral fragrance that explores the hidden life of flowers through an imaginary bloom with opalescent petals. Created by perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour, this unisex composition transforms the idea of floral beauty into something fluid, iridescent, and alive, blending sparkling citrus, vibrant spice, juicy fruit, exotic florals, and sensual musks. It opens with black pepper and bergamot, creating a bright, crystalline introduction where electric spice meets solar citrus. At its heart, starfruit, tiaré, and pink lotus form a luminous floral-fruity accord, combining juicy freshness with delicate, creamy floral nuances. As the fragrance settles, vetiver, musk, and grey amber create a smooth, enveloping base with a refined woody and sensual character. Fresh, radiant, and intriguingly fluid, White Blood Eau de Parfum is a poetic interpretation of the living energy flowing through every flower.

Fragrance Family: Fruity, Floral, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Black Pepper,Bergamot
Heart Notes: Starfruit,Tiaré,Pink Lotus
Base Notes: Vetiver,Musk,Grey Amber

title: Replica Jazz Club Limited Eau de Toilette
body_html:
REPLICA Jazz Club Limited Eau de Toilette — Maison Margiela is a warm and sophisticated ambery-spicy fragrance that captures the intimate atmosphere of a private jazz lounge, where smoky tobacco, intoxicating rum, and creamy vanilla create an alluring sense of nighttime elegance. Presented as a limited-edition collector’s fragrance, it retains the signature Jazz Club composition while being housed in a distinctive deep blue and gold bottle inspired by Maison Margiela’s Sandstorm pattern. It opens with aromatic pink pepper, neroli, and Primofiore lemon, creating a fresh and subtly spicy introduction that evokes the lively atmosphere of a sophisticated jazz club. At its heart, rum absolute brings a rich, boozy sweetness, complemented by clary sage and Java vetiver for aromatic and earthy depth. As the fragrance settles, styrax resin, tobacco leaf absolute, and vanilla bean create a warm, smoky, creamy base that leaves an addictive and sensual trail. Sophisticated, smoky, and irresistibly warm, REPLICA Jazz Club Limited Eau de Toilette is an evocative expression of nocturnal elegance and the timeless atmosphere of a classic jazz lounge.

Fragrance Family: Ambery, Woody, Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Pink Pepper,Neroli,Primofiore Lemon
Heart Notes: Rum Absolute,Clary Sage,Java Vetiver
Base Notes: Styrax Resin,Tobacco Leaf Absolute,Vanilla Bean

title: Lucky Spray Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lucky Spray Eau de Parfum — Ramon Monegal is a sophisticated fragrance inspired by the lucky charm and the positive superstition surrounding fortune, confidence, and optimism. Part of the Katharsis collection, this captivating composition creates an olfactory ritual designed to evoke the feeling of being surrounded by good fortune. It opens with a fresh and luminous combination of bergamot, coconut water, and Cascalone, creating a sparkling aquatic-citrus introduction with an airy, invigorating character. At its heart, Damask rose, oud, and jasmine grandiflorum unfold with elegant floral richness, creating a sophisticated contrast between delicate petals and deep woody warmth. As the fragrance settles, amber pearl and a pheromonal musk cocktail create a smooth, sensual base that leaves a refined and captivating trail. Radiant, optimistic, and distinctive, Lucky Spray Eau de Parfum is a contemporary expression of confidence, illusion, and security.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Woody, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot,Coconut Water,Cascalone
Heart Notes: Damask Rose,Oud,Jasmine Grandiflorum
Base Notes: Amber Pearl,Pheromonal Musk Cocktail

title: Dopamine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dopamine Eau de Parfum — Ramon Monegal is a vibrant fruity-floral fragrance inspired by the euphoric rush of happiness, motivation, pleasure, and the instinctive desire for more. Part of the Katharsis collection, this captivating composition transforms the idea of dopamine into an energetic olfactory experience designed to awaken the senses and inspire spontaneity. It opens with a juicy and exhilarating combination of mango, raspberry, and pineapple, creating a bright tropical introduction filled with vibrant sweetness and freshness. At its heart, ylang-ylang, cyclamen, and Helional unfold with luminous floral and airy aquatic nuances, adding freshness and emotional intensity to the composition. As the fragrance settles, vanilla musk, oakmoss, and Ambroxan create a smooth, sensual base that leaves a warm, addictive, and long-lasting trail. Energetic, euphoric, and irresistibly vibrant, Dopamine Eau de Parfum is a contemporary expression of pleasure and uninhibited emotion.

Fragrance Family: Fruity, Floral, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Mango,Raspberry,Pineapple
Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang,Cyclamen,Helional
Base Notes: Vanilla Musk,Oakmoss,Ambroxan

title: Yummy Jam Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Yummy Jam Eau de Parfum — Ramon Monegal is an indulgent oriental-vanilla fragrance that explores the irresistible harmony of rich gourmand accords, creamy textures, aromatic warmth, and smooth woods. Created for women and men, this captivating composition blends roasted coffee, velvety cocoa, luminous bergamot, and decadent vanilla into a luxurious fragrance with remarkable depth and sensuality. It opens with an enticing combination of coffee, cocoa, and bergamot, creating a vibrant introduction where bitter gourmand richness meets sparkling citrus freshness. At its heart, creamy lactones, tonka bean, and musk unfold with smooth, velvety warmth, adding a soft and enveloping character to the composition. As the fragrance settles, luscious vanilla, sandalwood, and burnt sugar create a deep, creamy, caramelized base that leaves an addictive and long-lasting trail of sweetness and sophistication. Indulgent, sensual, and unmistakably gourmand, Yummy Jam Eau de Parfum is a delicious expression of contemporary niche perfumery and the creative artistry of Ramon Monegal.

Fragrance Family: Oriental, Vanilla, Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Coffee, Cocoa, Bergamot
Heart Notes: Lactones, Tonka Bean, Musk
Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Burnt Sugar

title: In Paradise Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Lust in Paradise Extrait de Parfum — EX NIHILO is a luminous floral-musky fragrance inspired by the effortless glamour and sun-drenched beauty of the French Riviera. Presented in extrait concentration, this sophisticated composition combines vibrant fruits, fresh spices, radiant modern florals, and smooth woody-amber accords into an elegant fragrance with remarkable depth and refinement. It opens with a bright and subtly spicy accord of blackcurrant, pink pepper, Rosyfolia, and red ginger, creating a crisp introduction that blends juicy fruity facets with an invigorating aromatic lift. At its heart, Petalia, rose absolute, and jasmine sambac unfold into a luminous contemporary bouquet, combining delicate petal-like softness with graceful floral warmth. As the fragrance settles, Akigalawood and cedarwood introduce a refined woody dimension, while Ambrofix and musks create a smooth, ambery, and subtly sensual drydown that lingers beautifully on the skin. Radiant, elegant, and effortlessly sensual, Lust in Paradise Extrait de Parfum is a sophisticated expression of modern French perfumery and the irresistible spirit of the Riviera.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Musky, Woody
