Base notes: Musk, Civet, Vetiver, Suede, Incense, Tonka Bean and Patchouli

title: Lunatique Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Embrace your mysterious and hidden side with Lunatique Eau de Parfum. This alluring fragrance takes you on a journey of contrasts, from bright top notes to deep, enigmatic undertones. Refreshing juniper, pear, and bold Sichuan pepper top notes awaken your senses, while the heart reveals unexpected twists of iris, carrot, and neroli. The scent lingers with a sultry base of leather, oud, and ambergris, complimented by rich sandalwood and a touch of vetiver. The result is a magnetic and enigmatic scent that captures the essence of your complex personality.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sichuan Pepper, Juniper, Pear, Marigold and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Blackcurrant, Carrot, Frankincense, Iris, Cyclamen, Neroli and Ginger

Base notes: Leather, Oud, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Ambergris, Musk and Vetiver

title: B683 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The first perfume from Maison MARC-ANTOINE BARROIS, B683 was conceived in 2016 by perfumer Quentin Bisch. Its unique blend includes spicy touches of black pepper, chili, and saffron, as well as subtle leather notes and violet leaves. The fragrance evolves into a warm and woody scent of sandalwood and patchouli, resulting in an elegant and sophisticated signature. This timeless classic has been reimagined by two gifted young designers.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Black Pepper, Nutmeg and Red Chilli Pepper

Middle notes: Violet Leaf, Musk, Labdanum and Amber

Base notes: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Oakmoss

title: Rouge Chaotique Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Rouge Chaotique Extrait de Parfum, the first oud gourmand fragrance in our Night Veils collection. Inspired by creatives embracing chaos, this scent blends oud with indulgent gourmand notes for a unique olfactory experience. Embrace your inner chaos with Rouge Chaotique.

Fragrance family: Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cassis, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Plum, Praline and Oak

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli and Papyrus

title: Crush On Me Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing "Crush On Me," a powerful and alluring unisex fragrance. With notes of caramel and patchouli perfectly balanced for a captivating scent. Experience ultimate luxury with "Crush On Me."

Fragrance family: Sweet, chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger and Lime

Middle notes: Floral Notes

Base notes: Caramel and Patchouli

title: Beverly Hills Exclusive Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience luxury with Beverly Hills Exclusive Extrait de Parfum. Inspired by the opulence of Beverly Hills, this unisex fragrance captures the essence of the iconic city with honey, tobacco, and tonka bean scents. Its long-lasting freshness and exquisite blend make it perfect for any occasion. Discover the ultimate in fragrance luxury today.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Clary sage, Cardamom, Rose

Middle notes: Orris, Honey, Tobacco

Base notes: Tonka bean, Ambergris, Sandalwood

title: Darling Nikki Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the thrill of the unknown with Vilhelm Parfumerie's Darling Nikki Eau de Parfum. With a blend of black pepper, saffron, leather, and Sicilian tangerine, this fragrance captures the excitement and anticipation of secret parties. Let the smoky and spicy notes transport you to a world of mystery and intrigue.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper, Sicilian Mandarin and Cassis

Middle notes: Indian Saffron and Lotus

Base notes: Smoke, Woody Notes and Leather

title: The Oud Affair Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Oud Affair Eau de Parfum is a captivating fragrance that takes inspiration from the passionate love affair between actress Ava Gardner and bullfighter Luis Miguel Dominguin. According to Dominguin, Gardner was both the most beautiful and the most fierce, a fierce wolf kept in a cage. This scent embodies the intense push and pull of their relationship, blending notes of Wild Honey, Ginger Butter, Tobacco Leaves, Agar Wood, and Black Vanilla Bean.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Honey and Ginger

Middle notes: Tobacco Leaf

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Vanilla

title: Smoke Show Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Immerse yourself in the captivating glamour of the Smoke Show Eau de Parfum. Let the vibrant spotlights, smoky rooms, and simmering jazz transport you to a bygone era of spellbinding verve. With simmering, spicy notes of agarwood, accented by pink pepper and saffron, and a center stage of leather and rose, this burning composition captures life's beautiful extremities.

Fragrance family: Leather, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Leather and Rose Oil

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vetiver and Cedar

title: Opus Kore Eau de Parfum
body_html:
According to Greek mythology, the goddess Kore, also known as Persephone, represents the essence of spring and fertility. This ignites the creation of Opus Kore Eau de Parfum, a dynamic and blossoming fragrance. The vibrant notes of Sicilian lemon and acai create an invigorating and lively aura. As time passes, the refreshing scents mellow, revealing a delicate floral essence. With prolonged wear, the perfume's alluring base of sandalwood, skin musks and amber is unveiled.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Acai Berry and Sicilian Lemon

Middle notes: Raspberry Bloom, Magnolia and Violet Leaves

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Amber

title: Dirty Velvet Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Drawing from Jan's love for Paris and his favorite hotel, Dirty Velvet Eau de Parfum is an elegant, sensual fragrance. Inspired by dimly lit, blooming halls and shadowed corridors, this perfume is perfect for those seeking refinement and sophistication. Let the rich and seductive scent take you on a motionless journey.

Fragrance family: Woody, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pomelo

Middle notes: Tobacco Leaf and Fig

Base notes: Vetiver, Salt and Sandalwood

title: Back To The Roots Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a moment of grace with Back To The Roots Eau de Parfum. Immerse yourself in a tranquil garden with fresh floral notes and deep, woody sensations. Let our Master Perfumer take you to a place of delicate harmony. Perfect for those seeking a pure and mystical charm.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Galbanum, Petitgrain, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Angelica

Middle notes: Orris Root, White Tea, Ginger and Violet

Base notes: Driftwood, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Chicago High Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Chicago High is a tribute to the classic perfumery of the 20th century. It aims to transport us back to the Roaring Twenties with its olfactory time machine. According to Jan Vilhelm, the creator, it captures the effervescent feeling of the era as it came to an end. But it also delves into the deeper meaning behind the glamour and luxury, revealing the rhyme and reason behind such indulgent pursuits. The fragrance is a sparkling blend of champagne and pineapple, with hints of honey and tobacco, finishing with a warm embrace of leather, amber, and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Champagne, Pineapple and Bergamot

Middle notes: Tobacco and Honey

Base notes: Leather, Amber and Patchouli

title: Replica Flying Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Replica Flying Eau de Parfum captures the essence of flight, transporting the senses beyond the clouds to a weightless, dizzying experience. Each fragrance in the Replica Fantasies collection features a unique, surreal ingredient crafted from the Perfumer's imagination, melding real materials for an otherworldly effect. Maison Margiela's Replica Flying centers around the Ozonic Cloud accord, evoking the sensation of soaring through the sky and breaching the clouds, with a fresh breeze against your face. As you come back down to earth, the fragrance transforms into a soft, ethereal landing on a fluffy cloud.

Fragrance family: CItrus, Aromaitc

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange Blossom, Bergamot and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Neroli Essence, Ylang-Ylang and Almond Blossom

Base notes: Ozonic notes, Musk and Moss

title: Replica Under the Stars Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the mystical aura of a starry night spent in the wilderness with the timeless blend of Oud essence and Labdanum resinoid notes in Under the Stars Eau de Toilette. Oud captures the enigmatic essence of the night, while Labdanum adds a warm, amber-like touch reminiscent of a gentle summer breeze on your skin. A raw and untamed leather accord further accentuates the wild nature of Under the Stars, while Black Pepper essence enhances the captivating feeling of immersing yourself in the great outdoors.

Fragrance family: Leather, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Labdanum

title: Day Dreams Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the endless daylight of warm summer nights in Greece with the scent of Day Dreams Eau de Parfum. Immerse yourself in the evocative aromas of Orange Blossom, Jasmine, and Mandarin, enhanced by the essence of Neroli, Tiare Flower, and Sandalwood. Let the fragrance transport you to a realm of Vanilla and Coconut with a surprising twist.

Fragrance family: Floral, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Tiare Flower, Jasmine and Neroli

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood and Coconut

title: Lucky Candy Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience a delicious surprise with Lucky Candy Eau de Parfum. The sweetness of marshmallow, coconut cream, and caramel is elevated by frangipani flower, amber, musk, and vanilla. Like drawing a tarot card, each note reveals a new layer of delectation. Make this your new lucky charm.

Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Honey and Cacao

Middle notes: Frangipani, Marshmallow, Neroli, Coconut and Lily of the Valley

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Toffee and Amber

title: Black Aoud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted with exquisite care, Black Aoud Eau de Parfum offers a regal experience through its masterful blend of pure agarwood extract and refreshing sandalwood. This unparalleled combination delivers unparalleled elegance and excitement fit for great kings.

Fragrance family: Rose, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose

Middle notes: Mandarin Orange, French labdanum

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Musk

title: Roses Musk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enchanting scent of Rose Musk perfume, a refreshing blend of fruit and musk that awakens your senses and satisfies even the most refined tastes. This indulgent fragrance contains a carefully selected group of ingredients that provide a feeling of comfort and tranquility, with the addition of calming oriental musk for a touch of elegance

Fragrance family: Rose, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jasmine

Middle notes: Musk

Base notes: Rose

title: Fabulous Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This luxurious oriental leather with a captivating hold captures a refined atmosphere. Recalling the exclusive moments and intimate exchanges that fulfill our desires, this fragrance can only be described in one way. Its bold name speaks for itself, while the lively beginning makes an immediate statement with clary sage and fresh lavender taking center stage. Delicious notes of bitter almond and vanilla add richness to the leather heart. Enveloped in orrisroot from the iris flower, the full, sumptuous body of the supple Italian plongereveals its stunning beauty. Addictive tonkabean and opulent leather lead the fragrance, as amber undertones provide a warm, vibrant glow. Exquisitely fine blonde woods create an air of pure luxury, ending with a creamy finish.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender and Clary Sage

Middle notes: Leather, Bitter Almond, Vanilla and Orris

Base notes: Leather, Tonka Bean, Cashmeran, White Woods and Amber

title: Neroli Portofino All Over Body Spray
body_html: Experience the freshness of the Italian Riviera with Neroli Portofino All Over Body Spray by Tom Ford. This zingy spray features a burst of Sicilian lemon, bitter orange, and mandarin, followed by soft white floral notes of African orange flower, jasmine, and neroli. Keep it in your purse for a quick pick-me-up throughout the day.

title: Rose Prick All Over Body Spray
body_html: Introducing Rose Prick All Over Body Spray by Tom Ford – a fragrant floral blend of Rose de Mai, Turkish, and Bulgarian breeds. Delight in the sharp, pristine scent as the piercing prickles of the stems intertwine, creating a pink perfection. Experience the wild bouquet of beautiful roses like never before.

title: Tuscan Leather All Over Body Spray
body_html: Experience the iconic Tuscan leather scent in a new way with Tom Ford's invigorating all-over body spray. The signature fragrance expertly balances leather and fruity, herbaceous accords, featuring top notes of raspberry, saffron, and thyme, combined with olibanum and jasmine at its heart. The rich, woody finish is further elevated by darker base notes of leather, suede, and amber.

title: Fabulous All Over Body Spray
body_html: Unlock the secret to a world of indulgence with Fabulous All Over Body Spray. This expertly crafted fragrance features an alluring blend of clary sage, fresh lavender, and bitter almond. An infusion of vanilla and orrisroot adds a touch of elegance to the supple Italian plonge leather, creating a luxurious body that is impossible to resist. The addictive blend is completed with tonka bean, lavish leather, and warm amber undertones. With its revolutionary 360 spray technology, this body spray can effortlessly cover every inch of your body, from your neck to your arms, legs, and torso. Formulated with the perfect concentration, this spray is the epitome of pure luxury.

title: Oud Wood All Over Body Spray
body_html: Experience the exotic, rare and precious fragrance of Oud Wood with this all-over body spray from Tom Ford. Immerse yourself in the smoky, woody, and lightly spiced notes of rosewood and cardamom, complemented by the warmth of amber and tonka bean. Perfect for refreshing and invigorating skin, this spray is ideal for everyday use.

title: Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum by Tom Ford offers a luxurious, sensuous interpretation of fine leather, featuring notes of olibanum, night blooming jasmine, and black suede for an elegant and refined fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Saffron and Thyme

Middle notes: Olibanum and Jasmine

Base notes: Leather, Suede, Woody Notes and Amber

title: Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious and captivating scent of Tom Ford's Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum. This expertly crafted fragrance combines crisp citrus oils, refreshing floral notes, and warm amber undertones to transport you to the serene paradise of the Italian rivera. Indulge in a truly transformative olfactory journey.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Lemon, Bitter Orange, Lavender, Rosemary and Myrtle

Middle notes: African Orange Flower, Neroli, Jasmine and Pitosporum

Base notes: Amber, Angelica and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

title: Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the delightful notes of Electric Cherry as the tartness of Morello cherry blends with spicy ginger and pink peppercorn, accompanied by jasmine sambac's entrancing floral scent. A touch of Ambrettolide adds a warm, musky finish. This playful and effervescent fragrance captures the excitement of a budding romance. Encased in a bright red flacon, this Tom Ford scent is perfect for displaying on your dresser or vanity.

Fragrance family: Musk, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cherry and Ginger

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Pink Pepper, Ambrettolide and Musk

title: Oud Wood Parfum
body_html:
Enhance your senses with the aromatic blend of Oud Wood Parfum. Immerse yourself in the refreshing notes of cardamom and pink pepper, intertwined with the essence of rosewood. A complex combination of patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver, and oud forms the base of this fragrance, accented by the warm tones of amber, tonka bean absolute, and vanilla. Encased in a sleek and elegant bottle, featuring a platinum-colored plaque, this scent is a true representation of the luxurious Private Blend collection.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Rosemary

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli and Vetiver

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka and Amber

title: Vanilla Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the rich and alluring scent of Tom Ford's Vanilla Eau de Parfum. Crafted with a blend of vanilla tincture and tonka absolute, this long-lasting fragrance also features a timeless foundation of sandalwood. Addictively glamorous, it makes the perfect signature scent for yourself or as a gift.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bitter Almond

Middle notes: Vanilla and Floral Notes

Base notes: Vanilla Absolute, Ultravanil, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood

title: A La Rose Hair Mist
body_html: Experience a delicate, feminine scent with Maison Francis Kurkdijan's À La Rose Scented Hair Mist. This unique hair mist features a beautiful blend of Damascena rose from Bulgaria and centifolia rose from Grasse, complemented by notes of honey, pear, and lychee. Its alcohol-free formula adds a healthy shine to hair without any added weight.

title: A La Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian introduces a new women's fragrance, exclusively available in the Japanese market. This scent, inspired by Marie Antoinette's love for roses and her portrait A La Rose by Louise Elisabeth Vigée-Lebrun, incorporates two types of roses, Damascus and Turkish rose absolute. A citrusy blend of bergamot, orange, and lemon adds a refreshing touch, while powdery floral notes and velvety violets create a delicate bouquet. The fragrance is completed with woody notes of cedar for added character.

Fragrance family: Rose, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot and California Orange

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Grasse Rose, Violet and Magnolia

Base notes: Musk and Cedar

title: 724 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
I Descending over the metropolis, 724 exudes a chic silhouette against the clear sky. Inspired by urban landscapes and modern architecture, this musky floral Eau de parfum's graphic aesthetic is evident. With a luminous and captivating scent, 724 embodies the city's pulse. Top notes include a crisp and urban accord of Italian bergamot and aldehydes with a slightly metallic effervescence. The heart of this fragrance carries an airy bouquet of Egyptian jasmine absolute, sweet pea, and mock orange. In the base, the whiteness of sandalwood and white musk bring a comforting enveloping sensation, completing this unique olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes and Calabrian bergamot

Middle notes: Egyptian Jasmine, Mock Orange and Sweet Pea

Base notes: White Musk and Sandalwood

title: Oud Satin Mood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This woody fragrance, Oud Satin Mood Eau de Parfum by Maison Francis Kurkdjian, is a unique blend of natural oud from Laos, rose essence, benzoin from Siam, and violet and vanilla accords.

Fragrance family: Oud, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Violet and Strawberry

Middle notes: Turkish Rose

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Amber, Benzoin, Cedar and Caramel

title: APOM Eau de Parfum
body_html:
APOM, short for 'A Part of Me', is a unisex fragrance created by Maison Francis Kurkdjian. Originally launched as two separate scents for men and women in 2009, perfumer Francis Kurkdjian has reimagined APOM to encompass the best aspects of both versions. Influenced by the perfumer's trip to Lebanon, APOM is a floral amber fougere that follows a classic structure with a contemporary twist. The radiant top note of orange blossom dissolves into the elegance of fragrant lavender, culminating in a seductive base of creamy amber, comforting white musk, and the joyful radiance of ylang-ylang.

Fragrance family: Floral, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange blossom

Middle notes: Lavender

Base notes: Ambery woody accord

title: Oud Silk Mood Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the luxurious blend of Oud Silk Mood Extrait de Parfum by Maison Francis Kurkdjian, featuring pristine bergamot from Italy, exotic blue chamomile from Morocco, and fragrant rose from Bulgaria, all enhanced by a base of Indian papyrus.

Fragrance family: Oud, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose

Middle notes: Chamomile, Papyrus

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud)

title: Dolce Melodia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A delectable fusion of fruity and flowery aromas with a sugary hint. The introduction of effervescent Mandarin, flavorful Saffron, and succulent orange alludes to a hidden intrigue. In the enchanting center, Rose entices with crispness, welcoming creamy white tones of Jasmine and Gardenia, as a delightful Blackcurrant emerges from obscurity. It encourages the sensuality of Sandalwood and Vanilla, while whispers of White Musk swirl in a rich base, allowing the sweetness to linger gently all day.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Orange and Saffron

Middle notes: Pear, Gardenia, Black Currant, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Sandalwood

title: Erba Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted with a masterful blend of rich woody, leathery, and smoky notes, Erba Leather Eau de Parfum exudes an effortlessly masculine allure. This fragrance harmoniously combines succulent, charming notes with bold, sensual accents inspired by the robust essence of music. The scent opens with a mouthwatering burst of fruity Passion fruit, solar Bergamot, and sharp Lemon, igniting the senses. The heart of the fragrance features alluring Sandalwood, leathery undertones, and delicate Jasmine, perfectly balanced by warm Oriental and Vetiver accords for a decadent foundation.

Fragrance family: Leather, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Leather, Jasmine and Sandalwood

Base notes: Leather, Amber and Vetiver

title: Anniversary Numbered Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Celebrate your special moments with Anniversary Edition Eau de Parfum. This Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men features top notes of Raspberry, Orange Blossom, and Bergamot, middle notes of May Rose, Tuberose, and Jasmine, and base notes of Amber, Patchouli, and Oakmoss. A delicate balance of fruity and floral scents, perfect for any anniversary.

Fragrance family: Rose, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Orange Blossom and Bergamot

Middle notes: May Rose, Tuberose and Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Patchouli and Oakmoss

title: Qatar Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Qatar Parfum, a luxurious Oriental Spicy fragrance for both men and women. Launched in 2017, this expertly crafted scent from Roja Dove features a bouquet of exquisite Rose de Mai, Jasmine, and Violet, complemented by a fruity blend of Pear and Peach. The addition of Cedar, Sandal, Cashmere, and Aoud Woods, along with spices like Clove and Saffron, adds warmth and depth. The fragrance is sublimated by a soft and sensual base of Benzoin, Vanilla, Orris, Styrax, and Birch, layered with Labdanum, Orientalgris, and Musk for a touch of mystery. A medley of Citrus Notes provides a refreshing counterpoint.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses

Middle notes: Peach, Pear, Rose de Mai, Violet and Jasmine

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Cotton Candy, Ambergris, Saffron, Benzoin, Styrax, Musk, Orris Root, Birch, Patchouli, Cashmere Wood, Labdanum, Sandalwood, Cloves, Vanilla and Cedar

title: United Arab Emirates Parfum
body_html:
The combination of Bergamot and Artemisia serves as a refreshing contrast to the collection of fragrant Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Geranium, and the prominent Rose Taif. The addition of Blackcurrant Buds adds another layer of freshness, while a mixture of Clove Buds, Pink Pepper, and Cumin brings liveliness to the scent. This overall blend is enhanced by the warmth of Guaiac and Aoud Woods, Patchouli, Oakmoss, and Cypriol, all resting on a soft and sensual base of Benzoin, Frankincense, Labdanum, Cistus, and Musk.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Artemisia and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose de Mai, Cloves, Geranium, Cassis, Labdanum, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Musk, Cumin, Guaiac Wood, Pink Pepper, Benzoin, Labdanum, Olibanum, Patchouli and Oakmoss

title: Elysium Eau Intense
body_html:
Elysium, a renowned name in the world of perfume, has been a global sensation since it was first introduced in 2017. Expanding on the success of Elysium, Roja Parfums is proud to introduce a new addition to the line: Elysium Eau Intense. This fragrance reimagines the beloved Elysium accord, providing an even more invigorating experience. With its uplifting scent, it will transport you to a paradise of clear blue waters and endless skies.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rhubarb, Grapefruit, Lime, Bergamot, Artemisia, Musk, Thyme and Lavender

Middle notes: Black Currant, Orange Blossom, Lily of the Valley, Apple, Tuberose, Jasmine and Rose de Mai

Base notes: juniper berry, Vetiver, Musk, Dry Wood, Cedarwood, Galbanum, Violet Leaf, Black Pepper, Vanilla, Ambergris, Benzoin, Labdanum, Leather and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: Enigma Essence De Parfum
body_html:
The delicate, powdery fragrances of Orris and Musk intermingle with a central note of elegant Rose de Mai. But appearances can be deceiving as a burst of succulent Peach - nature's forbidden fruit - teases at a deeper, more mysterious undertone. Beneath this portrayal of refined femininity, a complex and exotic essence emerges from the shadows. A damp, earthy hint of Patchouli adds a carnal edge to the sensuality of Sandalwood, which is elevated to an intoxicating level with the animalistic allure of Ambergris. Both familiar and enigmatic, the elusive nature of this woman is the true Enigma.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: May Rose, Peach, Heliotrope, Ylang-Ylang, Geranium, Neroli and Jasmine

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood, Orris, Ambergris and Patchouli

title: 51 Essence De Parfum
body_html:
With the Roja Parfums boutique located at 51 Burlington Arcade, Mayfair's most iconic address, the 51 Essence De Parfum captures the essence of the store's prestige and charm. This scent delights with a blend of juicy Raspberry, delicate Rose, Jasmine, and Lily, all balanced by a smooth note of Vanilla. Its elegance and liveliness pay homage to the luxurious and mysterious world of The Burlington Arcade.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Raspberry, Gardenia, Orange Blossom, Tuberose, Lily-of-the-Valley, Lily, Jasmine and May Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Benzoin, Cashmere Wood, Sandalwood, Orris, Violet, Cinnamon, Anise, Clove and Patchouli

title: Elixir Essence De Parfum
body_html:
Elixir Essence De Parfum is a magical fragrance that transforms you into a goddess. With just one drop, feel irresistible, confident, and seductive. Exude effortless sensuality and light up a room. Get what you want with this powerful elixir.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Raspberry, Rose de Mai, Peach, Violet, Heliotrope, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Geranium and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Orris, Cashmere Wood, Violet Leaf, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Sandalwood, Cedar and Cinnamon

title: Apex Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Focusing on the beauty of nature and all living beings, Apex Eau de Parfum is a refreshing, fruity scent with spiritual and sensual undertones. A burst of tangy citrus at the start creates an invigorating sensation, while Mandarin and pineapple add a sunny touch, promoting positivity and motivating us to reach our goals. The fragrance is grounded in earthy tones of patchouli, fir balsam, galbanum, cypress, and oakmoss, evoking the feeling of being in the great outdoors. A blend of sacred ingredients such as sandalwood and frankincense honor the gifts of the earth, while animalic notes of leather, ambergris, and musk add a sensual touch to this irresistible new fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

title: Danger Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance is not only dangerous for the wearer, but also for those who catch its scent. With Aromatic Lemon, Lavender, and Tarragon, it emits a refreshing and enticing aroma, but be cautious because seductive aphrodisiacs are hidden in its depths, tempting you to take a deeper breath. The sweetness of Vanilla and Jasmine is counterbalanced by the dry, earthy notes of Cedarwood and Patchouli, luring you closer and making it hard to resist. Keep in mind the warning - you have been forewarned.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Lemon, Bergamot and Tarragon

Middle notes: Violet, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Cumin, Oakmoss, Vanila, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Musk, Ambergris, Leather, Clove, Woody Notes, Vetiver, Cedar, Rhubarb and Galbanum

title: Amber Aoud Parfum
body_html:
This exquisite parfum is expertly crafted using the finest Gum Resins from the Middle East and the exotic note of Aoud. The result is a soft and sensual scent that carries a rich history of perfumery. Expertly curated by Roja Dove, this parfum is a true luxury.

Fragrance family: Amber, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lime and Lemon;

Middle notes: Rose, Fig, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Ambergris, Saffron, Cinnamon, Civet, Sandalwood, Orris Root, Birch, Musk, Oakmoss and Patchouli

title: Elysium Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Elevate your fragrance game with Roja's Elysium Eau de Parfum - an exquisite fusion of citrus notes like lemon, bergamot, grapefruit, and lime, balanced with a touch of Lavender and thyme. The heart of this scent boasts a harmonious combination of floral and fruity scents, including lily of the valley, Rose de Mai, and apple, all resting on a luxurious base of vetiver, cedarwood, vanilla, leather, and musk. Immerse yourself in this refined blend and exude confidence like a true modern man

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Lemon, Bergamot, Lime, Thyme, Artemisia and Galbanum

Middle notes: Vetiver, Juniper Berries, Black Currant, Apple, Pink Pepper, Cedar, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Ambergris, Leather, Vanilla, Benzoin and Labdanum

title: Ibiza laislablanca Eau de Toilette
body_html:
The island's beauty shines through its luminous light, crystal clear waters, and omnipresent white hues. It's a pristine canvas that inspires the most daring of artistic combinations. Combining white musk with salt water and Mediterranean pine balsam, the fragrance is enveloped by a sea of white almond flowers.

Fragrance family: Woody, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pine needles, Dates and Black Currant

Middle notes: Almond Blossom, Heliotrope and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Sandal, Guaiac Wood and Incense

title: Ibiza Sunsetcafe Eau de Toilette
body_html:
This is a freshly launched fragrance titled sunsetcafe. It is an Oriental Floral scent crafted by the hands of expert perfumer Ramon Monegal. The top layer comprises of Seaweed, Coconut, and Coffee notes, while the heart is enriched with Strawberry, Jasmine, and Rose. The base notes include the comforting blend of Amberwood, Oakmoss, and Musk.

Fragrance family: Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Seaweed, Coconut and Coffee

Middle notes: Strawberry, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Amberwood, Oakmoss and Musk

title: Hazy Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As the sun rises and the light begins to break through the darkness, the wild rose's silhouette becomes hazy against the growing warmth. The dew on its petals evaporates in the heat, giving the flower a whimsical aura that dances in the morning breeze. As an expert in this field, I am drawn to the curiosity of approaching and indulging in the queen's unique scent as she wakes. My instinct leads me to the perfect moment when her heart is exposed and I can capture the essence of her existence between the dew and the dim.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Cashmeran and Indian Ginger

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Pink Pepper and Virginia Cedar

Base notes: Oakmoss, Musk and Siam Benzoin

title: Ole Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This perfume, Ole Eau de Parfum, is the perfect fusion of folklore and Spanish art. It captures the journey of self-affirmation that is sparked by the wonder and admiration inspired by art. It brings about moments of euphoria and complete fulfillment, creating a powerful emotional experience. It is a manifesto to art, freedom, passion, disinhibition, provocation, imagination, originality, emotion, joy, and life.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Raspberry and Dates

Middle notes: Cedar, Jasmine and Orchid

Base notes: Balsam Fir, Musk and Vanilla

title: Soul Of Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The Soul Of Oud Extrait de Parfum combines powerful and enticing essences, such as wild Oud wood, birch leaves, and osmanthus flower, layered on a musky and chocolatey base. This scent is enhanced by the grounding effect of vetiver roots, making it a legendary and seductive fragrance. Experience the quintessence of Oud in this captivating and mythical scent.

Fragrance family: Oud, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dark Chocolate, Nutmeg, Coriander, Chocovan

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol, Rose, Osmanthus

Base notes: Vetiver , Amber, Musk, Vanilla

title: Ibiza Allnightlong Eau de Toilette
body_html:
The transformation commences as the lemon cocktail, piña colada, cascalone, and mint cream take the stage. The heliotrope then dazzles with bursts of light, accompanied by a lively dance of jasmines and nerolis, until the break of dawn reveals a blend of mosses, musks, and sandalwoods.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Mint and Lemon

Middle notes: Patchouli, Jasmine and Heliotrope

Base notes: Salt, Musk, Vanilla and Oakmoss

title: Alhambra Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The Alhambra in Granada is a historic site known for its cultural significance, having been designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984. It served as the royal palace from the 11th century and is a key representation of Al-Andalus. I can almost envision the rich, intense aroma of Oud wafting through the grand halls and palaces, just like a daydream brought to life. This luxurious scent, inspired by Assam Vintage Oud, is captured in its purest form.

Fragrance family: Oud, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Agarwood (Oud), Apple and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Ambroxan and Birch

title: 17/17 Homme Anniversary Parfum
body_html:
The 17/17 Homme Anniversary Parfum collection by Xerjoff draws inspiration from the semi-precious stones showcased at London's Natural History Museum. As a result, the exquisite flacon features a one-of-a-kind grey mother of pearl stone, encased in meticulously designed gold-leaf accents.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tarragon, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Leather, Clove, Orange Blossom and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Candied Fruits, Styrax, Moss and Vanilla

title: Newcleus Parfum
body_html:
Newcleus Parfum introduces a groundbreaking, alcohol-free scent featuring innovative encapsulation technology. The precious alginate spheres release its elegant and soothing fragrance upon application, providing a refreshing and calming experience. With its delicate floral blend of soft rose petals and gourmand undertones of vanilla, white musk, and rich caramel, this perfume embodies luxury and pushes the boundaries of traditional perfumery. Perfect for summer and sensitive skin, Newcleus comes in a stunning Xerjoff flacon, a true piece of art with its unique, pearly, shimmering appearance.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose Petals, Milk and Green Notes

Middle notes: Caramel, Rose Petals and White Musk

Base notes: Rose Petals, White Musk, Vanilla and Sandalwood

title: La Capitale Parfum
body_html:
Experience the irresistible blend of sweet and powdery notes in La Capitale Xerjoff. With a refreshing combination of strawberry, peach, and caramel, this oriental aromatic fragrance will take you on a sensual journey through warm and inviting ingredients. The heart of the scent features Iranian saffron, ginger, rose, and amber, creating an intoxicating spell that leads to a classic base of oud and vanilla bourbon, further enticing the senses.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Strawberry, Caramel, Peach and Labdanum

Middle notes: Leather, Amber, Saffron, Ginger and Rose

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla and Benzoin

title: Lira Hair Mist
body_html: Lira Hair Mist is a fragrant and refreshing hair mist that infuses your hair with a luxurious, sweet, and sensual scent. It typically combines notes of citrus, florals, and warm vanilla or caramel undertones, creating an indulgent and irresistible aroma. Besides providing an elegant fragrance, Lira Hair Mist is designed to leave hair feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated, making it a great way to enhance your haircare routine with a subtle, lasting scent.

title: Musk Therapy Hair Perfume
body_html: Discover serenity with Musk Therapy Hair Perfume by Initio, a tranquil and alluring scent that envelops your hair in a harmonious aura. This captivating fragrance perfectly balances peace and mystery, providing a comforting and irresistible experience. Formulated with hydrating elements, it nourishes and conditions your hair, while the subtle musk aroma lingers with every sway. Apply directly onto your hair or brush it through for a long-lasting, undetectable infusion of olfactory delight. Allow yourself to indulge in the contradiction of calmness and addiction with each irresistible spritz of this hair perfume.

title: Oud for Greatness Hair Perfume
body_html: Discover your true potential with Initio Oud For Greatness Hair Perfume, an empowering fusion of boldness and enigma that captivates with every step. This alluring scent envelops your hair in a captivating presence, leaving a trail of grandeur and invincibility in your wake. Enriched with nourishing elements, it leaves your locks smelling heavenly while keeping them hydrated and silky smooth. Elevate your greatness with every spray and exude undeniable strength in every moment.

title: Paragon Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted using sacred plants such as white sage, this Paragon Extrait de Parfum offers a woody and vibrant aroma for daily wear. Infused with soothing bergamot and lavender top notes, it boasts plum and black pepper middle notes and a base of sandalwood and oud, promoting the wearer's physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being.

body_html:
The Initio Rehab Eau de Parfum presents a blend of woody and aromatic scents, with hints of patchouli and vanilla complemented by a core of lavender and tobacco for a uniquely refined and sophisticated aroma. The perfect choice for those seeking a one-of-a-kind fragrance experience.

This captivating scent from Clive Christian features Egyptian Jasmine as its main note, evoking the fiery romance of Cleopatra and Marc Anthony. A harmonious combination of bergamot, summer fruits, and rhubarb provides a tart contrast to the subtle sensuality of cashmere and cedarwood, resulting in a seductive and alluring fragrance.

Perfect for evening wear, this long-lasting fragrance has a 25% perfume concentration and is characterized by powdery notes, a creamy woody base, and a refreshing hint of citrus. Elevate your perfume collection with this alluring blend.

Experience the mystique of Asia with every spritz of Tam Dao Eau de Parfum. Immerse yourself in the lush jungle with precious Goa Sandalwood, dry cedar, exotic spices, and warm amber. Let the memories of this enchanting region come alive with every note.

Discover the captivating journey of Bitter Splash Eau de Parfum. Bright pomelo and vegetal leather combine for a unique balance of freshness and sensuality. With powdery iris and earthy vetiver, this elegant tribute to orientalism is encased in a striking pop-yellow bottle. A vibrant blend of tradition and modernity.

Immerse yourself in a delicate and subtle scent that will surely leave a lasting impression.

The result is a unique and captivating scent that highlights the duality of femininity. With hints of birch, leather, patchouli, and styrax, this perfume is perfect for those who embrace both light and dark aspects of their personality.

body_html:
Narcisse Blanc reveals a striking contrast constantly oscillating between opposites. The freshness of orange blossom, bergamot, orange and petitgrain notes meet the woody notes of cashmere wood and vanilla. Two extremes with warm accents that reveal the Caron woman with a complex and magnetic character. This double-faceted woman is revealed through her heart with scents of jasmine, narcissus and rose.

Olfactive pyramid

Experience nature's beauty with Wild Bluebell Cologne. Luscious persimmon blends with delicate bluebells and fragrant lily of the valley, creating a vibrant and dewy aroma. This scent captures the essence of a shaded woodland, bringing freshness and brightness to your day.

title: Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense
body_html:
Throughout the Middle East, oud has been revered for centuries as a luxurious and inviting aroma. Perfumers have long distilled its intensely fragrant essence into various products. Jo Malone London pays tribute to this ancient tradition with their Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense Eau de Parfum, blending the rich notes of oud with vibrant, zesty bergamot. The result is an alluring fragrance, enriched with woody and citrus tones, accented by a subtle touch of black musk.

Fragrance family: Oud, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes:Black Musk

Base notes: Oud

body_html:
Experience the elegant and captivating scent of Aventus for Her Eau de Parfum. Indulge in the fresh and fruity notes of green apple and bergamot, complemented by the subtle spice of pink pepper. This luxurious fragrance also features a floral touch of ylang ylang and a warm, long-lasting base of peach, cassis, and amber. Elevate your senses with Aventus for Her.

    Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

    Olfactive pyramid

body_html:
Viking Eau de Parfum captures the daring essence of limitless exploration for the contemporary man who defies convention. Drawing inspiration from the intricately crafted longships, a defining innovation of the Viking Age and a remarkable achievement in design during the 9th century. A symbol of voyage and unwavering resolve, longships were meticulously constructed for the accomplished sailor who embodied relentless determination to triumph.

Olfactive pyramid
