Byredo has now incorporated this classic floral rose scent into their luxurious hair perfume. Appropriate for all hair types, this perfume provides a subtle yet long-lasting fragrance.

title: Mojave Ghost Hair Perfume
body_html: Infuse your hair with a delicate scent using Byredo's Mojave Ghost Hair Perfume. Experience luminous, nourished locks subtly perfumed with captivating notes of ambrette, sandalwood, and magnolia.

title: Black Saffron Hair Perfume
body_html: Imbue your hair with a delicate fragrance using Byredo's Black Saffron Hair Perfume. The saffron and juniper berry notes will leave your hair luminous, nourished, and gently perfumed.

title: Bibliotheque Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Discover a timeless world with one spritz, enveloping your neck in the alluring aroma of leather-bound books displayed on dark wood shelves. Bibliotheque Eau De Parfum is now available as an elegant and highly requested option, crafted by the expertise of Ben Gorham - Founder and Creative Director of Byredo.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum and Peach

Middle notes: Violet and Peony

Base notes: Leather, Patchouli, Vanilla and Musk

title: Gypsy Water Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Discover Gypsy Water, an ode to the vibrant Romani culture. With woody notes of pine and sandalwood, and a blend of amber and citrus, this fragrance evokes the wanderlust spirit of the nomadic lifestyle. Embrace the freedom and adventurousness of the gypsy way of living.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper, Lemon, Bergamot and Pepper

Middle notes: Pine needles, Incense and Orris Root

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood and Amber

title: Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the rich and alluring scent of Byredo's Black Saffron Eau de Parfum, drawing inspiration from the colorful essence of India. Combining juniper berries, black violet, and vetiver, this fragrance exudes a subtle yet captivating musk infused with exotic spices.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Juniper Berries and Chinese Grapefruit

Middle notes: Leather and Black Violet

Base notes:Raspberry, Cashmeran and Vetiver

title: Rose Omeyyade Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating and luxurious scent of Rose Omeyyade Eau de Parfum, inspired by the grandeur of the Umayyad dynasty and the opulence of Levant palaces. This intense and bewitching fragrance pays homage to sensuality and refinement, reminiscent of orientalist paintings. With velvety and woody notes, this unique creation exudes elegance and sophistication.

Fragrance family: Rose, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Raspberry and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Brown sugar, Patchouli and Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Sandalwood

title: Noir by Night Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Noir By Night offers a distinctive blend of textures and flavors that creates a striking juxtaposition between freedom and sensuality. This expertly crafted fragrance exudes confidence and elegance through its opulent fusion of silky caviar and lush woods. An intense opening of incense and coriander sets the stage for a night of intrigue, as a burst of unexpected scents engulfs the senses. The sleek combination of gaiacwood and sandalwood, infused with amber notes, delivers a radiant warmth with subtle nuances.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense and Coriander

Middle notes: Caviar, Mate and Dreamwood

Base notes: Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood and Cashmere Wood

title: Villa Primerose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Villa Primerose is a celebration of elegance as a refined way of life. In the early days of perfume-making, the most exquisite flowers were used to scent leather gloves worn by high-class women. Atelier Des Ors pays homage to this exceptional "savoir-faire" and reimagines the Rose-Leather pairing as a dynamic blend that elevates both scents. This contrast of aromas creates a unique duality, balancing delicacy and strength, masculinity and femininity, tradition and innovation. A masterful play on materials that unveils the leather instead of concealing it with the rose.

Fragrance family: Musk, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Pink Pepper and Cardamom

Middle notes: Rose, Ambrette and Iris

Base notes: Musk, Amberwood and Leather

title: Blue Madeleine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the power of olfactive memory with Blue Madeleine Eau de Parfum. Let the familiar scent transport you to long-forgotten memories, evoking intense emotions and sensations. This tribute to olfactory memory is a true indulgence for the senses.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes:Cinnamon, Pink Pepper and Bergamot

Middle notes: Black Tea, Milk and Rose

Base notes: Peru Balsam, Sandalwood, Cade oil and Praline

title: Wild Leather Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Unleash your inner wild with Wild Leather Le Vestiaire Des Parfums. This vibrant blend of Oriental sensuality and Parisian edginess will ignite your senses, with a seductive leather accord and a subtle hint of sweet smokiness. Experience the carnal addiction of this daring fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom, Geranium

Middle notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Patchouli, Black Pepper, Thyme, Bergamot

Base notes: Suede, Leather, Licorice, Saffron, Guaiac Wood

title: Capeline Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Discover Capeline, the sensual fragrance from Le Vestiaire des Parfums. This Eau de Parfum combines the sophistication of Moroccan lily with the smoothness of vanilla, creating an ode to the Couture House's broad-brimmed hats. Perfect for the poised and mysterious Saint Laurent woman.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Sea water and Neroli

Base notes: Vanilla Absolute, White Musk and Vetiver

title: Saharienne Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Discover the essence of adventure and freedom with Saharienne Le Vestiaire Des Parfums. Evoke the never-ending summer with its signature sandy hue and lightweight cotton fabric. Originally a symbol of liberation in the desert, this iconic safari jacket has been transformed by Monsieur Yves Saint Laurent for the urban explorer.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Petitgrain and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Neroli, Jasmine and Clary Sage

Base notes: Musk, Vetiver and Patchouli

title: Caban Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Caban perfume evokes a cozy tonka bean scent highlighted by bursts of vibrant pink pepper. The opulent minimalism of plush wool cloth, accented by a subtle sense of genuineness.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi, Pink Pepper and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Olibanum and Osmanthus

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Jumpsuit Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Jumpsuit, the vibrant fragrance from Le Vestiaire des Parfums. Inspired by Saint Laurent Couture, this scent captures the bold empowerment of the feminine spirit. With refreshing bergamot and luscious magnolia, Jumpsuit exudes confidence and freshness for a truly empowering experience.


Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach, Bergamot and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Magnolia, Peony and Jasmine

Base notes: White Musk and Sandalwood

title: Lavalliere Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Discover Lavallière, the latest scent with fruity and floral aromas, featuring a blend of rose and fig. Lavallière embodies the perfect fusion of masculine and feminine elements, creating a silky blend of creamy fig and sparkling blackcurrant, accompanied by a radiant rose note for a refreshing twist on the traditional floral scent. Named after the duchess of La Valliere, but originally inspired by men's fashion accessories, Lavallière is a gender-neutral fragrance that captures the essence of fluidity. Throughout history, Saint Laurent has elevated the Lavallière into the ultimate YSL accessory, and now in this fragrance, it pays homage to its origins with a fragrant tribute.


Fragrance family: Fruity, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Black Currant and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Geranium and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Vetiver and Cashmeran

title: Cuir Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
As rich, profound, and potent as leather at its darkest. Cuir captures the same duality that makes leather so captivating. A scent that combines the boldness of leather with the warmth of spices and the sophistication of woods, featuring Oud Assafi paired with a surprising contemporary twist: the violet leaf, which adds a touch of natural freshness and floral delicacy.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet Leaf

Middle notes: Oud

Base notes: Leather

title: Winter's Spring Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Winter's Spring Eau de Parfum Mimosa evokes feelings of optimism and joy as winter comes to an end. With its bright, powdery blossom pompons, this fragrance captures the first signs of spring. The scent features a refreshing burst of energy and light, achieved through a blend of Pepper and Musk for an instant sense of brightness.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mimosa

Middle notes: Musk

Base notes: Pepper

title: The Voice of the Snake Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Voice of the Snake Eau de Parfum is inspired by the fluid motion of a snake in the forest. Its alluring scent is centered around precious and enigmatic oud, symbolizing eternal beauty. As the snake coils among the dried Patchouli leaves, its leather-like scales leave behind a trail of saffron hues. The fragrance exudes a hypnotic intensity, much like the mesmerizing sound of the snake's voice.

Fragrance family: Oud, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Agarwood (Oud)

Middle notes: Saffron

Base notes: Patchouli

title: A Song for the Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A Song for the Rose Eau de Parfum, embodies the essence of absolute femininity through its carefully selected notes. The fragrance pays homage to the rose, known as the eternal queen, by blending it with sweet Musk and strong Woods notes, resulting in an olfactive duality and harmonious melody. Its alchemy symbolizes the regeneration of separated essences, bringing them together on a new level.

Fragrance family: Rose, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose

Middle notes: Musk

Base notes: Woody Notes

title: A Reason to Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the unique essence of Fall with A Reason To Love, the latest Eau de Parfum from The Alchemist’s Garden collection. Created by Gucci's Creative Director Alessandro Michele and Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, this fragrance features the alluring notes of Damascena Rose, Oud Accord, and Tolu Balsam. Let the delicate top notes of Damascena Rose, Peony, and Cardamom envelop you in a warm and inviting blend of floral and spice.

Fragrance family: Rose, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Damask Rose, Peony and Cardamom

Middle notes: Damask Rose and Agarwood (Oud)

Base notes: Tolu Balsam

title: 24 Old Bond Street Triple Extract Eau de Cologne
body_html:
The 200-year celebration of Atkinsons is marked by the release of Atkinsons 24 Old Bond Street Triple Extract eau de cologne. This fragrance is one of several commemorating this milestone, following the trilogy known as The Contemporary Collection, featuring modern interpretations of the three timeless perfume components: rose, green notes, and lavender. The collection includes Rose in Wonderland, Posh on the Green, and Lavender on the Rocks.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper and Cardamom

Middle notes: Whiskey and Rose

Base notes: Black Tea, Cedar, Ambergris and Musk

title: Blu Indaco Eau de Parfum
body_html:
With its contrasting aromas, Blu Indaco Eau de Parfum is a captivating scent that begins with the refreshing Bergamot of Calabria. The bittersweet almond and sweet vanilla create a harmonious blend in the opening, while the Frangipane heart adds a citrus and floral touch with notes of lemon, jasmine, honeysuckle, and rose. The base notes of Habanolide give off a sophisticated musky scent with a hint of waxiness and metallic undertones. This fragrance exudes strength, enveloping the senses with a clean, sensual, and almost erotic aura.

Fragrance family: Musk, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Frangipani and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Almond and Vanilla

Base notes: Musk and Ambroxan

title: Celeste Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the uplifting freshness of Celeste Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the bright and clear morning after a storm, this fragrance features vibrant citrus, refreshing aquatic notes, and invigorating florals. With its powerful and clean scent, it will leave you feeling confident and radiant all day long.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea water and Lime

Middle notes: Violet, Raspberry and Exotic floral notes

Base notes: Vanilla Sugar and Ambroxan

title: Shabby Chic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance offers a comforting and embracing experience, blending woody and floral scents for a delicate and refined aroma. Virginia cedarwood exudes a pleasant aura while Bulgarian Rose adds a subtle, sweet touch. The dominant note of Javanol, a modern sandalwood molecule, provides a creamy and slightly rosy undertone.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peony

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose and White Flowers

Base notes: Musk, Javanol and Cedar

title: Rosso Radice Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the fresh notes of Rosso Radice Eau de Parfum. This scent combines Calabrian bergamot, vetiver, and oak moss with ambrettolide and ambroxan for a warm, sensual fragrance. The addition of Muscenone and the Iso and Super molecule adds a soft, velvety texture, making it a long-lasting and exotic scent.

Fragrance family: Musk, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Clary Sage and Bergamot

Middle notes: Cashmeran

Base notes: Vetiver, Ambroxan and Ambrettolide

title: Scintilla Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Unleash your captivating power with Scintilla Nobile Eau de Parfum. The irresistible blend of fruity notes, Iris, Violet, and Jasmine creates a refined and magnetic aroma. As the scent evolves, it wraps you in a warm embrace of Patchouli, Timbersilk, and sophisticated amber notes. Conquer hearts with this unexpected and alluring fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iso E Super, Pineapple, Apple, Black Currant and Pear

Middle notes: Iris, Violet and Jasmine

Base notes: Iso E Super, oak moss, Pink Pepper, Patchouli and Amber

title: Colonia Nobile Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the perfect balance between freshness and elegance with Colonia Nobile Eau de Parfum. The delicate floral notes enhance the refreshing cologne scent, while the ambroxan and ambrettolide add a clean and musky depth to the fragrance. Experience a beautiful and velvety aroma with this timeless scent.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Petitgrain and Neroli

Middle notes: Benzoin and Jasmine

Base notes: Oakmoss, Ambroxan and Ambrettolide

title: Christos Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the evocative and mysterious world of Christos Eau de Parfum. A dynamic and ascetic fragrance, its blend of rare essences, resins, and spices creates a sensual and spiritual experience. Unleash your inner shaman with notes of Ciste, rose, and amber. Elevate your senses with Christos.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Amber Xtreme and Bergamot

Middle notes: Patchouli, Labdanum and Rose

Base notes: Incense, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Amber and Pink Pepper

title: Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow is a captivating and luxurious iteration of the original Soleil de Jeddah. Its initial notes of tangerine and incense create a swirl of fragrance before settling into a leathery Vanilla base. At its heart, the Orchid weaves delicate vines around the mythical Iris, attempting to tame its beauty. And in front of the Benzoin of Sumatra, the majestic Amber radiantly glows, leaving behind a trail of golden shimmer as it transitions into the night. Experience the magnificence and allure of Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow's rich and captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Amber, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Chamomile, Incense and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris Butter, Myrrh, Amber and Orchid

Base notes: Benzoin, Vetiver, Vanilla and Styrax

title: Isra & Miraj Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Isra & Miraj Eau de Parfum captures the mystical voyage through the Orient, with a journey under the moonlight and ascension to the 7th sky. This fragrance embodies the spiritual and transformative experience, offering a promise of hope, serenity, and personal growth. Each layer of this perfume is meticulously crafted with the finest ingredients, resulting in a scent that exudes perfection. Sensual and alluring, this fragrance blends warm Amber with the seductive Heliotrope flower and envelops the skin with the soft embrace of white and brown Musks.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Heliotrope and Osmanthus

Base notes: Vanilla, Ambergris, White Musk, Sandalwood, Agarwood (Oud), Leather and Patchouli

title: Poudre De Musc Intense Hair Mist
body_html: Poudre De Musc Intense Hair Mist is a new perfumed routine that delicately completes your trail and makes your hair silky and natural. It contains natural ingredients, with Provitamin B5 for softness and shine and hydrolyzed silk that sheathes the hair, adding volume.

title: Number One Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating blend of white flowers, tuberose, and sandalwood in Number One Intense Eau de Parfum. With its remarkable diffusion and professional recognition as the winner of the International Prize for perfumery, this scent truly embodies the expertise of Patricia de Nicolaï.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Marigold, Galbanum and Black Currant

Middle notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom, Black currant leaf and Rose

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber and Musk

title: Poudre de Musc Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Poudre de Musc Intense Eau de Parfum offers a floral heart of rose, hawthorn, and orange blossom enrobed in sandalwood and a bouquet of musks. Aldehydes add a touch of vibrancy to the musky tones. This fragrance is both gentle and alluring, leaving a captivating trail. An elegant and comforting choice for an Eau de Parfum.

Fragrance family: Aldehyde, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes

Middle notes: Rose, Orange Blossom and Hawthorn

Base notes: Musk and Sandalwood

title: Smokin' Gun Eau de Parfum
body_html:
For those seeking an unconventional campfire fragrance, Smokin' Gun Eau de Parfum is not your average choice. This unique scent transports you to a hidden speakeasy, enveloped in a powerful, almost medicinal, smoke, and infused with the essence of gunpowder. It starts off strong with a blend of bitter Campari, spiced rum, and sharp citrus notes, but underneath lies a deep, earthy smoke, reminiscent of heavily peated whisky.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Bitter Orange, Juniper and Campari

Middle notes: Incense, Whiskey, Leather, Cinnamon, Pine and Oak

Base notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Virginia Cedar and Sandalwood

title: Drunk Saffron Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The man sitting across the table caught her attention. As if sensing her gaze, he calmly made eye contact and smiled, while the person next to him said something in a hushed tone. Feeling flustered, she looked away. He suddenly got up and approached her. She nervously put down her cup and reached for the shot glass on the table, but he swiftly took it before she could. With a beady eye, she watched as he grinned, lifted the glass, and drank the contents, leaving behind a trace of her vividly stained lipstick.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum, Cognac

Middle notes: Saffron, Leather, Coffee

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk

title: Nanatopia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Nanatopia Eau de Parfum opens with a distinct aroma of banana bread, featuring overripe bananas that are perfectly caramelized. This is not just a simple fruit scent; it is a full-bodied, rum-soaked indulgence that is amplified by notes of nutmeg and cinnamon. Imagine the most exquisite banana bread, freshly baked and spiked with a deliciously mischievous ingredient. As the fragrance settles, it becomes surprisingly seductive, with creamy tonka bean adding a velvety richness and hints of cypriol and musk that leave a lingering, animalic essence on the skin. It offers a sweetness with a sultry edge, like a playful wink and smile after taking a deliciously messy bite. Nanatopia Eau de Parfum is the perfect choice for those seeking a playful experience with a sensual twist. If you believe that sweetness can also be sophisticated and indulgence can leave a lasting impression, then this is the scent for you.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rum, Cinnamon and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Banana, Caramel and Bread

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Orcanox

title: Sans Merci Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the bold, uncompromising scent of Sans Merci Eau de Parfum. Rare Essence of Davana and sophisticated Vetiver from Haiti combine for a powerful, assertive fragrance. Let the expertly crafted blend leave a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Davana

Middle notes: Haitian Vetiver

Base notes: Haitian Vetiver

title: Oiseau Rare Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In this Eau de Parfum, the exquisite Pittosporum Flower combines seamlessly with the luxurious Cedar Wood Essence, resulting in a scent that exudes unparalleled elegance. Part of the La Collection Particulière, these exceptional fragrances are expertly crafted from the finest materials and each represents the distinct savoir-faire of Maison Givenchy.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pittosporum

Middle notes: Pittosporum

Base notes: Cedar Wood Essence

title: Noctambule Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
At the stroke of midnight, Noctambule embodies its enigmatic essence in the Givenchy Hôtel Particulier. As the night owl leads the crowd to the boudoir, the fragrance remains a tribute to the iconic Centifolia Rose, hand-picked in May and captured in both Rose Essence and Rose Infusion. Beyond its elegant floral notes, this scent embraces an earthy vibe with the Papyrus Roots accord, complemented by the rich Malaysian Oud for a touch of animalic and woody tones. This bold and rebellious floral-woody blend is elevated by the spicy and vibrant notes of Pink Pepper and Cumin Essence.

Fragrance family: Oud, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grasse Rose, Pink Pepper and Cumin

Middle notes: Papyrus

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud)

title: Faux Semblant Eau de Parfum Intense
body_html:
Faux Semblant is described as an enigmatic presence emerging from the darkness of Givenchy's Hôtel Particulier, playing with the contrasts of shadow and light to create a captivating mystery. This fragrance's rich Essence of Australian Sandalwood amplifies the unexpected and intense facets of Orange Blossom Absolute. Beginning with a mystical Essence of Frankincense from Somalia, the scent reveals an opulent White Flower at its heart. Crossed by shades of gold, this floral note unveils the addictive radiance of the precious Amber notes of Miel de Provence. An elegant and warm trail follows, blending the richness of Sandalwood with the depth of Oud Wood Essence. The enigmatic elegance of this floral woody Eau de Parfum showcases the Oud Wood Essence from Malaysia, extracted with the expertise of the Master Distillers.

Fragrance family: Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Olibanum and Angelica

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Honey, Patchouli, Amber and Spanish Labdanum

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and White Sandalwood

title: Oriental Enigma Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the alluring blend of Oriental Enigma Eau de Parfum, a new fragrance by Alexandre.J in 2022. Experience the rich top notes of Dates and Hazelnut, followed by the enticing middle notes of Hibiscus and Orris Root, and finish with the warmth of Tonka Bean, Rum, and Saffron. Indulge in the mysterious and spicy aroma of Oriental Enigma.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dates and Hazelnut

Middle notes: Hibiscus and Orris Root

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Rum and Saffron

title: Ode to Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the beauty and elegance of Ode to Rose Eau de Parfum by Alexandre.J. This new fragrance, launched in 2022, combines the romantic scents of May Rose, Ylang-Ylang, and Jasmine with the bold notes of Geranium, Orange Cassia Tree, and Violet Leaves. Finished with a warm and seductive blend of Sandalwood and Patchouli, Ode to Rose is the perfect scent for both women and men.

Fragrance family: Woody, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: May Rose, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Middle notes: Geranium, Orange Cassia Tree and Violet Leaves

Base notes: Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Majestic Nard Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the luxurious scent of Majestic Nard Eau de Parfum by Alexandre.J. Suitable for both women and men, this new fragrance boasts a woody spicy aroma. With top notes of Galbanum, Pink Pepper, and Incense, experience a blend of Saffron, Nard Himalayan, and Virginian Cedar at its heart. The base notes of Patchouli and Sandalwood add a touch of earthiness to this majestic fragrance.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Galbanum, Pink Pepper and Incense

Middle notes: Saffron, Nard Himalayan (Jatamansi) and Virginian Cedar

Base notes: Patchouli and Sandalwood.

title: Butterfly Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Butterfly Eau de Parfum - a symbol of metamorphosis and freedom. With a blend of pear, pink peppercorn, tuberose, and neroli, this fragrance captures the vibrant journey of migrating butterflies. Revel in its elegant and diverse floral notes, reflecting grace and sophistication.

Fragrance family: Musk, FLoral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Cardamom, Bergamot and Pear

Middle notes: Tuberose, Neroli and Hazelnut

Base notes: Musk, Milk, Vanilla, Amber and Woody Notes

title: Black Beetle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Expertly crafted by renowned perfumer Alexandre.J, Black Beetle Eau de Parfum is a new, must-have fragrance for both women and men. With top notes of Raspberry, Bergamot, and Frankincense, middle notes of Patchouli and Red Chilli Pepper, and base notes of Woody Notes and Musk, this woody spicy scent is sure to captivate and leave a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Bergamot and Frankincense

Middle notes: Patchouli and Red Chilli Pepper

Base notes: Woody Notes and Musk

title: Velvet Desert Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Desert Oud Eau de Parfum is a unique fusion of tobacco, saffron, and dark woods, incorporating influences from both Eastern and Western cultures. It is one of many scents in the Velvet Collection, providing a glimpse into the brand's artistic perspective inspired by the designers' own olfactory experiences and Italian heritage.

Fragrance family: Amber, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud)

Base notes: Amber, Musk

title: Velvet Amber Skin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the opulence of Sicily with Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Amber Skin. Reflecting the grandeur of Sicilian courts, this fragrance features rich amber notes. A part of the prestigious Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Collection, each scent is adorned in luxurious velvet, inviting you to discover their creative vision. Indulge in an intimate journey and discover the designers' olfactory memories and the beauty of Italy.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Citruses, Bergamot and Silk Tree blossom

Middle notes: Resins, Iris, Labdanum, Leather, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Tolu Balsam, Vanilla, Myrrh, Opoponax, Cinnamon, Amberwood, Honey and Clove

title: Velvet Exotic Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
From the perspective of a product expert, the Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Exotic Leather Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold combination of leather, cinnamon, and frankincense. This unique scent is reminiscent of the fumoir at Palazzo Mirto in Palermo, and is a cherished addition to the Velvet Collection, known for its luxurious velvet-wrapped fragrances that invite you to experience the designers' Italian-inspired olfactory journey.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Rum, Leather

Middle notes: Juniper Berries, Lavender, Olibanum

Base notes: Styrax, Labdanum, Clary Sage

title: Velvet Vetiver Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted for those seeking a sophisticated scent, Velvet Vetiver Eau de Parfum by Dolce&Gabbana combines aromatic artemisia, fruity Mediterranean fig, and earthy Haitian vetiver in perfect harmony.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Vetiver

Middle notes: black fig

Base notes: Galbanum

title: Velvet Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Rose fragrance showcases the essence of the Mediterranean rose, expertly created with three rare extracts. Experience the vibrant and luxurious scent of a spring rose blooming at dawn in the warm embrace of the Mediterranean sun. This addition to the Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Collection, known for its lavish velvet packaging, invites you to embark on a sensory exploration of the designers' personal memories and love for Italy.

Fragrance family: Rose, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses and Lily

Middle notes: May Rose, Moroccan Rose, Bulgarian Rose and Egyptian Pelargonium

Base notes: Musk

title: Velvet Blue Musk Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Through its expertly crafted eau de parfums, Dolce&Gabbana embodies the irresistible allure of scent, a powerful sense that has the ability to captivate. The Velvet Blue Musk fragrance perfectly encapsulates the spirit of Sicily, inspired by the refreshing sea breeze and the vibrant botanicals that adorn the island.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Saffron and Cumin

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Sandalwood and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

Base notes: Musk, Tonka and Cedar

title: Radical Rose Hair Mist
body_html: Experience a nomadic, light hair mist that caresses your strands with kindness. With an airy, captivating scent of Radical Rose, its high concentration of Rose Centifolia Absolute will leave a lasting impression. Spray at arm's length for a refreshing and indulgent experience.

title: Falcon Leather Hair Mist
body_html: Experience the rich, leathery scent of Matiere Premiere's Hair Perfume Falcon Leather. This nomadic and lightweight hair perfume doesn't damage hair and allows for long-lasting wear. With notes of ciste labdanum, saffron, and benzoin absolute, it offers a satin facet combined with a skin-like facet. Elevate your hair game with Falcon Leather.

title: Crystal Saffron Hair Mist
body_html: Experience the long-lasting scent of Crystal Saffron with the Hair Perfume by Matiere Premiere. Made with Greek saffron oil and warming musk, this nomadic and light perfume is gentle on hair. Envelop yourself in the warm and spicy notes of ambroxan and Somali incense while nourishing your locks.

title: Encens Suave Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious and comforting scent of Encens Suave Extrait de Parfum. Enhanced by the classic, resinous note of Amber, this fragrance will envelope you in warmth and richness. A must-have for lovers of French perfumery.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee

Middle notes: Frankincense and Vanilla Absolute

Base notes: Siam Benzoin, Amber and Spanish Labdanum

title: Santal Austral Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Santal Austral Extrait de Parfum by Matière Première features a smoky, woody intensity introduced by Black Cardamom Absolute from Nepal, developed exclusively for the brand. This fragrance blends Australian sandalwood, almond milk, Florentine iris absolute, Siam benzoin absolute, Venezuelan tonka bean absolute, and Nepalese black cardamom absolute.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris and Almond Milk

Middle notes: Australian Sandalwood

Base notes: Black Cardamom, Tonka Bean and Siam Benzoin

title: Crystal Saffron Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the luxurious scent of Crystal Saffron Extrait de Parfum. Infused with Myrrh Oil from Somalia, this fragrance offers a textured note and a luminous black hue. Myrrh enriches the vibrant and radiant aspects of Crystal Saffron, creating a warm and complex aroma. Experience the beauty of this exotic blend.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Habanolide

Middle notes: Saffron

Base notes: Ambroxan, Myrrh and Frankincense

title: Bois d'Ebene Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Utilizing the potency of deep wood, the Bois d'Ebene Eau de Parfum incorporates and preserves premium elements to produce a captivating fragrance suitable for individuals of any gender. Paraguayan Guaiac wood is enhanced by Indonesian Patchouli oil and Cypriol oil from India, demonstrating the brand's commitment to sourcing superior ingredients from various corners of the globe.

Fragrance family: Woody, Earthy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper Berries

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Patchouli and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: Cologne Cedrat Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The heart of Matiere Premiere's Cologne Cédrat eau de parfum is infused with Italian citrus oil, reflecting the brand's dedicated focus on sourcing the finest raw materials from around the world. Distilled into oils, Madagascan black pepper and Argentine rose bay create an enduring scent, enhanced by the tea-like freshness of Italian bergamot and Mate Absolute from Paraguay

Fragrance family: Spicy, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Pink Pepper and Black Pepper

Base notes: Mate

title: Radical Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Radical Rose Eau de Parfum boasts a potent dose of Rose Centifolia Absolute, extracted from organically grown roses by MATIERE PREMIERE. It harnesses the highest concentration of this rare ingredient in the world, expertly amplifying its bright and spicy facets with the addition of Saffron and Pepper Berries Essence from Jamaica. Meanwhile, the woody notes are deepened with Patchouli Essence from Indonesia and Labdanum Absolute from Andalusia

Fragrance family: Rose, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose

Middle notes: Patchouli, Saffron

Base notes: Labdanum, Pepper

title: Urban Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Urban Eau de Parfum by Alfred Ritchy. A Chypre Floral fragrance for both women and men, this new scent will elevate your senses. With top notes of Bergamot, Pink Pepper, and Rose, followed by middle notes of Patchouli and Jasmine, and a base of Oakmoss, Amber, and Musk, experience a perfect balance of sophistication and allure.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Rose

Middle notes: Patchouli and Jasmine

Base notes: Oakmoss, Amber and Musk

title: Mamba Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Introducing Mamba Eau de Parfum, a new floral fragrance for women and men by Alfred Ritchy. With top notes of Pear, Pink Pepper, and Apple, and base notes of Amber, Patchouli, and Musk, this luxurious perfume is designed to captivate and leave a lasting impression. Experience the sophisticated blend of Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang, and Jasmine, and make a statement with Mamba.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Pink Pepper and Apple

Middle notes: Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Patchouli and Musk

title: Lakeside Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refreshing and elegant scent of Lakeside Eau de Parfum. A perfect balance of blackberry, pineapple, and bergamot creates a fruity and inviting top note. The blend of rose, saffron, lily-of-the-valley, and violet in the middle notes adds a touch of floral sophistication. Grounded by vetiver, sandalwood, and musk in the base notes, Lakeside is a woody aquatic fragrance suitable for both men and women

Fragrance family: Woody, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blackberry, Pineapple and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Saffron, Lily-of-the-Valley and Violet

Base notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Jetty Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jetty Eau de Parfum, created by Alfred Ritchy, is a freshly launched fragrance for both women and men. This Oriental Woody scent showcases top notes of Bergamot, Carrot Seeds, and Orris Root, followed by a delicate blend of Violet and Cedar in the heart. The base notes of Sandalwood, Leather, Amber, and Gurjan balsam add a bold and earthy finish to this new, luxurious scent.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Carrot Seeds and Orris Root

Middle notes: Violet and Cedar

Base notes: Sandalwood, Leather, Amber and Gurjan balsam

title: Empyr Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Explore the dynamic blend of woody and fresh notes in Bvlgari Le Gemme Empyr. Crafted with a bold ginger heart extract and rich sandalwood essence, this fragrance offers a powerful contrast.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger

Middle notes: Ginger

Base notes: Sandalwood and Labdanum

title: Wulong Cha Hair Perfume
body_html: Discover the mesmerizing scent of Wulong Cha Hair Perfume. With sparkling citrus notes of bergamot, orange, and mandarin, this fragrance provides a strong freshness. The Mediterranean fig and musk base add depth, while the evasive essence of oolong tea brings a unique allure. Experience the ultimate hair perfume.

title: Tempfluo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the ephemerality of life with Nishane Tempfluo Extrait de Parfum. Inspired by the flow of time and the unity of humanity, this fragrance blends floral, gourmand, and woody notes for a harmonious and elegant composition. Seize the present and live boldly with every spray, embracing the profound olfactory journey that captures the rhythm of life.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Praline and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Cashmere Wood, Vanilla and Cedar

title: Ani X Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
ANI, the first reference under the new theme "NO BOUNDARIES" launched in 2019, aims to eliminate emotional barriers between people. Its vanilla fragrance has been raved about as the best in the world. ANI X amplifies this mystical experience of time, paying homage to an ancient metropolis that stands as a testament to empires and the inevitability of time. Like its predecessor, ANI X breaks boundaries and empowers wearers to build their own empires. With a refreshed scent, ANI X opens with a burst of juicy citrus, providing a pleasant surprise to those seeking a revitalizing fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Ginger, Melon, Cardamom, Water Notes and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Green Apple, Patchouli, Black Currant, Lavender, Sage and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cashmere Wood, Ambergris, White Musk and Cedar

title: Hacivat Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in luxury with Hacivat Oud Extrait de Parfum. Our carefully crafted fragrance perfectly embodies elegance and charm, while still retaining the essence of Hacivat. The complex blend of oud and pineapple creates a captivating aroma that is both intense and unforgettable. Elevate your scent game with this high-quality and alluring fragrance.

Fragrance family: Oud, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Citruses, Pink Pepper and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Frankincense, Olibanum and Jasmine

Base notes: Oud, Patchouli, Haitian Vetiver and Vanilla

title: Hacivat X Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the art of traditional shadow play with HACIVAT X Extrait de Parfum by NISHANE. This elegant chypre fragrance celebrates life with top notes of juicy pineapple and zesty bergamot, followed by a refreshing heart of lime and jasmine. It finishes off with earthy patchouli, woody cedarwood, and vetiver from Haiti

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Lime, Tunisian Orange Blossom and Jasmine

Base notes: Haitian Vetiver, Patchouli and Cedar

title: Favonius Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Experience the love of the Roman wind god, Favonius, with Favonius Extrait De Parfum. Inspired by the story of Favonius and Flora, this luxurious fragrance captures the essence of love, youth, and the beauty of nature. With every spritz, you'll be transported to a world of vitality and romance.

Fragrance family: Rose, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Litchi

Middle notes: Rose, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Geranium, Artemisia and Clary Sage

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Cedar

title: Outcast Blue Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted for the modern creative, Outcast Blue is a bold expression of EX NIHILO's signature shade. Stimulating notes of Saffron and Pepper ignite the senses, while a base of Cedarwood adds a seductive allure. A fusion of Patchouli, Vetiver, and Oak moss provide a fiery intensity, while hints of Tobacco add a rebellious edge to the fragrance's trail.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Black Pepper and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Cedar and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Tobacco, Vetiver, Oakmoss, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Irish Leather Hair Perfume
body_html: Experience the unique scent of Irish Leather eau de parfum in a new way with our Hair Perfume. Our alcohol-free formula gently perfumes your hair, creating a long-lasting, delicately scented veil that can be enjoyed in any season. Featuring a blend of Juniper essence, Green maté absolute, Leather accord, Pink pepper, oil of Clary Sage, oil of Flouve, Iris concrete, Tonka Bean absolute, oil of Birch, and Amber accor.

title: Oriental Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the mystical allure of the Wahiba Sands with Oriental Leather Eau de Parfum. In the still of night, the rich scent of patchouli leads the way to Wadi Shab, a lush oasis. During daylight hours, amber and leather notes merge with the fragrant spices of Mutrah souq, evoking a sense of wonder and discovery.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Red Chilli Pepper and Cilantro

Middle notes: Geranium, Anise, Cinnamon and Tea

Base notes: Leather, Clove, Patchouli, Benzoin and Vanilla

title: Cappadocia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The key ingredient in this perfume is saffron, enhanced by the soft floral scent of flowers, warm woods, and fragrant resins. Its delicate yet enveloping aroma is found in our Graines Vagabondes collection. The bottle is designed to reflect the unique landscape of Cappadocia, known for its "fairy chimneys" formed by volcanic eruptions and shaped by wind and rain.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron essence

Middle notes: Jasmine absolute, Iris butter, Rose absolute

Base notes: Sandalwood album essence, Olibanum essence, Myrrh resinoid, Benzoin resinoid, Vanilla absolute

title: Luxor Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the splendor and majesty of Luxor Oud Eau de Parfum. Immerse yourself in the oasis of roses and fruit, a marriage of wood and rose under Pharaoh's whip and sceptre. Feel the freshness and sensuality of the oldest prayer site, where time stands still and the stones seem to vibrate.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Fruits and Desert Rose

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Labdanum

title: Flam Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the energizing and comforting blend of Flam Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the northern lights and a cozy wooden house, this fragrance combines fresh notes of bergamot and bitter orange with warm cedarwood. Enriched with tonka bean, vanilla, mineral amber, and white musk, it evokes a sense of well-being and natural beauty

Fragrance family: Floral, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot essence, Orange Bitter essence, Clary Sage essence

Middle notes: Petaly accord, Jasmine Sambac absolute

Base notes: Cedarwood essence Virginia, Tonka Bean resinoid, Vanilla absolute Madagascar, Musk, ambrettolide

title: Iberian Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Unleash a rich, smoky aroma with Iberian Leather Eau de Parfum. A blend of aromatics and citrus, along with floral notes of iris, lily of the valley, rose, jasmine, and Osmanthus, creates a complex and alluring scent. With woody tones of cedar, vetiver, patchouli, and oakmoss, this fragrance is elevated by hints of dark spices, saffron, and vanilla.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Geranium, Rosemary, Coriander and Bergamot

Middle notes: Saffron, Clove, Iris, Cinnamon, Osmanthus, Rose, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Leather, Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Vetiver, Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Cedar, Balsam Fir, Amber, Musk and Vanilla

title: African Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the exotic and luxurious African Leather Eau de Parfum by Memo Paris. Let the scents of cardamom, leather, and geranium transport you to the sun-drenched Savannah. With additional notes of bergamot, saffron, cumin, patchouli, oud accord, vetiver, and musk, this fragrance is truly a sensory journey. Created by travel experts Clara and John Molloy, this collection is inspired by their personal adventures around the globe.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom essence Guatemala, Geranium absolute egypt, Pink Pepper CO2 extract

Middle notes: Rose essence, Patchouli essence Indonesia, Cinnamon essence

Base notes: Leather accord, Oud essence, Amber accord

title: Irish Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the refreshing scent of morning dew with Irish Leather Eau de Parfum. This fragrance by Memo Paris combines clary sage oil, green maté absolute, iris concrete, and leather accord to create a lingering aroma that is sure to captivate. Feel rejuvenated and confident with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pepper essence, Mandarin essence, Juniper Berry essence

Middle notes: Iris concrete, Clary Sage essence, Green mate absolute

Base notes: Leather accord, Cedarwood essence, Vetiver essence

title: Ambre Chromatique Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the highly concentrated, long-lasting perfume extract inspired by a trek through multicolored jungles in search of benzoin resin. Discover the lively and spicy facets of incense and pink peppercorn, paired with the sensual warmth of amber to create an endlessly elegant trail. Experience a sense of adventure with this diffusing fragrance.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Davana and Osmanthus

Base notes: Amber, Benzoin and Bourbon Vanilla

title: N°7 Hair Perfume
body_html: Introducing N°7 Hair Perfume, featuring premium patchouli sourced from Indonesia. Delicately distilled through a molecular process, enjoy spicy floral notes of jasmine with hints of animalistic undertones. Grounded with the highest quality ingredients like Laos and Thai ouds, Madagascar vanilla and Siam benjui, this hair perfume will leave your locks smelling luxurious.

title: N°5 Hair Perfume
body_html: N°5 Hair Perfume offers an exotic and unique blend of spicy carnation and lily of the valley, creating an oriental fragrance that's unlike any other. Its base notes of amber musk and vanilla add a sensual touch, making this floral scent linger on your skin like a dream.

title: 2010 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In 2010, Rosendo earned the prestigious title of "Maître Parfumeur" in recognition of his unwavering dedication, commitment, and passion for perfumery. This unique scent is inspired by his travels to Thailand, Singapore, and the United Arab Emirates, where he further cultivated his love for natural ingredients. The first notes introduce an aromatic and floral quality, followed by hints of wood. Over time, the fragrance reveals a captivating blend of spices, resins, and balsamic notes, with saffron as the primary note. As this perfume lingers on the skin, it releases its enchanting treasures of sweet notes, musk, and dry woods.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aromatic Notes, Woody Notes, Cedar and Floral Notes

Middle notes: Saffron, Resins, Balsamic Notes and Spices

Base notes: dark woodsy notes, Musk and Sweet Notes

title: 1968 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rosendo Mateu 1968 takes inspiration from the esteemed master's early days, delving into the realm of fragrances and perfumes. With extensive studies in Grasse, where he gained expertise in the key natural ingredients used in perfumery, 1968 is an invigorating and delicate scent. The dominant, intoxicating scent of tuberose comes to life with hints of rose and aromatic notes, before finishing with a touch of vanilla, musk, and woody elements for a sublime conclusion.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Accord, Floral Notes and Dew Drop

Middle notes: Aromatic Notes, Spices, Tuberose and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Woody Notes and Vanilla

title: 1988 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
1988 Eau de Parfum is a marine fragrance that embodies self-confidence and mastery. Its delicate balance of citric and fresh top notes leads to aquatic middle notes of ozone, sea water, marine salt, and undertones of white musk, spices, and woods. This tranquil scent invites you on a journey of self-discovery.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dew Drop and Citruses

Middle notes: Ozonic notes, Sea water, Woody Notes and Sea Salt

Base notes: White Musk, Woody Notes and Spices

title: 1970 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
1970 Eau de Parfum embodies the elegance and allure of Parisian style. Crafted by Rosendo Mateu, this fragrance exudes refinement and luxurious beauty, much like haute couture. Its delicate blend of sweet and sophisticated notes makes it a truly sublime experience.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses and Fruits

Middle notes: Chocolate, Spices, Earthy Notes and Woody Notes

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Amber and Musk

title: N°8 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Redefine your scent with N°8 Eau de Parfum by Rosendo Mateu, featuring three distinctive pillars of "Fruity, Amber, Exotic Musk". Experience an ethereal, multi-faceted fragrance that enchants both men and women with its versatile layers and captivating complexity. The top notes evoke a tropical oasis, blending sweet apple and pear with the exotic flair of pineapple.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Apple, Pear and Citruses

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Iris, Amber, Bulgarian Rose and Patchouli

Base notes: Vanilla, Cedar, Guaiac Wood and Vetiver

title: N°7 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The focal element of this product is patchouli sourced from the Indonesian countryside. The leaves are air-dried and then soaked in water for fermentation and distillation. The patchouli used in this scent undergoes a molecular distillation method to ensure the finest quality of this essential ingredient

Fragrance family: Oud, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose Petals, Floral Notes and Jasmine

Middle notes: Patchouli, Spices and Sweet Notes

Base notes: Vanilla, Thailand Oud, Laotian Oud and Siam Benzoin

title: N°6 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The main focus of this fragrance is the use of Indian sandalwood, known for its nobility. The scent is a delicate and sweet combination, with the fresh aroma of the Sambac Jasmine flower and a persistent, sensual touch of Amber and Vanilla. These carefully selected notes create a surprising blend that is sure to please even the most discerning of noses. The final touch of high-quality, white musk adds a long-lasting finish on the skin.

Fragrance family: Powdery, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jasmine Sambac, Exotic Fruits, Floral Notes, Coconut and Green Accord

Middle notes: Sandalwood and Spicy Notes

Base notes: White Musk, Vanilla and Amber

title: N°4 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
N°4 Eau de Parfum boasts a subtle aroma that embraces the wearer's skin. The heart note comprises of a captivating combination of spicy floral scents, including cinnamon, nutmeg, and saffron, accented by delicate hints of jasmine petals, nuts, and iris rhizomes. This fragrance is complemented by a notable base note, featuring the luxurious Oud wood, along with patchouli, sandalwood, guaiac, and vetiver.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Natural Bitter Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Saffron

Base notes: Jasmine, Nuts, Iris Rhizomes

title: N°3 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
N°3 Eau de Parfum highlights its sophistication, allure, and powerful feminine scent on the skin. It also features a desirable masculine undertone that exudes comfort and elegance, making it a perfect unisex fragrance

Fragrance family: Powdery, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot , Neroli, Iris

Middle notes: Iris, Damascus Rose, Jasmine Flower

Base notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver, Amber Cashmere With Tonka Beans, Vanilla, White Musk

title: N°2 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The fragrance greets you with an enticing blend of wild anise, pine, and juniper. These combine perfectly with the refreshing scent of lavender and the aroma of freshly-cut hay in the fields of French Provence. The middle notes feature a delicate floral bouquet of green, rose, and mint, balanced with clean notes of orange blossom and a touch of bitter orange. In the background, you'll notice hints of wood, amber, chocolate, tobacco, musk, and sandalwood, with cedar and patchouli adding a touch of sensuality to the overall woody and leathery fragrance, courtesy of OUD wood.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pine, Juniper, Anise and Hay

Middle notes: Bitter Orange Blossom, Geranium, Rose and Green Notes

Base notes: Chocolate, Tobacco, Musk, Sandalwood, Woody Notes, Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Cedar and Moss

title: N°1 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rosendo Mateu Nº 1 Bergamot, Tea Leaf, and Sandalwood by Rosendo Mateu Olfactive Expressions is a unisex Woody Aromatic fragrance. It was launched in 2017 and created by master perfumer Rosendo Mateu. With top notes of Calabrian bergamot, Lime, Lavender, Green Mandarin, Sage, Rosemary, and Thyme, and a heart featuring Tea Leaf, Bitter Orange Blossom, Neroli, Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley, Green Pepper, and Cardamom, this scent also has a base of White Musk, Sandalwood, and Iris.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot, Lime, Lavender, Green Mandarin, Sage, Rosemary and Thyme

Middle notes: Tea Leaf, Bitter Orange Blossom, Neroli, Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley, Green Pepper and Cardamom

Base notes: White Musk, Sandalwood and Iris

title: Pas Ce Soir Hair Perfume
body_html: Pas Ce Soir Hair Perfume is a sophisticated blend of fruity, spicy, and woody notes, evoking the feeling of a daring Parisian evening. Inspired by the trilogy of jasmine, quince, and orange blossom, this delicately scented hair perfume moisturizes and softens hair for a silky finish. Formulated with silk proteins, it also improves hair's hydration and elasticity, leaving it with a glossy shine. Apply to the mid-lengths and ends of hair to experience the luxurious benefits of silk.

title: Gris Charnel Hair Perfume
body_html: Drawing inspiration from the seductive aura of Parisian streets, Gris Charnel Hair Perfume combines the warm, spicy tones of sandalwood and vetiver to create a luxurious scent. Not only does this hair perfume delicately fragrance your locks, it also nourishes and softens them with the help of silk proteins. Known for its hair-enhancing properties, silk adds natural shine and improves hydration and elasticity for a silky, polished finish. For best results, apply to the mid-lengths and ends of your hair.

title: Wood Jasmin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
BDK Parfums Wood Jasmin Eau de Parfum is an exquisite oriental fragrance filled with potent natural ingredients and unexpected nuances. It boasts concentrated vanilla absolute, two varieties of jasmine, fruity top notes, and luxurious incense notes that give the scent a refined touch of opulence.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum and Pear

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Egyptian Jasmine, Artemisia and Turkish Rose

Base notes: Peru Balsam, Incense, Madagascar Vanilla, Spanish Labdanum, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

title: Tubéreuse Imperiale Eau de Parfum
body_html:

title: Molecule 03 Eau de Toilette
body_html: Molecule 03 Eau de Toilette highlights the hybrid molecule Vetiveryl Acetate, created through a combination of natural root and synthetic compounds. Vetiveryl Acetate is a fraction of vetiver oil sourced from Indian grass roots, which undergoes an acetylation process with acetic acid to extract the harsh, leathery elements and produce a refined and sophisticated scent. According to fragrance expert Geza Schoen, this process also enhances the citrus note of grapefruit in vetiver, resulting in a stronger, bitter-fresh top note.

title: Molecule 04 Eau de Toilette
body_html: Celebrate the futuristic freshness of Javanol with Escentric Molecules 04. This unique sandalwood molecule possesses the radiance and endurance of natural sandalwood while being sheer and transparent, creating a scent that is truly unlike any other sandalwood on Earth. As described by Geza Schoen, Javanol evokes a psychedelic freshness reminiscent of liquid metallic grapefruit peel over a bed of velvety cream-colored roses.

title: Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette
body_html: Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette highlights the grapefruit accent in Javanol, resulting in a uniquely fresh interpretation of a sandalwood fragrance. With crisp, bitter notes of pink grapefruit peel and added zest of lime, this formula is complemented by the freshness of juniper and pink pepper. The heart is composed of four different rose ingredients, achieving a "fresh soft rose" scent through the orris. The drydown features a balsamic and woody combination of Javanol and Polysantol, with a touch of sweetness from the sandalwood molecule.

title: Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette
body_html: Escentric 03 centers on the key ingredient of Vetiveryl Acetate, paying homage to the traditional roots used in perfumery: vetiver, ginger, and orris. Perfumer Geza Schoen wanted to highlight the unique scents of these roots and how they complement each other. The top note features a lively, green, and spicy blend of ginger, lime peel, and green peppercorn. The heart note is a indulgent mix of orris, Egyptian jasmine, and tea. The drydown showcases the deep, woody notes of vetiver, complemented by sandalwood, cedar, mellow balsams, and musk.

title: Molecule 01 + Patchouli Eau de Toilette
body_html: Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule known for its warm, velvety cedarwood note. The other ingredient, patchouli, is extracted naturally from the plant's leaves. According to fragrance expert Geza Schoen, patchouli is unique and often associated with the sixties and seventies. It has a cool, woodsy scent that I find moody and beautiful. This scent uses two different types of patchouli, including Patchouli Coeur, a clean and soft oil with the camphor note removed, and a patchouli oil from Indonesia for a touch of topnote.

title: Molecule 01 + Ginger Eau De Toilette
body_html: Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule that evokes a cedarwood scent and a warm, velvety sensation. Ginger is extracted from the rhizome of the ginger plant and offers a fresh and spicy aroma. M+ Ginger has a unique combination of contrasting notes that are both captivating and addictive. It is simultaneously strong and calming, peppery and effervescent, and both familiar and imaginative.

title: Molecule 01 + Guaiac Wood Eau De Toilette
body_html: Iso E Super is a synthetic molecule with a cedarwood scent and a cozy, velvety feeling. Guaiac wood is a vital oil extracted from the heartwood of the Bulnesia sarmientoi tree, known for its warm, smoky, and woody aroma. Known for its exceptional dry-down in olfactory alchemy, Guaiac wood has a dark, deep, and almost somber quality. Picture yourself enveloped in layers of creamy, warm whisky during the winter, with the fireplace smoke swirling around you; this is the experience of Molecule 01 + Guaiac Wood Eau De Toilette.

title: Molecule 01 + Iris Eau de Toilette
body_html: Iris has a distinctive scent that is difficult to describe, but when it is added to a fragrance, it brings a creamy powderiness and a physical dimension. As a lover of iris, I always include an iris note in every Escentric fragrance. The iris pallida absolue used in this fragrance is one of the most expensive ingredients in perfumery, but it adds a great and subtle beauty that cannot be found in cheaper iris extracts. Despite its radical use in large quantities, the sillage of this fragrance is truly fantastic.

title: Sandalwood Neroli Perfume
body_html:
Sandalwood Neroli perfume by Bohoboco is a gender-neutral fragrance that combines the warm, woody scent of sandalwood with the refreshing floral notes of neroli and bergamot. Launched in 2016, this luxurious perfume features a complex blend of sandalwood, smoke, jasmine, cedar, and musk.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sandalwood, Neroli and Bergamot

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Smoke and Jasmine

body_html:
Unveiled in 2016, Olibanum Gardenia is a unisex Oriental Floral scent from Bohoboco. Its top notes include a refreshing blend of Lime, Coconut, and Neroli, while its middle contains a rich combination of Incense, Labdanum, and Gardenia. The fragrance is anchored by its base notes of Resin, Sandalwood, and Cedar.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Coconut and Neroli

Middle notes: Incense, Labdanum and Gardenia

Base notes: Resin, Sandalwood and Cedar
