body_html:
Experience the luxurious scent of Jasmine White Leather by Bohoboco. This unisex fragrance, released in 2022, features a blend of Clove, Lemon, Bergamot, Jasmine, White Flowers, Lavender, Violet, Rose, White Leather, Musk, Patchouli, Ambergris, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, and Cedar notes for a complex and elegant aroma.

Fragrance family: Floral, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Clove, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine, White Flowers, Lavender, Violet and Rose

Base notes: White Leather, Musk, Patchouli, Ambergris, Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Cedar

title: Geranium Balsamic Note Perfume
body_html:
Geranium Balsamic Note by Bohoboco is a fragrance in the Oriental Woody category for both women and men. It was introduced in 2016 and contains top notes of Juniper Berries and Bay Leaf, middle notes of Geranium, Cedar, and Fig Tree, and base notes of Cedar, Resins, Egyptian balsam, and Vetiver

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: uniper Berries and Bay Leaf

Middle notes: Geranium, Cedar and Fig Tree

Base notes: Cedar, Resins, Egyptian balsam and Vetiver

title: Eucalyptus Patchouli Perfume
body_html:
Launched in 2016, Eucalyptus Patchouli by Bohoboco is a unisex fragrance that features a blend of woody, spicy, and incense notes. The top notes include eucalyptus, pink pepper, and cardamom, while the middle notes are composed of incense and woodsy scents. The base notes consist of patchouli, moss, and cedar, creating a unique and long-lasting aroma.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Eucalyptus, Pink Pepper and Cardamom

Middle notes: Incense and Woodsy Notes

Base notes: Patchouli, Moss and Cedar

title: Eternal Lily Amber Perfume
body_html:
Introducing Eternal Lily Amber, the latest unisex fragrance from Bohoboco. This 2022 release features top notes of Granny Smith apple and Sicilian Mandarin, complemented by a floral blend of Lily, Turkish Rose and Jasmine. The base notes of Amber, Patchouli and Madagascar Vanilla give this scent a long-lasting and alluring finish

Fragrance family: Amber, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Granny Smith apple and Sicilian Mandarin

Middle notes: Lily, Turkish Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Patchouli and Madagascar Vanilla

title: Dark Vinyl Musk Perfume
body_html:
Dark Vinyl Musk is a unique combination of black vinyl and musk that symbolizes the highs and lows of life. With enchanting incense and comforting balsamic notes, this fragrance brings us to unforgettable moments. The deep leather notes represent the darker side of the world, while the captivating scent of the rose symbolizes the brighter side

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Labdanum, Sandalwood and Rose

Middle notes: Styrax, Olibanum and Resins

Base notes: Labdanum, Amber, Leather and Musk

title: Coffee White Flowers Perfume
body_html:
Released in 2016, Coffee White Flowers by Bohoboco is an Oriental Vanilla scent for both women and men. The top notes include Chocolate, Cinnamon, and Cloves, while the heart of the fragrance is a blend of Coffee, White Flowers, and Cacao. The base notes provide a hint of Rum, Vanilla, and Leather.

Fragrance family: Amber, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Chocolate, Cinnamon and Cloves

Middle notes: Coffee, White Flowers and Cacao

Base notes: Rum, Vanilla and Leather

title: Brioni Eau de Parfum Suave
body_html:
The Eau de Parfum Suave is a highly sophisticated fragrance that captures the essence of the golden hour with its blend of carefully selected notes. It exudes a sense of refinement and individuality, making a bold statement through its subtle assertiveness. This fragrance belongs to the ambery leathery spicy olfactive family and offers a timeless appeal.

Fragrance family: Leather, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper, Cardamom and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Leather and Vetiver

Base notes: Amber and Sandalwood

title: Brioni Eau de Parfum Essentiel
body_html:
Discover the modern and delightful Brioni Eau de Parfum Essentiel. This 100% natural-origin fragrance captures the essence of nature with its powerful and unexpected blend of precious ingredients. With sparkling bergamot and aromatic cardamom, the opening is fresh and green, like a ray of light shining through tender tomato leaves. The heart of the scent is enhanced by earthy patchouli and a rare tonka bean, never before used in perfumery. The captivating drydown reveals notes of resinous frankincense and creamy sandalwood, providing a sense of calm and well-being.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Cardamom and Tomato

Middle notes: Patchouli and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Ambergris, Frankincense and Sandalwood

title: Blue Cypress Parfum
body_html:
As an expert in the fragrance industry, I present Blue Cypress Parfum, a refined blend of woody notes and aromatic spices that delivers both invigorating and grounding effects. The cobalt-colored Australian Blue Cypress serves as the fragrant foundation, complemented by a fusion of rejuvenating lavender and exotic patchouli, clove, and star anise. This versatile fragrance is perfect for both men and women and is inspired by the refreshing scent of dew evaporating from soft foliage amidst a backdrop of towering eucalyptus and cypress trees

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blue Cypress, Lavender, Patchouli

Middle notes: Clove, Star Anise, Zesty

Base notes: Woody, Green, Crisp

title: Wood Infusion Parfum
body_html:
Wood Infusion Parfum is inspired by the diverse range of wood species found on the Pacific Ocean's stunning Fraser Island. Enriched with Sandalwood Album, Iris, and velvety Agarwood (Oud Wood), this fragrance is an exotic infusion that evokes the creamy and rich scents of nature's most noble botanicals for both men and women. Discover the essence of this island paradise with Wood Infusion Parfum

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sweet Orange

Middle notes: Lavender, Italian Iris and Amber

Base notes: Exotic Woods, Agarwood (Oud), Island Musk and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

title: Southern Bloom Parfum
body_html:
Experience the exquisite and rare scent of the Boronia flower, found only on Australia's southernmost island, Bruny, during its brief 'spring-bloom' in September. This luxurious parfum features the highly coveted absolute of boronia, renowned as one of the most expensive perfume materials in the world. The floral-woody fragrance is pure, lavish, and sensationally smooth, with hints of delicate green notes and vibrant red fruit. Indulge in the opulence and sophistication of this intensely luxurious scent.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cassis and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Boronia, Coconut, Italian Iris, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Australian Sandalwood, Musk, Amber and Vetiver

title: Velvet Splendour Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Splendour Parfum evokes the sense of holding a vibrant bouquet of sun-kissed wildflowers, enveloping one's senses with the essence of a scenic country drive. The blooming mimosa tree, a symbol of spring in Australia, adds a touch of warmth and beauty against the backdrop of a clear blue sky. Upon first inhalation, a refreshing blend of green stems, sunny blooms, and cool air embraces the senses, creating a bold and alluring experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Hedione, Mimosa Absolute, Orange Blossom, Jasmine

Middle notes: Patchouli, Vetiver, Leather, Tonka Bean, Oppoponax

Base notes: Heliotropine, Velvety, Exotic, Leathery

title: Trajan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Trajan was renowned as a giant among men, earning his place as one of the Five Great emperors through his pioneering spirit, military prowess, and dedication to peace, philanthropy, and virtue. Under his rule, the empire flourished and expanded across the Silk Route, bringing prosperity, cultural richness, and commerce. Experience the journey of this warm citrus fragrance, weaving through Mediterranean citrus groves, lavender and sage gardens, and cedar woodlands, with a touch of Eastern sweetness and spice.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Mandarin Orange, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Saffron, Lavender and Sage

Base notes: Ambergris, Cedar and Oakmoss

title: Capua Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Capua Eau de Parfum has a rich history dating back to the Romans, who refined the art of perfumery in the city known as the heart of the industry. Derived from the Latin word "perfumare" meaning "to smoke through", this seductive scent combines rare and exotic ingredients from the Silk Road, resulting in a spicy and smoky wood fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi

Middle notes: Cedar

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Cashmere Wood and Amber

title: Persephone's Patchouli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This pleasant woody amber fragrance begins with a crisp and refined cardamom note, delicately infused with plum and pomegranate, before revealing a heart of Egyptian jasmine, a crisp and aromatic patchouli, and a touch of rose. With a blend of light sandalwood, cedar, and a hint of musk and amber, this scent is both light and sensual, making it perfect for any occasion

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum, Pomegranate and Cardamom

Middle notes: Patchouli, Bulgarian Rose and Egyptian Jasmine

Base notes: Honey, Sandalwood, Ambergris and Cedar

title: Patchouli of the Underworld Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance boasts a rich patchouli scent, reminiscent of carnal desires and musky allure. It evokes a sense of power and opulence, encapsulating the mysteries of the underworld and the hidden treasures of the earth. Hints of light above the surface add a touch of intrigue to this alluring perfume

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper, Pink Pepper, Cistus Incanus and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Leather, Patchouli and Carnation

Base notes: Castoreum, Labdanum and Styrax

title: Aquila Absolute Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the unique and flexible fragrance of Aquila Absolute Extrait de Parfum, carefully crafted by renowned Master Perfumer Julien Rasquinet using premium sustainable, natural, and vegan materials. Unleash a burst of radiant raspberry and refreshing cardamom, followed by a lively floral bouquet of Damascena Rose Abs and spicy Geranium. The alluring scent is completed with a base of rich leather and subtle white oud notes.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry and Cardamom

Middle notes: Rose and Geranium

Base notes: Leather, White Oud, Violet Leaf, Labdanum and Patchouli

title: Amber Aquilaria Parfum
body_html:
The perfect resin of Agarwood, mentioned in ancient religious texts, is extracted from the Aquilaria tree. With a refreshing, sparkling bergamot top note, this fragrance then unfolds into a luxurious blend of velvet rose petals, warm amber, sandalwood, Bourbon vanilla, and oud. Possessing exquisite oils and resins from Oriental Aquilaria, this scent is a connoisseur's delight, as larger scale production is unattainable due to its rare quality.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Cognac and Rose

Base notes: Ambergris, Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Aura Maris Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the essence of the Mediterranean Sea with the Mare Nostrum collection from Lorenzo Villoresi. Inspired by the sweet currents, soft breezes and ever-changing perfumes of the sea, this collection captures the excitement and danger of the mighty waters. The first fragrance in the collection, Aura Maris, perfectly captures the gentle sea breeze mixing with the scents of Mediterranean shrubs, citrus fruits and meadow flowers, all under the warm golden sun.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Green Notes and Floral Fruity Notes

Middle notes: Narcissus, Exotic Woods, Patchouli and Jasmine

Base notes: Woody Notes, Musk and Amber

title: Alamut Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Alamut is a gender-neutral scent, designed to take you on a luxurious and alluring journey through the Orient. It features rich and smooth flower petals from the East, such as osmanthus, rose, jasmine, rosewood, and other exotic blooms. The heart of the fragrance is a blend of daffodil, tuberose, ylang ylang, orange blossom, labdanum, and amber, while the base is a mix of amber, musk, sandalwood, patchouli, benzoin, leather, and powdery notes.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Brazilian Rosewood, Flowers, Osmanthus and Jasmine

Middle notes: French labdanum, Ylang-Ylang, Tuberose, Orange Blossom and Narcissus

Base notes: Amber, Sandalwood, Powdery Notes, Musk, Benzoin, Leather, Amyris and Patchouli

title: Musk Eau De Toilette
body_html:
Musk, launched in 1995, is a traditionally alluring and captivating woody scent. The top notes combine galbanum, cardamom, floral accords, and bergamot, while the heart brings out the fragrant essence of geranium and rose, gracefully layered over musk, sandalwood, oak moss, palisander, and vanilla. This exquisite perfume was crafted by perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody, Musky

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Floral Notes, Galbanum, Cardamom and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose and Geranium

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Brazilian Rosewood, Amber and Oakmoss

title: Patchouli Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Patchouli Eau de Toilette, released in 1996, evokes the rich and exotic scents of distant lands and lush jungles. Infused with woody and aromatic notes, this fragrance features a blend of patchouli and lavender in the opening, a heart of pure patchouli, and a base of sandalwood, vetiver, cedar, oak moss, musk, and benzoin. Created by the esteemed perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli and Lavender

Middle notes: Patchouli

Base notes: Patchouli, Vetiver, Oakmoss, Cedar, Sandalwood, Benzoin and Musk

title: Hindu Grass Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The unique scent of Hindu Grass is a harmonious blend of dry grass, green notes, and woody undertones, with a hint of dried herbs. It has a captivating and unconventional aroma that is difficult to compare to anything else. Designed to promote a sense of calmness, the earthy notes invite a peaceful and meditative atmosphere without being overpowering. Its natural allure draws people closer, making it an ideal fragrance for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli

Middle notes: Green Notes, Grass

Base notes: Tobacco

title: Absinth Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Absinth is a unique blend of earthy browns, woody greens, and dry, bitter herbs that evokes a range of colors. The initial scent of loamy earth is quickly accompanied by a soft, warm sweetness, reminiscent of a spring-rain soaked meadow. This fragrance captures the essence of the earth, with hints of rain and the fresh greens and florals of early spring. Its captivating aroma is both alluring and haunting, making it impossible to resist. You'll find yourself reaching for it throughout the day, whether with a wrist spritz or a dab on your leather watchband, just to indulge in its earthy pleasures.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wormwood

Middle notes: Green Notes

Base notes: Vetiver

title: Nudiflorum Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Nudiflorum Extrait de Parfum invites a tranquil experience of self-surrender without boundaries and a sense of deep intuition. This fragrance captures the intimacy of tactile sensation, as a gentle touch penetrates the skin and becomes one with the wearer. A fusion of natural and sensual elements, this bouquet of bare fur flowers evokes a delicate sensation of skin-to-skin contact

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody, Musky

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rhubarb

Middle notes: Amyl Salicylate, Raspberry and Rose

Base notes: Leather, Animal notes, Oakmoss and Cedar

title: Sadonaso Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
As a fragrance expert, Sadonaso Parfum offers a unique sensory experience. Our scents awaken hidden desires that are constantly evolving, embodying the true essence of the future. Let us guide you on a journey of indulgence and discovery.

Fragrance family: Tobacco

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee

Middle notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Tobacco

Base notes: Vanilla, Animal notes, Tonka and Amber

title: Boccanera Parfum
body_html:
The term "Boccanera" translates to "dark mouth" in Italian. This fragrance captures the seductive, sensual qualities of dark holes found in nature, and it does so in a bold and alluring way. It can be likened to a more indulgent version of Black Afgano, enticing you with its dessert-like aroma instead of its usual hashish associations. It's not a subtle or reserved scent, but it certainly embodies every other desirable trait.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Chili Pepper, Black Pepper, Ginger and Cacao Pod

Middle notes: Jasmine

Base notes: Chocolate, Musk, Leather, Animal notes, Cedar, Patchouli, Vanilla and Sugar

title: Brutus Parfum
body_html:
The scent of Brutus Parfum is influenced by Roman senator Marcus Junius Brutus, whose reputation for being unskilled in speechmaking. With a strong citrusy beginning and a rich woody essence, this fragrance may seem to want to harm you, but it maintains the courage to confront you directly. Its spicy, earthy, and intense fragrance will leave a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Lavender, Geranium and Rose

Base notes: Patchouli, Cedar, Amber, Musk, Labdanum and Oakmoss

title: Darcy Eau de Parfum
body_html:
With a lively blend of ingredients, Darcy Eau de Parfum is an enchanting and dynamic fragrance. Its captivating aroma bursts with the sweet and sunny scents of bergamot, orange, and citrus, while the heart is filled with a sensual bouquet of rose and jasmine. The base of patchouli, musk and praline adds a smooth and rich finish, completing the delightful and sophisticated composition.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot Essence, Orange, Citrus

Middle notes: Rose, Jasmine

Base notes: Patchouli, Musk, Praline

title: Darley Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Darley Eau de Parfum is a combination of complexity and elegance. Its opening bursts with a refreshing trio of lemon, bergamot and mint, while a heart of rose, orange blossom, lavender, rosemary and cinnamon adds depth and warmth. The fragrance is anchored by a rich foundation of sandalwood, guaiac wood, patchouli, amber and tonka, all captured in a transparent gold bottle. It's a perfect fusion of fresh, aromatic and luxurious notes

Fragrance family: Amber, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mint, Lemon

Middle notes: Lavender, Cinnamon

Base notes: Patchouli, Amber

title: Habdan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Habdan Eau de Parfum offers a harmonious blend of sweet and spicy notes. Its powerful saffron and incense aroma is enhanced by an encompassing amber hint. The aromatic top notes of incense and saffron give way to a fragrant heart of rose, apple, and agarwood, while the base notes of warm amber, maltol, and opopanax create a charismatic and balanced finish.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Saffron

Middle notes: Apple, Agarwood, Rose

Base notes: Amber, Maltol, Opopanax

title: Godolphin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted for the refined and sophisticated individual, Godolphin Eau de Parfum exudes a captivating blend of complex and deep aromas. Its opening notes of thyme, saffron, and cypress lead to a heart of rose, iris, and jasmine, while the narrative is anchored by rich woody scents of white cedarwood, vetiver, musk, and amber. The final touch of vanilla adds a luxurious dimension to this distinguished fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Leather, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Thyme, Saffron, Cypress

Middle notes: Roses, Iris, Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Vetiver, White Cedarwood, Musk

title: Palatine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Palatine Eau de Parfum is an empowering and sophisticated fragrance that centers on a modern floral bouquet and features fresh, fruity, and powdery notes. The scent opens with mandarin, bergamot, and pear, leading to a bold and contemporary violet petal. With a velvety finish, this fragrance is complemented by notes of musk and creamy sandalwood, evoking confidence, assertiveness, and freedom.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Pear

Middle notes: Violet Petal, Lavandin, Floral bouquet

Base notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk, Vanilla

title: Meliora Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Meliora is a well-crafted blend of fruity and floral notes that exude a charming and romantic aura. Notes of dreamy rose, jasmine tea, and ylang-ylang create a refreshing and alluring floral scent, complemented by the opening notes of fruity berries and lemon. The heart of the fragrance is enhanced by a touch of sweet vanilla, musk, and cedarwood, adding depth and warmth to the overall experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Berries, Raspberry, Lemon essence

Middle notes: Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine Tea

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Cedarwood

title: Kalan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Kalan Eau de Parfum boasts a complex yet balanced olfactory profile. Its enchanting opening combines black pepper and spices with vibrant blood orange, while its heart of orange blossom and lavender adds depth. As it develops, hints of white sandalwood, moss, and precious wood emerge, resulting in a harmonious and seductive aroma. Kalan truly captivates the senses with its top notes and base notes that come together to create a signature olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Black Pepper, Spices

Middle notes: Lavender, Solar notes, Orange Blossom Absolute

Base notes: Precious Wood, Oakmoss, White Sandalwood

title: Pegasus Exclusif Parfum
body_html:
Experience the allure and strength of Pegasus Exclusif Parfum, a one-of-a-kind blend of masculine and stimulating notes. The sensual vanilla is paired with hints of amber, sandalwood, natural oud, and guaiac, creating a captivating aroma. The floral heart notes of jasmine, lavender, bitter almond, and geranium perfectly balance the fruity and spicy elements of bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom, and heliotrope

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Cardamom, Heliotrope

Middle notes: Jasmine, Lavender, Bitter almond, Geranium

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Natural Oud, Gaiac Wood

title: Oriana Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A carefully crafted eau de parfum that blends gourmand, floral, and fruity notes into a unique sensory experience. Rich layers of flaky sweetness, softness, and sensuality create a mille-feuille effect. The fragrance opens with a sparkling burst of mandarin and Italian bergamot, followed by a joyful blend of orange blossom and blackcurrant. A delicate blend of marshmallow and airy Chantilly cream adds an addictive touch, while the ambrette and musk base notes bring a subtle carnal element to the composition. A truly luminous delight.

Fragrance family: Floral, Gourmand, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Grapefruit

Middle notes: Orange blossom, Blackcurrant, Raspberry

Base notes: Marshmallow, Ambrette, Chantilly cream, Musk

title: Oajan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience an unforgettable sensory journey with Oajan Eau de Parfum. This exquisite scent radiates warmth through rich top notes of honey and cinnamon, accented by the fruity nuances of osmanthus. The heart of the fragrance is a true delight, with sweet and smooth notes of amber, labdanum, and benzoin, all beautifully blended with vanilla, tonka bean, patchouli, and Davan. A truly refined and sophisticated addition to any lifestyle.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Honey, Cinnamon, Osmanthus

Middle notes: Amber, Labdanum, Benzoin

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Davan

title: Perseus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Perseus Eau de Parfum is an illuminating and invigorating scent with a long-lasting presence. This fragrance boasts a refreshing grapefruit and vetiver combination that instantly energizes and adds a touch of earthiness to the senses. As it lingers, Perseus reveals a refined, comforting, and sensual vetiver aroma, enriched by the addition of ambergris and long-lasting dry woods. Inspired by the early morning at the royal residence of Marly, this perfume captures the feeling of the first rays of sun awakening the château, warming its gardens, and sparkling its fountains. It is a sun-kissed scent that celebrates the radiance of citrus and makes for a unique morning ritual.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Blackcurrant Bud

Middle notes: Vetiver, Green Mandarin, Geranium

Base notes: Dry Woods, Cashmere Wood, Ambergris Accord

title: Pegasus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Pegasus Eau de Parfum is rooted in tradition and embodies the essence of a true gentleman. Its distinguished scent combines a perfect balance of fruit, wood, and spices, derived from cypress, bergamot, and heliotrope. The heart of the fragrance showcases a seamless fusion of jasmine, lavender, and bitter almond, resulting in a powdery and invigorating aroma. The base notes linger on the skin, with a vanilla and sandalwood blend accented by a touch of amber.

Fragrance family: Amber, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cypress, Bergamot, Heliotrope

Middle notes: Jasmine, Lavender, Bitter almond

Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood

title: Wild Stride Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wild Stride Eau de Parfum embodies the spirit of independence and rebellion against conformity. Its unique blend of galbanum and bergamot provides an invigorating energy, while the addition of pineapple and a burnt wood accord creates a balance between confidence and strength. Olibanum and patchouli in the base add a timeless complexity, symbolizing defiance and autonomy. This daring fragrance stands tall as a maverick, inspiring others with its innovation and independence, unconcerned with the opinions of others.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Galbanum

Middle notes: Pineapple and Woody Notes

Base notes: Oakmoss, Patchouli and Olibanum

title: Nº6 Brume Radieuse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A carefully crafted contemporary fragrance that defies conventional standards. This scent harmonizes deep smoky undertones, delicate sensual elements, and understated fruity hints. Charged with seductive energy, it conjures images of a warm, resinous evening; guaranteed to capture attention and elicit fascinated admiration.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blackcurrant Syrup

Middle notes: Coconut, Peach, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli and Amber

title: Nº10 Desir Du Coeur Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the true desires of the heart with this modern, artistic fragrance. Unlike traditional blending methods, this parfum uses a special blend of captives and molecules to create a one-of-a-kind scent that is uniquely tailored to each individual.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon Zest

As you continue on this journey, you will uncover uncharted territories of the East.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Clary Sage, Apple and Cardamom

Middle notes: Woodsy Notes, Papyrus and Damask Rose

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Musk, Patchouli, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Ardent Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ardent is a fragrance that stirs up feelings of love and indulgence. With a blend of saffron, Turkish rose, and beeswax, it ignites the senses and provides a touch of true indulgence. Argarwood, precious amber, and benzoin add depth to the scent, creating a captivating and addictive fragrance. Embrace the warmth and passion of Ardent, a perfume that captures both new beginnings and enduring love.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Turkish Rose, Saffron, Coriander and Carrot Seeds

Middle notes: Rose, Beeswax, Jasmine and Hedione

Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud), Benzoin, Amber, Labdanum and Musk

title: Azrak Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Azrak Eau de Parfum evokes the rarest blue of the ocean, with a bottle featuring a unique blue finish and gold shield. This fragrance soothes and uplifts with tropical notes of pineapple, lemon and cardamom, followed by the gentle caress of rose, jasmine and spicy accord, and finished with cedarwood, musk and amber. Inspired by the hypnotic motion of the ocean, Azrak offers a calming and refreshing experience. Captivate your senses with Azrak.

Fragrance family: Woody, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Pineapple, Lemon, Cassis, Cardamom and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Rose, Spices, Jasmine, Violet, Lily-of-the-Valley and Violet Leaf

Base notes: Woodsy Notes, Musk, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Cedar and Sandalwood

title: Back To Paradise Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Embrace the enchanting scent of Back to Paradise and let it transport you to a world of passion and beauty. With top notes of pineapple, bergamot, violet, and ylang ylang, complemented by hints of sambac jasmine, magnolia, sandalwood, vanilla, musk, and amber crystals, this perfume evokes a sense of romantic escape to exotic destinations. Let the gentle warmth of this alluring fragrance whisk you away to a dreamy paradise, tucked away from the hectic pace of reality. Revel in the intimate indulgence of Back to Paradise and lose yourself in its captivating allure.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet Leaf, Ylang-Ylang, Pineapple and Bergamot

Middle notes: Honey, Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Rose

Base notes: Benzoin, Sandalwood, Amber, Musk and Vanilla

title: Chariot Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the aura of confidence and adventure with Chariot Eau de Parfum. A blend of invigorating citrus and delicate florals converge into a daring base. This fragrance embodies the spirit and resilience of its namesake, Queen Boadicea, whose iconic statue stands on Westminster Bridge. Channel her fearless determination with Chariot, infused with distinctive spices, lush florals, and rich forest essences. Embrace your inner rebel and charge into life, unapologetically defying the status quo.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Berries, Black Currant, Apple, Lime and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Nutmeg, Cherry Blossom, Cardamom, Ylang-Ylang, Freesia, Jasmine, Neroli and Tuberose

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Benzoin, Saffron, Sandalwood, Musk, Papyrus, Cedar, Patchouli and Moss

title: Complex 2020 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the exclusive, concentrated version of Complex with Complex 2020 Eau de Parfum. This elevated fragrance retains the iconic elements of the original, but with an intensified herbal bouquet and deeper leather heart. The addition of incense-infused violet creates a divine and earthy scent, enhanced by oud and musks, making it a truly captivating perfume for any lover of fragrance.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sage and Basil

Middle notes: Olibanum and Violet

Base notes: Musk, Leather and Agarwood (Oud)

title: Defender Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Kamila Lelakova, the first female perfumer for Boadicea the Victorious, has created Defender, a bold and enduring fragrance infused with layers of unique notes. It opens with a rebellious mix of zesty ginger, grapefruit, licorice, and honeyed cognac, followed by the ultimate combination of night-blooming jasmine, myrrh, and leather. This extraordinary composition is both captivating and evocative.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Fruits, Cognac, Honey, Licorice, Ginger and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Myrrh, Hay, Orange Blossom and Night Blooming Jasmine

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Peru Balsam, Musk, Red Amber, Leather, Benzoin and Labdanum

title: Divine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Divine Eau de Parfum invokes a heavenly essence with its blend of waxy, lemony aldehydes and bright mandarin. Its ethereal heart contains a pulsating floral bouquet that exudes an intimate and sensuous aroma. The richness of musk and sandalwood adds depth and creates a timeless scent that transcends the ordinary. With Divine, experience a sense of opulence and perfection that will bring a moment of tranquility and optimism to each day.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Flowers, Red Berries and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Violet and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Resin, Sandalwood, Styrax and Woody Notes

title: Exotic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Addictive and sensual, Exotic is a luxurious scent that captivates both men and women. Launched in 2018, it features top notes of Litchi and Bergamot that create a refreshing and invigorating opening, while middle notes of Peony, Rose, and Vanilla add a touch of softness. Finishing with base notes of Musk, Incense, Vetiver, and Amber, Exotic is a timeless blend that lasts throughout the day, making it the perfect addition to your fragrance collection.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Litchi and Bergamot

Middle notes: Peony, Rose and Vanilla

Base notes: Musk, Incense, Vetiver and Amber

title: Glorious Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the splendor of summer, Glorious Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that captures the essence of British orchards in full bloom. Its playful scents evoke memories of carefree days, from the balsam and nutmeg notes to the enchanting blend of fruits and florals. Boadicea the Victorious, creators of this perfume, offer a truly sublime and luxurious experience with every spritz. Don't miss out on this captivating fragrance that will transport you to a forgotten, yet delightful, childhood.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Peach, Pineapple

Middle notes: Rose, Cardamom, Jasmine, Nutmeg

Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Amber, Cedarwood, Musk, Sandalwood

title: Imperial Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Imperial Eau de Parfum embodies the true essence of power and authority. Its enchanting blend of delicate floral notes and exotic woody scents, such as Indian sandalwood, Cambodian oud, and guaiac wood, creates a captivating fragrance that demands attention. The addition of angelica and rosewood adds a touch of tranquility, leaving one feeling empowered and secure, like a regal ruler. This fragrance is a truly majestic choice, evoking a sense of nostalgia while exuding a calming and empowering aura.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender

Middle notes: Jasmine, Galbanum

Base notes: Leather, Oud, Patchouli, Sandalwood

title: Cocoa Kimiya Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
From the perspective of a product expert, the Cocoa Kimiya Extrait de Parfum from Atelier des Ors offers a captivating interplay of light and dark, blending the celestial sweetness of cocoa with the lustrous glow of cardamom. At an exceptional 40% concentration, this captivating extract enhances every delicate essence, intertwining deep patchouli and silky vanilla for a tantalizing balance of temptation and intrigue. Luxurious and daring, it lingers like a well-kept secret, alternating between indulgent warmth and tantalizing complexity. More than just a scent, Cocoa Kimiya is an alchemical offering, a divine elixir for those who seek the extraordinary.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Cardamom Guatemala SFE, Cocoa Absolute SFE.

Middle notes: Walnut, Patchouli Indonesia Essence.

Base notes: Vanilla Planifolia Madagascar Infusion, Amber Woods, White Musks.

title: Kawa Karda Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Through conquests and explorations, coffee has been a faithful companion, carried in the pockets and holds of adventurers and merchant ships. Inextricably linked to the process of border exploration and world discovery, this fragrance is a masterful blend of potent, alluring coffee and invigorating cardamom. Crafted with 40% extract and the finest ingredients, this perfume captures the essence and limitless imagination of its creators.

Fragrance family: Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Guatemala SFE green cardamom, Santos SFE coffee.

Middle notes: Centifolia Rose infusion, Saffron, Virginia Cedar USA Essence.

Base notes: Vetiver Haiti SFE.

title: Aube Rubis Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the essence of dawn with Aube Rubis, a vibrant fragrance that transforms from cool grapefruit and blackcurrant notes to a rich, warm blend of sage and patchouli.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Currant, Grapefruit and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris, Sage and Violet

Base notes: Patchouli, Haitian Vetiver and Praline

title: Choeur Des Anges Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the harmonious voices of angels, Choeur des Anges Eau de Parfum is a symphonic creation that celebrates the beauty of color and scent. With notes of blood orange, carrot seeds, radiant fruits, and flowers, this fragrance captures the essence of joie de vivre. An ambrosial blend of osmanthus and honey adds a golden nectar quality, while ambered tones bring a lyrical and uplifting element. This joyous and soothing scent invites one to embrace and find happiness in its primal, heavenly notes.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Blood Orange, Pear and Black Currant

Middle notes: Osmanthus, Orange Blossom and Carrot Seeds

Base notes: Honey, Amber and Cedar

title: Cuir Sacre Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This rich and intense scent embodies the essence of Andalusian dreams, inspired by a leisurely stroll through Cordoba's Old Town. The notes of leather, wood, Saffron, and Vetiver pay homage to the heritage of cordovan leather, often known as "Gold Leather." These exquisite ingredients impart a bold and sophisticated character to Cuir Sacré.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Cypress and Juniper Berries

Middle notes: Incense, Saffron and Cedar Needles

Base notes: Vetiver, Leather and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: Riviera Lazuli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience suspended moments of pure bliss as the warmth of sunlight touches the azure hued water. Revive your spirit with sprays of salt water and refresh yourself with a tart citronade. Riviera Lazuli captures these moments with a new perspective, combining fresh citrus notes with precious woods and a hint of caramel spice. The scent of driftwood and sun-kissed skin lingers in the air, creating a picture postcard memory. Indulge in this tantalizing, refreshing scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cypress, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Sage, Cedar and Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Balsam Fir, Immortelle and Incense

title: Larmes Du Desert Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Larmes Du Désert embodies the Middle Eastern perfume tradition, incorporating Oriental and Incense elements. It pays tribute to the birthplace of perfumery with a luxurious blend of Gold, Myrrh, and Incense, creating a divine and resonating fragrance. This spiritual nectar combines the sensuality of noble amber and enchanting myrrh with the alluring spiciness of incense, resulting in a captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense and Cypress

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Cedar and Patchouli

Base notes: Woodsy Notes, Benzoin, Amber and Citruses

title: Rouge Saray Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rouge Sarây captures the essence of ancient trade routes that once crossed the Middle East, evoking a sense of adventure and romance. This Eau de Parfum combines the enticing scents of spices and the rich, fruity aroma of dates, symbolizing abundance and hospitality. The fragrance also features notes of sweet vanilla and heliotrope for added intensity and warmth. Sandalwood adds a sensual touch, while guaiac wood provides smoky tonalities and an ambered undertone. With its irresistible aroma, Rouge Sarây embodies the luxurious indulgence and welcoming spirit of caravanserais in the desert.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum, Cinnamon and Jasmine

Middle notes: Dates, Patchouli and Heliotrope

Base notes: Vanilla, Peru Balsam, Guaiac Wood and Sandalwood

title: L Red Tea Vetiver Perfume
body_html:
The "L Red Tea Vetiver" fragrance by Clive Christian is a sophisticated blend that combines the smooth, honeyed warmth of Rooibos Tea with the earthy vibrance of Vetiver. This unique scent evokes the timeless allure of African soils and is enhanced by delicate spices. Encased in Clive Christian's iconic bottle, the amber-toned glass mirrors the luxurious essence and raw beauty of its ingredients. A tribute to tradition and terroir, this perfume is more than just a fragrance, but an elegant olfactory journey.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Rooibos Tea and Vetiver

Base notes: Sandalwood and Musk

title: Moroccan Medjool Perfum
body_html:
The Moroccan Medjool fragrance is a luxurious blend of fruity amber, perfectly balancing the sweet caramel undertones of dates with the warm, golden essence of the desert. Upon first spray, bright and fruity notes accompany a fresh and dewy citrus aroma, as if setting the stage for a sunrise over the oasis. Intertwined with a bouquet of rose and jasmine petals, the floral scents of Morocco come to life. The addition of cashmeran and ambergris, known for their mineral-like warmth, evoke the arid heat of the desert air, while notes of vanilla and caramel add a touch of candied sweetness, reminiscent of the honeyed flavor of dates. The end result is a rich and complex fragrance, perfectly capturing the essence of Moroccan Medjool.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dates, Cardamom, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Dates, Rose, Jasmine, Ylang Ylang and Carnation

Base notes: Cashmere Wood, Caramel, Ambergris, Vanilla and oak moss

title: Spiky Muse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted by fragrance experts, Spiky Muse Eau de Parfum by Ex Nihilo embodies a fiercely feminine spirit. Featuring a blend of Rose, upcycled Strawberry extract, and Pistachio accord, this scent delivers a mouth-watering and exotic experience. Deep notes of ambery woods add a bold and sophisticated touch.

Fragrance family: Woody, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Strawberry

Middle notes: Rose and Pistachio

Base notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix™, Cedarwood and Tonka Bean

title: Portrait Of A Lady Hair Mist
body_html: This exquisite hair mist by Frédéric Malle, Portrait Of A Lady, is a delicate and refreshing variation of the original perfume formula. Its enchanting blend of rose, sandalwood, cinnamon, blackcurrant, and patchouli leaves the hair with a subtle, aromatic scent. Perfect for adding a touch of luxury to your daily routine.

title: Promise Hair Mist
body_html: This Frédéric Malle hair mist is designed to add a delicate and refreshing scent to your hair. It not only serves as a unique way to apply perfume, but also takes advantage of your hair's natural heat and ability to retain fragrance, allowing for a continual diffusion of the scent.

title: The Heart of Leo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As part of the luxurious Alchemist's Garden fragrance collection by Gucci, The Heart of Leo Eau de Parfum embodies the grandeur and might of the king of the jungle through a unique combination of sweet and tangy aromas. The resinous scent of myrrh and the smoky aroma of incense are expertly blended with an invigorating blackcurrant accord, creating a fruity and amber-like fragrance that mirrors the strength and nobility of its namesake.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Currant

Middle notes: Olibanum

Base notes: Myrrh

title: Fiori Di Neroli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the enchanting allure of Gucci's The Alchemist's Garden Fiori Di Neroli Eau de Parfum, a work of art created through the magic of olfactory alchemy. This luminous blend of floral, citrus, and woody scents captures the essence of the Mediterranean with its rare Italian Neroli Essential Oil, carefully crafted through centuries-old techniques. Hints of fresh Petitgrain harmonize with the earthy notes of Cedarwood, embodying the transformative essence of water in this exquisite fragrance. Encased in a luxurious gold bottle representing the precious Neroli oil, the orange blossom emblem honors the rich Italian heritage of fragrance-making. Expertly crafted by master alchemists, this scent pays homage to tradition, innovation, and the golden essence of nature.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Petitgrain, Bergamot and Green Mandarin

Middle notes: Neroli, Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Orcanox™, Cereals and Virginia Cedar

title: Where My Heart Beats Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gucci's Where My Heart Beats Eau de Parfum follows a sustainable approach to perfume-making, utilizing alcohol from recycled carbon emissions for their first fragrance. This process not only reduces water consumption and agricultural land use, but also provides a beautiful green scent. The eau de parfum features a captivating blend of roses, peonies, violet leaves, and white musk, and is part of The Alchemist's Garden collection, which allows for endless scent combinations.

Fragrance family: Green, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet Leaves

Middle notes: Peony

Base notes: White Musk

title: A Floral Verse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gucci's Where My Heart Beats Eau de Parfum follows a sustainable approach to perfume-making, utilizing alcohol from recycled carbon emissions for their first fragrance. This process not only reduces water consumption and agricultural land use, but also provides a beautiful green scent. The eau de parfum features a captivating blend of roses, peonies, violet leaves, and white musk, and is part of The Alchemist's Garden collection, which allows for endless scent combinations.

Fragrance family: Green, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet Leaves

Middle notes: Peony

Base notes: White Musk

title: Mystic Bliss Parfum
body_html:
Mystic Bliss is a celestial and addictive scent, inspired by Tasmania's starry night sky and pure Antarctic air. With aromatic notes of fig, cassis, and Kunzea, it captures the island's ancient and untouched feel, while cedarwood and incense add a grounding warmth. Herbaceous and green, the scent evolves into a rich and woody finish with sandalwood, labdanum, and vetiver.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Mint and Cassis

Middle notes: Kunzea

Base notes: Cedar, Orris and Incense

title: Island Lush Parfum
body_html:
Island Lush Parfum features South Pacific Sandalwood - a wild, exotic scent that captures the essence of tropical islands. Hand-harvested and distilled in Australia, this luxurious perfume is a tribute to the country's expertise in botanical research and development. Each bottle is coated in 24 carat gold, a nod to the Australian Gold Rush and the inspiration behind Goldfield & Banks fragrances.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Nutmeg, Pink Pepper, Ginger and Bergamot

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Cedar, Geranium and Iris

Base notes: Leather, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Vetiver and Patchouli

title: Irreverent Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in a clash of scents with Irreverent Eau de Parfum. The sweet freshness of bergamot, elemi, and lavender mingle with the balm of styrax and aoud, while patchouli's impertinent charm and sandalwood's carefree aura add to the daring blend. Let the notes and accords taunt and jostle each other in a playful, irreverent dance.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi, Lavender and Bergamot

Middle notes: Styrax, Agarwood (Oud) and Coffee

Base notes: Amber, Patchouli and Sandalwood

title: 1472 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A solar bouquet of Ylang-Ylang combines with white Artemisia to illuminate a sacred pillar of Cinnamon and Frankincense. Meanwhile, the scent of Jasmine blossoms from the eves of Eden adds a psychedelic touch. A dance of light and shadows is accompanied by gourmand winds, forbidden fruits, the liquorous bite of Rum Absolute, and the lingering scent of bodily balsams, Amber and Benzoin. This fragrance evokes a love that encompasses all human emotions, bridging the gap between Heaven and Hell.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ylang-Ylang, Artemisia and Solar Notes

Middle notes: Jasmine, Olibanum and Cinnamon

Base notes: Rum, Benzoin and Amber

title: Cashmere & Palo Santo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious scent of Cashmere & Palo Santo, inspired by the complexity of a woman. This addictive fragrance from the Donna Karan Cashmere Collection combines mouth-watering golden peach with warm Labdanum and sensual Cashmere Woods for a distinctive and alluring aroma. Hints of Palo Santo add a unique touch to this captivating scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach

Middle notes: Cashmere Wood and Labdanum

Base notes: Vanilla and Palo Santo

title: Cashmere & Wild Fig Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience an unexpected olfactory journey with Donna Karan's Cashmere Collection. Cashmere & Wild Fig is a woody floral fragrance that captures the essence of womanhood. The top notes of black pepper and bergamot create a fresh and floral opening, while the heart of Wild Fig and Bamboo adds warmth to the blend. The dry-down reveals a harmonious fusion of earthy, musky, mineral, and salty notes, providing a truly unique scent experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Freesia, Bergamot, Rose and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Fig and Bamboo

Base notes: Musk, Cedar, Mineral notes and Earthy Notes

title: Cashmere & Tiare Flower Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cashmere & Tiare Flower Eau de Parfum is a captivating fragrance from the Donna Karan Cashmere Collection. Inspired by the layers of a woman, this modern solar floral scent combines tropical freshness, gentle floralcy, and ambery woodiness. The fragrance opens with sun-drenched Bergamot and sweet Lemon, while Tiare Flower adds a unique sweet and creamy character. The cocooning warmth of vetiver creates a magnificent, ambery cashmere conclusion.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Tiare Flower

Base notes: Cashmere Wood and Vetiver

title: Cashmere & Tunisian Neroli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Cashmere & Tunisian Neroli Eau de Parfum, part of the Donna Karan Cashmere Collection, captures the essence of a woman through its bright citrus floral scent. The fragrance starts with a lively burst of citrus, awakening the senses with its invigorating and zesty aroma. A luminous bouquet of Tunisian Neroli then emerges, combining to create a complex and layered fragrance. Finally, the scent settles into a soft and balanced finish with cedarwood, leaving a gentle and long-lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Neroli

Base notes: Cedar

title: Gold Sublime Tonka Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the luxurious scent of Gold Sublime Tonka Eau de Parfum. Perfect for the sophisticated Cavalli lover, this captivating fragrance combines cinnamon, sage, and tobacco with the alluring tonka bean. Experience an enticing aroma that will leave you feeling truly sublime.
