Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon, Elemi, Geranium

Middle notes: Clary Sage, Tobacco, Frankincense

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Wheat Bran, Copaiba Balsam

title: Velour Saffron Eau de Parfum
body_html:
For the aficionado of velour and Cavalli, experience a warm, opulent, and sensual scent with Velour Saffron. This exquisite fragrance seamlessly combines some of the rarest and most precious spices, resulting in a luxurious and smooth leather finish.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Velvet, Leather, Agarwood (Oud) and Incense

Base notes: Myrrh and Woodsy Notes

title: Noble Woods Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Conceived as a scented journey, the Roberto Cavalli Gold Collection showcases a diverse range of perfumes that delve into various moods and atmospheres. Each fragrance, expertly crafted with the finest materials, centers around a distinct note and is enriched with carefully selected ingredients to bring out its unique characteristics. Suitable for both men and women, these exceptional scents are designed to stimulate the senses and ignite the imagination.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cedar, Patchouli

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood

Base notes: Saffron, Cardamom

title: Wild Incense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
For those who appreciate the exotic, Wild Incense is perfect. This luxurious scent combines rare spices from around the globe, resulting in a hypnotic fragrance that effortlessly captures the senses. From start to finish, its warm and leathery notes take you on a mystical journey of stimulating aromas.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Dates, Cognac and Olibanum

Middle notes: Black Leather, Guaiac Wood and Rose

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Vetiver

title: Woodiris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Woodiris Eau de Parfum by Roberto Cavalli is a gender-neutral scent, launched in 2022. Created with expert knowledge, it features top notes of Mandora and Bitter Orange, a middle note of Iris, and base notes of Sandalwood, Patchouli, and Musk, making it a must-have addition to any fragrance collection.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandora and Bitter Orange

Middle notes: Iris

Base notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli and Musk

title: Divine Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Discover a secret room in the grand palazzo filled with hidden treasures and precious artifacts from around the world, including a sextet of dark flasks adorned with a golden monogram. Experience the luxurious and complex scent of Divine Oud, blending oud with notes of roses, raspberry, and violet.

Fragrance family: Oud, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Oud, Violet

Middle notes: Cypriol Essence, Cedarwood, Ambriox

Base notes: Patchouli, Musk, Sandalwood

title: B683 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This fragrance is not just another game of focus, rather, it showcases a new facet of B683 - a sensual woody-leather depth. The mingling of Laos' natural oud and tart green apple creates a one-of-a-kind blend, while the sandalwood fades into a formidable patchouli leather. This strong and distinctive character is intensified by the high concentration of 40% in the extrait.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Black Pepper, Nutmeg and Red Chilli Pepper

Middle notes: Violet Leaf, Musk, Labdanum and Amber

Base notes: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Oakmoss

title: Ganymede Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This perfume extract begins with a powerful dose of immortelle, resulting in an addictive and spicy fragrance. The inclusion of myrrh and incense adds a rich, almost liquorice-like element, while the trail finishes with explosive mineral notes from Akigalawood and mandarin, creating Ganymede's signature scent.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Italian Mandarin

Middle notes: Chinese Osmanthus, Immortelle and Violet Leaf

Base notes: Mineral notes, Suede, Akigalawood, Musk, Cedar and Patchouli

title: Ocean The Rive Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Ocean The Rive Extrait de Parfum, launched in February 2025, is a refreshing and invigorating blend of marine accords, warm blue chamomile and basil, and zesty citrus undertones. With vibrant sea breeze and herbal notes like armoise and basil, and calming blue chamomile taking center stage, it offers a crisp, aquatic, and uplifting experience. The sophisticated and aromatic depth is provided by its citrusy undertones, while the warm, smooth, and lasting impression comes from the base notes of cashmere wood, patchouli, vanilla, musk, and amber. Nose behind the fragrance is Gökhan Şimşek.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Notes, Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit, Chamomile

Middle notes: Amber, Basil, Bergamot, Musk, Mugwort

Base notes: Cashmere Wood, Vanilla, Patchouli

title: Muse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Muse Eau de Parfum is a blend of sensuality, fruity and floral notes. Its mysterious character and destiny seem to captivate the senses. From its intoxicating white floral bouquet, to its heart of labdanum and jasmine, and its sweet, rich base of raspberries and patchouli, Muse is an alluring fragrance. This unique parfum also features a silk neck scarf, designed by Xerjoff and produced by renowned silk manufacturers in Lake Como.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Plum, White Flowers and Leather

Middle notes: Jasmine, Davana and Labdanum

Base notes: Raspberry, Patchouli, Amber and Benzoin

title: Kurky Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Invigorate your senses with Kurky by Maison Francis Kurkdjian, a radiant Eau de Parfum that captures the irresistible allure of tutti frutti candy. Be enveloped in a velvety embrace of white musk as this scent evokes the creamy warmth of vanilla and musk, delivering a delightful, gourmand experience. Inspired by the pure joy of life and the freedom of imagination, Kurky awakens your inner child, inviting you to rediscover the lightness of carefree moments. More than just a fragrance, it is a luminous burst of happiness - a sunbeam for the soul. Let its enchanting aroma transport you to a world of fantasy, where every day is infused with luxury and playful sophistication.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry and Peach

Middle notes: Gummy Candies and Fruity Notes

Base notes: White Musk and Vanilla

title: Writer Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted for the wordsmith in all of us, the Writer Eau de Parfum captures the alluring scent of ink and imagination. As you breathe in the notes of this fragrance, let your creativity soar and your words come to life. Let the power of the written word transport you to a world of limitless possibilities.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Thyme

Middle notes: Egyptian Jasmine

Base notes: Mate, Olibanum

title: Actor Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the transformation of becoming a replica of a stranger and immersing yourself in their unique identity. Through this, gain a new and diverse perspective on life.

Fragrance family: Amber, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose

Middle notes: Pink Pepper

Base notes: Incense

title: Sculptor Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In the sculptor's studio, you encounter various materials, each possessing unique qualities. Granite's hardness, tempered metals' ductility, the powerful mallet, and precise chisel all come together in a clash of titans, ceaselessly working until the idea is fully materialized.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fennel, Iris

Middle notes: Star Anise

Base notes: Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

title: Ballerina Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A graceful figure wrapped in flowers, satin, tulle, and dust, seemingly defying gravity with each jump courtesy of ballet. The essential desire to dance and feel accompanied by a confident presence that can conquer space.

Fragrance family: Amber, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose

Middle notes: Black Currant, Iris

Base notes: White Amber

title: Lac.ton.ic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Delight in the dreamy, gourmand scent of Lactonic Eau de Parfum. Experience playful hints of creamy milk, sweet almond, and juicy mandarin that blend with the tropical allure of coconut. As the fragrance unfolds, delicate lily of the valley dances with pistachio and ylang-ylang, creating a heart that is both enchanting and irresistible. The journey concludes with a rich base of caramel, ambrostar, and sandalwood, leaving a lasting trail of sweetness and warmth on your skin.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Milk, Mandarin, Almond, Bergamot and Coconut

Middle notes: Lily of the Valley, Ylang Ylang and Pistachio

Base notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Caramel and Ambrostar

title: Santal Boise Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In October 2019, Versace released the Atelier Versace collection, consisting of six perfumes: Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé, and Vanille Rouge. Each fragrance is centered around one ingredient and was developed by five perfumers. Santal Boisé, created by Christophe Raynaud, combines Sri Lanka sandalwood, saffron, and a cypriole plant to create a luxurious scent experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron

Middle notes: Sandalwood

Base notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: Vanille Rouge Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vanille Rouge Eau de Parfum is one of six fragrances in Versace's Atelier Versace collection, released in October 2019. The other scents, including Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, and Santal Boisé, all focus on a single key ingredient. Created by perfumer Jordi Fernandez, Vanille Rouge combines Madagascar vanilla with accords of powdered musk, almonds, and rose.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Madagascar Vanilla

Middle notes: Rose

Base notes: Musk, Almond

title: Iris D'elite Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Iris D'elite Eau de Parfum is distinguished by its dry woody tones and accented with a lively spice element that enhances the powdery essence of the fragrance. The iris, a revered flower in Italian culture, exudes luxuriousness - its delicate petals exude warmth through a blend of tonka beans and musky amber notes.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris

Middle notes: Amber

Base notes: Tonka Bean

title: Ambre Nectar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience sophistication and alluring elegance with Versace Ambre Nectar Eau de Parfum. Launched in 2024, this unisex fragrance features a spicy, woody blend of pink berries, saffron, caramel, cedar wood, oud wood, vanilla, sandalwood, and benzoin. Elevate your senses with this luxurious scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Caramel, Oud and Cedar

Base notes: Benzoin, Vanilla and Sandalwood

title: Rose Flamboyante Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Versace Rose Flamboyante fragrance, part of the 2024 Atelier Versace line, offers a delicate yet powerful blend of floral notes and spice, creating a timeless and elegant scent. The signature packaging features the fragrance's name engraved on a sculptural glass bottle, adorned with the iconic Atelier Versace logo.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange and Cardamom

Middle notes: Rose, Geranium and Patchouli

Base notes: Musk, Cedar and Vetiver

title: Cedrat De Diamante Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In October 2019, Versace released the Atelier Versace collection, consisting of six perfumes. These fragrances include Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé, and Vanille Rouge. Each of these creations focuses on one key ingredient, and was crafted by five perfumers. Of the six, Cédrat de Diamante stands out as a citrusy, Mediterranean-inspired blend of lemon, grapefruit, cedar, and vetiver, developed by Marie Salamagne.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Grapefruit, Italian Lemon

Middle notes: Cedar

Base notes: Vetiver

title: Figue Blanche Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In October 2019, Versace released the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes. The scents, named Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé, and Vanille Rouge, each feature a central ingredient and were developed by five perfumers. Figue Blanche, created by Marypierre Julien, incorporates fresh figs, mandarin, bergamot, neroli, jasmine, and rose essential oils.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Bergamot

Middle notes: Jasmine, Rose

Base notes: Neroli, Mandarin Orange

title: Tabac Imperial Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Tabac Imperial Eau de Parfum exquisitely blends tobacco absolute, Provence honey, and benzoin for a delectable scent. The addition of everlasting absolute adds a distinct aromatic touch, while refined woods such as patchouli and cypriol add depth and character to this elegant fragrance.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tobacco, Honey

Middle notes: Patchouli, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Benzoin

Base notes: Immortelle, Woodsy Notes

title: Rêve De Myrrhe Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Explore the captivating scent of Versace Rêve de Myrrhe, a new unisex fragrance released in 2024. This amber fragrance features the alluring resinous note of myrrh, which adds a delightful complexity to the overall composition. The top notes of mandarin and pink berries give way to a heart of iris, tuberose, and akigalawood, and finally settle into a base of vanilla, fir balsam, and cistus.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper and Mandarin

Middle notes: Akigalawood, Iris and Tuberose

Base notes: Balsam Fir, Vanilla and Labdanum

title: Fleur de Mate Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The Fleur de Maté Eau de Parfum by Versace Atelier is a powerful blend of dark, enigmatic woods. The woody aroma of Atlas cedarwood is combined with patchouli and cypriol, creating a tribute to the rich and natural elements of the Earth. The intense and smoky scent of Maté absolute adds depth to the fragrance, while the leathery undertones enhance its complexity. The balsamic notes of cistus provide a luxurious touch to the precious scent of incense.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli, Mate

Middle notes: Cistus Incanus

Base notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Olibanum, Atlas Cedar

title: 7 Miglia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the energy and vibrancy of Italy with 7 Miglia Eau de Parfum. This woody and smoky fragrance is built on the genesis of all things, giving a sense of completeness and perfection. Let it be your constant companion seven days a week and feel the Calabrian vivacity of Bergamot. Undertones of cigar tobacco from Tonka beans make this fragrance a masterpiece.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot, Tunisian Neroli and Orange

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, White Flowers, elemi and Jasmine

Base notes: oak moss, Copaiba balm, Guaiac Wood, Virginian Cedar, Patchouli and Tonka Bean

title: Dolcetto Romano Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious and sophisticated scent of Dolcetto Romano Eau de Parfum. Infused with the sweet essence of "dolce vita" and the warm aroma of Indian sandalwood, this fragrance will transport you to a relaxing summer evening. Let the refreshing citrus notes of bergamot and the woody base of cedarwood indulge your senses. From the Fabbrica della Musa collection, this versatile and masculine scent is perfect for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Ginger and Apple

Middle notes: Violet, Lily and Jasmine

Base notes: Praline, Caramel, Madagascar Vanilla, Patchouli and Cedar

title: Magia Maestrale Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the tranquil scent of lavender from Provence, the land of the cold and dry Maestrale (mistral wind), and endless sunshine with Magia Maestrale Eau de Parfum. Like a refreshing breeze, this fragrance transports you to the exhilarating turquoise waters of summer: with the sky above, sand below, and a sense of inner peace. Let Magia Maestrale enchant you with its blend of sea notes and the warm, soothing fragrance of Gaiac Wood - reminiscent of gazing at the horizon from the shore. A fragrance that captures the essence of sunshine, bringing good luck and blessings to those who embrace its magic.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon, Lemon and Yellow Mandarin

Middle notes: Lavender, Geranium and Jasmine

Base notes: Guaiac Wood, Benzoin, Cedar and Madagascar Vanilla

title: Mia Alba Mistica Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This morning, the richly spiced golden hues of dawn spread across the Tuscan hills. The intense Neroli-infused sunlight reflects off the Comoros Ylang and captivating Jasmine Indian scents, creating a refreshing and invigorating atmosphere. It's a time of new beginnings and endless opportunities, a blank canvas waiting to be explored. Embrace the world with Mia Alba Mistica and experience the limitless possibilities that Fabbrica della Musa has to offer.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Peach, Orange Oil and Yellow Mandarin

Middle notes: Sage, Madagascar Ylang-Ylang, Neroli, Jasmine and Lavender

Base notes: Patchouli, Cedar and Nutmeg

title: Via Velluto Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Via Velluto Eau de Parfum is a unique fragrance that accompanies you on your journey towards success and elegance. With a combination of cross-cultural ingredients from the Mediterranean to Asia, inspired by the Silk Road, this scent embodies a sense of adventure and possibility. The delicate aroma of Damask rose, complemented by fruity notes, gives way to a warm and alluring base of musk, vetiver, and sandalwood. Embrace the world around you with confidence and sophistication as you wear Via Velluto.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Red Fruits, Raspberry and Incense

Middle notes: Peony, Damask Rose and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Musk, Leather, Haitian Vetiver and Australian Sandalwood

title: Imperial Wood Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the luxurious scent of Imperial Wood, a revolutionary Extrait De Parfum inspired by traditional Swedish rustic life. Featuring a high concentration of aromatic compounds, this Parfum is expertly formulated with rare ingredients, including natural cocoa, Indonesian agarwood, and Damask rose. The top notes boast a unique blend of thyme, tobacco leaves, woody-spicy saffron, and a touch of Frankincense. As the scent unfolds, cardamom, cinnamon sticks, tonka, vanilla, and cocoa emerge, culminating in a final note of sandalwood. With a base note of Indonesian agarwood, leather, and amber wood, Imperial Wood encapsulates the essence of a bygone era. Perfumer Ibrahim Al Zouabi crafted this exquisite composition, drawing inspiration from the traditional Swedish banquets of the seventeenth century, known for their use of spices and natural flowers. Embrace the enchanting aroma of Imperial Wood and transport yourself to a time of grandeur

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tobacco, Spicy Notes, Safraleine and Thyme

Middle notes: Cinnamon, Cacao, Cloves, Cardamom and Olibanum

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Leather and Incense

title: XVI Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The seventeenth century was marked by the rise of grand palaces, which were built to embody the ideal of paradise on earth. One such palace, the Drottningholm Palace in Stockholm, stands out with its exquisite details, luxurious marble columns, and stunning paintings. In the same spirit of beauty, this fragrance is crafted with a unique blend of patchouli, woods, and coriander, inviting one to experience the nobility and splendor of this magnificent palace.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Artemisia and Bergamot

Middle notes: Green Notes

Base notes: Cyperus esculentus, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood, Caraway, Olibanum, Patchouli and Juniper

title: Grand Musk Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Grand Musk embodies the rich and alluring essence of musk and takes you on an aromatic voyage. Its captivating presence is enhanced by perfumers who have long understood the power of animal pheromones to elevate fragrances. Originally derived from the musk deer, musk has become synonymous with a range of animal scents. This fragrance is a tribute to the untamed wilderness, the mystery of dense forests cloaked in mist. With its earthy, organic, woody, and animalistic notes, Grand Musk is a truly unique perfume.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Cardamom, Geranium, Coriander and Lavender

Middle notes: Musk, Blueberry, Cloves, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Vanilla, Ylang-Ylang, White Magnolia and Green Tea Flower

Base notes: Musk, Leather, Patchouli, Guaiac Wood, Incense, Cedar and Amber

title: Patchouli Dust Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the captivating scent of Patchouli Dust Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the pheromones and raindrops of the Swedish countryside, this unique fragrance blends notes of burnt wood and dry soil for a smoky, earthy aroma. Transport yourself to a cozy autumn day with every spritz.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Patchouli, Cypress, Artemisia, Saffron and Cardamom

Middle notes: Vetiver, Nutmeg and Taif Rose

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Amber, Tonka Bean and Cedar

title: Scandic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Scandic by Pana Dora offers a sophisticated scent with a combination of fruity and floral notes. The top notes include myrtle, white hyacinth, lavender, peach, passionfruit, and raspberry, providing a refreshing and energetic opening. The heart contains a blend of sandalwood flower, cassia, Bulgarian rose, and carnation, adding a delicate floral essence to the fragrance. The base notes of white musk, heliotrope, birch, labdanum, camphor, and honey create a luxurious and long-lasting finish.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Passionfruit, Raspberry, Peach, Myrtle and White Hyacinth

Middle notes: Cassia, Sandalwood Flower, Carnation and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: White Musk, Labdanum, Camphor, Birch, Honey and Heliotrope

title: Velvet Iris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Infused with the essence of nature's fresh breeze, this fragrance transcends cultural boundaries and redefines the soul's exploration for adventure and discovery. Inspired by a daring and courageous life motif, the bold fusion of vetiver and ambergris with rich dark chocolate and tangy oranges creates the journey of Velvet Iris. This modern and unconventional scent is a treasure trove of premium natural ingredients and majestic influences.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mint, Bitter Orange, Bergamot and Juniper

Middle notes: Dark Chocolate, Iris, Raspberry, Caramel and Pear

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Vetiver, Musk and Cedar

title: Swedish Leather Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Immerse yourself in the captivating scent of Swedish Leather Eau de Parfum. Expertly crafted in the heart of Sweden using the finest leather and saffron, this fragrance captures the rich heritage and natural landscape of the country. With its rugged masculinity and velvety smoothness, it surpasses ordinary colognes.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Incense, Saffron, Osmanthus, Ylang-Ylang and Sage

Middle notes: Leather, Basil, Resins and Violet

Base notes: Animal notes, Oud, Tobacco, Virginian Cedar, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Opuluxe Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Explore the intricate and lavish aromas of Opuluxe Eau de Parfum by Pana Dora. Combining an assortment of saffron, basil, vetiver, clary sage, myrrh, coriander, and Brazilian rosewood, this scent opens with a harmonious blend of earthy and herbal notes. The heart of the fragrance reveals osmanthus, cinnamon, thyme, and carnation, while the base is enriched with mineral notes, suede, musk, timur, benzoin, oakmoss, castoreum, and sandalwood, creating a full-bodied and captivating sensory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Brazilian Rosewood, Basil, Clary Sage, Coriander, Vetiver and Myrrh

Middle notes: Osmanthus, Cinnamon, Carnation and Thyme

Base notes: Sandalwood, Mineral notes, Musk, Castoreum, Benzoin, Oakmoss, Suede and Timur

title: Neroli Plein Sud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Take a journey through the essence of Moroccan neroli, expertly blended with spices and woods to create Néroli Plein Sud Eau de Parfum. Inspired by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's voyages, the renowned explorer and author of The Little Prince, Guerlain Perfumers have crafted a captivating fragrance that transports you between earth and sky. This fragrance serves as a fragrant travelogue, paying tribute to the famous adventurer's flight log through Guerlain's signature artistry.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Turmeric and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Neroli and Tunisian Orange Blossom

Base notes: Vetiver and Sandalwood

title: Feve Gourmande Eau de Parfum
body_html:
As a symbol of gourmet indulgence, the cocoa accord within Fève Gourmande Eau de Parfum beautifully balances the sweetness and bitterness of chocolate. Playing on this contrasting dynamic, the scent pushes the boundaries of gourmandise, resulting in a delectably surreal cocoa experience. With the addition of a floral and regal rose essence, spiced and rum notes invigorate the cocoa, while the woodsy elegance of patchouli and smoky tea add an air of mystery and sensuality. Expertly crafted by a perfumer, this cocoa accord captures the essence of chocolate with a subtle blend of bitter and sweet notes, creating a decadently indulgent sensory experience.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black pepper and Cloves

Middle notes: Honey, Chocolate

Base notes: Rum

title: Oud Khol Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Khôl is a scent that celebrates the color black through the use of rich, dark oud. Perfumer Thierry Wasser has expertly crafted a hue of absolute black, enhanced by aldehydes. The result is an intense, leather and charcoal-infused scent with hints of moss, carbon, and a surprising caramelized praline note. The hypnotic black aroma is sure to entice.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Agarwood (Oud)

Middle notes: Leather, Aldehydes

Base notes: Praline, Moss

title: Epices Volees Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The fragrance Epices Volées presents two distinct aspects. It entices with a crisp infusion of bergamot and lemon, as well as bold, spicy nuances. At its core, fiery patchouli meets the soothing sophistication of sandalwood. Épices Volées is the rebranded version of Arsène Lupin Voyou.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coriander, Artemisia, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Clove, Cardamom, Sage and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Benzoin and Labdanum

title: Poivre Samarcande Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the enrichment of each fragrance in the Poivre Samarcande line, inspired by new countries, languages, cultures, and extraordinary ingredients. With eight unique scents, exclusively found in Hermès stores, Poivre Samarcande boasts a fiery spice blended with sweet wood, reminiscent of the musky, peppery scent of oak. This vibrant homage transports one to the ancient city of Samarkand, known as the "must-see stopover" on the journey between the Western and Eastern worlds, where caravans full of spices would pass through.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Caraway, Paprika

Middle notes: oak moss, Patchouli, Green Notes

Base notes: Pepper, Oak, Virginia Cedar

title: Ambre Narguile Eau de Toilette
body_html:
From the perspective of an expert in the fragrance industry, the warm, sensual notes of Oriental fragrances are evocative of the East. With the rich blend of tobacco, fruit, honey, and spices, this scent captures the vibrant atmosphere of bustling nargile cafes where sweet smoke adds a touch of intoxication.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cinnamon, Honey, Rum, Caramel, Vanilla

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Tobacco, Labdanum

Base notes: Coumarin, Sesame, Musk, White Orchid

title: Rose Ikebana Eau de Toilette
body_html:
The Rose Ikebana Eau de Toilette is a part of a line consisting of eight fragrances, exclusively available in Hermès stores. With its contrasting blend of rose petal and crisp rhubarb, this minimalist bouquet perfectly captures the delicate essence of Japanese Ikebana floral art. Perfumer Jean Claude Ellena was inspired by the image of a dewy, delicate rose plucked in the early morning.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Tea, Rhubarb, Lemon

Middle notes: Cassia, Orange

Base notes: Musk, Spices, Fruity Notes

title: Violette Volynka Eau de Toilette
body_html:
The Violette Volynka Eau de Toilette blends two distinct materials, creating a refined and surprising scent that mirrors itself like two alter egos. Perfumer Christine Nagel was inspired by the intense aroma of Volynka leather and combined it with the delicate essence of violet, resulting in a perfectly balanced and unexpected fragrance. With a raw and powerful leather note, this Hermessence is suitable for both men and women.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: French Violet

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Violet Leaf

title: Iris Ukiyoe Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Iris Ukiyoé was added to the collection in November 2010. Perfumer Jean Claude Ellena, who also crafted eight other fragrances in this collection, envisioned this scent to revolve around the key ingredient of purple iris flower. This floral bouquet is a delicate blend of rose, orange blossom, and mandarin, showcasing a plethora of nuances and contrasts. The name Ukiyoé, derived from a Japanese word meaning "images of the floating world," reflects the perfumer's appreciation for Japanese artwork and nature's beauty.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris

Middle notes: African Orange Flower, Mandarin Orange

Base notes: Rose

title: Castiamanti Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The sophisticated and enigmatic Agatho Castiamanti is just one of the exclusive scents in the Pompei collection. It combines tradition and innovation with a timeless charm. This fragrance features an alluring blend of laurel, myrtle, saffron, jasmine, rose, and vanilla in a symphony of sweet, balsamic, and spicy notes that evoke a promise of everlasting love and reveal precious oriental influences. Agatho Parfum's Castiamanti is the epitome of a modern olfactory project, created with the finest ingredients and a nod to the masterful craftsmanship of its home country.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Laurels and Myrtle

Middle notes: Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Incense, Labdanum and White Musk

title: Rossopompeiano Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the essence of Pompei's symbolic frescoes with Rossopompeiano Extrait de Parfum. Its vibrant red backdrop, crafted from cinnabar mineral, evokes delicate and intricate graphics. This luxurious scent from Agatho Parfum features a rich blend of Damask rose, ylang-ylang, Sambac jasmine, and orange blossom, capturing the enigmatic allure of this ancient city.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Yellow Mandarin, Galban, Bitter, Almond

Middle Notes: Orange Flowers, Rose Damascena, Ylang Ylang, Jasmine Sambac, Heliotrope

Base Notes: Cashmere Wood, White Amber, Labdanum, Sandal, Cashmere , Patchouli, Vanilla

title: Adone Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The prestigious Pompei line by Agatho Parfum has been enriched with Adone Extrait de Parfum: an invigorating, radiant, and ardent scent that captures the dazzling essence of a young man - Adonis (Adone in Italian) - who was once adored by Aphrodite. Just like a fleeting jewel of ethereal beauty, this fragrance delicately blossoms and then fades, leaving behind a captivating blend of citrus, floral, and woody notes. A powerful passion gives way to an everlasting memory of an all-consuming love, marked by a tragic conclusion. Agatho Parfum's Adone Extrait de Parfum solidifies its position as the pinnacle of luxury Italian perfumery.

Fragrance family: Rose, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Cassis, Rosewood, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit

Middle Notes: Geranium, White Lily, Damask Rose, Jasmine, Wisteria

Base Notes: Ambroxan, Precious Woods, Ambrette Seeds, White Musc

title: 03 Lonestar Memories Eau de Toilette
body_html:
Experience the essence of the American West with Lonestar Memories Eau de Toilette. Inspired by a lonesome rider, this scent evokes the rugged and adventurous spirit of the dry woods. Notes of green geranium, spicy carrot seed, and smoky leather blend with cistus, jasmine, and the finest woods and balms for a truly unique and captivating fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Clary Sage, Geranium and Carrot Seeds

Middle notes: Leather, Labdanum and Jasmine

Base notes: Myrrh, Vetiver, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood

title: Cologne Du Maghreb Eau de Cologne
body_html:
Renowned for its robust appeal, Cologne du Maghreb flawlessly blends occidental and oriental notes, showcasing the true diversity of Middle Eastern scents beyond the traditional oud and spice. Crafted with a citrus-infused foundation, reminiscent of a Moroccan citrus garden basking in the morning sun, this cologne boasts the highest quality Bergamot and lemon essential oils, along with exquisite neroli oil and steam distilled orange blossom oil, creating a refreshing and captivating opening that entices and captivates. Lavender and rosemary essential oils provide a herbaceous counterpoint to the airy citrus accord, while rose absolute, rose essential oil, and clary sage contribute a green, ambery floral layer, adding complexity and depth to the overall fragrance.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Petitgrain, Clementine, Bergamot, Blood Mandarin, Rosemary, Litsea Cubeba, Grapefruit, Lavender and Clary Sage

Middle notes: Neroli, Orange Blossom, Moroccan Rose, Bulgarian Rose and Bourbon Geranium

Base notes: Atlas Cedar, Java vetiver oil, Labdanum and Ambergris

title: Ibiza Nights Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ibiza Nights is a unisex Oriental Floral scent from Carner Barcelona, released in 2020. The top notes feature Italian Mandarin, Pear, and Star Anise, balanced by Magnolia, Ylang-Ylang, and Jasmine Sambac in the middle. The base notes are a blend of Vanilla, Benzoin, and Patchouli.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Mandarin, Pear and Star Anise

Middle notes: Magnolia, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Vanilla, Benzoin and Patchouli

title: Helix Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Helix Eau de Parfum offers a unique interpretation of freshness and sophistication. The initial notes of tangy lemon and neroli blend in with the subtle spiciness of cardamom, creating a refreshing and refined scent. The heart of the fragrance is a delicate fusion of muguet, petitgrain, and aquatic florals, giving off a clean and modern impression. As it develops, Helix settles into warm and comforting notes of ambroxan, cashmeran, and cedarwood, leaving a lasting and subtle base. This versatile and gender-neutral scent is perfect for both professional and casual occasions, reminding you to take a moment, breathe, and move forward with clarity.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot, Peach and Clary Sage

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Sea Notes and Lily-of-the-Valley

Base notes: Virginian Cedar, Musk and Haitian Vetiver

title: Revolucion Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Revolucion Eau de Parfum is a fearless fragrance that captures the spirit of resistance and change. With spicy black pepper and saffron, it creates a sense of energy. Tobacco and carnation add warmth, while notes of labdanum and patchouli provide an earthy base. Perfect for evening wear, it expresses confidence and challenges the norm. Unleash your bold and commanding side with Revolucion.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ozonic notes, Thyme and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Saffron, Violet Leaf and Mate

Base notes: Leather, Texas Cedar and Olibanum

title: Bond Street Leather Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Experience the essence of London's renowned Bond Street with this luxurious fragrance. Featuring a blend of leather, bergamot, marshmallow, amber, cedar, musk, vetiver, and exotic oud, this scent embodies sophistication and elegance.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Marshmallow, Mandarine, Lemon

Middle notes: Geranium, Ylang-Ylang, Ginger, Iris

Base notes: Leather, Vetiver, Musk, Cedar, Amber, Oud

title: Musk Mantra Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Unlock your true potential with Musk Mantra Extrait de Parfum. Its invigorating scent captures your energy, guiding you towards what you truly desire. Experience the power of manifestation, little by little, every day. Let destiny come to you with this inspiring fragrance.

Fragrance family: Floral, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Night blooming Cereus

Middle notes: Floral Notes, Orris Root and Cinnamon

Base notes: Musk and Ambrette

title: Meet Me Where The Sky Touches The Sea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Where the sky and sea converge in the farthest reaches of the world, their embrace in perfect harmony, the sun a blazing divider, is where we truly belong.

Fragrance family: Leather, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Salt, Musk

Middle notes: Mimosa, Heliotrope, Florentine Iris

Base notes: Suede, Leather, Ambergris, Vetiver, Cedarwood

title: Lost In Heaven Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The dual essence of humanity: striving for flawless perfection and pristine innocence while confronting our inherent fallibility and irreversible missteps. This sophisticated fragrance juxtaposes luminous white florals against rich animalic undertones, embodying the fundamental human paradox. Lost In Heaven invites wearers to embrace both their idealistic aspirations and inevitable imperfections as quintessential aspects of the human condition.

Fragrance family: Woody, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Green Tangerine, Orange Blossom Absolute

Middle notes: Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Mimosa, Magnolia, Cumin, Cinnamon, Coriander

Base notes: Ambergris, Musk, Castoreum, Beeswax, Orris Butter, Cistus Absolute, Opoponax, Heliotrope, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Tonka Bean

title: Unspoken Musk Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This personal musk creation occupies the sensual and deeply human territory of the olfactory landscape. An Emotional Musk that provokes visceral responses while exploring profound emotional depths. The composition balances sweetness and velvet textures with persuasive earthiness, floral elements, and distinctly human qualities. It embodies the essential paradox of humanity—simultaneously innocent and transgressive—capturing the fundamental duality of human nature through its complex aromatic profile.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Immortelle and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris and Magnolia

Base notes: Musk, Castoreum, Civet, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha

title: Breathe Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Breathe Eau de Parfum captures the essence of vast, silent landscapes where nature's eloquence reigns supreme. This sophisticated fragrance embodies the transcendent sensation of connecting with something greater than oneself. It masterfully balances escape, serenity, splendor, and simplicity—a precise olfactory representation of nature's raw power. Breathe delivers an authentic return to the natural world, offering a refined respiratory respite from the mundane through its meticulously crafted aromatic profile.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender and Bergamot

Middle notes: Water Notes

Base notes: Musk

title: Smile Eau de Parfum
body_html:
SMILE represents a deeply personal olfactory journey, originating from the intimate bond between Akro founder Anaïs Cresp and her father, master perfumer Olivier Cresp. This distinctive composition emerged when Olivier crafted an exclusive fragrance for his daughter—a bespoke aromatic signature blending herbaceous sage, citrusy bergamot, and luscious raspberry. The resulting elixir achieves remarkable versatility while maintaining its vibrant character, suitable for any occasion. After treasuring this private creation for decades, Anaïs has now decided to unveil this bottled happiness, allowing fragrance connoisseurs worldwide to experience her cherished scent legacy.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Raspberry and Clary Sage

Base notes: Musk

title: Smoke Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Smoke Eau de Parfum captures the timeless allure of tobacco—a botanical substance that has captivated humanity through generations with its distinctive aromatic profile and ceremonial significance. This sophisticated composition evokes the intimate social ritual of crafting a cigarette for another, the tactile sensation of tobacco's delicate structure yielding between fingertips, and that ephemeral moment when fire transforms paper and leaf. The fragrance masterfully translates these sensory experiences into an olfactory narrative that embodies forbidden pleasure—a complex aromatic indulgence that, once experienced, becomes an essential element in the connoisseur's fragrance repertoire.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Smoke, Tobacco Leaf

Middle notes: Benzoin

Base notes: Cade oil, Tonka Bean

title: Malt Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Malt Eau de Parfum encapsulates the multidimensional experience of premium whisky—from its initial palate-stimulating astringency to the facial warmth it induces, culminating in the aromatic release of peaty notes when chilled. This composition emerged from Akro founder Anaïs Cresp's professional immersion in London's hospitality scene, where she developed a profound appreciation for whisky's transformative role in nocturnal social dynamics. The fragrance precisely captures that pivotal moment when casual libations transition to spirits, when convivial relaxation evolves into uninhibited pleasure, and when evening imperceptibly advances toward dawn. With its harmonious balance of sweetness and smokiness, Malt delivers sophisticated indulgence appropriate for any context, elevating ordinary moments with its refined complexity.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey, Seaweed

Middle notes: Leather

Base notes: Rum, Patchouli

title: Night Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Night Eau de Parfum transcends conventional olfactory seduction, boldly capturing the essence of physical intimacy with remarkable authenticity. This composition directly translates sensual experience into fragrance form, evoking profound moments of passionate connection. The perfumer has masterfully orchestrated animalic elements with addictive spices—notably cumin—and the complex depth of Bulgarian rose to create an irresistibly compelling aromatic narrative. The resulting elixir possesses both collectible quality and provocative character, establishing itself as a treasured addition to the connoisseur's collection while maintaining an air of discretion that may warrant selective disclosure among more conservative acquaintances.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cumin

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Saffron, Agarwood (Oud)

title: East Eau de Parfum
body_html:
East Eau de Parfum presents an olfactory journey centered around the enigmatic allure of Oud—the precious resinous heartwood of the Aquilaria tree. This sophisticated composition harnesses the transportive power of this rare material to evoke the multisensory landscape of the Middle East. The fragrance masterfully balances the complex, woody depth of authentic Oud with complementary notes that capture both the vastness of desert landscapes and the vibrant energy of traditional souks. With remarkable projection and longevity, East stands as the most potent and distinctive offering in the Akro collection—an aromatic portal that enables connoisseurs to experience distant lands through the most evocative of senses.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Leather

Base notes: Ambroxan

title: 20|20 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
20|20 Eau de Parfum captures the essence of the Golden Twenties—that iconic period of unbridled luxury, extravagance, and liberation known globally as "The Roaring 1920s." This jubilant fragrance heralds an auspicious beginning to our own 2020s decade. The composition juxtaposes authentic hippie patchouli against the refined, velvet-like freshness of rose and geranium, while distinguished woody accords provide a warm, sophisticated foundation. A truly celebratory olfactory experience that bridges two golden eras.

Fragrance family: Rose, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Bourbon Geranium, Patchouli

Base notes: Amberwood, Benzoin

title: Fougair Eau de Parfum
body_html:
FOUGAIR: A sophisticated olfactory experience combining VisionAIR and RevolutionAIR elements. This composition presents freedom through a harmonious blend of Fern Accord, Bergamot, and Pink Pepper. Its distinctive identity emerges from Boxwood, Artemisia, and Grafted Cypress notes, while sensual appeal develops through the profound core of Patchouli, Fir Balsam, and Oriental accords.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fern, Bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: boxwood, Artemisia and Cypress

Base notes: Balsam Fir, Amber and Patchouli

title: Etrango Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A complex fragrance inspired by Berlin's contrasting character. Features patchouli, tree moss, and cypriol balanced with Damask rose and Arabian jasmine. This modern interpretation of a 1929 "fantasy perfume" creates harmony from contrasting elements, capturing the city's ever-changing spirit.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Cumin & Saffron

Middle notes: Arabian Jasmine, Damascena Rose, Carnation.

Base notes: Patchouli, Treemoss, Cypriol.

title: 1A-33 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
1A-33 Eau de Parfum represents the inaugural contemporary reimagining of a J.F. Schwarzlose heritage fragrance, capturing the authentic essence of "Berlin Air." Its designation references Berlin's pre-war automotive registration prefix, creating a sophisticated olfactory bridge between the city's historical legacy and its modern identity.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Lime (Linden) Blossom, Pink Pepper and Dew Drop

Middle notes: Magnolia and Jasmine Sambac

Base notes: Iris and Cedar

title: Iris Ebene Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The iris root undergoes meticulous hand-peeling, washing, drying, and extended storage before distillation—a six-year process that renders it among perfumery's most valuable ingredients. Its sophisticated aroma presents violet, mimosa, and carrot notes with woody undertones. In Iris Ebène, perfumer Marie Hugentobler harnesses premium Atlas Valley iris to craft a composition where this noble ingredient reveals its darker facets through strategic pairing with woods, balsams, and musks. The fragrance develops into a refined leather accord that leaves an irresistible sillage reminiscent of cashmere's tactile comfort.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pimento, Petitgrain and Blood Mandarin

Middle notes: Suede, Iris and Pink Pepper

Base notes: Peru Balsam, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Narcisse Taiji Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Marie Hugentobler sources rare narcissus from the Aubrac mountains of France, where nearly 1,600 kilograms of wild-harvested blooms yield just one kilogram of the precious absolute with its potent yet refined floral character. NARCISSE TAIJI masterfully juxtaposes the flower's inherent dualities—contrasting its bright, verdant freshness against its profound, animalic depth, which Hugentobler accentuates with leather and patchouli notes. The composition achieves remarkable equilibrium, delivering an unexpectedly sensual olfactory experience that perfectly balances opposing aromatic forces.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose, Ginger and Pear

Middle notes: Narcissus, Hay and Bran

Base notes: Patchouli, Leather and Musk

title: Cacao Porcelana Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This exceptional white cocoa variety, cultivated in Peru's historic Piura plantations, undergoes meticulous hand-extraction, fermentation, sun-drying, and roasting. Marie Hugentobler collaborated with a French Maître Chocolatier to perfect the roasting process, unlocking the bean's nuanced nutty and milky characteristics with subtle Tonka undertones. CACAO PORCELANA opens with sweet rum notes before revealing cocoa's captivating bitterness, balanced by powdery and woody elements. The composition concludes with a distinctive dry down featuring light tobacco, patchouli, and sandalwood, creating a uniquely sensual olfactory signature.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cacao Pod, Rum and Immortelle

Middle notes: White Tobacco, Davana and Indian Jasmine

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Sandalwood

title: Poivre Pomelo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A distinctive freshness emanates from the rare Timut pepper, meticulously harvested from the thermal valleys of the Himalayas. This exceptional berry exhibits remarkable grapefruit nuances with extraordinary aromatic persistence. Perfumer Marie Hugentobler accentuates the pepper's effervescent, spicy characteristics while amplifying its citrus facets against a sophisticated backdrop of textured vetiver and maté. POIVRE POMELO delivers an enduring signature marked by its vibrant freshness and remarkable longevity.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Sichuan Pepper and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Peony, Osmanthus and Angelica

Base notes: Mate, Vetiver and Cedar

title: Cuir Nilam Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This Haute Couture composition reimagines patchouli—known as Nilam in its Indonesian homeland—through a sophisticated olfactory architecture. The fragrance initiates with refined, verdant violet leaf notes before transitioning to a contrasting heart where rose's aristocratic character encounters leather's audacious presence. The base reveals patchouli's profound complexity harmonized with captivating tobacco facets, creating a distinctively sensual sillage. CUIR NILAM presents as patchouli adorned in leather—a perfecto jacket rendered with quintessential Parisian refinement.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom and Violet Leaf

Middle notes: Leather and Rose

Base notes: Patchouli and Tobacco

title: What About ME? Parfum
body_html:
WHAT ABOUT ME? Parfum captures the essence of present consciousness through its intense, sensual unisex composition. This sophisticated fragrance eschews nostalgia and future aspirations, instead celebrating life's fleeting moments with remarkable clarity. The parfum's complex notes evolve on skin, serving as an olfactory reminder to embrace the now and acknowledge life's impermanence with refined sensibility.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Japanese Plum, Black Pepper, Tangerine

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Iso E Super, Juniper

Base notes: Musk, Bergamot, Geranium, Patchouli

title: Glorya Day Parfum
body_html:
Lengling's 2024 release, Glorya Day, presents an exquisite olfactory paradox—a fragrance of remarkable intensity yet delicate nuance. This sophisticated parfum juxtaposes vibrant sensuality with refined subtlety, evoking the complex sweetness of a rose macaron. The composition masterfully balances a passionate fruity-floral rose accord against a foundation of luxurious woods and patchouli, while artfully incorporating premium caramel notes and sophisticated dark chocolate undertones for a truly distinguished aromatic experience.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Apricot, Bergamot and Ginger

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Heliotrope, Violet and Hedione

Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Caramel, Dark Chocolate, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Skrik No.2 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Drawing inspiration from an iconic masterpiece, this expressionist parfum juxtaposes dramatic tensions with Scandinavian precision. Skrik No.2 delivers an initial arousing intensity before transitioning to soothing vanilla accords, creating an olfactory composition that transcends mere fragrance to become an artistic expression for one's inner self.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Vanilla

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, Iso E Super, Petitgrain

Base notes: Hedione, Musk, Sandalwood

title: Acqua Tempesta No.3 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Acqua Tempesta No.3 Parfum presents a remarkably distinctive olfactory profile with pronounced feral undertones. This composition pays tribute to individuals who embrace nature's power as a worthy adversary. The sophisticated fragrance juxtaposes crisp aquatic elements against untamed, rebellious smoke accords, creating an intriguingly valiant aromatic experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea water, cannabis

Middle notes: Mint, Olibanum, Hedione

Base notes: elemi, Haitian Vetiver, Cedar

title: In Between No.4 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
In Between No.4 Parfum artfully balances the innocent, dulcet qualities of youthful naivety with the sophisticated richness of fully matured Arabian jasmine. This composition presents an exquisitely nuanced olfactory experience—delicately restrained yet profoundly feminine in its expression.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peach, Patchouli, Musk

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Violet

Base notes: Brazilian Rosewood, Vanilla

title: A La Carte No.6 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This captivating fragrance presents an exquisite balance of refined gourmand accords with sumptuous richness. The composition oscillates between subtle suggestion and complete immersion, offering a sophisticated olfactory experience that invites luxurious sensory indulgence.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Toffee, Vanilla, Pistachio

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood

Base notes: Styrax, Olibanum, Pink Pepper

title: Apero No.8 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
This sophisticated composition transports the wearer to Mediterranean evenings, capturing the essence of twilight indulgence. Notes of refined Chardonnay interplay with effervescent citrus and delicate mimosa, creating a distinctive olfactory profile with remarkable precision. The fragrance achieves perfect equilibrium between refreshing brightness and the sensual warmth of nocturnal ambiance, delivering an exceptional aromatic experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Wine, Petitgrain, Heliotrope

Middle notes: Lime, Mimosa, Cashmeran

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Musk, Agarwood (Oud)

title: Wunderwind No.9 Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
A masterful equilibrium of strength and sensuality, this composition evokes the revitalizing experience of traversing a coniferous woodland. The aromatic profile artfully blends coniferous sharpness and Mediterranean herbaceous notes with maritime air currents, creating a sophisticated olfactory journey. The composition culminates with honeyed sweetness and delicate musk accords that simultaneously soothe and energize, stimulating a profound sense of rejuvenation.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ozonic notes, Sea Notes, Watermelon, Thyme

Middle notes: Rosemary, Pine needles, Honey, Incense

Base notes: Musk, Floral Notes, Lemon

title: Sekushi No.7 Hair Perfume
body_html: Sekushi No.7 Hair Perfume delivers exceptional hair care through its sophisticated formulation, combining luxurious fragrance with protective properties. The advanced blend incorporates hydrating components that enhance elasticity and luminosity, while the high-performance panthenol penetrates from root to tip, providing comprehensive nourishment. This specialized treatment offers defense against UV radiation and environmental stressors. The fragrance profile presents an intriguing contrast of sweet fruit notes balanced against deep leather accords, creating an intellectually stimulating and sensually provocative olfactory experience.

title: Italian Citrus Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Transport yourself to the sun-drenched Italian coastline with Italian Citrus Eau de Parfum. This sophisticated men's fragrance artfully blends bitter Chinotto, red orange, lemon, and green mandarin top notes with complex undertones of ambrette seed and clean musk. The result is a refined, long-lasting scent profile that evokes Mediterranean sophistication while providing refreshing clarity throughout the day.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses, Bitter Orange, Blood Orange

Middle notes: Amalfi Lemon, Mandarin Orange

Base notes: Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Musk, Green Notes

title: Amber Teutonic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Amber Teutonic Eau de Parfum by DS&Durga exemplifies a sophisticated Woody Spicy composition suitable for all genders. Crafted in 2018 by perfumer David Seth Moltz, this fragrance commences with aromatic Cardamom, Cedar, and Green Mandarin. Its heart reveals a coniferous accord of Silver Fir and Larch, balanced by floral Geranium. The foundation develops into a complex blend of resinous Opoponax, earthy Pine, and sensual Musk, creating a distinctive olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardomom, Cedar, Green Mandarin

Middle notes: Silver Fir, Larch, Gernaium

Base notes: Opoponax, Pine, Musk

title: Black Mango Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Black Mango Extrait de Parfum presents a sophisticated olfactory journey beginning with succulent mango and vibrant orange essential oil. The heart reveals a luxurious accord of creamy mango lassi intertwined with bourbon vanilla and tolu resin, creating an opulent middle phase. The composition culminates in a profound base of authentic oud, refined leather, noble sandalwood, and aromatic cypriol. This complex fragrance embodies the quintessence of sensual indulgence—a masterfully crafted parfum that balances tropical sweetness with smoky depth for a truly distinctive and memorable signature scent.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango and Orange

Middle notes: Mango, Tolu Balsam and Bourbon Vanilla

Base notes: Oud, Leather, Cypriol and Sandalwood

title: Castley Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Castley Eau de Parfum artfully combines premium aromatic components to achieve a harmonious equilibrium between crisp freshness and alluring sensuality. The composition initiates with vibrant bergamot and ginger top notes, complemented by a sophisticated interplay of spicy and mineral accords, notably featuring the distinctive Timut Pepper. Its foundation incorporates the resinous warmth of ambery Labdanum alongside the complex woody character of Akigalawood, imparting remarkable complexity and refinement to the olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Black Pepper and Ginger

Middle notes: Pepper, Neroli, Petitgrain and Timur

Base notes: Akigalawood, Benzoin and Labdanum

title: Duran Duran NeoRio Orange Flacon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
NeoRio embodies unbounded creativity and artistic synthesis. This compelling fragrance reflects Duran Duran's transformative essence and the innovative spirit that defines Xerjoff's heritage. It represents a temporal convergence as captivating and unpredictable as the legendary band. Available in four distinctive variations of Xerjoff's signature flacon, NeoRio delivers an enticing composition of sweet fig and rum notes complemented by the vibrant clarity of elemi absolute. The fragrance evolves through intense saffron warmth and delicate rose oil, ultimately settling on a foundation of velvety Tonka bean and profound Peruvian balsam. This olfactory masterpiece celebrates vitality, liberation, and life's most intense sensory experiences.

Fragrance family: Rose, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Candied Fig, Rum, Elemi Absolute, Spanish Cistus Oil

Middle notes: Maple Syrup , Rose Oil, Saffron

Base notes: Balsam Of Peru , Patchouli, Tonka Bean

title: Duran Duran NeoRio Yellow Flacon Eau de Parfum
body_html:
NeoRio exemplifies infinite creative potential and artistic convergence. This daring and mesmerizing fragrance captures Duran Duran's continuously evolving identity and revolutionary energy—characteristics fundamental to Xerjoff's heritage. It represents a temporal intersection as alluring and dynamic as the iconic band itself. Pioneering Xerjoff's design innovation with four unique interpretations of their renowned flacon, NeoRio delivers an enticing composition of luscious candied fig and rum harmonized with the bright vibrancy of elemi absolute. The fragrance develops through intense saffron warmth and refined rose oil, ultimately settling on a foundation of sumptuous Tonka bean and enduring Peruvian balsam. This olfactory masterpiece honors vitality, liberation, and the intensity of life's most profound experiences.

title: Cassiopea Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Cassiopea by Tiziana Terenzi presents a sophisticated Chypre Floral composition suitable for all genders, created by master perfumer Paolo Terenzi in 2015. The fragrance opens with vibrant passionfruit, cassis, lemon, and fern accords. Its heart reveals an elegant floral bouquet of tea rose, carnation, and lily-of-the-valley, while the foundation rests on a refined blend of tonka bean, musk, and sandalwood.

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Passionfruit, Cassis, Lemon and Fern

Middle notes: Tea Rose, Carnation and Lily-of-the-Valley

title: Draco Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tiziana Terenzi's Draco presents an exquisite Oriental composition crafted by Paolo Terenzi in 2015, suitable for all genders. The fragrance architecture begins with a citrus quartet of bergamot, lemon, orange, and verdant notes. Its complex heart reveals a harmonious blend of peach, magnolia, jasmine, cedar, and patchouli. The composition concludes with a sophisticated foundation of musk, pear, vanilla, tonka bean, and heliotrope.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Orange and Green Notes;

Middle notes: Peach, Magnolia, Jasmine, Cedar and Patchouli

Base notes: Musk, Pear, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Heliotrope

title: Lince Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Created by Paolo Terenzi in 2018, Tiziana Terenzi's Lince offers a sophisticated Oriental Spicy profile suitable for all genders. The composition begins with an aromatic blend of absinthe, star anise, and green tea, brightened by bergamot, orange, and grapefruit. Its heart reveals a luxurious floral arrangement of iris, jasmine, orange blossom, fig, and Bulgarian rose. The foundation delivers depth through vanilla flower and bean, heliotrope, ambergris, musk, and sandalwood.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Absinthe, Star Anise, Green Tea, Bergamot, Orange and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Iris, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Fig and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Vanilla Flower, Vanilla Bean, Heliotrope, Ambergris, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Orion Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tiziana Terenzi's Orion, crafted by Paolo Terenzi in 2015, exemplifies a refined Floral Woody Musk composition suitable for all genders. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of pineapple, apple, bergamot, and red currant. Its complex heart reveals an aromatic-woody character through birch, thyme, patchouli, and jasmine. The sophisticated dry-down features cedar, incense, precious agarwood (oud), musk, and amber for a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple, Apple, Bergamot and Red Currant

Middle notes: Birch, Thyme, Patchouli and Jasmine

Base notes: Cedar, Incense, Agarwood (Oud), Musk and Amber

title: Leo Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Leo Extrait de Parfum by Tiziana Terenzi represents a distinguished unisex creation released in 2022, developed by master perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The composition begins with vibrant citrus elements of kumquat, Brazilian orange, Sicilian mandarin, and Calabrian bergamot. Its complex heart unfolds with ambergris, magnolia, violet leaves, myrrh, jasmine sambac, and Bulgarian rose, while the foundation delivers depth through musk, Australian sandalwood, cedar, tonka bean, Siam benzoin, and oak notes.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Kumquat, Brazilian Orange, Sicilian Mandarin and Calabrian bergamot

Middle notes: Ambergris, Magnolia, Violet Leaves, Myrhh, Jasmine Sambac and Bulgarian Rose

Base notes: Musk, Australian Sandalwood, Cedar, Tonka Bean, Siam Benzoin and Oak

title: Arethusa Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tiziana Terenzi's Arethusa Extrait de Parfum, created in 2014 by Paolo Terenzi, presents a sophisticated Floral Aquatic composition suitable for all genders. The fragrance opens with a complex blend of Fig, Plum, Sage, and citrus notes complemented by Ginger and Red Sandalwood. Its heart reveals floral dimensions of Jasmine, Orange Blossom, and Rose, enhanced by Pomegranate, Heather, and Saffron. The distinctive base combines marine elements of Sea Water and Salt with earthy Vetiver, Sand, and warm notes of Leather, Labdanum, Patchouli, and Liquidambar, finished with White Nerium Oleander and Broom.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fig, Plum, Sage, Ginger, Pink Grapefruit, Orange and Red Sandalwood

Middle notes: Pomegranate, heather, Saffron, Jasmine, Orange Blossom and Rose

Base notes: Sea water, Salt, Vetiver, Sand, White Nerium Oleander, Leather, Labdanum, Patchouli, Broom and Liquidambar

title: Delox Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Delox captures the essence of the Cyclades islands with Mediterranean-inspired notes. This sophisticated fragrance blends roasted coffee and morning sea air with white hyacinth, royal iris, and ecstasy rose. Sweet myrrh, amber, cypress, and honey create depth, while Lebanese cedar provides structure—evoking the timeless beauty of Greek coastal landscapes.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coffee, Iris and White Hyacinth

Middle notes: Turkish Rose, Vanilla and Opoponax

Base notes: Honey, White Musk, Amber and Cedar

title: Adhil Assoluto Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Adhil Assoluto Extrait de Parfum by Tiziana Terenzi presents a sophisticated Floral Green composition suitable for all genders, introduced in 2016 and crafted by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The fragrance opens with a distinctive blend of Anise, Cassis, and Green Notes, evolving into a heart of Jasmine and Ozonic elements. Its foundation rests on a complex arrangement of Vanilla, Heliotrope, Australian Sandalwood, Amber, Amyris, and Oakmoss, creating a multifaceted olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Anise, Cassis and Green Notes

Middle notes: Jasmine and Ozonic notes

Base notes: Vanilla, Heliotrope, Australian Sandalwood, Amber, Amyris and Oakmoss

title: Hyakutake Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Hyakutake by Tiziana Terenzi presents a sophisticated unisex olfactory composition released in 2023, crafted by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The fragrance opens with vibrant notes of eucalyptus, Calabrian bergamot, cardamom, and lemon. Its heart reveals a complex blend of orris, ambergris, incense, and pansy, while the foundation consists of larch, Australian sandalwood, Haitian vetiver, tobacco, and musk—creating a distinctive aromatic experience that balances freshness with depth.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Eucalyptus, Calabrian bergamot, Cardamom and Lemon

Middle notes: Orris, Ambergris, Incense and Pansy

Base notes: Larch, Australian Sandalwood, Haitian Vetiver, Tobacco and Musk

title: Hale Bopp Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tiziana Terenzi's Hale Bopp, introduced in 2019, represents a sophisticated Woody Spicy composition suitable for all genders, developed by master perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The fragrance architecture begins with an aromatic blend of nutmeg, cinnamon, and lemon. Its heart unfolds with a harmonious combination of vanilla, geranium, patchouli, and sage, while the foundation rests on a rich base of amber, labdanum, sandalwood, and musk—creating a complex olfactory experience with remarkable depth and character.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Nutmeg, Cinnamon and Lemon;

Middle notes: Vanilla, Geranium, Patchouli and Sage

Base notes: Amber, Labdanum, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Tabit Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted by perfumer Paolo Terenzi in 2016, Tabit is a sophisticated Floral Woody Musk composition from the house of Tiziana Terenzi, designed for all genders. The olfactory journey begins with verdant accords and bergamot, transitions through a heart of peach, floral elements, sand, and coconut, before settling on a complex foundation of musk, cotton candy, woody nuances, vanilla, and amber.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Notes and Bergamot

Middle notes: Peach, Floral Notes, Sand and Coconut

Base notes: Musk, Cotton Candy, Woody Notes, Vanilla and Amber

title: Mirach Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Paolo Terenzi's 2018 creation for Tiziana Terenzi, Mirach is an exquisite unisex extrait de parfum. This composition opens with a luxurious blend of rose varieties, saffron, nutmeg, and neroli. Its heart reveals white oud, more damask rose, ambergris, sand, and patchouli, while the foundation showcases precious agarwood, vanilla, benzoin, and sandalwood for a sophisticated olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Oud, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Damask Rose, Saffron, Nutmeg and Neroli

Middle notes: White Oud, Damask Rose, Ambergris, Sand and Patchouli

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Benzoin and Sandalwood

title: Kaff Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Kaff Extrait de Parfum presents an olfactory tightrope walk where hypnotic White Iris meets crisp bergamot, pink pepper, and ginger in a captivating opening. The composition transitions through a heart of magnolia, Tuscan leather, Iris Blu, Orris, and precious grey amber. This sophisticated vertigo settles on a foundation of cedar, sandalwood, and distinctive tonka bean—a mysterious creation that reveals its full artistry only to true perfume connoisseurs.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper, White Iris, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Ginger

Middle notes: Leather, Iris, Orris Root, Ambergris and Magnolia

Base notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Sandalwood and Tonka Bean

title: Cas Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Named after the celestial body known as "the hand of God," Cas Extrait de Parfum embodies the essence of a variable-intensity star. This sophisticated composition, housed in exquisite Bohemian crystal, reveals its magnificence selectively—not to casual observers but to discerning connoisseurs. Like its namesake star, this artistic fragrance illuminates those who appreciate true elegance and possess the perceptive depth to transcend mere appearances.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose and Black and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Green Pepper, Agarwood (Oud) and Birch

Base notes: Ambergris, Vanilla and Musk

title: Dolce Riviera Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Launched in 2024, this meticulously crafted eau de parfum opens with a distinctive accord of Star Anise and Aldehydes—the former contributing warm, licorice-tinged spice while the latter provides effervescent brightness and metallic facets that enhance projection and radiance.

Fragrance family: Aldehyde, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Star Anise and Aldehydes

Middle notes: Sandalwood and Hawthorn

Base notes: Patchouli and White Musk

title: Macaron d'Amour Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Macaron d'Amour Dragée by Reminiscence represents a masterful olfactory composition designed for the discerning fragrance connoisseur. This contemporary unisex creation, introduced in 2024, showcases the artistry of modern perfumery through its sophisticated gourmand architecture.

Fragrance family: Vanilla, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tangerine, Cardamom and Petitgrain

Middle notes: Sugared Almonds, Orange Blossom and Almond Blossom

Base notes: Tonka Bean, White Musk and Vanilla

title: Sous un Mimosa de Provence Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sous un Mimosa de Provence Eau de Parfum is a contemporary unisex fragrance that captures the golden beauty of Provence's mimosa blooms.

Fragrance family: Floral, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mimosa absolute, Hawthorn and Violet Leaves

Middle notes: Tonka Bean, White Flowers and Patchouli

Base notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla and Musk

title: Fleur de Delice Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fleur de Délice Eau de Parfum by Reminiscence represents a masterful exploration of Mediterranean elegance, capturing the essence of sun-drenched gardens where aromatic herbs meet delicate white flowers. This sophisticated unisex creation, launched in 2024, embodies the perfect balance between invigorating freshness and comforting warmth, making it a truly versatile and captivating fragrance experience.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mint, Bergamot and Rosemary

Middle notes: Jasmine, Neroli and Petitgrain

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean and White Musk

title: Bois Etoile Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bois Étoilé Eau de Parfum by Reminiscence represents an exceptional interpretation of contemporary woody-spicy perfumery, masterfully blending precious Eastern ingredients with sophisticated Western sensibilities. This luxurious unisex creation, introduced in 2024, showcases the artistry of modern fragrance composition through its expertly orchestrated interplay of rare spices, noble woods, and opulent resins.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper and Rose

Middle notes: Cardamom and Saffron

Base notes: Patchouli, Amber and Oud

title: Rose Tentation Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bois Étoilé Eau de Parfum by Reminiscence represents an exceptional interpretation of contemporary woody-spicy perfumery, masterfully blending precious Eastern ingredients with sophisticated Western sensibilities. Top notes: Pink Pepper and Rose
