Base notes: Patchouli, Amber and Oud

title: Yesterday Haze Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Yesterday Haze Eau de Parfum captures the essence of nostalgic reverie and complex emotions in an exquisitely crafted fragrance. This sophisticated scent evokes the hazy beauty of golden hour memories, where past and present intertwine like the shifting colors of a California sunset.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Fig, Iris, Whipped Cream

Middle Notes: Walnut, Fruity Notes

Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Woody Notes

title: A City On Fire Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A City On Fire Eau de Parfum captures the essence of urban intrigue and nocturnal mystery. This sophisticated fragrance embodies the tension between solitude and connection, much like the compelling narrative that inspired its creation.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Cade oil, Spikenard, Cardamom

Middle Notes: Clearwood, Dark Berries

Base Notes: Labdanum & Burnt Match

title: Cape Heartache Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cape Heartache captures the essence of Philip Sava's most celebrated exploration novel, inspired by his transformative 1881 expedition to the Pacific Northwest. This evocative eau de parfum embodies the raw beauty of coastal Oregon, where ancient Douglas firs meet the endless Pacific and new beginnings take root in untamed wilderness.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Douglas Fir, Pine Resin

Middle Notes: Western Hemlock, Vanilla Leaf, Strawberry

Base Notes: Old Growth, Mountain Fog

title: Bull's Blood Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bull's Blood captures the raw intensity of souls who live without compromise, drawn from the sun-baked plazas and shadowed corners of Spain where passion burns brightest. This compelling eau de parfum embodies the spirit of those who choose love over safety, courage over comfort—matadors facing down death, fighters embracing the ring, hearts that beat with unrelenting fervor.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top Notes: Geranium, Spanish Rose

Middle Notes: Patchouli, Black Musk

Base Notes: Tobacco, Sandalwood, Bull’s Blood

title: Lilac Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lilac Love Eau de Parfum is a harmonious blend of floral and balsamic notes that redefines classic femininity with a sensual touch. This elegant fragrance captures the essence of delicate lilac blossoms intertwined with warm, soothing balsams, creating a captivating and sophisticated scent experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Heliotrope, Lilac, Gardenia, Jasmine, Peony and Rose

Middle notes: Cacao, Tonka Bean and Orris

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Blossom Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Blossom Love embodies a soft elegance paired with bold charm, representing contemporary femininity that challenges norms while celebrating romantic aspirations.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Heliotrope and Bergamot

Middle notes: Amaretto, Cherry Blossom, Ylang-Ylang and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Suede and Amber

title: This Is Not Kisspeptin Parfum
body_html:
Kisspeptin Parfum combines a sophisticated blend of notes designed to enhance your natural allure and captivate those around you. Each carefully crafted drop releases electrifying properties that build a magnetic scent profile, elevating your presence with subtle yet powerful attraction. Experience the expert fusion of fragrance elements that empower you to become the radiant center of attention in any setting.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Brazilian Rosewood, Cinnamon and Apple

Middle notes: Lily of the Valley, Cedarwood and Iris

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Amber

title: This Is Not Oxytocin Parfum
body_html:
Enhance your fragrance with a touch of Oxytocin Parfum, designed to evoke a captivating and alluring presence. This sophisticated blend of scent notes is expertly crafted to naturally boost your appeal, making you irresistibly attractive with minimal effort.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Basil and Lavender

Middle notes: Apple, Geranium, Cinnamon and Cloves

Base notes: Musk, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Cedar and Green Tea

title: This Is Not Adrenaline Parfum
body_html:
Tap into your inner energy with Adrenaline Parfum, a scent designed to sharpen focus and boost concentration. Each carefully crafted note delivers a burst of revitalizing energy, driving you toward maximum productivity. This compelling fragrance sparks your own motivation while inspiring a vibrant sense of enthusiasm in those nearby.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sandalwood, Incense, Amber and Pine

Middle notes: Rose, Agarwood and Carnation

Base notes: Saffron and Cashmeran

title: This Is Not Dopamine Parfum
body_html:
Dopamine Parfum is an exotic and captivating scent inspired by the happiness hormone. This unique blend stimulates feelings of joy in the brain, sparking a surge of motivation that empowers you to overcome challenges. Experience the uplifting power of happiness and seize every moment with confidence.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Nutmeg and Lavender

Middle notes: Agarwood, Sugar and Vanilla

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Musk

title: This Is Not Endorphin Parfum
body_html:
Experience pure euphoria anytime with Endorphin Parfum. This expertly crafted blend stimulates your brain, releasing waves of happiness and renewed energy.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: elemi, Black Pepper, Pear and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Saffron, Marshmallow and Ambergris

Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Cedar, Honeysuckle and Ambroxan

title: Flowerlush Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Khanjar draws inspiration from a distinctive Omani emblem representing honor and sacred elegance. This fragrance captures the essence of Oman's heritage, beginning with a luxurious blend of floral accords, saffron, and bergamot. It then unfolds into a sophisticated fusion of genuine oud, ambergris, and leather, creating a rich and timeless scent.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Cyclamen and Jasmine

Base notes: Patchouli, Woody Notes, Musk, Agarwood (Oud) and Sandalwood

title: Sea My Love Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Stephane Humbert Lucas Sea My Love Eau de Parfum is a refined unisex fragrance that captures the essence of the ocean’s mysterious depths. This marine scent evokes the sensation of diving into the deep blue, where light fades and endless wonders emerge. Its carefully crafted notes invite you to experience the sea’s vastness and boundless possibilities, making it a sophisticated choice for those who appreciate the allure of the ocean.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Salt and Mandarin

Middle notes: Marine notes, Leather and Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Benzoin, Patchouli and Musk

title: PM Parfum
body_html:
PM Parfum is the result of a collaboration between Producer Michael and Fragrance Du Bois, crafted to embody a powerful signature scent. Drawing inspiration from the golden era of bold fragrances, it features the finest ingredients to create a commanding and memorable aroma that leaves a lasting impression.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Indian Tuberose, Floral Notes, Juniper Berries, Lemon and Cardamom

Middle notes: Leather, Orris Root, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Cedar

Base notes: Labdanum, Woody Notes, Amber and Benzoin

title: Secret Tryst Parfum
body_html:
Secret Tryst is a new, intoxicating perfume crafted for those who seek to ignite passion while embracing a spirit of adventure. This fragrance combines alluring notes that evoke mystery and excitement, making it perfect for individuals who desire a bold and unforgettable scent experience. Ideal for evening wear or special occasions, Secret Tryst leaves a lasting impression that captures both intensity and elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Saffron and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Vetiver, Cedar and Jasmine

Base notes: Olibanum, Vanilla, Patchouli and Labdanum

title: Oud Orange Intense Parfum
body_html:
Fragrance Du Bois is a distinguished luxury perfume brand rooted in the finest natural essences, crafted by fifth-generation perfumers following the 17th-century French Grasse tradition. Each fragrance features 100% pure, organic Oud oil alongside sustainably sourced ingredients. Oud Orange Intense presents a sophisticated blend of warm, musky accords, beginning with vibrant coconut and fruity top notes. The heart reveals a rich Bourbon vanilla that harmonizes with the potent Oud, settling into a comforting, musky base that exudes depth and vitality.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Fruity Notes and Coconut

Middle notes: Bourbon Vanilla

Base notes: Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud) and Musk

title: New York 5th Avenue Parfum
body_html:
New York 5th Avenue Parfum captures the essence of a winter in NYC with its expertly crafted blend of woody, sweet, and warm spicy notes. It opens with fresh bergamot and delicate rose, leading into a rich heart of caramel, violet, and cypriol that adds a sophisticated floral-spicy character. The fragrance settles into a long-lasting base of vanilla, musk, Kashmir wood, and guaiac wood, creating a harmonious balance of warmth and sweetness ideal for colder seasons. This parfum offers a refined and enduring scent experience for those seeking elegance and depth.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose and Bergamot

Middle notes: Caramel, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Violet

Base notes: Cashmere Wood, Vanilla, Musk and Guaiac Wood

title: London Spice Parfum
body_html:
London Spice Parfum redefines freshness with a bold, sporty character crafted by master perfumer Francois Merle-Baudoin. Inspired by London Oud but distinctively free of Oud, this fragrance embodies the spirit of champions, delivering a unique and compelling scent that inspires confidence and victory. Perfect for those who demand distinction in every moment.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Peppermint, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Sea Notes, Lavender, White Flowers and Jasmine

Base notes: Nutmeg, Cedar, Cardamom and Patchouli

title: Cannabis Intense Parfum
body_html:
The scent begins with a vibrant spicy burst of cardamom, transitioning into a fresh, rosy citrus blend of pink pepper and orange. At its core, a unique fusion of cannabis accord, saffron, and nutmeg delivers a green, spicy sweetness. This evolves into a lasting base featuring rich pure trat oud oil, complemented by woody cedar and warm musk notes.

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange, Cardamom and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: cannabis, Saffron and Nutmeg

Base notes: Woody Notes, Agarwood (Oud), Cedar and Musk.

title: Not A Perfume Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Juliette Has a Gun introduces Not A Perfume, launched in September 2010, a unique fragrance centered solely on Ambroxan (C16H28O). Originally developed in the 1950s by Firmenich as an affordable alternative to rare grey amber, Ambroxan typically serves as a base note but here takes center stage. This minimalist scent challenges conventional perfumery by offering a composition free of allergens, making Not A Perfume a bold and innovative statement in fragrance design.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ambroxan

Middle notes: Ambroxan

Base notes: Cetalox

title: Lady Vengeance Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lady Vengeance by Juliette Has A Gun is a sophisticated Chypre Floral scent designed for women, introduced in 2006. Crafted by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, it opens with fresh Lavender and Bergamot. The heart reveals a rich blend of Bulgarian and Moroccan Roses, Patchouli, Iso E Super, and Geranium, while the base combines White Musk, Ambroxan, and Vanilla for a lasting, elegant finish.

Fragrance family: Floral, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender and Bergamot

Middle notes: Bulgarian Rose, Moroccan Rose, Patchouli, Iso E Super and Geranium

Base notes: White Musk, Ambroxan and Vanilla

title: Lipstick Fever Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lipstick Fever, introduced in June 2020, is the latest release in Juliette Has A Gun’s general collection. This fruity-floral fragrance is presented in a striking gradient red bottle that exudes a bold, seductive vibe. Described as daring and captivating, it embodies a confident spirit that embraces temptation with style and finesse.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry and Violet

Middle notes: Iris and Patchouli

Base notes: Cedar and Vanilla

title: Oil Fiction Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Oil Fiction Eau de Parfum is a limited edition fragrance presented in a lacquered wooden box with a new bottle and logo. This scent masterfully balances the radiant warmth of oriental notes with an elegant wildness, creating a sophisticated and generous olfactory experience. Its rich, opulent character unfolds like a captivating story, leaving a refined, suave, and animalistic trail that enchants and seduces with every wear.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose, Amber, Ylang-Ylang, Labdanum, Ambroxan

Middle notes: Iris, Saffron, Patchouli, Sandalwood

Base notes: Papyrus, Vanilla, Bergamot

title: Into The Void Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Into The Void is part of the LUXURY collection, which also features Oil Fiction, Moon Dance, and White Spirit. As the collection’s fourth fragrance, it captures humanity’s fascination with scientific advancement and the forces shaping our universe. While science has unraveled many mysteries, black holes remain elusive—where space, time, and light vanish, giving way to an unknown realm where conventional physics and gravity no longer apply.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Licorice

Middle notes: Orchid and Tonka Bean

Base notes: Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Papyrus, Patchouli and Cedar

title: Metal Chypre Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Metal Chypre by Juliette Has A Gun is a unisex chypre fragrance introduced in 2017, created by perfumer Romano Ricci. It opens with vibrant pink pepper and bergamot, followed by a heart of suede, iris, patchouli, and amber. The scent settles into a base of ambroxan, white musk, and tonka bean.

Fragrance family: Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper and Bergamot

Middle notes: Suede, Iris, Patchouli and Amber

Base notes: Ambroxan, White Musk and Tonka Bean

title: White Spirit Eau de Parfum
body_html:
White Spirit by Juliette Has A Gun is a floral woody musk fragrance designed for women, released in 2015. It features top notes of tuberose and jasmine sambac, a heart combining tuberose and ambroxan, and a base composed of musk, sandalwood, amber, and cedar.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tuberose and Jasmine Sambac

Middle notes: Tuberose and Ambroxan

Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Amber and Cedar

title: In the Mood for Oud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
In The Mood For Oud by Juliette Has A Gun is an oriental woody fragrance for both women and men, introduced in 2019. It opens with bergamot, followed by a heart of agarwood (oud), saffron, papyrus, and raspberry, and finishes with base notes of tonka bean and vanilla.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Saffron, Papyrus and Raspberry

Base notes: Tonka Bean and Vanilla

title: L'Animal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L'Animal Eau de Parfum opens with the warm embrace of golden rum, its richness flowing over the skin like a lover’s caress. Spicy nutmeg adds intrigue, while creamy almond paste offers a soothing, sensual touch. At its heart, the fragrance blends the soft texture of abundant suede with the captivating floral notes of heliotrope, balanced by a fresh hint of verdant Mugane. The base reveals a raw, animalistic sensuality where earthy gaiac wood and smooth sandalwood entwine in a powerful, seductive dance. Accents of honey and vanilla add decadent sweetness and a lingering, erotic finish. L'Animal invites you to embrace your primal instincts and desires.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Almond, Rum and Nutmeg

Middle notes: Suede, Heliotrope and Mugane

Base notes: Honey, Sandalwood, Vanilla and Guaiac Wood

title: Mud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Mud Eau de Parfum captures the moment when rain drenches the earth, cooling the ground as water cascades from the roof and splashes among the grass, transforming soil into mud. The delicate aroma of rain, damp grass, and softened earth blends into an evocative scent that stirs memories of a past farewell.

 

Fragrance family: Sweet, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Milk and Almond

Middle notes: Chocolate, Plum and Turkish Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, elemi, Sandalwood and Amber

title: Naked Laundry Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Naked Laundry Eau de Parfum transitions from the crisp freshness of clean linens to the intimate warmth of bodies intertwined, evolving from purity to the rich, unmistakable scent of heated, sweaty skin.

Fragrance family: Aldehyde

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Skatole, Aldehydes, Ambrinol and Mandarin

Middle notes: Mimosa absolute, Caramel and Honey

Base notes: Milk, Woodsy Notes, Tonka Bean and Amber

title: Nsfw Eau de Parfum
body_html:
A dark, heavy chill hangs in the air. As I walk down the alley, I notice a short-haired woman framed by the wooden doorway of a local bar. Her sensual focus on the book made me wish I were the pages she turned. What secrets lie beneath her guarded expression? Catching my gaze, she lifts her face and raises her eyebrows, tensing as she locks eyes with me. Her bold stare unsettled me like never before, leaving me unsure how to respond.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Rose

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose, May Rose and Damask Rose

Middle notes: Vanilla, Geranium and Papyrus

Base notes: Benzoin, Violet, Patchouli and Laotian Oud

title: Z&T Eau de Parfum
body_html:
On a sultry summer night, the moon glowed with an almost blue-white hue. The summer grass drooped under the intense heat, releasing a heavy, dense aroma. Nearby, the creek remained cool despite the warmth, especially after dark. He shed his clothes, tossing them into the bushes, and plunged into the cold water. Reveling in the exhilarating chill, he called to her, “Come in.” Beneath the moonlight, his wet, pale skin shimmered.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Gin, Lemon Verbena, Juniper, Pink Pepper and Guatemalan Cardamom

Middle notes: Coriander, Clary Sage and Black Pepper

Base notes: Patchouli, elemi and Virginia Cedar

title: Santal Nirvana Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Mohamed Rebatchi sought to capture the true spirit of sandalwood by collaborating with perfumer Nathalie Feisthauer to develop Santal Nirvana. This scent highlights the distinctive sandalwood originally from Mysore, now ethically sourced from Australia because of export restrictions. Feisthauer emphasized the wood’s inherent elegance, enhancing it with notes of cedar and patchouli to craft a refined and complex woody fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron

Middle notes: Clove

Base notes: Sandalwood, Agarwood (Oud) and Patchouli

title: Myrrhe & Musc Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Myrrhe & Musc Eau de Parfum is a captivating scent where the sacred essences of myrrh and incense are enveloped in a smooth, silky veil. Enhanced by notes of juniper and pink berries, its aroma balances the richness of woods with the gentle softness of musks. Both alluring and enigmatic, this fragrance reflects the global journey of Ilias Ermenidis, whose cultural openness and collaboration with Mohamed Rebatchi inspired a perfume that bridges Eastern and Western influences.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Juniper and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Frankincense and Myrrh

Base notes: Musk and Patchouli

title: Velvet Date Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Date Eau de Parfum reveals a captivating date note, sculpted like a precious gem. This fragrance is enriched with rose, saffron, amber’s warm glow, and tonka bean, all resting on a dark, velvety, woody base. Vincent Ricord, born in Grasse, draws inspiration from his lifelong passion for fragrant plants and the shared appreciation of Eastern cultures. Together with Mohamed Rebatchi, they created this elegant scent that celebrates the unique essence of date.

Fragrance family: Oud, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Saffron, Rose and Davana

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), White Tobacco, Honey, Amber, Dates and Tonka

title: Ambre Blanc Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ambre Blanc is a modern fragrance that combines ethereal lightness with rich texture, radiating a bright and joyful aura. Created by Nathalie Feisthaueur, who embraces perfume-making as an act of free expression, this scent breaks traditional boundaries. Beneath its pure white elegance lies the warm glow of vibrant amber, capturing a unique and inspired olfactory experience.

 

Fragrance family: Amber, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Carrot

Middle notes: Hedione and Saffron

Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Cashmeran, Vanilla, Woody Notes, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Oakmoss, Labdanum, Benzoin, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Agarwood (Oud) and Ambergris

title: Rose Rebatchi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rose Rebatchi Eau de Parfum reflects a blend of Eastern and Western influences, inspired by the Middle East. It features the essence of Damascena and Turkish roses, softened by powdered iris and white musks. Velvety peach, crisp apple, and spicy bay rose notes combine with the luxurious saffron known as "Red gold." In the background, white musks harmonize with warm sandalwood, ambergris, and lively cedarwood, creating a refined and balanced fragrance.

 

Fragrance family: Rose, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Peach, Saffron, Pink Pepper and Apple

Middle notes: Damask Rose, Turkish Rose and Orris Root

Base notes: White Musk, Sandalwood, Ambergris and Cedar

title: Feu Patchouli Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Feu Patchouli Eau de Parfum combines powerful woody notes softened by hints of cypress, with patchouli taking center stage. A vibrant and spicy blend of cloves, cinnamon, black and pink pepper bursts forth like a bold brass ensemble. This rich, dense, and intense fragrance is both mysterious and captivating, leaving a lasting, intoxicating impression.

Fragrance family: Woody, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Aldehydes, Citron, Bergamot, Sweet Orange, Cassis, Black Pepper and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Wormwood, Cloves, Carnation and Cinnamon

Base notes: Patchouli, Oakmoss, Driftwood, Incense, Labdanum, Myrrh, Caramel, Musk and Vanilla

title: Musc Panache Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Musc Panache Eau de Parfum is a personal and sensual musk crafted by Maurice Roucel. It balances a spicy cologne opening with a delicate iris heart layered over rich musks for a smooth, rounded effect. The fragrance settles on a transparent woody base of vetiver and cedar, enriched by warm notes of vanilla and tonka bean.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Tamarind, Bitter Orange, Cardamom and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris and Honeysuckle

Base notes: Musk, Cedar, Patchouli, Haitian Vetiver, Tonka Bean and Amber

title: Cuir Tassili Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cuir Tassili Eau de Parfum honors Mohamed Rebatchi’s roots, inspired by a journey through the Tassili desert in southeast Algeria. Aliénor Massenet captures the sensory experience of waking in a desert camp—the aroma of brewing tea, Algerian cherbet lemonade, and the rich scent of camel leather—creating a fragrance that invites you to embark on a true journey.

 

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rosemary, Incense and Carrot Seeds

Middle notes: Sage, Tea Leaf and Violet Leaf

Base notes: Leather, Patchouli and Amber

title: Jasmin Satin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jasmin Satin Eau de Parfum captures Mohamed Rebatchi’s memories of Mediterranean summers, blending two jasmine varieties from India and Egypt. Created with Karine Dubreuil, this fragrance combines delicate nocturnal jasmine freshness with lush gardenia and woody notes. Jasmin Satin evokes the magical moment when the sparkling blue sea meets the shaded scent of towering cedars, offering an intense yet subtle sensory experience.

 

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Gardenia and Palisander Rosewood

Middle notes: Jasmine Sambac, Peach, Lily and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Musk, White Amber, Sand and Virginia Cedar

title: Yin Transformation Parfum
body_html:
Yin Transformation Parfum captures the essence of water, the origin of life, blending calm and dynamic elements with precision. This fragrance balances opposing notes, from the creamy depth of Sandalwood to the sharp freshness of Calypso Orchids—a pioneering ingredient in perfumery. The result is a sophisticated and nuanced scent that stimulates the senses with subtle complexity.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orchid, Bulgarian Rose and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Almond Milk, Ylang-Ylang and Iris

Base notes: White Musk, Sandalwood and Benzoin

title: Sacred Water Parfum
body_html:
Sacred Water is a flowing fragrance that both energizes and calms. Featuring citrus, fresh spices, and mineral undertones, it refreshes and relaxes, evoking the serene vastness of a peaceful ocean.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Citron and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Seaweed, Magnolia and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Ambergris, Cedar and Amyris

title: Sun Force Parfum
body_html:
Sun Force captures the sun’s energy, illuminating our senses and enhancing the vibrancy around us. This fragrance blends bright citrus notes with rich exotic woods, growing warmer like the afternoon sun. The lively Hawaiian Pomelo brightens the mysterious depths of benzoin, vetiver, and sandalwood, creating a confident scent that invigorates and uplifts.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Bulgarian Rose and Pomelo

Middle notes: Cardamom, Honey and Olibanum

Base notes: Benzoin, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Velvet Fire Parfum
body_html:
Velvet Fire is a captivating fragrance that stimulates and ignites passion. Its rich blend of woody notes enlivens and warms the wearer, reminiscent of the sun’s gentle touch.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Clary Sage, Cypress and Myrtle

Middle notes: Tobacco, Saffron and Neroli

Base notes: Oud, Tonka Bean and Labdanum

title: Magnetic Wood Parfum
body_html:
Magnetic Wood is a vibrant fragrance that invigorates like the sun awakening early blossoms. It combines powdery mimosa with the crispness of Chinese sweet osmanthus, green mandarin, and refined iris root. Fresh and elegant, this sophisticated Yin scent refreshes and enriches the wearer.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Osmanthus, Bergamot and Green Mandarin

Middle notes: Mimosa, Iris and Sea Daffodil

Base notes: Sandalwood, Cedar and Guaiac Wood

title: Guiding Water Parfum
body_html:
Guiding Water is a soothing fragrance that rejuvenates like morning dew on blooming flowers. It combines the aquatic crispness of Ozonic Accord and pink peppercorn with a floral blend of cyclamen, jasmine, and fleur-de-lys. Light and flowing, this refined Yin scent gently awakens the senses.

Fragrance family: Floral, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ozonic notes, Watermelon and Aquatic notes

Middle notes: Lotus, Cyclamen and Jasmine

Base notes: Lily, White Musk and White Pepper

title: Golden Wood Parfum
body_html:
Golden Wood is a distinguished fragrance that soothes and reassures. Its rich blend of gourmand and woody notes provides warmth and resilience, reminiscent of the enduring strength of an ancient tree.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Bitter Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: LBeeswax, Guaiac Wood and Pea

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Oak and Cabreuva

title: Desired Earth Parfum
body_html:
Desired Earth is a commanding fragrance that captivates and uplifts. Its bold blend of spicy and woody notes elevates the wearer, evoking the grandeur of towering mountain summits.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Immortelle, Elemi resin and Cade oil

Middle notes: Tolu Balsam, Red Cedar and Myrrh

Base notes: Iris, Vanila and Vetiver

title: Royal Earth Parfum
body_html:
Royal Earth Parfum embodies the richness of Yin Earth in a sophisticated and mysterious scent. Exotic ylang-ylang, vibrant passion fruit, and refined Egyptian rose envelop a core of powdery Tuscan iris. Earthy angelica and carrot seeds blend with sandalwood and vanilla, crafting a sumptuous gourmand fragrance.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Angelica, Carrot Seeds and Passionfruit

Middle notes: Iris, Ylang-Ylang and Egyptian Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood and White Musk

title: Matrix Metal Parfum
body_html:
Matrix Metal is a striking fragrance that empowers and fortifies. Its dynamic blend of contrasting hot and cold accords, metallic nuances, and creamy freshness sharpens the senses, evoking the polished edge of a finely crafted blade.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Metallic notes, Nutmeg and Cardamom

Middle notes: White Tea, Vetiver and Cyclamen

Base notes: Sequoia, White Musk and Sandalwood

title: Carved Oud Hair Fragrance
body_html: Experience the luxury of Carved Oud fragrance in a way that suits warm climates perfectly. Hair retains the scent far longer than skin due to its porous nature, allowing you to enjoy the perfume’s richness throughout the day.

title: The Cora Hair Fragrance
body_html: The Cora Hair Fragrance draws inspiration from a rare gemstone, offering a luminous, golden blend of exquisite ingredients that captivate with their timeless elegance. Ideal for indulging in luxury scent throughout the day, especially in warm climates, this fragrance clings to hair longer than skin due to hair’s porous nature, ensuring a lasting and refined aroma.

title: Riviere Hair Fragrance
body_html: A Rivière refers to a timeless necklace featuring gemstones of uniform size or a smooth gradient. Our Riviere Hair Fragrance offers a sophisticated way to experience luxury scent throughout the day, with your hair retaining the fragrance significantly longer than your skin.

title: Florentine Diamond  Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The Florentine Diamond, a lost 16th-century Indian gem, is renowned for its unique nine-sided, 126-facet double rose cut and 137-carat weight. This sophisticated fragrance blends intoxicating tuberose with deep cocoa undertones, revealing woody notes and a hint of sugar cane that exudes a commanding presence. Enhanced by majestic oud and a lingering vanilla finish, Florentine Diamond offers a captivating signature scent. It is housed in Thameen London’s iconic blue bottle, accented with a gold border and magnetic black cap, while the marbled sleeve features blue, cream, and gold foil detailing.

 

 Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin and Cocoa

Middle notes: Sugar Cane, Tuberose and Barley

Base notes: Vanilla, Oak and Oud

title: The Cora Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Inspired by the exquisite rarity of its gemstone namesake, The Cora Extrait de Parfum presents a luminous, golden spectrum of exceptional and captivating ingredients, embodying timeless elegance.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Wisteria, Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine and Magnolia

Middle notes: Benzoin, Carnation, Lily-of-the-Valley and Vanilla

Base notes: Patchouli, White Musk and Amber

title: Regent Leather Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Thameen draws inspiration from rare gemstones for its fragrances, and for this creation, the legendary Regent Diamond—a flawless, 141-carat cushion-cut gem over 300 years old—serves as the muse. This extrait de parfum radiates sophistication, beginning with a bold blend of smooth vanilla and sharp lemon. At its core lies a distinctive leather aroma, evoking the refined interior of a Rolls Royce, enveloping the wearer in artisanal luxury. Accented by spices like saffron and rich labdanum, the scent’s base features elegant gurjum, cedar, and patchouli. Expertly crafted, Regent Leather offers a dynamic, evolving fragrance experience that balances familiarity with intrigue.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon

Middle notes: Saffron, Cardamom, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vanilla, Animal notes, Gurjan balsam, Cedar, Labdanum, Patchouli and Musk

title: Peacock Throne Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
The golden platform was adorned with enamel, precious gems, and a double peacock’s tail featuring rubies, emeralds, pearls, and diamonds, crowned by the Kohinoor diamond—the world’s largest known gem. This fragrance begins with radiant Indian jasmine, Egyptian orris, and pink pepper pearls. At its core is the opulent rose of Taif, renowned for its deep, luxurious glow. The base reveals a rich warmth from noble patchouli, vibrant vetiver, and smooth vanilla, creating a majestic and sophisticated scent.

 

 Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orris Root, Pink Pepper and Indian Jasmine

Middle notes: Taif Rose

Base notes: Patchouli, Vetiver and Vanilla

title: Red Redemption Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Red Redemption Eau de Parfum presents a daring take on the quintessential masculine rose. Its fresh top notes of blood orange and pink pepper add complexity, while rich amber and the deep, enigmatic vetiver bring character and vigor. This captivating blend captures the fiery sophistication of the rose with commanding presence.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Pepper and Blood Orange

Middle notes: Rose, White Amber, Patchouli and Vetiver

Base notes: White Musk, Vanilla and Oakmoss

title: Epine Du Desert Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Epine du Désert Eau de Parfum honors the tradition of Mukhallat, a Middle Eastern craft that expertly blends ingredients into a harmonious composition. Central to this fragrance is the pure essence of rose oil, renowned for its elegant simplicity. Accents of saffron and pimento add a warm, spicy vibrancy, while the smooth suede note leaves a gentle, lasting touch on the skin. These refined components combine to create a mysterious oriental Eau de Parfum, distinguished by its uniquely sophisticated character.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pimento and Saffron

Middle notes: Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Suede, Dry Wood and Sandalwood

title: Kashmir Print Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Kashmir Print Eau de Parfum envelops you in refined warmth, centered on a subtle powdery musk blended seamlessly with white patchouli, orris, and freesia. This fragrance captures the delicate elegance of a scarf gently swaying in the breeze, balancing a sense of comfort with the outside world. Its unfolding scent resembles a graceful dance, evoking attraction and serenity that lingers softly on the skin.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Freesia, Lily-of-the-Valley and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Rose, Orris Root and Pink Pepper

Base notes: White Musk, Patchouli and White Amber

title: Stallion Soul Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Stallion Soul Eau de Parfum highlights the leathery character of rare Oud in a bold unisex fragrance that exudes strength and elegance. At its core, the precious Oud blends leathery tones with the subtle charm of rose and the vibrant energy of carnation. A musky base fuses effortlessly with the skin, creating an olfactory masterpiece that declares confidence and allure, leaving a captivating trail wherever it is worn.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Incense and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Violet, Leather and Jasmine

Base notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Agarwood (Oud), Musk, Patchouli and Vanilla

title: Routes Nomades Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Routes Nomades Eau de Parfum celebrates the heritage and essence of nomadic life. Each spray honors the moment a frankincense harvester carefully stores precious dried resins in a leather pouch. The scent opens with a captivating blend of incense and soft leather, their deep, earthy tones balanced by the crisp spice of ginger and cardamom, alongside the woody depth of vetiver, transporting you to a world rich with untold stories.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Cypress and Ginger

Middle notes: Vetiver, Cinnamon Leaf and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Leather, Incense and Patchouli

title: Infusion Velours Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Infusion Velour Eau de Parfum invites you into a world of luxury and charm with its captivating unisex scent. It wraps you in the rich warmth of juicy oud, perfectly balanced by a blend of woody and resinous notes intertwined with the sweetness of red fruits. Each spray evokes the sensation of soft velvet against the skin. This fragrance is both captivating and elegant, leaving a refined and sophisticated trail wherever you go.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Pepper, Blackberry and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Raspberry and Cedar

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Incense and Patchouli

title: Ciel d'Orage Eau de Parfum
body_html:
At the core of Ciel d’Orage Eau de Parfum lies the rich, smoldering essence of oud. The fragrance opens with vibrant, lush artemisia notes, while its smoky character is deepened by the warm, earthy guaiac wood, reminiscent of glowing embers from a distant fire. Soft suede accents add a sensual and refined touch that lingers delicately on the skin. Experience the depth and elegance of Arabian luxury with this unisex Eau de Parfum.

Fragrance family: Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Artemisia and Saffron

Middle notes: Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, Pine, Patchouli and Rose

Base notes: Suede, Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood and Styrax

title: Oud Nebula Parfum
body_html:
Oud Nebula Parfum from The Harmonist is an elegant and contemporary fragrance that showcases the intricate depth of Amber and Oud. Created by perfumer Guillaume Flavigny, it surrounds you with a commanding woody and spicy character, highlighting the distinctive essence of Oud, known as 'Black Gold.' The composition centers on an Amber core enriched with Oud, complemented by warm notes of Cedar and Sandalwood, spiced with Saffron and Tonka Bean, and subtly lifted by Bulgarian Rose.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Laurel, Saffron

Middle notes: Leather, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean

Base notes: Amber, Cedar, Oud

title: Chypre Azural Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Chypre Azural Eau de Parfum is a vital addition to any daily fragrance collection, offering a vibrant citrus chypre composition. Its fresh and invigorating scent unfolds with bright citrus notes that provide an energizing start, while the chypre base ensures a sophisticated, long-lasting presence. Designed to wear like a second skin, this fragrance seamlessly accompanies you from morning to evening, enhancing your natural elegance with a subtle yet enduring trail. Perfect for those seeking a refined, everyday scent that balances freshness with depth and complexity.

 

 Fragrance family: Citrus, Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sicilian Orange, Tarragon

Middle notes: Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

Base notes: Amber, Egyptian Rose

title: Iris Perle Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Iris Perle Eau de Parfum is a rare gem in perfumery, as it takes seven years for orris to produce its valuable oil from planting to extraction. This sophisticated and subtle fragrance combines earthy notes of French orris, Egyptian violet leaves, and Moroccan mimosa absolutes, all perfectly balanced by a crisp ocean breeze.

 

 Fragrance family: Floral, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orris Root, Moroccan Mimosa

Middle notes: Clary Sage

Base notes: Madagascar Ylang-Ylang, Indian Jasmine

title: Floriental Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Floriental Eau de Parfum challenges conventional perfume norms by presenting a floral scent that reimagines the concept of a fragrance-free flower. It merges floral and oriental elements in an inventive interplay, creating a unique composition where no clear top, heart, or base notes dominate. Instead, each component rises and fades, contributing to an artful and dynamic olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: plum

Middle notes: labdanum cistus, pepper rose

Base notes: amber, cedar, incense, sandalwood, vetiver

title: Bonbons A La Violette Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Bonbons à la Violette Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of a delicate, nostalgic treat with expert craftsmanship. This fragrance artfully combines the soft, powdery aroma of sugared violets with subtle fruity nuances and a creamy, gourmand sweetness that lingers on the skin. Designed for those who appreciate refined gourmand scents, it evokes the joyful experience of savoring violet-flavored candies, balancing freshness and warmth with sophistication. Perfect for adding a touch of playful elegance to your fragrance collection, this extrait offers lasting depth and a uniquely indulgent olfactory journey.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Violet, Sugar and Jasmine

Base notes: Moss, Cedarwood, Amber and Vanilla

title: Atramental Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Atramental Eau de Parfum is a complex fragrance that captures the essence of personal expression. Opening with vibrant bergamot and spicy black pepper, it evolves through a heart of cistus, cardamom, and fresh aqueous notes. Warm saffron lingers on the skin, while rich resins and suderal deepen the scent’s intensity. Castoreum adds a distinctive animalic depth, creating a tribal and evocative aroma that leaves a lasting impression. This expert blend is designed for those who wear their story boldly and uniquely.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Water Notes, Bergamot, Citruses and Lemon

Middle notes: Black Pepper and Cardamom

Base notes: Castoreum, Resins and Saffron

title: Blomma Cult Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Blomma bursts forth—an exhilarating bloom igniting a sensory revolution. Beneath flowing locks and open minds, conventions dissolve and desire takes flight. This daring fragrance unveils a seductive blend: delicate violet whispers mingle with playful vanilla and cinnamon wrapped in warm cashmeran. Suddenly, a striking patchouli emerges, its intense presence shattering the soft musk embrace with a powdery impact. This scent captures the essence of liberated passion and bold expression.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Lilac

Middle notes: Cashmeran, Iris and Patchouli

Base notes: Cinnamon, Vanilla and White Musk

title: Purple Mantra Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Purple Mantra Eau de Parfum invites you to connect deeply with your inner voice, blending it seamlessly with your senses. As you breathe in, the purifying burst of incense clears your mind, while lavender soothes your nervous system. Distractions fade, leaving your mind open and receptive to new insights. Light as an iris petal, your spirit feels free, uplifted by the bright touch of pink berries. Marjoram’s gentle notes mingle with white flowers and clary sage, elevating your senses. Ambroxan and musk rise with myrrh, bridging earth and sky, unlocking your creative spirit. Exhale and let your inspiration flow.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Pink Pepper and Freesia

Middle notes: Clary Sage, Iris and Floral Notes

Base notes: Incense, Myrrh, Musk and Ambroxan

title: Sweet Leaf Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sweet Leaf Eau de Parfum captures the essence of a vibrant early morning journey. As the pink grapefruit sun melts into a turquoise horizon, purple trees sway like familiar friends. Red eucalyptus reaches out, drawing in the last light of dawn, while dreamy jasmine and cannabis scents drift through the air. Green angelica rests on orange sand, creating an almost surreal scene. This fragrance embodies a colorful, uncharted adventure, wrapped in a delicate white paper—inviting you to take the wheel and explore without limits.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Eucalyptus

Middle notes: cannabis, Angelica, Turpentine

Base notes: Jasmine, Cashmeran, Patchouli

title: Ten Fifteen Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Citrus bursts forth, ignited by the scent of charred wood. Drops of saffron sweat descend onto a violet base. Iris powder lingers softly on the skin like a delicate veil. Papyrus breaks apart in flexible, withered fragments along the walls, which crumble and collapse. The atmosphere widens, revealing the scene of a battlefield beyond it all.

Fragrance family: Woody, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Violet and Iris

Base notes: Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood and Papyrus

title: Yesterday Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Within Room 1015’s misty bathroom, cardamom-infused steam sets the scene as youthful spirits, marked by drizzles of bergamot, embark on a fierce pursuit. The sharp edge cuts through with geranium oxide, leaving no trace behind. Laughter-lined skin, freshened by crisp apple, is swept by waves of nostalgic davana. Poised before the spotlight and lost in reflection, these musicians recall Yesterday while pouring their passion into Today, embodied by the dynamic interplay of aristocratic vetiver and the divine lover’s sweat, ambroxan.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Thyme, Bergamot, Orange and Basil

Middle notes: Geranium, Lavender, Artemisia and Caraway

Base notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, White Musk, Tonka Bean and Amberwood

title: Torino 23 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
TORINO23 captures the essence of tennis heritage, celebrating Xerjoff’s third year as Silver Partner of the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin. This fragrance embodies timeless elegance and refinement. It opens with a vibrant burst of bergamot, softened by subtle notes of rose and cardamom. The heart reveals a harmonious blend of neroli, jasmine, and the rich intensity of tuberose. The scent settles into a warm, inviting base of cashmere wood, amber, and musk, creating a luxurious composition that reflects tradition and sophistication.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Rose, Nutmeg and Cardamom

Middle notes: Tuberose, Neroli, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang

Base notes: Musk, Cashmere Wood, Amber, Patchouli and Cedarwood

title: Torino 24 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Torino 24 Eau de Parfum captures the essence of an indoor tennis match, blending fresh and warm notes. It opens with fruity and floral scents of mandarin, mango, plum, pink lotus, and orange blossom. The fragrance finishes with a cozy base of moss, patchouli, and white musk, evoking the atmosphere of the game.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mango, Bergamot, Mandarin and Plum

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Pink Lotus and Styrax

Base notes: White Musk, Moss and Patchouli

title: Casa futura Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Casa Futura Eau de Parfum honors the Futurism art movement, blending modernity, technology, and romance into a unique fragrance. Inspired by early 20th-century innovation and energy, this perfume captures the spirit of progress and creativity in a refined scent.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender and Rosemary

Middle notes: Geranium, Rose and Skeleton Flower

Base notes: Cedar, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Regio Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Regio Eau de Parfum by Xerjoff is a sophisticated Oriental Spicy fragrance designed for both women and men, launched in 2011. It opens with a fresh and invigorating blend of lavender, grapefruit, bergamot, and lemon blossom, creating a vibrant and uplifting introduction. The heart reveals a complex floral and spicy bouquet featuring geranium, carnation, cardamom, plum, ylang-ylang, and rose, adding depth and richness. The scent settles into a warm and sensual base of vanilla, ambrette (musk mallow), patchouli, and musk, providing a lasting and elegant finish that balances sweetness with earthiness. This fragrance offers a refined and versatile experience suitable for various occasions.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lavender, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Lemon Blossom

Middle notes: Geranium, Carnation, Cardamom, plum, Ylang-Ylang and Rose

Base notes: Vanille, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Patchouli and Musk

title: Levar del Sole Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Levar del Sole Eau de Parfum by Xerjoff is a modern Chypre Fruity fragrance crafted for both women and men, introduced in 2024. It opens with a vibrant blend of apple, orange, bergamot, lemon, rose, and fresh green notes, creating a lively and refreshing start. The heart reveals a sophisticated floral and spicy mix of cardamom, violet, jasmine, and lily, adding complexity and elegance. The base combines warm and rich elements such as benzoin, caramel, musk, oakmoss, tonka bean, and patchouli, providing a deep, sensual foundation. This fragrance balances fruity brightness with earthy and sweet undertones, making it a versatile and refined choice for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Orange, Bergamot, Lemon, Rose and Green Notes

Middle notes: Cardamom, Violet, Jasmine and Lily

Base notes: Benzoin, Caramel, Musk, Oakmoss, Tonka Bean and Patchouli

title: Fiero Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fiero by Xerjoff is an Aromatic Spicy fragrance crafted for men, introduced in 2010 and created by perfumer Chris Maurice. It opens with vibrant top notes of Amalfi lemon, lemongrass, bergamot, and blood orange. The heart features refreshing mint, neroli, tarragon, and thyme, while the base combines earthy vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, nutmeg, and coumarin for a rich, lasting finish.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Amalfi Lemon, Lemongrass, Bergamot and Blood Orange

Middle notes: Mint, Neroli, Tarragon and Thyme

Base notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Nutmeg and Coumarin

title: 1888 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
1888 Eau de Parfum by Xerjoff is an Oriental Floral fragrance designed for both women and men, launched in 2013. It opens with a distinctive blend of carnation, pepper, coriander, and saffron, offering a spicy and aromatic introduction. The heart reveals a rich floral combination of ylang-ylang, rose, and neroli, adding depth and elegance. The base notes of amber, sandalwood, birch, and patchouli provide a warm, woody foundation that lingers on the skin. This fragrance balances vibrant spices with lush florals and earthy undertones, creating a sophisticated and timeless scent suitable for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Carnation, Pepper, Coriander and Saffron

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang, Rose and Neroli

Base notes: Amber, Sandalwood, Birch and Patchouli

title: Fiore d'Ulivo Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fiore d'Ulivo Eau de Parfum is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women, featuring fresh top notes of Amalfi lemon, lotus, basil, and ambrette. Its heart combines olive blossom, magnolia, and jasmine, while the base offers warm musk, benzoin, and amber for a refined and elegant scent.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Amalfi Lemon, Lotus, Basil and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Middle notes: Olive Blossom, Magnolia and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Benzoin and Amber

title: Quattro Pizzi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Quattro Pizzi Eau de Parfum tells the tale of a Sicilian dynasty marked by glory, wealth, and influence. Inspired by the iconic palace that housed Palermo’s most distinguished families, this fragrance evokes the Belle Époque era—a time where love, beauty, and nobility intertwined with mystery and temptation. The scent opens with a captivating blend of rum, davana, and pink pepper, delivering sweet and spicy notes. At its heart, tuberose enchants and seduces, creating a sensual aroma that lingers on the skin like a lover’s forbidden touch long after nightfall.

 

Fragrance family: Green, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Davana, Rum, Pink Pepper and Coriander

Middle notes: Tuberose and Coconut

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Hay and Tobacco Leaf

title: Buddha Blend Eau de Parfum
body_html:
BUDDHA BLEND celebrates nature’s generosity, inspired by a fruit that opens like a welcoming hand, sharing its bounty freely. This sophisticated gourmand fragrance blends two unique essences: the vibrant juiciness of yuzu enhanced by a bright mix of sweet citrus, resting on a base that is both rich and airy. The luxurious velvet orchid combines with the gentle, warm sweetness of vanilla and tonka bean, crafting a scent that is both soothing and elegant.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Finger Lime, Yuzu, Ginger and Lemon

Middle notes: Milk, Vanillin and Orchid

Base notes: Ebony Wood, Georgywood, Tonka and Vetiver

title: Roasted Tangerine Eau de Parfum
body_html:
ROASTED TANGERINE captures the essence of a mandarin warmed by its native sun, with its aromatic peel gently toasted to reveal smoky and leathery hints. This complex citrus composition is enhanced by the warm, vibrant aroma of toasted fennel seeds, lending a dry, smoky character. Rich base notes of wood, coffee, and incense evoke the spirit of Morocco—its sunlit streets and fragrant spice markets—creating a striking contrast with the fruit’s full, juicy brightness.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Mandarin, Blood Orange and Bergamot

Middle notes: Fennel, Petitgrain, Incense, Coffee and Ginger

Base notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix™, White Musk, Cedarwood, Tonka and Woody Notes

title: Cedrat Tonic Eau de Parfum
body_html:
CEDRAT TONIC is an energetic and lively fragrance crafted to stimulate the senses with a fresh, vibrant character. It begins with the sharp clarity of juniper, sparkling bubbles, and the zesty bitterness of grapefruit. The heart reveals a crisp blend of citron mint, ginger, and jasmine buds, balanced by the subtle herbaceousness of rosemary. The base offers a refreshing combination of musks and amber woods, providing a lasting sense of vitality and freshness.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Gin, Rosemary, Grapefruit, Lemon and Citrus

Middle notes: Mint, Pink Pepper, Ginger, Bergamot and Jasmine

Base notes: Akigalawood, Amberwood, Musk, Ambrette and elemi

title: Bergamot Brother Eau de Parfum
body_html:
BERGAMOT BROTHER presents a bright citrus blend where the fresh green notes of bergamot are mellowed by sweet orange and mandarin, with a subtle cooling touch of angelica. Its core reveals a bouquet of white flowers enriched by the warm spices of cinnamon, ginger, and saffron, creating complexity and allure. The scent finishes on a clean, amber-infused base that exudes warmth and uplifting energy.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Angelica, Cardamom, Mandarin and Orange

Middle notes: Ginger, Dried Fruits, Orange Blossom, White Pepper, Cinnamon and Saffron

Base notes: Cosmone, Ambrofix™, Atlas Cedar, Benzoin, Leather, Akigalawood and Orange

title: Upcycled Mandarin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
UPCYCLED MANDARIN captures the essence of mandarin through multiple extractions, revealing its full depth and complexity. It begins with a lively citrus-green burst, enhanced by fresh pink pepper and cardamom. The heart blends floral and aromatic notes with hints of rich fruit nectar. Helichrysum adds a warm golden touch, complemented by the sweet, honeyed tones of almond, vanilla, and benzoin. The base combines powdery woods and the subtle earthiness of immortelle for a sophisticated and enduring finish.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Mandarin, Green Mandarin, Pink Pepper, Italian Lemon and Cardamom

Middle notes: Lavender, Apricot, Orange Blossom and Mahonial

Base notes: Immortelle, Benzoin, Amber, Vanillin, Haitian Vetiver, Cedarwood, Almond and Heliotrope

title: Saffron Mandarin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
SAFFRON MANDARIN celebrates a distinctive blend where the bright juiciness of mandarin combines with the mysterious richness of saffron. It opens with a lively citrus mix, accented by cool, anise-like, and metallic spice notes. At its core, saffron intertwines with subtle floral hints, adding warmth and depth. The base reveals saffron’s smooth, velvety character, merging with luxurious suede tones to create an elegant and captivating finish.

Fragrance family: Spicy, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Italian Mandarin, Pink Pepper, Blood Orange, Petitgrain, Mandarin Leaf, Italian Lemon and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Saffron, Ylang Ylang and Jasmine

Base notes: Benzoin, Tonka, Oak and Labdanum

title: Seductive Cedrat Eau de Parfum
body_html:
SEDUCTIVE CEDRAT is a luxurious gourmand fragrance inspired by a lemon tart. It begins with the zesty sweetness of citron, lifted by fresh notes of yuzu, lemon, and green mandarin. The heart reveals a creamy floral blend that adds softness and depth. The scent finishes with a rich base of vanilla and amber, complemented by warm sandalwood and toasted sesame, creating a warm, inviting, and irresistible aroma.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lemon, Green Mandarin, Yuzu and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Milk, Sesame, Jasmine and Green Notes

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber, Musk and Cedarwood

title: Pistachio Cousin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
PISTACHIO COUSIN is a striking blend inspired by the Tree of Life, combining crisp freshness with creamy richness. It opens with a sparkling green accord that transitions into a gourmand mix featuring nutty pistachio, hazelnut, and almond. At its core, black lemon—cured citrus in salted water—adds a distinctive twist to the lively fruitiness. Milky, sweet, and caramelized notes mellow the composition, while Earl Grey tea and delicate lemon and orange blossoms introduce a refined freshness. The fragrance settles on a woody, incense-like base that evokes the textured bark of this imagined tree.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pistachio, Italian Lemon, Orange, Bergamot, Incense and elemi

Middle notes: Orange Blossom, Lemon and Petitgrain

Base notes: Akigalawood, Patchouli, Cypriol, Australian Sandalwood and Vetiver

title: Lime Sister Eau de Parfum
body_html:
LIME SISTER is a complex and captivating fragrance with a seductive character. The sharp zest of lime is mellowed by the sweet roundness of orange, while Pomarose adds rich notes of apple, raisin, and dried fruit for a full, pure experience. At its core, a sensual floral bouquet evokes the mystery of night gardens, with delicate yet intoxicating blooms that bring depth and quiet intensity to the scent.

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lime, Bitter Orange, Italian Lemon, Blood Orange, Grapefruit and Bergamot

Middle notes: Broom, Cosmone, Mimosa, Pomarose and Indian Jasmine

Base notes: Galaxolide, Ambrofix™ and Vanilla

title: Ambre Premier Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ambre Premier Eau de Parfum opens with delightfully playful top notes reminiscent of cotton candy. This harmonious fragrance creates a sensuous aura on the skin, offering a subtle sweetness that uplifts the senses. Crafted by perfumer Michelle Saramitot (Robertet), it features fresh and spicy head notes, a floral rose heart, and a rich base dominated by patchouli, amber, and vanilla.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Spices and Citruses

Middle notes: Rose

Base notes: Amber, Vanille and Patchouli

title: Gardez Moi Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Gardez Moi revisits the vibrant energy of the 1920s, blending the era’s bold spirit with today’s refined tastes. Crafted by perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour, this fragrance features an opulent bouquet centered on gardenia, enriched by fresh aquatic hints and the subtle green aroma of crushed leaves. The result is a rich, balanced composition that is both feminine and sensual, offering lasting elegance that honors its historic inspiration while appealing to the modern wearer.

 

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tomato Leaf, Aldehydes, Cyclamen, Coriander and Black Pepper

Middle notes: Gardenia, White Lily, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Mimosa absolute

Base notes: Raspberry, Vanilla, Musk, Styrax, Oakmoss and Virginia Cedar

title: Incident Diplomatique Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Incident Diplomatique Eau de Parfum embodies bold provocation and irresistible desire, effortlessly challenging convention with its daring character. This woody spicy fragrance by Jovoy Paris, launched in 2017, opens with bright mandarin orange, followed by a rich heart of Haitian and Java vetiver combined with warm nutmeg. Its base reveals deep, sensual notes of patchouli and sandalwood, creating a captivating scent that builds from a subtle encounter into an overwhelming wave of sensuality.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Haitian Vetiver, Java vetiver oil and Nutmeg

Base notes: Patchouli and Sandalwood

title: La Liturgie des Heures Eau de Parfum
body_html:
La Liturgie des Heures captures the atmosphere of a historic monastery, where the air is rich with the scent of burning incense alongside the rhythm of daily prayers. Crafted by perfumer Jacques Flori (Robertet), this fragrance opens with fresh, green cypress, leads into a heart of incense, olibanum, cistus, and myrrh, and rests on a warm musk base.

 

 Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cypress and Green Notes

Middle notes: Incense, Olibanum, Myrhh and French labdanum

Base notes: Musk

title: L’Arbre de la Connaissance Eau de Parfum
body_html:
L’Arbre de la Connaissance Eau de Parfum embodies the essence of enlightenment, inspired by the Buddha’s meditation beneath the sacred Bodhi fig tree of India. Created by perfumer Marc Fanton d’Andon (Robertet), it features fresh top notes of hesperidium and leafy green accords, a fruity fig heart, and a warm base combining sandalwood, patchouli, and fig tree nuances.

 

 Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Green Notes and Citruses

Middle notes: black fig

Base notes: Fig Tree, Sandalwood and Patchouli

title: Pavillon Rouge Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Pavillon Rouge Eau de Parfum captures the spirit of adventure and bold living. Inspired by a daring privateer’s fleeting moments ashore, its rich notes of amber, vanilla, and exotic spices evoke a life lived fully and fearlessly. This fragrance celebrates courage and passion, perfect for those who embrace every day as a new conquest.

 

 Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Whiskey, Rum, Spices and Sesame

Middle notes: Tobacco, Leather, Coffee and Tea

Base notes: Ebony, Vanilla and Benzoin

title: Rouge Assassin Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rouge Assassin by Jovoy Paris is a floral woody musk fragrance for women, created by perfumer Amelie Bourgeois and introduced in 2012. It opens with fresh notes of rose, elemi, and bergamot. The heart reveals iris, ambrette, and rice, while the base combines white musk, sandalwood, cedar, benzoin, tonka bean, and vanilla for a warm, elegant finish.

 Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, elemi and Bergamot

Middle notes: Iris, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Rice

Base notes: White Musk, Sandalwood, Cedar, Benzoin, Tonka Bean and Vanilla

title: Touche Finale Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Touche Finale by Jovoy Paris is a unisex floral fragrance introduced in 2019 and crafted by perfumer Vanina Muracciole. It opens with bright mimosa and pink pepper notes, followed by a heart of violet leaf, rose, jasmine, and cedar. The base features soothing heliotrope, white musk, and sandalwood for a refined finish.

 Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mimosa and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Violet Leaf, Rose, Jasmine and Cedar

Base notes: Heliotrope, White Musk and Sandalwood

title: Deziro Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Deziro Extrait de Parfum captures the essence of Desire, a powerful emotion that influences fate and deepens human bonds. It opens with a refreshing Marine Accord mixed with cool Mint, reminiscent of a sudden ocean wave. The heart is grounded by Vetiver and Cypriol, adding earthy depth and harmony. Warmth comes from Star Anise and Sandalwood, evoking the sunlit sea shore, while Ambrettolide and Carrot Seed introduce subtle animalistic hints, reflecting nature’s raw, instinctive longing.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Sea Notes and Ambrox Super

Middle notes: Mint, Star Anise, Cypriol, Geranium and Carrot Seeds

Base notes: Ambrettolide, Haitian Vetiver and Sandalwood

title: Cricket Song Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cricket Song Eau de Parfum by Floraïku Paris captures the serene atmosphere of a nighttime walk, blending the gentle sounds of nature into a sophisticated fragrance. This floral woody musk opens with fresh, uplifting notes of bergamot paired with the soft, elegant aroma of magnolia. The heart of the scent flows seamlessly into a rich, earthy vetiver base, creating a sensual and grounding experience. The composition evokes a peaceful yet evocative mood, making it an ideal choice for those who appreciate subtle complexity and natural beauty in their fragrance.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Magnolia

Base notes: Vetiver

title: Rise and Fall Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rise and Fall by Floraïku masterfully embodies the poetic transition between day and night. This fragrance opens with the fresh and invigorating aroma of Madagascar ginger oil, capturing the energetic rise of the sun. It then unfolds into the warm, bittersweet notes of immortelle absolute, evoking the fleeting beauty of twilight. Finally, the composition is grounded by the comforting, creamy essence of vanilla bean, which creates a harmonious contrast and balance between light and darkness. Together, these elements form a sophisticated scent that reflects both the vibrancy and melancholy of nature’s daily cycle.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger

Middle notes: Immortelle

Base notes: Vanilla Bean

title: Jasmin D'eau Eau de Parfum
body_html:
This women's fragrance combines the classic Jasmin Grandiflorum Absolute with the contemporary touch of Mineral Jasmin and the subtlety of Jasmine Tea to create an elegant floral bouquet. Enhanced by notes of White Peach, Bergamot Tea, and Plum Blossom, it delivers a fresh and aquatic clarity that defines its refined character.

 

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Jasmine, Jasmine Tea, Tea

Middle notes: White Peach, Bergamot

Base notes: Plum Blossom

title: Beyond The Wall Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Beyond The Wall Extrait de Parfum by Gritti is a sophisticated unisex fragrance launched in 2022, expertly crafted by perfumer Luca Gritti. This distinctive scent opens with fresh, aromatic top notes of Artemisia, Violet, and spicy Ginger, creating an intriguing and vibrant introduction. At its heart, creamy Milk blends seamlessly with powdery Iris and soothing Black Tea, adding depth and elegance. The composition settles into a warm, sensual base of White Musk, rich Sandalwood, and spicy Cardamom, offering a long-lasting, refined finish. Beyond The Wall captures a unique balance of freshness and warmth, ideal for those seeking a versatile and memorable scent.

 

Fragrance family: Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Artemisia, Violet and Ginger

Middle notes: Milk, Iris and Black Tea

Base notes: White Musk, Sandalwood and Cardamom

title: Antalya Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Antalya Eau de Parfum by Gritti offers a sophisticated Oriental scent designed for both women and men, first introduced in 2010. This fragrance opens with fresh, aquatic top notes of sea water and the aromatic green touch of myrtle, evoking a crisp coastal breeze. At its heart, rich woody accords combine with the warmth of cedar and the distinctive depth of tobacco, creating a complex and inviting mid-layer. The base reveals a subtle marine essence of seaweed intertwined with the creamy, resinous warmth of amber, lending a lasting, refined finish. Antalya balances freshness and warmth with expert craftsmanship, making it ideal for those seeking an elegant and enduring fragrance experience.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea water and Myrtle

Middle notes: Woody Notes, Cedar and Tobacco

Base notes: Seaweed and Amber

title: Aqua Incanta Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Aqua Incanta Eau de Parfum by Gritti is a refined Floral Aquatic fragrance crafted exclusively for women, introduced in 2012. It opens with the elegant blend of iris and rose, offering a fresh yet soft floral introduction. The heart reveals powdery notes combined with the comforting sweetness of vanilla, creating a delicate and warm mid-layer. Anchoring the scent are base notes of benzoin, amber, and woody accords, which provide depth and lasting warmth. This composition skillfully balances freshness with creamy warmth, making Aqua Incanta an ideal choice for those who appreciate sophisticated and enduring floral-aquatic perfumes.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris and Rose

Middle notes: Powdery Notes and Vanilla

Base notes: Benzoin, Amber and Woody Notes

title: Noctem Arabs Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Noctem Arabs by Gritti is a masterful Oriental Woody fragrance crafted for both women and men, embodying a timeless elegance since its launch in 2014. The scent opens with a bold combination of tobacco, patchouli, and Virginian cedar, creating a rich and inviting introduction. At its heart, precious agarwood (oud) and creamy sandalwood deepen the composition, offering a sophisticated warmth and resinous depth. The base is anchored by a sensual blend of musk, myrrh, and amber, which provide a lasting impression of mystery and allure. This fragrance is ideal for those seeking a refined and enduring scent that balances strength with subtlety.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Sandalwood

Base notes: Musk, Myrrh and Amber

title: Preludio Eau de Parfum

Preludio by Gritti is a refined Woody Aromatic fragrance designed for both women and men, offering a dynamic and balanced scent experience. It begins with fresh and invigorating top notes of lavender, watermelon, and lemon that awaken the senses with bright, crisp energy. The heart reveals a complex blend of pine tree, woody accords, sandalwood, and tobacco, creating a rich, textured character that evokes both strength and sophistication. Finally, the base settles into warm and earthy tones of musk, borage, and amber, providing a lasting depth and sensual finish. This fragrance is perfect for those seeking a versatile and elegant scent that smoothly transitions from day to night.

 

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Woody

Top notes: Lavender, Watermelon and Lemon

Middle notes: Pine Tree, Woody Notes, Sandalwood and Tobacco

title: Rebellion Eau de Parfum

Rebellion by Gritti is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2021 and crafted by perfumer Luca Gritti. It opens with fresh top notes of lemon zest, mint, and bergamot. The heart features a unique blend of shiso, fruits, and cypress, while the base offers warm, earthy tones of ambergris, patchouli, and oakmoss.

Anima by Gritti is a unisex Oriental fragrance introduced in 2020. Crafted by perfumer Luca Gritti, it opens with vibrant top notes of Pineapple, Apple, Strawberry, Bergamot, Lime, and Plum. The heart reveals a floral blend of Jasmine, Iris, and Rose, while the base is grounded in rich Ambergris, White Musk, Cedar, Patchouli, Vanilla, and Sandalwood, creating a sophisticated and lasting scent experience.
