title: Oud Reale Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Oud Reale by Gritti is a unisex Oriental Spicy fragrance introduced in 2020. Created by perfumer Luca Gritti, it features vibrant top notes of Ginger, Lemon, and Orchid. The heart combines Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Copahu Balm, Amyris, and Jasmine, while the base is anchored by Gurjan balsam, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, and Musk, delivering a complex and refined scent profile.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ginger, Lemon and Orchid

Middle notes: Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Copahu Balm, Amyris and Jasmine

Base notes: Gurjan balsam, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla and Musk.

title: Puro Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Puro by Gritti is a unisex Oriental Floral fragrance introduced in 2020, created by perfumer Luca Gritti. It opens with top notes of Apple, Peony, Lemon, Green Accord, and Pink Pepper. The heart blends Magnolia, Lily-of-the-Valley, Pelargonium, and Petitgrain, while the base features Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Musk, and Ambrette (Musk Mallow), resulting in a balanced and elegant scent.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Apple, Peony, Lemon, Green Accord and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Magnolia, Lily-of-the-Valley, Pelargonium and Petitgrain

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Musk and Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

title: Arancia Ambrata Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Arancia Ambrata by Gritti is a sophisticated unisex citrus fragrance introduced in 2017, crafted by perfumer Luca Gritti. This scent opens with vibrant top notes of Calabrian bergamot and blood orange, enriched by subtle spices that add complexity. At its heart, the fragrance unfolds with the fresh elegance of vetiver, jasmine, and rose, creating a refined floral-woody balance. The composition settles into a warm and inviting base of vetiver, creamy sandalwood, smooth vanilla, and rich amber, offering a lasting impression of depth and sensuality. Ideal for those seeking a well-rounded, expert-crafted fragrance that harmonizes freshness with warmth.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calabrian bergamot, Blood Orange and Spices

Middle notes: Vetiver, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, Vanilla and Amber

title: Costiera Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Costiera by Gritti is a refined unisex Citrus Aromatic fragrance launched in 2017, expertly crafted by perfumer Luca Gritti. It opens with invigorating top notes of fresh rosemary, vibrant Calabrian bergamot, and sweet orange, creating an immediate sense of Mediterranean freshness. The heart unveils a unique blend of marine sea notes, delicate lemon blossom, and subtle floral accords, evoking coastal breezes and sunlit shores. The fragrance gracefully settles into a warm, comforting base of creamy sandalwood, rich amber, and smooth vanilla, adding depth and sensuality. Perfect for individuals seeking a sophisticated scent that captures the essence of a coastal Mediterranean escape.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rosemary, Calabrian bergamot and Orange

Middle notes: Sea Notes, Lemon Blossom and Floral Notes

Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber and Vanilla

title: Neroli Extreme Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Neroli Extreme Eau de Parfum by Gritti is a captivating unisex citrus fragrance expertly crafted by perfumer Luca Gritti and launched in 2017. This sophisticated scent highlights the vibrant and elegant essence of neroli, layered with zesty citrus notes that bring a fresh, invigorating character. Perfectly balanced, Neroli Extreme offers a refined aroma that suits both women and men seeking a distinctive and uplifting fragrance experience. Its alluring composition makes it ideal for daytime wear, adding a touch of brightness and sophistication to any occasion.

 

Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Petitgrain, Orange, Lemon Peel

Middle notes: Musk, Vanilla

Base notes: Amber, Galbanum

title: Dame de L'ile Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dame de L'Île by Gritti is an Oriental Floral scent designed for women, introduced in 2018. Created by perfumer Luca Gritti, it opens with bright bergamot and lime. The heart combines jasmine, ambergris, and rose, while its base reveals musk, vanilla, and animalic nuances, offering a rich and sophisticated fragrance experience.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Lime

Middle notes: Jasmine, Ambergris and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla and Animal notes

title: Macrame Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Macrame Eau de Parfum by Gritti is an elegant Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women, launched in 2018 by renowned perfumer Luca Gritti. This sophisticated scent opens with a fresh and zesty burst of bergamot, creating an inviting and vibrant introduction. At its heart, the blend of delicate rose and luscious cassis offers a harmonious floral-fruity fusion that adds depth and complexity. The fragrance settles into a warm and sensual base of musk and patchouli, providing a lasting impression of refined softness and subtle earthiness. Macrame balances freshness and richness, making it a versatile choice for both day and evening wear.

Fragrance family: Rose, Musk

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose and Cassis

Base notes: Musk and Patchouli

title: Chyprissime Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Chyprissime Eau de Parfum redefines tradition by blending unexpected notes, a tribute to Thierry Mugler’s fearless creativity. Les Exceptions challenges conventional perfumery with bold ingredient pairings that rejuvenate classic olfactory families. This masterpiece enhances the iconic chypre accord—bergamot, orange, oak moss, and patchouli—with a striking burst of pear, adding a fresh luminosity. The result is an elegant and sophisticated fragrance that radiates sensuality and exemplifies Mugler’s distinctive artistry.

Fragrance family: Chypre

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Oakmoss, Bergamot

Middle notes: Pear, Orange

Base notes: Patchouli

title: Fougere Furieuse Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Fougere Furieuse Eau de Parfum ventures into uncharted territory by blending genres and crafting bold, unexpected combinations. Inspired by Thierry Mugler’s rebellious spirit, Les Exceptions redefines classic fragrance families to create something truly remarkable. Mugler challenges traditional forms through inventive pairings that feature surprising ingredients. This intoxicating collection showcases exquisite materials fused into unique, compelling scents that embody Mugler’s signature artistry. Fougere Furieuse captures the quiet power of the forest floor, intertwining aromatic and woody fougère notes—geranium, oak moss, coumarin, and bergamot—with vibrant hints of orange, neroli, and amber, delivering a lively, sensual, and adventurous olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Herbal Notes and Fern

Middle notes: Geranium and Neroli

Base notes: Oakmoss, Coumarin and Amber

title: Homme II Eau de Parfum
body_html:
The design of Homme II Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from the iconic Alhambra palace in Granada, Spain, a masterpiece of Medieval architecture renowned for its intricate planning, elaborate decorations, and enchanting gardens and fountains. Known as Qal’at al-Hamra, or the Red Fort, the Alhambra was constructed by the Nasrid Dynasty between 1232 and 1492. The fragrance’s design incorporates geometric elements inspired by the palace’s distinctive facets and decorative motifs, particularly the 4-, 5-, and 6-pointed stars. This mathematical approach to design lends both KAJAL HOMME and HOMME II a refined and signature aesthetic.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Amber, Lemon, Green Notes and Orange Blossom

Middle notes: Peach, Lavender, Cinnamon, Cedar, Rosemary, Clary Sage and Cloves

Base notes: Woody Notes, Sweet Notes, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Patchouli and Musk

title: Sawlaj Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sawlaj Eau de Parfum by Kajal, crafted by expert perfumer Christian Carbonnel, is a distinctive unisex leather fragrance launched in 2017. It opens with fresh, invigorating top notes of labdanum, lemon, and bergamot that provide a bright introduction. The heart reveals a rich blend of carnation, leather, patchouli, jasmine, and rose, delivering depth and complexity with a bold yet elegant character. The fragrance settles into a warm, lasting base of benzoin, oakmoss, vanilla, and vetiver, enhancing its sophisticated and enduring aroma. This carefully balanced composition offers a refined sensory experience suitable for both day and evening wear.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Labdanum, Lemon and Bergamot

Middle notes: Carnation, Leather, Patchouli, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Benzoin, Oakmoss, Vanilla and Vetiver

title: Jihan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jihan Eau de Parfum by Kajal, introduced in 2018, is a sophisticated woody spicy fragrance designed for both women and men. The composition opens with vibrant top notes of saffron and apple blossom, offering a unique and alluring start. Its heart combines the floral elegance of rose and magnolia with the warm, spicy nuance of clove, creating a rich and dynamic middle layer. The base features a luxurious blend of agarwood (oud), patchouli, vanilla, sandalwood, and musk, providing a deep, sensual foundation that lingers throughout the day. This expertly crafted fragrance balances freshness, warmth, and intensity for a versatile and captivating scent experience.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron and Apple Blossom

Middle notes: Rose, Clove and Magnolia

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Joorie Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Joorie Eau de Parfum by Kajal is a sophisticated Oriental Floral fragrance designed for both women and men, introduced in 2018. Its complex composition opens with invigorating top notes of cloves, nutmeg, pepper, ginger, bergamot, and lemon, creating a vibrant and spicy introduction. The heart reveals a lush bouquet of rose, ylang-ylang, and orange blossom, adding floral warmth and depth. The scent settles into a rich, alluring base of honey, patchouli, cedar, tonka bean, musk, and vanilla, providing a smooth, sensual finish. This well-balanced perfume offers a lasting impression of elegance suitable for any occasion.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cloves, Nutmeg, Pepper, Ginger, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: Rose, Ylang-Ylang and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Honey, Patchouli, Cedar, Tonka Bean, Musk and Vanilla

title: Kajal IV Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Kajal IV evokes the spirit of nomadic exoticism, inspired by the untamed African Savannah. Its opening combines the warm allure of Davana Gaze with a lively mix of Cassis, Rum, and cardamom. The heart blends the sweet aromas of Jasmine and Palm flowers with smooth Leather undertones. The base transports you to a wild paradise where rich palm trees offer fresh Kholas Dates, harmonizing with a captivating fusion of Musk, Woods, and Vanilla for a seductive finish.

Fragrance family: Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Davana, Cardamom, Rum and Cassis

Middle notes: Leather, Palm Tree and Jasmine

Base notes: Dates, Vanilla, Woody Notes and Musk

title: Perfect Oud Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Mizensir Perfect Oud captures the vivid glow of glowing red embers from burning oud wood, unleashing a deep and smoky woody aroma. Renowned perfumer Alberto Morillas highlights the rare Alaskan cedar at the core, complemented by refreshing touches of cardamom and bergamot essence. This extrait de parfum combines rose oxide and rum absolute, elegantly elevating the smoky notes and awakening the senses with a refined intensity.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot and Cardamom

Middle notes: Rose Oxide, Cedar Essence and Rum

Base notes: Oud, Incense and Vanilla

title: Platinum Blend Parfum Intense
body_html:
Platinum Blend Parfum Intense by Atkinsons, launched in 2025, is a sophisticated unisex fragrance expertly crafted for those who appreciate depth and complexity in scent. This composition opens with vibrant top notes of Belanis and Madagascan laurel, providing a fresh yet intriguing introduction. The heart reveals creamy Australian sandalwood paired with delicately sweet heliotrope, creating a smooth and elegant core. Anchoring the fragrance, a warm and resinous base of Spanish labdanum absolute harmonizes with the comforting richness of tonka bean, adding lasting intensity and sensuality. Platinum Blend Parfum Intense is a refined choice for both day and evening wear, offering a balanced yet memorable olfactory experience.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Belanis and Laurels

Middle notes: Heliotrope and Australian Sandalwood

Base notes: Tonka Bean and Spanish Labdanum

title: La Primavera Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Sandro Botticelli, a master of the Early Renaissance, is famed for artworks that blend religious themes with Greek mythology. His renowned painting La Primavera captures the spirit of spring, depicting a mythical garden full of love, fertility, and renewal. This fragrance honors earthly love as a gateway to the divine, inspired by Botticelli’s vibrant tribute to life and beauty.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Green Leaf

Middle notes: Rose, Heliotrope

Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Vetiver

title: Lyric Woman Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Amouage Lyric Woman unfolds with an eternal rose in deep red shades. Its opening features a blend of bergamot and spices including ginger, cinnamon, and saffron. The heart reveals a rich rose accord, complemented by angelica and a floral blend of jasmine, ylang-ylang, geranium, and iris root. The fragrance settles into a base of oak moss, musk, woody notes, patchouli, vetiver, sandalwood, Tonka bean, and incense, creating a sophisticated and enduring scent experience.

Fragrance family: Floral, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Cinnamon, Ginger and Bergamot

Middle notes: Rose, Geranium, Ylang-Ylang, Orris Root, Angelica and Jasmine

Base notes: Incense, Sandalwood, Woodsy Notes, Musk, Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss, Vanilla and Vetiver

title: Chypre Toscano Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Chypre Toscano by Unique'e Luxury is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2018. Crafted by perfumers Sylvain Cara and Jorge Lee, it opens with vibrant notes of saffron, lavender, thyme, violet, cloves, black tea, and cinnamon. The heart reveals rich accords of leather, smoke, cedar, patchouli, and styrax, while the base settles into a warm blend of woody notes, olibanum, musk, and vanilla.


Fragrance family: Spicy, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Lavender, Thyme, Violet, Cloves, Black Tea and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Leather, Smoke, Cedar, Patchouli and Styrax

Base notes: Woody Notes, Olibanum, Musk and Vanilla

title: Hidden Accords Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Hidden Accords by Unique'e Luxury is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2018. Crafted by perfumers Sylvain Cara and Selim Özen, it opens with vibrant notes of pear, orange blossom, and pink pepper. The heart reveals a rich blend of coffee and jasmine, while the base offers warm tones of vanilla, cedar, and patchouli.


Fragrance family: Floral, Sweet

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Orange Blossom and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Coffee and Jasmine

Base notes: Vanilla, Cedar and Patchouli

title: SoScentific Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
SoScentific Extrait de Parfum captures the elusive essence of osmanthus, one of the rarest and most exquisite flowers of the Far East. This fragrance delicately balances the floral's rich, sweet aroma with subtle hints that evoke the purity and elegance of a bride emerging in nature. Expertly crafted, it offers a refined and sophisticated scent profile that unfolds seamlessly on the skin. With this extrait de parfum, you hold the key to releasing the full, enchanting presence of osmanthus, transforming your fragrance experience into a rare olfactory journey.


Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Osmanthus, Orange Blossom and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Peach, Strawberry, Plum, Cherry, Pink Pepper and Jasmine

Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Amber and Cedar

title: Chocolate Makes Me Happy Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Indulge in the sophisticated allure of Chocolate Makes Me Happy Extrait de Parfum, where the richness of premium cocoa beans is captured in a masterful blend. This fragrance transcends mere scent to evoke the joy and comfort that chocolate brings, expertly crafted to highlight the depth and warmth of its key ingredient. Each note is carefully balanced to create an unforgettable aromatic experience that lifts the spirit and delights the senses. Perfect for those who appreciate refined gourmand fragrances, this extrait de parfum offers a lasting impression of happiness and indulgence. Embrace a scent that turns everyday moments into luxurious escapes.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cacao Pod, Dark Chocolate, Lavender, Grapefruit and Mandarin Orange

Middle notes: Benzoin, Ginger, Cinnamon, Labdanum and Olibanum

Base notes:  Cacao Pod, Caramel, Amber, Vetiver, Sandalwood and Musk

title: Beril Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Long before amber was recognized by name, our ancestors referred to this enchanting substance as the "Gravitational field." Its swift attraction to the body comes from its unique property of melting instantly upon contact with skin temperature. BERİL captures the essence of this phenomenon, representing the most intense and refined interpretation of amber.

Fragrance family: Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Pink Pepper, Lemon, Coriander and Cardamom

Middle notes: Rose, Jasmine, Thyme, Nutmeg and Cinnamon

Base notes:  Musk, Patchouli, Amber and Vetiver

title: Woud And Mood Absolute Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Woud And Mood Absolute Extrait de Parfum delivers a sophisticated fragrance experience for both women and men. Launched in 2024, it opens with bright citrus, aromatic herbs, and spicy saffron that create an inviting warmth. The heart reveals a robust woody blend of guaiac wood, dry patchouli, benzoin, and labdanum, adding depth and richness. Its base combines leather, oud, nagarmotha, musk, and amber to provide a luxurious, ambery foundation with a powerful, lasting scent trail. This extrait de parfum showcases an expert balance of woody elegance and intense character.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Citruses and Herbal Notes

Middle notes: Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Benzoin and Labdanum

Base notes: Oud, Leather, Amber, Musk and Nagarmotha

title: Golden Gallop Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Golden Gallop by Hajine captures the essence of untamed luxury, inspired by the noble grace of horses. This fragrance blends power and elegance, reflecting the dynamic energy of a galloping journey through golden fields. A fusion scent that combines warmth and vitality in every note, Golden Gallop embodies the vibrant spirit of a sunlit sprint.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Elemi, Firbalsam, Orange and Jasmine Absolute

Middle notes: Thyme, Patchouli, Raspberry and Oud

Base notes: Sandalwood, Moss, Praline and Amber

title: Santal Intense Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Santal Intense honors the deep and enchanting aroma of sandalwood. This smooth core is enhanced by spicy cardamom and black pepper, perfectly balanced with lavender at its heart to form a timeless woody fougère scent. The fragrance’s base is intensified with amber and frankincense, resulting in a richer, longer-lasting experience. A delicate blend of vanilla and tonka bean introduces subtle sweetness and warmth, while the amber and frankincense impart a mystical depth, enhancing the overall allure.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Black Pepper, Lemon, Bergamot and Green Grass

Middle notes: Clove, Lavender and Nutmeg

Base notes: Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Frankincense, Vetiver, Vanilla, Amber and Musk

title: Vanilla Powder Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Vanilla Powder by MATIERE PREMIERE offers a distinctive take on vanilla, highlighting the contrast between the deep intensity of Vanilla Absolute Fair for Life Madagascar and an abundance of white powders with modern accords. For the Vanilla Powder Extrait, Maison Founding Perfumer Aurélien Guichard enhanced the Eau de Parfum by adding Tonka Bean Absolute Venezuela. This ingredient, combined with an increased perfume concentration and a richer vanilla presence, introduces a velvety powdery quality that amplifies the fragrance’s captivating allure.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Coconut Powder and Heliotrope

Middle notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean

Base notes: Vanilla Absolute, White Musk, Musk, Palo Santo, Lactones and Coconut

title: Piccadilly Hero Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Piccadilly Hero by Fabbrica della Musa captures the dynamic spirit and distinctive style of London’s fashion world. Crafted by perfumer Hamid Merati-Kashani and launched in 2025, the fragrance begins with vibrant cherry and pear notes. Its heart reveals geranium, sunflower, and lavender, while the base combines saffron, tobacco, and guaiac wood. This blend artfully balances fruity freshness with floral and woody richness. Reflecting London’s bold and confident fashion culture, Piccadilly Hero celebrates individuality and fearless self-expression at the heart of a global style capital.

 


Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pear, Apple, Orange Blossom, Cherry and Praline

Middle notes: Violet, Solar Notes, Geranium, Lavender and Black Tea

Base notes: Tobacco, Guaiac Wood, Pink Pepper, Saffron, Leather, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vanilla

title: Tribeca Vibes Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Tribeca Vibes by Fabbrica della Musa draws inspiration from New York City's vibrant energy, merging tradition with modern flair. The fragrance opens with bright grapefruit and fresh green grass, unfolding into a floral heart of violet, rose, and jasmine. Its base combines vetiver, smoky incense, clove, and musk, crafting a musky-woody scent that mirrors the city's urban character. This blend captures New York’s unique fusion of history and innovation, reflecting its diverse culture and iconic landmarks, from lively jazz clubs to renowned theaters and fashion scenes.

 

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grass, Grapefruit and Basil

Middle notes: Violet, Jasmine and Rose

Base notes: Vetiver, Clove, Musk, Incense and Cetalox

title: Holy Berry Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Holy Berry Extrait de Parfum by D’ORSAY unveils a vibrant burst of red berries and luminous strawberry, enveloped in a gentle, creamy veil that reveals a hidden sweetness with an alluring edge. The subtle intrigue of iris blends seamlessly with the sacred warmth of white oud and sandalwood, leaving an enduring impression on the skin. Enriched with dark vanilla, this sweet-woody fragrance transforms temptation into an instinctive, evocative ritual with an almost enchanting quality.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Strawberry Milk Accord, Cardamom

Middle notes: Iris Concrete, Jasmine, White Oud Accord

Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood

title: Rose Blaze Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
D’ORSAY’s Rose Blaze Extrait de Parfum captures an aromatic spell, blending vibrant passion with soft floral notes. It opens with lively bergamot and peach, revealing a luxurious rose softened by iris and enveloped in smoldering sandalwood. As it settles, benzoin and vanilla create a smooth, warm embrace, while subtle hints of amber add a delicate spice that awakens the senses.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Peach, Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Rose Absolute, Iris Butter

Base notes: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Orpur

title: Incense Crush Extrait De Parfum
body_html:
Incense Crush Extrait de Parfum exudes a compelling allure. True to D’ORSAY’s signature naming convention, this fragrance centers on a warm, spicy amber heart highlighted by rich oak and cedar bases. Notes of cardamom, saffron, and clove provide a lavish and captivating intensity with every breath.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Clove, Cardamom

Middle notes: Leather Accord, Creamy Accord

Base notes: Olibanum, Cedarwood, Oak Wood, Vetiver

title: Dandy Or Not G.A Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Dandy Or Not G.A Eau De Parfum by D'ORSAY, crafted by perfumer Nicolas Beaulieu, captures a perfect balance of warmth and freshness. Inspired by the brand’s heritage since 1865, this fragrance celebrates individuality and self-expression. The intricate blend of spicy cardamom and rich leather creates a distinctive, multi-layered scent that lingers elegantly on the skin.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom and Grapefruit

Middle notes: Black Tea and Orange Blossom

Base notes: Leather, Cedar and Patchouli

title: Te Dire Oui V.H Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Established in 1865, D'ORSAY stands as a trusted name in fragrance. Embrace Te Dire Oui V.H. eau de parfum—meaning 'Say yes and mean yes'—as your next signature scent. Created by Vincent Ricord for D'ORSAY, this fragrance, enriched with saffron, invites you to explore the blooming floral landscapes of distant horizons.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Black Pepper, Pink Berries, Incense

Middle notes: Nagarmotha, Leather, Damask Rose, Sandalwood

Base notes: Styrax, Benzoin, Moss, Musk

title: Sweet Disruption W.T Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Sweet Disruption W.T Eau De Parfum defies gender and convention with its striking fragrance. Originally exclusive to D'ORSAY’s Tokyo boutique, it gained wider recognition when passionate perfumers beyond Japan sought out its dynamic, vibrant core. Now accessible globally, this scent blends luminous jasmine, moss accord, and alluring frankincense to create a bold olfactory statement.

 

 Fragrance family: Oriental, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink pepper extract, Spearmint, Mandarin

Middle notes: Jasmine absolute, Frankincense oil, Geranium oil

Base notes: Vetiver oil, Haiti for life, Olibanum resinoid, Moss accord

title: Sketchbook P.33 Blank Page Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sketchbook P.33 Blank Page Eau de Parfum honors unfiltered creativity, inspired by page 33 of Sergio Momo’s personal sketchbook—the foundation of the Sketchbook Collection. This floral-fruity fragrance begins with a vibrant, refreshing burst before unveiling a refined heart of iris, cinnamon, and cypress, adding complexity and elegance. It concludes with a warm, genuine blend of amber, cedarwood, and musk. The collection brings to life Momo’s visionary designs and ideas, previously unseen and boundary-breaking, now transformed into scent.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Grapefruit, Apple and Bergamot

Middle notes: Cypress, Iris and Cinnamon

Base notes: Musk, Cedarwood and Amber

title: Coro Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Coro Eau de Parfum captures the spirit of a dynamic early riser, imbued with vibrant energy that motivates and invigorates. Designed for those ready to seize each day, it opens with a fresh, uplifting aroma that mirrors the crispness of dawn. The fragrance evokes imagery of morning hikes and the exhilaration of reaching new heights, blending carefully selected notes to create a sophisticated yet lively experience. Its expertly balanced composition ensures lasting freshness, making it an ideal companion for moments when focus and resilience are essential. Coro is more than a scent; it’s an invitation to embrace life’s challenges with confidence and clarity.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Tropical Fruits

Middle notes: Mango, Pineapple and Jasmine

Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Musk and Sandalwood

title: Woody Spirit Extriat de Parfum
body_html:
The valuable wood from a lush forest, paired with the finest tobacco leaves and enveloped in soft styrax balsam, delivers an unforgettable sensory journey for anyone drawn to this fragrance.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Bergamot and Green Notes

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Lavender

Base notes: Musk, Vetiver and Tonka

title: Dream Hashimi Extriat de Parfum
body_html:
Dream Hashimi Extrait de Parfum springs from a visionary dream where tradition and modernity blend seamlessly. This expertly crafted formula results in an exceptional and unique scent that captivates with a personal touch. Its complex layers unfold to reveal a mysterious aura, making it a distinctive fragrance that leaves a lasting impression. Ideal for those seeking a sophisticated and enigmatic presence, Dream Hashimi balances heritage with contemporary elegance in every breath.

Fragrance family: Woody, Leather

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Birch, Vetiver and Hibiscus

Middle notes: Tobacco, Gurjan balsam and Violet

Base notes: Civet, elemi, Peru Balsam, Tonka, Labdanum and Sandalwood

title: Magnum Iris Extriat de Parfum
body_html:
Magnum Iris Extrait de Parfum showcases the rare and luxurious Florence iris, celebrated worldwide for its refined elegance. This exquisite ingredient imparts a dry, deep, and majestic character to the fragrance, creating a magnificent scent that resonates with sophistication. Designed for discerning connoisseurs, Magnum Iris offers a unique olfactory experience that combines nobility with timeless luxury, making it an exceptional choice for those who appreciate the finest in perfumery.

Fragrance family: Woody, Powdery

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris, Raspberry, Vetiver and Immortelle

Middle notes: Ylang-Ylang and Tonka

Base notes: Iris, Virginia Cedar and Styrax

title: Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne
body_html:
Jo Malone introduced the Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne in September 2014, complemented by a matching body care line. Available globally at leading perfumeries and duty-free outlets, this fragrance blends ambrette seed, sea salt, sage, red algae, and grapefruit. Perfumer Christine Nagel describes it as a unique scent capturing the essence of sea air combined with the salty, mineral nuances of sand and stones. Evoking the natural freshness of driftwood, it offers a sophisticated yet free-spirited blend of wood and sea elements.

Fragrance family: Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Salt, Sage

Middle notes: Grapefruit, Ambrette (Musk Mallow)

Base notes: Seaweed

title: Amelia Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Rooted in Grossmith’s rich heritage, this delicate and feminine fragrance pays tribute to Amelia Brooke (née Grossmith), the founder’s daughter. Amelia is an elegant Chypre blend that begins with inviting top notes of Neroli and Osmanthus. Its floral heart features Rose, Peony, and Jasmine, gracefully layered over a warm Oriental base. The scent is anchored by enduring notes of Patchouli, Sandalwood, Vetiver, and Cashmere Musk, creating a smooth and sophisticated finish.

 

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Neroli and Osmanthus

Middle notes: Rose, Peony, Jasmine and Amber

Base notes: Vetiver, Cashmere Musk, Patchouli and Sandalwood

title: Floral Veil Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Floral Veil captures the essence of mystery and elegance, much like a delicate veil. It begins with fresh, vibrant citrus and green notes that contrast beautifully with a rich floral core of geranium, rose, ylang, tuberose, and vanilla orchid. The fragrance settles into a warm, refined base of cashmeran, oriental, and musk. Part of the Black Label modern collection, this scent exemplifies the sophistication and luxury that define Grossmith British heritage.

 

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black Currant, Green Notes, Citruses and Lemon

Middle notes: Tuberose, Vanilla Orchid, Geranium, Ylang-Ylang and Rose

Base notes: Musk, Cashmeran and Amber

title: Phul-Nana Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Phul-Nana, meaning ‘lovely flower,’ was introduced in 1891 as a tribute to a carefully selected bouquet of Indian flowers. Its blend features bergamot, orange, neroli, geranium, tuberose, ylang-ylang, patchouli, benzoin, cedar, sandalwood, opoponax, tonka bean, and vanilla. This fragrance laid the foundation for modern oriental scents.

 

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Neroli, Bergamot and Orange

Middle notes: Geranium, Ylang-Ylang and Tuberose

Base notes: Opoponax, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedar and Vanilla

title: Saffron Rose Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Saffron Rose Eau de Parfum is a genuine and intricate Oud fragrance blending saffron and rose for a rich, luxurious aroma. It opens with spicy saffron and cinnamon, complemented by elegant rose. The heart features exotic myrrh, oud, and tobacco, adding a captivating smoky depth. This evolves into a sumptuous base of creamy woods, labdanum, and deep animalic notes.

 

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose, Saffron and Cinnamon

Middle notes: Agarwood (Oud), Tobacco, Myrrh and Woody Notes

Base notes: Castoreum, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood, Amber and Sandalwood

title: Betrothal Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Betrothal Eau de Parfum was originally created by Grossmith for Princess May’s wedding to King George V. The princess later became Queen Mary, Prince William’s great-great grandmother, linking this fragrance to royal history. Revived for the modern royal wedding of William and Kate, Betrothal opens with fresh citrus notes before unfolding into a floral heart dominated by Rose de Mai and jasmine. Rose de Mai is a rare and valuable ingredient, exclusively grown in Grasse, France, the historic center of perfumery.

 

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Citruses

Middle notes: Heliotrope, Ylang-Ylang, Rose, African Orange Flower and Jasmine

Base notes: Civetta, Vetiver and Vanille

title: Diamond Jubilee Bouquet Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Diamond Jubilee Bouquet by Grossmith is a floral woody musk fragrance for women, introduced in 2012 and crafted by perfumer Trevor Nicholl. It opens with top notes of narcissus, citrus, and lily-of-the-valley, followed by a floral heart of iris, violet, carnation, rose, and jasmine. The base is composed of tonka bean, vetiver, musk, amber, vanilla, and hawthorn, creating a sophisticated and elegant aroma.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Narcissus, Citruses and Lily-of-the-Valley

Middle notes: Iris, Violet, Carnation, Rose and Jasmine

Base notes: Tonka Bean, Vetiver, Musk, Amber, Vanilla and Hawthorn

title: Carios Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Carios opens with a vibrant burst of red mandarin and succulent bergamot, accented by the sharp zest of saffron and pink peppercorn—an arresting introduction. At its core, aromatic red thyme intertwines with the floral sharpness of geranium and the spicy warmth of black pepper, creating a nuanced complexity. The base reveals a rich blend of roasted tonka bean, woody cedarwood, earthy vetiver, and a subtle layer of ambroxan, leaving a captivating and sophisticated trail.

Fragrance family: Woody, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Mandarin Orange, Pink Pepper and Bergamot

Middle notes: Black Pepper, Geranium and Red Thyme

Base notes: Ambroxan, Tonka Bean, Cedarwood and Vetiver

title: Eragon Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Eragon unfolds as a striking interplay of brightness and depth, blending spicy amber with creamy sweetness to embody the essence of a bold creator. The fragrance opens with vibrant notes of bergamot, mandarin, and cardamom, accentuated by the sharpness of pink peppercorn, evoking a sense of daring exploration. Its core reveals a fiery mix of cinnamon, fresh herbal Davana, and the smoky earthiness of Cypriol (nagarmotha). This complex heart transitions into a rich base of warm vanilla bean, smooth tonka bean, and opulent patchouli, all enveloped in soft leather, creating a lasting impression of refined sensuality. Eragon is an oriental-woody amber layered with gourmand nuances—radiant, grounded, sweet, and spiced.

 

Fragrance family: Woody, Oriental

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot and Cardamom

Middle notes: Cypriol, Cinnamon and Davana

Base notes: Leather, Vanilla Bean, Tonka Bean and Patchouli

title: Patchoulight Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Patchoulight Eau de Parfum masterfully combines the rich depth of Musk with the delicate yet bold floral nuances of Iris concrete, elevating the fragrance’s complexity and elegance. At its heart, the traditional earthiness of Patchouli is reimagined with a contemporary edge, blending seamlessly into a refined woody aroma that feels both timeless and fresh. This sophisticated composition offers a balanced interplay between intense muskiness and floral brightness, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a modern, versatile scent that leaves a lasting impression. Ideal for confident wearers who appreciate nuanced perfumery with an expert touch.

Fragrance family: Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink pepper essence

Middle notes: Iris concrete, Rose, Violet leaf absolute

Base notes: Patchouli essence, Musk, Benjoin Resinoid

title: Pomeloflow Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Verticaloud Eau de Parfum is a compelling fragrance that commands attention with its powerful presence. Expertly crafted, it combines the timeless elegance of Rose Essence with the rich, resinous depth of Oud, a rare dark wood native to the Middle East, renowned for its luxurious aroma. This iconic note is artfully reinterpreted to bring forward a refined and sophisticated character. Complemented by a warm Amber note, the fragrance achieves a harmonious balance, adding an alluring depth and warmth that captivates the senses. Verticaloud is an expertly layered scent designed for those who appreciate complexity and refinement in their fragrance choices.


Fragrance family: Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pink Grapefruit essence, Mandarin essence, Blackcurrant

Middle notes: Rhubarb, Jasmine absolute, Lychee

Base notes: Vetiver essence, Musk

title: Sandalsun Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Sandalsun Eau de Parfum captures the radiant warmth and exotic allure of a sun-drenched day. This fragrance harmoniously blends the creamy richness of sandalwood essence with the smooth, sweet nuances of hazelnut and vanilla. The result is a luxurious, comforting scent that evokes the gentle embrace of sunlight on skin and the serene pleasure of leisurely moments. Sandalsun beautifully balances oriental heat with soft gourmand undertones, making it a sophisticated choice for those seeking a refined yet inviting perfume that celebrates the sweeter side of woody fragrances.


Fragrance family: Gourmand, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Hazelnut, Bergamot essence

Middle notes: Vanilla extract, Cacao, Heliotrope

Base notes: Sandalwood essence, Myrrhe essence, Musk

title: Amberoud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Amberoud Eau de Parfum masterfully blends the vibrant intensity of black coffee with the deep, luxurious character of oud essence. This captivating combination creates a bold and sophisticated scent that commands attention. Enhanced by a rich amber note, the fragrance reveals an alluring animalistic and sensual depth, perfect for those who appreciate complexity and refinement. Amberoud offers a unique olfactory experience that balances energizing warmth with mysterious elegance, making it an exceptional choice for evenings or special occasions.


Fragrance family: Amber, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Black coffee, Bergamot essence, Saffron

Middle notes: Amber, Iris, Suede

Base notes: Oud essence, Vetiver essence, Patchouli essence

title: Bloomtea Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bloomtea Eau de Parfum highlights a harmony of color-inspired ingredients to evoke the essence of an endless spring. At its heart lies White Lavender, offering a delicate and feminine touch distinct from the traditional blue variety. This is complemented by a fresh and aromatic Green Tea extract that adds vibrancy and clarity. The fragrance deepens with the sensual and refined absolute of Damask rose, enriching the floral experience with elegance. Finally, an enveloping white musk base provides warmth and softness, wrapping the scent in a gentle embrace. Bloomtea creates a spirited, floral composition that captures freshness, sophistication, and the beauty of nature in full bloom.


Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: White Lavender, Green Tea Extract, Clary Sage Essence

Middle notes: Rose Absolute, Geranium Essence, Heliotrope, Pear

Base notes: Musk, Moss, Tonka Bean

title: Tonkandy Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Tonkandy Eau de Parfum invites you into a nostalgic world filled with sweet, comforting delights. The fragrance centers on the warm, powdery richness of tonka bean, which wraps around a creamy vanilla absolute to create an irresistibly smooth signature. Enhanced by a milky caramel candy note, this scent evokes the gentle sweetness of melting confectionery, capturing a fleeting gourmand scent that lingers softly on the skin. Tonkandy blends warmth and delicacy, delivering a cozy, sensual experience reminiscent of cherished childhood memories and indulgent treats.


Fragrance family: Aromatic, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot essence, Cinnamon leaf essence, Black pepper essence

Middle notes: Milky caramel candy, Geranium essence, Davana essence

Base notes: Vanilla absolute, Tonka bean, Musk

title: Eterniris Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Eterniris Eau de Parfum offers a timeless floral experience that captures the essence of eternal elegance. At its core, delicate iris petals unfold to reveal a sophisticated and powdery richness, enhanced by subtle woody undertones that add depth and warmth. This refined composition is balanced by soft, fresh notes that brighten the scent, creating an uplifting yet graceful aura. Eterniris is designed to evoke lasting impressions, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a fragrance that blends classic beauty with modern sophistication. Its harmonious blend ensures a smooth, enduring presence that lingers gently on the skin throughout the day.


Fragrance family: Powdery, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Iris concrete, Raspberry, Bergamot essence

Middle notes: Rose essence, Saffron, Black pepper essence

Base notes: Oud essence, Leather, Cypriol essence

title: Macomba Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Macomba Eau de Parfum captures the fresh and invigorating spirit of nature with a vibrant blend centered on mate essence. This aromatic note pairs beautifully with crisp green accents and the zesty, citrusy brightness of combava, creating an energizing and revitalizing opening. The fragrance is grounded by the earthy, smoky depth of vetiver essence, which adds a sophisticated vegetal quality. This harmonious combination evokes the feeling of a refreshing breath of air, making Combava an ideal fragrance to uplift your mood and energize your day with a natural, lively character. Perfect for those seeking a scent that inspires clarity and freshness, Combava offers a unique balance between brightness and depth.


Fragrance family: Oriental, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Combava, Mandarin essence, Coriander seeds essence, Petitgrain citronnier essence

Middle notes: Cardamom essence, Neroli essence, Angelica roots essence

Base notes: 

Mate superessence, Vetiver essence, Cedarwood essence

title: Darkoud Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Darkoud Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated blend that balances spicy vibrancy with deep luxury. At its core lies a rich oud essence, weaving an opulent and entrancing character that captivates the senses. The freshness and brightness of rose essence add a luminous contrast, enhancing the fragrance’s complexity and inviting allure. Warm saffron notes introduce a subtle spice that enriches the composition, creating a hypnotic and addictive scent experience. Darkoud is designed for those who appreciate a fragrance that is both bold and elegant, offering a harmonious blend of warmth, freshness, and depth that lingers on the skin with irresistible charm.


Fragrance family: Rose, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Bergamote essence, Cardamome

Middle notes: Rose essence, Tuberose absolute, Geranium essence

Base notes: Oud essence, Myrrh essence, Patchouli essence

title: Cedarise Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Cedarise Eau de Parfum pays tribute to the iconic cedar tree, capturing its full natural complexity. At the heart of this fragrance is the pure, resinous scent of cedar essence, complemented by the warm, spicy brightness of cardamom essence. The earthy and woody tones of vetiver add depth and enhance the fragrance’s vegetal character, evoking the rich aroma of roots and forest floor. Together, these notes create a balanced and immersive scent that feels both grounded and uplifting. Cedarise transports you to a peaceful dream beneath a majestic cedar tree, offering a refined, nature-inspired experience that lingers with elegance and strength.


Fragrance family: Powdery, Woody

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom essence, Black pepper essence, Elemi essence

Middle notes: Violet leaf absolute, Geranium essence

Base notes: Vetiver essence, Cedarwood essence, Moss, Patchouli essence

title: Jade888 Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Jade888 Eau de Parfum transports you to the heart of a lush, untamed forest, where dense foliage and tangled vines create a vibrant, natural tapestry. This soft, verdant fragrance opens with the delicate powderiness of iris concrete, bringing a refined floral touch that is both elegant and fresh. The warmth of ginger adds a subtle spice, enhancing the scent’s depth and vitality. Complemented by the gentle sweetness of lily of the valley, the fragrance evokes the fresh, green aroma of blooming undergrowth. Jade888 offers a beautifully balanced blend that captures the wild spirit and serene beauty of the Amazon, making it an ideal choice for those who appreciate nature-inspired scents with complexity and softness.


Fragrance family: Aromatic, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Lily of the valley, Pear, Galbanum essence

Middle notes: Ginger extract, Iris concrete, Clary sage esssence

Base notes: Cedarwood essence, Ambrette seeds absolute, Musk

title: Casablanca Lily Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Discover the nocturnal elegance of Casablanca Lily, a refined extrait de parfum from Byredo's Night Veils collection. This sophisticated fragrance unfolds with an initial burst of gardenia and plum, transitioning into a sumptuous heart of carnation and Indian tuberose. The composition concludes with a graceful base of rosewood and honeyed warmth, creating a multidimensional floral experience enriched by delicate fruity undertones and refined woody nuances.

Fragrance family: Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Gardenia and Plum

Middle notes: Indian Tuberose and Carnation

Base notes: Palisander Rosewood and Honey

title: Vanille Caviar Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted by master perfumer Alexandra Carlin, Vanille Caviar from BDK Parfums is an Oriental Vanilla composition that transcends gender boundaries. The fragrance opens with crisp top notes of calamus and cassis, evolving into a sophisticated heart of vanilla, osmanthus, and cacao. A warm, sensual base of labdanum, vanilla, and Peru balsam creates a lasting impression that balances gourmand sweetness with refined complexity.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Vanilla

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Calamus and Cassis

Middle notes: Vanille, Osmanthus and Cacao

Base notes: Labdanum, Vanille and Peru Balsam

title: Alfa Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Alfa Eau de Parfum captures the essence of primordial beauty and pastoral elegance, evoking the mythological image of Venus emerging from crystalline waters. This fragrance weaves an arcadian narrative through carefully selected accords that celebrate nature's most sensual offerings. The composition opens with earthy, creamy notes reminiscent of milk and sun-drenched vineyards, establishing an intimate foundation. A luminous saffron heart provides warmth and complexity, while the middle notes of jasmine and thyme introduce floral sophistication and herbaceous intrigue. The base reveals the sensual embrace of sandalwood and nutmeg, creating a lingering trail that speaks to refined taste and timeless elegance. Designed for those who appreciate fragrances that transcend mere scent to become olfactory poetry, Alfa represents the convergence of classical mythology and contemporary perfumery. Each application is an invitation to experience beauty in its most authentic, unadorned form.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Ravensara, White Thyme

Middle notes: Jasmine, Saffron, Carnation

Base notes: Indian Sandalwood, Frankincense, Precious Woods, White Musk, Oud

title: Dejan Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Dejan Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from the legendary roses of Oman's Jabal Akhdar mountains. This distinguished composition features a commanding smoky rose accord harmoniously blended with precious oud, musk, and amber. The fragrance evokes an aura of magnificence and individuality, delivering a truly distinctive olfactory experience that celebrates the region's most treasured botanical heritage.

Fragrance family: Rose, Oud

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Rose Water

Middle notes: Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Labdanum

Base notes: Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Musk

title: Alchermes Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Alchermes Extrait de Parfum represents a masterful fusion of historical tradition and contemporary perfumery. Inspired by the legendary Alchermes liqueur—once favored by Caterina de' Medici—this spicy Fougère composition opens with luminous saffron top notes that immediately captivate. Modern galbanum and davana accords provide a sophisticated middle layer, while an exclusive ambery base anchors the composition with sensual depth. This is a fragrance for those who appreciate the intersection of heritage craftsmanship and refined olfactory artistry, delivering an intoxicating elixir of seduction with every application.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fougere

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Saffron, Davana, Peach, Rose, Cinnamon, Clove, Galbanum, Liquor, Bergamot, Pink Grapefruit and Orange

Middle notes: Leather, Saffron, Lavender, Ambrette, Orris, Hay, Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Amyris

Base notes: Musk, Agarwood (Oud), Labdanum, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Spicy Notes, Amber, Ambergris and Immortelle

title: Astronaut Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Adventures await in every spritz of Astronaut Extrait de Parfum, a fragrance engineered for those who dare to dream beyond earthly limits. This alpha-caliber scent captures the essence of cosmic exploration with its cool, crisp composition that evokes the pristine atmosphere of outer space. The opening delivers fresh, invigorating notes reminiscent of a newly minted space helmet with its gleaming golden visor—a sensory nod to humanity's greatest achievements in exploration. Crafted with astonishing longevity, Astronaut demonstrates the endurance required for interstellar journeys, ensuring your signature scent remains steadfast throughout your day. The fragrance balances its futuristic coolness with sophisticated depth, creating a distinctive olfactory experience that transcends conventional perfumery. Whether you're navigating boardrooms or pursuing your boldest ambitions, this extrait de parfum delivers an unmistakable presence that speaks to the pioneer within. A fragrance for the visionary—one who refuses to settle for the ordinary.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Amber

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot, Lime, Feijoa Fruit and Galbanum

Middle notes: Lavender, Brazilian Rosewood, Geranium, Patchouli and Rosemary

Base notes: Floral Notes, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Vetiver and Labdanum

title: De La Lune Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
De La Lune Extrait de Parfum captures the enchantment of moonlit waters through a refined aquatic composition. This citrusy fragrance orchestrates a sophisticated interplay between natural elements and artistic inspiration, evoking the luminous quality of silver light reflecting across nocturnal seas. The scent embodies those languorous summer evenings that stretch into early morning hours, where warmth and mystery converge. Each application transports you to a realm where dreams crystallize beneath the moon's serene influence, creating an olfactory narrative of ethereal beauty and timeless elegance.

Fragrance family: Citrus, Aquatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Notes, Lemon, Petitgrain, Grapefruit, Sea Salt, Bigarade and Fennel

Middle notes: White Rose, Jasmine, Calone, Seaweed, Iris and Sea Daffodil

Base notes: Sea water, Musk, Sea Salt, Mineral notes, Amber, Vetiver and Moss

title: Fond d'Amour Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Fond d'Amour Extrait de Parfum is an exquisitely crafted chocolate fragrance that explores the intoxicating nature of profound emotional connection. This sophisticated composition artfully weaves together cocoa and cardamom at the opening, evolving through sensual florals and elegant chocolate orchid, before culminating in a decadent base of caramelized oud and sandalwood. The fragrance captures that compelling, almost addictive quality of deep affection—a precious bond expressed through refined olfactory artistry. Mexican-inspired accords of cocoa powder, chocolate liqueur, and coffee create a distinctive character that transcends conventional gourmand perfumery, delivering an experience both mysterious and profoundly intimate.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cardamom, Baileys Irish Cream, Chocolate, Cocoa, Cinnamon and Coffee

Middle notes: Chocolate, Cedarwood, Cake, Sandalwood, Hazelnut, Chocolate Fudge, Iris and Orchid

Base notes: Dark Chocolate, Caramel, Sandalwood, Musk, Amyris, Oud, Resin, Copal and Amber

title: Darling Rouge Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Darling Rouge Extrait de Parfum represents a masterful composition born from artistic inspiration at the legendary Moulin Rouge in spring 2022. This sophisticated fragrance celebrates the union of two noble rose varieties—French Centifolia and Turkish Damascena—meticulously blended to capture the essence of emerging romance. The floral heart rests upon a luxurious foundation of sandalwood, delivering an elegant and sensual character that evolves gracefully on the skin. Each application evokes the refined artistry and passionate energy of a cabaret performance, translating visual beauty into olfactory poetry. A testament to meticulous craftsmanship, this extrait de parfum offers enduring sophistication for those who appreciate the intersection of fine fragrance and artistic expression.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: French Rose, Bergamot and Lemon

Middle notes: French Rose, Turkish Rose, Floral Notes, Olibanum and Sandalwood

Base notes: Rose, Musk, Ambergris, Floral Notes, Amber, Labdanum, Vetiver and Vanilla

title: Darling Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Darling Extrait de Parfum stands as an acclaimed gourmand sandalwood creation, recognized internationally at the 2016 World Perfumery Congress in Miami where it ranked among the world's finest ten sandalwood compositions. Crafted around premium natural sandalwood, this niche fragrance has garnered widespread appreciation from both sandalwood aficionados and gourmand perfume enthusiasts alike. Its excellence was further validated by Fragrantica's 2020 recognition as one of the best indie and niche perfumes of the decade, cementing its status as a distinguished olfactory achievement for the discerning collector.

Fragrance family: Fruity, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Cognac, Cherry, Saffron, Fig, Ginger, Dried Plum, Calabrian bergamot and Pink Pepper

Middle notes: Sandalwood, Rum, Guaiac Wood, Marzipan, Praline, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amyris, Coffee blossom, Patchouli, Orchid and Jasmine

Base notes: Sandalwood, Suede, Ambergris, Agarwood (Oud), Benzoin, Spanish Labdanum, Leather, Musk and Powdery Notes

title: Candy Dust Eau de Intimite
body_html:
Candy Dust Eau de Intimité captures the essence of spun sugar and nostalgic sweetness with sophisticated precision. The composition opens with tart raspberry and juicy pear, brightened by bergamot's citrus clarity. A heart of candied dragibus and soft milk mingles with powdery peony, creating an indulgent sweetness. The base anchors the fragrance with powdered sugar, moss, Orcanox™, and tonka bean, delivering a refined, lingering finish that balances gourmand notes with subtle earthiness. An expertly crafted scent for those who appreciate complexity within comfort.

Fragrance family: Sweet, Gourmand

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Raspberry, Pear and Bergamot

Middle notes: Dragibus, Milk and Peony

Base notes: Sugar, Orcanox™, Tonka Bean and Moss

title: My Shadow on the Wall Eau de Parfum
body_html:
My Shadow on the Wall represents Floraïku's distinctive approach to contemporary fragrance design. Crafted by renowned perfumer Alienor Massenet, this unisex composition opens with the crisp, green facets of violet leaf before transitioning into the soft, powdery warmth of mimosa. The base anchors the composition with creamy sandalwood, creating a balanced floral-green profile that appeals equally to women and men. Since its 2017 debut, this eau de parfum has established itself as a refined choice for those seeking a fragrance that bridges delicate florality with verdant freshness.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Violet Leaf

Middle notes: Mimosa

Base notes: Sandalwood

title: Flowers Turn Purple Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Flowers Turn Purple exemplifies Floraïku's mastery of aromatic composition, presenting a sophisticated woody-aromatic fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2018, this eau de parfum opens with the herbaceous brightness of basil, immediately establishing a fresh, culinary-inspired character. The heart reveals a delicate lavender accord that softens the composition with its classic floral elegance, creating an intriguing contrast between herbal and botanical elements. The base settles into warm amberwood, providing a creamy, woody foundation that grounds the fragrance and ensures lasting presence on the skin. This carefully balanced structure makes Flowers Turn Purple an ideal choice for those seeking a fragrance that transcends traditional gender boundaries while delivering both complexity and wearability throughout the day.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Basil

Middle notes: Lavender

Base notes: Amberwood

title: Volcanic Flowers Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Volcanic Flowers represents a bold collaboration between three acclaimed perfumers—Alienor Massenet, Philippe Paparella-Paris, and Symrise—resulting in Floraïku's 2020 oriental-spicy masterpiece. This unisex eau de parfum channels raw sensuality through its distinctive fusion of exotic florals and warming spices, creating a fragrance that defies conventional boundaries. The composition captures an intriguing duality: delicate floral elements intertwine with assertive spice accords, evoking the dramatic contrast between beauty and intensity. Designed for those who embrace complexity and depth, Volcanic Flowers delivers a memorable olfactory experience that evolves throughout the day, revealing new facets with each wear. This fragrance stands as a testament to Floraïku's commitment to innovative, gender-neutral compositions that challenge traditional fragrance expectations.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Spicy

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Bergamot Oil, Madagascar Ginger Oil, Olibanum, Pepper

Middle notes: Coffee Accord, Cardamom Oil, Cedarwood Oil, Clove, Gingerbread

Base notes: Lavender Absolute, Nutmeg Oil, Amber, Sandalwood, Leather, Chocolate

title: I Am Not a Flower Eau de Parfum
body_html:
I Am Not a Flower boldly defies floral conventions through its assertive woody composition. Built upon a foundation of ginger oil, oriental oil, and sandalwood oil, this eau de parfum establishes a distinctly masculine and introspective character that prioritizes depth over delicacy. The carefully selected precious ingredients work in concert to create an intense, lingering trail that commands attention and presence. Rather than relying on traditional floral sweetness, this fragrance embraces warmth, spice, and creamy woodiness to deliver a sophisticated olfactory statement. Ideal for those who reject conventional fragrance categories, I Am Not a Flower offers a refined alternative that celebrates complexity, longevity, and understated elegance. The collection emphasizes traditional extraction character and high-concentration formats, presenting pure, tactile materials—honeyed florals, sun-baked woods, balsamic resins, noble oud, and gilded spices—in concentrated forms meant for lingering, personal sillage. Crafted for collectors and ritual wear, Duna Secrets balances lavish depth with refined restraint, offering an immersive, long-lasting oriental experience suited to special occasions and contemplative evenings.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Resinous, Woody, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Designed for daytime glamour and refined evening wear, Louis XV 1722 Rosé projects regal warmth and romantic sophistication without excess.

Olfactive pyramid

Base notes: Vanilla, benzoin, sandalwood, soft amber, white musk

This composition places a polished floral bouquet at its center, where a noble rose and creamy white florals are brightened by fresh citrus and a hint of spice, then settle into a warm, ambery-woody base with a subtle powdery veil.
