As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth base of white musk, vanilla, amber, and soft woods, leaving a clean, warm, and long-lasting trail that feels graceful, modern, and naturally captivating.

Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity, Musky

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Citrus accords, juicy fruits
Middle notes: Soft florals, airy powdery facets
Base notes: White musk, vanilla, amber, soft woods

title: Vaillant Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Vaillant — Moudon is a bold, energetic, and confidently refined fragrance that blends vibrant citrus, aromatic spices, and warm woody-amber accords into a composition that feels powerful, modern, and effortlessly charismatic. It opens with an invigorating burst of citrus and spicy nuances, creating an immediate sensation of freshness, strength, and dynamic elegance. The heart unfolds into a smooth aromatic-woody accord enriched with herbal and subtly smoky facets, adding structure, depth, and a composed intensity that defines its character. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a rich base of amber, sandalwood, musk, patchouli, and precious woods, leaving a warm, woody, and long-lasting trail that feels commanding, polished, and distinctly masculine in spirit.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic, Amber

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Citrus accords, spicy nuances
Middle notes: Aromatic woods, herbal facets, smoky nuances
Base notes: Amber, sandalwood, musk, patchouli, precious woods

title: Tempio d'Acqua Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Tempio d’Acqua — Casamorati 1888 is a luminous, aquatic, and elegantly meditative fragrance inspired by the serenity of water and the timeless beauty of Italian artistry, blending marine freshness with soft florals and refined woods. It opens with a sparkling burst of citrus and aquatic accords, creating an immediate sensation of cool sea breeze freshness and crystalline clarity. The heart unfolds into a delicate floral composition enriched with aromatic and mineral nuances, adding softness, depth, and a tranquil sophistication that feels both airy and refined. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth base of musk, amber, and soft woods, leaving a clean, watery, and long-lasting trail that feels serene, elegant, and effortlessly sophisticated.

Fragrance family: Aquatic, Floral, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Citrus accords, aquatic freshness
Middle notes: Delicate florals, aromatic nuances, mineral facets
Base notes: Musk, amber, soft woods

title: Wave of Freedom Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Wave of Freedom — Jusbox is a vibrant, uplifting, and emotionally liberating fragrance inspired by the spirit of music festivals and the energy of open-air freedom, blending radiant citrus, aromatic herbs, and warm woods into a modern and expressive composition. It opens with a sparkling burst of citrus and fresh aromatic nuances, creating an immediate sensation of movement, positivity, and exhilarating freshness. The heart unfolds into a smooth floral-aromatic accord enriched with herbal and slightly spicy facets, adding depth, texture, and a carefree sophistication that feels energetic yet refined. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a warm base of amber, musk, cedarwood, and soft woods, leaving a clean, vibrant, and long-lasting trail that feels joyful, modern, and effortlessly charismatic.

Fragrance family: Aromatic, Citrus, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Citrus accords, fresh aromatics
Middle notes: Floral-aromatic accords, herbal nuances, soft spices
Base notes: Amber, musk, cedarwood, soft woods

title: Silver Ceremony Absolu de Parfum
body_html:
Silver Ceremony is a refined, luminous, and elegantly modern fragrance that blends sparkling citrus, aromatic spices, and smooth woody-musky accords into a composition inspired by sophistication and timeless celebration. It opens with a radiant burst of fresh citrus and crisp aromatic nuances, creating an immediate sensation of brightness, clarity, and polished elegance. The heart unfolds into a smooth blend of soft florals and aromatic spices, adding depth, texture, and a graceful warmth that enhances the fragrance’s contemporary character. As it settles, the composition reveals a clean and refined base of sandalwood, amber, white musk, and soft woods, leaving a smooth, airy, and long-lasting trail that feels luxurious, serene, and effortlessly distinguished.

Fragrance family: Woody, Aromatic, Musky

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Sparkling citrus, aromatic nuances
Middle notes: Soft florals, aromatic spices
Base notes: Sandalwood, amber, white musk, soft woods

title: Frutto Proibito Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Frutto Proibito — Fornasetti is a dark, artistic, and intriguingly sensual fragrance that explores the allure of forbidden temptation through a luxurious blend of ripe fruits, smoky woods, spices, and warm resins. It opens with a rich burst of juicy fruity accords and aromatic spices, creating an immediate sensation of mystery, warmth, and seductive sophistication. The heart unfolds into a velvety composition of dark florals and resinous nuances, adding depth, texture, and an almost theatrical richness that reflects the surreal artistic spirit of Fornasetti. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a powerful base of patchouli, amber, woods, musk, and smoky balsamic facets, leaving a warm, dark, and long-lasting trail that feels opulent, enigmatic, and deeply captivating.

Fragrance family: Oriental, Fruity, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Juicy fruits, aromatic spices
Middle notes: Dark florals, resinous nuances
Base notes: Patchouli, amber, woods, musk, smoky balsamic facets

title: Giardino Segreto Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Giardino Segreto — Fornasetti is a lush, elegant, and dreamlike fragrance inspired by the hidden beauty of an enchanted garden, blending radiant florals, green nuances, and soft woods into a refined and atmospheric composition. It opens with a fresh burst of green accords and sparkling citrus nuances, creating an immediate sensation of vitality, serenity, and natural sophistication. The heart unfolds into a rich floral bouquet filled with delicate white flowers and velvety petals, adding softness, romance, and an ethereal elegance that feels both timeless and artistic. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a smooth base of sandalwood, musk, amber, and soft woody nuances, leaving a clean, floral, and long-lasting trail that feels tranquil, luminous, and quietly sensual.

Fragrance family: Floral, Green, Woody

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Green accords, sparkling citrus nuances
Middle notes: White florals, velvety petals
Base notes: Sandalwood, musk, amber, soft woods

title: Contralto Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Contralto — Sospiro Perfumes is a rich, dramatic, and irresistibly addictive gourmand fragrance that blends sweet fruits, warm spices, and creamy oriental accords into a composition inspired by the depth and power of a contralto voice. It opens with a luscious burst of orange blossom, pink pepper, and sweet fruity nuances, creating an immediate sensation of warmth, brightness, and captivating elegance. The heart unfolds into a decadent accord of caramel and vanilla enriched with floral facets, adding velvety sweetness and luxurious depth that feels both comforting and opulent. As it settles, the fragrance reveals a sumptuous base of amber, musk, sandalwood, tonka bean, and precious woods, leaving a warm, creamy, and long-lasting trail that feels sensual, enveloping, and deeply sophisticated.

Fragrance family: Gourmand, Oriental, Floral

Olfactive pyramid
Top notes: Orange blossom, pink pepper, fruity nuances
Middle notes: Caramel, vanilla, floral accords
Base notes: Amber, musk, sandalwood, tonka bean, precious woods

title: Gold Supreme Bouquet Le Vestiaire Des Parfum
body_html:
Gold Supreme Bouquet — Yves Saint Laurent is an opulent and radiant white floral fragrance that embodies the brilliance, luxury, and sensuality of gold. Created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion, the composition centers around an intoxicating tuberose accord that is both creamy and luminous, capturing the warmth and richness associated with Yves Saint Laurent's iconic use of gold in fashion. The fragrance opens with a sparkling blend of bergamot, pear, and pink pepper, creating a vibrant contrast of freshness, juicy sweetness, and subtle spice. As it develops, a lavish floral heart emerges, where tuberose absolute is enriched by jasmine sambac and ylang-ylang, producing a rich, solar bouquet that feels elegant, seductive, and sophisticated. The base settles into a smooth blend of patchouli, ambery woods, and musk, adding depth, warmth, and lasting sensuality. The result is a luxurious and captivating fragrance that balances radiant florals with creamy richness and a glowing amber trail.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Amber, White Floral

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Pear Accord, Pink Pepper Essence
Heart Notes: Tuberose Absolute, Jasmine Sambac Absolute, Ylang-Ylang Essence
Base Notes: Patchouli Heart Essence, Ambery Woody Accord, Musks

title: Pulperia Pure Essense
body_html:
Pulpería — Fueguia 1833 is a refined and atmospheric woody-spicy fragrance inspired by the traditional Argentine pulperías—rustic gathering places where travelers, gauchos, and storytellers shared drinks, conversation, and music deep into the night. Created by Julian Bedel, the composition embraces minimalism, using only a few carefully selected materials to evoke a richly textured olfactory landscape. It opens with the dry, aromatic character of red cedar, immediately creating the impression of aged wooden walls and well-worn furniture. The heart introduces black pepper, adding a vibrant spicy warmth that recalls lively discussions and the spirited energy of late-night gatherings. As the fragrance settles, elemi resin emerges, lending a smooth balsamic quality with subtle smoky and resinous nuances that enrich the composition without overwhelming its elegant simplicity. The result is a distinctive scent that feels woody, spicy, and quietly leathery, capturing both the rugged authenticity and timeless charm of rural Argentina.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Spicy, Resinous

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Red Cedar (Cedro Rojo)
Heart Notes: Black Pepper
Base Notes: Elemi Resin

title: Quilombo Pure Essense
body_html:
Quilombo — Fueguia 1833 is a rich and comforting gourmand fragrance inspired by the spirit of freedom, celebration, and cultural fusion found within the historic quilombos of colonial Brazil. Created by Julian Bedel, the composition transforms the beloved aroma of dulce de leche into an elegant and artistic olfactory experience. The fragrance opens with a smooth and creamy milk accord that immediately evokes warmth and indulgence. As it develops, luscious caramel and Mexican vanilla emerge at the heart, creating a decadent blend of sweetness and velvety richness reminiscent of caramelized desserts and condensed milk delicacies. The dry down settles into a soft veil of sugar, enhancing the fragrance's addictive gourmand character while maintaining a refined and airy elegance. Despite its simplicity, Quilombo delivers remarkable depth and texture, capturing the nostalgic comfort of sweet treats with a sophisticated niche perfumery approach.

Fragrance Family: Gourmand, Oriental Vanilla, Lactonic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Milk
Heart Notes: Caramel, Mexican Vanilla
Base Notes: Sugar

title: Vetiver Fauve  Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Vétiver Fauve — Guerlain is a bold and sophisticated interpretation of vetiver that combines the raw elegance of earthy woods with the sensual warmth of amber and spice. Created by Delphine Jelk for the prestigious L’Art & La Matière collection, the fragrance draws inspiration from the untamed beauty of the animal kingdom, where instinct and refinement coexist in perfect harmony. It opens with a vibrant burst of fig, pineapple, and bergamot, bringing a luminous fruity freshness that contrasts beautifully with the darker facets to come. At its heart, smoky vetiver takes center stage, enriched by the aromatic spice of clove and the floral softness of rose, creating a textured and captivating depth. As the fragrance settles, the base unveils a rich blend of tonka bean, tobacco, and cistus absolute, leaving a warm, ambery, and subtly leathery trail that feels both powerful and irresistibly elegant. The interplay between bright fruits, smoky woods, and sensual resins results in a composition that is distinctive, refined, and deeply charismatic.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Amber, Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Fig, Pineapple, Bergamot
Heart Notes: Vetiver, Clove, Rose
Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Tobacco, Cistus Absolute

title: Do Son Limited Edition Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Do Son Limited Edition — Diptyque is a luminous and evocative white floral fragrance that captures the memory of sea breezes carrying the intoxicating scent of tuberose along the Vietnamese coastline. Inspired by Yves Coueslant's childhood summers in Do Son, near Haiphong, this limited edition interpretation preserves the timeless elegance of the original composition while presenting it in an exclusive artistic design. The fragrance opens with the delicate freshness of orange blossom and the subtle spice of pink pepper, creating an airy and radiant introduction. At its heart, tuberose unfolds in all its creamy splendor, accompanied by jasmine and rose, revealing a floral bouquet that is sensual yet remarkably refined. As the scent settles, benzoin and musk provide a soft, comforting warmth that enhances the velvety richness of the white flowers without diminishing their luminous character. Sophisticated and effortlessly elegant, Do Son Limited Edition evokes the tranquility of distant shores and the enduring beauty of blooming tuberose.

Fragrance Family: Floral, White Floral, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Pink Pepper
Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Rose
Base Notes: Benzoin, Musk

title: Ilha do Mel Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ilha do Mel — Memo Paris is a radiant and addictive fragrance inspired by the idyllic Brazilian island from which it takes its name, where golden beaches, lush vegetation, and the sweetness of wild honey create an atmosphere of effortless sensuality. The composition captures the warmth of sun-kissed skin and the carefree spirit of tropical escape, blending luminous florals with creamy vanilla and honeyed nuances. It opens with a sparkling burst of mandarin orange, hyacinth, and juniper berry, offering a fresh and aromatic introduction touched by subtle green facets. At its heart, jasmine absolute, iris, and orange blossom unfold into a soft and elegant floral bouquet, balancing powdery refinement with radiant femininity. As the fragrance settles, rich honey and creamy vanilla merge with musk, creating a warm, velvety trail that feels both comforting and irresistibly seductive. Bright yet enveloping, Ilha do Mel is a sophisticated expression of tropical elegance, evoking memories of sunlit shores and honeyed breezes.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Amber, Gourmand

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Hyacinth, Juniper Berry
Heart Notes: Jasmine Absolute, Iris, Orange Blossom
Base Notes: Honey, Vanilla, Musk

title: Moroccan Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Moroccan Leather — Memo Paris is a rich and captivating leather fragrance inspired by the vibrant soul of Morocco, where bustling souks, aromatic spices, and intricate craftsmanship create an atmosphere of timeless allure. The composition pays tribute to the artistry of traditional Moroccan leatherwork, blending smoky depth with luminous freshness and warm spice. It opens with the striking contrast of ginger and mandarin, delivering a burst of zesty brightness softened by aromatic nuances. At its heart, ylang-ylang and iris introduce a velvety floral elegance that enhances the fragrance's refined character while adding a subtle powdery sophistication. As the scent evolves, leather emerges in all its supple richness, intertwined with vetiver, musk, and styrax to create a smoky, resinous, and deeply sensual trail. The result is an opulent yet balanced fragrance that feels adventurous, sophisticated, and irresistibly evocative of Moroccan landscapes and traditions.

Fragrance Family: Leather, Spicy, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Ginger, Mandarin Orange
Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang, Iris
Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver, Styrax, Musk

title: Indian Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Indian Leather — Memo Paris is a majestic and vibrant leather fragrance that pays homage to the spiritual richness and colorful landscapes of India. Inspired by the ornate beauty of royal processions and the sacred significance of the elephant, the composition combines luminous florals, warm spices, and supple leather to create a scent that is both opulent and deeply evocative. It opens with the exotic radiance of davana, pink pepper, and mandarin, offering a fruity-spicy freshness with a subtly aromatic character. At its heart, osmanthus and rose unfold into a rich floral accord, where velvety petals intertwine with the apricot-like nuances of osmanthus to soften and elevate the composition. As the fragrance settles, a luxurious leather accord emerges alongside patchouli, cypriol, and musk, leaving a warm, smoky, and irresistibly sensual trail. Richly textured and elegantly balanced, Indian Leather captures the spirit of adventure and refinement with unmistakable sophistication.

Fragrance Family: Leather, Floral, Spicy

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Davana, Pink Pepper, Mandarin Orange
Heart Notes: Osmanthus, Rose
Base Notes: Leather Accord, Patchouli, Cypriol, Musk

title: Ocean Leather Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ocean Leather — Memo Paris is an invigorating and sophisticated leather fragrance that captures the meeting point between the vastness of the sea and the richness of supple leather. Inspired by the untamed beauty of oceanic horizons and the spirit of exploration, the composition contrasts sparkling marine freshness with deep woody warmth, creating a scent that feels both adventurous and refined. It opens with the vibrant brightness of mandarin oil, basil, and sage, delivering an aromatic wave of citrus and herbal energy reminiscent of sea air carried by the wind. At its heart, violet leaves and cedarwood introduce a crisp green elegance, adding texture and depth while maintaining the fragrance's luminous character. As it settles, the signature leather accord emerges alongside vetiver, nutmeg, and patchouli, leaving a smooth, spicy, and subtly smoky trail that evokes weathered sails and sun-warmed driftwood. Fresh yet sensual, Ocean Leather offers a distinctive interpretation of leather infused with the freedom and vitality of the open sea.

Fragrance Family: Leather, Aromatic, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Mandarin Oil, Basil, Sage
Heart Notes: Violet Leaves, Cedarwood
Base Notes: Leather Accord, Vetiver, Nutmeg, Patchouli

title: Argentina Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Argentina — Memo Paris is a vibrant and sensual floral-leather fragrance inspired by the passion, elegance, and rhythm of Argentine tango. Capturing the spirit of Buenos Aires, the composition dances between the intoxicating bloom of roses and the warmth of an ambery leather accord, evoking the intimacy and intensity of two bodies moving in perfect harmony. It opens with the sparkling freshness of pink pepper, ginger, and lemon essence, creating an energetic and luminous introduction enlivened by subtle spice. At its heart, an opulent Turkish rose absolute unfolds alongside jasmine sambac and magnolia, revealing a velvety floral bouquet that is both romantic and sophisticated. As the fragrance settles, a sensual base of leather accord, cypriol, patchouli, and amber emerges, leaving a warm, smoky, and irresistibly elegant trail. Richly expressive yet impeccably refined, Argentina embodies confidence, seduction, and the timeless allure of dance.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Leather, Amber

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Ginger, Lemon Essence
Heart Notes: Turkish Rose Absolute, Jasmine Sambac, Magnolia
Base Notes: Leather Accord, Cypriol, Patchouli, Amber

title: Candy from Strangers Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Candy From Strangers — Francesca Bianchi is a seductive and intriguingly playful fragrance that explores the magnetic tension between sweetness and temptation. Conceived as an olfactory reflection of unexpected attraction, the composition balances powdery elegance with sensual depth, transforming familiar comforts into something intimate and irresistible. It opens with a sparkling blend of bergamot, green mandarin, and aromatic lavender, offering a refined brightness that feels effortlessly inviting. At its heart, iris and violet create a velvety, lipstick-like softness, enriched by jasmine and a touch of raspberry that introduces a delicate fruity sweetness reminiscent of violet candies. As the fragrance settles, caramel and amber intertwine with patchouli, cedarwood, sandalwood, and supple leather, revealing a warm, slightly smoky trail that is both comforting and provocative. The result is a beautifully textured scent that feels elegant yet daring, sophisticated yet playful, capturing the thrill of attraction wrapped in a powdery gourmand embrace.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Floral, Musk

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Green Mandarin, Lavender
Heart Notes: Iris, Violet, Jasmine, Raspberry
Base Notes: Amber Accord, Patchouli, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Leather, Caramel

title: Memory of the Sun Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Memory of the Sun — Mizensir is a radiant and joyful fragrance that captures the carefree sensation of a sun-drenched summer afternoon by the sea. Created by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, the composition evokes the warmth of golden skin, the freshness of citrus-laden breezes, and the comforting sweetness of cherished holiday memories. It opens with a sparkling burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and petitgrain, delivering a luminous and invigorating freshness that immediately recalls endless blue skies and Mediterranean coastlines. At its heart, orange blossom unfolds with creamy elegance, enhanced by delicate floral nuances that add softness and sophistication. As the fragrance settles, warm cedarwood, white musk, and ambrox create a smooth and sensual trail, enveloping the skin in a clean, sunlit embrace. Bright yet comforting, Memory of the Sun beautifully balances freshness and warmth, offering an effortlessly elegant expression of summer nostalgia.

Fragrance Family: Citrus, Floral, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Petitgrain
Heart Notes: Orange Blossom
Base Notes: Cedarwood, White Musk, Ambrox

title: Lalibela Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Lalibela — Memo Paris is a rich and enchanting floral-amber fragrance inspired by the spiritual beauty of Lalibela, the sacred Ethiopian city renowned for its ancient rock-hewn churches and vibrant religious celebrations. The composition evokes an atmosphere of devotion and festivity, enveloping the senses in an opulent bouquet of exotic flowers wrapped in warm resins and creamy sweetness. It opens with the luminous elegance of rose, peony, and coconut orchid, creating a soft and velvety floral introduction touched by a subtle tropical nuance. At its heart, jasmine absolute intertwines with patchouli and labdanum, adding depth, sensuality, and a balsamic richness that enhances the fragrance's sophisticated character. As it settles, tobacco, incense, vanilla, and precious woods emerge to create a warm, smoky, and irresistibly comforting trail. Both mystical and refined, Lalibela balances radiant florals with sensual amber facets, resulting in a fragrance that feels timeless, elegant, and deeply captivating.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Amber, Oriental

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Rose, Peony, Coconut Orchid
Heart Notes: Jasmine Absolute, Patchouli, Labdanum
Base Notes: Tobacco, Incense, Vanilla, Precious Woods

title: V Eau de Parfum
body_html:
V — Robert Piguet is a timeless and sophisticated fragrance that beautifully bridges vintage glamour with modern sensuality. Originally introduced as Visa in the 1940s and later reimagined as V, the composition celebrates the spirit of adventure, elegance, and effortless confidence. It opens with a luminous blend of pear, bergamot, and peach, creating a juicy yet refined introduction that feels both vibrant and inviting. The heart unfolds into an exquisite floral bouquet of ylang-ylang, rose, and orange blossom, enriched with a subtle warmth that lends the fragrance its distinctive allure. As it settles, creamy vanilla intertwines with supple leather, sandalwood, patchouli, oakmoss, and vetiver, revealing a velvety dry down that is sensual, sophisticated, and deeply memorable. Balancing fruity radiance with floral elegance and a soft leathery warmth, V is both classic and contemporary—a fragrance of understated luxury and enduring charm.

Fragrance Family: Fruity, Floral, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Pear, Bergamot, Peach
Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang, Rose, Orange Blossom
Base Notes: Vanilla, Leather, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Vetiver

title: Bois Noir Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Bois Noir — Robert Piguet is a sophisticated woody-oriental fragrance that celebrates the allure of dark woods and warm balsams through a composition of understated elegance and quiet intensity. Originally introduced in 2012 as a reinterpretation of the house's classic Bandit spirit, the fragrance envelops the wearer in a rich tapestry of smoky woods, soft amber, and sensual musks. It opens with the dry refinement of cedarwood, creating an immediate impression of polished sophistication. At its heart, creamy sandalwood intertwines with earthy patchouli and the smoky nuances of guaiac wood, revealing a bittersweet depth that feels both comforting and mysterious. As the scent settles, amber and musk emerge to soften the composition, leaving a warm, velvety trail that lingers with effortless elegance. Rich yet remarkably balanced, Bois Noir embodies timeless masculinity with a modern, refined sensibility.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Oriental, Amber

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Cedarwood
Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Guaiac Wood
Base Notes: Amber, Musk

title: Un Bel Amour D'eteEau de Parfum
body_html:
Un Bel Amour d’Été — Parfum d'Empire is a radiant and nostalgic fragrance that captures the carefree romance of a fleeting summer love beneath the Mediterranean sun. Created by Marc-Antoine Corticchiato, the composition evokes golden afternoons, salt-kissed skin, and the intoxicating scent of blooming flowers carried by a warm coastal breeze. It opens with the sparkling freshness of bergamot and petitgrain, brightened by the juicy sweetness of peach that instantly recalls the abundance of sun-ripened fruit. At its heart, magnolia, rose, and jasmine unfold into a luminous floral bouquet, their velvety petals enhanced by delicate green nuances that lend elegance and natural grace. As the fragrance settles, soft musks intertwine with cedarwood and subtle amber accents, creating a smooth and comforting trail that lingers like the memory of a cherished holiday romance. Tender yet sophisticated, Un Bel Amour d’Été beautifully balances freshness, florals, and warmth in an ode to the magic of summer.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Fruity, Musky

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Bergamot, Petitgrain, Peach
Heart Notes: Magnolia, Rose, Jasmine
Base Notes: Musk, Cedarwood, Amber

title: To Vetiver Eau de Parfum
body_html:
To Vetiver — Comme des Garçons is a distinctive and contemplative interpretation of vetiver that reflects the house's avant-garde approach to perfumery. Created by perfumer Antoine Maisondieu in 2026, the fragrance explores the timeless nature of one of perfumery's most revered ingredients through an unexpected dialogue between aromatic herbs, earthy roots, and sacred resins. It opens with the vibrant contrast of black pepper and white thyme, delivering a cool, spicy freshness that feels both invigorating and meditative. At its heart, smoky vetiver intertwines with the balsamic richness of opoponax, revealing a textured accord that is earthy, resinous, and quietly sophisticated. As the fragrance settles, Ambrofix™, musk, and myrrh emerge to create a smooth, enveloping dry down, adding warmth and subtle sensuality while preserving the composition's elegant restraint. Minimalist yet deeply expressive, To Vetiver transforms a classic note into an introspective and modern olfactory experience that is both refined and unconventional.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Spicy, Aromatic

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Black Pepper, White Thyme
Heart Notes: Vetiver, Opoponax
Base Notes: Ambrofix™, Musk, Myrrh

title: Clifton Parfum
body_html:
Clifton — Adamo Parfum is a charismatic and sophisticated woody gourmand inspired by the breathtaking coastal beauty of Clifton Beach in Cape Town. The fragrance captures the contrast between sun-bleached landscapes, ocean breezes, and intimate summer memories, blending creamy fig with warm spices and velvety woods. It opens with the intriguing combination of cardamom, ripe fig, and juicy peach, creating an enveloping introduction where smoky spice meets the milky sweetness of fig. The heart reveals a refined fusion of creamy orris, orange blossom, and balsamic sandalwood, adding elegance and a soft romantic character to the composition. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, amber, vetiver, tonka bean, and vanilla unfold into a warm and sensual dry down, leaving a smooth, addictive trail that feels both comforting and sophisticated. Richly textured yet effortlessly wearable, Clifton evokes the nostalgia of unforgettable summer romances wrapped in understated luxury.

Fragrance Family: Woody, Gourmand, Fruity

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Cardamom, Fig, Peach
Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Orris, Orange Blossom
Base Notes: Cedarwood, Amber, Vetiver, Tonka Bean, Vanilla

title: South Of 5th Parfum
body_html:
South Of 5th — Adamo Parfum is an elegant and sun-drenched aquatic fragrance inspired by Miami's most exclusive coastal enclave, where the refreshing energy of the Atlantic Ocean meets the effortless glamour of golden sunsets. Created by perfumer Hamid Merati-Kashani, the composition captures the transition from salty sea spray to the warmth of an evening stroll along palm-lined avenues. It opens with an invigorating blend of marine accords, neroli, Siberian pine, and pink pepper, delivering a luminous freshness enhanced by aromatic and subtly smoky nuances. At its heart, the creamy richness of tuberose intertwines with Damask rose and the gentle spice of nutmeg, creating a refined floral accord that balances the fragrance's aquatic character with sophistication and depth. As the scent settles, Haitian vetiver, Indonesian patchouli leaf, Virginia cedar, and praline emerge to form a smooth and addictive dry down, where earthy woods and a touch of sweetness leave an irresistibly elegant trail. Fresh yet sensual, South Of 5th perfectly captures the spirit of modern coastal luxury and understated refinement.

Fragrance Family: Floral, Aquatic, Woody

Olfactive Pyramid
Top Notes: Marine Notes, Neroli, Siberian Pine, Pink Pepper
Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Tuberose, Damask Rose
Base Notes: Haitian Vetiver, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Virginia Cedar, Praline

title: Tawakkul Parfum
body_html:
Tawakkul — Adamo Parfum is a rich and sophisticated leather fragrance that embodies the beauty of trust, surrender, and quiet confidence. Created by perfumer Vincent Ricord, the composition unfolds like a deeply personal journey, balancing indulgent sweetness with dark sensuality and refined warmth. body_html:
Pure Musc For Her Eau de Parfum — Narciso Rodriguez is a refined and intimate floral-musky fragrance that celebrates the timeless beauty of the house's iconic musk in its purest and most luminous form. As it settles, cashmeran creates a smooth, woody foundation, adding warmth and depth while preserving the fragrance's soft, skin-like elegance. Originally created for the Duke of Windsor, the composition blends classic freshness with timeless sophistication, evoking the atmosphere of impeccably tailored suits, private gardens, and regal celebrations. At its heart, delicate rose takes center stage, softened by jasmine and tuberose to form a graceful floral bouquet that lends the fragrance its unmistakable elegance. title: Molecule 02 Eau de Toilette
body_html: Ambroxan is a laboratory-created molecule that has the same chemical structure as the ambrox produced from ambergris, which was once highly coveted in perfumery. This mysterious substance is expelled by the cachalot or sperm whale and only acquires its desirable scent after floating in the ocean for a long time. Today, natural ambergris is hard to come by, so modern fragrances use a synthetic equivalent of its aromatic compounds, with the finest being the nature-identical Ambroxan. Just like ambergris, Ambroxan exudes refinement and sensuality, making it a highly valuable ingredient in perfumery.

title: Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Crafted by the esteemed brand Creed, Millésime Impérial is an exquisite unisex scent that captures the essence of Sicily's sun-kissed citrus groves and picturesque coast. This invigorating blend features top notes of fruit and sea salt, accompanied by refreshing middle notes of lemon, bergamot, iris, and mandarin orange. The base notes of musk, wood, and marine elements add depth and allure to this citrus marine fragrance.

Fragrance family: Marine, Citrus

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Sea Salt and Fruity Notes

Middle notes: Sicilian Lemon, Bergamot, Iris and Mandarin Orange

Base notes: Sea Notes, Musk and Woody Notes

Delicately infused with soft musk and rich amber, this perfume evokes a sense of sensuality and dreamy vanilla. Warm, delicate, and divinely fresh, Erba Pura captures the essence of joie de vivre.

body_html:

title: Accento Eau de Parfum
body_html:

With initial hints of pineapple and hyacinth, this luxurious perfume boasts a timeless blend of jasmine, iris, and pink pepper. The subtle base of patchouli, amber, and musk adds a classic touch. Accento also comes with a one-of-a-kind silk neck scarf exclusively designed by Xerjoff and crafted by renowned silk makers in Lake Como.

Fragrance family: Chypre, Floral

Olfactive pyramid

Top notes: Pineapple and Hyacinth

Middle notes: Iris, Pink Pepper and Jasmine

Base notes: Musk, Amber, Vetiver, Vanilla and Patchouli
